Precepts: - Jeremiah 30:3 The days come that I will bring again the captivity of my people Israel and Judah, and I will cause them to return to the land that I gave to their fathers, and they shall possess it. We went over this last week. Now we know what Joel 3:1 is saying. - I will also gather all nations, and will bring them down into the valley of Jehoshaphat: that valley is in Israel, at the place called Har-Megiddo, where the name Armageddon comes from. Why in Israel? The Most High is making sure all nations hate Amalek, those fake Israelis; do you not see all nations condemning what they are doing and calling it a genocide? He will plead with them there for my people and for my heritage Israel, whom they have scattered among the nations and parted my land: they parted the land between the Arabs and the Edomites. - They have cast lots for my people: they bid on us, the same thing they are doing in these Arab countries. Given a boy for an harlot: they made the men into breeders. Sold a girl for wine, that they might drink. - What have ye to do with me, O Tyre and Zidon, and all the coasts of Palestine? Tyre and Zidon were the Hamite nations of Canaan back then; the coasts of Palestine, the ancient Philistines, is the modern name for the modern people there, the Arabs. Will ye render me a recompence? If ye recompense me, swiftly and speedily will I return your recompence upon your own head: what you did to my people, I will have done to you. Ye have taken my silver and my gold, and carried into your temples my goodly pleasant things: they robbed our wealth and our temples. - Here is the part to highlight: the children of Judah and the children of Jerusalem have ye sold unto the Grecians, that ye might remove them far from their border. Tyre, Zidon and the Palestinians, the Arabs, sold us to the Grecians, the white man. Precepts: - Amos 1:9-10 For three transgressions of Tyrus, and for four, I will not turn away the punishment thereof; because they delivered up the whole captivity to Edom, and remembered not the brotherly covenant. The same people delivered us to Edom, whom Joel calls the Grecians. I will send a fire on the wall of Tyrus, which shall devour the palaces thereof: the wall of Tyrus is the land, and you see that land catching hell today, and the Arabs are there too. - Behold, I will raise them out of the place whither ye have sold them: the Most High will raise up the Israelites from the places you sold us, back to verse 1, and bring us back to our homeland in freedom. And will return your recompence upon your own head: how did they recompense us? By selling us as slaves. So I will sell your sons and your daughters into the hand of the children of Judah, and they shall sell them to the Sabeans, to a people far off. Eye for eye, tooth for tooth. For the Lord hath spoken it. Christians, you cannot change this Bible; the way they recompensed him by selling us, the same judgment comes on them. 2 Esdras 15:21-26 161:46 - Verse 21 goes back to Joel 3:7: like as they do yet this day unto my chosen, so will I do also, and recompense in their bosom; the same word Joel used, payback to them. My right hand shall not spare the sinners, and my sword shall not cease over them that shed innocent blood upon the earth. The fire is gone forth from his wrath and hath consumed the foundations of the earth, and the sinners, like the straw that is kindled. - Now this is a message to us: woe to them that sin and keep not my commandments, saith the Lord; I will not spare them. Why is he saying that? Because you have doctrines springing up even among Israelites: you do not have to keep the commandments, grace, grace, the Most High does not care what you eat or how you dress. They are trying to fuse Christian lies with the truth of the Bible. Woe means destruction, great sorrow through being put to death. - Go your way, ye children, from the power, defile not my sanctuary. You have some people complaining; it says do not defile the sanctuary. If you do not want to do what the Bible says, just leave. For the Lord knoweth all them that sin against him, and therefore delivereth he them unto death and destruction. That is the final outcome. 2 Esdras 7:13-18 163:48 - The entrances of the elder world were wide and sure, and brought immortal fruit: the elder world is paradise, where Adam was. If then they that live labour not to enter these strait and vain things, they can never receive those that are laid up for them. The strait things are the hard things; we have to go through trials and tribulation. You come into this truth and say, I do not want to be persecuted, I do not want to go through anything; then you can never receive what the Most High has laid up for you. - Why disquietest thou thyself, seeing thou art but a corruptible man? Why hast thou not considered in thy mind this thing that is to come, rather than that which is present? Ezra answered: O Lord that bearest rule, thou hast ordained in thy law that the righteous should inherit these things. That is what your word says; we are supposed to inherit the earth. But that the ungodly should perish: the ungodly among us. - Nevertheless the righteous shall suffer strait things, and hope for wide: the righteous shall suffer tribulation and hope for paradise, the kingdom. For they that have done wickedly have suffered the strait things, and yet shall not see the wide: the Israelites who do not keep the commandments still suffer the tribulation, and they are not going to get the kingdom, the new world coming. 2 Esdras 16:68-78 166:35 - The burning wrath of a great multitude is kindled over you, and they shall take away certain of you, and feed you, being idle, with things offered unto idols. Christianity is the number one idolatrous religion, followed by Islam. The idle brothers and sisters in here and online will give way to the Christian lies. Why? Because you are idle: not studying, not praying, and surely not applying anything. You are just here. - They that consent unto them shall be had in derision and in reproach, and trodden under foot: when you give way to that idolatrous religion, they use you for what they can and then put you to death. - There shall be in every place, and in the next cities, a great insurrection upon those that fear the Lord: that is great tribulation. They shall be like mad men, sparing none, but still spoiling and destroying those that fear the Lord. They are going to look for those keeping the commandments, those wearing fringes with the border of blue, women wearing head coverings, black and brown people. They shall waste and take away their goods, homes and properties, and cast them out of their houses. - Then shall they be known, who are my chosen, because the chosen are not going to give in or blaspheme against the Lord; and they shall be tried as the gold in the fire. It is going to be a major test. - Hear, O ye my beloved, saith the Lord: behold, the days of trouble are at hand, but I will deliver you from the same. Write this down: Jeremiah 30:7 says the same thing, the time of Jacob's trouble, but he shall be saved out of it. Be ye not afraid, neither doubt; for God is your guide. Why does it say neither doubt? Because when we see the death and tribulation our people are going to receive, it will make us doubt: is God really with us? Why is he allowing all this? Regardless of what happens, do not be afraid and do not doubt. - Let not your sins weigh you down: many times we sin, and Satan gets in your spirit and says you are of no value to God, you might as well keep sinning, do not get back up. And let not your iniquities lift up themselves: when you start meddling with the old man, your sins rise up in you all over again. - Woe be unto them that are bound with their sins, and covered with their iniquities like as a field is covered over with bushes, and the path thereof covered with thorns, that no man may travel through. Once your iniquities lift up themselves there is a point of no return; no scripture we can give you, no fasting can help you, because now you are bound in your sin, covered from the top of your head to the bottom of your feet. The only way through a walkway covered with thorns and thistles is to chop it up and burn it so you can see the pavement beneath. That field is left undressed and is cast into the fire to be consumed therewith. - Clip played on what we just read: the White House has created an FBI joint mission center dedicated to proactively pursuing Americans suspected of domestic terrorism. The budget request lists anti-Americanism, anti-capitalism, anti-Christianity, support for the overthrow of the United States government, extremism on migration, on racism, on gender, and hostility towards those who hold traditional American views on family, religion and morality. So a domestic terrorist is anti-Christianity; that sounds like us. Anti-Americanism, because we teach that Babylon is going to be destroyed. Hostility means: sister, cover yourself; brother, stop kissing that man, go get you a woman. They call correcting sin hostility. The request says domestic terrorists use social media platforms, smaller websites and encrypted chat applications to recruit and radicalize. In other words, if your political views are practically anything other than the current administration's, you are on notice, courtesy of the FBI. They already have their law set in place. Revelation 17:5-18 173:27 - Upon her forehead was a name written, Mystery. Why does it say mystery first? Because when we tell our people the United States of America is Babylon the Great, they say you are insane, Babylon the Great is Iraq; America feeds us, gives us education and religion. Babylon the Great, the mother of harlots and abominations of the earth: her whole church system, Catholic, Protestant, Episcopalian, Baptist, Anglican, Lutheran, Christian nationalism, all fall under America and her religions, and everything that comes out of America's mouth, her religions and her democracy, is an abomination to the Most High; it is always contrary to what the Bible says. - I saw the woman: the woman is America. Picture shown: the Statue of Liberty in the harbor, a woman holding a torch, saying she is the light of the world and her religion and politics are what all the world should follow. Drunken with the blood of the saints and with the blood of the martyrs of Jesus: America is going to do a lot of killing, and based on what the young man was reading, the law is already in place. When I saw her, I wondered with great admiration: John was shocked at all the killing he saw. - The angel said, I will tell thee the mystery of the woman, and of the beast that carrieth her, which hath the seven heads and ten horns: NATO and the EU. The beast that thou sawest was (in your vision), and is not (not currently in existence), and shall ascend out of the bottomless pit (come out of Europe), and go into perdition (destruction). This is America. And they that dwell on the earth shall wonder, whose names were not written in the book of life: all the wicked of our people love Babylon the Great. When they behold the beast that was, and is not, and yet is: it is just like Rome. - Here is the mind which hath wisdom. The seven heads are seven mountains, seven kingdoms, on which the woman sitteth; America is supported by them. And there are seven kings: five are fallen by the time John wrote this; one is, that is Rome, the empire in existence when John wrote; and the other is not yet come, and when he cometh, he must continue a short space: write that down, that is Britain. And the beast that was, and is not, even he is the eighth, and is of the seventh: America came out of Britain. Britain was the seventh, America is the eighth, and goeth into perdition. - The ten horns are ten kings which have received no kingdom as yet in John's day, but receive power as kings one hour with the beast: economic and military power; America shared her technology with these nations. These have one mind, and shall give their power and strength unto the beast: they support America in all her ventures. These shall make war with the Lamb, and the Lamb shall overcome them, for he is Lord of lords and King of kings, and they that are with him are called, and chosen, and faithful. - The waters where the whore sitteth are peoples, and multitudes, and nations, and tongues: they made themselves a great melting pot here. - Now watch: the ten horns which thou sawest upon the beast, these shall hate the whore. Wait a minute. Verse 12 said they gave their power and strength unto the beast; after World War II all these nations supported the United States. But something is going to happen to make NATO and the EU turn against America. Do you not see it in the news? America says help us bomb Iran; NATO says no. And we remember what you said about Greenland, which Denmark owns; that is against the articles we signed. You said you want to take Canada; that is against the articles. Now America puts tariffs, meaning taxes, on everybody. Those nations are sitting back saying, this is an evil country; she is the devil the Bible speaks of. - These shall make her desolate and naked, and shall eat her flesh, and burn her with fire: NATO is going to turn on this country and burn her flesh with nuclear fire. For God hath put in their hearts to fulfil his will, and to agree, and give their kingdom unto the beast, until the words of God shall be fulfilled. The Most High put it in their minds to agree to this treachery against Babylon the Great. - And the woman which thou sawest is that great city, which reigneth over the kings of the earth. Here is the point: America is the world's superpower, not the Vatican. 2 Esdras 15:43-45 183:02 - They shall go stedfastly unto Babylon, that is America, and make her afraid. They shall come to her, and besiege her; the star (the missile) and all wrath shall they pour out upon her; then shall the dust and smoke go up unto the heaven, and all they that be about her shall bewail her. Everybody around America is going to cry when they see it. Here is the precept. Precepts: - Revelation 18:9-10 The kings of the earth who have committed fornication and lived deliciously with her: you did business with America, you got rich, you did America's bidding. They shall bewail her, and lament for her, when they shall see the smoke of her burning, standing afar off for the fear of her torment, saying, Alas, alas, that great city Babylon, that mighty city, for in one hour is thy judgment come. It is the same wording as Esdras, and chapter 18 comes after the chapter 17 we just read. - And they that remain under her shall do service unto them that have put her in fear: prisoners of war. 2 Esdras 15:46-60 185:05 - And thou, Asia, that art partaker of the hope of Babylon, and art the glory of her person: that includes China, North Korea, who have the bombs, and Japan. They all envy America. America has neocolonialism; China is doing the same thing, and China took the technology America has; that is how they built those nukes. - Woe be unto thee, thou wretch, because thou hast made thyself like unto her, and hast decked thy daughters in whoredom: their daughters are their businesses and corporations, that they might please and glory in thy lovers, the nations that always desired to do business with them. Thou hast followed her that is hated in all her works and inventions; the inventions came from America. Therefore saith God, I will send plagues upon thee: widowhood, poverty, famine, sword and pestilence, to waste thy houses with destruction and death. The glory of thy power shall be dried up as a flower when the heat shall arise that is sent over thee. Thou shalt be weakened as a poor woman with stripes, and as one chastised with wounds, so that the mighty and lovers shall not be able to receive thee: nobody will be able to help you. - Would I with jealousy have so proceeded against thee, saith the Lord, if thou hadst not always slain my chosen, exalting the stroke of thine hands, and saying over their dead, when thou wast drunken? A lot of us do not know the history of our people being enslaved in China, Korea and those countries; that history is hidden, but slowly we have been uncovering it. The first samurai were black; those were Israelites. They got them drunk at a party, and when our people were drunk, they killed them. - The reward of thy whoredom shall be in thy bosom; therefore shalt thou receive recompence. Like as thou hast done unto my chosen, saith the Lord, even so shall God do unto thee, and shall deliver thee into mischief. Thy children shall die of hunger, and thou shalt fall through the sword; thy cities shall be broken down, and all thine shall perish with the sword in the field. They that be in the mountains shall die of hunger: they have people in bunkers up in China. And eat their own flesh, and drink their own blood, for very hunger of bread and thirst of water. - Thou as unhappy shalt come through the sea, and receive plagues again: come through the sea is their navy. And in the passage they shall rush on the idle city, and shall destroy some portion of thy land, and consume part of thy glory, and shall return to Babylon that was destroyed. Put the map of the military bases back up. Although this country is prophesied to be burned with fire, the party is not over; America still has bases across the earth. The American military is going to destroy a portion of Asia, China, Japan, and consume part of their glory; then that same military shall return to Babylon that was destroyed. They are going to say, Houston, we have a problem: Revelation 17 said this place gets burnt up. That is why Christ has to come; to take her down ultimately, only the Most High can do it. 2 Esdras 11:37-46 191:10 - We close with this. A roaring lion chased out of the wood, that is Christ, sent out a man's voice, the prophets, unto the eagle: Art not thou it that remainest of the four beasts, whom I made to reign in my world, that the end of their times might come through them? That fourth beast was the eagle. The Lord made them reign in his world, and the end of times shall come through this eagle. Precepts: - 2 Esdras 6:9 For Esau is the end of the world, and Jacob is the beginning of it that followeth. Did we not read about those twelve Caesars? They were all Edomites, from that time to this time. The eagle represents Esau; the end comes through Esau. - The fourth came, and overcame all the beasts that were past, and had power over the world with great fearfulness, and over the whole compass of the earth. America today has power over the whole world; put the bases back up. That map represents the whole earth; America is everywhere. Rome did not have this, but America does. With much wicked oppression: not with righteousness. What did Captain Ibrahim Traore say about democracy? It kills. They put democracy in Libya and look at Libya today, destroyed; Somalia, destroyed. And so long time dwelt he upon the earth with deceit: everything that comes out of that man's mouth in the White House is a lie. - For the earth hast thou not judged with truth: America set herself up as the police of the earth, but she has not judged the earth with truth. For thou hast afflicted the meek, that is Judah; thou hast hurt the peaceable, that is the northern kingdom. I am going to prove that. Precepts: - 2 Esdras 13:12 Afterward saw I the same man come down from the mountain, and call unto him another peaceable multitude. - 2 Esdras 13:39 And whereas thou sawest that he gathered another peaceable multitude unto him: those are the ten tribes. So thou hast hurt the peaceable is the kingdom of Judah and the kingdom of Israel, the northern kingdom. - Thou hast loved liars: if you lie, you can be their friend, a senator, a mayor; they sat in Congress and lied, especially about the Epstein files, all of them lying. And destroyed the dwellings of them that brought forth fruit, and hast cast down the walls of such as did thee no harm: the northern kingdom here did them no harm, and they said destroy them, and enslaved them. - Therefore is thy wrongful dealing come up unto the Highest, and thy pride unto the Mighty. What you did to the peaceable and the meek of the earth has come up before the Most High, and he has considered it. The Highest also hath looked upon the proud times (the time of their technology), and, behold, they are ended, and his abominations are fulfilled. - And therefore appear no more, thou eagle, nor thy horrible wings, nor thy wicked feathers, nor thy malicious heads, nor thy hurtful claws (the militaries), nor all thy vain body (the citizens). This is the end of the eagle. That all the earth may be refreshed, and may return, being delivered from thy violence, and that she may hope for the judgment and mercy of him that made her. That is you and me right there. With that, brothers, twelve tribes; and with that we say shalom. In Closing America is the new Roman Empire: the same Senate, the same articles of war, the same coups d'etat, the same taxation, the same architecture, the same gods with new names, and the same eagle. The Most High made the eagle to reign so that the end of their times might come through them, and the same book that gives you the twelve Caesars in order tells you the eagle appears no more, that all the earth may be refreshed. Do not be afraid, neither doubt; be tried as the gold in the fire, and do not let your sins weigh you down. Announcements & References Books referenced in class: - The Story of Civilization, Caesar and Christ, by Will Durant (Christ the greatest revolutionist in history; the Latins named Africa) - Dr. William Smith's Dictionary of the Bible, 1896 (Edom proceeded the kings of Italy; Julius Caesar and Titus as Idumeans) - The New Testament World in Pictures, by William H. Stephens (Titus, the siege of Jerusalem, Jews set against wild beasts, the prisoners of Smyrna, the gladiators) - History of the Jews (Septimius Severus and the war against the Samaritans and Jews) - Jews vs. Rome: Two Centuries of Rebellion Against the World's Mightiest Empire, by Barry Strauss - Documentary: The Panama Deception (on YouTube) Field reports played: - IUIC visited the Lions Renaissance Festival in Houston, Texas, where the people received the word with openness; a bystander said, "When we see y'all in purple and gold, we see real men." - Captain Michael of IUIC TV and the Lions Den radio show did a hidden history and black history presentation at Silverstar Christian Church; the young men were intrigued to learn their true nationality, and Bishop Nathanyel was set alongside Marcus Garvey, Malcolm X and Martin Luther King Jr. as a leader of the so-called blacks, Hispanics and Native Americans. - The Prophets of the Northwest sat down with a local podcast, Blackish in Spokane, to discuss mixed identities, racial belonging and black unity; subscribe to IUIC Spokane 2.0. - IUIC Gastonia held a Marriage Is Honorable western night, emphasizing love, order and leadership according to the scriptures. - Isaiah 11:11 Ministries: subscribe to IUIC Diaspora 2.0 and email to join the international mission; twelve tribes worldwide. - Booster Club mission 189, led by Captain Zephaniah and Captain Laquat, brought the word to the Dominican Republic on the national TV platform La Tora TV, where imaginations were cast down; when the image of Christ came out, the darkest brother in the room protested that his face was white, but the scripture says his head and his hairs were white like wool, not his face. Subscribe to IUIC Dominican Republic and IUIC Haiti. Donate to the Booster Club. - Booster Club appeal: many brothers and sisters outside the States depend on us to help them keep the Passover; the captains are going all over to celebrate with them, and fuel is sky high. We have to help them with food, buy lambs, and rent places to keep the Passover. Faith without works is dead; we must work together for it to come to pass. Scan the QR code and give what you can, and do not forget Original Royalty. - Original Royalty: Sitting on My Throne, the first video from Ben Zion Judah and Judah Blood off their album Royalty in My Veins, dropping May 23; the Royal Standard Maxi Collection for sisters, coming soon in youth and women's sizes; the Royal Range collection in premium cotton and sheepskin leather; and the LM Royal Heritage Jacket, available now in two colors at originalroyalty.com. - The new moon Lit Challenge entry from IUIC OKC. - Marriage Is Honorable is coming to the West Coast: a night of connection, joy and renewal for building and nourishing godly marriages, open to single brothers and sisters as well; see your rep to register. - Men's Conference 2026: registration is open for serious-minded brothers; leadership is for serious-minded brothers, and space is limited. The conference is meant to exhort and inspire the men to persevere through trials and to reach the pinnacle of power, where we can run this earth in righteousness. - Another marriage done right: may the Lord bless the union of Officer Michelle and our sister with love, peace and many children. Dates: Passover is April 16 at sundown; keep it with joy. The next congregational fast is April 24 at sundown; get a fast in before Passover night. Closing reading: 1 Corinthians 11:23-30, the bread and the cup, in remembrance of the Lord's death till he come; let a man examine himself. --- Class Notes Index Transcript: full session

title: Armageddon: Islam and the Armies of the East
text: Introduction Opening prayer: Blessed be the Lord God of Israel. Lord, we come before you on the Sabbath day asking for mercy upon the twelve tribes of Israel scattered throughout the four corners of the earth, and upon your elect in these war-torn countries. Look over us and protect us as you send these plagues on the earth: war, famine, death, destruction. Take away from us the stony heart and put inside of us your spirit, the spirit of repentance and the spirit to love our neighbors as ourselves; take away all guile and all malice. Strengthen the leaders and the congregation, that they may stand strongly in this truth. You prophesied there will be death, destruction, wars and famine; give us the ways and means to prepare, and protect us from all our enemies that seek to destroy this truth; make them fall and never rise again. Heal the brothers and sisters that are sick amongst us. Everybody say hallelujah. Happy Sabbath, Israel. I love when the Sabbath comes around; it is the day you can rest up and strengthen your spirit. But you all see what is happening in the world: wars, death, famine. As I see these things happening, that is all on my mind. So today's topic is Armageddon: Islam and the Armies of the East. I see a lot of things in the news, and I am telling you, we do not have long again on this earth to prepare. Things are going to get worse and worse. When you heard there was a ceasefire, some of you said yes, the war is going to stop. No, it is not going to stop. Nobody is going to stop the wars that the Most High prophesied. You heard the president took a peace deal for Iran; the treacherous dealer dealt treacherously. Thumbnail video: a montage of the armies with the chant, "Free our land. We stand united. We demand justice now. We will not be silenced. Let us rise up against her in battle. We stand together." Shout out to Jersey for the thumbnail. In The News Clip played: after the so-called peace deal between America, Israel and Iran, Israel carried out heavy strikes across Lebanon. Over 150 bombs fell, hospitals are begging for blood donations, casualties reach the thousands, and the reporter says the strikes were overwhelmingly on civilians; a funeral in the Bekaa was bombed. France, Spain, Egypt and Pakistan confirmed Lebanon was part of the ceasefire; Israel claims it was targeting Hezbollah in populated areas of Beirut. Iran says if this continues the ceasefire is off and it will come to the help of Lebanon. - So the synagogues of Satan are massacring people in Lebanon, the same thing they were doing in Palestine. They are doing the will of the Most High. Some of you see this on the news and say, that is wrong; some of you feel sorry for the Lebanese people. Let us go into the scriptures and I will show you why. Clip played: the president saying he was not going to start wars, then saying, "We bomb the crap out of it, then we leave. What did we get? We got nothing." And on Iran: "We are going to hit them extremely hard over the next two to three weeks. We are going to bring them back to the stone ages where they belong. We are giving them till tomorrow 8:00 Eastern time, and after that they are going to have no bridges, no power plants." - You see the contradiction. He said there would be no wars, that the other side would take you to war; now he is going to make you fight Iran. And you know they made the draft registration automatic for ages 18 to 25; you no longer have to sign up. Why? Because they realize the American army is not as strong as they thought, and they understand war is coming. - The Iranian people are Persians, Elam; they are a very smart people. The US government thought it would do to Iran what it did to the Arab countries, and the Persians showed they are not the ones to play with. - He gave them till 8:00 and said he is about to destroy a whole civilization. These people are evil, but he is fulfilling the will of the Most High. Scriptures Opened 2 Esdras 15:20-21 17:49 - Behold, saith God, I will call together all the kings of the earth to reverence me, from the rising of the sun, from the south, from the east, and Libanus. Libanus is Lebanon. To turn themselves one against another: that is what the Most High wants to take place. He wants all of them, Lebanon and all of them, to turn against each other and fight each other, and repay the things that they have done to the Israelites. - Like as they do yet this day unto my chosen: even in the time of Ezra, Lebanon and all the nations we were amongst were dealing evil with us. The Lord told Ezra, the evil you see them doing to my chosen to this day, I am going to repay in the future; I am going to bring all of them to fight against each other. So when you see Iran, America and all these wars, the Lord is behind it. When I see little kids getting bombed, it plays with your emotions as a man, because you have kids. But we have to understand it is the judgment of the Most High. Amos 1:9-11 19:11 - Tyrus is Lebanon; Tyre was a city in Lebanon. For three transgressions and for four: remember, visiting the iniquity of the fathers upon the children unto the third and fourth generation. So this is a generational curse; the judgment is going to be generational. - I will not turn away the punishment thereof, because they delivered up the whole captivity to Edom. The Lebanese delivered us up to Edom, the white man; they had a role in our enslavement too. They hide these histories and you forgot, but the Most High never forgets. And remembered not the brotherly covenant: we had a covenant with the people of Lebanon; they paid us tribute, and they broke it. - But I will send a fire on the wall of Tyrus, which shall devour the palaces thereof: that is what you see taking place today, missiles and bombs being dropped on Lebanon, devouring those cities. Then it goes on to Edom. - Understand this about Palestine: there will be no two-state solution. The Israelis will always control Palestine; a yoke will be put on the Palestinians, and if any government is set up it will be puppets. Isaiah 14:8 22:36 - The fir trees rejoice at thee, and the cedars of Lebanon, saying, Since thou art laid down, no feller is come up against us. This is the prophets, us, speaking after we are delivered from America; the chapter is about the king of Babylon being destroyed. Lebanon is rejoicing because since America and Israel are destroyed, no feller comes up against them. What does that tell you? America and Israel are going to keep fighting with Lebanon; from time to time they will keep bombing and destroying Lebanon, and try to do to Lebanon what they did to Palestine. Daniel 8:25 27:35 - Through his policy also he shall cause craft to prosper in his hand; and he shall magnify himself in his heart, and by peace shall destroy many. That is what America does and what you see the president doing: he keeps talking about setting up peace, and he is dropping bombs and killing world leaders and civilizations. By peace shall destroy many: he says, I want peace, let us negotiate, and while you are negotiating with him he bombs you. That is what you saw in Lebanon this week; they said they got a peace deal, and the following day the Israeli government bombed the Lebanese people. - He shall also stand up against the Prince of princes, that is Christ; but he shall be broken without hand. That is a future prophecy. This is not just talking about Antiochus in the past; that same system he set up is going to be back in these last days. - Now the topic. That leader they are waiting for is going to gather all Muslims together; not all Arabs, all Muslims, Pakistan, Iran. You always ask, when we read 2 Esdras 15, why do the Carmanians join with them? Because the Carmanians believe the same thing they believe. Somebody is going to say, let us rise up against Israel and America in battle: a leader among the Arabs, because of the oppression and affliction on the Arabs. And I think that leader, that Mahdi, might be Ishmael coming back. - Behold, I have made thee small among the heathen; thou art greatly despised. Israel and America will be greatly hated. Do you not see that today? Everybody hates the synagogues of Satan for the evil they are doing; not just Arabs, Spain, all nations, saying how can they carpet bomb everybody with no remorse. But the Lord is behind that; let them keep afflicting Ishmael so that leader can rise up and say, let us rise up against them in battle. That is the beginning of World War III. Joel 3:1-2 152:13 - In those days, when I shall bring again the captivity of Judah and Jerusalem, I will also gather all nations, and will bring them down into the valley of Jehoshaphat, and will plead with them there for my people and for my heritage Israel, whom they have scattered among the nations, and parted my land. The land is parted between the Palestinians and those who call themselves Jews but are not. The valley of Jehoshaphat is the land of Israel; the valley of Jehoshaphat is also what is called Armageddon, where all armies are gathered to fight against the land of Israel. Armageddon is not in China and not in Europe; the third woe takes place in the land of Israel. 2 Esdras 15:28-33 154:16 - When Obadiah says let us rise up, that ideology, the Mahdi returning and an army rising to fight: they got that from the scriptures. Behold an horrible vision, and the appearance thereof from the east, where the nations of the dragons of Arabia shall come out with many chariots, and the multitude of them shall be carried as the wind upon earth, that all they which hear them may fear and tremble. The dragons of Arabia are the Arabs of the Arabian peninsula. This is all Arabs united under one leader, the leader they have been waiting for, whom they call the Mahdi. - Also the Carmanians raging in wrath: angry because of what the American government is doing to them right now; shall go forth as the wild boars of the wood, and with great power shall they come, and join battle with them. Why would they join the Arabs? Because they have the same ideology; they believe the Mahdi will return and bring justice to Islam, they believe the black flag will be raised, and whoever rises up and says let us rise up against her in battle, they will believe that is the Mahdi. - And shall waste a portion of the land of the Assyrians. It says the land of the Assyrians because, the same way the Assyrians took our land in the past, today you have Gentiles in the land of Israel. A portion of the land of Israel will be destroyed; that is Bible prophecy. - And then shall the dragons have the upper hand, remembering their nature: the Muslims are going to have the upper hand for a time. That nature goes back to Ishmael; the Most High made him a warrior whose hand is against every man, and they will die for what they believe. And if they shall turn themselves, conspiring together in great power: all Muslim countries conspiring together to persecute them, the Israelis, the synagogues of Satan. Then these shall be troubled, and keep silence through their power, and shall flee: the Israelis will keep silence before that power of all Muslims uniting. That is what the real Muslim religion is about: bringing in that apocalyptic event, Ishmael fighting against every man and every man's hand against him. And from the land of the Assyrians shall the enemy besiege them. Zechariah 14:2-3 158:28 - I will gather all nations against Jerusalem to battle, and the city shall be taken. This is future prophecy: the Muslims are going to capture the city. When you look into their prophecy, they prophesy planting the black flag in Jerusalem, and say that ushers in the coming of Christ, and then that Christ becomes a Muslim and destroys the Christians. I think they make their stuff up as they go, reading the scriptures. But the Bible says the city shall be taken, and the houses rifled, and the women ravished, and half of the city shall go forth into captivity, prisoners of war, and the residue of the people shall not be cut off from the city. Armageddon is Jerusalem, the place of troops. Then shall the Lord go forth and fight against those nations: the Lord comes down during this destruction. The Arabs will take that land back for a short time. - Read from the screen: the conquest of Jerusalem was foretold by Muhammad as a sign indicating the approach of the day of judgment, recorded in Sahih al-Bukhari, hadith 3176; the prophecy lists the conquest alongside a plague and a truce with the Byzantines, and the capture of the city is considered a major milestone signaling the end times. So real Muslims consider it their duty to go to war and take back that city; that is why they keep chanting death to Israel. Muslims believe Jerusalem has to be conquered by Muslims. There is no reasoning with that. Do American Muslims and the Nation of Islam think like that? No. But the real Muslims, the Shia and the Sunni, that is how they think. Zechariah 12:2-3 164:43 - Behold, I will make Jerusalem a cup of trembling unto all the people round about, when they shall be in the siege both against Judah and against Jerusalem. And in that day will I make Jerusalem a burdensome stone for all people; all that burden themselves with it shall be cut in pieces. That is what you see taking place today. Everybody that burdens themselves with it, saying let me go help the Israelis, let me go help the Palestinians, let me go help the Lebanese, gets involved and is broken in pieces. The Palestinians burdened themselves with it, saying we want to create a state of Palestine here, and look what came upon them. Anybody who gets involved with the land of Israel is going to be broken; America is going to go over there, and they will be broken too. Jerusalem is that burdensome stone, because Jerusalem is also called Armageddon. - I am going to stop there; Deacon Malachi is coming up next. Brothers and sisters, I hope you got something out of that lesson. Stop following Islam. The whole reason of Islam is to bring in the apocalyptic event, World War III. That is the real meaning of it. In Closing The Most High declared the end from the beginning. He said we would serve wood and stone in our captivity, and we did: Christianity and Islam, the two biggest religions on the earth, both new gods that came newly up, whom our fathers feared not. He said Ishmael would be a wild man whose hand is against every man, that he would have twelve princes, and that the dragons of Arabia and the Carmanians would rise from the east and have the upper hand for a time. What Islam calls the Mahdi and the army of the black flags is Bible prophecy fitted to their own narrative: the kings of the east prepared, all nations gathered against Jerusalem, and the city taken, until the Lord goes forth and fights against those nations. Do not cry for the nations under judgment, do not burden yourself with Jerusalem, and do not follow the Arab man's religion any more than the white man's. Watch, and keep your garments. Announcements & References Booster Club: Captain OC announced the Booster Club is open again. Many of you reached out and nobody got back to you; that is because they were trimming down. They are only looking for the best members, the elite, to join. Email the IUIC fundraiser address with your name, your camp, and how long you have been with IUIC. Read from the screen in class: the differences between Sunni and Shia Islam; the trans-Saharan slave trade (seventh through twentieth centuries, 10 to 20 million people); the doctrine of the Mahdi and the twelfth imam; the countries east of the Euphrates; Megiddo and Har Megiddo; and Sahih al-Bukhari hadith 3176 on the conquest of Jerusalem. Clips played: the strikes on Lebanon after the ceasefire; the president on Iran; the UAE foreign minister on Europe and Islam; Secretary of State Marco Rubio on the Mahdi and the final showdown; several Mahdi videos circulating online, including the black flags of Khorasan; and Iran and prophecy. --- Class Notes Index Transcript: full session

title: MAKING OUR FACE HARDER THAN THEIR FACE
text: Introduction Opening prayer: Father, we come into your presence this morning on your holy Sabbath day to ask forgiveness for our sins. Thank you for sending your son to die for our sins. We pray for all of us who are struggling and fighting to become the perfect man, the perfect woman, the perfect child that you designed us to be, to do your work; that we succeed according to your word by following your commandments, and that we be a good light to those out in the world, so they see there is hope in following your commandments and not the ways of the world, not depending on America or any other nation to save us. We pray for all who are seeking your word, that the seed planted in them gets watered, and that they understand that in the day of judgment it is between you and them only. Destroy the plots of the enemy who work to keep your people from your commandments; make them fight against each other and leave us alone. Protect all who are traveling around the world for the Lord's Passover, and let this class edify everybody. In the name of Christ, amen. Happy Sabbath, Israel. If you are still asleep this morning, it had better be for the Lord. This is the holy Sabbath; let us make it honorable and reverence the sanctuary and the unity of the Lord. Thumbnail: making our face harder than their face. Their face is the face of the wicked. We must prepare to make our faces harder than the faces of the wicked, because you see what is happening in the earth: the wicked are revealing themselves, and the ones the Most High has chosen have chosen their side. Slowly the Lord is revealing that it is go time; it is time for the righteous to step up, because the wicked are getting bolder and bolder. Like we talked about last night, the line in the sand has been drawn. To you who are comfortable in Babylon, the Lord is making it known that the wicked are stepping up, so likewise the children of light must step up. In The News Video played: at the United Nations General Assembly, draft resolution A/80/L.48, declaring the trafficking of enslaved Africans and racialized chattel enslavement of Africans the gravest crime against humanity, was adopted with 123 in favor, 3 against, and 52 abstentions. The three against were the United States, Argentina and Israel. From the video: the word enslaved does not carry the full context, because the law of the time gave the legal right not only to own a human being but to sexually violate and murder them, so enslavement should also remind you of sex trafficking, human trafficking and murder. The 52 abstaining nations were largely the colonizers, sitting this one out on the world stage. The US delegate's explanation of the no vote: the United Nations exists to maintain international peace and security, not to advance narrow agendas or create costly new mandates; the US does not accept that historical facts from the fifteenth through nineteenth centuries constitute violations of jus cogens as understood in contemporary international law, and does not recognize a legal right to reparations for historical wrongs that were not illegal under international law at the time; and the president has done more for black Americans than any other president and enjoyed historic support from the black community in the 2024 election. - Captain: I hope you are listening. That goes on his checklist; they deem that as doing for the black community while our community is so dilapidated. Photo shown of Christians in the White House praying for the president; that is what emboldens them: look, they love me. They remember the stimulus check, and our people are still waiting on another one. Remember the white Christian nationalist who said slavery was a blessing to the negro; that is the same religion those brothers and sisters are following. - Why is slavery on the topic at all right now? Because the watchmen are on their A game, constantly edifying the people. We are the slaves; the nations dragged us and used our strength to build their cities and nations, and the Lord is not letting the nations forget it. This is spiritual; I hope your spiritual eyes see the work of the servants of the Most High pushing this truth through the four corners. Video played of a commentator asking, sarcastically, in what way could this country be improved by making it more like Haiti, and his guest answering: we would not want a Marine invasion and occupation that decapitates governments and takes the money out of the country, or the debt France saddled Haiti with after the revolution, a colony the entire West spent two hundred years punishing; the host replied that at a certain point a country has to stand on its own two feet. Captain: you hear the disrespect. They destroy a whole country and then say stand on your own two feet, the same way they told us to pull ourselves up by our bootstraps while forgetting the enslavement of the Native American and of our ancestors. Martin Luther King said it is telling a bootless man to strap up his boots. In 1915 they took Haiti's gold and removed the president; when Haiti tries to trade and lease machinery to build, they hit it with an embargo. That is their pattern: be the destroyer, then fly in and play the hero. Article read in class: a New York Times report, citing eleven current and former military and administration officials, that the Secretary of Defense struck the names of two black and two female officers from a military promotions list, and that his chief of staff told a military leader the president does not want to stand next to a black female officer at military events. Captain: at the UN they said he works hand in hand with the black community; but you still want to send your children to serve a nation that despises you. Video played of US soldiers doing a TikTok dance after the strike on the Ayatollah: we are on the brink of war, and this is what they are doing; how are other nations supposed to take that seriously? That is how you know Babylon is in decline, the age of decadence. Those are the ones dispatched for a ground invasion, put on the front line as human shields; the nations know what the American military is about and say, we are ready. Video played of a preacher declaring that God obeys him, and that anyone who does not obey him is stupid. Captain: this is the blasphemy we are up against; are you studied to show yourself approved, or will he convince you? He shows which god he really serves by his actions. Video played: the British government blocked Kanye West from entering the country over his comments about Jewish control of the media and the swastika shirts, and he apologized, citing bipolar disorder, in a sit down where he said he wanted to take accountability. Captain: he was not wrong when he said the media is controlled and we are the children of Israel; but he apologized and went back, dismayed, because he had roots in Babylon and the cares of this world. That is why the Lord said it is hard for a rich man to enter the kingdom: hundreds of millions of dollars is a lot of hooks. Note the hand placement in the clip, dominance on one side and submission on the other. He did not count the cost. Book read in class: New World Jewry, 1493 to 1825: Requiem for the Forgotten, by Seymour B. Liebman. The passages read state that Jewish merchants were the largest ship chandlers in the Caribbean, that the shipping business there was mainly a Jewish enterprise, that many of those ships carried slaves from Africa to the thirteen colonies, the British Caribbean and the Spanish colonies, and that Jews were traders and masters while blacks were merchandise, slaves and servants. Captain: those goods included our bodies. That is why the vote went the way it did; they know what they had a hand in. And then you have one of our people asking, where are the ships? That is how you know they are void of understanding. Scriptures Opened Romans 15:4 6:04 - Everything written aforetime by our forefathers was instruction given to us. Through patience: this is not a swift race; you have to pace yourself, and if you fall you get back into the fight. And comfort of the scriptures: we find our comfort in the scriptures, and that is why we make it our business twenty four seven. We are not giving the wicked among our people any rest; constantly you hear the word of the Most High and the good news being professed. That we might have hope: we need that hope now especially, because the wicked among our people and the wicked of the nations are gearing up for battle. Are you ready for battle, or are you comfortable in your captivity, complacent with the nine to five, the bonus, the big house, at ease in Babylon? That time is over; the Lord is stirring it up. - The president is handpicked; Satan has chosen his champion. But the wicked among our people have yet to choose. We have to let it be known who our God is, who our king is, and what our constitution is: the Bible is our constitution. Ecclesiasticus 33:14 8:51 - Good is set against evil, and life against death. This world is full of death; the only thing that has life is the scriptures. So is the godly against the sinner, and the sinner against the godly. This is the battle we are in today. The sinners are powering up, invading one another and creating laws against each other, mustering for the battle to come against us, and a lot of our people are still in la la land. Which side do you choose: a servant of the Lord, which leads to life, or a servant of Satan? Deuteronomy 11:26-30 10:27 - I set before you this day a blessing and a curse: the contract of the battle. A blessing if ye obey the commandments; if you want to enlist with the Lord, you have to obey the commandments. A curse if ye will not obey, but turn aside out of the way to go after other gods. It is set before you: wake up out of your slumber and be introduced to the path of life, or stay asleep and die with the rest of them. You can live it up and party, or choose to suffer with your people, which leads straight to life, and be used by the Most High to go into those dark ghettos and wake up the young brother and young sister depending on you. It is up to you. Ezekiel 2:3-7 11:50 - Son of man, I send thee to the children of Israel. Over and over the prophets are set to a task and dispatched to their own people, through the generations; the mission is in full effect. A rebellious house that hath rebelled against me: they chose this world, rejected the life and rejected the commandments, they and their fathers, even unto this very day, 2026. We are still in the midst of that same battle; that is why the prophets have been dispatched again. - Whether they will hear or whether they will forbear: we do not care; the Lord is preparing us. Some of our people are so hard headed they will hear this good news and reject it, they love this wicked world so much. Yet shall they know that there hath been a prophet among them: they will know when the trouble comes, because the scriptures are the only guideline that gives hope, and people without a guideline are led into darkness and chaos. - Be not afraid of them, neither be afraid of their words. Our people are full of words; they will curse you out and slander you quickly. Even when we come with words of righteousness, brother, you are the chosen people, repent, put down the guns, edify your people, raise your children, marry your wives, they hate us for that. They hate this mighty word that has life in it, the doctrine of life. Proverbs 4:2-7 14:39 - I give you good doctrine; forsake ye not my law. Let thine heart retain my words: keep my commandments, and live. So the doctrine is the laws of God, the commandments of God. - Get wisdom, get understanding, forget it not, neither decline from the words of my mouth. Decline means to pull back. We have brothers and sisters who have declined, taken their hand off the plow; they were introduced to the mighty heritage, you are the Israelites, the sons of God, and then the cares of this world and the lust of the flesh took them out of here. That is when you hear the complaints: I am overwhelmed, cap. There is no better place to be overwhelmed than for the Lord; you would rather be overwhelmed for your nine to five, invest more in this world than in the Lord? Overwhelmed from editing videos to wake up your people, from traveling, from teaching brothers who are brand new? That is a shame. - Forget it not, because the Lord is constantly looking for those who will retain the knowledge and be dispatched to wake up the lost who do not have that understanding. Wisdom is the principal thing; therefore get wisdom, and with all thy getting get understanding. They go hand in hand: thou shalt not steal is the wisdom; the understanding is, I used to walk in that lifestyle and I am not doing it anymore, and now I can be used to teach the next brother who is battling that. Not just hearing the word and letting it go in one ear and out the other, not letting wisdom sit in you: you learn it and you apply it. So you cannot be a professional student. Come in, get involved, join the curriculum set in place to make us better men, better fathers, better leaders. - Neither decline from the words of my mouth: the mouth of God is this Bible. But who is he using to edify the people and the nation? Baruch 1:21 18:56 - We have not hearkened unto the voice of the Lord our God, according unto all the words of the prophets. That is who is teaching; that is who the Lord uses to project and teach his word, as it is written and exactly as he instructed us to bring it out. So we do not want anyone to be a professional student: once you come into this truth and put on that purple shirt, you go ahead and prophesy and teach the people. Learning the laws is part of getting rid of twenty, thirty, forty years of nonsense; but once you learn it, you have to do something. Ecclesiasticus 19:20 20:22 - The fear of the Lord is all wisdom, and in all wisdom is the performance of the law. Get the gunk of Christianity out of your brain: they say, yes, God said do not do this, but we can do whatever we want. Fearing God is all wisdom; if a king decrees something and you go against it, that is your behind. The decree of the Most High is this Bible; when he says thou shalt not, we have to know there is a punishment. When you learn thou shalt not, love thy brother, go into all the world and teach, how to deal with each other, the Most High says perform it. Because when the sky cracks and the black Messiah and the legions of angels come down, practice time is over. Even if you have only been here six months, you had better have been performing the law; there is no more forgive me at that point. It is death, and he moves you out of the way for those who were serious. - And the knowledge of his omnipotency: he knows the end from the beginning. I say this to the Christians: if the kingdom is for everybody, why did the Most High build the kingdom of heaven with twelve gates named for the twelve tribes of Israel? Before he made Adam, before a tree or a goat, he knew his people would be in the place he created before anything was here. So how does everybody fit in there? You are saying God does not know what he is talking about. 2 Timothy 2:15-16 23:30 - Study to shew thyself approved unto God, not unto man; he is the one who makes the selections. Come up out of the sin, the drug dealer, the harlot; come get cleaned up and master this. A workman that needeth not to be ashamed, rightly dividing the word of truth. You have a nation depending on you; you have been activated in your perimeter. You have wicked family members breaking the laws of the Most High, and the homeboy you used to do wickedness with is depending on you to wake him up so his soul is not snatched away. So you have to show yourself approved. - Definition read in class: dismay describes feeling shocked, disappointed, disheartened, or distressed, typically due to unexpected bad news or negative situations. This is what happens most of the time, brothers: they decline; they get discouraged or dismayed. In camp 101 they think, I can slaughter John 3:16, I can smash this Christian; but once it is go time and you hit the streets, we put a brother up on the corner for fifteen minutes, the crowd rises up against him and he does not know what to do; he is looking to the side, somebody save me. Or someone takes him to Nicodemus and all the scriptures go out of his brain, and now he wants to lay hands on the person, because he has not studied to show himself approved. He has the wisdom part but has not mastered it, and we know that takes time; that is why we put the pressure on you in camp 101. We have these systems in place for a reason. - Back to Ezekiel 2:5-7: whether they will hear or forbear. We know it hurts when they do not listen: mom, you should not be eating that pork, the Lord said do not do it; boy, leave me alone. Yet shall they know a prophet has been among them; the Lord is giving you comfort right there: they are going to find out, just do not stop preaching the word and giving the correction. Be not afraid of them nor of their words: you are going to get cursed out, slandered, told on at your job, here is his Facebook, this is him. The Lord said do not be afraid of that. Though thou dost dwell among scorpions: scorpions are poisonous, and he compares them to the wicked who can possibly kill you. When we go to camp, into the highways and byways, we are risking our lives. Thou shalt speak my words: but how are you going to speak his words if you have not mastered them? If you do not have the genuine spirit to use the words of the Lord to wake up that drug dealer and get that harlot cleaned up and modestly dressed, if your intention is only to cut up a Christian, roll over men, and be in high places, you will be confounded and dismayed by them. You are going to be shocked when the crowd comes up: who are you talking to, we are trying to twerk. Disappointed because the bulk of them do not believe you. Distressed: am I really supposed to be doing this, am I bothering these folks? Your family will say, dad, I am catching heat at school, do you have to wear those fringes every day? Your job will call a meeting about this purple and gold thing. You are going to be distressed. But be not dismayed at their looks. Nehemiah 8:8 30:23 - They read in the book of the law of God distinctly, and gave the sense, and caused them to understand the reading. You hear the law, thou shalt not steal; now this is what it means, and this is when you apply it. See the importance of studying to show yourself approved, mastering and applying the scriptures. - Video played, a social experiment: a man walks around with an envelope of fake money asking people, did you drop this? An older church mother takes it, claims it as hers, hands him two dollars as a reward, says there were no fives in there, and refuses to give her name. Notice the face of the little boy with her: she just taught him it is okay to lie, and you can see in his countenance that he knows it is wrong. Then watch who cosigns her: the wicked move in bulk. The woman next to her says, you gave it to her, she gave you a reward, leave her alone, when she saw everything and knows the envelope is not hers. Then the man in front says it is his, and she says he was trying to steal it while she was going to bring it to the counter. You see how the lie multiplied? Caught in one sin, now you have to lie to cover it. Once that money is tucked away it is going to the house; she was already loading up the cart. And she was in that line to get aid for the children's Easter egg program. These are Christians, church mothers. This is why you have to master these scriptures, because you will be tried. Ecclesiasticus 5:5-6 36:34 - Concerning propitiation, be not without fear to add sin unto sin. You saw how it escalated: from claiming the money as hers, to her sister lying for her, to her lying again about bringing it to the counter. Sin unto sin. And say not, his mercy is great, he will be pacified for the multitude of my sins: that is what a Christian would say. But without repenting, how would you receive mercy? You have to confess, then repent. For mercy and wrath come from him: Christians say he is merciful but forget the wrath. He is a God of love, but he is also a God of judgment; the Lord loves judgment. You want to be found among the judges, not among the judged. 1 Thessalonians 4:12 38:35 - That ye may walk honestly. You claim to be a follower of Christ, and now you are caught, and it is going everywhere through your whole community; the church mother in that video is going to have to face her church. Those are the same ones who afterward will curse us out on the corner: why are you picking on me, go bother the white neighborhood, do not judge me. Listen, if we do not stop you now, you could go to jail; that was stealing, and that could have been someone's bill money. Your integrity is out the window. Now imagine brothers and sisters in Israel doing the same thing, and the videos catch you: no, I did not take that phone, that was not me. Do not be caught like that. Stay on your A game; your words and your actions must match. 1 Samuel 2:3 40:39 - Talk no more so exceeding proudly, I am covered by the blood, I am a Christian; let not arrogancy come out of your mouth: for the Lord is a God of knowledge, and by him actions are weighed. Your actions are examined by the Lord. If you are not filling yourself with the commandments of God and studying to show yourself approved, then your actions follow who you really worship, and debauchery and all manner of wickedness follow that. If you truly follow the God of this Bible, your actions will follow. Your actions are weighed every day; when you wake up you have a choice, continue on the path of righteousness or fall back, and judgment is waiting. Brothers who go into the highways and byways teaching our people to repent: do not stop; our people are depending on you. Satan is always on his A game; we have to stay on ours. Jeremiah 50:7 45:52 - After the UN vote video: all that found them have devoured them, and their adversaries said, we offend not. That is why they voted against it; to them what they did through slavery, destroying us and taking our culture, was nothing wrong. Because they have sinned against the Lord: it is your fault; that is how they always turn it. The habitation of justice, even the Lord, the hope of their fathers. Daniel 9:11-12 52:00 - All Israel have transgressed thy law; therefore the curse is poured upon us, the curses of Deuteronomy 28:15-68, and the oath written in the law of Moses, because we have sinned against him. We violated the contract our forefathers accepted; we all said yes to the commandments. He hath confirmed his words which he spake against us by bringing upon us a great evil, for under the whole heaven hath not been done as hath been done upon Jerusalem. That great evil was done to Israel; there is a mark on the chosen people. Everybody suffered some form of slavery, but not the type we did: our names erased, our women violated, that sex trafficking the video described, still going on to this day. And then you want to be coerced with fast food and the bonus at your nine to five. The whole nations are talking about it because the Lord is not going to let them forget, and we cannot let them forget. Ecclesiasticus 12:10-12 59:07 - Never trust thine enemy. They have systems in place to keep you oppressed, generation after generation: black codes, Jim Crow, convict leasing, laws purposely set to put you in prison and then lease your labor to companies. We show you over and over, but you do not want to believe it. For like as iron rusteth, so is his wickedness; though he humble himself and go crouching: his humbling is deceiving you. Here is a stimulus check, here is housing, food stamps, a high paying job, a scholarship, then make you the boss; sure, we are all the same. Yet take good heed and beware of him; take good heed means be careful. Thou shalt know that his rust hath not been altogether wiped away. Set him not by thee: do not put him beside you, and do not envy his wealth or his power, because the power reserved for us is unimaginable. - They say, you cannot talk to an Israelite, all they do is go to the scriptures. You are right, because what I say on my own might be stupid, but when the Lord says it, what are you going to do? They know they cannot fight against God. We tell you they hate you, and the scripture shows it, and then the Lord activates it and makes it come to life. 1 Maccabees 2:10 1:01:27 - What nation hath not had a part in her kingdom, and gotten of her spoils? Almost every kingdom had a hand in our demise and enslavement. That is why they cannot stop talking about it; the Lord constantly reminds them, and he is using his servants in the highways to teach the atrocities that happened to us and pull our people out of the fire. The Lord does not want to destroy his people; he wants their deliverance. But some of them are so hard headed they have to go. Psalms 83:1-4 1:02:10 - Keep not thou silence, O God; hold not thy peace, and be not still. Our forefathers saw this: Lord, do something. For lo, thine enemies make a tumult, and they that hate thee have lifted up the head. They hate us and make it known over and over with their systems. You, the so called working class, make just enough to make it to next week; as soon as the money comes in the bills are lined up to take it, the police are lined up in your own community with the citation, red light and speeding cameras all over our neighborhoods and none in theirs, where there are trees, parks and health food markets while our community gets a fast food place across from another fast food place. That money does not belong to you. And then our people idolize this kingdom because of a bonus check. We owe this whole world. It hurts to see our people glorify this kingdom; that vexes us to keep fighting, because the light at the end of the tunnel is our kingdom and our rulership. - They have taken crafty counsel against thy people, and consulted against thy hidden ones. They have said, come, and let us cut them off from being a nation. They made it their business to cut us off from being a nation. - Deacon: the main reason America and Israel voted against that resolution is that they know who the slave masters and ship owners were, who owned and insured the ships; if they say slavery was the worst atrocity, they have to point the finger there. That is also why the president dodges when it comes to Netanyahu: he said ceasefire, and the next day it was announced Lebanon was not part of the ceasefire. Psalms 64:8 1:11:16 - After the Haiti clip: so they shall make their own tongue to fall upon themselves; all that see them shall flee away. That is why he was stuttering. They reveal their own evil out of their own mouths, and the Lord is manifesting the evil and the righteous right now, so we have no excuse about which path to take, like the captain read in Deuteronomy 11:26. 2 Thessalonians 2:3-6 1:15:54 - Deacon: if you Christians still do not know who the devil is, the Bible reveals him right now. Paul says two things must take place before the second coming: a falling away first, and that man of sin be revealed. The falling away: all twelve tribes fell, in 70 AD. And the man of sin revealed: that is what we are doing right now, the Israelites are on the prophecy revealing him. The son of perdition, who opposeth and exalteth himself above all that is called God, so that he as God sitteth in the temple of God, shewing himself that he is God. That is how you know who it is talking about: who today has painted himself as Christ and is worshipped as God, when the majority of black churches have a white painted image of Christ? We did not paint ourselves; we just read what Revelation 1:14 says Christ looked like. Ezekiel 3:7-9 1:22:55 - The house of Israel will not hearken unto thee, for all the house of Israel are impudent and hardhearted; whether in the blasphemy of Christianity or in twerking and every form of debauchery, their conscience is seared. Behold, I have made thy face strong against their faces, and thy forehead strong against their foreheads. The Lord said, I am going to have you double up: strong against them, fortified, ready to take down the evildoers. How is it going to be strong? You are going to be well studied and know how to genuinely apply what you studied; wisdom and understanding go hand in hand. As an adamant harder than flint have I made thy forehead. - Fear them not, neither be dismayed at their looks. That is why we constantly show you these videos: to prepare you for the battle and to harden you against their wickedness. Because some of you see this and get dismayed and disheartened, and some of you have said, you know what, I give up: here is my purple shirt, take my fringes off, go smoke a little weed, make that phone call, go all out; a sister takes off the dress, puts on the pants, and then you see her on Facebook twerking. We have seen it. - Though they be a rebellious house: Israel is a rebellious house, and we are called to be revolutionaries, to be strong. When you examine the revolutionaries, they were all strong and prepared to be imprisoned for what they were doing for their community. - Video played, an interview with Bobby Seale of the Black Panthers on being thrown in the hole: no bars, a box seven feet by five with a thick steel door, a cold floor with no bed, a hole in the floor, and sewage that would back up and flood the cell so he had to stand until it receded and then sit back on the floor. Asked how he kept sane, he said when you are a revolutionary they cannot break your spirit that way; the real thing is understanding the psychology of the guards, who themselves could never stand to be in there. Captain: they put you in conditions they themselves could not take; that is how you know there is a strong spirit on the nation of Israel and on the true revolutionaries. He also told how Huey Newton, in the hole for leading a strike for better food, refused the green mush for two days, and a brother on the night shift who knew him brought him sandwiches every night, so that in the morning he was doing push ups when they came with the slop. So brothers who are correction officers: do not use your position to abuse your own brothers in there; there are videos of brothers doing that. Your brother might be a true revolutionary, and we might depend on you to sneak us a piece of bread. That is why we fast often, every other week, declaring fasts among each other; we are rehearsing for Jacob's trouble, which is coming soon. 1 Samuel 10:6 1:30:21 - The Spirit of the Lord will come upon thee, and thou shalt prophesy with them, and shalt be turned into another man. If we keep our carnal selves we will not sustain psychologically what they do to us; but if we keep the commandments and the faith in Christ, and are turned into another man, the spirit of Christ, then whatever we go through, we will endure it. This is our lot. This is why we have to keep the commandments and go with the Lord's doctrine we read in Proverbs 4:2, his laws, statutes and commandments. - Do not think we are not going through Jacob's trouble, that we are getting beamed up by the chariots. Sorry, it is not happening that way; we have to go through the suffering, as our forefathers went through it. That is the ticket for our salvation and our entrance into the kingdom. Jeremiah 20:9 1:31:43 - Then I said, I will not make mention of him, nor speak any more in his name: that is Jeremiah experiencing being dismayed at all the work he was set to. But his word was in mine heart as a burning fire shut up in my bones; I could not stay. That is the course we are setting: our faces hardened with the word of God. Precepts: - Jeremiah 1:5-8 He tried to run away from it and the Lord did not let him. Like most of us: we see the task at hand, but we have not been fortified to see how important the mission is. Before I formed thee in the belly I knew thee: the Lord sent a search party for you; he knew since the womb what he created. I sanctified thee, and I ordained thee a prophet unto the nations. Then said I, Ah, Lord God, behold, I cannot speak, for I am a child: I do not know much, I am weak, I am nobody. Most of my brothers have that same weak spirit; shake it off. The little that you know, that you mastered Deuteronomy 28 and breaking down John 3:16, the Lord can use; now apply it and let the Lord do his work. Give the Lord something to work with. Say not, I am a child: stop making excuses. Thou shalt go to all that I shall send thee, and whatsoever I command thee thou shalt speak; we are bound by that. Be not afraid of their faces: the same thing we just read in Ezekiel; same task, same mission. For I am with thee to deliver thee: that power with us is unstoppable. Brothers, gird up your loins. Judith 9:1-4 1:34:38 - Sisters, this is for you too; there is no sitting on your hands saying, I am just going to have babies, I have nothing to do. Judith fell upon her face, put ashes upon her head, and cried with a loud voice. Sisters, you have to cry with a loud voice: while we are out there prophesying and going in the scriptures, you need to be praying for the prophets, praying for the children to get their minds right, praying for our nation to rise up. - O Lord God of my father Simeon, to whom thou gavest a sword to take vengeance of the strangers who defiled the maid: that goes to Simeon and Levi destroying the nations for Dinah. This is a sister praying, Lord, take vengeance on the nations. Thou gavest their rulers to be slain, so that they dyed their bed in blood: she is thinking of Psalms 149; she is not praying a Hail Mary, she is praying for vengeance. Their wives for a prey and their daughters to be captives: she is thinking of Isaiah 14; and all their spoils to be divided among thy dear children, all their money and lands given back to the nation of Israel. Which were moved with thy zeal, and called upon thee for aid: O God, O my God, hear me also a widow. So sisters, you should be praying like no other, three times a day, sweating, asking the Lord to bring vengeance on the nations. Do what we are doing, on your side. Jeremiah 38:6-9 1:40:47 - One of our forefathers was thrown in a pit: they cast Jeremiah into the dungeon of Malchiah and let him down with cords, and in the dungeon there was no water, but mire; that is dung. Jeremiah sunk in the mire. And Ebedmelech the Ethiopian went to the king: these men have done evil in all that they have done to Jeremiah the prophet, and he is like to die for hunger. The Lord made a way for him, because Jeremiah was set: I am not holding back my tongue anymore, the fire is shut up in my bones; I have to bring the correction and warn the king despite my life. When you step before a king with unpleasant words, as a messenger you might forfeit your life on the spot. - Captain: people might think the Bobby Seale video was just the sixties; we are reading that Jeremiah was in a dungeon, a hole, where the dung came up and he could not avoid it. The same thing, scripturally; it is not far fetched. The Lord constantly reminds us of the mission: do not get comfortable here; you are set on a task. Just as the nations chose their champion, we must constantly declare our champion, Christ the King, the black Messiah. Stay on the mission. - As we go through this class, men and women in this truth: you are going to have to make a choice, and the hardest thing you will have to fight is you. You will tell yourself it is not worth going ten times more for God, that you do not have to get your wife and your kids in order. The hardest person to fight is you, fighting your sins and the things that will keep you from the kingdom. We all need to get ourselves together before that sky cracks. - Video played of a UFC champion visiting an orphanage in his own country: after the photo, a little girl whispers to him that her whole family was wiped out; most of the children in the audience are orphans because their parents were killed in the bombing, and she runs off in tears, and the champion, trying to keep it together, breaks down. Captain: a champion with all the accolades and money, and that smile turns into tears for the state of his people; his face began to be hardened. This is not about smiles and giggles; what matters is the estate of my people. Those are the ones the Lord is looking for. Ezekiel 9:4 1:47:33 - Go through the midst of the city, through the midst of Jerusalem, and set a mark upon the foreheads of the men that sigh and that cry for all the abominations that be done in the midst thereof. They understand the state of the people and cry constantly; they do not hold their peace. That is a mark set on the servants of the Lord. There are moments we enjoy and delight in each other, our wives, our children, the brotherhood; but when it is time for the Lord's business, we know the mission is the kingdom, and we do not have time to play. - Video played from Haiti: Bishop Canaan holding up a speaker with Bishop Nathanyel teaching in the midst, surrounded on all corners, hot, no place to hold post; it was raining so we relocated under a shelter and did not stop the work. We walked down five, six, seven flights of stairs into the mountains, deep down into the middle of a voodoo festival, surrounded, teaching morality, because what the wicked stumble at is the moral law and the ceremonial law, idolatry, vexing the Most High to his face. In the valley, teaching our people to return, repent, come back to the one true God and the Bible; why are you in the midst of darkness? Those are the ones with the mark, who sigh and cry. They even took our flyers and stuck them in the stumps of the trees to try to put something on us. It does not work; we understand the scriptures.
