Precepts: - Numbers 23:23 Surely there is no enchantment against Jacob, neither is there any divination against Israel. Voodoo and roots are enchantment; it does not work on us. But step outside the zone and use it yourself and you will be bugged out of your mind, clucking like a chicken. Zodiac signs are divination too; we are not supposed to be in the midst of that; it is against the commandments of the Most High. Psalms 94:16-20 1:56:34 - Video played of a black man on the street: the reason your communities are all messed up is that you men have not stood up and straightened out the problems; who do you think is going to fix it if you men do not, some other man? You hand your authority to somebody else to clean up your problems and want to call yourselves men. Who will rise up for me against the evildoers? Which one of our men is going to stand up and correct evil when they see it? That is what the Lord is looking for. That is the mark on the servants of the Lord, the real revolutionaries; and I believe the Lord picks those same souls generation after generation and brings them back over and over, cleansing them with the word. - Video played: where is the black man that is looking for salvation, that is going to rule his household? Where are you at? We are looking for you. - Or who will stand up for me against the workers of iniquity? Workers of iniquity are criminals, because you are a criminal in the sight of God when you break his laws. He is asking who will step up and contend with the wicked and be the perfect example of how to praise our God, uphold the ceremonial laws, and have the integrity to keep the moral laws. Unless the Lord had been my help, my soul had almost dwelt in silence: the Lord gives us the assignment and protects us from the wiles of Satan. When I said my foot slippeth, thy mercy held me up; thy comforts delight my soul. Shall the throne of iniquity have fellowship with thee, which frameth mischief by a law: the man of sin is always finding new ways to contend against us and seduce the children of Israel. - Video played: we are not saying we are sick of the drug dealers, the gang banging, the black man not having a job and sitting under the tree every day doing nothing? Captain: the mark of them that sigh and cry. We see the atrocities and we are not scared to go into those corners; we have been in those corners, and what is in our hand is far stronger. The power on our side is innumerable and unstoppable. - A captain to you moment: brothers who go out on the street corners talking about being the deacons, bishops and captains, and you are in here watching porn and doing dumb stuff; you might be put to shame or confounded, and you put the whole congregation in jeopardy. You know you are in the midst of evil, committing adultery; you cannot sigh and cry for anybody, because you are going to be put to shame in front of the congregation. Get your stuff together. - Video played from the Million Man March, where the men of the Lord showed up because we were fed up with the lies being peddled to our people: are we supposed to be scared, supposed to pack up and leave? We have more with us than with you: holy angels standing beside us that you cannot see, the one true God with us. I do not care how many men you have; you put one of us to death, the next man is going to rise up. Captain: this is the faith and the power you need to have, and you cannot fake it. You have to grow into that spirit; it takes time, being saturated with the word, going through the trials, getting the counsel. Brothers who just sit in the back, sisters who stay quiet, shalom, happy Sabbath, and then hit the door: you cannot fool the Lord. He knows how to categorize; if you have that fake spirit he will cause an event to happen where you have not been rooted, and you will be exposed and scared. A lot of things are lining up against us right now. Are you fortified? Are you rooted? - If one of us is taken out, the other has to be ready to stand in his place; you cannot let the banner fall to the ground. In their military it is a shame for the flag to touch the ground; when that man is shot down the next one scoops it up. Likewise the Bible is our banner. When a righteous brother steps up to edify the people and something happens to him, you have to be ready to go out and teach. That is what happened in Kenya: Deacon Isaac came back to the hotel and said the brothers got stoned, and we are going back, and they went back. In Cuba the captain and the bishops were arrested and put in the wagon, and the next man grabbed the mic and went back to teach. No man is left behind, and we keep teaching this word as it is written. John 16:2-4 2:03:58 - Christ warned us of this, and this is why we have no fear; as it reads in Samuel, he gives us another spirit and we are turned into another man, Christ dwelling in us and doing his work. They shall put you out of the synagogues; the time cometh that whosoever killeth you will think he doeth God service, because they have not known the Father nor me. But these things have I told you, that when the time shall come, ye may remember that I told you of them. Christ pre warned us, so it is not shocking to those in the spirit; but to those who do not study day and night, who came to be professional students, when your number is called you are shaken. Matthew 24:6-9 2:05:19 - This is why we have to be fortified and make our face harder than the wicked, and not just the wicked of the other nations but the wicked of our people. We have to be hardened as adamant stone, and what hardens us is the scriptures: yes, I am an Israelite; yes, Christ is black; this is what it says; we are the people, these are the laws, these are our customs. You have to believe it, because they have think tanks set up to convince you this is a fantasy and not about you, that the skull cap and what is done to infants is the true custom. That is not the circumcision found in the scriptures. - Ye shall hear of wars and rumours of wars; see that ye be not troubled, do not be dismayed; all these things must come to pass. It cannot be stopped; a commentator said this nation is set on a self destructive course, and the Lord knows what is going to happen. Nation shall rise against nation: Iran, Israel, America, China getting in, Lebanon being bombed. There shall be famines and pestilences: we are getting a heads up from the Lord. Get your pantries up; you have heard the warning over and over from the bishops, deacons and captains. Do not come knocking later asking for my address. All these are the beginning of sorrows; we are working on the golden ticket to the kingdom. - Then shall they deliver you up to be afflicted, and shall kill you, and ye shall be hated of all nations. You saw the video: all those nations know the wrong they did against us, and the Lord has a wonderful way of reminding all oppressors of their evil just before he kills them, as we read in Wisdom of Solomon: he sent them terrors at night and blackened the whole land to remind them. Exodus 11:1-9 2:08:50 - Hear how Moses spoke to Pharaoh. Yet will I bring one plague more upon Pharaoh and upon Egypt; afterwards he will let you go, and he shall surely thrust you out altogether. The other times the Lord hardened his heart because he wanted to show his wonderful power. Let every man borrow of his neighbour jewels of silver and gold; the Lord gave the people favour in the sight of the Egyptians, and the man Moses was very great in the land. Remember Moses at first was dismayed: who made thee a ruler over us; he had to run when he tried to step up and defend his people. Now he came back as a hero for his people, empowered by the one true God. - About midnight will I go out into the midst of Egypt, and all the firstborn shall die, and there shall be a great cry throughout all the land, such as there was none like it. But against any of the children of Israel shall not a dog move his tongue, that ye may know how that the Lord doth put a difference between the Egyptians and Israel. The Lord showed favoritism to his people. So when they tell us God loves everybody: wait, he said, I will personally come down and kill another nation for my people, so that the world knows I choose my people over other nations. - All these thy servants shall come down unto me and bow down, saying, get thee out, and all the people that follow thee. And he went out from Pharaoh in a great anger. Moses had to drop the mic: this is going to be it, Pharaoh; I warned you about the frogs and the blood and you would not listen. See the boldness of a servant of the Lord. And the Lord said, Pharaoh shall not hearken unto you: he is going to be hardened, but do not stop doing what you are doing, that my wonders may be multiplied. This is why some of the wicked have to go; do not feel sorry for them. Go in and do your mission, teach, prophesy, edify, build up, but the Lord has to show the wicked of our people: all you had to do was repent; multiple times he reached out through the mouth of the prophets and they refused. He is doing the same thing with America, hardening their hearts; they do not see the stress of the people and do not care about black and Hispanic America; those they cannot use and manipulate they want to eliminate. But there is a God, and he has a mission for us. Do not be afraid of it. Luke 14:26-32 2:16:23 - After the video of the apology: once you open your mouth and declare yourself to keep this gospel and teach this understanding, you cannot go back. If any man come to me and hate not his father, mother, wife, children, brethren and sisters, yea, and his own life also, he cannot be my disciple. If you are still tied to family and friends who dishonor the Most High to his face continually, and you want to walk hand in hand with them, the Lord cannot use you. Whosoever doth not bear his cross cannot be my disciple. - Which of you, intending to build a tower, sitteth not down first and counteth the cost, whether he have sufficient to finish it? He did not count the cost. The same with the entertainer who was shamed on air for endorsing what was done to a child, and you could see his posture drop. He declared, I am an Israelite, the twelve tribes, and then had to say sorry and hold the hand of the one he had exposed. He was not even talking like himself in that clip. - Video played: the woke cousin who pulls up to the Fourth of July cookout. A week ago he posted all that Israelite stuff, do not invite me to any Fourth of July or Juneteenth events, do not celebrate birthdays or Easter; now he is at the cookout saying you cannot take Facebook seriously, and eating the pork he called the devil's beef. Captain: this is how you look when you go back on the word of the Lord. Now you are in blasphemy, denying Christ. - Lest haply, after he hath laid the foundation and is not able to finish, all that behold it begin to mock him: this man began to build and was not able to finish. Some of you take this as a fad and do not count the cost: I am an Israelite this season and next season you are gone; I used to wear those; one time I was an Israelite, I was a Muslim. You played with it. You will be mocked; the Lord purposely sets that spirit so you are exposed: you professed to be a servant of God, and now look at you cutting the cake at the cookout, after all the commanding and hating you did. Shame. Actions shall be weighed. - Or what king, going to make war, sitteth not down first and consulteth whether he be able with ten thousand to meet him that cometh with twenty thousand? Or else, while the other is yet a great way off, he sendeth an ambassage and desireth conditions of peace: he waves the white flag because he did not estimate the overpowering; he was dismayed. That is why the Lord constantly reminds you: be not dismayed by them; do the work; stay focused on the mission, or you will be confounded by the wicked. Stay on the job, harden your face and your spirit constantly. - When we first started listening to the bishop's classes, we used to ride through the neighborhood with the windows down blasting the class. That joy you once had, you have to renew over and over; you will hit a plateau and have to keep fighting through it. It will come as correction; now you have people saying camp 101 is boring, sitting all day on the Sabbath is boring. This is what we signed up for, because what is lined up for the children of light our minds cannot fathom. Stay on your A game; the gospel is our profession. Hebrews 10:23 2:24:21 - Let us hold fast the profession of our faith without wavering. Captain: he even brought the porcelain plate from the house to that cookout; he had it planned. And a couple of days ago it was Easter, and in the comments where we were telling our brothers and sisters not to keep Easter, guess who came in against us: former Israelites, mocking us. You know why it is boring to them? Because it was a fad. This is not your life, not who you have become; it is just what I am doing now. That is why it becomes church to them; they take this as church, not knowing we jeopardize our lives, we are being watched constantly, and there are laws being made right now gearing up to come against us. Then you have a choice: go back into the world, or, when they put you in that dark room and say, all you have to do is leave that Bible on the table and walk out and we will forget all of this, understand that you just denied Christ and gave up your keys to the kingdom. - Article read in class, on the prophets: at times the message was like a burden upon them, urging them on with divine compulsion, yet they were free men, to speak or to remain silent, and they spoke of their preaching as the vision or the word of the Lord, meaning their conviction that the message was from God. They had paid the price of long and earnest meditation upon the divine purposes for their generation, and did not hesitate to begin with thus saith the Lord. They drew on their own experience and used past, present and future events to enforce their teaching, and their moral insight as students in the school of God made them competent to lead the people to fuller comprehension. Captain: divine compulsion, they could not hold back; long and earnest meditation, they counted the cost; everything written aforetime for our learning; and the school of God, this is a place of learning. - Second passage read, on Elijah and Elisha: the greatest marvel Elijah accomplished was founding a circle of disciples, who kept alive the teachings of the ancient law and raised their voices against the perversions of the mighty ones of the land, and lived by the work of their own hands; after Elijah's disappearance Elisha placed himself at their head, and at the beginning of his career followed closely in the footsteps of his master. Captain: a circle of disciples. You have to be around wise men, not fools; you cannot expect to be successful constantly around sinners, money makers, harlots and drug dealers, because whatever is around you consumes your thoughts and seduces you. That is why we encourage the brothers to come to the school and not leave the young men by themselves; we get messages from mothers that their son is at the park smoking with his buddies. The schools must be available to the youth, and we have to bring our arms together to keep these sanctuaries functioning. His career: this work is our profession, our career, not the nine to five. And he followed in the footsteps of his master; that is what we are supposed to be doing. Jeremiah 28:8-9 2:32:38 - The prophets of old prophesied against many countries and against great kingdoms, of war, of evil, and of pestilence. That is what you see our leadership doing today: we are on the quest, in Ecuador, in Haiti, in Puerto Rico, going to different countries because this gospel cannot be stopped; the mission must continue. - The prophet which prophesieth of peace, when the word of the prophet shall come to pass, then shall the prophet be known that the Lord hath truly sent him. You will be manifest when the mission is accomplished. We have been warning this country over and over, warning our brothers of what is coming; those who take heed will show that this prophet was among us doing his job. That is what you are beginning to see now. That is why we are here, continuing the mission, continually hardening our faces against the wicked. Precepts: - Lamentations 3:53-54 They have cut off my life in the dungeon, and cast a stone upon me; waters flowed over mine head; then I said, I am cut off. That is our forefather Jeremiah in the pit. We all have to go through that; write that precept down. In Closing Shalom, Israel; we are pressed for time and there is a mighty lineup waiting for you. Happy Sabbath. Stay with who we have next, Deacon Malachi. I hope you are on your way to keeping this holy convocation holy. Announcements & References Deacon Malachi teaches next. Books and articles referenced in class: - New World Jewry, 1493 to 1825: Requiem for the Forgotten, by Seymour B. Liebman (Caribbean shipping and the slave trade; summarized above) - An article on the prophets and the schools of the prophets, on divine compulsion, the vision of the Lord, and Elijah's circle of disciples with Elisha at their head (read at length above) - New York Times report on names struck from a military promotions list - The UN General Assembly vote on resolution A/80/L.48 on the enslavement of Africans as the gravest crime against humanity Field reports: the Haiti quest, teaching in the mountains in the midst of a voodoo festival with Bishop Nathanyel and Bishop Canaan; the brothers stoned in Kenya who went back to teach; the arrests in Cuba where the next man picked up the mic; the Million Man March. Dates: brothers are traveling around the world for the Lord's Passover; keep praying for them. Congregational fasts are declared every other week to rehearse for Jacob's trouble. Get your pantries up. --- Class Notes Index Transcript: full session

title: The Pride Of Thine Heart Hath Deceived Thee!
text: Introduction Shalom Israel, Most High Christ bless, happy Sabbath. The opening prayer came out of Psalms 91: he that dwelleth in the secret place of the Most High shall abide under the shadow of the Almighty. We pray for the brothers that are traveling for the Passover all over the world; we are praying for safe return, and praying that the Most High allows this truth to spread to the four corners of the earth as the enemy tries to stop us. The class is teaching from Canada this week. The class comes from an image posted last week from the president's own page: the man portrayed as Jesus, with the American flag behind him, the military with eagles' wings, ships, and him healing people. He is not healing anybody; he is destroying the lives of his own people and the other countries of the world with his pride. Somebody in his office sat down and made him the Messiah, with the Statue of Liberty and soldiers looking up to him and nurses praying at his side. That is why the class is titled the pride of thine heart hath deceived thee. The back of the dollar bill is all ancient Babylonian symbolism: the pyramid, the all-seeing eye, Novus Ordo Seclorum written when they declared their independence in 1776, and the eagle on the other side with a branch in one talon and arrows in the other, because they make war. Babylon is not written as America in the Bible; it is called Babylon because of the characteristics of ancient Babylon. And you people that just did Easter last week: that is not in the Bible either; it is an ancient Babylonian pagan fertility custom. Bunny rabbits do not lay eggs. Scriptures Opened Isaiah 14:4-19 9:22 - Thou shalt take up this proverb against the king of Babylon: Babylon is the United States of America, and this is what is going to happen to its king. - He who smote the people in wrath with a continual stroke: that is how they got to where they are, by smiting people in wrath. This land was taken with bloodshed, violence, and force: the indigenous people massacred and pushed onto reservations, and then Negroes dragged here against their will for hundreds of years of free labor. A hundred years after slavery was abolished, they put a bullet in Martin Luther King's head while he was asking to be judged by the content of his character. And when we point out the conditions they created, they turn around and call us the racists. - He that ruled the nations in anger: that is what you are seeing now, as they help bomb the Gaza Strip and declare war on Iran, with his own officials asking why. As soon as he got in office he put tariffs; he did not hurt one country with the tariffs; he hurt his own people. Prices went up on everything and mom and pop shops shut down, and he did it in pride. - The whole earth is at rest, and is quiet: they break forth into singing. When America goes down, the nations are going to sing. Yea, the fir trees rejoice at thee: even the trees will be happy, because no feller is come up against us; they clear whole forests for their luxury and do not care about nature. - Hell from beneath is moved for thee to meet thee at thy coming. Hell is a real place of torment, and it is the destiny of the prideful chief ones of the earth. There has to be a punishment that is extreme for the people who disregard life; if there were no place of suffering, God would not be feared. - How art thou fallen from heaven, O Lucifer, son of the morning: America right now is in its heaven; heaven is rulership, but the Bible says they are going to fall, because they weakened the nations: robbing, stealing, killing, plundering, enslaving, and destroying. - For thou hast said in thine heart, I will ascend into heaven, I will exalt my throne above the stars of God: we are the stars of God, and their throne is sitting on us. They know that once we open our eyes, we rise. I will sit also upon the mount of the congregation, in the sides of the north: the bulk of the Israelites are here in America; that is why the truth started here, and from here the bishop sent it to our brothers and sisters scattered all over the world. - I will be like the Most High: that is the picture he posted; he presents himself as the Messiah with spiritual power and healing, because he has no respect for the Most High God and his son. - Yet thou shalt be brought down to hell, to the sides of the pit. They that see thee shall narrowly look upon thee, saying, Is this the man that made the earth to tremble, that did shake kingdoms? The nations are already answering back without fear. Is this the man that made the world as a wilderness, that opened not the house of his prisoners? The countries of the earth are held like prisoners: if you do not play, they make you pay. - But thou art cast out of thy grave like an abominable branch: this is the future of the pride of America. Precepts: - Matthew 8:28-33 The devils cried out, Art thou come hither to torment us before the time? The demons recognized Christ, and they knew there is a time appointed of torment. So do not let any camp make you think you are going to escape judgment: there is a place appointed where evil spirits and evil people go to suffer torment. Some Israelite camps do counter classes saying there is no hell every time we teach it; they have no scripture to paint that picture. - Romans 11:1-2, 25-26 Why did Paul open with, Hath God cast away his people? Because of the northern and southern kingdom conflict: the Jews thought God was not dealing with the northern kingdom. I would not that ye should be ignorant of this mystery: blindness in part is happened to Israel, until the fulness of the Gentiles be come in; God blinded a portion so the gospel could be preached to the northern kingdom living as Gentiles. And so all Israel shall be saved means both kingdoms, all twelve tribes, can be saved. It is not a license saying the wicked escape hell; that is not what Paul was talking about. - Genesis 27:39-40 Isaac told Esau, thy dwelling shall be the fatness of the earth, and by thy sword shalt thou live. That is why they do not want anybody else to have a weapon: a nuclear weapon is a sword, and they rule because they have the ability to kill and destroy anything that comes against them. That is why the Pope calling for peace is called weak. Ecclesiastes 7:16 46:48 - Be not righteous over much; neither make thyself over wise. To be righteous over much means nobody can correct you: you think you know everything and you see nothing wrong with yourself. - Why shouldest thou destroy thyself? When you get to that mindset, you bring destruction on yourself. And that is how you see the president moving: nobody can tell him anything. Ecclesiasticus 10:12-13 48:03 - The beginning of pride is when one departeth from God. When you pull God out of the equation, the only thing left for you is pride, and his heart is turned away from his Maker. - For pride is the beginning of sin, and he that hath it shall pour out abomination. That is why everything coming out of his mouth and his page is abominable, stupid thing after stupid thing every day, and he explains his own logic for all of it. - Therefore the Lord brought upon them strange calamities: and that is what you are seeing. A war that was supposed to be over in a week has run over a month, and the counselors who said leave those people alone are watching it backfire. Psalms 10:1-4 51:29 - Why standest thou afar off, O Lord? That is how we feel sometimes, like God is not with us; but he said in affliction they will seek him early. - The wicked in his pride doth persecute the poor: let them be taken in the devices that they have imagined. Whatever he is imagining to do to us is going to happen to him. But understand: things are going to get bad for us before they get better. - For the wicked boasteth of his heart's desire, and blesseth the covetous, whom the Lord abhorreth. That is why he keeps yes men around him. - The wicked, through the pride of his countenance, will not seek after God: God is not in all his thoughts. Even when the Pope tells him to look for a way toward peace, he will not hear it. Video played in class: asked why he attacked Pope Leo on his platform, the president called the Pope weak and liberal and answered with talk about COVID arrests and crime; his own advisers asked how you disrespect the Pope, the first president in history to do it. Psalms 31:19-20 54:26 - Oh how great is thy goodness, which thou hast laid up for them that fear thee. Keep the fear of God on you, because in the end you get God's goodness. Trust in God, not in the people that are big, bad, and prideful; their time is temporary. - Thou shalt hide them in the secret of thy presence from the pride of man. What we know is a secret: we are learning we are the Israelites of a Bible they took away from us and told us this is not your book. Thou shalt keep them secretly in a pavilion from the strife of tongues: they speak evil against us, but God keeps us in a secret place from it. Ecclesiasticus 10:7-8 57:04 - Pride is hateful before God and man: God hates it and man hates it. When you meet somebody prideful, even though you do not say it, you feel it. - Because of unrighteous dealings, injuries, and riches got by deceit, the kingdom is translated from one people to another. The riches gotten by deceit was enslaving the children of Israel; almost all these countries were established on the blood, sweat, and tears of slaves. That is why all the kingdoms of the earth are going to lose their dominion, and the one kingdom that will stand is the kingdom of the twelve tribes of Israel. Jeremiah 30:16 59:48 - Therefore all they that devour thee shall be devoured; and all thine adversaries, every one of them, shall go into captivity; and they that spoil thee shall be a spoil. You are where you are because you devoured the Israelites and used us for free labor. - So do not let anybody tell you that you are nothing right now. The Bible is your future; the Bible is your hope. Proverbs 8:13 1:00:45 - The fear of the Lord is to hate evil: pride, and arrogancy, and the evil way, and the froward mouth, do I hate. Once the fear of the Lord is inside of you, you are supposed to hate pride too. - We have been conditioned to be filled with pride: we get things in this wicked kingdom and rub it in other people's faces, and look down at our own people. The rap music brags on the house, the car, the watch: frivolous things of no bearing to God. What we are learning as Israelites is the opposite: to love our neighbor, our wives, our children; when one suffers, we all suffer. America is going to suffer by itself, because all the other nations are pulling away. Proverbs 29:23 1:03:03 - A man's pride shall bring him low: but honour shall uphold the humble in spirit. This man was on top of the world when he was elected, and now everything is turning. - Although you see a lot of prideful people thriving and successful, always remember to stay humble; the Lord will exalt you in due time. And when you deal with prideful people, do not let them bring you down to their level: a wise man said do not argue with fools, because people from a distance cannot tell who is who. When IUIC was growing and arguing with the other camps, the bishop finally said leave them alone, and that is when people could tell who to follow. Ecclesiasticus 32:12-17 1:05:12 - There take thy pastime, and do what thou wilt: but sin not by proud speech. You can have your fun on this earth, but God listens to your speech. For all these things bless him that made thee: always remember you have a creator; do not turn into a hater. - Whoso feareth the Lord will receive his discipline. God is correcting us right now: the president is in a position to make our lives miserable because we are being corrected by God. It is important to see this as discipline from God. And they that seek him early shall find favour: do not wait until the whole world is falling apart to seek God. - He that seeketh the law shall be filled therewith: that is why we teach you to follow God's laws, and the denominations call us legalists. But the hypocrite will be offended thereat. They that fear the Lord shall find judgment, and shall kindle justice as a light: we cannot bring forth justice on our own; we do not need bombs or a military; all we need is to be filled with the law. Fringes, skirts and head coverings, beards, the Sabbath: you are not doing anything evil, but it bothers people. - A sinful man will not be reproved, but findeth an excuse according to his will. There is nothing you can tell them; in their heart they believe they can sin and win. It is the same in the congregation and in your house: you show them every scripture and they give you every excuse. After a while, do not chase them, replace them. James 4:1-3 1:19:01 - From whence come wars and fightings among you? Come they not hence, even of your lusts that war in your members? Something inside is making the conflict come up all the time. Whether it is the government, the congregation, your house, or your marriage, be honest about where the trouble starts. That is why we do counsel and hear both sides: once you let them speak enough, you can say, you are the reason there is no peace. - Ye lust, and have not: ye kill, and desire to have, and cannot obtain. No matter how much you fight, you have nothing. He has everything and it is not enough for him. - Ye ask, and receive not, because ye ask amiss, that ye may consume it upon your lusts. There is a way to ask according to the Lord; and some people you are not going to have peace with. People with no peace inside of them cause conflict; they only feel comfortable starting trouble. If the scripture cannot fix them, there is nothing you can do for them: examine the life of the person, send them on their way, and guard your peace. Proverbs 16:5 1:30:05 - Every one that is proud in heart is an abomination to the Lord: though hand join in hand, he shall not be unpunished. You think you can hold hands with the wicked and not get touched. Some of you will defend the wicked and make excuses for them: a prideful spouse, a wicked child. When God brings the judgment, if you are joining hands trying to protect them, it reaches you too. Ecclesiasticus 13:1 1:31:18 - He that toucheth pitch shall be defiled therewith; and he that hath fellowship with a proud man shall be like unto him. Look at the people the prideful surround themselves with: the bishop says show me your friends and I will tell you who you are. - Video played in class: the attorney general testifying before Congress on the Epstein files, where the department redacted the names of the abusers but released the names of the victims, the worst thing you could do to the survivors. Asked to take responsibility and apologize to the survivors standing behind her, she answered that the questioners should be apologizing to the president. The whole world called it a disgrace, and she was let go. He that hath fellowship with a proud man shall be like unto him. Ecclesiasticus 3:28-31 1:36:37 - In the punishment of the proud there is no remedy: for the plant of wickedness hath taken root in him. Some people, there is no scripture and no picture you can paint to show them they need to stop. You can discipline them, fine them, take things away: they cannot see that they are the cause. - The heart of the prudent will understand a parable; and an attentive ear is the desire of a wise man. That is why we tell you to get your pen and notebook out and write scriptures. The ones looking around not paying attention, you already see what spirit is on them. - He that requiteth good turns is mindful of that which may come hereafter; and when he falleth, he shall find a stay. We are all going to make mistakes, but if you keep a certain heart with God, when things go bad the Lord will sustain you. Never get to that place of pride where God says you are on your own. Ecclesiasticus 16:6-11 1:39:49 - In the congregation of the ungodly shall a fire be kindled; and in a rebellious nation wrath is set on fire. In the beginning, when there was a congregation of the ungodly, he drowned them. - He was not pacified toward the old giants, who fell away in the strength of their foolishness: they were giants, but they were foolish, and people feel strong in their foolishness. Neither spared he the place where Lot sojourned, but abhorred them for their pride. - He pitied not the people of perdition, nor the six hundred thousand footmen, who were gathered together in the hardness of their hearts. How long are you going to keep using somebody's rough life story to excuse the one who refuses correction? If they will not listen to the scripture, stop making excuses for them. - And if there be one stiffnecked among the people, it is marvel if he escape unpunished: one stiffnecked person in the congregation, and it would be a marvel if God lets it go. For mercy and wrath are with him: he is mighty to forgive, and to pour out displeasure. That is why the saying God is good all the time is not scriptural: the same God drowned the whole earth, swallowed rebels alive, and left a generation in the wilderness for forty years. God is good all the time to the people that keep his commandments. 2 Esdras 9:7-12 1:46:24 - Every one that shall be saved, and shall be able to escape by his works, and by faith, whereby ye have believed, shall be preserved from the said perils, and shall see my salvation in my land, and within my borders: for I have sanctified them for me from the beginning. You are here because God cares about you; you are not here by accident. - Then shall they be in pitiful case, which now have abused my ways. You come into the school and we tell you God's ways, and now you are mad; and they that have cast them away despitefully shall dwell in torments. - For such as in their life have received benefits, and have not known me: you will see people prospering in their pride with the house and the car, and they do not know God. And they that have loathed my law, while they had yet liberty, and, when as yet place of repentance was open unto them, understood not, but despised it. The liberty is us in the streets going all over the world opening the door of repentance; the brothers at camp are running up to people with flyers and they throw them down. - The same must know it after death by pain. This is a God that will kill you and still have pain awaiting. So do not let anybody tell you the place of torment was made up by a church; these scriptures are in the book. Precepts: - Jeremiah 1:5 Before I formed thee in the belly I knew thee; and before thou camest forth out of the womb I sanctified thee. Where did he know us? In the spirit, before our parents brought us forth. There is something in your spirit that God said, I need to fix you, so that when the time comes you come back to me and not to your pride. 2 Kings 18:17-37 1:54:43 - The first example of the punishment of the proud: the king of Assyria sent Rabshakeh with a great host against Jerusalem, taunting king Hezekiah: what confidence is this wherein thou trustest? He mocked their trust in Egypt, a bruised reed, and mocked their trust in the Lord, and even claimed, the Lord said to me, Go up against this land, and destroy it. - He offered two thousand horses if they would give up, and threatened them with siege conditions in the crudest terms, and called out in the Jews' language so all the people on the wall could hear: let not Hezekiah make you trust in the Lord, saying, The Lord will surely deliver us. It is the same thing they try with us now: things get bad and the enemy says, you think your God is going to come and deliver you? - Make an agreement with me, and eat ye every man of his own vine: they threaten your resources, because they know once you cut off people's food and water, most will humble themselves and turn their back on God. That is why the bishop tells you to start putting food away. - Hath any of the gods of the nations delivered at all his land out of the hand of the king of Assyria? He called out all the gods that could not stop him. But the people held their peace, and answered him not a word, for the king's commandment was, Answer him not. That is why the bishop says do not do interviews with these people; we do not have to answer them. 2 Kings 19:1-37 2:03:41 - When king Hezekiah heard it, he rent his clothes, covered himself with sackcloth, and went into the house of the Lord, and sent to Isaiah the prophet. A government always had spiritual advisers; the king got threatened and said, go get Isaiah. When the nation of Israel is threatened, you get the man of God. - It may be the Lord thy God will hear all the words of Rabshakeh, whom the king of Assyria his master hath sent to reproach the living God. God heard him disrespecting the living God. Isaiah answered: be not afraid of the words which thou hast heard; behold, I will send a blast upon him, and he shall return to his own land, and I will cause him to fall by the sword in his own land. - While Rabshakeh was running his mouth, the Assyrians were already at war on another front: the Lord had already set ambushes. It is the same pattern now: while they attack God's chosen people, nations they never expected rise up against them. - Hezekiah spread the blasphemous letter before the Lord and prayed: save thou us out of his hand, that all the kingdoms of the earth may know that thou art the Lord God, even thou only. Then Isaiah sent word: that which thou hast prayed to me against Sennacherib king of Assyria I have heard. Hezekiah prayed by himself, and Isaiah came and told him God heard your prayer; that is why you need strong men of faith around you. - The virgin the daughter of Zion hath despised thee, and laughed thee to scorn. Whom hast thou reproached and blasphemed? Even against the Holy One of Israel. He shall not come into this city, nor shoot an arrow there; by the way that he came, by the same shall he return: for I will defend this city, to save it, for mine own sake, and for my servant David's sake. That is why we honor our forefathers: God has a relationship with them before us. - And it came to pass that night, that the angel of the Lord went out, and smote in the camp of the Assyrians an hundred fourscore and five thousand. One angel killed 185,000 men of war in one night; in the morning they were all dead corpses. - Sennacherib returned to Nineveh, and as he was worshipping in the house of Nisroch his god, his own sons smote him with the sword and escaped. God will send strange punishments to the proud, even from inside their own house. Daniel 4:18-37 2:15:06 - The second example: Nebuchadnezzar's dream of the great tree. Daniel told him, it is thou, O king: thy greatness is grown, and reacheth unto heaven; but the watcher said, Hew the tree down, and leave the stump. They shall drive thee from men, and thy dwelling shall be with the beasts of the field, and seven times shall pass over thee, till thou know that the Most High ruleth in the kingdom of men, and giveth it to whomsoever he will. You only rule because God put you there. - Daniel counseled him: break off thy sins by righteousness, and thine iniquities by shewing mercy to the poor, if it may be a lengthening of thy tranquillity. He warned him a year in advance, and he did not listen. - At the end of twelve months, walking in the palace, the king said, Is not this great Babylon, that I have built by the might of my power, and for the honour of my majesty? While the word was in the king's mouth, there fell a voice from heaven: the kingdom is departed from thee. You think there is not a God listening when you are running your mouth? As long as the words were still in his mouth, God turned him out. - The same hour he was driven from men, did eat grass as oxen, his body was wet with the dew of heaven, his hairs grew like eagles' feathers and his nails like birds' claws. God humbled him until the length of time was fulfilled. - At the end of the days, Nebuchadnezzar lifted up his eyes unto heaven, and his understanding returned, and he blessed the Most High: all the inhabitants of the earth are reputed as nothing; none can stay his hand, or say unto him, What doest thou? And those that walk in pride he is able to abase. Do not let your pride pull you aside from God; humble yourself before he draws the picture for you. Acts 12:1-11, 18-23 2:24:23 - The third example: Herod killed James with the sword, and because he saw it pleased the Jews, he proceeded to take Peter also. The government attacked the Israelites because it pleased a portion of the very people. Do not think the ones we pass flyers to will not side with the government when it turns on us. - Then were the days of unleavened bread: they waited until the highest holy days to attack. Christ was killed on Passover, and Peter was arrested on Passover. Imagine we get snatched up on Passover, or something happens to the men traveling all over the world for Passover: we want you praying without ceasing, like the church prayed for Peter. - The angel of the Lord came upon him, and a light shined in the prison, and his chains fell off from his hands. The angel walked him past the first and second ward, and the iron gate opened of his own accord, and Peter thought he saw a vision. When Peter was come to himself, he said, Now I know of a surety, that the Lord hath sent his angel, and hath delivered me out of the hand of Herod, and from all the expectation of the people of the Jews. The government and his own people were against him; all we have is the prayer of the church and the angels answering those prayers. - Herod examined the keepers and commanded that they should be put to death; then on a set day, arrayed in royal apparel on his throne, he made an oration, and the people gave a shout, saying, It is the voice of a god, and not of a man. And immediately the angel of the Lord smote him, because he gave not God the glory: and he was eaten of worms, and gave up the ghost. That is the same spirit as calling a president the savior. God is still listening to these empires talk. 2 Maccabees 9:1-28 2:32:42 - The fourth example, and the teacher's favorite: Antiochus came with dishonor out of Persia after being put to flight at Persepolis, heard what had happened to Nicanor, and swelling with anger, thought to avenge upon the Jews the disgrace done unto him. He commanded his chariot to drive without ceasing, the judgment of God now following him, for he had spoken proudly, that he would come to Jerusalem and make it a common burying place of the Jews. - But the Lord Almighty, the God of Israel, smote him with an incurable and invisible plague: a pain of the bowels that was remediless, and sore torments of the inner parts; and that most justly, for he had tormented other men's bowels with many and strange torments. The same things you do to other people, God makes you feel. - Howbeit he nothing at all ceased from his bragging, but still was filled with pride, breathing out fire in his rage against the Jews, and commanding to haste the journey. Everything is going wrong around him and he is still running his mouth. Then he fell down from his chariot, carried violently, so that all the members of his body were much pained. - And thus he that a little afore thought he might command the waves of the sea, so proud was he beyond the condition of man, and weigh the high mountains in a balance, was now cast on the ground and carried in an horselitter, shewing forth unto all the manifest power of God. - The worms rose up out of the body of this wicked man; his flesh fell away, and the filthiness of his smell was noisome to all his army, so that no man could endure to carry him for his intolerable stink. The man that thought he could reach to the stars of heaven, nobody could even come near him. - Being plagued, he began to leave off his great pride, and to come to the knowledge of himself by the scourge of God, his pain increasing every moment. He said, It is meet to be subject unto God, and that a man that is mortal should not proudly think of himself, as if he were God. Some people get touched once and straighten up; some have to be brought this low to know where they need to go. - This wicked person vowed unto the Lord, who now no more would have mercy upon him: he promised to set the holy city at liberty, make the Jews equals to the citizens of Athens, garnish the temple with goodly gifts, pay for the sacrifices out of his own revenue, yea, and become a Jew himself, and go through all the world preaching the power of God. When that torment touched him, all of a sudden he wanted to be God's friend. - But for all this his pains would not cease: for the just judgment of God was come upon him. He wrote the Jews a flattering letter, to the good Jews his citizens, blaming circumstance and commending his son. Thus the murderer and blasphemer, having suffered most grievously, as he entreated other men, so died he a miserable death in a strange country in the mountains. All praises to the Most High God of Israel. 1 Peter 5:6-8 2:46:43 - Humble yourselves therefore under the mighty hand of God, that he may exalt you in due time. That is the message of the whole class. - Casting all your care upon him; for he careth for you. We are here because God cares; do not let anybody take you in any other direction. - Be sober, be vigilant; because your adversary the devil, as a roaring lion, walketh about, seeking whom he may devour. Obadiah tells you who plays that role on the earth today. Obadiah 1:1-4 2:47:45 - The vision of Obadiah: thus saith the Lord God concerning Edom. We have heard a rumour from the Lord, and an ambassador is sent among the heathen: Arise ye, and let us rise up against her in battle. That is why the nations of the earth are aligning against the United States of America. - Behold, I have made thee small among the heathen: thou art greatly despised. The other nations hate them; God said it, so stop saying we are the racists for reading it. - The pride of thine heart hath deceived thee, thou that dwellest in the clefts of the rock, whose habitation is high; that saith in his heart, Who shall bring me down to the ground? That is the title of the class, and that is the boast you hear: the strongest military, the ultimatums, the threats. And the ones being threatened answer back without fear. - Though thou exalt thyself as the eagle: the eagle is on their military, on their mail trucks, on the back of their dollar bill; the eagle has landed on the moon. And though thou set thy nest among the stars, thence will I bring thee down, saith the Lord. In Closing Humble yourselves under the mighty hand of God, that he may exalt you in due time. Sennacherib ran his mouth and one angel emptied his camp; Nebuchadnezzar boasted and ate grass like an ox; Herod took the glory of a god and was eaten of worms; Antiochus swore to make Jerusalem a graveyard and died begging in a strange country. Pride is pride, and it cannot hide: from your house, to the congregation, to the White House. The pride of thine heart hath deceived thee; though thou exalt thyself as the eagle, thence will I bring thee down, saith the Lord. Twelve tribes worldwide, shalom. Announcements & References The class was taught on the road in Canada this Sabbath, with prayers throughout for the brothers traveling all over the world for the Passover and for their safe return. Videos shown in class: the presidential image posted online portraying the president as a healing Messiah; the clip of the president attacking Pope Leo for calling for peace; and the congressional hearing clip on the Epstein files where the victims' names were released while the abusers' names were redacted. A sit down with a Christian pastor the day before was also recalled, where the teacher explained from the scriptures that God's goodness is toward them that keep his commandments, and judgment toward them that do not. --- Class Notes Index Transcript: full session

title: Passover Class: Exodus From America Modern Day Egypt
text: Introduction Opening reading, Psalms 149:1-9: sing unto the Lord a new song, and his praise in the congregation of saints; let the high praises of God be in their mouth, and a twoedged sword in their hand, to execute vengeance upon the heathen; this honour have all his saints. Opening prayer: Lord, we come before you today on the Passover, the day that you delivered our forefathers from the land of Egypt, the day that you brought salvation to our people; you freed us from oppression, from our enemy, from slavery. We ask you to send your Son again to deliver us from these lands where we have been scattered throughout the four corners of the earth in slavery. Have mercy upon all the leaders that are traveling to the four corners of the earth; watch over them and make their missions successful. Heal the brothers and sisters that are sick, mentally and physically. Take away from us malice, guile, and all evil speaking, all the leaven, out of our heart, that we may serve you in spirit and in truth. And as we celebrate the Passover, deliver us again in these last days, and bring swift destruction on our enemies, all those that hate us and enslaved us and seek to do us harm. Bless the lamb, the wine, and the food. Happy Passover. This Passover is in remembrance of us being delivered out of Egypt, and Lord's will we will be able to celebrate the new Passover in the future; anyone that makes it to that Passover is going to live forever. The leadership is traveling all over the world on the Passover blitz, so the deacon holds the Passover lesson tonight. The topic: Exodus from America, modern day Egypt. A lot of times you read the scriptures and they mention Egypt and you think it is only talking about ancient Egypt. Tonight you will see it is also talking about America. Scriptures Opened Genesis 15:11-14 12:38 - An horror of great darkness fell upon Abram. What is that great horror? Abraham saw his descendants in ancient Egypt as slaves, being oppressed. Know of a surety that thy seed shall be a stranger in a land that is not theirs, and shall serve them; and they shall afflict them four hundred years. Before it happened, Abraham saw it. - And also that nation, whom they shall serve, will I judge: that nation lets you know this is talking about back then, the nation we served in ancient Egypt. And afterward shall they come out with great substance: that is literally what happened; we came out of ancient Egypt with great substance. What has to happen for us to turn to God with all our heart, soul, and mind? We have to cry out the same way we cried out in Exodus. - For they shall cry unto the Lord because of the oppressors: because of what the oppressors, the government, are doing to us, we will cry unto the Lord, the same way the Lord said in Exodus, I have heard the cries of the children of Israel. - And he shall send them a saviour, and a great one, and he shall deliver them. He is going to send Christ. Christ is coming back to this earth to deliver us from spiritual Egypt. That is why we read earlier: it shall no more be said, The Lord liveth that delivered the children of Israel from the land of Egypt, because the children of Israel will be delivered from mystery Babylon the great. - And the Lord shall smite Egypt: he shall smite and heal it. The smiting goes into the affliction; the healing is because we are going to change. As God brings the plagues on Babylon, a lot of our people will change. 2 Esdras 15:5-12 2:38:26 - Behold, saith the Lord, I will bring plagues upon the world; the sword, famine, death, and destruction. For wickedness hath exceedingly polluted the whole earth, and their hurtful works are fulfilled. All the hurtful works are fulfilled; therefore the Lord says, I will hold my tongue no more. - Behold, the innocent and righteous blood crieth unto me, and the souls of the just complain continually. A lot of blood is going to be shed here in Babylon, crying out to the Lord the same way we cried out in ancient Egypt. And therefore, saith the Lord, I will surely avenge them: God says, I will take vengeance for you. - Behold, my people is led as a flock to the slaughter: I will not suffer them now to dwell in the land of Egypt. Which Egypt is this? America. The Lord says, I am not going to allow them to dwell in the land of Egypt anymore. - But I will bring them with a mighty hand and a stretched out arm, and smite Egypt with plagues, as before. As before: letting you know this is not ancient Egypt. The same way I destroyed ancient Egypt and smote them with plagues, I am going to do the same thing to this spiritual Egypt that my people were slaves in. This is the new Exodus. - And will destroy all the land thereof. Ancient Egypt's land was not destroyed; this is mystery Babylon. Egypt shall mourn, and the foundation of it shall be smitten with the plague and punishment that God shall bring upon it. Baruch 4:25-37 2:42:56 - My children, suffer patiently the wrath that is come upon you from God. The wrath that came upon us from God is slavery, the curses of Deuteronomy 28. The Bible says suffer it patiently, for thine enemy hath persecuted thee. - But shortly thou shalt see his destruction, and shalt tread upon his neck. We are going to see our enemies destroyed. Some of you do not want to see that; some of you want to take your enemies into the kingdom of heaven with you. No. There is no salvation unless your enemies are destroyed. When they afflict you, when they put you in prison for things you did not do, when they lie on you and bring up charges against you for the word of God's sake, remember that: shortly thou shalt see his destruction. Even if you die today or tomorrow, you are going to see it, because the Lord is going to bring you back. This new Passover has a resurrection taking place too: the Lord is not just coming to destroy, he is bringing souls back with him. - Be of good comfort, O my children, and cry unto God. Jerusalem is speaking here. You see what God wants us to do: cry unto him. You all have not started crying yet, because you are not being afflicted yet. You were crying in the 1800s, you were crying during the Jim Crow era, you were crying when we were being lynched; but the false sense of comfort of the last 60 years quieted the crying. Affliction is going to be turned up on our people under this administration and the ones after it, and we will cry. - For as it was your mind to go astray from God: so, being returned, seek him ten times more. And he that hath brought these plagues upon you shall bring you everlasting joy again with your salvation. - Miserable are they that afflicted thee, and rejoiced at thy fall: everyone that afflicted us and took us as slaves. Miserable are the cities which thy children served: every city we served hard bondage in, misery is coming to every last one of them, including this one. Miserable is she that received thy sons: for as she rejoiced at thy ruin, so shall she be grieved for her own desolation. Her pride shall be turned into mourning, for fire shall come upon her from the Everlasting, long to endure, and she shall be inhabited of devils for a great time. - O Jerusalem, look about thee toward the east, and behold the joy that cometh unto thee from God. Lo, thy sons come, whom thou sentest away: they come gathered together from the east to the west, rejoicing in the glory of God. Romans 10:14-15 3:04:20 - How then shall they call on him in whom they have not believed? Do our people around the world believe in the Christ of the Bible? No. And how shall they believe in him of whom they have not heard? They never heard the true gospel, which is being taught right now: that they are the Israelites, that Christ came to deliver them out of the land of their captivity. - And how shall they hear without a preacher? and how shall they preach, except they be sent? All the brothers you see all over the world on the blitz, the soldiers, the officers, the captains: they are the teachers, and the only way our people hear is if the teachers go and teach. We are not going to cover all the earth, but we are going to wake up who the Lord wants us to wake up, that elect. - As it is written, How beautiful are the feet of them that preach the gospel of peace, and bring glad tidings of good things. That is what the brothers are doing right now. What you see taking place is prophecy. In Closing On the Passover night the Lord broke bread; the first communion took place at the Passover dinner, so that is what we take part in tonight. We are going to try to come together as many of the feast days as we can: tomorrow, Lord's will, the class goes over leaven. Those of you that can open the schools, open them; it is seven days of feasting and celebrating, so come through. Happy Passover, brothers and sisters. Announcements & References The 2026 worldwide Passover blitz reel played in class: bishops, deacons, captains, and officers reporting in from Booster Club missions 191 through 226, including Nassau Bahamas, Freetown Sierra Leone, Toronto, Anguilla, the US Virgin Islands, Paramaribo Suriname, India, Jamaica, the Netherlands, Barbados, Malawi, Hawaii, the Solomon Islands, Birmingham UK, Calgary and Edmonton Canada, Lagos Nigeria, Lusaka Zambia, Papua New Guinea, Ecuador, Georgetown Guyana, Australia, Grenada, Puerto Rico, Trinidad and Tobago, Nairobi Kenya, Johannesburg South Africa, Kampala Uganda, Yaounde Cameroon, Montreal, the Democratic Republic of Congo, Haiti, Melbourne Australia, Dar es Salaam Tanzania, Accra and Kumasi Ghana, and Monrovia Liberia. This is not just travel; this is sacrifice. Pray for their strength, their protection, and their endurance. Prophecy is being fulfilled: the gospel is being taught to our people scattered throughout all the countries of the world. Support the Booster Club: what you see the leadership doing costs. The last two years the Passover has been kept differently, without the big hotel gathering, because we see the big picture. Closing reading: 1 Corinthians 11:23-30, the bread and the cup, in remembrance of the Lord's death till he come; let a man examine himself, for he that eateth and drinketh unworthily eateth and drinketh damnation to himself. --- Class Notes Index Transcript: full session

title: LEAVEN: THE ROOT OF BITTERNESS
text: Introduction Opening prayer: Lord, Father, we come before you today, bringing in the second day of the days of unleavened bread. Protect the brothers that are traveling all over the world, teaching thy word, healing thy people, waking thy people up; watch over the bishops, the deacons, the officers that are traveling. Have mercy upon us and purge from us that old leaven that we got inside our spirit: the leaven of malice, the leaven of hatred, the leaven of bitterness, the leaven of emulation, the leaven of adultery, the leaven of fornication. Take away all these leaven from our flesh, that we may be a holy lump before thy eyes. We are about to bring in the Sabbath, and we are also bringing in the second day of the feast of unleavened bread. We are going to try to keep the schools open for the full seven days; it is the feast days of the Lord, and we literally got to make it joyous and come together. Tonight's topic: leaven, the root of bitterness. This is going to be a part one and a part two. It is the feast of unleavened bread, and we got to deal with the leaven and the sin that is amongst us. Scriptures Opened Exodus 13:3-11 23:48 - By strength of hand the Lord brought us out from Egypt, out of the house of bondage. The Most High was not playing; he flexed his strength and his power when he was delivering us out of Egypt. - There shall no leavened bread be eaten. That is why we are celebrating the days of unleavened bread. Some of you will say, we do not eat leaven for seven days, what does that mean? Everything that we celebrate has meaning behind it. The Lord did not say kill a lamb for no reason, or keep tabernacles for no reason. He has his reasons behind these things. - Thou shalt shew thy son in that day, saying, This is done because of that which the Lord did unto me when I came forth out of Egypt. Who is the me here? It is not Moses. It is the children that were 20 years old and under, that became adults in the land, telling their sons why we celebrate the feast of unleavened bread: the Lord purged the leaven out of me in the wilderness. All the adults did not make it, but the little ones made it into the promised land. - It shall be for a sign unto thee upon thine hand, and for a memorial between thine eyes, that the Lord's law may be in thy mouth. Why are we celebrating the days of unleavened bread? It is a sign for us to keep God's laws, for God's laws to be in our minds. That is what the days of unleavened bread really represent. Precepts: - Numbers 14:27-34 How long shall I bear with this evil congregation? When we came out of Egypt, our people were evil. You thought they were righteous? They were rebellious: liars, fornicators, murmurers. Your carcases shall fall in this wilderness, from twenty years old and upward. Once you were 20 years old and up, the Lord said, all of you are going to die. Even Aaron died, and Moses did not enter; not that Moses was evil, but the people provoked him to anger. Joshua and Caleb were the only two adults the Lord allowed to make it into the promised land. Everybody 20 and up, their blood was on their own head, because according to the law, at 20 you are the age of a man and you take responsibility for yourself. The little ones which ye said should be a prey, them will I bring in. The children wandered 40 years and bore the whoredoms of the adults, until every last rebellious one died. That is what the Lord did to us in the wilderness: he purged that leaven out of our people. Exodus 12:15 40:20 - Seven days we are supposed to eat unleavened bread, and whosoever eateth leavened bread from the first day until the seventh day, that soul shall be cut off from Israel. When you read things, read and pay attention: that soul. This is not talking about just regular death; it is talking about your soul being cut off. That is going into your name being blotted out of the book of life. That is damnation, condemnation. - So the leaven there is not necessarily just talking about eating bread without yeast in it. It is something much more symbolic. Amos 4:5 42:15 - Offer a sacrifice of thanksgiving with leaven, for this liketh you, O ye children of Israel. We were offering our offerings of thanksgiving with leaven, meaning with sin, and thinking that is acceptable to God. You cannot give God offerings while you are in the midst of sin. The Lord said, I do not deal with that. Precepts: - Matthew 16:6 Take heed and beware of the leaven of the Pharisees. The leaven of the Pharisees was hypocrisy; the leaven of the Pharisees is sin. When you keep reading it says, for they say and do not. So the leaven in the scriptures is really going into sin. The days of unleavened bread that we are celebrating right now represent us being without sin. 2 Esdras 7:31-32 45:12 - After seven days the world, that yet awaketh not, shall be raised up. That is us being raised up and getting the kingdom, after seven days. Within them seven days we are in the midst of sin and all wickedness, but there will be a group of us that will get rid of that leaven that is inside of us: unleavened bread within that seven days, and our soul is not going to be cut off. - And that shall die that is corrupt. That is what we read in Exodus: within them seven days, if any man eat leaven, that soul will be cut off. If you are taking part in leaven, that means you are corrupt. But the earth shall restore those that are asleep in her: the righteous coming back, after seven days. - The days of unleavened bread are us fixing ourselves right now, trying to become a better person. The sins you are battling, you try to get rid of them. Because in the seventh day, when the Lord returns, if we did not get rid of the leaven, your soul will be cut off. 1 Corinthians 10:1-6 49:01 - All our fathers were under the cloud, and all passed through the sea, and were all baptized unto Moses. When it says we were baptized unto Moses, meaning Moses taught us the laws. - They drank of that spiritual Rock that followed them, and that Rock was Christ. That was Christ in the wilderness with us, speaking on behalf of the Father. - But with many of them God was not well pleased, for they were overthrown in the wilderness. God killed everyone 20 years old and up, and just the children he allowed to enter into the promised land. - Now these things were our examples, to the intent we should not lust after evil things, as they also lusted. When you read about the things that happened to our forefathers in the wilderness, it is an example for us not to be like them. They were murmuring, they were fornicating, they were trying to overthrow Moses. You got to read and say, I cannot do that; I got to train myself not to be like that. Ezekiel 20:35-38 51:36 - I will bring you into the wilderness of the people. This is prophecy: after the second exodus, after the Lord delivers us from this new Egypt, from America, he is taking us back into the wilderness. That is why Paul said do not be like our fathers; these things are for an example, because we will be going back into the wilderness again. - There will I plead with you face to face, like as I pleaded with your fathers in the wilderness of the land of Egypt. How did the Lord plead with us in the wilderness the first time? He got rid of the leaven; he killed everybody rebellious that was 20 years old and up. The same thing is going to happen again. A lot of us might make it out of Babylon, but you might not make it into the promised land. - Everything we learned here in America, the customs, the days named after their gods, all of it has to go. The Lord is going to change everything and teach us everything the right way, even the parts we are missing now. We do our best according to the moon to tell the feast days, but the sun and the moon both were given for signs and seasons; through slavery that wisdom was destroyed from amongst us, and the Lord will restore what we forgot. - I will cause you to pass under the rod: the rod is correction. And I will bring you into the bond of the covenant. - I will purge out from among you the rebels, and them that transgress against me: those that break God's laws, those that got leaven in them. I will bring them forth out of the country where they sojourn, and they shall not enter into the land of Israel. You will be delivered up out of that destruction, but the same way everybody was delivered up from Egypt and everybody did not make it into the promised land, there will be groups of people that will be delivered that will not make it into the promised land. Precepts: - Hebrews 8:10-11 The bond of the covenant is the new covenant. I will put my laws into their mind, and write them in their hearts. We are going to know God's laws and we will keep them. You are not going to forget the feast day and eat the donut out of routine; his laws will be in our minds, and we will do them and serve him. We are in the beginning of the new covenant now, but once Christ returns it will be fully established in the wilderness. And they shall not teach every man his neighbour, saying, Know the Lord: for all shall know me, from the least to the greatest, because the Lord is going to teach us. Isaiah 35:1-10 1:01:15 - The wilderness and the solitary place shall be glad for them, and the desert shall rejoice, and blossom as the rose. When we are delivered, those desert places in our land are going to blossom; trees are going to start springing up. When the righteous people start ruling, everything changes, because we are connected to the earth. The glory of Lebanon shall be given unto it; they shall see the glory of the Lord, the majesty of our God, because the Lord will be on the earth. - Strengthen ye the weak hands, and confirm the feeble knees. Say to them that are of a fearful heart, Be strong, fear not. Those of you that are afraid of what you see coming, our job is to exhort you: behold, your God will come with vengeance. He is coming to judge the nations that destroyed his people. A lot of you talk about reparations; what can they give us to repay us for what they did to us? They cannot give us anything. The scripture says God himself will come with a recompence; he will come and save you. - Then the eyes of the blind shall be opened, and the ears of the deaf shall be unstopped; nobody is going to be hard headed anymore. Then shall the lame man leap as an hart. For in the wilderness shall waters break out, and streams in the desert. You see why we went here: in the wilderness. - And an highway shall be there, and it shall be called The way of holiness; the unclean shall not pass over it. In the wilderness, the unclean are not going into the land. It shall be for the wayfaring men: those brothers and sisters that kept the commandments, that got rid of the leaven inside of them. - But the redeemed shall walk there, and the ransomed of the Lord shall return, and come to Zion with songs and everlasting joy upon their heads. That is us walking back into our land. Precepts: - Revelation 5:12-13 Worthy is the Lamb that was slain to receive power, and riches, and wisdom, and strength, and honour, and glory, and blessing. And every creature which is in heaven, and on the earth, and under the earth, and such as are in the sea, heard I saying. There are creatures in heaven, creatures on the earth, creatures created deep inside the earth nobody has ever seen, and creatures in the sea like leviathan that no man has seen. And they all heard, and they understood. The creatures understand us; remember the donkey talked to Balaam and asked him, why are you beating me? 1 Corinthians 5:1-8 1:13:24 - It is reported commonly that there is fornication among you, that one should have his father's wife. Fornication is sexual sin. Understand the law concerning marriage: when a woman is betrothed, like Mary was betrothed to Joseph, she is already that man's wife, even if they are betrothed for years. We know his father's wife was not his mother; it had to be a woman promised to his father, and the son went and slept with her. - And ye are puffed up, and have not rather mourned, that he that hath done this deed might be taken away from among you. You should have put this brother away from among you. - To deliver such an one unto Satan for the destruction of the flesh, that the spirit may be saved. How do you deliver someone to Satan? You put them out of the school: you cannot be amongst us anymore. That is only if they are not trying to repent, not trying to change. When you read 2 Corinthians, Paul forgave this brother after he repented; Paul said if ye forgive him, I forgive him also, lest Satan should get an advantage of us, for we are not ignorant of his devices. That is a lesson for us. - If you allow one brother to commit adultery with no recompence, everybody starts committing adultery. Do not allow fornication to fester. Do not fear man; fear what God could do to you. And there are diseases out there. The teacher shared his own losses: his sister died at 20 years old HIV positive, and his stepmother and his father also died. Stop playing around; there is a God. - Know ye not that a little leaven leaveneth the whole lump? The leaven there was fornication. A little bit of fornication allowed in the schools starts spreading. - Purge out therefore the old leaven, that ye may be a new lump, as ye are unleavened. We are supposed to be unleavened, without sin. Are we without sin? No. But Paul said I die daily: when you make a mistake, you run to the Lord quick and say, Lord, forgive me, have mercy upon me, and you start over. Sin is always there in the mind; it is when you act on it that it becomes the problem. - For even Christ our passover is sacrificed for us. Therefore let us keep the feast, not with old leaven, neither with the leaven of malice and wickedness. Malice goes into hatred. We are keeping the feast of unleavened bread right now, and we cannot keep it with these things in us. - But with the unleavened bread of sincerity and truth. Ask yourself: am I sincere in this truth? The Lord looks for people that are sincere and really trying to change. Even if you make a mistake, when you are sincere you run to him. But there are some brothers and sisters that are not here in sincerity and truth: they do not love their brothers, they do not love their sisters, they complain, they gossip, they murmur. Those are all the people that were in the wilderness that got killed. We must be sincere: we believe Christ is coming back with vengeance, we believe we are the people of this book, even though we are a small remnant and the whole world is pushing the lie. The odds being against us makes it much more marvelous when the Lord does his thing. Genesis 4:1-7 1:31:27 - The two greatest things that destroy people in this truth are lust and bitterness. Lust is number one; from time to time you hear about brothers and sisters falling into fornication, and some never recover themselves. But bitterness is something very hard for brothers to recover from. I have seen a lot of brothers and sisters leave the truth because of bitterness. So let us go to the beginning: Cain was the first one to develop bitterness. - The Lord had respect unto Abel and to his offering, but unto Cain and to his offering he had not respect. Why? Because Abel did what he was told to do; Cain wanted to do his own thing. - And Cain was very wroth, and his countenance fell. That is where the bitterness starts. That anger came from jealousy. Anger, jealousy, malice, all these things go hand in hand, and they fall under the umbrella of hatred. Thou shalt not hate thy brother. - The Lord said unto Cain, Why art thou wroth? If thou doest well, shalt thou not be accepted? If you do what I tell you to do, I am going to accept you the same way I accept your brother. - And if thou doest not well, sin lieth at the door, and unto thee shall be his desire, and thou shalt rule over him. Ask yourself: what was Satan doing there? Moses is seeing what took place, and the Lord is showing him Satan present. When Cain got angry and his countenance fell, that is when Satan attacked him. Satan was there messing with Cain, and the Lord saw it. The Lord told Cain: fight Satan and do what is right, otherwise he will rule you and control you. He became the servant of Satan, for whosoever committeth sin is the servant of sin. - Satan was whispering all kinds of things in Cain's head concerning his brother, and what Cain ended up doing was rising up and killing his brother. Satan was behind all of that. Satan will play with your mind. Matthew 16:21-23 1:39:36 - Christ began to shew unto his disciples how that he must go unto Jerusalem, and suffer many things of the elders and chief priests and scribes, and be killed, and be raised again the third day. Was that a good thing or a bad thing? It was a good thing: he had to die to redeem the nation of Israel. It is hard to understand, like when we tell you some of us are going to be killed for teaching this truth; but Revelation 6 says the fellowservants must be killed as they were, and that has to be fulfilled. - Then Peter took him, and began to rebuke him, saying, Be it far from thee, Lord: this shall not be unto thee. Peter looked at Christ's death as a bad thing. - But he turned, and said unto Peter, Get thee behind me, Satan. What happened there? Satan literally jumped on Peter. That was not Peter; that was Satan talking to Christ through Peter, and Christ was literally talking to Satan. That is why in another place Christ told Peter, Satan hath desired to have you, that he may sift you as wheat: but I have prayed for thee, that thy faith fail not. - Satan comes for all of us. He comes different ways to defile us and destroy us: for some it is money, for some it is sex, for some it is hatred. Satan only comes at you at your weakness. So examine yourself: what is my weakness? That is what I need to strengthen, because that is what Satan is going to try to destroy me with. The worst brothers and sisters are the ones that say they have no weakness, that they are perfect; those are the ones dealing with the heaviest demons and just hiding it. Everybody has weakness. The Lord told Paul, my strength is made perfect in weakness; Paul asked three times for his weakness to be removed, and the Lord said no, fight it and become strong. Precepts: - Luke 4:13 When the devil had ended all the temptation, he departed from him for a season. You think Satan stopped tempting Christ? He never stopped; he just left for a season and came back in different ways. When Christ was about to be crucified, Satan came back, and he came back by jumping on Peter. Acts 5:3 1:51:01 - But Peter said, Ananias, why hath Satan filled thine heart to lie to the Holy Ghost? That is what happened with Cain, and that is what Satan does to us: he fills the heart. - Ananias and Sapphira sold their possession, and Satan came to them and said, act like you are giving them all the money, but keep back part for yourself, and do not let them know anything. If they wanted to keep back part for themselves, they could have just told Peter openly: we kept back a little part, and this part we are giving to the church. But Satan told them to hide it.
