By thy great wisdom and by thy traffick hast thou increased thy riches: by the way they traded slaves is how they became who they are today. - Video shown: a Polish member of parliament displayed an altered Israeli flag in parliament and compared the present war to the worst of the last century. Out of nowhere, from a country that never talks like that. Israel is a problem and America is a problem, and they are one and the same. - Readings shown on the covert record: Patrice Lumumba, with declassified documents showing US involvement in his assassination; Jaime Roldos Aguilera, whose plane crashed with his wife and officials aboard and had no black box; Fidel Castro, assassination plots and propaganda campaigns, with surveillance of sympathizers at home used to justify watching black activists and student movements; Che Guevara; Kwame Nkrumah, feared as the connection between African independence and black US leadership; Pedro Albizu Campos, constant surveillance, mail interception, informants inside the party, and the radiation that ruined his body, the king of towels walking his cell to stay cool; Martin Luther King, hotel bugs, blackmail, smear campaigns, and the letter telling him there was one thing left for him to do; Malcolm X, COINTELPRO surveillance and informants planted in his inner circle. And such happened with the Young Lords and everyone else mentioned. Why is Esau greatly despised? Obadiah 1:19-21 2:31:16 - They of the south shall possess the mount of Esau. This is the judgment of Esau; this is what is going to happen. - News video played in class: a grand jury in the Middle District of Alabama returned an eleven count indictment charging the Southern Poverty Law Center with wire fraud, bank fraud, and conspiracy to commit money laundering, alleging that between 2014 and 2023 it paid at least three million dollars to individuals affiliated with Klan and other hate organizations, not dismantling those groups but manufacturing the extremism it purports to oppose by paying sources to stoke racial hatred. The mission statement read: a catalyst for racial justice partnering to dismantle white supremacy. Whatever was done against us, the Lord flipped the script. - And saviours shall come up on mount Zion to judge the mount of Esau; and the kingdom shall be the Lord's. We are the herald to Christ; we are letting you know what is going to happen. In Closing The class closed with a comedian's routine on how good it is to be white in America: he can get in a time machine and go to any time in the past and it will be fine when he gets there, an option nobody else has, and he does not want to see the future because he knows there is a bill coming due. Out of their own mouth: they shall make their own tongue to fall upon themselves. We will never know what that privilege is, but we know what the book says about it, and the kingdom shall be the Lord's. Happy Sabbath. Stay tuned: Captain Zephaniah is up next at 11 with Puerto Rico: The Flame of Resistance, going in heavy on everything the brothers went through on the island. Announcements & References Captain Zephaniah's class Puerto Rico: The Flame of Resistance follows this class the same Sabbath morning. Support the Booster Club; the worldwide Passover blitz has reached Liberia, Ghana, Tanzania, the Caribbean, South America, Central America, Papua New Guinea, and the South Pacific, with much more to go. Books and documents read or referenced in class: - Modern Judaism by John Allen: Esau's descendants, sworn enemies of Jacob to the end of the world, founded Rome; the prophecies against Edom belong to Rome and the Christians - Dum Diversas (1452, Pope Nicholas V) and Romanus Pontifex: the papal bulls of perpetual slavery behind the doctrine of discovery - In the Pillory: The Tale of the Borgia Pope by John Bond: the bust of the Savior posed for by Cesare Borgia - The memoir of Heriberto Marin Torres, last survivor of the Puerto Rican Nationalist Party, on the Ponce and Utuado massacres - Books found in Puerto Rico: Puerto Rico Negro; Fotografias para la Historia de Puerto Rico; a history of the slave trade in Puerto Rico 1820 to 1860; Sugar, Slavery, and Freedom in Nineteenth Century Puerto Rico - The Green Book by Victor Green - The Wayward Rudd Collection: Soviet era poster art about Africa, Lumumba, and colonialism Media played: the Obadiah mini movie, the El Resplandor film reference, the Havana oil blockade report, the 1950s racism and Green Book segment, the exorcism movie clips on the Spanish Inquisition, the mission field report from the ruins of the 1685 synagogue, the Polish parliament clip, the SPLC indictment report, and the closing comedy clip. --- Class Notes Index Transcript: full session

title: I Come In Peace
text: Introduction Happy Sabbath to all. We are in the building, the best place to be on the Sabbath. A lot of people may not show up, want to stay home; you got to shake that spirit off, because we are supposed to congregate on the Sabbath. That is what the Bible says, so that is what we are doing. Today's class is called I Come In Peace. Thumbnail video: "The garden was here once. Now, only silence remains. Fire before them. Flame behind. The earth remembers who walked here." Book read to open the class: Chosen People from the Caucasus: "Nuclear war, environmental pollution, resource rape, all are primary threats to our survival, and all are the result of peculiar Caucasoid behavior, Caucasoid values, and Caucasoid psychology. There is no way to avoid the truth. The problem with the world is white men." - Who has nuclear weapons? The US is the only country that actually used nuclear weapons on anybody, on Hiroshima and Nagasaki. Figures read in class: Hiroshima, approximately 140,000 people died by the end of 1945; Nagasaki, approximately 74,000. Over 200,000 people from just two bombs, and that is just those two cities; about 26 million Russians died in that war. When people mention black on black crime as the biggest thing in America, just remind them of the wars they fought and the things they have done to our people. We should not be killing one another, but look at who is really doing the killing on this earth. - Environmental pollution: who owns all the big corporations with the chimneys pumping fumes 24/7? And they try to convince you it is your little car, or hairspray, or cow farts. The elephant in the room is the big factories. - Resource rape: the Berlin Conference divided Africa, and from that day until today they are raping that land. Gold, bauxite, oil, lithium for the batteries; and our people are the ones digging for these things with their bare hands, because they want it cheap so they can sell it for more. - I do not like saying the white man, because his real name is Esau. He is an Edomite, red and very hairy. A man that will create a weapon that could kill everybody including himself is telling you the only way he is giving up power is to wipe out everybody. That alone lets you know his heart. - Why are they called Caucasian? French Caucasian, German Caucasian, British Caucasian, American Caucasian: they all came from the Caucasus Mountains in Georgia, Russia. Because we made the mistake of allowing them to come around us, we bathed them, shaved them, educated them, showed them how to dress; and the biggest mistake was we started sinning against our maker, so they ended up getting the upper hand over us. Scriptures Opened Job 30:1-9 14:55 - They that are younger than I: Esau came out of the womb first, but they are the youngest nation, the last nation to take rulership on this planet. - Whose father I would have disdained to have set with the dogs of my flock: they were not counted worthy to even sit with the dogs of the flock. Maybe that is why they love dogs so much; they treat their dogs better than they treat us. - For want and famine they were solitary, fleeing into the wilderness: they did not live among us. They cut up mallows by the bushes and juniper roots for their meat. This is why, when they came to America and when they went to Africa and saw all that food, they said we need everything, we are going to take everything. - They were driven forth from among men; they cried after them as after a thief: we were the men, and we drove them away from us; they could not come around us. - To dwell in the clifts of the valleys, in caves of the earth, and in the rocks: it is not like the Bible says it and you cannot find it. Go to the Caucasus Mountains and you will find the caves. Originally they lived in Mount Seir; they are cave dwellers. Video shown in class on the origin of the Caucasian: images of how they looked in Europe, and the commentary that the Moors were fighting these people for hundreds of years. We ruled Europe; go read a book, do some research, look into your history. - Book referenced: The Thirteenth Tribe, on a tribe that would sit together picking lice off of each other; the teaching point is the condition the scripture describes was a documented reality. - They kicked us out of Europe; we went to Sao Tome and Cape Verde. When they really had power they came to America and conquered our brothers here, the natives, and then went back to Africa and got us again. All of that is because of our sins. Never forget the real reason these things were able to happen to us: we did not want the Most High to rule over us, so he put the basest of people over us. Almost everything they have, we invented; but they have convinced the world that they are the brightest and the smartest. - They were children of fools, yea, children of base men: you do not get any lower than the basement. No understanding, no wisdom whatsoever; but today, because of our sins, they are over us. - And now am I their song, yea, I am their byword: today we are the ones mocked with every insult, because they took over the world, and as long as they have control they do whatever they want. Genesis 25:21-31 24:28 - Isaac entreated the Lord for his wife because she was barren, and Rebekah conceived. Any of you sisters that is barren, do not nag your husband, but pray; ask the Lord, because only the Lord can open your womb. Have faith and pray to the Lord. - The children struggled together within her: we have been fighting since the belly. The division that exists between us and them is always going to be there. Christianity has fooled us into believing they can be changed, that we can trust them. We cannot, because it was ordained, as you are going to see through the scriptures today, for them to be who they are. - Two nations are in thy womb, and two manner of people: they come from the same belly, but they become two separate nations with different mannerisms, different ways of doing things, different ways of thinking. - The one people shall be stronger than the other people: we are the stronger people. Look at European sports today; the majority representing them is black people. Look at the French national soccer team, the German team. - The elder shall serve the younger: yes, we had dominion over them at one point. - The first came out red, all over like an hairy garment: it was important for that to be mentioned, because everybody was of the same complexion before. Notice they did not mention the brother's color; when Esau came out red, they had to document it. Precepts: - Genesis 2:7 The Lord God formed man of the dust of the ground: the deeper you dig, the darker the earth gets. Even the red earth in Oklahoma, put your hand next to it: it is a vivid brown, not red. That is another way to show you the natives were black; you can read the book Black Indians. And breathed into his nostrils the breath of life: the breath of life is the Lord's statutes and commandments that your Christian pastor tells you you do not have to keep. When you are not keeping the Lord's statutes and commandments, you are dead. - Proverbs 7:2 Keep my commandments and live, and my law as the apple of thine eye. If you want to have life, you must keep God's laws; there are no two ways about it. - Feed me, I pray thee, with that same red pottage; therefore was his name called Edom: that is his character; the food had to match his complexion. We are not supposed to be eating blood; that food has to be cooked. Two different manner of people. But you know how they did our people; they wanted to be just like their masters, so they started eating all the garbage that Esau eats. - Edom means red. Esau's name was changed to Edom, and he became the father of the Edomite nations. That is your so-called friendly neighborhood white man: the one that says I come in peace, but leaves you in pieces. That is how Esau operates. Do not trust his words. Genesis 27:37-40 33:56 - Behold, I have made him thy lord, and all his brethren have I given to him for servants: everybody on this planet is supposed to be our servants. It is our birthright; we are the rulers of this earth. But the only way to get it back is to remember where we fell off, what we did wrong. Christianity is not teaching you what you did wrong; matter of fact, they want you to stay in the wrong. - All Christianity is is a continuation of slavery. You ever heard the expression good cop, bad cop? In slavery, the man whipping you was the bad cop, and Christianity was the so-called good cop that pacified you into accepting the rules and regulations of slavery. Once you fully accepted it, you were fully destroyed, and then the shackles came off. They needed Christianity embedded in our brain so that we now willingly serve. Christianity and the slave masters were always the same people, one entity with one purpose: to enslave you and me. - Esau lifted up his voice and wept: hast thou but one blessing, my father? He ended up getting a blessing. Thy dwelling shall be the fatness of the earth, and of the dew of heaven from above: but wait, everything was already given to Jacob. If Jacob already has everything, how is Esau going to get the best portions of the earth? - And by thy sword shalt thou live: he is going to get all these things by using the sword. He is going to be a killer. But no matter where he goes, he says I come in peace; I just want to liberate your people; I just want freedom for you. Meanwhile it is missiles after missiles, nothing but atrocities going on in your country once you let them in. When you read the book of Maccabees it says evils were multiplied in the earth in their days; the earth already had evil, but when they took over, that thing multiplied. - And it shall come to pass when thou shalt have the dominion, that thou shalt break his yoke from off thy neck: that happened in the days of the kings, and we went back and forth; there was dominion again in 193 AD under Septimius Severus, and it was lost again around the Renaissance. So Esau is going to have possession of the earth, and he is going to kill to get it. Precepts: - 2 Kings 8:20 In his days Edom revolted from under the hand of Judah, and made a king over themselves: the breaking of the yoke the blessing spoke of. Malachi 1:1-4 41:23 - I have loved you, saith the Lord. Yet ye say, Wherein hast thou loved us? God loves us, but looking at our condition you would say there is no way you love me; I am in the ghetto and everything is going wrong for me. - Was not Esau Jacob's brother? Yet I loved Jacob: Jacob and all his descendants, the twelve tribes, the whole nation of Israel. And I hated Esau: and all his nation. Precepts: - Genesis 36:8 Thus dwelt Esau in mount Seir: Esau is Edom. There is no argument; Esau is Edom, and Esau came out red from his mother, hairy like a garment. - Whereas Edom saith, We are impoverished, but we will return and build the desolate places: they said we are living in the Caucasus Mountains, in the caves, but we are going to come back and build. They did come back; it is called the Renaissance, and they built major cities and took control of the whole earth. - They shall build, but I will throw down: the Lord is going to tear down what they built. - And they shall call them, The border of wickedness: not him, them; all of them. According to this verse there is not one righteous Edomite. Love it or hate it, that is on you; I cannot make the Bible say what it does not say. You could try to avoid the scriptures, but that is not going to change what is written. - And, The people against whom the Lord hath indignation for ever: definition read in class: indignation is anger aroused by something unjust, unworthy. So Esau is both unjust and unworthy. Unjust: from a journalism class, news that never aired: the same store robbery, and the black man got five years in jail while the white man got probation. And unworthy: chosen from the beginning to be the vessels of wrath fitted to destruction. His job is to chastise us because we stepped out of line, and that is just for a time; once that is done, then that is it for him. If the Lord has indignation against them forever, how are they going to be saved? A Christian will read this and argue it away; that is how you know Christianity is a drug. Habakkuk 1:4 49:01 - Therefore the law is slacked, and judgment doth never go forth: the wicked compass about the righteous. There are many wicked people on this earth, but there is a principal wicked man we just read about in Malachi: Esau Edom, the border of wickedness. They are everywhere, in all our countries, and they run things. - Therefore wrong judgment proceedeth. Cases discussed in class as the record of wrong judgment: the young man found dead in a gym mat whose case was closed without a trial, the bodies found hanging down south ruled suicides, Emmett Till murdered over a white woman's accusation and his mother's open casket, and the brother killed in a chokehold over selling cigarettes. The teaching point: justice still has not been served in this system, and the white woman's tears are used as a weapon. - Nonetheless, we need to repent, because our people are watching all these things happen, and we bring class after class with the truth. That is why we have to separate from these people; if not, we are going to keep getting judged like this. Deuteronomy 28:47-48 54:14 - Because thou servedst not the Lord thy God with joyfulness, and with gladness of heart, for the abundance of all things: we had the whole earth and we were ungrateful children. The Lord delivered us out of Egypt, we watched plagues upon plagues come upon Egypt, and we turned back and worshipped the same gods the Lord destroyed in Egypt. Even today it is pulling teeth to get us to be happy and joyous on a feast day. If you want your strength, apply Nehemiah: the joy of the Lord is your strength. The blueprint is already set. - Therefore shalt thou serve thine enemies, which the Lord shall send against thee: not friends, enemies. God himself sent them against us because we did not want him as a ruler. - In hunger, and in thirst, and in nakedness, and in want of all things: we serve for food, for water, for clothes, for all kinds of paperwork, because nothing is real in your life until the so-called white man says it is real. You are not even dead until the paper says so, stamped by Esau Edom. - And he shall put a yoke of iron upon thy neck, until he have destroyed thee: Christianity will tell you a spiritual demon put that yoke on. It is documented through history: a man put a yoke of iron upon our necks, and while he was doing it the heads of the churches were right there with him in agreement. While we were getting whipped, on Sundays they allowed us to go to church, and if we did not want to go we were whipped into accepting everything they taught. Once we fully accepted Christianity as it is today, they took the yoke off, because we were well trained to say the Lord loves my master, and to fight for our master. Until today we have that same mentality. - Even the understanding you have of the Bible was taught to you by Esau. That is why you do not have the right spirit on you. Precepts: - Nehemiah 8:10 The joy of the Lord is your strength: coming back to serve the Lord, we have to serve him with gladness, because we did not have gladness before and that is why we went into captivity. - 2 Corinthians 11:4 Once you serve another Jesus, you get another gospel, and once you get another gospel you receive another spirit. That is the spirit in these churches. - Romans 1:26 Once you serve another god, the Lord gives you up unto vile affections. Look at what is coming out of the churches now. You keep staying in that Christianity, serving a false deity, do not be surprised when the evil spirit jumps on you and you start defiling your body. - Your choir master is making all those songs dedicated to another deity, and the Lord is unhappy with that. He says you want to devote all your time to serving another god? I am going to remove myself, and watch what happens to you. - One of the most fascinating religions is the Pentecostals, because the name is the name of a feast, the feast of Pentecost. To choose that name means you read the scriptures and read the feast itself, and yet you do not keep the feast. Meanwhile you did not read Christmas, 4th of July, Halloween, Valentine's Day, or Thanksgiving anywhere in the Bible, and you gladly keep those. Christians are suffering from Stockholm syndrome: they love their oppressors and everything their oppressors do, because they are scared that if they stand up they are going to die. Thank the Lord for saving a remnant, because we all would have been as Sodom and Gomorrah. Hebrews 12:15-17 1:05:11 - Lest there be any fornicator, or profane person, as Esau: there are fornicators and profane people, but nobody reached the level of Esau when it comes to fornication and profaneness. He topped everybody. - Who for one morsel of meat sold his birthright: and when he would have inherited the blessing, he was rejected. - For he found no place of repentance, though he sought it carefully with tears: none. That means he cannot be saved. Though he cried, he is not getting it. Acts 5:30-31 1:06:26 - Him hath God exalted with his right hand to be a Prince and a Saviour, for to give repentance to Israel: repentance is for Israel. Not the fake people in the land right now; the Israelites, the children of the captivity, of the slave trade, of the colonization of Africa. - And forgiveness of sins: the reason we are able to be forgiven is the law was given to us. Their only job is to chastise us into shape. We are in punishment right now; it is like we are in jail and they are the correction officers. We just have to do our time in peace and we are going to come out. - When you hear brothers say we should gather guns and go fight Esau: something is wrong with you. The Bible said the sword was his gift; the Lord gave him the sword. Read the name written on your gun: Smith and Wesson. We do not make guns; the AK-47 is the Russians, the Uzi is the Israelis. That is their gift. All they have to do is cut the water off in the hood, that is it. Story told in class from Haiti: a gang leader bought five of ten cases of bullets from one of the oligarchs' middlemen, the police showed up within the hour, and after a three hour shootout used up all his bullets and had to call the same rich man for the other cases. That is the setup: America will have a shootout with you, make you waste your bullets, and then you are done. In 1985 they dropped a bomb on the MOVE organization in Philadelphia, and at Waco they came with tanks on white people, an offshoot of the Seventh-day Adventist church. Stop playing. Your only defense against this man is the Bible. - We have to learn to come back to the Lord and walk in righteousness, because that man does not know peace; all he knows is war. Even though he loves saying the word peace, like his president: I will be known as the most peaceful president ever. Precepts: - Psalms 91:1 He that dwelleth in the secret place of the Most High shall abide under the shadow of the Almighty. This is the place; this is where you find your rest and your protection. Video played in class: John Henrik Clarke, Pan-African historian: the African invited the European for dinner; the Indian invited the European for dinner; the Polynesians invited the European for dinner. If you invite people for dinner, you have plenty of dinner, and a society traditionally hospitable to strangers. The Indians invited Christopher Columbus for dinner, and in his own diary Columbus wrote: I wonder why they are so friendly; they will be easier to conquer than I thought; I wonder why they bring such small amounts of gold; I wonder where the mines are. His intentions were not good then, and the intentions are not good now. Black people have not seen white people at all; that is why they cannot deal with them. - Every time you invite this man for dinner, he eats the food, kills you, and takes your place. That is his character, but he says he comes in peace; that is why you invite him for dinner. Then he leaves you in pieces. Columbus's memoir says exactly what the Bible says. Obadiah 1:5-7 1:17:47 - If thieves came to thee, if robbers by night, would they not have stolen till they had enough? Regular thieves steal until they have enough; they grab a couple of bags and they are out. If the grapegatherers came to thee, would they not leave some grapes? - How are the things of Esau searched out! how are his hidden things sought up! Esau is a whole different being. Like Columbus said: that is a nice piece of gold, show me where you got it. You think he is just going to dig a few out of the mine? He will take the whole mountain, and when he realizes he cannot move the mountain, it is your land no more. That is what Esau does: steal, steal, steal. He can never have enough; he is like the ocean, all the rivers run into it and it is never full. They took everything of ours and then took our names as well; watch Our Hidden History, where the deacon brings that history out. - All the men of thy confederacy have brought thee even to the border: Esau is going to get the business from his own partners; the men in cahoots with him will turn against him. Does not Trump say he wants Greenland? Is Greenland not part of his confederacy? Does he not want Canada? To show you how greedy they are, they even turn on each other. They can never, ever have enough. Habakkuk 2:4-8 1:28:55 - Behold, his soul which is lifted up is not upright in him: something is wrong with that man; the Most High created him that way. Precepts: - Wisdom of Solomon 12:10-11 Executing thy judgments upon them by little and little: a war here, a storm here, a plague there. Not being ignorant that they were a naughty generation, and that their malice was bred in them, and that their cogitation would never be changed: their hatred was baked in from the creation, and their way of thinking will never change. For it was a cursed seed from the beginning: Cain was cursed from the beginning, and Esau was cursed from the beginning. Neither didst thou for fear of any man give them pardon for those things wherein they sinned: no matter what they do, they can never be pardoned for the sins they have committed. Even the killings where the officer himself cannot say why he shot a man lying flat with his hands up: sometimes they do things they do not even know why they do. - Micah 2:11 If a man walking in the spirit and falsehood do lie, saying, I will prophesy unto thee of wine: the wine he transgresses by is the falsehood and the lying. Esau gave you Protestant, Mormon, Seventh-day Adventist, Jehovah's Witness, Pentecostal, Freemasonry, Rosicrucian: lies. Every institute of doctrine he put on this earth takes you away from God. - He is a proud man: listen to how his president talks, saying the prince of Saudi Arabia has to kiss up to him now. Who talks that way? Like it says in the book of Daniel, he sets up over kingdoms the basest of men. - Neither keepeth at home: he is in everybody's country. Image shown in class: the US controls about 850 military bases in more than 90 countries worldwide, and there are actually more churches than military bases. That shows you the real way they control us is through Christianity, because we are more obedient to Christianity than to their military. - Who enlargeth his desire as hell, and is as death, and cannot be satisfied: right now they are on a quest to control the oil in Venezuela, Iran, Iraq; Greenland and Canada for the natural resources. And is as death: wherever he goes, people are dead; the class viewed the death tolls out of Gaza, with numbers in the hundreds of thousands reported since the conflict began. - But gathereth unto him all nations, and heapeth unto him all people: this is the great melting pot. After he destroys your country, he allows a few of you in, taking the brains of that country to come help his. It is modern slavery: back in the day you left your country in chains to be put in the work field; today they make it so bad you hop on the plane on your own and come look for a job. Same thing, different methods. And the church convinces you it is okay to be broke, okay for your country to lie desolate while another man eats your riches; just pray. No, it is not okay. The earth belongs to us and it is going to come back to us. - Woe to him that increaseth that which is not his! Everything is ours and he is stealing it from under our eyes. In all our countries, who controls the resources? We have enough to feed ourselves and do for ourselves, but are we doing anything? - Shall they not rise up suddenly that shall bite thee, and awake that shall vex thee? The other nations within his country shall rise up suddenly. There are sleeper cells in America and America knows it; the agencies have admitted it. They are lawyers and school teachers doing good, and once they get that phone call they are going to remember their families, like the Bible says Israel is going to remember their nature one day. America knows it, and the beautiful thing is they cannot stop it, because it was already preordained by the Most High. If you do not believe that, look at Deuteronomy 28: what was written about us happened, and we had no power to stop it. - News read in class: the US Army has increased its maximum enlistment age to 42, effective April 20th, 2026. They know they are going to need more men. Those of you who already served and think you retired: read the fine print; let a world war break out and they will need you at the base. There are going to be major decisions to be made in those days. The best thing any one of us can do right now is get right with the Lord: enough with the bickering, the fighting, the grudging, the murmuring, the hatred. Read 1 Corinthians 10, read Numbers, read Exodus: the Most High destroyed our forefathers because of these things, and now we are about to be delivered again from modern day Egypt. If we behave the way our forefathers behaved in the wilderness, we will not be delivered either. We are witnessing the greatest time on this planet; keep your eyes on the prize, do not look to the left or the right, stay focused. - Because thou hast spoiled many nations, all the remnant of the people shall spoil thee: image shown in class of the countries where they ran coups and robbed the land: Iran, Chile, Guatemala, where a fruit company orchestrated the coup for the bananas, Indonesia, Ukraine, the Congo, Brazil, South Vietnam, Iraq, Syria, Venezuela, Cambodia, Greece, Bolivia, the Dominican Republic, Egypt, Haiti twice, Australia, and more. They spoiled the world, and the whole world is going to turn against them. Because of men's blood, and for the violence of the land: so much blood has been shed here, and they have been shedding blood all over the world. Videos played in class on the board of peace: reporters asked whether the board of peace is meant to replace the UN, and the answer was the UN has not been very helpful. The initiative began with Gaza, where a fragile ceasefire took effect in October under the plan accepted by both sides; the health ministry reports the dead in the tens of thousands, including children, women, and the elderly, and hundreds more killed since the ceasefire began, with people still living in tents. - Stop for a second: you are creating a board of peace, and after you meet, people are still getting killed. You create a board of peace and you still go to war. What peace are you talking about? There can never be peace, because they are not a peaceful people. The sword is their blessing. They speak as a lamb, but really they are the dragon. - You invited a negotiator to negotiate, and while he is sitting at the table with you, you bombed his country. Then after that you say, okay, let us talk. Esau is a different breed; you cannot trust his word, not to save your life. - Comedy clip played: when I heard about the formation of the peace summit, I asked, is that p i e c e? A little piece of Greenland, a little piece of Venezuela, a little piece of everything. And once they are done, they leave you in pieces. - The department was even renamed the Department of War. They are showing their teeth, and the world is starting to see what they are really about. That is why you see Iran fighting back. Video discussion played earlier in class on Libya: as a black person, I watched slavery return to Libya. A man who was willing to help black people in their struggle, who wanted to unite Africa under one currency and a potential United States of Africa, was knocked off his chair; the country that used to have free housing, free education, and free health care now has slave markets. It is a club and you are not in it: Democrat or Republican, they fly on the jet together afterwards, and the working class gets crushed. - He said you can stay mad at the past forever; Haiti is not the past, that is current. Venezuela is current. White people get real uncomfortable when you start talking about real history. You said you went to Libya to liberate the people; they used to have free education and free health care, and now the people are broke and hungry. So how did you liberate? They always enter the country under the pretext of bringing peace and democracy, but really it is destruction. The peacekeeping mission in Haiti left sickness in the drinking water and abuse of the children. Image shown in class: countries before and after intervention: Afghanistan, Syria, Somalia, Yemen, Gaza. To get a country looking like that, you have to drop a very large amount of bombs; what do you think happened to the soil, and to the children being born? America is not the author of peace; he is the author of war and destruction. America loves puppets under their finger more than elected presidents; look at the coups in Haiti, who was behind them, and who they deposed. 1 Thessalonians 5:3 1:53:17 - For when they shall say, Peace and safety; then sudden destruction cometh upon them: you think there is going to be peace on earth? The Bible already tells you they are going to be destroyed. - As travail upon a woman with child: when a woman has a child there are increments of birth pains, and what you are watching right now is increments of birth pains. Besides Pearl Harbor, when has a navy fleet carrier been hit the way Iran just hit America? What you are witnessing is the tide slightly changing; we are getting closer to the serious birth pains. Israel has been bombarding many countries, but have they ever been hit the way they are getting hit right now? - And they shall not escape: because of what has been done to people, the whole earth wants to see this system gone. That is not me saying it; just turn on your TV. There is no nation that is really happy with America; even Europe is slowly turning against America. Daniel 8:25 1:59:00 - And through his policy also he shall cause craft to prosper in his hand: he creates rules and policies that make him rich on the earth. That board of peace he just created costs a billion dollars to join. So he is using his policies to get rich. - And he shall magnify himself in his heart, and by peace shall destroy many: I come in peace, and I leave you in pieces. - But he shall be broken without hand: remember what we read in 1 Thessalonians; he is not going to escape. All that he is doing right now on earth is going to happen for a little bit, but eventually the whole earth is going to come up against him. That world war is not going to be nice, and Esau is going to pay. The Most High has it timed. Our part as a people now is to come out. 2 Corinthians 6:17-18 2:00:50 - Wherefore come out from among them, and be ye separate, saith the Lord: how? Stop doing the things they are doing; stop following their ways. Let go of his ways and start choosing to keep God's ways. - And touch not the unclean thing: your Christmas, let it go. Thanksgiving, let it go. Your Christianity, let it go. Your masonry, your sororities and fraternities, let them go. Come out. - And I will receive you, and will be a Father unto you, and ye shall be my sons and daughters: when you cleanse yourself of all the uncleanness this world has to offer, then the Lord will receive you and be a Father to you. Those are not my words; all I am doing is reading and giving you the understanding of the scripture, written long before I was born. Precepts: - Proverbs 3:31 Envy thou not the oppressor, and choose none of his ways: none. Who created Christianity? Esau. Choose none of his ways. Revelation 18:4-5 2:03:13 - And I heard another voice from heaven, saying, Come out of her, my people: in case you did not comprehend it in Corinthians, this time the voice speaks straight from heaven. - That ye be not partakers of her sins, and that ye receive not of her plagues: that is the unclean thing; in her is found all manner of profaneness and fornication. If you partake in her sins, then when she gets destroyed, you get destroyed with her. - For her sins have reached unto heaven, and God hath remembered her iniquities: and when God remembers your iniquities, he is going to judge you. You have been warned. You have to come out of her. Revelation 14:12 2:04:30 - Here is the patience of the saints: here are they that keep the commandments of God, and the faith of Jesus. The churches do not teach you the commandments, so how are you going to be a saint if you do not keep the commandments as an Israelite? In order to get salvation you need both: the commandments of God and the faith of Christ. In Closing I hope you got something out of this class that will benefit you in coming to repentance, and help you see the so-called white man for who he is. Like the professor said in the beginning, black people cannot see white people for who they are; they trust them too much. The Bible says we cannot trust our enemy; your enemy will never teach you anything that is right. All the churches you are in, remember your enemies gave them to you. So come out of these churches, so that you do not get destroyed with America, because America will leave you in pieces. Stay in the spirit and enjoy the Passover, but meditate mostly on what not to do. Do not be like our forefathers who murmured; let us cut it out so that we can get our salvation. Shalom. Most High and Christ bless. Happy Sabbath. Happy Passover. Announcements & References Books referenced in class: - Chosen People from the Caucasus (read to open the class on the threats to our survival) - The Thirteenth Tribe (on the condition of the tribes of the Caucasus) - Black Indians (on the complexion of the natives) - The Willie Lynch letter (the mind can correct itself if it comes across substantial truth, therefore create a duplicity of lies; the class point: they created many false avenues so that by the time you go through them all, your life is spent. But the phenomenon they feared did occur: the Israelite movement, and IUIC is at the vanguard of this truth) Videos played in class: the origin of the Caucasian; John Henrik Clarke on the dinner invitations and Columbus's diary; the Libya discussion; the board of peace news coverage; the countries before and after intervention; the US military bases map; the coup flags image. title: LEAVEN: THE ROOT OF BITTERNESS PART 2
text: Introduction Opening prayer: Lord, we come before you today going into the fourth day of the days of unleavened bread. We come together to fellowship and to enjoy thy feast day. Put that joyful spirit on us and in our kids, to love thy word, to love thy feast days; you command us to be joyous in your feast days. Protect the brothers that are traveling and doing thy work, waking Israel up overseas; make the missions of the bishops, the deacons, and all the traveling brothers successful. You said even if one soul repents, the angels rejoice. We pray for the house of Officer Jonah, for sister Carmen: bring her back to full strength and health. Protect us from our enemies the same way you protected us when we were delivered out of the land of Egypt. And as we celebrate the feast of unleavened bread, help us get rid of the leaven of malice, the leaven of hatred, all the leaven, from our life, from our mind, from our body. We are going into the fourth day of the feast of unleavened bread, and tonight continues the lesson from last Friday: leaven, the root of bitterness. Yesterday Captain Matthew and the brothers went over leaven and the root of bitterness in the 9 a.m. class; if you did not see that class, go look at it. Lust and leaven, fornication and bitterness, are the two rampant sins amongst our people; those are the two things that destroy brothers and sisters out of this truth. When I say bitterness, I mean somebody did something to you and you did not deal with it right, or you felt offended, even from correction, and bitterness rose up inside of you, and you fell out of the truth because you allowed Satan to make that bitterness rise up in you. Bitterness is one of the devices Satan uses to take brothers out of the truth, so you have to learn how to fight it. Tonight: how Satan plants the root of bitterness, and the key ways to fight it and get rid of it. Scriptures Opened 1 John 2:14 13:04 - I have written unto you, young men, because ye are strong, and the word of God abideth in you, and ye have overcome the wicked one. The wicked one is Satan. This whole thing is about overcoming the wicked one, because that root of bitterness that comes to brothers and defiles them, guess who plays on it, who whispers things in your mind to cause that bitterness to grow? Satan. Back then the young men knew how to fight Satan; today you have to learn how to fight this war and where the war begins. 1 Peter 5:8 14:41 - Be sober, be vigilant. Sober means clear minded; vigilant means you are always aware, because you are fighting a battle. - Your adversary the devil, as a roaring lion, walketh about, seeking whom he may devour. Satan's job is to devour you, to destroy you. How does he devour you with the root of bitterness? The same way he did it to Cain: when Cain's sacrifice was not accepted, Satan put that hatred spirit on him and played on it, and Cain ended up hating his brother, killing him, and becoming a servant of Satan, because he gave in to the root of bitterness and envy. - Pay attention to the things people say to you, because Satan can use people to plant an evil seed in your mind. A brother or sister comes gossiping, telling you this person said this about you: they are planting a seed, and now you become bitter toward that person. When somebody comes to you like that, ask them: what did you say when they said that? Did you correct that person? And why would they feel comfortable saying that to you about me? If they feel comfortable saying things about me to you, I have to watch you too. That is the state of mind you have to have, because that is what Satan does: he plants seeds. 1 Corinthians 9:26-27 17:56 - So fight I, not as one that beateth the air: fighting Satan is not swinging in the air. But I keep under my body, and bring it into subjection: the way you fight Satan is controlling your body and controlling your mind. - The fight is not physical; the fight is spiritual, meaning it is in your mind. Every sin that every last one of us commits starts in the mind. If you can kill it there, it will not manifest itself. If you kill the root of bitterness in your mind when that seed tries creeping in, it is not going to bear a root. - A lot of brothers and sisters do not like correction, but if anybody comes and tells you the Deacon said something about you, do not believe them, because I will tell you to your face. - A couple weeks ago a brother reached out: Deacon, you got a problem with me? At the new moon I said shalom and you did not pay me any mind. Listen: my mind is often far away; if you do not get my attention, I zone out, especially when I am thinking on the scriptures. It was nothing intentional. But respect to the brother for reaching out directly, because otherwise Satan could play with his head and he could develop bitterness toward me for no reason. That is how you get rid of bitterness: you go to the person, because you can sit there thinking a person moved against you when they are not aware of anything running through your mind. Romans 7:20-25 27:06 - If you do things you are not supposed to do, it is no more you that do it, but sin that dwelleth in you. I find then a law, that, when I would do good, evil is present with me: evil is present with all of us, all the time. When you want to do good, Satan is always there too, tempting you and trying to destroy you. - I delight in the law of God after the inward man: the inward man is your mind, the inner you. - But I see another law in my members, warring against the law of my mind: there is something in you that wars against your mind. You want to do good, you want to do right, but something is telling you evil stuff all the time. Them thoughts in your mind warring against your mind is Satan. - Somebody says something to you and it triggers things in your mind: who does that person think they are talking to? Some of these officers can be disrespectful sometimes, and when we find out you are rolling like that, we are going to take your rank. But even when a brother is wrong in how he dealt with you, you still cannot entertain them kind of evil thoughts, because them evil thoughts turn into bitterness. Everybody in here is trying to become perfect, and imperfect people will offend you; you either go to that person and fix it, or you cannot sit there and become bitter and hateful. - It is weird for brothers to stop talking to a brother because of a sister, and sisters do the same thing: two sisters were cool, both liked the same brother, and now they stop talking to each other. That is bitterness and that is fake. If that brother is for you, he is for you. You cannot let anybody make you and your sister stop talking; and you brothers cannot stop talking to each other over a woman either. Brothers that roll like that need to repent. - And bringing me into captivity to the law of sin: that is what Satan is trying to do, bring you into the captivity of sin, the captivity of bitterness. O wretched man that I am! who shall deliver me from the body of this death? I thank God through Jesus Christ our Lord: so then with the mind I myself serve the law of God. Everything starts with your mind; when them evil thoughts come to your mind concerning your brother or your sister, you have to shake it off. Do not play with bitterness, hatred, or envy; when these things try creeping up in you, shake it off. Precepts: - Tobit 6:10-17 Raguel had one only daughter, named Sarah, and the angel said: fear not, for she is appointed unto thee from the beginning. From ever since the beginning, that was his wife. The Most High does bring people together. So do not develop bitterness and hatred toward each other over who is talking to whom: be happy for the brother; be happy for the sister. Whoever is for you is for you. That bitterness is going to change you, and it is just a matter of time before you leave the body. Acts 5:3 39:50 - But Peter said, Ananias, why hath Satan filled thine heart to lie to the Holy Ghost? The war always starts in the mind, and Satan is the one who puts these things there. The thought came into his mind: you do not have to tell the apostles how much you really sold the land for. He could have said, no, I cannot think like that; but he gave in to the thought, and then he went and lied to the apostles. That is how Satan attacks: he whispers things in your mind, and if you are not careful and vigilant and paying attention to your thoughts, you will defile yourself and get caught up in sin. 1 Samuel 18:6-9 41:26 - David returned from the slaughter of the Philistines, and the women came out of all cities of Israel, singing and dancing: Saul hath slain his thousands, and David his ten thousands. Satan was there too, and Satan went to Saul: you hear that? - And Saul was very wroth. Remember with Cain: why art thou wroth? Did David really slay ten thousands? Yes, he did; the Lord was fighting with David, and David was another level of warrior. - They have ascribed unto David ten thousands, and to me they have ascribed but thousands: and what can he have more but the kingdom? He wants my position. That is Satan whispering them things in his mind: the people love David; they are saying he is better than you; watch him. And Saul listened. - And Saul eyed David from that day and forward: he envied David and became bitter toward him, watching him sideways. Why did that happen? Because Saul entertained Satan. Them thoughts came to Saul's head, and instead of saying, David is a godly man, he does not want my position, he fed into it. The spirit of envy came on him. 1 Samuel 26:5-25 46:35 - This is when Saul was hunting David to kill him, because Saul was dealing with bitterness, envy, and hatred. David and Abishai came down to the camp by night, and Saul lay sleeping in the trench, with Abner, the top warrior in Israel at that time, and the people round about him. - Abishai said, God hath delivered thine enemy into thine hand this day: now therefore let me smite him. But David said, Destroy him not: for who can stretch forth his hand against the Lord's anointed, and be guiltless? Saul was anointed by the Lord to be king, and David understood: I cannot kill one of God's anointed. That is the kind of love David had toward his people. - As the Lord liveth, the Lord shall smite him; or his day shall come to die; or he shall descend into battle, and perish. The Lord is the one that is going to deal with Saul if he does not change. That is the same state of mind we all have to have: even if somebody does you wrong, you do not have to do evil back. Sometimes it is good to leave it in God's hands. David took the spear and the cruse of water, went far off on a hill, and called out. - Wherefore doth my lord thus pursue after his servant? for what have I done? or what evil is in mine hand? If the Lord have stirred thee up against me, let him accept an offering. Sometimes the Lord can put a spirit on somebody to do something to you, to see how you operate; and how you deal with it tells whether you get the kingdom or not. That person might deal with you wrongfully, but it is really to try you. If you become bitter and deal with it wrong, you lose the kingdom, while the Lord may forgive the one who wronged you. Remember Shimei cursing David: David said, let him alone; the Lord hath bidden him. - But if they be the children of men, cursed be they before the Lord. What was taking place with Saul? You had men around Saul whispering in his ears: David thinks he is better than you; David wants the kingdom. Satan was in certain men around Saul, and Saul was feeding into it instead of saying, I do not want to hear that; David would never do that; David is a man of God. That is why you better be vigilant: if somebody comes and whispers evil to you, ask them, why are you coming to say this to me? You want me to hate that person? Did you correct that person? - I have seen people in the body spread evil, even about me: brothers going to brothers saying the Deacon said this and that, and brothers end up hating me off of a whisper. A couple years back there were a couple of wormtongue brothers just whispering and murmuring, and I sat back and watched. Once I find one bitter, murmuring brother, everybody in that circle is defiled, because the scripture says if a man purge himself from these, he shall be a vessel unto honour. If a brother is bitter against leadership because he got corrected, and you are around him buddy buddy, it is because you all have the same spirit. That is why I do not rush to get rid of bitter brothers; I leave them for a while and see who gravitates to them. - Then said Saul, I have sinned: return, my son David... behold, I have played the fool, and have erred exceedingly. David hit a nerve, and Saul caught himself. Sometimes people do evil to you because Satan jumped on them, and afterward they realize it and say, I am sorry. When somebody comes at you sideways, it is not necessarily the person in front of you that you are fighting; it is Satan in them. - As thy life was much set by this day in mine eyes, so let my life be much set by in the eyes of the Lord, and let him deliver me out of all tribulation. That is what you want: the Lord to deliver you out of tribulations. But you do not want to take vengeance into your own hands, and that is what David understood. - Even in your marriage: sometimes Satan will jump on a brother and he will say evil things to his wife; sister, you have to realize it is not your husband, it is Satan you are really dealing with. Remember when Satan entered Job's wife: curse God, and die. Job said, thou speakest as one of the foolish women speaketh. Job was not dealing with her; he was dealing with what entered into her and was speaking. Leviticus 19:17-18 1:02:55 - Thou shalt not hate thy brother in thine heart: thou shalt in any wise rebuke thy neighbour, and not suffer sin upon him. Thou shalt not avenge, nor bear any grudge against the children of thy people. That is where bitterness comes from: the grudge. This is what David understood; he had love for his brother and did not take vengeance, even though Saul wanted him dead. Ecclesiasticus 28:1-3 1:06:45 - He that revengeth shall find vengeance from the Lord, and he will surely keep his sins in remembrance. If you take vengeance, you will find vengeance from the Lord. If David had taken vengeance, he would have found vengeance from the Lord. - Forgive thy neighbour the hurt that he hath done unto thee, so shall thy sins also be forgiven when thou prayest. We will do things that hurt each other from time to time; your spouse will do things that hurt you from time to time. Why does it say the hurt? Because it hurts, and you do not really want to forgive; it is hard. But you have to do what God says and get rid of that pride, because if you do not forgive them, it turns into bitterness. And it is not talking about forgiving only the small things you want to forgive; it is talking about the stuff that really hurt. King David forgave Saul for trying to kill him. - One man beareth hatred against another, and doth he seek pardon from the Lord? You are bearing grudges and bitterness toward your spouse and talking about how you love God: you are phony and you are fake. Colossians 3:19 1:11:40 - Husbands, love your wives, and be not bitter against them. The root of bitterness is not just congregational; it also goes into how a brother deals with his wife, because a woman can do things where you end up bitter toward her. When you are bitter toward her, there is no love in the marriage; there is a separation there, and the counsel sessions cannot fix a marriage where the bitterness stays. - Let me tell you men something straight: if you deal evil with your wife, push her away, and the marriage falls apart because of your evil dealing, do not think leadership only deals with her. You go too. You and your wife are one flesh, and you are supposed to try to save her, to love your wife as you love yourself. If she fell back into the world because of you being evil, why would the brothers trust you? Any man that deals evil with his wife, brothers do not trust him; let him repent and change. - If Satan comes into your mind saying, why does she not just commit adultery so I can divorce her and marry another sister, that thought should never come to your mind. That is bitterness, and God reads your thoughts; you are not going to last in here rolling like that. - There are levels to the bitterness. There is a low form between spouses over small disappointments; that can be fixed easily and you are smiling again the next day. Then there is the other type of bitterness that is really hatred, where a brother hates his wife; that is the bitterness that destroys marriages, and if it is in you, examine yourself. - Women mostly become bitter from correction: when you get on them and tell them what they did was wrong, they become bitter about it. Sisters, you have to work on that bitterness too, and listen to your husband in all things; be like Sarah, who listened to Abraham even when he was wrong. Do not try to prove yourself right; be quiet, and go to the Lord and pray. 1 Corinthians 13:4-5 1:19:08 - Charity suffereth long: if you really love your brother, your wife, your spouse, you are going to endure and be patient. Charity envieth not; is not easily provoked; thinketh no evil. - Hear that: charity thinketh no evil. When Satan comes to put evil thoughts in your mind about someone else, you have to say: I am not going to think evil about that person. Repeat it over and over: charity thinketh no evil. That is how you deal with it when Satan tries to put evil thoughts in your mind. Somebody says something; charity says that person probably did not mean it like that. Ecclesiasticus 28:7-8 1:21:05 - Remember the commandments, and bear no malice to thy neighbour: remember the covenant of the Highest, and wink at the ignorance. To wink at ignorance means sometimes people say dumb stuff out of immaturity; the person has not grown, and they probably did not even mean it a certain way. For the root of bitterness not to build up in you, sometimes you just wink at it: that person just does not know. Do not take it serious. - Abstain from strife, and thou shalt diminish thy sins: for a furious man will kindle strife. Strife is the arguing. When you see brothers and sisters arguing and striving all the time, that is evil among them. Abstaining from strife is how you diminish your sins. Ecclesiasticus 19:13-17 1:23:58 - Admonish a friend, it may be he hath not done it: and if he have done it, that he do it no more. You hear something, or you think somebody did something to you: go and admonish that person, correct them, warn them. Do not hold on to it inside, because Satan will play with it and it turns into the root of bitterness. Sometimes the person never said it. - Admonish thy friend, it may be he hath not said it: and if he have, that he speak it not again. If the person did say something evil about you, tell them: do not say that again. And if they say they are sorry, forgive them and forget about it; do not hold on to it. - Admonish a friend: for many times it is a slander, and believe not every tale. A lot of times when somebody comes and says this person said this about you, this person does not like you, it is slander; it is Satan. Do not believe everything you hear. - There is one that slippeth in his speech, but not from his heart: sometimes brothers and sisters slip in their speech and say something offensive, but they were not trying to offend or hurt you; there was no evil behind it. God reads their mind, but your mind takes it as evil, and now you have bitterness inside toward a person who meant nothing. And who is he that hath not offended with his tongue? Every one of us can offend with the tongue from time to time. - Admonish thy neighbour before thou threaten him; and not being angry, give place to the law of the most High. You cannot be angry, wanting to fight somebody; you go to that person and try to fix it. Matthew 18:33-35 1:28:48 - So likewise shall my heavenly Father do also unto you, if ye from your hearts forgive not every one his brother their trespasses. You have to forgive from your heart; it has to be real, not fake. Some of you say, I forgive you, and then go to the next person: you know what that sister did to me? You never really forgave. God reads your heart; he can tell if you really forgave someone. - That goes for you spouses too. When the scripture says love thy neighbour, your neighbour is your spouse, your brother, your sister. Sisters, if your husband did something to you, forgive him from your heart; brothers, if your wife did something to you, forgive her from your heart. Otherwise Satan will use it, and bitterness rises up in your mind. Matthew 5:44 1:31:22 - Love your enemies: your enemy is like King Saul was to King David, and David still loved him. That is the example of how you get rid of bitterness. - Bless them that curse you: even if somebody in here does not like you, so what? Keep it moving. - Pray for them which despitefully use you, and persecute you. If somebody is dealing evil with you, do not entertain it; pray for them: God, take that spirit away from that sister. Lord, take that bitter spirit away from my husband. How about praying for your husband instead of telling people your husband is wicked? Your enemy could even be your spouse when Satan jumps on them. Instead of taking vengeance, leave it to the Lord; instead of sitting there becoming bitter, approach the person and fix it; if they do not want to fix it, leave it to the Lord, wink at ignorance, and pray for that person. Charity thinketh no evil. In Closing This is how you really purge out that leaven from your spirit. You have to clean up your heart: get rid of the leaven out of your heart, the hatred, the jealousy, the envy, the strife, the malice, the pride. We cannot be fighting and avoiding each other; we have to endeavor to keep the unity, really deal right with each other, and have a real love toward each other. To fight the root of bitterness: charity thinketh no evil; admonish the person, because many times it is a slander; wink at ignorance; forgive from the heart; pray for the one dealing evil with you; and leave vengeance to the Lord. Announcements & References Happy feast of unleavened bread. All the schools are open with different events tonight: movie night, game night, and formal night here in New York, so everybody come fly. The teacher rocked the brown Original Royalty jacket; if you want one, go to Original Royalty. Closing reading: 1 Corinthians 11:23-29, the bread and the cup, in remembrance of the Lord's death till he come; let a man examine himself. Do not eat the bread unworthily. --- Class Notes Index Transcript: full session

title: Puerto Rico: The Flame Of Resistance
text: Introduction Sabbath class from Captain Zephaniah, born out of mission 212 to Puerto Rico. The opening reading is Psalms 16, and the opening prayer covers the leadership and the brothers traveling during the season of Passover, still in the midst of the worldwide blitz. This class is dedicated to the tribe of Ephraim, the so-called Puerto Ricans, and to everyone on the comment boards with sincere questions after the work done on the island. The mission work recapped at the top: a podcast with a brother named Carlos on La Teologia de la Calle, the theology of the streets; the Derek Xander podcast, where one reel alone pulled about half a million views; and a Christian radio show that has been on the air in Puerto Rico for about 40 years. The Most High is opening up doors, and the people are curious. The inspiration for the class is Heriberto Marin Torres, a 97 year old revolutionary who opened his home to the brothers. He is an elder of the movement of Pedro Albizu Campos, whose original picture hangs in his home. He lived through the 1948 gag law, Law 53, La Ley de la Mordaza: you could not wave the Puerto Rican flag, carry it, speak about independence, or congregate as a political party, and he did nine years in prison. He wept telling the history of the diaspora, the Puerto Rican brothers and sisters who came to New York and the condition they were in. When the elders pass away, a whole library burns to the ground; the brothers got the history directly from him. Pedro Albizu Campos, El Maestro: a Harvard law valedictorian who was not allowed to give the speech because he was a black Puerto Rican. He learned racism in the States and went back to improve conditions, leading the sugarcane cutters' strike that raised their pay. He was teargassed, imprisoned 26 years in El Morro, and subjected to radiation experiments that left his legs swollen. They offered him the governorship of Puerto Rico if he gave up his revolutionary ways, and he refused: I cannot betray my people. He was of Afro Latino descent, from the tribe of Ephraim. When he first met young Heriberto he refused to shake his hand and hugged him instead, tapped his chest and asked, how is your heart? The Jayuya and Ponce uprisings, Blanca Canales, and Lolita Lebron were remembered alongside him. These brothers fought with love, not hatred; they wanted independence for Puerto Rico. Boriqua is a term of pride used by Puerto Ricans to identify themselves, from Borinquen, the indigenous Taino name for the island, translating to the land of the valiant and noble lord. They say it is a Taino word; we believe it is a Hebrew word, because we are the Israelites. Scriptures Opened Romans 15:4 21:46 - Whatsoever things were written aforetime were written for our learning. The Bible was written for our learning. - We have to have patience and comfort with our people, because they get upset; they have never heard this truth before. Christ is black, the Israelites are black, Puerto Ricans are the tribe of Ephraim. So we deal with them patiently and comfort them through the scriptures, that we might have hope. - There is hope in these scriptures, because we are not going to win against an imperialist government with arms, with bombs, with guns. Through patience and comfort of the scriptures we have hope. Isaiah 34:16 23:33 - Seek ye out of the book of the Lord, and read. We have to read for ourselves. When we bring out these scriptures to our people, they have to read it for themselves, because we could be lying, we could be wrong, but the scriptures do not lie. - No one of these shall fail: the prophecy of what would happen to the tribe of Ephraim in these last days will not fail. We have the history and the books to back it up. - None shall want her mate: if the books do not align with the scriptures, we do not bring them out. We bring them out because they line up with what the scriptures say. Revelation 1:3 24:49 - Blessed is he that readeth. For a long time we would go to church and just sit there and let the pastor give us his rhetoric, and never read the scriptures for ourselves to see whether what he brought was true. - Blessed is he that readeth, because you do not get deceived, you do not get lied to. Daniel 9:2 26:00 - Daniel understood by books. If the books do not coincide with what the scriptures say, do not follow them. - This class shows with books, historical records, and the Bible who the tribe of Ephraim is, who Christ the black Messiah is, and who the devil is that deceived us and gave us a white Jesus and a white God, which is not found in the Bible. 1 Kings 8:56 26:56 - Blessed be the Lord, that hath given rest unto his people Israel. Unto Israel, not everybody. The people of God is Israel. - There hath not failed one word of all his good promise. The Bible is a true book: everything in it has come to pass and is coming to pass. Deuteronomy 28:15, 46, 64 28:34 - Do we need the books? No. Before the internet and before Google, the elders, Elder Abba Bivens and Elder Marshall, identified who the northern kingdom is according to the scriptures, according to the curses that are upon our people today. The books only back up what the scriptures say. - All these curses shall come upon thee and overtake thee. This is how we know who the twelve tribes are: there are curses upon the nation of Israel to this day. - They shall be upon thee for a sign, and for a wonder, and upon thy seed for ever. When we see these curses upon us, it is a sign to tell us who we are. We are not black, not Latino, not Native American, not Puerto Rican, not even Boriqua; we are the nation of Israel. The so-called Puerto Ricans are the tribe of Ephraim. - The Lord shall scatter thee among all people, from the one end of the earth even unto the other. You want to know how you got to that little island of Puerto Rico? The Most High scattered you there. Colossians 2:8 37:44 - Beware lest any man spoil you through philosophy and vain deceit, after the tradition of men. The main religion in Puerto Rico is Roman Catholicism, with roughly 70 percent of the population identifying as Catholic and about 25 percent Protestant and evangelical. Pay attention to the name: Roman Catholicism. The Romans are a people, the so-called white man. All those denominations fall under Catholicism; Catholicism is the umbrella. - We saw in the thumbnail how they burned the cacique Atahualpa at the stake for not accepting the white man's religion. What happened to him is the reason 70 percent of our people today are in Roman Catholicism. - Another cacique, a leader and king, was baptized under the Christian name Don Alonso Manso. Manso means tamed, docile, weak, like when you tame a wild animal. That is what they did to a king for accepting Christianity. The monument inscription in Utuado says the Catholic evangelization of the Taino ultimately served as a significant tool in the conquest of Borinquen; a tool is a weapon, used like the rifle against our people. - Reading from the man-made religions chart: Pope Nicholas V is the father of the transatlantic slave trade; John Smyth created the Baptist religion in 1608; Joseph Smith created the Mormon religion in 1830; William Miller created the Seventh Day Adventist religion in 1863; Charles T. Russell created the Jehovah's Witness religion in 1872; Charles Parham created the Pentecostal religion in 1901. We were still in slavery while these religions were being created. None of that is found in the scriptures. The Bible is the Israelites' history book, our laws, statutes, and commandments. - Throwback video played from the Bronx camp about 13 years ago: a so-called Puerto Rican wanted to put hands on the brothers for stepping on the image of a white Jesus. That is the effect of Roman Catholicism on the minds of our people. Revelation 6:2 43:05 - You do not think the conquistadors are found in the scriptures? A white horse, and he that sat on him had a bow, weapons, and a crown was given unto him, and he went forth conquering and to conquer. Conquering: conquistando, conquistador. This man on a white horse represents Esau conquering the dark nations. - An engraving of the conquest was shown and summarized in class: the record of the atrocities the conquistadors committed against our men, women, and children, read as the fruit of that man-made religion and of the curses that befell our people for turning our backs on the laws of God. - Book read in class, Dr. William Smith's Dictionary of the Bible (1890): "I have several times shown that from Edom proceeded the kings who reigned in Italy, and who built up Rome... in this way Italy and Greece and all the western provinces filled with Idumeans. Thus it is that the prophets called the whole of that nation by the name of Edom." Rome is Edom. Those are the Italians, the Romans, your Roman Catholic popes. This was written in 1890, when we were just coming out of slavery; Esau wrote about themselves. It continued on the book of Obadiah: it is a fixed principle of rabbinic interpretation that by Esau is prophetically meant the Christians, and that by Edom is meant Rome. All that the prophets said about the destruction of Edom in the last times has reference to Rome. - Book read in class, The Rise of Christendom (1890): the medieval chroniclers say expressly that Edom means the Roman Empire, or the European powers. Benjamin of Tudela, circa 1160, calls Rome the Edomite capital, and the Pope the head of the Edomitish religion. That was the twelfth century; there was no Google, no AI to distort the truth. Historians documented it. - Book read in class, Modern Judaism by John Allen (1771 to 1839): the descendants of Esau, the sworn enemies of the descendants of Jacob even to the end of the world, were at first a small nation inhabiting Mount Seir; after the republic of the twelve tribes was destroyed by the Assyrians and Babylonians, they increased, spread their colonies, subjugated Italy, and founded Rome and the Roman Empire, which at length overturned the Jewish state, the second temple being destroyed by Titus Vespasian. Esau detains his brother Jacob in captivity until the Messiah, the son of David, shall appear. And Obadiah says there shall not be any remaining of the house of Esau; the slaughter of the Christians in the future battle will be greater than that of the Muhammadans, for many of the Turks will escape according to Isaiah 66:19. - Movie clip played, Apocalypto: the northern kingdom in idolatry, brother persecuting brother, until they stop in their tracks at the sight of the ships. The Nina, the Pinta, the Santa Maria: we know those names because they were ingrained in our brains in elementary school, singing about them every October 12th, commemorating our enslavement. And who came with the conquistadors? The Roman Catholic priests with the cross. The Tainos, the Boriquas, the Arawaks did not have Roman Catholicism; it was forced upon us. Isaiah 29:13 1:05:17 - This people draw near me with their mouth, and with their lips do honour me, but have removed their heart far from me. We say we love God, we say Christ is our Lord and Savior, hallelujah, but we have removed our minds far from what the scriptures say. - That is why you have black priests holding up white men on the cross, and our women weeping over statues of white people. That is idol worship. Centuries and centuries of deception were forced upon our people; if we did not accept it we were put to death, and now we cry tears over it. Matthew 15:8 1:07:29 - Christ quotes Isaiah: this people draweth nigh unto me with their mouth, and honoureth me with their lips, but their heart is far from me. But in vain they do worship me, teaching for doctrines the commandments of men. - What do the commandments of men translate to this day? Roman Catholicism, Christianity, a white Jesus, a white God. Far from Christ. 2 Corinthians 11:3-4 1:10:15 - As the serpent beguiled Eve through his subtilty, so our minds were corrupted from the simplicity that is in Christ. It is easy to understand Christ if you read for yourself. - For if he that cometh preacheth another Jesus: who came preaching another Jesus? The conquistadors, Christopher Columbus, Ponce de Leon, Hernan Cortes. The priests were not far behind; they were necessary to indoctrinate the people. Esau knew how to control our people with the religion they created. - Images shown: 1923 Christmas cards mocking our people, and a Christian church pulpit surrounded by the Klan, the same men who were burning and lynching black people. Yet our people still think we can be united in the same church building and the same religion. Ecclesiasticus 12:10-12 1:12:49 - Never trust thine enemy: for like as iron rusteth, so is his wickedness. When the conquistadors and the priests came with that religion, we were not supposed to trust them. - Though he humble himself and go crouching, though he come bearing gifts in the name of Christianity, take good heed and beware of him. They come now with smiles and docile ways, but the wickedness is still there. - Pictures shown of the baptism of the Tainos by the Catholic priests, and of our people in Puerto Rico kneeling with rosary beads to a white image of the Virgin Mary and the baby Jesus with white saints behind them. That is what happens when you accept the white man's religion: you become docile, you become a slave in your mind. Revelation 1:1-3 1:19:00 - Book read in class, In the Pillory: The Tale of the Borgia Pope by John Bond: the bust of the Savior was posed for by Cesare Borgia, the second son of Pope Alexander VI of Rome. It was removed from the church of San Salvador in Lauro, now destroyed, to the monumental morgue of St. Louis church, where it is shown as the bust of the relative of a famous pope. It is an open secret. This is how the image of our Lord and Savior got changed; the truth got changed into a lie. This is why that so-called Puerto Rican got so upset at camp when the elder stepped on the image: he was fed this lie. - The revelation of Jesus Christ, which God gave unto him to show unto his servants: John bore record of all things that he saw. Christ had to leave his image recorded for us in these last days, because in the last days they would come preaching another Jesus. - Blessed is he that readeth those records for himself, so a white image does not deceive him. With this Bible you cannot be deceived; you can cast down wicked imaginations and doctrines. Ephesians 1:1-5 1:21:50 - Christ told John to send the book unto the seven churches which are in Asia: Ephesus, Smyrna, Pergamos, Thyatira, Sardis, Philadelphia, Laodicea. The brothers visited the churches in Ephesus and Smyrna; the acts of the apostles still continue to this day. - Paul writes to the saints which are at Ephesus. Those were not white people. Having predestinated us unto the adoption of children by Jesus Christ: the adoption is not for everyone. Precepts: - Psalms 148:14 He also exalteth the horn of his people, the praise of all his saints, even of the children of Israel. The horn of his people is Christ, and the saints are indeed the children of Israel: the so-called blacks, Latinos, and Native Americans who are under the curses found in Deuteronomy 28. - Romans 9:3-4 My brethren, my kinsmen according to the flesh, who are Israelites, to whom pertaineth the adoption. Paul was talking to the twelve tribes scattered in Asia. That is who the adoption is for. Line upon line, here a little and there a little: this is how you get the understanding. Revelation 1:11-15 1:25:45 - Being turned, John saw seven golden candlesticks: a menorah, a seven branch menorah representing the seven churches. He did not see a crucifix; he did not see a cross. - In the midst of the candlesticks, one like unto the Son of man. Our people say the image does not matter, as long as I have him in my heart. But if you do not know what Christ looks like, you are going to get deceived; you are going to fall for the white man's Jesus. - His head and his hairs were white like wool. It is telling you two things: the color and the texture. The color is white; the texture is wool, like the woolly hair of the negro. Some of the old dictionaries under the word woolly say hair of the negro. Christ did not have blonde hair; he had an afro, white like wool. - His eyes were as a flame of fire. The podcast host asked whether that was literal or figurative, so the class went line upon line. - His feet like unto fine brass, as if they burned in a furnace.
