Bronze is a derivative of brown, like the Olympic medals: gold, silver, bronze. And when you burn brass it turns black. Video played of a brass menorah being burned: it turns black. Christ's feet were so black they looked like they burned in a furnace. - His voice as the sound of many waters: a deep voice. That is hip talk, the way the scriptures speak in idiom; when a king was rich the scripture says he waxed fat, and when Saul relieved himself the scripture says he covered his feet. That is how you know the scriptures were written by our people; we speak in parables. - Slave registries shown from a university archive in Mayaguez, Puerto Rico, original cedulas listing each slave's name, height, color, hair, eyes, nose, and mouth. Modesto, about 15 years old, dark skinned with an afro; Lucia, 80 years old, still enslaved in field labor, dark complexion; Manuel, origin Africa, moreno with an afro. Renderings generated from the registry descriptions were shown: black Puerto Ricans. Ephraim is a cake not turned; Puerto Ricans come from the lightest shade to the darkest dark, like Roberto Clemente. - Reading shown: contrary to common belief, European slave traders were fairly well informed about various African ethnicities, leading to slavers targeting certain ethnic groups which plantation owners preferred, so that desired ethnic groups became fairly concentrated in certain parts of the Americas. The slave traders knew which tribes they were transporting and where they put them. Even if you are light skinned, the curses fit you; you are an Israelite. Precepts: - Genesis 49:12 His eyes shall be red with wine. When you drink wine, the whites of your eyes turn red. Christ did not have blue eyes. And his teeth white with milk: his teeth were white, and the milk represents the word. - 1 Peter 2:2 As newborn babes, desire the sincere milk of the word. Christ's teeth were white with milk because he came teaching the laws. Genesis 41:50-52 1:43:14 - Joseph is the father of the two tribes, Manasseh and Ephraim, born in Egypt after his brothers sold him into slavery out of jealousy, because he was his father's favorite. - Manasseh means made to forget: God hath made me forget all my toil. Ephraim: God hath caused me to be fruitful in the land of my affliction. One of the blessings of Ephraim, the so-called Puerto Ricans, is to have many children. Genesis 48:11-20 1:44:53 - Israel thought he would never see Joseph's face, and God showed him his seed also. Joseph set Ephraim toward Israel's left hand and Manasseh toward his right, so the firstborn would get the right hand blessing; and Israel crossed his hands wittingly, guiding them knowingly, laying his right hand on Ephraim the younger. - Let my name be named on them: this is why Ephraim and Manasseh are counted in the twelve tribes even though they are Joseph's children. - Joseph was displeased and tried to move his father's hand, and Israel refused: I know it, my son, I know it. Manasseh also shall become a people, and he also shall be great; but truly his younger brother shall be greater than he, and his seed shall become a multitude of nations. And he set Ephraim before Manasseh: Ephraim is the head tribe of the northern kingdom. - Reading shown on the multitude of nations: as of recent estimates, roughly two thirds of people of Puerto Rican origin live in the fifty states and the District of Columbia rather than on the island, about 6 million on the mainland and only about 3 million on the island. That is displacement, and it also shows Ephraim scattered as a multitude; you find Ephraimites even in Hawaii, sent there to work the sugarcane fields. Deuteronomy 28:36 1:52:56 - There thou shalt serve other gods, wood and stone. Christianity and Islam are the two main religions our people are in today. - Video played on gentrification in Puerto Rico: abandoned buildings, investors calling it opportunity, communities being displaced, and residents occupying and restoring the spaces themselves. It is not coincidence; it is by design. Back then the Assyrians and Babylonians moved us off the land by force; now Esau deals subtly, painting the United States as the land of milk and honey so the people abandon the island and it can be bought up. - That is what we have to do: take care of our communities ourselves, plant, grow, have some self worth. Common unity, community, all things common like it says in Acts 2 and Acts 4. - Video played on Lorain, Ohio: in 1947 Puerto Rico's legislature passed Public Law 89, and the migration division opened, a state run pipeline shipping tens of thousands of workers a year to mainland farms and steel mills in Lorain, Gary, Bridgeport, and Holyoke. They built churches and bodegas and raised families; then the mills closed, urban renewal bulldozed their blocks, and the community was allowed to vanish from the map. Recruited, used, and erased. You shall be scattered, and it was with ships, like the scripture says. 2 Esdras 13:12 1:56:50 - The same man come down from the mountain is Christ, the black Messiah we just read about in Revelation 1, and he calls unto him another peaceable multitude. - Book read in class, Lost Tribes and Promised Lands by Ronald Sanders (1978): Columbus gave to the peaceable multitude of the islands the name Indios, because he considered their habitation to be the Indies, but perhaps also because he thought of them as living in God, en Dios. Columbus was reading the book of Esdras. The scriptures call them a peaceable multitude; the world called them noble savages. Precepts: - Hosea 1:10 The historian Duran found confirmation in the promise that the number of the children of Israel shall be as the sand of the sea: surely, he argued, this promise was fulfilled by the multitudes the Spanish found in the new world. He also noted the traditions of long journeys like the one from Assyria to Arzareth, traditions of flights like the Exodus from Egypt, manna falling from heaven, and an old man who began the tale of his people's origins with the words in the beginning, roughly parallel to Genesis. Why would so-called Indians be quoting the Bible unless they were Israelites? 2 Esdras 13:39-45 1:57:30 - Those are the ten tribes which were carried away prisoners out of their own land in the time of Osea the king, whom Salmanasar the king of Assyria led away captive. That is the Assyrian captivity, 722 BC. Our land is Israel; we were not always in the islands. - They took this counsel among themselves, that they would leave the multitude of the heathen and go forth into a further country where never mankind dwelt, that they might there keep their statutes which they never kept in their own land. The northern kingdom wanted a fresh start after captivity upon captivity. - They entered into Euphrates by the narrow passages of the river, the Most High showed signs for them and held still the flood till they were passed over. Issachar was good in navigation, reading the stars. It was not one ship; it was thousands of our people gathering food, clothes, and gold for the journey. - Through that country there was a great way to go, namely of a year and a half. There were stops along the routes: down the African coast, over to Brazil where some of Asher landed, Naphtali into Argentina, others into Peru and Colombia, Manasseh in the Caribbean, Ephraim in the islands, Reuben in Florida, Gad in North America. - And the same region is called Arzareth. The Jewish Encyclopedia definition was read: the name of the land beyond the great river, far away from the habitation of men, in which the ten tribes of Israel will dwell, observing the laws of Moses, until the time of the restoration, according to 2 Esdras 13:45; Columbus identified America with this land. Columbus knew who was here. - Book read in class, Origins of the American Indians: European Concepts 1492 to 1729 by Lee E. Huddleston: l'Empereur's argument was that the ten tribes of Hebrews exiled to various parts of the Assyrian empire by Salmanasar had escaped to Arzareth, which he identified with the Indies, America. The historians knew who they found in the new found land. - Book read in class, Lost Tribes and Promised Lands, on the Marrano navigator Montezinos: he heard an exclamation of thanksgiving that blessed God for not making the speaker an idolater, a barbarian, a negro, or an Indian, and it dawned on him: those Indians, they are Hebrews. Later, strangers who came by canoe told him in their common ancestral tongue that they were themselves of the tribe of Reuben, and that the tribe of Joseph lived on an island nearby. Ephraim and Manasseh make up the tribe of Joseph: the islands. They asked him to send twelve bearded men to be their teachers, for though they spoke Hebrew they could not read or write it. The sorcerers of Francisco's tribe had perceived that they were a special people who should be left alone, that the God of these children of Israel is the true God, that everything inscribed on their tablets is true, and that at the end of days they will be lords of all the nations of the earth. Montezinos turned the tale into propaganda for the Dutch conquest of Brazil; Esau turned even this knowledge into conquest. Precepts: - Ezra 1:1-4 The Most High stirred up the spirit of Cyrus king of Persia in 539 BC, that the word of the Lord by the mouth of Jeremiah might be fulfilled. Who is there among you of all his people? His God be with him, and let him go up to Jerusalem and build the house of the Lord God of Israel. Cyrus gave us freedom to go back; the ten tribes instead took counsel to go into a further country. Genesis 49:1 2:23:01 - Jacob called unto his sons: gather yourselves together, that I may tell you that which shall befall you in the last days. The last days run from the time Christ walked the earth until now. Genesis 49:22-25 2:23:35 - Joseph is a fruitful bough, even a fruitful bough by a well. That is a symbol of the tribe of Ephraim: the blessing of many children, and many riches in the waters. - Whose branches run over the wall. In some Bibles the annotation on branches says daughters. What wall? El Morro. The daughters of Ephraim, in desperation, because they did not keep the faith and the commandments, mixed with the Spaniards to try to find a better life. - The archers have sorely grieved him, and shot at him, and hated him. Who are the archers? The conquistadors we read about in Revelation 6:2. They shot at the men, the warriors, the caciques, and hated us because we are God's chosen people and they wanted our land and our riches. - But his bow abode in strength, and the arms of his hands were made strong by the hands of the mighty God of Jacob; from thence is the shepherd, the stone of Israel. That shepherd is Christ. - With blessings of heaven above: the good weather that makes Puerto Rico an island paradise. Blessings of the deep that lieth under: the riches in the waters. - Book read in class, The Flame of Resistance, the book that inspired the title: an old Latin American legend about a foreign tyrant who used arms to conquer another nation, enslaved the people, forced them to work for his benefit, and had a ceaseless drive for more wealth and power; but he was not yet all powerful, because the truth stood in his way. He shouted the truth into a deep hole in the jungle and buried it, stamped it down with his boots, and went home to plan new wars of conquest. But two peasants watched him, dug it up, found all that remained of the truth was a small seed, and planted it. In the morning, on the exact spot, there stood a strong and beautiful tree. That is the purpose of all these missions and worldwide blitzes: plant the seed of truth into the minds and hearts of our people, and wait for the Most High to give the increase. Ephraim is a fruitful tree planted by the waters; that is what the tyrant fears. - Interview shown from the first Puerto Rico trip in 2017: Israel United in Christ interviewed Dr. Reniel Rodriguez, professor of archaeology in Puerto Rico, holding ancient relics with Hebrew writings etched in them, found in Puerto Rico. He said it would change the history of Puerto Rico. Scholars try to denounce the stones, but these things need to be documented and studied, because this is the history our people kept. - Book read in class, Christopher Columbus and the Participation of the Jews: Columbus was very fond of reading the Bible and the fourth book of Ezra; the incentive that impelled him to plan his discoveries was not a love of science but his interpretation of the prophecies. In Cuba, Espanola, and the other islands, Columbus found natives with their caciques, and several writers asserted, with much learning, that the aborigines were descendants of the Jews, a result reached already in the sixteenth century. The clergyman's chief argument is the language of the Indians in Espanola, Cuba, Jamaica, and the adjoining islands: he calls it corrupted Hebrew, and asserts that names like Cuba and Haiti are Hebrew, along with names of rivers and persons, Yaque from Jacob, and the names of their tools and canoes and the storehouses for grain, all pointing to the Hebrew language. Brothers and sisters, we are the Israelites. 1 Corinthians 4:9 2:40:19 - God hath set forth us the apostles last. Before us came Pedro Albizu Campos, Blanca Canales, Lolita Lebron, Filiberto Ojeda Rios, the Young Lords, all the brothers and sisters who paved the way and fought for our rights. It was not just the southern kingdom fighting in the 60s; the northern kingdom was fighting as well. - Albizu Campos passed away April 21st, 1965, and four days later there was a revolution in the Dominican Republic the same year. There were always revolts in Cuba, in Haiti, in the Dominican Republic, in Puerto Rico, because we are not a people that is supposed to be enslaved or indoctrinated. - The Most High left the apostles last, as it is to this day. People are going to laugh at the men in purple and gold, but the scriptures prove who we are. God left the truth so that we can find it and plant it in the hearts and minds of our people. We have a big job to do. In Closing We believe brothers like Albizu Campos and Fred Hampton were prophets back on the earth. They did not have the truth at that time, but Lord's will, the Most High is going to show them mercy for the works they did and the love they had for their people. This class is dedicated to them, and to the tribe of Ephraim: share this class with your kinsmen according to the flesh, so that they know who they are. There is no more excuse after this class. Lord's will there will be another class to cover the rest of the revolutionaries. Announcements & References Mission 212 to Puerto Rico: podcasts and radio recapped in the introduction; shout out to Officer Eleazar on the Derek Xander podcast, and to the brothers and sisters of the congregations in Puerto Rico, Ecuador, and Mexico. The worldwide blitz is still in progress; keep the traveling leadership in prayer that they return home safe during this Passover season. Books read or referenced in class: - Dr. William Smith's Dictionary of the Bible (1890): from Edom proceeded the kings who built up Rome - The Rise of Christendom (1890): Benjamin of Tudela, circa 1160, calls Rome the Edomite capital and the Pope the head of the Edomitish religion - Modern Judaism by John Allen: Esau's descendants subjugated Italy, founded Rome, and hold dominion over all Europe until the Messiah appears - In the Pillory: The Tale of the Borgia Pope by John Bond: the bust of the Savior posed for by Cesare Borgia, son of Pope Alexander VI - Lost Tribes and Promised Lands by Ronald Sanders (1978): Columbus, the peaceable multitude, en Dios, and the Montezinos account of the tribe of Reuben and the tribe of Joseph on an island nearby - Origins of the American Indians: European Concepts 1492-1729 by Lee E. Huddleston: the ten tribes escaped to Arzareth, identified with America - Christopher Columbus and the Participation of the Jews: Columbus and 2 Esdras, and the corrupted Hebrew of the islands - The Flame of Resistance: the legend of the tyrant who buried the truth; out of circulation Media played: the mini movie on the conquest of the caciques, the Apocalypto clip, the Bronx camp throwback with the elders, the brass menorah burning video, the Puerto Rico gentrification and Lorain, Ohio displacement videos, the Mayaguez slave registries with generated renderings, and the 2017 interview with Dr. Reniel Rodriguez on the Hebrew inscribed relics. --- Class Notes Index Transcript: full session

title: THE BOOK OF THE WARS OF THE LORD
text: Introduction We are here on another Sabbath day, in the days of unleavened bread. The Lord's will, brothers and sisters, is getting rid of that leaven that is in your heart and in your spirit. Shout out to all the brothers out there putting in the work: the bishops, the deacons, the captains, the officers. Deacon is teaching from New York with visitors in the building: officers from Philly holding him down while the other deacons are traveling. Yesterday's class went over the root of bitterness, and the captain went into it again in the morning class; those of you that have not seen it, go look at it, because a lot of you are dealing with heavy bitterness. Today's topic, since we are in the Passover season, is the book of the wars of the Lord: the wars of the Lord that took place back then, and the war that is going to take place in the future when he returns. Video played to open the class: an economist with a PhD in mathematics, one of the wise men of this world, telling the average person to get your board in the water and prepare to paddle, because the tsunami of a lifetime is coming and nothing your elders have seen will prepare you. Every place is over: Austin, Miami, Nashville, Jamaica, Thailand. Every named occupation is over: dentist, radiologist, accountant, teacher. Whatever is coming, get flexible; learn to think across disciplines. The teaching point: Trump is going to go down in history as the beginning of sorrows. Do not learn just one thing. If you go to college to be a doctor or a dentist, your state of mind should be to help your people when things get hard. Learn a little of everything: what herbs to use for a cold or a fever, how to filter water, how to farm, how to take care of animals. There is no way to fully prepare for what is coming; we are going to have to put our trust in God and take it as it comes. Scriptures Opened Isaiah 34:16 20:08 - Seek ye out of the book of the Lord, and read. The book of the Lord is the Bible. No one of these shall fail: nothing that is written in the Bible is going to fail. Everything inside here is going to come to pass, whether you believe or not. - For my mouth it hath commanded, and his spirit it hath gathered them: these words are the Lord's spirit. Precepts: - Hebrews 10:7 Then said I, Lo, I come in the volume of the book. Christ comes in the volume of the book: it is written of him. When you read the Bible and it says the Lord said this and the Lord did that, it is talking about Christ. He was the one speaking right through the scriptures, dealing with us right through the scriptures. - John 5:46-47 Had ye believed Moses, ye would have believed me: for he wrote of me. When Moses wrote in Genesis, Exodus, Numbers, and Deuteronomy about the Lord, that person Moses was talking about was always Christ. Numbers 21:14-16 24:20 - This is where the topic comes from: wherefore it is said in the book of the wars of the Lord, what he did in the Red Sea, and in the brooks of Arnon. What he did in the Red Sea is in Exodus. - The question is this: the book of the wars of the Lord, where is it? Do we have that book? There is a book called the book of the wars of the Lord, a book that went into the wars of the Lord, and we do not have it. But reading the other scriptures, we are able to piece certain things together. - And when it says the wars of the Lord, who is the Lord there? It is talking about Christ. You think Christ is just going to come in the future and war? No. He has been warring ever since the beginning, ever since Exodus. - Definition read in class on the King James Version: when Elizabeth died in 1603, the crown passed to James I, who had been king of Scotland for 37 years as James VI. Several months after he ascended the throne of England, he authorized a new translation of the Bible to replace the Bishops' Bible. All King James did was authorize it; he did not sit down and write the Bible. Forty-seven of the best Hebrew and Greek scholars of the day were divided into six groups: three for the Old Testament, two for the New, and one for the Apocrypha. Two groups met at Oxford, two at Cambridge, and two at Westminster. When a group completed its task, its work was submitted to twelve men, two from each panel. The revisers, who received no financial pay for their work, completed their task in two years and nine more months of revision. In 1611 the new version was published; it took almost 50 years to displace the Genevan Bible in popular favor, and after 350 years it is still used in preference to any other version in the English-speaking Protestant world. - Counted in class: a traditional 80 book Protestant Bible consists of 39 Old Testament books, 27 New Testament books, and 14 Apocrypha books. Eighty books in all. Keep that in mind, because we just read about a book of the wars of the Lord, and that book is not in the Bible. 2 Esdras 14:1-5, 19-48 32:26 - The Lord revealed himself to Moses in the bush, held him by him a long season, told him many wondrous things, and showed him the secrets of the times. He commanded him: these words shalt thou declare, and these shalt thou hide. Some things Moses hid; he wrote them in parables and similitudes, so everybody cannot understand it. Only the wise can understand it. - They that shall be born afterward, who shall admonish them? That is talking about us today. For thy law is burnt: at that time the Bible was burnt. When you read Nehemiah and Ezra, it tells you our forefathers were not keeping tabernacles or the laws; they grew up in Babylon for 70 years, and the scrolls were destroyed. No man knew the things that God did, like delivering us out of Egypt, and the wars of the Lord. But Ezra knew; he was brought up in the law. - Ezra asked the Most High to send the Holy Ghost into him, and I shall write all that hath been done in the world since the beginning, which were written in thy law, that men may find the path, and that they which will live in the latter days may live. That is how we are able to find the path today: we all came together because we heard the word of God. - Ezra took the five men that were ready to write swiftly, and the Lord lit a candle of understanding in his heart. Ezra was up there 40 days, the same way Moses went up to mount Sinai 40 days, and wrote back everything word for word that Moses gave us. His heart uttered understanding, wisdom grew in his breast, and his spirit strengthened his memory. - The spirit strengthened his memory: that is what the Holy Spirit does. A scripture you read two years ago just comes to your mind in the heat of battle at camp. But it cannot strengthen your memory if you have nothing in your memory. Ezra read the whole Bible many times, so his memory was able to be strengthened. Some of you brothers need your memory strengthened: put something in it. - In 40 days they wrote 204 books. Today we have 80. Remove the New Testament, which came afterwards, and we hold 53; from the 204 that leaves over 150 books missing from the Old Testament from the time of Ezra all the way up to today. - The first that thou hast written, publish openly, that the worthy and unworthy may read it: that is the law; everybody has to learn the law. But keep the seventy last, that thou mayest deliver them only to such as be wise among the people: for in them is the spring of understanding. There were 70 books with some heavy stuff in them that only wise men could read. - Those 70 books, the Most High made it where we do not have them today, because some things in them we are not supposed to know; it would mess with some of our minds. What we do have is enough to get the kingdom: all the laws are there, and the prophecies of what is going to take place. And in the teacher's opinion, some of those books the leadership of Rome has in the Vatican, deep down in the archives. Joshua 10:13 49:18 - The sun stood still, and the moon stayed, until the people had avenged themselves upon their enemies. Is not this written in the book of Jasher? So there is a book of Jasher that we do not have today. - Is it that book you see they have out there on the Bible apps? Leave that alone. The books of all the prophets complement each other; they do not contradict each other. If you read a book talking about angels having relations with women, or Esau being saved, that is made up to throw you off. The teacher stays with what the Lord gave us: Christ said that which ye have already, hold fast till I come. What is in these 80 books, we can get the kingdom with that. Precepts: - 1 Kings 14:29 The rest of the acts of Rehoboam, are they not written in the book of the chronicles of the kings of Judah? There is a book called the chronicles of the kings of Judah. We do not have that book. - 1 Kings 14:19 The rest of the acts of Jeroboam, how he warred, and how he reigned, they are written in the book of the chronicles of the kings of Israel. We do not have that today either. - 1 Kings 11:41 The rest of the acts of Solomon, and all that he did, and his wisdom, are they not written in the book of the acts of Solomon? There is a book called the acts of Solomon, full of the spring of wisdom, things Solomon revealed that the Lord did not want us to know today. - 2 Chronicles 33:18 The rest of the acts of Manasseh, and his prayer unto his God, are written in the book of the kings of Israel. We do have the prayer of Manasses in the Apocrypha, but that prayer is also part of the book of the kings of Israel, which we do not have. - 1 Chronicles 29:29 The acts of David the king, first and last, are written in the book of Samuel the seer, and in the book of Nathan the prophet, and in the book of Gad the seer. We have the book of Samuel, but we are missing Nathan and Gad. A seer is a prophet; he sees the future. - 2 Chronicles 9:29 The acts of Solomon are also written in the prophecy of Ahijah the Shilonite, and in the visions of Iddo the seer. There is a prophet called Ahijah that wrote books we know nothing about. Our forefathers in the time of the Greeks, Judas Maccabeus and the woman with the seven sons, were ready to die because they had a level of understanding from those other books; we are just starting to figure it out piece by piece today. - 2 Chronicles 33:19 His prayer also, and how God was intreated of him, behold, they are written among the sayings of the seers. There is a book called the sayings of the seers that we do not have today. The Lord took those books away because some things in them we are not to understand today; he wants us to just trust in him. Revelation 2:25-26 1:03:10 - When Christ went up to the heavens, he told John the revelator: that which ye have already, hold fast till I come. What do we have today? Only 80 books. Do not go looking for other books; do not try to incorporate what Esau made up out there with the scriptures. - He that overcometh, and keepeth my works unto the end, to him will I give power over the nations. If you overcome your lusts, the temptations, and the lies, and hold on to that little faith and understanding you have from these 80 books, the Lord is going to give you power over the nations. You have enough to get the kingdom. 1 Corinthians 13:12 1:06:46 - For now we see through a glass, darkly. Why do we see in the glass darkly? Remember what God told Moses: some things I want you to hide. We get bits and pieces; one of the apostles explains it here and there, and we start putting the full picture together, but we are still seeing in parts. - Now I know in part; but then shall I know even as also I am known. When Christ returns, he is going to teach us face to face, everything in those other 70 books and everything we are confused about right now. That is why you will never hear us say we have 100 percent truth: the scripture says we know in part. The part we have is these 80 books, and even with them we are missing the other books. The Most High has it that way because our flesh cannot contain some of these things. Zechariah 14:1-3 1:11:23 - Behold, the day of the Lord cometh: the day of the Lord is destruction, and this is going to happen in the third woe. All nations will be gathered against Jerusalem to battle, and the city shall be taken; the houses rifled, the women ravished, half of the city into captivity: prisoners of war. That is future prophecy over that land. - Then shall the Lord go forth, and fight against those nations, as when he fought in the day of battle. The question is: when did the Lord fight in the day of battle? That is what is called the book of the wars of the Lord. He will fight against them in the future the same way he fought against the nations in the past. So now we go to the past. Exodus 15:3-6 1:16:10 - The Lord is a man of war: the Lord is his name. When Moses says this, he is talking about something much more. Moses said it because he saw the Lord warring for his people. And this Lord is talking about Christ the anointed. - Pharaoh's chariots and his host hath he cast into the sea: his chosen captains also are drowned in the Red Sea. Who did that? The Lord. Thy right hand, O Lord, hath dashed in pieces the enemy. This is the wars of the Lord we are reading about: when the Lord fought against the Egyptians, drowned them in the Red Sea, and brought plagues upon them. Precepts: - Wisdom of Solomon 18:14-19 Solomon gave the same account Moses gave. While all things were in quiet silence, thine Almighty word leaped down from heaven out of thy royal throne, as a fierce man of war. The word of God, the anointed Christ, has a throne in the heavens, and during Exodus he came down for war; he leaped off his throne. That is why Moses says the Lord God is a man of war. He brought thine unfeigned commandment as a sharp sword, and standing up filled all things with death. A lot of you did not fully understand what Passover is really about: it is about death and destruction of the enemies of Israel. And the Lord sent the Egyptians horrible visions and dreams, so they should not perish without knowing why they were afflicted. - 1 Corinthians 15:47 The second man is the Lord from heaven. The Lord from heaven is Christ: that is the Almighty word that leaped off his throne and came down in Exodus. Exodus 14:8-31 1:22:46 - The Lord hardened the heart of Pharaoh, and he pursued after the children of Israel. Even after the Lord killed all the firstborn in Egypt, Pharaoh still went after the Israelites; but the Lord made him do that. - The children of Israel cried out and started blaming Moses: because there were no graves in Egypt, hast thou taken us away to die in the wilderness? Is not this the word that we did tell thee in Egypt, saying, Let us alone, that we may serve the Egyptians? Some of our people were comfortable in ancient Egypt, the same way some are comfortable serving in America today, making good money, saying leave me alone, I am good. - Moses said, Fear ye not, stand still, and see the salvation of the Lord: for the Egyptians whom ye have seen to day, ye shall see them again no more for ever. The Lord shall fight for you, and ye shall hold your peace. Remember the lesson: the book of the wars of the Lord. When we came out of Egypt, this was one of the wars of the Lord. - I will get me honour upon Pharaoh, and upon all his host. The Lord wanted honor. He said: I am going to harden the Egyptians' hearts to make them chase after you into the sea, so the whole world could talk about what I did to the Egyptians. Even to this day they are talking about what was done to the Egyptians. And the Egyptians shall know that I am the Lord. - The angel of God went from before the camp and stood behind them; it came between the camp of the Egyptians and the camp of Israel. It was a cloud and darkness to them, but it gave light by night to us, so the one came not near the other all the night. Imagine seeing something bright, what you would call a UFO today, standing between you and your enemy to protect Israel as they crossed. - The Lord caused the sea to go back by a strong east wind; the waters were a wall on the right hand and the left. In the morning watch the Lord looked unto the host of the Egyptians through the pillar of fire, troubled their host, and took off their chariot wheels, so the Egyptians said, Let us flee from the face of Israel; for the Lord fighteth for them against the Egyptians. - The waters returned and covered the chariots and the horsemen: there remained not so much as one of them. Thus the Lord saved Israel that day out of the hand of the Egyptians, and Israel saw the Egyptians dead upon the sea shore. And the people feared the Lord, and believed the Lord, and his servant Moses. We celebrated Passover. Precepts: - 1 Corinthians 10:1-4 All our fathers were under the cloud, and all passed through the sea. Paul is speaking to the Corinthians: if they all passed through the sea, that means the Corinthians were Israel, because no Egyptians passed through the sea. And the mixed multitude that came out died in the wilderness. Baptized unto Moses means Moses taught us God's laws. They drank of that spiritual Rock that followed them: and that Rock was Christ. Who was following us in the wilderness? Christ. Who killed the Egyptians? Christ. - Exodus 13:21-22 The Lord went before them by day in a pillar of a cloud, and by night in a pillar of fire. That pillar of cloud is a chariot, and the Lord was inside it: that is the Rock that followed them. He took not away the pillar of the cloud by day, nor the pillar of fire by night. Deuteronomy 4:33-37 1:38:17 - Hath God assayed to go and take him a nation from the midst of another nation? The same thing is happening today: we are becoming a nation in the midst of a nation, in spiritual Egypt, like Daniel 2 says, in the days of these kings shall the God of heaven set up a kingdom which shall never be destroyed. And the same way Egypt saw us multiplying and started oppressing us, it is going to be the same thing again in the future. - By temptations, by signs, and by wonders, and by war. How did the Lord take us out of Egypt? By war. The signs are the plagues; the wonders are what Moses did through the Lord; and by a mighty hand, and by a stretched out arm, and by great terrors. The Lord brought terror on the Egyptians when we came out of Egypt, before our eyes. - Out of heaven he made thee to hear his voice: whose voice did they hear from the heavens? That was Christ's voice, speaking the commandments. And upon earth he shewed thee his great fire: when the Lord came down in Exodus, only the seventy elders saw his majesty; everybody else saw fire. Precepts: - John 5:37 Ye have neither heard his voice at any time, nor seen his shape. You never heard the Father's voice at any time in history. So that voice our people heard in the wilderness, and that shape the elders saw: that was Christ. - Hebrews 12:25-29 See that ye refuse not him that speaketh. The one that spake on earth was Moses; the people said, we do not want God to speak to us, Moses, you tell us the commandments, because his voice shook the earth and they were terrified. Much more shall not we escape, if we turn away from him that speaketh from heaven: that was the Lord. Yet once more I shake not the earth only, but also heaven: that is when he returns in the future to shake the nations. For our God is a consuming fire: that is what the people saw when he came down on the mountain. Wisdom of Solomon 18:7 1:50:07 - So of thy people was accepted both the salvation of the righteous, and destruction of the enemies. There can be no salvation without the enemy being destroyed. Salvation is the Lord coming to save you from your enemies, the same way he came down and destroyed the enemies of Israel in ancient Egypt. That is what the Passover is about: the wars of the Lord, the Lord making war on Egypt and saving his people. - Some of you are trying to save your enemy. Imagine back in Egypt, the Lord sends Moses to deliver the children of Israel, and the Israelites are fighting to save the Egyptians. That does not make sense, and it is what is happening today. The problem is many of our people do not even know who their enemy is: the enemy is the powers that enslaved and oppress you, and scripture says all the nations that touched Israel are going to answer for it. Precepts: - Luke 1:68-75 Blessed be the Lord God of Israel; for he hath visited and redeemed his people: his people are the Israelites; that is possessive. As he spake by the mouth of his holy prophets: that we should be saved from our enemies, and from the hand of all that hate us. To perform the mercy promised to our fathers Abraham, Isaac, and Jacob, and to remember his holy covenant. That we being delivered out of the hand of our enemies might serve him without fear: because in ancient Egypt we were fearful to serve our God, the same way some of you today are scared to even ask for a day off. Christ is going to return and redeem us from the hands of our enemies. That is Passover: deliverance. - Wisdom of Solomon 19:22 For in all things, O Lord, thou didst magnify thy people, and glorify them, neither didst thou lightly regard them: but didst assist them in every time and place. Wherever we were, the Lord was always there fighting for us. Even in these last days, the Lord will help us. 2 Chronicles 20:15 1:58:56 - Be not afraid nor dismayed by reason of this great multitude. Do not be scared of armies and people, brothers and sisters. Teach the word of God, speak the word of God, no matter what they say or what they threaten you with. - For the battle is not yours, but God's. Why does it say the battle belongs to the Lord? Because the Lord is always there fighting with you. Precepts: - 2 Kings 6:15-17 A host surrounded the city with horses and chariots, and Elisha's servant said, Alas, my master! how shall we do? A whole army came for this one prophet. And he answered, Fear not: for they that be with us are more than they that be with them. Elisha prayed, Lord, open his eyes, that he may see: and behold, the mountain was full of horses and chariots of fire. Those were angels waiting for the word. You cannot see things spiritually, but understand: the Lord is with us, his angels are with us, and the Lord is fighting with us. There is no way we could do what the Lord sent us to do on this earth, and no way you would see the growth of IUIC and of Israel, if he were not with us. And prepare your mind: it is going to be the same in the future; they came for one prophet, and they will come with agents and lies for those who teach the word of God. Read about COINTELPRO and ask yourself if you think that stopped. - 1 Peter 4:1 Forasmuch then as Christ hath suffered for us in the flesh, arm yourselves likewise with the same mind. If your mind is not prepared to suffer the same way Christ suffered, you are not a soldier in Christ. The Bible is telling you what is going to happen; do not live in la la land. For he that hath suffered in the flesh hath ceased from sin: that is how you become perfect. Those of you that want a comfortable life, this truth is not for you. Joshua 10:7-42 2:07:56 - The Lord said unto Joshua, Fear them not: for I have delivered them into thine hand; there shall not a man of them stand before thee. The Lord was always fighting for us and warring with the nations. - The Lord cast down great stones from heaven upon them, and they died: they were more which died with hailstones than they whom the children of Israel slew with the sword. The Lord killed more than we killed. What are we reading? The wars of the Lord. - Joshua said in the sight of Israel, Sun, stand thou still upon Gibeon; and thou, Moon, in the valley of Ajalon. And the sun stood still, and the moon stayed, until the people had avenged themselves upon their enemies. Time stopped. And there was no day like that before it or after it, that the Lord hearkened unto the voice of a man: for the Lord fought for Israel. The reason it stopped for him is his faith: he believed the Lord would do it. - Is not this written in the book of Jasher? Another record from a book we do not have today. - The five kings fled and hid themselves in a cave at Makkedah, and Joshua said, Roll great stones upon the mouth of the cave; stay ye not, but pursue after your enemies. When they brought out those five kings, Joshua called for all the men of Israel and said unto the captains of the men of war, Come near, put your feet upon the necks of these kings. And Joshua said unto them, Fear not, nor be dismayed, be strong and of good courage: for thus shall the Lord do to all your enemies against whom ye fight. This was Israel conquering the land of Canaan, and it is going to happen again in the future. - And all these kings and their land did Joshua take at one time, because the Lord God of Israel fought for Israel. Joshua 11:10-23 2:20:46 - Joshua took Hazor, which beforetime was the head of all those kingdoms, and utterly destroyed it, as Moses the servant of the Lord commanded. He left nothing undone of all that the Lord commanded Moses. Joshua made war a long time with all those kings; there was not a city that made peace with Israel save the Hivites: all other they took in battle. - It was of the Lord to harden their hearts, that they should come against Israel in battle, that he might destroy them utterly. The same Lord that hardened Pharaoh's heart. - At that time Joshua cut off the Anakims from the mountains: the Anakims are the giants. He was fighting giants. None were left in the land of the children of Israel: only in Gaza, in Gath, and in Ashdod there remained. That is where Goliath the Philistine came from later. - So Joshua took the whole land, and gave it for an inheritance unto Israel according to their divisions by their tribes. Joshua 5:13-14 2:25:54 - Joshua lifted up his eyes by Jericho and saw a man over against him with his sword drawn in his hand, and Joshua stepped to him: art thou for us, or for our adversaries? - And he said, Nay; but as captain of the host of the Lord am I now come. Who is the captain of the host of the Lord? This is talking about Christ. Precepts: - Hebrews 2:9-10 We see Jesus, who was made a little lower than the angels for the suffering of death. Before that, in Exodus, he did not come a little lower than the angels. It became him to make the captain of their salvation perfect through sufferings: the captain of our salvation is the captain of the Lord's host that we read about with Joshua. 1 Samuel 17:45-47 2:28:28 - Thou comest to me with a sword, and with a spear, and with a shield: but I come to thee in the name of the Lord of hosts, the God of the armies of Israel. When we fight and when we war, we war in the name of our God. Goliath was a giant remaining from the Anakims in Gath. - This day will the Lord deliver thee into mine hand; that all the earth may know that there is a God in Israel. And all this assembly shall know that the Lord saveth not with sword and spear: for the battle is the Lord's. Precepts: - Psalms 144:1 Blessed be the Lord my strength, which teacheth my hands to war, and my fingers to fight. David understood the Lord was with him in every fight and battle, and the Lord was teaching him how to fight. David chased a lion and killed it; he fought bears. How was he able to do that? The Lord was with him. - 2 Samuel 5:22-24 When the Philistines spread themselves in the valley of Rephaim, David enquired of the Lord. David used to talk to the Lord before he made decisions, and we have to learn to do that: Lord, should I do this? If it is not right, shut it down. The Lord said, Thou shalt not go up; but fetch a compass behind them, and come upon them over against the mulberry trees. And when thou hearest the sound of a going in the tops of the mulberry trees, then thou shalt bestir thyself: for then shall the Lord go out before thee, to smite the host of the Philistines. The Lord goes out before you, fighting with you. And when you read the Maccabees, angels came down and fought with Judas Maccabeus too. Revelation 19:9-21 2:43:10 - Now we go into the wars of the Lord that are going to take place in the future. I saw heaven opened, and behold a white horse; and he that sat upon him was called Faithful and True, and in righteousness he doth judge and make war. - His eyes were as a flame of fire, and he was clothed with a vesture dipped in blood. Why is that garment dipped in blood? Because the Lord will be warring. And his name is called The Word of God: remember, the Almighty word leaped off the throne and brought death in Egypt; that is not just back then, that is the future too. - The armies which were in heaven followed him upon white horses, clothed in fine linen, white and clean. When Christ comes back, he is coming back with armies. He is not coming back to shake hands; he is coming back for war, for deliverance, for vengeance. - Out of his mouth goeth a sharp sword, that with it he should smite the nations: and he shall rule them with a rod of iron. Christ is not using a literal weapon; he is using his words. He is not coming to save the nations. - An angel cried to all the fowls, Come and gather yourselves together unto the supper of the great God; that ye may eat the flesh of kings, and the flesh of captains, and the flesh of mighty men. When that war takes place, the birds will eat. - I saw the beast, and the kings of the earth, and their armies, gathered together to make war against him that sat on the horse, and against his army. The kingdoms ruling the earth today really believe they can fight against Christ and the 144,000. And the beast was taken, and with him the false prophet, and these both were cast alive into a lake of fire: that is eternal damnation, not regular death. And the remnant were slain with the sword of him that sat upon the horse, which sword proceeded out of his mouth. Precepts: - Jude 1:14-15 Behold, the Lord cometh with ten thousands of his saints. Those armies in heaven following him are the saints in the white robes, the ones that loved not their lives unto the death and received the immortal body. He is coming to execute judgment upon all, and to convince all that are ungodly of all their ungodly deeds, and of all their hard speeches which ungodly sinners have spoken against him. Joel 3:2, 9-21 2:54:00 - I will also gather all nations, and will bring them down into the valley of Jehoshaphat, and will plead with them there for my people and for my heritage Israel, whom they have scattered among the nations, and parted my land. - Proclaim ye this among the Gentiles; Prepare war. This is what God says we have to proclaim among the nations. There will be no peace: prepare war, because the Lord God is a man of war. Wake up the mighty men; let all the men of war draw near. Beat your plowshares into swords, and your pruninghooks into spears: let the weak say, I am strong. - Assemble yourselves, and come, all ye heathen. The war of Armageddon is in the land of Israel. First the fight over that land, then all nations come down, and in the midst of the destruction Christ returns; then they leave the war they are fighting with each other and come against Christ, in the valley of Jehoshaphat, the valley of decision. The Lord wants it that way: he wants them to come down. - Multitudes, multitudes in the valley of decision: for the day of the Lord is near. The sun and the moon shall be darkened. The Lord also shall roar out of Zion, and utter his voice from Jerusalem, because that is where he is coming back: Acts 1 tells you he returns to the mount of Olives the same way he ascended. And the heavens and the earth shall shake: but the Lord will be the hope of his people, and the strength of the children of Israel. - Then shall Jerusalem be holy, and there shall no strangers pass through her any more. Egypt shall be a desolation: the Egypt there is spiritual Egypt, and Edom shall be a desolate wilderness, for the violence against the children of Judah, because they have shed innocent blood in their land. We are not doing anything to these people but teaching the word of God, and for that they will persecute. But Judah shall dwell for ever, and Jerusalem from generation to generation, for the Lord dwelleth in Zion. Isaiah 13:4-9 3:03:23 - The noise of a multitude in the mountains, like as of a great people; a tumultuous noise of the kingdoms of nations gathered together: the same multitude we read in Joel, gathered in the valley of Jehoshaphat. The Lord of hosts mustereth the host of the battle. - They come from a far country, from the end of heaven, even the Lord, and the weapons of his indignation, to destroy the whole land. The end of heaven is paradise: the Lord is coming from paradise with the weapons of his wrath. - Howl ye; for the day of the Lord is at hand. Every man's heart shall melt, and they shall be afraid: pangs and sorrows shall take hold of them; their faces shall be as flames. Behold, the day of the Lord cometh, cruel both with wrath and fierce anger, to lay the land desolate. 2 Esdras 13:1-11, 25-39 3:06:17 - Ezra dreamed: a wind arose from the sea, and that man waxed strong with the thousands of heaven. That is Christ with his saints. When he turned his countenance to look, all things trembled; and whensoever the voice went out of his mouth, all they burned that heard his voice. That is the two-edged sword: when Christ speaks, he is speaking the word of God, and it burns. - There was gathered together a multitude of men, out of number, from the four winds of the heaven, to subdue the man that came out of the sea. All the armies of the earth are going to think they can subdue Christ when he returns. They were sore afraid, and yet durst fight. - He saw the violence of the multitude that came, and he neither lifted up his hand, nor held sword, nor any instrument of war: but only I saw that he sent out of his mouth as it had been a blast of fire, and out of his lips a flaming breath, and out of his tongue he cast out sparks and tempest. It fell with violence upon the multitude which was prepared to fight, and burned them up every one, so that upon a sudden of an innumerable multitude nothing was to be perceived, but only dust and smell of smoke. When the prophet saw this, he was afraid. - The interpretation: the man coming up from the sea is he whom God the Highest hath kept a great season, which by his own self shall deliver his creature. Behold, the days come when the Most High will begin to deliver them that are upon the earth: the twelve tribes of Israel. One shall undertake to fight against another, one city against another, one people against another, one realm against another: that is the third woe. And then shall my Son be declared, whom thou sawest as a man ascending. - When all the people hear his voice, every man shall leave the battle they have against one another, and an innumerable multitude shall be gathered together willing to come and overcome him by fighting. But he shall stand upon the top of the mount Sion, and Sion shall come and be shewed to all men, prepared and builded, like as the hill graven without hands. - And this my Son shall rebuke the wicked inventions of those nations: their missiles, their weapons; the Lord is going to rebuke all of it. Which for their wicked life are fallen into the tempest, and he shall destroy them without labour by the law which is like unto fire. He is going to be speaking the law of God, and that is what will be destroying them; and that fire is not regular fire; that is when the torment begins. Isaiah 42:13-16 3:17:04 - The Lord shall go forth as a mighty man, he shall stir up jealousy like a man of war: he shall cry, yea, roar; he shall prevail against his enemies. The same man of war Moses saw. He will destroy his enemies, and the wicked among Israel too. - I have long time holden my peace; I have been still, and refrained myself. The Lord is saying: I saw all the evil being done on this earth and I said nothing; I restrained myself. Now will I cry like a travailing woman; I will destroy and devour at once. I will make waste mountains and hills: mountains are nations. - And I will bring the blind by a way that they knew not; I will lead them in paths that they have not known: I will make darkness light before them, and crooked things straight. These things will I do unto them, and not forsake them: that is what the Lord will do for us. Isaiah 43:2-6 3:20:23 - When thou passest through the waters, I will be with thee; when thou walkest through the fire, thou shalt not be burned. All of this we are learning is for us to have faith, brothers and sisters, for when the time comes: all this rich history of God fighting for us as a people is for us to have faith and hope. - For I am the Lord thy God, the Holy One of Israel, thy Saviour: I gave Egypt for thy ransom. He is saying, I killed the Egyptians for you. - Since thou wast precious in my sight, thou hast been honourable, and I have loved thee: therefore will I give men for thee, and people for thy life. - Fear not: for I am with thee. When the persecution comes, a lot of us are going to be scared, like when Pharaoh came after us; but God says fear not, for I am with thee. I will bring thy seed from the east, and gather thee from the west; I will say to the north, Give up; and to the south, Keep not back: bring my sons from far, and my daughters from the ends of the earth. The Israelites scattered throughout the planet: this is the new Passover; this is deliverance. In Closing That class was straight volcanic activity: the wars of the Lord. The Lord fought for Israel in Egypt, at the Red Sea, in the wilderness, in the land of Canaan, with Joshua, with David, and he will fight the same way in the day of battle to come. The battle is the Lord's. What we have in these 80 books is enough to get the kingdom; hold fast to it till he come, and get the confidence from now: when we pass through the waters and walk through the fire, he is with us. The teaching point: the missing books are preserved but withheld, and what we hold is enough to get the kingdom. Missions announced from Nassau, Freetown, Toronto, Anguilla, the US Virgin Islands, Paramaribo, India, Jamaica, the Netherlands, Barbados, Hawaii, the Solomon Islands, Birmingham UK, Calgary and Edmonton, Lagos, Lusaka, Ecuador, Georgetown, Grenada, Trinidad and Tobago, Johannesburg, Kampala, Yaounde, Montreal, the Democratic Republic of Congo, Melbourne, Dar es Salaam, Accra and Kumasi, Monrovia, and more: mission numbers 191 through the 220s. title: THE PLAGUES COMING TO AMERICA
text: Introduction Opening prayer: Lord, we come before you today coming into the last day of the feast of unleavened bread, which you have commanded us to keep throughout all our generations. This week we have kept thy feast, which is symbolic of getting rid of the leaven from our heart. Take away that old leaven, that sin, from our people. Help us to get rid of the malice, the envy, the bitterness, the strife. Watch over all the brothers traveling right now, waking Israel up throughout the four corners of the earth. Heal the sick amongst us, and send your son to deliver us out of these lands of our captivity, out of this spiritual Egypt, and judge these nations for all the evil that they have done to us, the same way you judged them in the past. We are in the days of unleavened bread, the season where we were delivered from ancient Egypt. When the Most High delivered us from Egypt, he brought plagues on Egypt. The same way he showed signs and brought plagues on that people, it will be the same thing again in these last days when we are delivered from spiritual Egypt, which is America. At the beginning of the feast the lesson was Exodus From America, Modern Day Egypt: how the same curses written in Deuteronomy 28 that were on us in Egypt are on us here in America. Tonight we go into the plagues. The same plagues that fell on ancient Egypt are the same plagues God is going to bring on these Egyptians today, on modern day Egypt, which is America, but on another technological level. Write it down: the plagues coming to America. Scriptures Opened Genesis 12:1-3 12:07 - God told Abraham to get out of his country, from his kindred and his father's house, unto a land that I will show thee. Abraham was in Ur of the Chaldees, ancient Babylon; God told him to leave and go to a land he would give to him and his descendants. - I will make of thee a great nation, and make thy name great. I will bless them that bless thee, and curse him that curseth thee. - In thee shall all families of the earth be blessed: when we break that down, the all families is Israel scattered throughout the four corners of the earth. In the beginning the Most High is prophesying Israel being scattered through the four corners of the earth, because the Lord knew what would happen to us. Genesis 13:12-18 13:42 - Abraham is now dwelling in the land of Canaan, the land the Lord promised to give unto him and his seed. Lift up now thine eyes northward, southward, eastward, and westward: all the land which thou seest, to thee will I give it, and to thy seed for ever. - The Most High is promising Abraham this land, but there were already people in the land: the Canaanites, the descendants of Canaan. So were Abraham and the Israelites just going to take a land that belonged to another people? No. - Before the flood, the sons of God were living in that land; that is the land Adam and his sons were given. When God flooded the earth, Canaan went back and settled that land; Shem did not. Shem stayed over in the Chaldees, and Shem is the chosen lineage the sons of God came back through. So when the sons of God came back, the Lord was giving them back the land they dwelt in before the flood. Genesis 15:13-16 18:37 - The Lord gave Abraham a vision: thy seed shall be a stranger in a land that is not theirs. This land is ancient Egypt. Remember Jacob and his sons went into Egypt because of the famine; these things are what the Lord is letting Abraham know. They shall serve them, and they shall afflict them four hundred years. - And also that nation whom they shall serve will I judge: God judged ancient Egypt; he brought plagues on them. And afterward shall they come out with great substance: this is ancient Egypt, not America in the future. Are we coming out of America with great substance? No, we are not taking anything from Babylon. - Thou shalt go to thy fathers in peace; thou shalt be buried in a good old age. But in the fourth generation they shall come hither again: the Israelites will come back to the land of Canaan again. We did it under Moses and Joshua. - For the iniquity of the Amorites is not yet full: the Amorites were of the sons of Canaan living in the land. The Lord is letting Abraham know that when his seed comes back into that land, the wickedness of those nations will be filled up, and God will use Israel to judge them. God is not evil, killing people for no reason; the people in that land were doing much evil, sacrificing babies, murder, all types of wickedness, and their cup became full. Exodus 12:35-37 20:18 - The children of Israel borrowed of the Egyptians jewels of silver, jewels of gold, and raiment; and the Lord gave the people favour in the sight of the Egyptians, and they spoiled the Egyptians. That is us coming out with great substance. Psalms 105:36-37 21:05 - He smote also all the firstborn in their land, the chief of all their strength. He brought them forth also with silver and gold: and there was not one feeble person among their tribes. When we came out of Egypt, we came out with silver and with gold. Job 42:16-17 25:47 - Job lived an hundred and forty years, and saw his sons, and his sons' sons, even four generations. The generation here is talking about his descendants: your son, your grandson, your great grandson, your great great grandson. That is genealogical generation. - So when we read Genesis 15, is the fourth generation talking about descendants? Seventy souls went into Egypt. A fourth generation genealogically does not equal four hundred years, so something else is being said there. Exodus 20:3-5 28:36 - I the Lord thy God am a jealous God, visiting the iniquity of the fathers upon the children unto the third and fourth generation of them that hate me. God visits the father's sins upon his children unto the third and fourth generation, meaning his descendants. So a genealogical fourth generation is not four hundred years; there is another kind of generation in the scriptures. Exodus 1:8-9 31:46 - There arose up a new king over Egypt, which knew not Joseph. Why would a new king rise up that did not know Joseph? A lot of time went by. Joseph was dead, and everybody who knew what Joseph did for Egypt had died. It was a new society, a new kingdom; the new king did not understand the greatness Joseph did in Egypt. There was a society change. - Besides genealogical generation, there is societal generation: within a hundred years, everybody born around your time will be dead, and society will change. Everybody around in the eighteenth century is dead, and society changed. A couple generations ago we could not go into a restaurant and sit down and eat; society has changed. And Israel multiplied; that seventy souls multiplied greatly. Psalms 102:23-28 36:15 - He shortened my days. Thy years are throughout all generations: God's years go throughout all generations. The generations there are not talking about each kid; it is talking about different societies and times. - They shall perish, but thou shalt endure: the generations perish. All of them shall wax old like a garment; as a vesture shalt thou change them, and they shall be changed. Generations change. At one point of time the Babylonians ruled this earth, then the Persians, then the Greeks; at one point Britain ruled the earth, and now America rules the earth. Those were different time frames and different generations. - But thou art the same, and thy years shall have no end: God does not change. - So back in Genesis 15: they will be afflicted four hundred years, and in the fourth generation they come back to the land. In this context, how many years is one generation? A hundred years. The generation there is societal generation, every hundred years, because the Most High gives most people seventy years to live, eighty with strength. Within a hundred years society changes and everybody you know is dead. Them four hundred years is four generations. We came back into the land under Moses and Joshua, about four hundred thirty years after. Jeremiah 51:19-23 46:13 - The portion of Jacob is not like them: our portion is not like the other nations' portion. He is the former of all things, and Israel is the rod of his inheritance: we are the ones God uses to judge the earth. - Thou art my battle axe and weapons of war: for with thee will I break in pieces the nations, and with thee will I destroy kingdoms. With thee will I break in pieces the horse and his rider, the chariot and his rider, man and woman, old and young, the young man and the maid, the shepherd and his flock, the husbandman and his yoke of oxen, captains and rulers. - Pay attention: God says Israel is his battle axe and his weapons of war. That is why God brought an army out of Egypt. Exodus 7:4-5 50:02 - That I may lay my hand upon Egypt, and bring forth mine armies, and my people the children of Israel, out of the land of Egypt by great judgments. You think when God delivered us out of Egypt he was just delivering a people? No, God was bringing out an army: an army to judge the nations. That is why he says in the fourth generation he will bring them back into the land, because the sin of the Amorites was not yet full. Deuteronomy 20:10-18 51:53 - A lot of people read the Bible and say the Israelites just went and killed everybody; why would God allow that? Because these people did much evil against God. When the Lord sent us in the past to conquer the land, it was his judgment on everyone in that land because of all the evil and wickedness they were doing. God's army was not going around killing people for no reason. - When thou comest nigh unto a city to fight against it, then proclaim peace unto it. If they answered peace and opened up, the people became tributaries and served; taxes were paid. If they would make no peace but war, then the city was besieged, and when the Lord delivered it, judgment fell on it, and the rest became servants. - The cities far off were dealt with one way, but of the cities of these people, which the Lord thy God doth give thee for an inheritance, thou shalt save alive nothing that breatheth: the Hittites, the Amorites, the Canaanites, the Perizzites, the Hivites, and the Jebusites, as the Lord commanded. - You have to ask yourself why God commanded that. That land belonged to God. The record explains it: that they teach you not to do after all their abominations, which they have done unto their gods; so should ye sin against the Lord your God. If they were left alive, Israel would follow their ways and sin against God. Remember this is the same God that flooded the whole earth because of the wickedness of everyone on it. Remember God had to deal with Saul because he left people alive. Exodus 3:19-20 1:03:28 - I am sure that the king of Egypt will not let you go, no, not by a mighty hand. And I will stretch out my hand, and smite Egypt with all my wonders which I will do in the midst thereof. God stretched out his hand and smote Egypt with plagues. Exodus 11:1 1:04:20 - Yet will I bring one plague more upon Pharaoh, and upon Egypt. Them wonders that were brought upon Pharaoh and Egypt are called plagues. Deuteronomy 4:34 1:05:02 - Hath God assayed to go and take him a nation from the midst of another nation, by temptations, by signs, and by wonders, and by war, and by a mighty hand, and by a stretched out arm, and by great terrors. Them signs and wonders are the plagues. The same way the Lord brought us out of ancient Egypt with signs, wonders, great terror, and war is the same way he is going to bring us out of this Egypt, spiritual Egypt, which is America. Deuteronomy 28:68 1:06:25 - The Lord shall bring thee into Egypt again with ships. This Egypt is talking about the transatlantic slave trade, us being brought into the Americas. This is the last curse that fell upon the Israelites: they would go into slavery into another Egypt, another house of bondage, but this time on ships. It happened in the 1600s; we were brought here on cargo slave ships. - By the way whereof I spake unto thee, Thou shalt see it no more again: meaning it is not ancient Egypt. - And there ye shall be sold unto your enemies for bondmen and bondwomen, and no man shall buy you: nobody would be able to redeem you out of that house of bondage. Only Christ could redeem us from this place, because the scripture says Christ bought us with a price. Revelation 11:8 1:08:53 - Their dead bodies shall lie in the street of the great city, which spiritually is called Sodom and Egypt. This proves that America is Egypt; that Egypt in Deuteronomy 28:68 is talking about America. - Why dead bodies? Because we do not know who we are; we are in a dead state of mind, we left from keeping God's laws. - This place is spiritually Sodom because sodomy is legalized here, and spiritually Egypt because the same way the Israelites were enslaved in ancient Egypt, the Israelites were enslaved and are oppressed here in America: the land of oppression, the land of bondage, the land of slavery. Precepts: - Revelation 17:5 That great city is Mystery Babylon the Great, the mother of harlots and abominations of the earth: America. 2 Esdras 15:5-11 1:11:47 - Behold, saith the Lord, I will bring plagues upon the world; the sword, famine, death, and destruction. What we are living in right now is the beginning of sorrows, when the Lord starts to send his plagues on the earth. - For wickedness hath exceedingly polluted the whole earth: everywhere you look is war, murder, lies being pushed all over this earth. Their hurtful works are fulfilled: a lot of the time the Lord leaves nations to do their wickedness, but once that wickedness is fulfilled, he brings forth his plagues and his judgment. - Behold, the innocent and righteous blood crieth unto me. Revelation says the dragon shall make war with the saints: they will kill and imprison many of us here in America who believe this Bible. This goes with Revelation 6:9 and Revelation 18:24, in her was found the blood of the saints. - The souls of the just complain continually: you die and you are with the Lord, asking for judgment and vengeance. Therefore saith the Lord, I will surely avenge them. God will avenge us for slavery, for Jim Crow, for all the evil done to us over these centuries. - Behold, my people is led as a flock to the slaughter: I will not suffer them now to dwell in the land of Egypt. This Egypt God says he will not suffer them to dwell in is America, modern day Egypt, that Egypt of Deuteronomy 28:68. - But I will bring them with a mighty hand and a stretched out arm, and smite Egypt with plagues, as before, and will destroy all the land thereof. According to Bible prophecy, God is going to smite America, spiritual Egypt, with plagues the same way he smote ancient Egypt, and the plagues he sends will destroy the whole land. Revelation 18:1-8 1:18:37 - Babylon the great is fallen, is fallen: Babylon the great, that great city spiritually called Sodom and Egypt, is destroyed. First it tells you Babylon is destroyed; then it goes backward into why. - All nations have drunk of the wine of the wrath of her fornication: America jacked up the nations. The merchants of the earth are waxed rich through the abundance of her delicacies: that is how China, Saudi Arabia, and all these nations got rich. - Come out of her, my people, that ye be not partakers of her sins, and that ye receive not of her plagues. The people God is commanding to come out from amongst her are the slaves that were brought here, the Israelites brought into spiritual Egypt on ships. - Verse 11 and verse 13: the merchants weep because no man buyeth their merchandise any more; the merchandise includes slaves, and souls of men. Where did them slaves come from? Deuteronomy 28:68, the transatlantic slave trade. One of the commodities Mystery Babylon the Great traded was slaves. - Her sins have reached unto heaven, and God hath remembered her iniquities. You want to forgive and forget, but God does not forget. God remembers how she stole this land from the North American Indians; God remembers the bomb dropped on Japan; God remembers slavery, Jim Crow, every lynching, all our blood shed here. Now he brings judgment for all the evil done throughout centuries, because their wickedness is fulfilled. - Reward her even as she rewarded you, and double unto her double according to her works: she will drink double of what she has done. - She saith in her heart, I sit a queen, and am no widow, and shall see no sorrow. That is how the government talks: we have the strongest military in the world. That is the pride of their heart deceiving them. - Therefore shall her plagues come in one day: death, and mourning, and famine; and she shall be utterly burned with fire: for strong is the Lord God who judgeth her. In ancient Egypt the plagues came at many different times; the plagues coming to modern day Egypt all come in one day. Jeremiah 51:6 1:24:30 - Flee out of the midst of Babylon, and deliver every man his soul: be not cut off in her iniquity. That is saying the same thing Revelation 18:4 says. What do we have to deliver out of here? Our soul. If you get caught up with the sins in Babylon, you destroy your soul. That is what it means when she sells souls. Matthew 16:26-27 1:25:36 - What is a man profited, if he shall gain the whole world, and lose his own soul? America sold you a dream, and a lot of us came here seeking that dream; a lot have sold their soul for the American dream. That is what Revelation 18 means when she trades slaves and souls of men. - You gain the nice house, the nice job, all these things, but you had to break God's laws to obtain them, so you lost your soul. You agree with the homosexuality, the fornication, all the sins of America; you follow the white man and his religions. That is how America sells souls: I can make you rich, but you have to agree with what I do. 2 Esdras 15:27 1:30:51 - For now are the plagues come upon the whole earth, and ye shall remain in them: for God shall not deliver you, because ye have sinned against him. The wicked of our people will not be delivered from them plagues; they will remain in them. - You think it is just a nuclear bomb alone coming, and you just die? Why would you remain in the plagues? There are levels to this; that is saying a lot right there. Revelation 9:14-21 1:39:06 - Loose the four angels which are bound in the great river Euphrates. Them four angels are the armies of the earth with their weapons, prepared for an hour, and a day, and a month, and a year, for to slay the third part of men: two and a half billion people. - In that year there is a month, in that month there is a day, and in that day there is an hour when all of Babylon's plagues come on her. It will take the nations one hour to destroy this whole land. - The number of the army of the horsemen were two hundred thousand thousand: two hundred million soldiers. - The prophet saw a vision of a modern military and explained it as best he could. Horses with heads as the heads of lions, out of their mouths fire and smoke and brimstone: that is tanks. Their power is in their mouth and in their tails, their tails like unto serpents, with heads, and with them they do hurt: that is missiles flying, and the warhead is where the hurt is. Some warheads are nuclear. What he is seeing is a world war, that army that kills the third part of men. - The rest of the men which were not killed by these plagues yet repented not of the works of their hands: they will not stop worshiping devils and idols. The white Jesus image is worshiping the devil. Neither repented they of their murders, nor of their sorceries, nor of their fornication, nor of their thefts: neither of the lands they stole. When Christ returns, they will come to fight against him. Revelation 15:5-8 1:46:07 - The seven angels came out of the temple, having the seven plagues, and one of the four beasts gave unto them seven golden vials full of the wrath of God. Them seven plagues are the wrath of God. - Remember what the Lord said: I will smite Egypt with plagues as before. Them seven plagues are the plagues the Lord is bringing on America. Revelation 16:1-2 1:49:58 - The first went, and poured out his vial upon the earth; and there fell a noisome and grievous sore upon the men which had the mark of the beast, and upon them which worshipped his image. - Compare Exodus 9:8-9: one of the plagues on Egypt was boils breaking forth upon man and upon beast throughout all the land. Same plague, coming again. - Noisome means foul smelling, harmful, noxious: a real nasty sore. - Definition read in class on cutaneous radiation injury: a nuclear explosion causes severe radiation burns that frequently lead to intense itching, blistering, and open sores; the burns appear in stages, initial redness and swelling, a latent phase, then severe blistering and deep, long lasting necrotic ulcers. When that blast does not kill you, the skin is rotting and falling off, and it is noisome. That is how we know this plague is in that one hour. - The key thing: the sore falls on the people that worship the image of the beast and have his mark. If it is only them, where are we? We are delivered. Precepts: - 2 Maccabees 9:9 Worms rose up out of the body of this wicked man Antiochus, his flesh fell away, and the filthiness of his smell was noisome to all his army. That is what noisome looks like in the record. - Psalms 91:1-3 He that dwelleth in the secret place of the Most High shall abide under the shadow of the Almighty: his protection. Surely he shall deliver thee from the snare of the fowler, and from the noisome pestilence. That is the first plague, and the Lord will deliver us from it. In that one hour, when them bombs are falling, it is not going to come near us. Exodus 7:20-21 1:58:46 - The fish that was in the river died; and the river stank, and the Egyptians could not drink of the water of the river; and there was blood throughout all the land of Egypt. That is what happened in ancient Egypt. Now remember what the Lord said: I will smite you with plagues like as before. Revelation 16:3-7 1:59:47 - The second angel poured out his vial upon the sea; and it became as the blood of a dead man: and every living soul died in the sea. This is talking about war on the sea, bombs going off in the ocean. This is Mystery Babylon being destroyed; the same plagues he sent on Egypt he is sending on America, and all of it comes in one hour. - The third angel poured out his vial upon the rivers and fountains of waters; and they became blood. When it says it became blood, it means it became poisonous; nobody can drink it. - Thou art righteous, O Lord, because thou hast judged thus. For they have shed the blood of saints and prophets, and thou hast given them blood to drink; for they are worthy. America will kill the saints and prophets here in the future, so the Lord gives America blood to drink: poisonous, radioactive water. Them that the blast does not incinerate die from noisome sores, and them that go trying to drink water die from drinking poisoned water. Revelation 8:8-11 2:02:44 - As it were a great mountain burning with fire was cast into the sea: that great burning mountain is America. The third part of the sea became blood, the third part of the creatures which were in the sea died, and the third part of the ships were destroyed: all them Navy carriers destroyed in the sea. Remember in ancient Egypt all the fish died; it will be the same thing on the shores of America. - There fell a great star from heaven, burning as it were a lamp, and it fell upon the third part of the rivers; and the name of the star is called Wormwood. In the Ukrainian language, wormwood is Chernobyl; you remember that nuclear accident. That star is a nuclear weapon hitting the waters. - The third part of the waters became wormwood, poisonous, toxic, and many men died of the waters, because they were made bitter. That goes back to Revelation 16: thou hast given them blood to drink. 2 Esdras 5:4-7 2:06:09 - Thou shalt see after the third trumpet that the sun shall suddenly shine again in the night, and the moon thrice in the day. How does the sun shine in the night? Bombs going off in the night; a nuclear detonation at night is like a sun. How does the moon shine bright in the day? Bombs going off in the day. That is what the prophet is explaining. And blood shall drop out of wood, and the stone shall give his voice: when that happens, Christ is returning. - The Sodomitish sea shall cast out fish: the sea of that great city spiritually called Sodom, per Revelation 11:8.
