The seashores of America: all the fish are going to die from radiation, and all you will see on the shores is dead fish. The Bible is no fairy tale book. Isaiah 19:1-9 2:10:49 - The burden of Egypt: the Lord shall come into Egypt, and the idols of Egypt shall be moved at his presence. The Egypt here is America; he is coming to deliver us. - I will set the Egyptians against the Egyptians: and they shall fight every one against his brother, and every one against his neighbour; city against city, and kingdom against kingdom. That is one of the plagues before that one hour: there will be civil war here; they will be fighting each other. - The waters shall fail from the sea, and the river shall be wasted and dried up. The brooks of defence shall be emptied and dried up: that is the dams, the water reserves they always talk about. - The reeds and flags shall wither; everything sown by the brooks shall wither, be driven away, and be no more. This is a future apocalyptic event; this is what America looks like after that one hour. - The fishers also shall mourn, and all they that cast angle into the brooks shall lament: because all the fish died and the water is poisonous. Exodus 9:6 2:17:58 - All the cattle of Egypt died: but of the cattle of the children of Israel died not one. Killing the cattle of Egypt caused what? Famine. Exodus 10:4-5 2:18:47 - Tomorrow will I bring the locusts into thy coast, and they shall eat the residue of that which is escaped, which remaineth unto you from the hail. The locusts eat all the crops. This plague goes into farming. Exodus 9:23-25 2:19:32 - The Lord sent thunder and hail, and the fire ran along upon the ground; hail, and fire mingled with the hail, very grievous, such as there was none like it in all the land of Egypt. The hail smote every herb of the field, and brake every tree of the field, and every man and beast that was in the field. Hail fire from the sky came down on ancient Egypt. Guess what: he is going to do that again today, but them hails on modern day Egypt are going to be nuclear bombs. 2 Esdras 15:11-13 2:21:46 - But I will bring them with a mighty hand and a stretched out arm, and smite Egypt with plagues, as before, and will destroy all the land thereof. Egypt shall mourn, and the foundation of it shall be smitten with the plague and punishment that God shall bring upon it: the foundation of America shall be smitten. - They that till the ground shall mourn: for their seeds shall fail through the blasting and hail, and with a fearful constellation. A constellation goes into stars, and the stars falling are the bombs; the Bible refers to them as stars. When them bombs hit, there is no more farming, no more crops; nothing is going to grow. The farmers are going to mourn. Exodus 10:21 2:24:36 - Stretch out thine hand toward heaven, that there may be darkness over the land of Egypt, even darkness which may be felt. That darkness in Egypt was not just the place getting dark; you could feel the darkness. When you read Wisdom of Solomon, it tells you people saw strange things and were terrified; read that when you get a chance. Revelation 16:10-11 2:26:10 - The fifth angel poured out his vial upon the seat of the beast, which is America, and his kingdom was full of darkness; and they gnawed their tongues for pain, and blasphemed the God of heaven because of their pains and their sores. They are feeling that darkness, and the sores go back to the first plague, the noisome sores. Same plague of darkness that was on Egypt. Jeremiah 51:8-9 2:27:23 - Babylon is suddenly fallen and destroyed: howl for her; take balm for her pain, if so be she may be healed. Balm is ointment. We would have healed Babylon, but she is not healed. They are trying today to make America great again, but she is not going to be healed; she is going to be destroyed, and there is no ointment for them plagues God is bringing on her. Revelation 8:12 2:29:32 - The fourth angel sounded, and the third part of the sun was smitten, and the third part of the moon, and the third part of the stars; and the day shone not for a third part of it, and the night likewise. No light on the earth: the nuclear fallout, the cloud, covers the sky; the sun, the moon, and the stars are blocked out. Bombs going off all over the earth. All of these plagues are happening at the same time, in that one hour. Ezekiel 34:12-13 2:31:13 - As a shepherd seeketh out his flock, so will Christ when he returns seek out his sheep: the lost sheep of the house of Israel, the slaves scattered throughout the four corners of the earth. He will deliver them out of all places where they have been scattered in the cloudy and dark day. When them bombs go off, the Lord is going to be delivering us in that cloudy and dark day, and he will bring us to our own land. Zephaniah 1:14-18 2:33:15 - The great day of the Lord is near, it is near, and hasteth greatly. It is coming, brothers; you can see the things that are happening; time is speeding up. - The mighty man shall cry there bitterly: these dudes that think they are tough are going to cry bitterly. - That day is a day of wrath, a day of trouble and distress, a day of wasteness and desolation, a day of darkness and gloominess, a day of clouds and thick darkness: there will be thick darkness all over America and all over the world. - A day of the trumpet and alarm against the fenced cities and against the high towers: the fenced cities are the protected cities. You are going to hear the alarm, the warning going all over the television, that the missiles are coming, within one hour. - I will bring distress upon men, that they shall walk like blind men, because they have sinned against the Lord: and their blood shall be poured out as dust, and their flesh as the dung. - Neither their silver nor their gold shall be able to deliver them in the day of the Lord's wrath. No matter how much money you get, it cannot deliver you in the day of God's wrath. Those of you that are rich in this world: do not save your riches up in this world; help with the work. - But the whole land shall be devoured by the fire of his jealousy: for he shall make even a speedy riddance of all them that dwell in the land. Exodus 11:4-6 2:38:12 - About midnight will I go out into the midst of Egypt: and all the firstborn in the land of Egypt shall die, from the firstborn of Pharaoh that sitteth upon his throne, even unto the firstborn of the maidservant that is behind the mill; and there shall be a great cry throughout all the land of Egypt. That is another plague. Now let us take that plague to America. Isaiah 47:1-10 2:39:08 - Come down, and sit in the dust, O virgin daughter of Babylon: not ancient Babylon, the daughter of Babylon, which is America. Sit on the ground: there is no throne: you are not going to be ruling any more. - Thou that art given to pleasures, that sayest in thine heart, I am, and none else beside me. Who is the I AM? God. You set yourself up as God. I shall not sit as a widow, neither shall I know the loss of children: I am not going to lose citizens. - But these two things shall come to thee in a moment in one day, the loss of children, and widowhood: they shall come upon thee in their perfection. Nobody has ever attacked America on its own soil like this; that is going to happen, and the destruction comes in one day, in a moment, like the plague of the firstborn came in one night. - For thou hast trusted in thy wickedness: thou hast said, None seeth me. You think nobody sees the evil you have been doing, but God sees it. Thy wisdom and thy knowledge, it hath perverted thee: it made you think you are God. Jeremiah 51:25-30 2:42:26 - Behold, I am against thee, O destroying mountain, saith the Lord, which destroyest all the earth: the destroying mountain is America. I will stretch out mine hand upon thee, and roll thee down from the rocks, and will make thee a burnt mountain: a burnt nation. - They shall not take of thee a stone for a corner, nor a stone for foundations; but thou shalt be desolate for ever. That is the Bible prophecy: Babylon, spiritual Egypt, will be desolate for ever, and nobody is going to dwell here any more. - Set ye up a standard in the land, blow the trumpet among the nations, prepare the nations against her. The nations are being prepared to fight against the destroying mountain. That is what you see taking place with Iran, with Russia, with Europe: the nations are being set to fight against America and destroy her. That is the prophecy. - Call together against her the kingdoms of Ararat, Minni, and Ashchenaz: Ashchenaz is the Germans. Prepare against her the nations with the kings of the Medes: that is Persia, that is Iran. All the rulers are going to be gathered together against America, and the land shall tremble and sorrow, for every purpose of the Lord shall be performed against Babylon, to make the land of Babylon a desolation without an inhabitant. - The mighty men of Babylon have forborn to fight, they have remained in their holds: they remain in their bunkers. Their might hath failed; they became as women: all that big bad talk, and they fold. They have burned her dwellingplaces; her bars are broken. Revelation 17:16-18 2:46:52 - The ten horns which thou sawest upon the beast: the ten horns are Europe, NATO, the European Union. At one point they were one with America; they gave their power unto the beast. These shall hate the whore, and shall make her desolate and naked, and shall eat her flesh, and burn her with fire. Europe and NATO will play their part in burning America with fire. - For God hath put in their hearts to fulfil his will, and to agree, and give their kingdom unto the beast, until the words of God shall be fulfilled. They formed the European Union, the UN, and NATO and gave their kingdom to America, but what is happening right now? They are starting to hate America because of what America is doing. So they will turn on America and burn her. - And the woman which thou sawest is that great city, which reigneth over the kings of the earth: Mystery Babylon the Great, that great city called Sodom and Egypt. Revelation 18:4-8 2:49:40 (closing the lesson) - Come out of her, my people: brothers and sisters, we are to come out from spiritual Egypt, out from Mystery Babylon the Great. Do not take part in the sins here in America; deliver your souls. If you do not come out of her sins, you will receive of the plagues God is going to send here. - Therefore shall her plagues come in one day: death, and mourning, and famine; and she shall be utterly burned with fire. All them plagues you read about in Revelation 16 come in one day: the noisome sores, the waters turning to blood, the darkness, the famine, the fire. Them plagues that were on ancient Egypt are coming to America. In Closing Hope you all got something out of the lesson. The plagues from ancient Egypt are the same plagues God is going to bring on America, and we have to come out from amongst her if we do not want them plagues to come upon us. We cannot get caught up in the sins, the lies, the philosophies, the politics, the religions of America; otherwise we will receive them plagues, and when them plagues come, it is one hour, one day. There are other plagues that will take place on the earth building up to that: the wars and the judgments you see happening to the nations now are all a buildup, and at the end of that buildup, Babylon is destroyed. We do not know what year, what month, what day, or what hour that is, but we can tell how close it is. Announcements & References Passover 2026 worldwide: mission reels played from the brothers keeping the Passover across the earth, missions 191 through 226 and beyond: Monrovia, Liberia with Bishop Nathaniel and Bishop Yahwasa; Tanzania; Johannesburg, South Africa; Zambia; Toronto and Edmonton, Canada; Kingston, Jamaica; Nigeria; Uganda and Rwanda; Sierra Leone; Cameroon; Birmingham, UK; the US Virgin Islands; Australia; Trinidad and Tobago; Grenada; St. Lucia; Anguilla; Honolulu, Hawaii; Ecuador, the biggest Passover kept there yet; the Solomon Islands, keeping their first Passover; Baltimore; New York; and more. A great thing the men of God are doing: a shout out to all the brothers that sacrificed and went to places where no man went before, keeping the Passover out there and building with the brothers out there. The things we say, we do not just talk. Support the work through the Booster Club. Prayer video played: every step forward is a step into the unknown; when truth moves, opposition follows. Pray for the traveling brothers' strength, protection, and endurance, because not every battle is seen on camera. The mission continues: unstoppable, unshaken, unfinished. Closing reading: 1 Corinthians 11:23-29, the bread and the cup on the last day of the feast of unleavened bread, in remembrance of the Lord's death till he come; let a man examine himself. --- Class Notes Index Transcript: full session

title: JUDGEMENT! TO HELL WITH YOUR REPARATIONS!
text: Introduction Happy Sabbath, everyone. Hope everybody having a blessed Sabbath; right now it's raining in NYC. Shout out to Captain Zef and Captain Abiel sitting with us. I think you all is some mind readers, cuz a lot of the stuff the brothers went over is like one spirit we rolling in today: we going over slavery and our people being scattered. The opening prayer asked the Most High to bring back the bishops, the deacons, the captains, and all the brothers that were traveling doing the work, and, as we are coming off from the days of unleavened bread, to keep all that leaven out of our spirit: the malice, the guile, the hatred. Today's topic: Judgment! To hell with your reparations. What prompted this lesson is the United Nations vote saying that the transatlantic slave trade was the most horrible thing that ever happened on the earth. Now Europe is in an uproar, America is in an uproar. As long as I've been alive, I keep hearing about reparations. I'm going to show you all what the Bible says about reparations. In The News Video played in class: the United Nations has officially declared that the transatlantic African slave trade is the gravest crime against humanity, in a resolution adopted on the 25th of March, 2026, which also called for reparations. 123 countries agreed. Only three voted against the resolution: the US, Israel, and Argentina. 52 countries abstained, among them the UK and every member of the European Union. Ghana spearheaded the resolution; its president said its adoption is a route to healing and reparative justice. The US ambassador said the resolution creates a hierarchy of crimes against humanity and that reparations shouldn't be paid for things that weren't illegal under international law when they happened. The Netherlands is the only European country to formally apologize for its role in African chattel slavery. - So the US, Israel, and Argentina voted against slavery being the worst thing that ever happened in history. And the UK and the whole European Union said, we ain't voting. - The Ghanaian representative interviewed: never in the history of mankind have we had such a systemic crime, over three centuries, more than 12.5 million people forcibly removed, more than 3 million dead in the Atlantic, which is a mass grave site. African and Caribbean leaders are not looking for money; they are talking about dealing with structural inequality and the return of thousands of stolen artifacts, from Egypt to the Ashanti kingdom. - After the vote, the ambassador of the so-called Israel to Ghana put out that the Holocaust is the biggest crime against humanity, not slavery. If I was Ghana, I would kick him out of the country. - Meanwhile, an article read in class: laws signed by Trump for Holocaust survivors prove reparations is possible. Trump signed an update to the Holocaust Expropriated Art Recovery Act, a bill that establishes a process for Holocaust victims and their heirs to recover artwork and cultural property stolen by the Nazis between 1933 and 1945, first signed by Obama in 2016. Their descendants can go after the museums and whoever has their things. That's called reparations. But when Ghana asks for stolen artifacts back, America says to hell with that. - Video played in class: a UK plan to block work, study, and temporary visas from 17 countries demanding reparations over slavery, including Ghana, Nigeria, Kenya, and 11 Caribbean nations, saying the bank is closed for anyone who wants to use history as a weapon to drain the treasury. So things are getting hot on this reparations stuff: ask for what they owe you, and they ban your visas. Scriptures Opened Genesis 49:1 8:33 - Jacob called unto his sons to tell them that which shall befall them in the last days. What time are we living in? The last days. Our forefather Israel was a prophet, and the Lord showed him what's going to happen to his twelve sons, the twelve tribes of Israel, in the last days. Genesis 49:5-9 9:24 - Simeon and Levi are brethren: in the last days the so-called Haitians and the so-called Dominicans are living on the same island of Hispaniola. Instruments of cruelty are in their habitations: that's going into the witchcraft, the voodoo and black magic. Unto their assembly, mine honour, be not thou united: that's why the Haitians and the Dominicans hate each other and are not united; that's why you see them snatching people off the street and deporting them. - Judah, thou art he whom thy brethren shall praise: thy hand shall be in the neck of thine enemies. Judah is going to be living in close proximity to his enemy, which today is Esau. Go back into the 60s and 70s: the Black Panthers, Martin Luther King, Malcolm X, a lot of movements where Judah rose up and was contending with the so-called white man. He couched as a lion, and as an old lion; who shall rouse him up? Christ is going to rouse him up. Precepts: - Zechariah 2:6-7 Deliver thyself, O Zion, that dwellest with the daughter of Babylon. Zion is the city of Judah, and the daughter of Babylon, when you read Psalms 137, is Edom. So Judah will be dwelling with Edom, living with his enemy. Genesis 49:13 14:14 - Zebulun shall dwell at the haven of the sea, and he shall be for an haven of ships: that's talking about Panama, the Panama Canal. When you read 2 Esdras 13, the ten tribes came over to this side of the world; this identifies them. Genesis 49:19 15:23 - Gad, a troop shall overcome him: Gad is the so-called North American Indians. Which troop overcame him? The US cavalry, led by Andrew Jackson. Genesis 49:22-24 16:13 - Joseph is a fruitful bough by a well: Joseph, the so-called Puerto Ricans, dwelling on an island. When the Spaniards came they called it the port of riches, because there was gold all over the place. And fruitful, because the people there multiply. - The archers have sorely grieved him, and shot at him, and hated him: but his bow abode in strength, and the arms of his hands were made strong by the hands of the mighty God of Jacob. - Genesis 49 is talking about the Western Hemisphere: Israel that's going to be living on this side of the world, brought here on cargo slave ships and oppressed by the king of Babylon. Israel is not just on this side of the world; Israel is all over the world. But the Lord put emphasis on this side, because Judah needed to know who they were first, and then go unto his people. Isaiah 14:13 18:28 - The king of Babylon, America, said in his heart, I will exalt my throne above the stars of God: I will sit also upon the mount of the congregation, in the sides of the north. The mount of the congregation is the twelve tribes of Israel, and he sits upon us in the sides of the north. Deuteronomy 33:7 20:25 - And this is the blessing of Judah: Hear, Lord, the voice of Judah, and bring him unto his people. Which Judah is this speaking about? There is Judah in Africa too, but this is Judah on this side of the earth, specifically in the United States of America. - Why? Because Judah in North America is under Esau, who controls the world right now, and with an American passport you could go anywhere in the world. A Jamaican passport, a Haitian passport, a Nigerian passport can't take you everywhere. That's why we tell you brothers, get your passport. - Bring him unto his people: the tribes in Africa, in Japan, in Iran, in India, the Israelites scattered throughout the four corners of the earth. Judah is the one that's going to go and teach them. Let his hands be sufficient for him, and be thou an help to him from his enemies: God is a help to Judah. - The revised twelve tribe chart was shown in class: Judah includes American blacks and the Igbo of Nigeria; the chart now carries tribes identified across Africa, India, and the islands, from the Falasha of Ethiopia to the Kikuyu of Kenya to the Sefwi Israelites of Ghana, the Fon and Ashanti under Benjamin, the Zulu under Simeon, the Wolof under Zebulun, and more. How do we know? By traveling: the bishops and brothers that travel went into the history of the people, and the Lord guided us. The chart is going to keep getting updated as the spirit reveals more. Precepts: - Zechariah 12:7 The Lord also shall save the tents of Judah first: God is going to raise up the tribe of Judah first, Judah in America, and then Judah will know where God's people is and go find them. Luke 21:24 36:28 - We fell by the edge of the sword in 70 AD, and shall be led away captive into all nations: that's a process of time; it didn't all happen in 70 AD. And Jerusalem shall be trodden down of the Gentiles: Jerusalem occupied by heathens, until the times of the Gentiles be fulfilled, which is when Christ returns. - In 70 AD, most of us fled into Africa. We formed communities, we built cities, and we mingled amongst the Hamitic tribes over there. - An old map drawn by Esau was shown in class, found by Captain Joel in a library archive: Jewish communities marked all over Africa, the Elephantine Jews, Levite cities in Nigeria, Bnei Ephraim on the slave coast, the Jewish kingdoms of Ganata and Kamnuri, the Berber Jews of the north. Esau knew where we were in Africa; they drew this map to pinpoint us. Why did they need to know where we were? Because slavery was not coincidence. Slavery was war. Precepts: - John 4:19-22 Woman, believe me, the hour cometh, when ye shall neither in this mountain, nor yet at Jerusalem, worship the Father. Christ told the Samaritan woman the Israelites would not be worshipping in Jerusalem and not in Samaria: he's saying what we read in Luke 21, that we would be carried away as slaves into all nations. Deuteronomy 28:15 45:50 - A lot of times when we read Deuteronomy 28 we leave it on our own experience: we came here on cargo slave ships. But we got to learn to bring it out on a broad experience, because the curses follow us wherever we are: the brothers on this side of the world, on that side of the world, on any side of the world. Deuteronomy 28:46 47:52 - The curses shall be upon thee for a sign, and for a wonder, and upon thy seed for ever. Why a sign? Like a McDonald's sign lets you know a McDonald's is there. Because according to prophecy we would be scattered in slavery and forget our nationality, God said: these curses are going to follow you and your seed, so no matter where you are scattered, when you read the Bible you're going to say, wait, this is talking about my people. In the future, Judah will need to identify who Israel is; today you identify the Israelites by the curses. Precepts: - Deuteronomy 32:26 I said, I would scatter them into corners, I would make the remembrance of them to cease from among men. The remembrance of who we are has ceased from amongst men. We didn't just forget; the nations made war with us and used crafty counsel: make sure them slaves cannot read and write. Ask a man today who the Israelites are and he points at the synagogue of Satan. Yet in Africa today there are millions professing they are the Israelites; just in Nigeria there is an Israelite community of millions, and they always knew. Deuteronomy 28:42-48 54:04 - The stranger that is within thee shall get up above thee very high, and thou shalt come down very low: that's how it is in society today. There's no such thing as equality; don't let nobody fool you with that democracy and equal rights talk. Somebody has to be on top and somebody has to be on the bottom. We have been assimilated into their society, and they are on top. No matter if one, two, three Negroes become millionaires or billionaires, you cannot rise above your people while our people are the base of society. - He shall lend to thee, and thou shalt not lend to him: you need a loan, you go to the white man's bank. Now take it on an international, geopolitical level: does Africa borrow from China? Does Jamaica borrow from China? China lends to the Caribbean and Africa, and when our people cannot pay, China takes their land and resources. Russia lends to African nations. And the IMF tells Africa what their money is worth and gives loans they cannot pay back. That's the curse in action: it's talking about Africa, Guatemala, Panama, Ecuador, Venezuela, Chile, wherever our people are scattered and wherever our people are governing. - He shall be the head, and thou shalt be the tail. Moreover all these curses shall come upon thee, and shall pursue thee: no matter where we are, the curses pursue us. The reason Africa is at the bottom of the food chain among all nations, while the Arabs and the Chinese are rich, is because most of the people over there are our people. - Therefore shalt thou serve thine enemies: whether it's the white man, the Chinese, the Russians, or the Arabs. In hunger, and in thirst, and in nakedness, and in want of all things: food, clothing, water, education; anything you need, you got to serve your enemy for it. The educational systems in Africa and the Caribbean were designed by the colonizers. - Video played in class: Thomas Sankara explaining why he refused food aid: it keeps us in a beggar mentality, and it stops our farmers from producing; those who really want to help can send plows, tractors, and boreholes, not bags of wheat. They killed him; his best friend was paid to do it. Africa and the Caribbean depend on America for food because that's the deal the IMF makes: we'll lend you billions, but you can't grow your own food; you buy it from our farmers. That's control: disagree, and they shut off your food supply. - And he shall put a yoke of iron upon thy neck, until he have destroyed thee: they didn't just take millions of us to the Western Hemisphere; they went into Africa and enslaved the ones that remained. Colonization is slavery. Don't get confused by the terminology. When King Leopold colonized the Congo, he enslaved us. Deuteronomy 28:32 1:12:15 - Thy sons and thy daughters shall be given unto another people: when King Leopold came, record read in class of the forced rubber quotas in the Congo and the mutilation of those who fell short; the curses followed our sons and daughters into colonization, and there was no might in thine hand to get them back. - The same sons and daughters left in Africa were colonized, taught Christianity, enslaved. Why do you think everybody in Africa worships white Jesus? You think one day they got up and chose that? The same thing they did to us on this side of the world in slavery, they did to our people in Africa. They always want to say black people sold black people into slavery: don't let them fool you. Slavery was big business; the white man caused division amongst the tribes, armed them against each other, and took the prisoners of war. And who colonized Africa? Deuteronomy 28:36 1:15:40 - The Lord shall bring thee, and thy king which thou shalt set over thee, unto a nation which neither thou nor thy fathers have known. The king whom the Lord chose was David and David's seed; after Babylon, no king from David's lineage was ever raised up again. So when did we set kings over us? In Africa, and on this side of the world: the chiefs of North America, the kings of Puerto Rico and Guatemala, the kings of Africa. Image shown in class: the king Atahualpa, whom the colonizers killed while forcing Christianity, one of the bloodiest religions, on our people. - And there shalt thou serve other gods, wood and stone: that's where Christianity and Islam come in; the Lord saw us following the religions forced on us. Hosea 3:4 1:19:16 - The children of Israel shall abide many days without a king, and without a prince, and without a sacrifice, and without an image, and without an ephod. The king goes into political sovereignty: governing your country and ruling yourself. When were we without it? When Europe colonized us in Africa; before that we had kings. And when the transatlantic slave trade took us. They took Ghana, Nigeria, Angola, Senegal, Papua New Guinea, the Congo, and you had no sovereignty. - Without an image: our mind was destroyed in slavery and in colonialism. You go to Africa: the sisters bleach their skin and put on weaves. Where did that come from? Our image was destroyed. When you worship a God that does not look like you, it does something to your psyche; when you worship the God of your oppressor, it destroys the way you look at yourself. - Without the ephod: no priest there to guide you and tell you what God needs you to do. That's the religious infrastructure and spiritual guidance stripped away. Precepts: - Daniel 12:6-7 How long shall it be to the end of these wonders? A time, times, and an half: a time is a hundred years, times is two hundred, and an half: 350 years, and when he shall have accomplished to scatter the power of the holy people. Within those 350 years we were totally destroyed: we forgot who we are, we even forgot our nationality. After 70 AD our country was destroyed, but we still built cities in Africa, still had kings and governments, still knew we were the children of Israel. It was within the slave trade and colonization that the power was scattered. - Daniel 12:11 From the time that the daily sacrifice shall be taken away, and the abomination that maketh desolate set up. - Video played in class: a history of British rule in Kenya and the Mau Mau uprising of 1952, one line for the record: the detention camps, the torture of detainees, the burned files rediscovered in 2011, and Britain's 2013 admission, paying 20 million pounds to 5,228 survivors, less than 4,000 pounds each, with not a single officer ever charged. That's why I tell y'all I don't want no damn reparations. You can do things like that to my people and then talk about you're holding this money right here? Isaiah 11:11 1:35:27 - The Lord shall set his hand again the second time to recover the remnant of his people: from Assyria, from Egypt, from Pathros, which is upper Egypt, from Cush, which is Ethiopia, from Elam, from Shinar, which is Babylon, Iraq, from Hamath, and from the islands of the sea, the Pacific islands and the Caribbean islands. We have people in all these places, and Judah is going to find them. Romans 10:14-15 1:37:10 - How shall they believe in him of whom they have not heard? And how shall they hear without a preacher? And how shall they preach, except they be sent? The only way the brothers and sisters in all these places are going to come is if they are taught. You got to be sent; that's the mission. We're not going to reach every place on this earth, and the Lord will have mercy on some, but our job is to find the elect and teach them and show them how to change their life. Even where we have a small congregation, like in India, we still have to go there like Paul visited congregations, and build the brothers up. Matthew 12:25 1:39:42 - Every kingdom divided against itself is brought to desolation. That's how they destroyed Africa: in 1885, at the Berlin conference, the Europeans came in and divided up Africa. They whispered in this chief's ear, gave this king weapons, then armed the other prince, had us fighting each other, and that's how they colonized us. - Video played in class: an average African country has over 50 tribes, 50 different cultures and languages in a single country, and when tribes vote as blocks, tribalism takes over; democracy is a foreign system imposed by the colonizers. - Europe is united: the European Union shares economies, welfare, military; you can cross their borders without visas. But in Africa the borders were carved up so that to go from Ghana to Liberia you fly through Europe. That's by design, to keep the people divided, because a nation divided cannot stand. - Video played in class: Kwame Nkrumah wrote Africa Must Unite and Neo-Colonialism, exposing the network of foreign companies exploiting Africa's resources, with charts. America immediately stopped aid to Ghana over the book, and that was probably the final straw in deciding this dangerous man had to be removed. We cannot have Africa united or in control of its own resources. - Video played in class: Ghana's kingdoms almost ended Dutch slavery in 1760, when Ashanti warriors, Fante chiefs, and coastal leaders launched a coordinated attack on every Dutch fort from Elmina to Anomabu; the Dutch feared their enslaved Ghanaians in Suriname would rise next. So don't let people fool you that black people simply sold black people: when they found out what the white man was doing, they fought. But remember, God said the holy people were to be taken. - Video played in class: after World War II, exploitation of African minerals was actually a bigger funder of the European Recovery Plan, the Marshall Plan, than America's $13 billion. If Africa contributed that much to Europe's recovery, why wasn't Africa equally developed? Africa does not need aid; it needs those exploiting it to stop. The reason why is Deuteronomy 28: a lot of our people are in Africa, so the curses follow them. Isaiah 3:5 2:07:32 - News played in class: xenophobic violence in South Africa; shopkeepers from Ethiopia, Somalia, and other parts of Africa closing their businesses in anticipation of looting, at least five killed, families from Zimbabwe, Malawi, and Mozambique in a makeshift refugee camp, a pregnant migrant woman chased from a Pretoria hospital and told to deliver her baby elsewhere, and migrants beaten in the street. - And the people shall be oppressed, every one by another, and every one by his neighbour: that's what goes on in America amongst our people, and in Africa amongst our people. We hate each other and we oppress each other. What the South Africans are doing to migrants is the same thing you see some black people in America doing: get out of our country, you're taking our jobs. It's the same destroyed mind. - A land audit report read in class: white individuals own approximately 72 percent of individually owned farms and agricultural holdings in South Africa, while black Africans specifically own 4 percent of agricultural land. And they're mad at the people from Ghana and Zimbabwe. That's misdirected aggression: the people who stole your land and hold the resources, you're not going after them; you're going after people that look like you. - Video played in class on what colonialism does to a colonized people: it doesn't just steal their land; it robs them of self-confidence, until they internalize the colonizer's view that they're worth nothing and their history is minor. South Africa came out of apartheid barely a generation ago; to see them treat their fellow people like that is self-hatred, and it stems from colonialism. It's no different from black on black crime: brothers that will hurt a man for stepping on their shoes but never say a word to the oppressor. - News played in class: a South African court sentenced an outspoken opposition leader to five years in prison, on charges brought by AfriForum, an organization of Afrikaners, descendants of the Dutch, French, and German colonizers, that presents itself as a civil rights organization while existing to protect the economic inequality apartheid formalized. When the people of South Africa rise up angry about jobs and money, they're directing it at the wrong people. Ecclesiastes 7:7 2:08:05 - Surely oppression maketh a wise man mad. When you're being oppressed, it makes you mad; but you got to direct that anger in the right place, and the right place is the colonizer. Isaiah 42:22 2:31:19 - This is a people robbed and spoiled; they are all of them snared in holes, and they are hid in prison houses: they are for a prey, and none delivereth; for a spoil, and none saith, Restore. What does reparation mean? To restore. No one says: restore these people their land, their resources, the culture that you stole. What is our true culture? We are the children of Israel. They stole our culture, and nobody says restore. Deuteronomy 28:31 2:32:19 - Thine ass shall be violently taken away from before thy face, and shall not be restored to thee: when the white man came and conquered, the Bible said it's not going to be restored. The white man ain't restoring nothing to us. - Article read in class: the major European powers compensated the slave owners, not the enslaved. The UK paid 20 million pounds, roughly 26 billion dollars today, to 46,000 owners in 1833; France compensated owners in 1849, concentrated among the top ten percent. When Haiti won independence, Haiti had to pay reparations to France, billions, and only finished paying in living memory. And in America, the compensation act gave $300 per slave to slave owners. The people that were enslaved can't get reparations, but the slave master got compensated for his merchandise. That's the world we're living in. Exodus 22:1 2:35:14 - If a man shall steal an ox, or a sheep, and kill it, or sell it; he shall restore five oxen for an ox: according to the law, if you steal, you restore five times what it's worth. That's the law. Lamentations 2:13 2:35:36 - What thing shall I take to witness for thee? What shall I equal to thee, that I may comfort thee, O virgin daughter of Zion? For thy breach is great like the sea: who can heal thee? You can't equal anything to what we went through. Slavery, the transatlantic slave trade, was the worst crime in history, and only the Most High God can heal us from what it did to us. Daniel 9:12 2:36:30 - He hath confirmed his words by bringing upon us a great evil: for under the whole heaven hath not been done as hath been done upon Jerusalem. What happened to us didn't happen to nobody else on this earth. So yes, slavery is the worst thing that ever happened: slavery and colonialism, cuz colonialism is slavery. Jeremiah 50:7 2:37:19 - All that found them have devoured them: and their adversaries said, We offend not. All nations have devoured us, and they say: we did nothing wrong, that was in the past. Because they have sinned against the Lord: they excuse it because we sinned against the Lord. Isaiah 9:7 2:38:08 - Of the increase of his government and peace there shall be no end, upon the throne of David, to order it, and to establish it with judgment and with justice. When Christ returns, he's going to establish judgment and justice on this earth. That's what you should be asking for. That's what you should be looking for: judgment and justice, not a payoff. - It's like somebody harms your daughter and offers you $5 million. I don't want your $5 million; I want justice. According to the law, that carries death. Anybody that takes the money instead is among the lowest people on this earth. For slavery, I want justice and judgment from my God. - Video played in class: a so-called foundational black American arguing reparations should be strictly for descendants of freedmen, because others are black when it's convenient. At least Ghana is trying to involve everyone; when you're narrow-minded like that, you only think about yourself. And let me tell you all something: I don't want no damn reparations. I want justice. Keep your money. Jeremiah 23:5-6 2:40:36 - Behold, the days come, saith the Lord, that I will raise unto David a righteous Branch: that king is Christ. And shall execute judgment and justice in the earth: all the wickedness, slavery, all of it, will be answered when Christ returns. In his days Judah shall be saved. Exodus 21:16 2:41:37 - He that stealeth a man, and selleth him, or if he be found in his hand, he shall surely be put to death. That's judgment and justice. Weren't we stolen from Africa and brought to America, the Caribbean islands, and Britain? Are we still in these lands? Then what is the judgment for that? Zechariah 5:4 2:42:29 - I will bring it forth, saith the Lord of hosts, and it shall enter into the house of the thief: the house of the thief is those that stole us and brought us here as slaves, those that steal lands and countries. It's talking about America; it's talking about Edom. The Lord's chariots, what you all call UFOs seen in these lands, are a curse: it shall remain in the midst of his house, and shall consume it. Obadiah 1:15 2:43:34 - For the day of the Lord is near upon all the heathen: as thou hast done, it shall be done unto thee; thy reward shall return upon thine own head. That's justice; that's judgment. As the nations did to us, God says it shall be done unto them. What is their reward? What they did to us. Psalms 58:10-11 2:44:39 - The righteous shall rejoice when he seeth the vengeance: he shall wash his feet in the blood of the wicked. You brothers and sisters that want vengeance for slavery, talking about reparations: to hell with their paper money. Who are the wicked? The people that robbed, stole, and murdered us. - So that a man shall say, Verily there is a reward for the righteous: verily he is a God that judgeth in the earth. That's our reward: the Lord is going to bring judgment on this earth. Revelation 13:9-10 2:47:27 - He that leadeth into captivity shall go into captivity: he that leadeth the children of Israel into captivity shall go into captivity. I don't want no reparation; I want the judgment written: the people that enslaved us will answer with the same measure. He that killeth with the sword must be killed with the sword: weren't we killed in Africa and over here with the sword? - Here is the patience and the faith of the saints: this is what you got to believe. Precepts: - Revelation 13:7 And it was given unto him to make war with the saints, and to overcome them. What you all got to understand: slavery was war. Colonization was war. The judgment of verses 9 and 10 answers the war of verse 7. Psalms 149:7-9 2:48:38 - To execute vengeance upon the heathen, and punishments upon the people; to bind their kings with chains, and their nobles with fetters of iron; to execute upon them the judgment written: this honour have all his saints. This is the faith of the saints. To hell with your reparations: I want the judgment written executed when my King returns. - All the gold on this earth, everything the nations stole, they're going to bring it to us when Christ returns. That's the restitution. Lord's will, I'll do a whole lesson called The Restitution. In Closing To hell with reparations. Judgment. What can you give me for what you did to me and my people? Money cannot answer it; the law answers it. When Christ returns, he's going to execute judgment and justice on this earth, and the saints will execute the judgment written. That's what we want: judgment and justice from our God. Announcements & References Stay tuned: The Ignition is coming up next after the class. Media referenced in class: the UN resolution coverage of March 25, 2026 and the country-by-country vote, the Ghanaian representative's interview on reparative justice, the article on the Holocaust Expropriated Art Recovery Act update, the UK visa-ban announcement against 17 reparations-seeking countries, Thomas Sankara on food aid, the Kenya Mau Mau history, the Kwame Nkrumah Africa Must Unite interview, the 1760 Gold Coast uprising against the Dutch, the Marshall Plan and African minerals analysis, the South Africa xenophobia news reports and land-audit figures, the colonialism and self-confidence interview, the AfriForum report, and the foundational black American reparations clip. --- Class Notes Index Transcript: full session

title: The Secret Hands Behind South Africa's Xenophobia
text: Introduction Thumbnail video: "The blood of innocent civilians cries out for justice. South Africa calls on this court to hold Israel accountable and prove that no nation is above the law. Effective immediately, the Republic of South Africa is suspending all diplomatic relations with Israel. The International Criminal Court hereby issues an arrest warrant for Israeli Prime Minister Benjamin Netanyahu. South Africa has become a problem. Then it's time we dealt with the problem; put our people on the ground; I give them 30 days. South Africa has become a threat to our position. It's time we remind them how fragile stability can be. They wanted the world's attention; let's see how long they can keep it when their own country is on fire." Happy new moon, brothers and sisters. The new moon isn't in yet, but it's right there. This new moon class, I'm going to go over some things that have been going on. I'm going to get on the South Africa situation again, but not really the South Africans; I'm going to show you what's really taking place. Every time I go on social media, all I'm seeing is the xenophobia going on in South Africa, so I started looking into it more and more, and the Lord showed me what's going on over there. The opening prayer asked the Most High to protect the leaders and the brothers that put their lives on the line to teach the word, to heal the sick among us, and to strengthen Captain Tobias and his house as they go through their ordeal. Scriptures Opened Numbers 10:10 9:31 - In the day of your gladness, and in your solemn days, and in the beginnings of your months. The beginning of our months is the new moon, also called the days of our gladness. On these days we are supposed to be happy, not sorrowful. Nehemiah 8:10 10:26 - Go your way, eat the fat, and drink the sweet, and send portions unto them for whom nothing is prepared: for this day is holy unto our Lord: neither be ye sorry; for the joy of the Lord is your strength. The joy of the Lord is where we get our strength. - When you read the whole history, they were there from morning to afternoon being taught the law, and when they heard the law they started crying, sorrowful for all the evil they had been doing. Nehemiah told them, do not be sorrowful; the joy of the Lord is your strength. So for you brothers and sisters that are always sorrowful, that's an evil spirit, because the only way you get strength is from having joy in the Lord. Luke 10:38-42 12:29 - Mary sat at Jesus' feet and heard his word: she was learning the scriptures, hearing all that wisdom coming from Christ. Martha was cumbered about much serving, like a lot of you sisters get caught up in the kitchen serving. That's a good work; the scripture says if you give the prophets even a cup of water, you get your blessing. - But Christ said, Martha, Martha, thou art careful and troubled about many things: but one thing is needful, and Mary hath chosen that good part, which shall not be taken away from her. The good part is learning wisdom. The serving is good, but the best part is learning the wisdom, and as you learn and understand these scriptures, that can never be taken away from you. Ecclesiasticus 40:20 15:52 - Wine and musick rejoice the heart: but the love of wisdom is above them both. When you drink some wine your heart is merry; on the feast days we play music and everybody dances and has fun. But above them both is wisdom. - So the joy of the Lord is not just having fun on the feast days. That same joy you have for wine and music, you are supposed to have in learning wisdom. That's why every feast day and every new moon we go over the scriptures; this is supposed to be the better part. You're not supposed to be sitting there asking why the class is two hours. You are supposed to be excited, because you're learning things that haven't been taught for over 2,000 years or were forgotten. If you don't have joy in learning the wisdom of God, you have to pray and ask God for it. You should be around the brothers, and a brother pulls a scripture, and you say, let me write that down and put that in my notes. Wisdom of Solomon 10:5 25:31 - Moreover, the nations in their wicked conspiracy being confounded. You always hear about conspiracy theories; Esau throws that label out any time anybody speaks truth, so the public won't believe you. But when we read the scriptures, God says the nations have wicked conspiracies. They are doing things secretly to destroy our people. - The topic is the secret hands behind South Africa's xenophobia. You see the South Africans rising up, beating people from Nigeria, from Zimbabwe, from Ethiopia, saying get out of my country, and we say these South Africans are foolish; it makes no sense. But when you really examine what's going on, everything you see going on in South Africa, the CIA and Mossad are behind it, and I'm going to show you without a shadow of a doubt. Isaiah 29:15-16 26:39 - Woe unto them that seek deep to hide their counsel from the Lord, and their works are in the dark, and they say, Who seeth us? and who knoweth us? There are people seeking to hide the evil they are doing. In the dark means the way these operatives operate: the CIA and Mossad will go into a country, murder leaders, and cause civil unrest, and they think nobody sees what they are doing. - Surely your turning of things upside down shall be esteemed as the potter's clay. The potter has the power to turn things back the way they are supposed to be. Psalms 64:2-6 28:27 - Hide me from the secret counsel of the wicked; from the insurrection of the workers of iniquity. The wicked have secret councils, so we want God to hide us from them. - Who whet their tongue like a sword, and bend their bows to shoot their arrows, even bitter words: they use their words as a weapon. That they may shoot in secret at the perfect: the perfect is the twelve tribes of Israel. The bitter words are things they say and put out there secretly to confuse our people and cause uprisings. Suddenly do they shoot at him, and fear not: they call us a hate group and all types of names, and they don't fear God when they speak their lies against us. - They commune of laying snares privily: they sit down and talk among themselves about setting traps. Traps to assassinate leaders, traps to overthrow countries, traps to cause civil unrest, traps to murder the prophets, traps to get us locked up for things we did not do. - They search out iniquities; both the inward thought of every one of them, and the heart, is deep. When they set things up, they are thinking a hundred steps ahead. Habakkuk 3:13-14 31:34 - Thou wentest forth for the salvation of thy people: the Lord is coming forth for the salvation of the twelve tribes of Israel. Thou woundedst the head out of the house of the wicked: the head of the house of the wicked is America, and Christ is going to destroy it when he returns, by discovering the foundation unto the neck. - Their rejoicing was as to devour the poor secretly. Everything they are doing to destroy us is secret, through their secret services, the CIA and Mossad. And it is not just on an individual level; it's us as a whole people. It's Venezuela, Guatemala, Panama, the Sahel, Cuba, South Africa, Nigeria: things are set up to destroy our people all over the world secretly, with the food, with the vaccines, with the music. - We have to start thinking on an international level, because Israel is global; our people are scattered globally. Once Malcolm X realized it was not just about the US, that his people were being oppressed all over Africa and all over the world, and he started linking up with other leaders, they said, we have to kill this guy. Obadiah 1:6 35:24 - How are the things of Esau searched out! how are his hidden things sought up! The hidden things are what he is doing and hiding from the world. Who has to bring it out? We do. We are the ones that have to search out the hidden things; God puts his spirit on us and we go forth and reveal him. 2 Thessalonians 2:8 37:25 - And then shall that Wicked be revealed. Why does the wicked need to be revealed? Because the wicked is acting like he's righteous, acting like he's holy. So it's up to the servants of God to search out his secrets and show the world: no, this man is the wicked. He's not about justice; he's not about rights. - Whom the Lord shall consume with the spirit of his mouth: that starts first and foremost with us teaching. And shall destroy with the brightness of his coming: when the Lord returns, he will destroy Esau. Matthew 10:26-28 39:43 - Fear them not therefore: for there is nothing covered, that shall not be revealed; and hid, that shall not be known. Whatever the white man did or is doing and trying to hide from the world, the Lord is going to reveal it to us. - What I tell you in darkness, that speak ye in light: go speak it and let everybody hear; preach it upon the housetops. - And fear not them which kill the body, but are not able to kill the soul. What the US government and the Israeli government are doing in South Africa is a hidden thing, and teaching it could get you killed. But as the Lord reveals things to you, you had better speak it, and don't fear them that can kill the body. Videos played in class, the history: - A South African clip: why were Mandela and Tutu and all of us so critical of Israel? Because Israel was apartheid South Africa's closest ally. It provided the apartheid state with weapons, with military training, with the technology that helped apartheid South Africa and Israel both become nuclear powers. When Mandela was first released from prison, he was asked on American television why he was so critical of Israel, and he said: why would I not be critical of my enemy's closest ally? If it wasn't for the state of Israel, I might have spent seven years in jail, not 27 years; thousands of my fellow South Africans who fought for their freedom would be alive today. - So the synagogue of Satan supported apartheid. They had an allegiance with the Afrikaners, the whites ruling South Africa, all through apartheid: selling them weapons and training them. So what changed? - South Africa's lawyers at the International Court of Justice, pleading the genocide case: Israel has a genocidal intent against the Palestinians in Gaza; Israel has deliberately imposed conditions on Gaza that cannot sustain life and are calculated to bring about its physical destruction; nothing will stop the suffering except an order from this court. - News clip: on February 7 the president signed an executive order freezing all financial aid to South Africa. The stated trigger was the South African Expropriation Act, but the order also cites the fact that the country takes positions against the United States and its ally Israel. The South African president responded that no land has been taken away and the law is not an instrument of confiscation. So all aid to South Africa was banned, not because anybody is being oppressed there, but because of the charges South Africa brought against Israel. - News clip: South Africa and Israel expelled each other's top diplomats, declaring them persona non grata. South Africa accused the Israeli embassy of misusing its social media to insult President Ramaphosa and of breaching the Vienna Convention by not disclosing that a senior Israeli diplomat was part of a delegation visiting the Eastern Cape. What was an Israeli official doing at one of the biggest shipping ports? You have to read between the lines. There is a secret war going on between the synagogue of Satan and South Africa. - News clip: the International Criminal Court issued an arrest warrant for Netanyahu, a first for a major Western ally. He is unlikely to stand trial, but he risks arrest if he travels to any of the ICC's 124 member states, and the warrant puts him on a list alongside Putin and Omar al-Bashir. - News clip: South African foreign minister Naledi Pandor accused Israeli intelligence of attempting to intimidate her and her family over the genocide case, saying her children were mentioned in threatening messages, and requested extra security: "The Israeli agents, the intelligence services, this is how they behave as they seek to intimidate you. So we must not be intimidated." Pretoria also said the country is facing destabilization campaigns by international intelligence agencies, and the security minister placed her agency on high alert to prevent foreign interference ahead of national elections. Did that go over your heads? The country is facing destabilization campaigns by external intelligence agencies. That is Mossad and the CIA. - Article read in class, from a Times of Israel blog, published January 2: "Africa must fragment. South Africa first." Fragment means a small piece broken off from a larger whole. The article says South Africa presents the most urgent and compelling case: under the ANC the country has collapsed into one of the world's worst examples of governance, systemic extractive plunder designed to enrich the party's leadership, with every component of government for sale, including and especially foreign policy, which has been aligned with Iran through deepening military ties such as participation in joint BRICS naval exercises. Now you see it. The plan is to isolate South Africa from the other African nations and weaken it, because South Africa is a founder of BRICS: Brazil, Russia, India, China, South Africa. All the nations that are part of BRICS, America is trying to destroy. - Testimony played, a former conscript in the South African Army in 1988 and 1989, a law officer in a Zulu battalion in northern Zululand: a small group of recce officers, the equivalent of SAS or Navy SEAL types, was training local Zulu men to go up to the townships and the mine hostels around Johannesburg and the Transvaal to deliberately foment racial tension and violence with other tribes. This was a very deliberate strategy of the South African government and military at the time, to create black-on-black violence to detract from the potential for black-on-white violence. White people at the time kept saying these blacks can't run a country because they're always fighting each other, and what most people have no idea of is that that intertribal violence was fomented by the white South African government, army, and police force very deliberately. He said we need to revise our idea of the entire history of European domination of Africa: the things we believe about the history of Africa and colonialism are not what actually happened. - What you see taking place right now is the same thing they were doing in 1989. They paid and trained black South Africans to fight their own people, and painted it to the world as black-on-black crime: they can't govern their own country. - Street clip: men saying that if the immigrants don't go, their shops will be looted. A British woman asks, I'm also a foreigner in your country; does that mean you'd attack me? They answer no. So they're going after people that look like themselves only. These are the ones being paid to attack immigrants so South Africans look violent. Matthew 12:25 1:16:24 - Every kingdom divided against itself is brought to desolation; and every city or house divided against itself shall not stand. This is what the white man always does, and this is what he's doing to South Africa. Mossad and the CIA are trying to turn all the other African countries, Nigeria, Ghana, Zimbabwe, against South Africa. - How are they doing it? Paid agents. A lot of the people you see rising up, marching, and beating people in the streets are paid agents. You have some people that are just following it, saying they're taking my job, but there are culprits behind it, to destabilize South Africa and weaken BRICS. Any nation divided shall not stand, so South Africa is about to fall; that's the plan. Isaiah 14:12 1:18:09 - How art thou fallen from heaven, O Lucifer, son of the morning, which didst weaken the nations! That's what you see taking place. America and Israel are trying to weaken South Africa by causing civil unrest. The xenophobia you see is really afrophobia, black-on-black crime, and they are doing it to make it look like South Africa can't govern themselves, that they are a failed state. Then the Afrikaner rises back up and takes back that government. Videos played in class, the agenda: - Julius Malema: the Ghanaians are gone now, 300 of them; how many jobs were created after the Ghanaians left? So it's just a myth, a lie which they're using to further divide us, to perpetuate colonial divisions that were created. We should all accept that the violence is state sponsored violence, because the people committing these crimes are accompanied by the police, and the state broadcaster and the mainstream media are giving them unlimited air time. He also said: you can't say you are against colonialism but support the borders; the borders are the most practical thing colonialism brought about. They do not want Africa to come together, because they understand that's the only way they retain power, by keeping the countries divided. - Why are the platforms allowing all those beating videos to go viral? To turn everyone against South Africa. Listen: it is a small group of South Africans doing this, not the whole country, but when you watch the media it seems like all of South Africa is like that. - Clip: if black people would act the same way as Chinese people do, they would be so much more powerful; there are so many black people in the world, but they are not bonding, they're fighting each other. Or maybe it's the elite which keeps them divided. That's it: it's not that we don't have the capacity to unify; the elites keep us divided. That's what colonialism was about. - Clips of Erik Prince, former Navy SEAL and founder of Blackwater: all this talk of illegal migration ultimately comes down to a contest of governance, and if so many of these countries around the world are incapable of governing themselves, then it's time for us to just put the imperial hat back on and say we're going to govern those countries, pretty much all of Africa. Asked whether that's talking about being a colonialist again, he answered: absolutely, yes, because the governments there are criminal syndicates, and the people of Africa and Latin America deserve better. Brothers and sisters, things are about to get bad. They are putting the imperial hat back on. And not just over there: they're not going to allow us to govern ourselves in America either; you see them changing the districts and getting rid of black senators. It's been 60 years, and white people want that power back. Habakkuk 1:10 1:33:33 - And they shall scoff at the kings, and the princes shall be a scorn unto them: they shall deride every strong hold; for they shall heap dust, and take it. The civil uprising and the afrophobia you see going on over there is confusion, and that's the dust. It's going to get worse, and as it gets worse the white people are going to step in and take back that country from the black South Africans. - And nobody is going to feel sorry for them: not Nigeria, not Zimbabwe, none of these countries, because propaganda was put out there that all South Africans hate black people. It's a trap. Ask yourself who benefits from all of it. Videos played in class, the takeover: - A white woman telling a Nigerian brother she will never be quiet for him: what I'm showing you is the Afrikaners are behind what you see going on over there, working with the Israeli government, because the Israeli government supported them for decades during apartheid, and it benefits the Israeli government if the Afrikaners come back into power. - A white Afrikaner interviewer pressing a Zimbabwean guest: if you have such faith in Zimbabwe, why don't you take your family and go fix up Zimbabwe? The guest answers: why are Europeans not going back to Europe? Why did your great grandparents come here instead of staying in Europe? You see where the talking points come from. "Go back to your country" is not coming from the Zulu first; it's coming from the Afrikaners. - Clip: there are a lot of illegal immigrants in South Africa who are white people, many in Cape Town. One tweeted that she came for six months of tourism and stayed more than twelve, and there was never an outrage that she has no visa. Had a black person said that, they would go home the following day. - Clip of a white South African asked why white South Africans do nothing about white foreign nationals: "Excuse me, we're not in government; that's not our job. Secondly, white foreign nationals are our brothers. We love them. They're our racial kin. Maybe you should learn to love your brothers the way we love ours. With regards to my racial kin from Europe coming to this country, I hope more of them come." In their mind, South Africa is still theirs. - Headline: white South Africans being pushed to divide South Africa and seek a separate country as black South Africans intensify afrophobia attacks on other Africans. It's a setup. - News clip: as of early May 2026, Mozambican youth groups have planned border shutdowns in response to anger over anti-immigrant operations in South Africa, with over 5,000 South African trucks facing blockades at the Lebombo, Ressano Garcia, and Ponta do Ouro crossings. Mozambique fell for the bait. - News clip: Ghana reported South Africa to the African Union over the xenophobic attacks, and there is talk of South Africa being removed from the AU. Remember what the Times of Israel article said: Africa must fragment, South Africa first. Divide and rule. Ghana also rejected the renewal of South African gold fields licenses. - Clip on the Cape Town wall: the settler class controlling Cape Town is spending about 7 million dollars to wall South African communities away from a major road, calling it safety. Cape Town generates 10 percent of South Africa's entire GDP, and with the Red Sea in conflict, global shipping is rerouting around the Cape, making it the most strategically valuable coastline on earth; whoever controls Cape Town controls the southern gateway of an entire continent. The Belgians handed identity cards to the Hutu and Tutsi, two peoples who had lived together for centuries, and told them they were enemies; the British pitted the Igbo against the Yoruba, the Fante against the Ashanti, to prevent a unified African resistance. Every ethnic conflict on the continent has the fingerprints of a settler class that knew it couldn't take African land from a united people. Today the targets are Xhosa and Zulu, township against township, African immigrant against South African. A unified Africa is the greatest threat the settler class has ever faced: divide, destabilize, annex. What they are testing in South Africa, they intend to scale across the continent. - Remember the Israeli diplomats were put out over an undisclosed visit near the Eastern Cape. Cape Town is becoming one of the most important strategic shipping points right now because the Red Sea is cut off. It's all about weakening BRICS. 2 Esdras 16:49-52 1:52:31 - So shall righteousness hate iniquity, when she decketh herself, and shall accuse her to her face. That's how we must hate iniquity, all the evil we see them doing. Our job is to accuse them to their face: what you are doing in South Africa is evil. The division, the secret counsel to destabilize South Africa, turning tribesmen against each other and countries against each other, is evil. Let the white man know he's evil; let the Israeli government, the US government, and the Afrikaners know they are evil for what they are doing. - When he cometh that shall defend him that diligently searcheth out every sin upon earth. What is our job, brothers? To diligently search out every sin upon the earth. Every sin and wickedness the white man is hiding, our job is to search it out. And how are we able to see these things? The spirit of God shows it to us. - For yet a little, and iniquity shall be taken away out of the earth, and righteousness shall reign among you. Amos 3:3-11 1:55:33 - Shall a trumpet be blown in the city, and the people not be afraid? The trumpet is us teaching. What are we telling the people is going to take place on this earth? Oppression is coming. - Surely the Lord God will do nothing, but he revealeth his secret unto his servants the prophets. God reveals his secrets to us, and it's our job to teach it. The lion hath roared, who will not fear? The Lord God hath spoken, who can but prophesy? - Publish in the palaces at Ashdod: Ashdod is in the land of Israel, so we prophesy against those people that are in the land of Israel. And in the palaces in the land of Egypt: the land of Egypt is America. Israel and America are the two behind what you see going on in South Africa, and behind much of the evil you see taking place on the earth; even what you see going on in the Congo. - For they know not to do right, saith the Lord, who store up violence and robbery in their palaces. That is what America does and what the Israeli government does. - Therefore thus saith the Lord God; An adversary there shall be even round about the land; and he shall bring down thy strength from thee. God is going to raise up an adversary against them. Remember what we read in Isaiah: I will stir up the Medes; that's Iran. America is not going to destroy Iran; that's not going to happen. In Closing I hope I was able to paint the picture clear for you. What you see taking place in South Africa is not going to stop there; it's going to spread all over, even in the islands. Anybody that speaks against the synagogue of Satan, they are coming for you. The South African government is being threatened because they told them what you are doing to the Palestinians is wrong, and they brought up genocide charges against Netanyahu, who is a wanted man right now under an International Criminal Court warrant. The civil unrest and the xenophobia taking place in South Africa: the Israeli government, the Afrikaners, and the CIA are behind it, and in the next couple of months or couple of years the white man aims to take back South Africa, with no other country in Africa feeling sorry for the South Africans because of the propaganda. Watch and pray. The class closed with the breaking of bread and wine for the new moon, reading 1 Corinthians 11:23-29: this do in remembrance of me; but let a man examine himself, and so let him eat of that bread, and drink of that cup. Announcements & References - Prayers went up for Captain Tobias and his household as they go through their ordeal. - Shout out to the Jersey crew for putting together the class thumbnail. --- Class Notes Index Transcript: full session

title: Are You A Strong Independent Woman?
text: Introduction Glad to be here with you. As I just left you this morning, there was people complaining why I cut off at 5:00 and I'm not taking questions. I got to leave it to the young men now: Captain Yamagan on my right and Captain Zephaniah on my left. Hopefully I could give y'all something edifying, to you sisters who like me. It's not going to offend you. You sisters who don't like me, put your helmets on and put your combat boots on, cuz it's going to feel like war to you. The reason why I put the title Are You A Strong Independent Woman, I left black out. But I'm using y'all, and I'm talking to the Latino woman, the women in the Caribbean, to all of you. I'm saying black because y'all are the face of all the women now. Don't let the white man have to remind you: you black, too. The video team opened with a skit: the voice of America telling a woman, "You don't need no man controlling your life. You are a strong independent woman. Hair done, bills paid. And I did it all without a man." Then the answer: Hebrews 13 and verse 4, marriage is honorable. In The News The Southern Poverty Law Center has been charged in a massive, sweeping indictment with allegations of fraud and using the banking system to perpetrate that fraud. From the press conference played in class: the SPLC advertised to its donor network to raise money to dismantle violent extremist groups for at least a decade, then used that fraudulently raised money to actually pay the leadership of those very groups, including the Ku Klux Klan, the United Klans of America, Unite the Right, the National Alliance, the National Socialist Movement, the Aryan Nation Motorcycle Club, the National Socialist Party of America, and the American Front, totaling over $3 million. The investigation also revealed shell companies set up around America to hide that the money was coming from the SPLC. - These people put us on their list for years. They put us as number three on the Southern Poverty Law Center list, as a greatest threat, while the Ku Klux Klan, that historically burned crosses on people's lawns, firebombed churches, and lynched people, sat at number 20. People were attacking us; they were hindering us from traveling, from making ventures. The bishop told y'all that 12 years ago when they put us on the list. - Why did they put us as number three? You know where to find Israel United in Christ and the Nation of Islam. The Proud Boys, you can't find them, cuz they walk around with masks; they're your police officers, your judges, your workers in affluent positions. - Who cares if they caught them? The DOJ is the one investigating them. Were they any help with the Epstein files? Did anybody come to justice? We just want it known to our viewing audience that the evil title they put on us for the past 10, 11 years, they are the wicked ones. That's all that matters. All they'll do is take the money and give it to another group; they still got AIPAC, Canary Mission, the ADL. Anybody teaching the truth of the Bible, that we are the people of the book, they want to destroy them. - We also replayed our defense videos from 10, 11 years ago. Now it all makes sense: the SPLC admitted they were paying people to help them tear down other people, and back then a disgruntled ex-member sat down with them to attack this ministry, secretly recording, circulating private documents and financial statements. We didn't have the proof before; we just speculated. The Most High said it's going to take time, but I'm going to give it to you. That's why anybody with access to sensitive information signs an NDA: not to hide anything, but so there's repercussions when your personal information gets put out to make you look bad. - Years ago the SPLC's own co-founder was forced out over workplace misconduct, and a letter signed by about two dozen employees said internal allegations of mistreatment, sexual harassment, gender discrimination, and racism threatened the moral authority of the organization. These are supposed to be the people watching out for you. It took almost 11 years, all praises to the Most High: the scripture say what's done in the dark shall come to the light. - A lot of people left IUIC when the attacks came, and now that they saw it didn't work, they want to come back. My answer is no. Stay where you are. Watch online. Scriptures Opened Deuteronomy 11:8-16 41:35 - We have to define what is strong first, cuz the definition of strong is wrong according to God. You black women professing yourself to be strong black women, you have your identity from America, a place that God is going to destroy; America is Babylon in the Bible. Your strength is temporary. The strength of the true daughters of Sarah is eternal, and their strength is the wisdom they have of God. - Therefore shall ye keep all the commandments, that ye may be strong. That's how you get strength: by keeping God's commandments. The most powerful force known to mankind is God, not the United States of America. Daniel spoke about four empires: the Babylonians, the Persians and the Medes, and the Greco-Roman empire. America is an extension of ancient Rome; their kingdom is temporary. - That you may prolong your days in the land: keeping the commandments allows you to prolong your days. A land that floweth with milk and honey: God is the one that gave the resources. America has milk and honey and iPhones and cars cuz they enslaved your people, used us for hundreds of years of free labor, and altered your behavior, so now you think America is your savior. - The land is not as the land of Egypt, from whence ye came out, where thou sowedst thy seed and wateredst it with thy foot. We were sowing seed in Egypt and taking care of Egypt with our feet. It's the same thing with America: you think America's good because you're in slavery here and they give you certain benefits. God got something better than America: the twelve tribes of Israel coming together according to prophecy to set up the kingdom. - A land which the Lord thy God careth for: the eyes of the Lord thy God are always upon it. Precepts: - Amos 9:8-10 God has another land his eyes are upon for a different reason: behold, the eyes of the Lord are upon the sinful kingdom, and I will destroy it from off the face of the earth. America is a sinful kingdom. Saving that I will not utterly destroy the house of Jacob: Jacob is the father of the twelve tribes. I will sift the house of Israel among all nations, because we were scattered into all nations; the sifting is a teaching process. All the sinners of my people shall die by the sword, which say, The evil shall not overtake nor prevent us: that's what America, aka Egypt, has convinced you to believe, that nothing can happen to you here because Donald Trump talks tough about the strongest military and the Strait of Hormuz. - Matthew 28:19 Go ye therefore, and teach all nations: because we were scattered into all nations, we have to be taught in all nations. That's why you see the bishop giving the order: look historically where our people were slaves, and train them how to behave for God, to establish the kingdom, because they've been trained after the ways of their colonizers. - I will give you the rain of your land in his due season: rain produces agriculture and makes it so we can eat. We have no control over that now; they have the food plants, they bring food into our communities, and they control how you eat. Now you're being fed by another man, like Revelation chapter 12 says the beast will nourish us for a time. God had it set up that we control the land: your own crops, your own cattle. If you have your own land, you don't have to pay rent; why do you care about the things America's worried about? America set us up to be dependent upon them, and they did that to all the other countries they destabilized, cuz that's the only way they can stay in power. - Take heed to yourselves, that your heart be not deceived, and ye turn aside, and serve other gods: and we did get deceived. Methodist, Baptist, Catholic, Jehovah's Witness, Seventh Day Adventist, Protestant, Lutheran, Pentecostal: these are all false gods. When they took us as slaves, they trained us how to behave, stopped us from reading and writing, created a slave Bible, and gave us these slave religions to follow, because you have a zeal of God but not according to knowledge. - There's nowhere in the Bible that says there is a white Jesus. They made him up in the 14th century during the Renaissance period, and told us that he is our savior. That's how they modified your behavior: by telling you that a white man is your savior.
