The brothers traveling report the hardest thing they run into is trying to tell oppressed people that Jesus Christ is not a white man. - Christ started his own ministry; he did not join with the church when he walked the earth. Matthew 10:5: these twelve Jesus sent forth, saying, Go not into the way of the Gentiles, but go rather to the lost sheep of the house of Israel. Why were we lost? Cuz we broke covenant. And as ye go, preach, saying, The kingdom of heaven is at hand. That's God's plan for the Israelite man, and that's the only way we'll stand: by telling our people, you're not black, you're not Hispanic, you're not West Indian, you're not Haitian, you're not African; you are the lost sheep of the house of Israel. Deuteronomy 28:1-6 56:35 - God wanted the twelve tribes of Israel to be the nation above all nations of the earth. First they had to define their worth: hearken diligently unto the voice of the Lord thy God, to observe and to do all his commandments. - Blessed shalt thou be in the city, and blessed shalt thou be in the field: we think blessings in the city and the field is whatever white people give us. You have no cities, you have no fields; they could cut you off at any time. You're not living, you're surviving. - Blessed shall be the fruit of thy body, and the fruit of thy ground, and the fruit of thy cattle: those are the things we worry about, our health, our finances, our food. Blessed shall be thy basket and thy store: our finances. Blessed when thou comest in and when thou goest out: from when we're born until we leave the earth. Deuteronomy 28:15-16 58:16 - But we didn't listen; we broke the covenant. These are the consequences. When God brought us into this covenant, we ruled as a theocracy: theo meaning God, cracy meaning government. God say it, we obey it. Not the Constitution of the United States of America; we had a constitution with God. - Cursed shalt thou be in the city: that's why in your cities right now there's drugs, violence, alcoholism, domestic violence, police brutality, gangbanging, mental illness; the rents going up and up and our salaries stay down. - Cursed shalt thou be in the field: we own no more fields, and when we was in the fields, what were we doing? Picking cotton, sugarcane, tobacco. They sent us into mines in Africa and mutilated workers who didn't meet the quota. They massacred the Native American Indians that were here before and broke all the treaties with them. Ain't nothing changed; the only thing that's changed is when we tell you this is what it says in the Bible, you look at it strange. Deuteronomy 28:30-32 1:00:39 - Thou shalt betroth a wife, and another man shall lie with her: they violated our wives and daughters in captivity and we couldn't do nothing. Watch the opening scene of The Butler with your children: the boy's mother is taken to the barn, and when his father tried to intervene, he was killed on the spot. That historical damage is generational; it don't go away, and we got no counseling and no reparations for it. Deacon Malachi was saying, to hell with reparations. We don't want no reparations; just allow us to become the Israelite nation and keep your reparations. That's how we get our salvation. - Thou shalt build an house, and thou shalt not dwell therein: you see that in 12 Years a Slave. He won his freedom, they re-enslaved him, and had him building a house he could not live in. - Thou shalt plant a vineyard, and shalt not gather the grapes thereof: you had to meet a quota; you couldn't take grapes home for your family. Sit with your children and watch 12 Years a Slave, Amistad, Roots; turn off Love & Hip Hop and show them their history so the Bible won't be a mystery. This is you. This is your book. They trained you not to look inside your book. - Thine ox shall be slain before thine eyes, and thou shalt not eat thereof: there's documentaries on how oxtail became a delicacy. They would discard the tail of the oxen and keep the best meat for themselves, and the slaves seasoned what was thrown away. Now oxtail is $20 a plate. News read in class: five IHOP locations in the Bronx are testing a new menu featuring braised oxtails as of April 26th, with an oxtail omelet, oxtail tacos, oxtail quesadillas, and an oxtail chopped cheese. They make a menu specific to the demographic that's there; these people study us. - Thine ass shall be violently taken away from thee before thy face, and shall not be restored to thee: that's why when we ask for reparations we always say, where's my 40 acres and my mule? It was never restored unto us. - Thy sheep shall be given unto thine enemies: that's a multi-billion dollar industry; see how much a sheepskin coat costs. And thou shalt have none to rescue them: to this day they're still manipulating the system so that they stay on top and we stay on the bottom. It's not an equal playing field; that's why we need God. - Thy sons and thy daughters shall be given unto another people, and thine eyes shall look, and fail with longing for them all the day long: imagine the psychological trauma when your children are taken from you at birth and given off to another plantation. Northern kingdom, they're separating your children as we speak; but you're saying these curses don't fit you. - And there shall be no might in thine hand: that's why we need God. We got to rise up as the Israelite man according to God's plan; that's the only way we going to stand. Deuteronomy 28:43-50 1:09:15 - The stranger that is within thee shall get up above thee very high, and thou shalt come down very low: that's the prophecy. So I don't expect nothing from them but to do what God said in prophecy they were going to do. We're not asking them for nothing; we're waiting patiently for God to bring forth change. - He shall lend to thee, and thou shalt not lend to him: there's no place where black people are lending white people money. He shall be the head, and thou shalt be the tail. - All these curses shall come upon thee: some of y'all want to believe cuz you got a good job, a nice house, and a car that you're not cursed. You believe in a fake feel-good religion they gave you to sustain you. Till thou be destroyed: and that's what we are, a destroyed people, because thou hearkenedst not unto the voice of the Lord thy God. - They shall be upon thee for a sign and for a wonder, and upon thy seed for ever: if you want to know who the Israelites are, God said these curses will be upon you for a sign. Read your Bible and see who this fits. - Therefore shalt thou serve thine enemies: these people are your enemies. It's not cuz we don't like them; you never hear us training you to dislike a race. These conditions exist because we resist the word of God, and God said he's going to deal with them. In hunger: to eat we got to go to them. In thirst: they could cut off or contaminate our water supply at any time, like they did in Flint, Michigan. A yoke of iron upon thy neck: tell me when this happened to the people that's saying they are the people of the book. We lost our land, heritage, culture, and identity, and now we're destroyed and need a savior. The Messiah is the savior of the Israelites; that's why they changed him from a black man to a white man, so they could execute their plan. - The Lord shall bring a nation against thee from far, as swift as the eagle flieth: what's the symbol of the United States of America? The eagle, on the dollar bill, on the quarter, on their military. When they landed on the moon they said, the eagle has landed. - A nation whose tongue thou shalt not understand: that's why they forced us to speak English. The New Testament is written in Greek because the Caucasians that enslaved us first under Alexander the Greek forced us to speak Greek, 300 years before Christ came. That's why Paul says there's no difference between the Jew and the Greek: he's talking to us. A nation of fierce countenance, which shall not regard the person of the old, nor shew favour to the young: they don't care if you're young or old, they want to control your soul. 1 Kings 2:1-4 1:16:55 - King David, about to die, charged Solomon his son. Be thou strong therefore, and shew thyself a man: how do we define strong? And keep the charge of the Lord thy God, to walk in his ways, to keep his statutes, and his commandments, and his judgments, and his testimonies. That's the only way you identify someone that's strong. - You black women saying you're strong: you ain't strong according to God, you're strong according to the devil. The devil took you to another level; that's why you feel empowered. The Bible makes it clear every time it speaks about being strong, it is keeping God's commandments. - That thou mayest prosper in all that thou doest: that's how we prosper, when we keep God's laws. As a transfer of power comes from King David to his son, he said, follow what's written in the law of Moses, what we read in Deuteronomy. - To walk before me in truth: because America's fake. They're prospering because you're not prospering; as long as they have you in their power, they will continue to devour. There shall not fail thee a man upon the throne of Israel: the throne is how we rule. That's why they destroy our leaders and get rid of our teachers, cuz they know once you got men teaching this, a kingdom is being established. That's why they reprogram our black women to make them feel empowered and strong, so they could do everything wrong. Genesis 3:1-5 1:20:42 - America is doing the same thing that was done to Eve in the garden. The serpent was more subtle than any beast of the field: we know this is a parable; the scriptures tell you men are beasts. - How was Satan able to deceive? He promised her she would be on a god-like level. She didn't need nothing; she was in paradise, and her husband was a god. But Satan saw something inside of women where you can take control of their emotions and pull them away from God's devotion. - That's why Satan targeted Eve in the garden: this is how you disrupt the balance of life. By telling women that they could be stronger than what God designed them to be, to pull them out of their God-given divine nature. That's how you start a war: you take women out of their divine nature and write checks to them that you cannot cash. They're following Satan today, cuz America's doing the same thing. Isaiah 3:12 1:23:27 - As for my people, children are their oppressors: the places where we don't want to live is because there's wicked children in the streets with guns and violence, selling drugs and acting like thugs. The children don't respect nobody. - And women rule over them: women want to be in a position of power, full control. The court system is designed for them, the legal system is designed for them, the benefits are designed for them, and that's what makes them feel empowered: now I am a strong black woman. - O my people, they which lead thee cause thee to err: God is supposed to lead us, but a system is leading us now. The system started with Adam and Eve in the garden. Satan took Eve out of her God-given divine nature and turned her against God, against her husband, and against the nation. So now, through God's teaching, we got to bring our women back. 1 Timothy 2:11-15 1:25:15 - What inspired this class: every day except the Sabbath we do the Clubhouse room, Biblical Smoke, open to the public, and the women come in the room very disrespectful. These are Christian women that say, I'm washed in the blood of Jesus, I'm born again and saved, but they don't know how to behave. All they want to do is argue and be combative. - Let the woman learn in silence with all subjection. But I suffer not a woman to teach, nor to usurp authority over the man: they want to be in a position of authority to teach, with no respect for the man. They're following Satan's plan, because America told them to be strong black independent women. - For Adam was first formed, then Eve: Paul took it all the way back to the beginning and said the reason for silence is because there's order with God. And Adam was not deceived: Satan didn't go to Adam to get them kicked out of the garden. But the woman being deceived was in the transgression: why did she get deceived? Cuz she didn't believe that God was enough for her. - Notwithstanding she shall be saved in childbearing: cuz we can't do it without our women. If they continue in faith and charity and holiness with sobriety: a lot of you women are not going to continue. Sobriety means you're in your right mind; the strong independent woman is not in her right mind. - Destruction is coming here, as you read in Amos chapter 9 verse 8, and you strong independent black women who don't want to listen to what God got to say, judgment is coming your way. 1 Corinthians 14:34-35 1:31:46 - Let your women keep silence in the churches: try to tell black women they should not be teaching in the church, and they're going to find every excuse. You women preaching in the church are disobedient. As also saith the law: we're not saying this cuz we don't like you; we're saying this cuz it's written in God's law. - And if they will learn any thing, let them ask their husbands at home: you're supposed to have a husband, but you don't have a husband to ask cuz you're a strong independent woman. - What the Lord is saying about keeping silence in the church is also in society. News shown in class: a viral video of a 14 year old brutally attacking a 15 year old girl on the corner of East 107th Street and 3rd Avenue in East Harlem, around 3:30 pm on Monday after school got out, because she refused to give him her phone number. He was arrested days later. I always teach the girls: walk away when men are being disrespectful to you. Come tell your father, come tell another male; don't be up in no man's face, don't go back and forth. You are not stronger than a man; being quiet, as I showed you in two places, is for your protection. - Video shown in class: a young woman and her crew destroyed a McDonald's, then she came back in to record the damage for Instagram. Does this look like a woman that cares about God or authority? She ain't worried about no consequences. This is the strong black independent woman that America has made. - Video shown in class: a woman in Maryland shot at a man in a gas station, then went live to announce it, saying the police have no authority on her earth, that she steals everything, and quoting scripture the whole time. This is how far we've fallen, because the women don't listen to God when he's calling. They arrested her that week. Isaiah 3:16-25 1:42:08 - Because the daughters of Zion are haughty: haughty means mean, nasty. This is before America was established; God looked at the women and called out that spirit. And walk with stretched forth necks and wanton eyes: you're supposed to be shamefaced, but their eyes is in everybody's face. Anytime you see a woman that's not demure and is ready to stare you down, walk away from her. Train your daughters not to make eye contact with people, not to have wanton eyes. - The Lord will take away the bravery of their tinkling ornaments: whatever they put on that makes them feel empowered, the Lord said he was going to take it away when they go into captivity. The changeable suits of apparel: our women like to get dressed up, so God said, I'm going to take that away when you get taken as slaves. - Instead of a sweet smell there shall be stink, and instead of a girdle a rent: y'all would be disfigured and smell bad when the captivity happens. Instead of well set hair baldness: that's why y'all so obsessed with your hair now, and other nations have made it a multi-billion dollar industry. And burning instead of beauty: that's why there's so much cosmetic surgery now. The industry destroys our women and tells them surgery is the standard of what beauty is supposed to look like. God is showing you where you went wrong when you decided that you're the one who's strong. - Thy men shall fall by the sword, and thy mighty in the war: on top of bringing the women down low, he said, I'm going to get your men also. The other nations enslaved us, changed us, and renamed us with the sword. So now the black woman looks at us as weak, inferior, a nobody. This is why we have to train them to look at us through God's eyes. You women are not strong by yourself: Eve was great in the garden because Adam was mighty. 2 Kings 9:1-25 1:49:12 - The Bible speaks about wicked women and how hard they made it for the nation of Israel. Elisha the prophet sent one of the children of the prophets to Ramoth-gilead to find Jehu, anoint him king over Israel, and then flee. He told him, God sent me to make you the new king, because the original king was wicked: thou shalt smite the house of Ahab thy master, that I may avenge the blood of my servants the prophets at the hand of Jezebel. - Jezebel, a strong independent woman, was attacking God's prophets, so God wanted judgment on her for not listening to what he said. He said, I'm going to put a king in place who could address you with the right answer from God. And the dogs shall eat Jezebel in the portion of Jezreel, and there shall be none to bury her. - Jehu's men asked, wherefore came this mad fellow to thee? When he told them what happened, they hasted, put their garments under him on the top of the stairs, blew with trumpets, and said, Jehu is king. - Joram, the son of Ahab and Jezebel, rode out to meet Jehu and asked, Is it peace, Jehu? And he answered, What peace, so long as the whoredoms of thy mother Jezebel and her witchcrafts are so many? There's no peace as long as you got a wicked woman in power. And that's what America likes to do: set up wicked women and empower women that go against God. - Joram turned his hands and fled, saying, There is treachery, O Ahaziah. And Jehu drew a bow with his full strength and smote Jehoram between his arms, and the arrow went out at his heart. 2 Kings 9:30-37 2:03:00 - When Jehu was come to Jezreel, Jezebel heard of it, and she painted her face and tired her head and looked out at a window. Armies coming into the city, and all she's thinking about is putting on makeup. A lot of women lead with how they look, not with God on their mind. She thought she was going to impress him. - Bishop: what did she paint her face for? She wanted to entice the foolish men to be on her side with her beauty, but her beauty was superficial. That's what the scripture is showing us about a Jezebel spirit. Sisters, you don't have to overdo the makeup; that look is not feminine. - Jehu lifted up his face to the window and said, Who is on my side? Who? And two or three eunuchs looked out, and he said, Throw her down. They went to bury her, but they found no more of her than the skull, and the feet, and the palms of her hands: exactly as God had spoken by his servant Elijah the Tishbite. This is the stuff they will never read in the Christian church. - This is history of what happened, and there's also prophecy concerning what God says about the rebellious now. God is not with these emotions; God don't care if it's a woman. You put yourself in the wrong position against his instruction for the nation, God will address it. 2 Kings 8:26-29 2:07:56 - Another wicked woman that used the men around her to manipulate the people of Israel: Athaliah. Her son Ahaziah reigned one year in Jerusalem, and he walked in the way of the house of Ahab, and did evil in the sight of the Lord, for he was the son in law of the house of Ahab. 2 Kings 11:1-8 2:09:42 - When Athaliah saw that her son was dead, she arose and destroyed all the seed royal: a mother giving orders to kill anybody next in line, because her power came through her son. Back then a woman was only empowered based on the man; America is empowering you directly now. - But Jehosheba took Joash, the son of Ahaziah, and stole him from among the king's sons that were slain, and hid him and his nurse in the house of the Lord six years. They had to hide that little boy, cuz this is how wicked women are: to stay in power, they'll destroy the men. - In the seventh year Jehoiada the priest brought the rulers over hundreds into the house of the Lord, made a covenant with them, showed them the king's son, and set armed guards around him on every side: and he that cometh within the ranges, let him be slain. 2 Kings 11:12-16 2:13:22 - He brought forth the king's son, and put the crown upon him, and gave him the testimony; and they made him king, and anointed him; and they clapped their hands, and said, God save the king. That's where that saying comes from: we literally had to deal with wicked women trying to interfere with the rulership of men, and the priest had to establish a king. It's just like our ministry: we're trying to set up things for the King of kings and Lord of lords. - Athaliah rent her clothes and cried, Treason, Treason. She just killed all the royal seed, and when they anoint the rightful king, she screams treason. When you try to restore order, that's how some women look at you, like it's treason against them; they don't see that they're out of order. - Jehoiada the priest commanded, Have her forth without the ranges, and him that followeth her kill with the sword; let her not be slain in the house of the Lord. And they laid hands on her, and by the way the horses came into the king's house, there was she slain. That was the restoring of order: twice in the history, when wicked women rose up in power to devour, God sent men of the Lord to remove them for not listening to what God got to say. 1 Samuel 25:25-43 2:17:15 - Some of you women that want to serve the Lord are attached to some wicked men. On Clubhouse a lot of women say, we listen to you guys, but our husband is wicked. Here is a woman married to a wicked man: Nabal disrespected King David, and King David was coming to kill him. - Abigail told David, Let not my lord regard this man of Belial: Belial means a child of Satan. She said openly, my husband is the devil the Bible speaks of, and folly is with him. She wasn't defending him. Every wise woman that was with a wicked man wasn't taking him by the hand and following his plan. - She told him, the Lord will certainly make my lord a sure house, because my lord fighteth the battles of the Lord; you're going to overcome, you're going to be king again. This is a woman who knows how to speak and how to deal with situations, cuz King David was coming to kill everything moving. - David said, Blessed be thy advice, and blessed be thou, which hast kept me this day from coming to shed blood. The Lord put the spirit on her, she spoke eloquently, and he changed his mind. This is why it's important for women to know how to speak, when to speak, and how to speak. - She told Nabal nothing till the morning light, cuz he was drunk; when the wine was gone out of him and she told him, his heart died within him, and about ten days after, the Lord smote Nabal that he died. Sometimes you got to let God handle your beef. Like with the SPLC, the Lord is going to return their wickedness on their own head. - David sent and communed with Abigail, to take her to him to wife, and she bowed herself and said, let thine handmaid be a servant to wash the feet of the servants of my lord. Even attached to a wicked man, she still was in a place of humility. Some of you are not wicked; you're getting the title because of who you're attached to. Read your Bible and make your decision; draw your strength from the scripture. Ezra 9:12-15 2:31:16 - Video shown in class: a compilation of people who bragged about abandoning their own people to marry into another race and came to violent ends, with the commentary: go date outside of your race if you're entitled to, but the type of person that disrespects their own race to uplift another is the worst type of person. - Give not your daughters unto their sons, neither take their daughters unto your sons: that's the law. Nor seek their peace or their wealth for ever, that ye may be strong: that's how you're strong, by staying within your own nation. When you stick with your own people, you strengthen your race; when you go and sleep with another nation, you weaken yourself and your race. - Should we again break thy commandments, and join in affinity with the people of these abominations? When you abandon your nation, that's an abomination. Wouldest not thou be angry with us till thou hadst consumed us? God will create bad conditions for you and judgment will come your way. Proverbs 14:1 2:34:38 - Every wise woman buildeth her house: but the foolish plucketh it down with her hands. Wisdom is according to the commandments. A foolish woman is going to use her own hands to find her own man and do her own thing; she ain't going to listen to what the scriptures say. Proverbs 11:16 2:35:06 - A gracious woman retaineth honour: and strong men retain riches. The way strong men do things to keep their riches, a gracious woman will retain her honor, and her honor is dependent on her being obedient to God's laws. Ecclesiasticus 7:19 2:35:32 - Forgo not a wise and good woman: for her grace is above gold. When you have a wise woman according to the scriptures, the grace God has bestowed upon her is more valuable than gold. Proverbs 12:4 2:36:01 - A virtuous woman is a crown to her husband: but she that maketh ashamed is as rottenness in his bones. Video played in class: a married woman announcing that she hates men, that her marriage is not patriarchal but matriarchal, that it's a girl's world and her husband just lives in it, and that women deciding to decenter men entirely is something she applauds. I just wanted y'all to know that women like this exist, and the video got a lot of likes. Only a weak man lets a woman come and say that; some of you men are married to strong independent women cuz you're weak, and they control how you think. Proverbs 31:10-15 2:42:06 - Who can find a virtuous woman? Cuz there's no more of them; it's these strong independent women now. For her price is far above rubies: if you find a woman that matches what virtue is, value her. - The heart of her husband doth safely trust in her: you men that got women that want to keep these commandments, that's value God said is far above rubies, so don't mistreat them. - She worketh willingly with her hands: because she's not there for a payday, to live off the man. She riseth also while it is yet night, and giveth meat to her household: she's concerned with being the way God designed her to be, a good wife to her husband and a caretaker of the home. This is what we need to instill in our women and bring that back. Wisdom of Solomon 4:1-6 2:44:02 - Some of you women don't have kids or a husband, and people make you feel like you're nothing. Better it is to have no children, and to have virtue: for the memorial thereof is immortal, because it is known with God and with men. You could be a woman with no kids and no husband and still have your virtue; that's going to get you the kingdom. Some of you are single for a reason; don't rush into a relationship cuz you see other people in one. - When it is present, men take example at it; and when it is gone, they desire it: they see you're a woman of God. It weareth a crown, and triumpheth for ever: you're going to get eternal life when you do things right. It's a victory to say, I haven't found the right person, so I'm going to stay celibate and keep my virtue. - But the multiplying brood of the ungodly shall not thrive, nor take deep rooting from bastard slips: you'll have women that say, I don't need no man, and they got a whole bunch of kids and no man. Though they flourish in branches for a time, standing not fast, they shall be shaken with the wind: when life hits and trials come, those kids fall, cuz a sure foundation is a loving husband and a loving wife. - For children begotten of unlawful beds are witnesses of wickedness against their parents in their trial: even what they call in vitro with strange DNA from a sperm bank, taking another man's seed and not caring where it came from, that's not according to God. Ecclesiasticus 4:10 2:50:31 - This is for you women in this truth that are single mothers, not by choice or because you didn't know the truth. I'm not tearing you down; I was tearing down the strong independent woman that says, I don't need no man, I can raise these kids by myself. - Be as a father unto the fatherless, and instead of an husband unto their mother: so shalt thou be as the son of the most High. The righteous men in this truth are thinking like this: be role models to the children that don't have a man of God in their life. Let the men groom your children so they'll be successful serving God and won't be a statistic. Don't just think, I need to find a baby daddy; if it happens, fine, but that should not be the first thing on your mind. And you men should not be trying to take advantage of the women that are single mothers. Proverbs 31:30 2:52:17 - Favour is deceitful, and beauty is vain: but a woman that feareth the Lord, she shall be praised. In the world you may get favor because of your beauty, but it's deceitful, and your beauty is vanity cuz eventually you're going to get old. A woman that feareth the Lord shall be praised till the day that she dies. - A lot of these strong independent women on social media, everything is about their body and all they want is attention. But the woman of God is praised because of her attributes of God. 1 Peter 3:3-4 2:53:25 - Whose adorning let it not be that outward adorning: don't lead with your looks. It's nothing wrong with looking nice, but don't lead with that. - But let it be the hidden man of the heart: that's what this ministry is for, to bring out the attributes of Christ. He's hidden in your heart, and that's where you need to start. In that which is not corruptible, even the ornament of a meek and quiet spirit: your strength is in the wisdom of God and having a meek and quiet spirit, not tearing up a McDonald's or pulling guns in a store or arguing with men in the street. - Even if your beauty fades or you get old in this truth, God is going to restore it back to you. You can't get that in the world; the world's industry destroys women with surgery after surgery chasing a manufactured standard of beauty. Ecclesiasticus 36:22-23 2:57:10 - The beauty of a woman cheereth the countenance, and a man loveth nothing better: that's why we encourage our women to look your best. Look your best, but don't lead with that; the primary thing you should lead with is the hidden man of the heart. - Bishop: the stipulation is in verse 23. If there be kindness, meekness, and comfort in her tongue, then is not her husband like other men: it's the way she talks to her husband that makes the beauty stand out. Her husband is going to be happy; he's not going to be the brother sitting in the car for half an hour before he goes in the house after work, or staying out cuz he don't want to come home. Ezekiel 13:17-21 3:03:10 - Some people will be mad that we pull these scriptures out and give these examples, but this is what God ordained us to do. Set thy face against the daughters of thy people, which prophesy out of their own heart, and prophesy thou against them: what they're doing is of their own heart; it's not of God. Tell them what God says about how a good wife is supposed to be, how a marriage is supposed to be, how a woman is supposed to speak. You women of God, this shows you that you're in the right place to receive God's grace. - Woe to the women that sew pillows to all armholes, to hunt souls: there are women that hunt souls. They're not trying to bring people to the Lord; they hunt souls for their own goal. Will ye pollute me among my people for handfuls of barley and for pieces of bread? These strong women will pollute the teachings of God for their own benefit, and set the wrong example that lines other women up for destruction. - Behold, I am against your pillows, and I will tear them from your arms, and will let the souls go: how? With us teaching the right doctrine, freeing our people from these evil examples of what strong is supposed to be. - And ye shall know that I am the Lord: you're going to find out who God is when his men are raised up before you, teaching against the things America has taught you and against these lying religious denominations. Isaiah 13:12-15 3:08:07 - I will make a man more precious than fine gold: that's happening now, cuz we got the scriptures in our soul. The scriptures tell you of 144,000 new leaders; God is raising up new men, and he cannot bring the destruction until he's made these new men more precious than fine gold. - They shall every man turn to his own people, and flee every one into his own land: that's what you're seeing now, a division of the races, and everybody going to their right places. As Israelites we got to return back to the Lord. - Every one that is found shall be thrust through: when this prophecy unfolds, you better make sure you're on the right side. Isaiah 32:9-17 3:10:09 - Rise up, ye women that are at ease; hear my voice, ye careless daughters: you strong independent women, God says you're careless, and you're not listening to God's voice. - Many days and years shall ye be troubled: although it looks like it's all good, judgment is coming to this earth. Tremble, ye women that are at ease: right now you're relaxed cuz you think you ain't going to get taxed. - Strip you, and make you bare, and gird sackcloth upon your loins: stop holding on to the way America made you, and take the word of God to save you. Humble yourself. - Until the spirit be poured upon us from on high: this is what's happening to us; God is pouring out his spirit upon us. Then judgment shall dwell in the wilderness, and righteousness remain in the fruitful field: that's the purpose of our ministry. In Closing Okay, we're going to end it here; I didn't realize the time. All praises to the Most High. I'm glad y'all was able to let me speak with y'all and go over the scriptures. Your strength is in the wisdom of God: keeping his commandments, following his ways, and having a meek and quiet spirit. That's what strong is. Announcements & References Clubhouse: every day except the Sabbath day the brothers run the room Biblical Smoke on the Clubhouse app; come in and ask any question you want, one on one. There are copycat rooms, so make sure it's the right one. The room stops at 12:00 noon and continues as Upload God's Laws. Spanish speakers, join La Biblia en Fuego. Rebroadcasts play on the Israelite Social YouTube page. Field reports played from the worldwide missions, where the men remembered the Passover abroad: - Mission 192, Sierra Leone, led by Captain Young and Captain Komrabai Fania. - Mission 196, Suriname, led by Captain Jeroham: preaching village to village by boat, and visiting the prison where the slaves were held. - Mission 198, Jamaica, led by Captain Harrib and Captain Michael. - Mission 199, Netherlands, led by Captain Enoch, with brothers from IUIC Spain, Belgium, Germany, and the Netherlands; they remembered Passover, deliverance from captivity. - Mission 200, Barbados, led by Captain Kemuel: you Bajans, this is your identity; you are the twelve tribes of Israel. - Mission 206, Lagos, Nigeria, led by Captain Sevaris and Captain Beniah. - Mission 207, breaking ground in Zambia, led by Deacon Ithon, Captain Gadalia, and Captain Yehoshua. - Mission 208, Papua New Guinea, led by Captain Hezekiah and Captain Joel: a brother came on the Sabbath, came back closing the Passover, and joined the work. - Mission 211, St. George, Grenada, led by Captain Gad. - Mission 214, Nairobi, Kenya, led by Captain Amaziah. - Mission 215, South Africa, led by Deacon Abiel, Captain Sham, and Captain Mattathias: keeping the Lord's feast according to the law, with the lamb without blemish from Exodus 12:5. - Mission 217, Cameroon, led by Captain Gideon. - Mission 224, Zanzibar, led by Bishop Kena, Captain Shamaya, and Captain Yuri. - Mission 226, Monrovia, Liberia, led by the general Bishop Nathaniel, Bishop Ya'ohshai, Deacon Isaac, Deacon Malachi, Captain Azanell, Captain Yo'el, and Captain Uriel. - While in the Congo visiting a prison, led by Captain Hosiah, the prophets gave out free haircuts, free water, and free bread: not only the bread of life, but the physical as well. Original Royalty: the third single from Solomon and the Jews' album Un Trapped premieres tonight, Love for My People featuring Amos, only on Original Royalty. The Original Royalty Heritage jackets are selling out; some sizes already gone at originalroyalty.com. Closing reading: 1 Corinthians 11:23-29, the bread and the cup, in remembrance of the Lord's death till he come; let a man examine himself. --- Class Notes Index Transcript: full session

title: CALLED TO JUDGE: COMMANDED TO BE JUST
text: Introduction Shalom, Israel. Happy Sabbath, happy new moon. Last week we finished celebrating Passover. You know how we do Passover: Messiah God sent us all over the world to keep Passover with our people, our brothers and sisters. Captains went to Tanzania and Zanzibar, to Kenya; I was in Liberia. This Passover we got a lot of new officers: rank ups, soldiers made officers of 10, officers of 10 up to 20 and 50, newly captains. What I want you to understand is that those positions come with very heavy consequences and responsibilities. How does the scripture go? To whom much is given, much is required. When you got this position, do not take it lightly. Some of you do not understand what you stepping into. And keep in mind, old age doesn't mean you got wisdom; it just means you got old age. We got young men in the midst who got more wisdom than the old age. The Most High is not looking at your old age. When you become an officer, you are a judge. You go to the courthouse, you go in front of a judge: nobody has more power in that courthouse than the judge. Whatever you say goes; based on what you say, you can destroy or you can build. That's what you were called to be. You were not called to just sit here; you were called to be a judge. However, being a judge, you are also commanded to be just. That's why I call it Called to Judge, Commanded to Be Just. You cannot be a wicked judge. Some of you accept the position to be a judge, but you do not accept the command to be just. Scriptures Opened Deuteronomy 1:12-17 12:16 - How can I myself alone bear your cumbrance, and your burden, and your strife? Cumbrance refers to a burden, hindrance, obstacle, or source of trouble. Moses was saying, I cannot do this alone, because there are too many of you. Bishop alone cannot bear it; Bishop cannot do this alone. So what did they do? He appointed deacons, captains, officers of 90, 80, 60, 50, 20, 10, then down to soldiers. - Soldiers are not part of leadership. It's called soldier for a reason: soldier prepares you to be a leader, to be a judge. A soldier is supposed to take counsel from an officer, not from another soldier, because that officer is supposed to build him and prepare him to be an officer, to be a judge. - Take you wise men: a judge must be wise. A stupid judge will destroy everything. That's why you must know the scriptures. If you a judge and you don't know the scriptures, you will eventually become a traitor. - And understanding: a judge must have understanding of the scriptures. - And known among your tribes: a judge must be known. That is talking about reputation. Nobody just leaves law school and becomes a judge; some wait for years before they can be appointed. Before a president appoints a judge, he must know that judge's background, his reputation, and the cases he has been judging, because we got corrupt judges. And some of you are corrupt. We cannot have corrupt men ruling us. - Your reputation is how you deal with your wife, how you deal with your children, how you deal with the brother that sits next to you, your reputation in the congregation, and your reputation in your workplace. You must be wise here and at home, not just here. You cannot be a judge in Israel but carry a whole different spirit at your workplace, hanging with the wicked crowd after work. That means you faking it somewhere, and more than likely you faking it here, cuz your spirit agrees with out there. You only a judge when you among us, but in the streets you that same old person. You wasting your time, and do not think the Most High don't see you. - And I will make them rulers over you. Why would he use that word rulers? To rule something means you got power over it. Some of you officers of 10: are you ready to rule 10 men? Can you even rule yourself? Can you rule your own household? - Some of you are way too emotional. A ruler cannot be emotional. Any little thing, you feel offended: he told me I got to tuck my pants in my boots, I'm going to use Matthew 18 against this captain. You too emotional. A judge cannot be emotional. - Captains over thousands, captains over hundreds, captains over fifties, captains over tens, and officers among your tribes: those are judges. If you an officer of 10, you should be able to lead 10 men with no problem. If you're a captain of 100, you should be able to lead 100 men with no problem. And an officer of 10 should mentor with the man he wants to become like: the officer of 20 is the only one who can help you become that. Some of you used to be in the military and understand the ranking system, but when you come into the Most High God's military, you have no idea. - Expand your mind. We just traveled all over the continent of Africa, all over the Caribbean, South America, Europe, for Passover. Some camps have hundreds of men. Imagine you end up in one of those places: can you lead those 100 men? Be honest with yourself. Those brothers and sisters are not asking; they are going to look at you like that's the man that the bishop sent. You're the representation of the bishop, the deacons, the captains. When they see you come over there and they're confused by the way you move, they know something is wrong, and it's because of your lack of study. They're going to assume you've been around Bishop, you've been around deacons, you're the man; but then you get there and it's a totally different story. - And I charged your judges at that time: you notice after mentioning officers, he says judges, because that's what they are. - Hear the causes between your brethren, and judge righteously. Some of you are not judging righteously. To judge righteously you must be just, not partial. Some of you want the position to destroy brothers. - Ye shall not respect persons in judgment; ye shall hear the small as well as the great: you got to hear both sides, the small matter and the great matter. - Ye shall not be afraid of the face of man. You are not here to be loved, to be liked. You're judges. Some of you are afraid to make a decision because you afraid of what that man is going to think of you. You ain't here to make friends. This is why some of you are going to find yourself out of here: because when judgment happens to your friend, you're going to get offended. What does that have to do with you? There were judgments handled during Passover, and some people who weren't even there got offended at the judgment, not knowing what even happened. You have got to be crazy to be offended about something you have no idea what happened. - Don't be afraid of men. Your fear is supposed to be toward the Most High, not those men. For the judgment is God's. - And the cause that is too hard for you, bring it unto me, and I will hear it. Leaders, read that again slowly. You might have a situation where, to judge a matter, you don't know what to do. Don't just wing it. That decision you make can destroy somebody. There is nothing wrong with reaching out to a deacon, a captain, an officer higher ranking than you, and asking how you think I should judge this matter. Don't just make a decision where you're not sure, because your decision can destroy somebody. And when the time comes, we don't want to hear, my bad. A judge doesn't say, my bad. - Something you might not know: in the judge's chambers there are books on the wall, and those books have old cases. Your case might have the same case from 20 years ago. This is why the judge says, I'll be back with my decision. Some lawyers and prosecutors base their case on old cases. Where am I going with this? A judge is not always right. This is why they keep records, old records, so they can make the decision the right way. Some of you got a bishop in your camp, a captain in your camp, high ranking officers in your camp, and what did you do? You hide from them. These men are supposed to be your old records. And you know where you find the old records? The scriptures. Those are our records. When you ask Bishop a question, Bishop never gives you his opinion; he goes to the old records and makes them new to you. Where do you find the prophecies? In the old records. Precepts: - James 2:1 Have not the faith of our Lord Jesus Christ, the Lord of glory, with respect of persons. - James 2:4 The respect of persons goes into having a certain type of man in admiration over another, preferring one over another, and it shows in how you deal with matters with that brother. You are ready to have men's persons in admiration because of advantage: there's something you're going to gain by showing favoritism. And the end result: you are become judges of evil thoughts. Some brothers are horrible judges because there's something about the person they should judge that they can gain from them: they give you gifts, they're your ride to Sabbath, they got you a job. Now you are partial in your judgment because of what that person can provide for you. The Lord said that's an evil thing. - James 2:9 We always hear thou shalt not kill, thou shalt not steal; we know those like the back of our hand. But it says if you have respect to persons, you commit sin, and are convinced of the law as transgressors. You are breaking the commandments of God. You want the position, but there is much required from you in the position as judges. You must judge righteous judgment, whether it's your friend or not. You're in a position of leadership: you cannot conceal your friend's folly. They have the greatest respect for you; show the same respect to them. These people love us. Some of them say, I wish you guys didn't have to leave. Shout out to the brothers and sisters in Belize for the great hospitality, to the bishops, deacons, captains, and officers who traveled, and to everyone who donated fringes and supported through the Booster Club: your help goes a lot further than many of you could even imagine. The schools we visit need generators, air conditioning, and basic supplies, and we cannot do it without y'all. Keep in mind: we are only weak when we are alone. When we unify, nothing can break us. A closing video played: they broke me, took everything from me; and pain is what made me stronger. They thought they could destroy me, but all they did was create something they now fear. Thus saith the Lord: I am a lion. When you travel, wake up your people; that's how you got to think, because we are lions. --- Class Notes Index Transcript: full session

title: JUDE 1:16
text: Introduction Let's give it up to the most high God for another Sabbath day, and for a successful worldwide blitz. Everybody can't do that. The Most High is moving in the earth, and if you ain't noticed, you better wake up and hop on the train, cuz it's full steam ahead. Today's topic is Jude 1:16. When we speak of Jude 1:16, what are we talking about? Murmuring, busybodies, gossiping. Folks that just can't mind their own business. There's so much peace in not knowing things that don't pertain to you. You don't realize the tranquility you could be in, not knowing all the messed up stuff that goes on in people's lives. Let me tell you something about these type of classes: the people who are in the midst of murmuring, gossiping, complaining, being busybodies, talebearing, for some reason never come to the understanding during the class that this is about me. You know what they doing? I wonder who Deacon talking about. I wonder what done happened. Completely missing the point. Scriptures Opened Romans 15:4 11:07 - This is why we here, why we're taking notes, why we must continue to study, pray, fast, and apply what the Lord told us in the scriptures. Cuz without that, what are we doing? - I don't know how many times we got to go into the Bible to show our people a mistake that somebody else made that they made, and they have no idea it's even in there. This historical book, this book of advice, this book of laws, statutes, and commandments is going to tell you exactly what you need to do, and it's also going to give you warning so that you don't make those mistakes. As well as tell you what's going to happen to those who continue to make these same mistakes. - The Bible is the most important book on the planet. You better act like it. Romans 1:18-32 13:28 - Some of y'all going to be like, Deacon, why you starting way back there? Just watch. - The wrath of God is revealed from heaven against all ungodliness and unrighteousness of men. You cannot say you didn't know what your behaviors are going to pay off for. You won't be able to say you were unaware that you didn't know it was wrong. When you continue to do it after we go over this, just know you deserve whatever happens afterwards. - The invisible things of him from the creation of the world are clearly seen. You see these things plain as day, so that they are without excuse. I don't care how many big words a man puts together: if you have not come to the conclusion that we were created and we need to do what the creator told us to do, you are far behind civilization. - They became vain in their imaginations. What did these people start to do in their imaginations? Whatever they wanted to do. The Lord said, forsake not the assembling of yourselves together. Man, forget the book, I'mma do it my way. That's what people do. - Professing themselves to be wise, they became fools. Cuz you think you know something. You think you got a bright idea, your way's the better way. - They changed the glory of the uncorruptible God into an image, and worshipped and served the creature more than the Creator. Whether it be yourself, some made-up god, mother nature, or science: you gave all the credit of creation to a molten image. - For this cause God gave them up unto vile affections. These idol worshipers, these people in their imaginations, went against nature; men with men, working that which is unseemly. The Bible calls it unseemly, but you say it's love. In your own imagination. - God gave them over to a reprobate mind. Reprobates are the type of person that can't get right; they're seared with a hot iron, they think they know it all, they can't change. - Being filled with all unrighteousness: fornication, wickedness, covetousness, maliciousness, full of envy, murder, debate, deceit, malignity, whisperers. Wait a minute. Whisperers. What is a whisperer? You murmuring, you gossiping, all behind the scenes, with certain individuals. You know what you call them? Your friends. - Backbiters. You mean to tell me they're in the same category with men with men, murderers, covetousness, fornication? You are the equivalent to a hater of God, all because you can't control your mouth. - Who knowing the judgment of God, that they which commit such things are worthy of death. Worthy of death. Whispering? Backbiting? Jude 1:16 24:00 - These are murmurers, complainers, walking after their own lusts. They think they're God's greatest gift on earth, and that things should be done the way that they think it should be done, or protocols should be how they think they should be. - Do y'all realize how many systems can come under criticism? I can criticize any system, any program, any structure, any order set. I can sit back and say, that shouldn't be done like this. Any system. So what type of person are you really? Ask yourself this. - You know the individuals in the congregation that can't keep their mouth closed. They're always complaining about something, gossiping about something, always involved in some mess. Why? Cuz they can't control their mouth. 2 Timothy 3:1-3 25:16 - We were warned. This know also, that in the last days perilous times shall come. For men shall be lovers of their own selves, covetous, boasters, proud. - Y'all know what that prideful spirit does? That prideful spirit won't allow you to take any correction. It won't allow you to accept what is being said. That prideful spirit will have you thinking it is everybody but you. - Despisers of those that are good: some people just hate the fact that you doing what you supposed to do. That you are above them in rank, that you have more time to put in for the truth and you are active in the body. Therefore they hate everything you put out. Every time you turn around, they got a suggestion. Nobody asked you. But what do they do? They don't say nothing to you; they tell everybody underneath you. All your peers know how they feel. - That's the type of people you don't know for exhorting anybody. You only know them for bringing problems about everything they see, but they lack exhortation in any form. Precepts: - Ecclesiasticus 11:7 You cannot accuse, you cannot blame, until you have seen all that needs to be seen concerning a matter. You look foolish when you do this without understanding what's going on. Your opinion, if it lacks understanding, if it lacks the pertinent information that needs to be used in order to explain what's going on, but you feel necessary to give that opinion, something is wrong with you. You've been put in many situations that have shown you: yeah, you jumped the gun. But yet and still, you feel your opinion matters. It don't. Understand first, and then rebuke. Leviticus 19:16-17 29:54 - I want the law. Thou shalt not go up and down as a talebearer among thy people. You realize these are the laws of God. This is what God said not to do. - To go up and down as a talebearer is going up and down telling people's business. You got the inside scoop. How is it that you know everything that's going on all the time? How does all information filter through you? Some folks be knowing before leadership know. Some of y'all talk too much. - Neither shalt thou stand against the blood of thy neighbour: that's bearing false witness. If you were bearing false witness to have your neighbor stoned, you were going to be in the blood. The Lord told you not to do that. - Thou shalt not hate thy brother in thine heart. Understand what type of hatred it is for a person to be a gossiper, a talebearer, a busybody. You're the reason why things continue to happen, why people's reputation continues to get scarred, why people are continuously at odds with one another. You are the fuel behind it. Why? Cuz you can't shut up. It's you. You keep it going. Psalms 101:1-8 33:18 - To behave wisely in a perfect way means you apply the laws of God. You read what is written and you do what it says. The laws are the apple of your heart. This is how you're supposed to conduct yourself, how you treat your neighbor, how you treat your brother. - I will set no wicked thing before mine eyes: this person got their mind right. I hate the work of them that turn aside from the laws of God, the way of the Most High. I will not know a wicked person: I am not going to put myself around wicked people. - Whoso privily slandereth his neighbour, him will I cut off. You privately slandering; you got some slick, ill things to say about your neighbor. Get away from me. Ask yourself: why do you have to privately do it? - He that telleth lies shall not tarry in my sight. When you don't know what you're talking about and you don't have the whole story, yet you telling it like you know what's going on, and it's not true, do you know what that's called? Oh, you thought you was exempt. It's a lie. Whether you believe it or not, it's a lie. - A sensible Israelite in Christ will read that and do what? Hide himself from the evil. I don't want my name in the hat of those people that are gossipers and murmurers. I'm going to move far away from anybody that is like this. That's what you say, until it comes out that your friend's a gossiper. How do people look at you now? That's her friend. That's his boy. He must have been talking to him. - We have to get this murmuring spirit far away from us. It is not productive to the body. It's not making you stronger in spirit, it's not going to take you to the next level, it's not going to benefit you in any way, shape, or form. So why do it? - Video played on handling complainers at work: don't come to me with just a complaint; present your solution to me. That's the same thing that distinguishes murmuring from not in the truth: is there a solution? And you don't give your solution to the people that can't implement the solution; you give it to the people that can implement it. - You know how many folks will sit up and complain about some stuff and have absolutely no idea how to fix it or what to do to make it better? But they just feel so good about saying how wrong it is. Where is that going to get us? It doesn't help. So stop. - Reading shared in class from a question on the psychology of complainers: people who like to complain do not need solutions; they need problems. If you solve their problem, you are undermining their ability to complain, which irritates them. Complainers need listeners, not problem-solvers. - And it's heavy: the person that's listening to the complaining, you ain't no better. You're complicit. You are essentially a part of the problem. All complainers need an ear. That's you. 1 Corinthians 10:10 41:20 - Neither murmur ye, as some of them also murmured, and were destroyed of the destroyer. Y'all know what he's speaking about. Write these examples down so you can jog your memory when you get the feeling like you want to complain about something, when you got a problem with something that's been set up. Exodus 15:22-26 41:50 - The history up to this point: they were serving hard bondage as slaves in Egypt. Out of nowhere the Most High brought Moses to deliver them. They saw the water turn to blood throughout the land. They seen plagues drop on the Egyptians and not them. They literally witnessed the power of God show that all them Egyptian gods was nothing and that he was the one true God. God killed the firstborn of everyone who did not have the blood on the posts of their doors. They walked up out of Egypt with gold and jewelry, everything the Egyptians that was oppressing them had. The Lord split the Red Sea for them; they walked in between two waters to safety and the Egyptians got swallowed up behind them. They seen all of this miraculous power happen, and then they got to the wilderness talking about, I'm thirsty. - How? You get to the wilderness after you done seen all this power, and now you worried about water, like the Lord don't know you need something to drink? - The people murmured against Moses, saying, What shall we drink? And the Lord showed him a tree, which when he had cast into the waters, the waters were made sweet. There he proved them. - If thou wilt diligently hearken to the voice of the Lord thy God, and wilt do that which is right in his sight, and give ear to his commandments, and keep all his statutes, I will put none of these diseases upon thee, which I have brought upon the Egyptians: for I am the Lord that healeth thee. Exodus 16:2-3 45:29 - After they complained, after they murmured, guess what God did? All right, here's some water. Here you go. And the whole congregation still murmured against Moses and Aaron in the wilderness. - Would to God we had died by the hand of the Lord in the land of Egypt. You telling me this is the same people that saw the sun literally get removed, darkness come upon the whole land but in one spot? This is the same folks talking about I wish I would have died in Egypt? How does that happen? We a rebellious people is how. - Think about this, y'all. Imagine leaving Babylon, and we get out there to the wilderness and they up there talking about, man, I wish I would have just died. I could eat fast food every day when I was in America. The point is: imagine seeing all the powers come to an end, and you complaining, talking about you wish you would have died so you could stay and eat. What type of person are you? You was a murmurer. It's in your soul. You get over there talking about the bugs, the flies. You are so far from the understanding of what God has put in front of you. Exodus 16:8-12 49:14 - Your murmurings are not against us, but against the Lord. Moses is giving them the reality of the fact. You're complaining about how things are done; you're not murmuring against leadership, it's against God. There's a reason why protocols are put in place. Every protocol that was put in place was for a time; look at the Old Covenant, put in place until something else was to come. - You going to complain? You got a problem with it? The best thing for you to do in that situation is to shut up. That's the safest thing to do, especially if you know the history of what happens to complainers, murmurers, and gossipers. - The Lord said, I have heard the murmurings of the children of Israel. He heard all the complaints. At even ye shall eat flesh, and in the morning ye shall be filled with bread. What, you mean God don't show mercy? After all that, the Lord showed mercy again. Exodus 17:2-6 51:39 - The people did chide with Moses and murmured, saying, Wherefore is this that thou hast brought us up out of Egypt, to kill us and our children and our cattle with thirst? Same thing. You came to kill us, Moses? Knowing good and well that ain't it. - That's what complainers do. They put them crazy scenarios out to make you feel a certain type of way, to make you feel bad, or to get you to do what they want you to do. - Moses cried unto the Lord: they be almost ready to stone me. And the Lord said, smite the rock, and there shall come water out of it. The Lord yet again showed mercy. Numbers 14:1-4 53:17 - All the congregation lifted up their voice and cried, and the children of Israel murmured against Moses and against Aaron: would God that we had died in the land of Egypt. Same thing again. Now, mind you, who are they saying this to? God. - And they said one to another, Let us make a captain, and let us return into Egypt. Them imaginations. Let's set up our own leader and go back to Egypt. Numbers 14:26-32 54:32 - How long shall I bear with this evil congregation? Wait a minute. The Lord, yes, he runs out of patience too. He was patient when they asked for water. He was patient when they asked for food. He gave it to them, but that wasn't good enough. What did Israel continue to do? Complain, complain, complain. - As truly as I live, saith the Lord, as ye have spoken in mine ears, so will I do to you. Okay, keep on asking for it then. I would to God we had died in Egypt; I would to God we had died in the wilderness. What he say? So will I do to you. - Your carcases shall fall in this wilderness; all that were numbered of you, from twenty years old and upward, which have murmured against me. Now he getting real specific. Doubtless ye shall not come into the land, save Caleb the son of Jephunneh, and Joshua the son of Nun. But your little ones, which ye said should be a prey, them will I bring in, and they shall know the land which ye have despised. - The simple right now is saying, well, how did they despise the land? They just wanted water and food. You don't bite the hand that feeds you. The same hand that's going to give you that land, you had better make sure you taking care of business and doing what that hand wants you to do. If you murmur, complain, talebear, gossip, guess what's going to happen? The Lord said he going to kill you. Oh, y'all thought it was a game. Psalms 106:1-27 57:28 - Give thanks unto the Lord, for he is good: for his mercy endureth for ever. Have we not read about the Lord's mercy? Is the Lord not merciful? Oh yes, he is. And we need it. Why? Cuz we rebellious as all get out. - Blessed are they that keep judgment, and he that doeth righteousness at all times. This has to be you full-time. Right now, is anybody murmuring? You got to keep that energy whenever you leave, when class is over, when nobody's looking, or when you with your best friend, that person you feel comfortable with. That's when it counts. - Our fathers understood not thy wonders in Egypt; they remembered not the multitude of thy mercies. They forgot all of it. Is that us now? Are we forgetting? Did we forget how patient the Lord is and how much patience he's shown each and every one of us? - He rebuked the Red Sea also, and it was dried up. Y'all remember these people saw that. They were there. Y'all remember it says where they was walking the grass was green; it was dry land, like it was made for that moment. - Then believed they his words; they sang his praise. They soon forgat his works. They waited not for his counsel: they was hasty. I need it now, now, now. But lusted exceedingly in the wilderness, and tempted God in the desert. And he gave them their request, but sent leanness into their soul. This came with a price. - They envied Moses also in the camp, and Aaron the saint of the Lord. What were they doing? They despised order. They despised structure. Murmurers, complainers. The earth opened and swallowed up Dathan, and covered the company of Abiram, and the flame burned up the wicked. There was a lesson to be learned in the wilderness. Have we not learned yet? - They made a calf in Horeb, and worshipped the molten image. Right after they came out of all this great tribulation: these be the gods that delivered thee from Egypt? You just made that golden calf. That golden calf needed you to be born. That goes back to Romans 1: your imagination is powerful. It'll have you thinking you can sense things and see things and do things unbiblical. - They forgat God their saviour, which had done great things in Egypt, wondrous works in the land of Ham. The Egyptians were Hamites, black folks; the same Nilotes you see in Africa today. - Therefore he said that he would destroy them. Why? Because of murmuring, complaining, their imaginations, serving other gods. Had not Moses his chosen stood before him in the breach, to turn away his wrath. He was ready to get rid of everybody. - They believed not his word, but murmured in their tents. That's where it all happens. Listen, when you go home, ask yourself. Brothers, these your wives hear you complaining. Some of y'all complain to your wives about leadership, and then you turn around and wonder why your wife ain't subject to you. You don't respect order; why she going to respect order? You buck at every order you get, and you wonder why your house is out of order. - Therefore he lifted up his hand against them, to overthrow them in the wilderness, to overthrow their seed also among the nations, and to scatter them in the lands. - Video played on handling complainers: when somebody complains to you, make them keep going and get it all out, then empower them with solutions. What solution do you have so far? How do you propose to resolve this? You're teaching them ways to solve it themselves. - When a person that's a complainer is bombarded with the solution, you'll find out real quick they don't really want the solution. They feel good talking about it; they want to vent about it. Well, I'm not the person for that. I'm here about the solution. Let's fix it and be done with it. You pull all the traction from underneath their tires. Now you hold them to that solution: go talk to them, and let me know what they say, cuz I'm going to ask them if you asked them about it. Complainers don't want to deal with the problem; they just feel comfortable complaining. - A lot of times they do this to empower themselves, to make you believe that they have the answers, or that they should be sought out for counsel by the leadership. No. Everything needs to be done decently and in order. Don't empower these folks. - These folks that are complainers have far deeper issues than you could even imagine. There's a reason why they're so worried about what somebody else is doing. - They're not going to murmur to me; they're not going to murmur to the captains. Who they going to come to? You folks in the back. They going to come to you sisters that ain't particularly involved in anything, or they going to search for those familiar spirits. If you have that spirit of gossiping, wanting to know what's going on, all into somebody else's business, guess what? They going to locate you. Satan going to find you. And you're going to be named amongst the murmurers and the complainers. You are the front line against this evil. Without you shutting it down, it's going to only grow. - Video played on the psychology of complaining: complaining is a form of emotional release; when people feel powerless or overwhelmed, the brain looks for ways to regain control. Some complain seeking validation; some because reality doesn't meet their expectations; some grew up in environments where complaining was a form of communication, and the brain learns that expressing dissatisfaction equals attention. And constant negativity is draining: being around a chronic complainer can make you start to complain too, because emotions are contagious. - Y'all all know somebody that wants to just dump their problems on you. Have any of y'all ever felt like this person is using me as a trash dump? Let me be very clear: I am not your recycling bin. I'm going to help you fix it, and we're going to be done. Now, there are people that are good at taking on your problems and sitting with you for hours; you have to know those individuals and locate them. That's different from somebody who is a murmurer. - We all better deal with murmuring swiftly, quickly, speedily, to shut it down. Don't let somebody come to you complaining about an officer and they're not ready to deal with that officer. You already messed up when you came to me, because I'm solution-based. You've told me; now you've got 24 hours to go tell so-and-so how you feel. Imagine if everybody was like that: the moment a murmurer stepped foot in here, every person they went to shut it down. That murmurer would be rehabilitated from murmuring forever, cuz they know they can't do it here. Proverbs 22:24-25 1:17:11 - Make no friendship with an angry man; and with a furious man thou shalt not go: lest thou learn his ways. A liar, a murmurer, we all fit in that same category if you rolling in that spirit. Don't be around these people. - Because those emotions transfer. That spirit transfers. The Bible is telling you, just like Romans 15:4 said, whatever is written is written for our learning. Stay away from these people. Stay away from that spirit. - Skits played in class showed the murmuring spirit in action: a brother going from listener to listener looking for cosigners about a judgment instead of dealing with it in order, and sisters murmuring against a new kitchen protocol from the bishops. Ladies, remember the wilderness. Proverbs 11:13 1:23:39 - A talebearer revealeth secrets: they talking about everybody's business. But he that is of a faithful spirit concealeth the matter. When it says a faithful spirit, it's letting you know what type of person, their character. - Brothers will hear judgment and all of a sudden think leadership don't know what they talking about. The week prior they are asking all the questions they can ask about Deuteronomy 28 and how to break this down. But the moment we give you judgment and tell you what the scriptures say, now we don't know what we talking about. - There are things about people in this room right now that I would never tell anybody about. Brothers have come to me and talked to me. What is the benefit in me telling you? You always evaluate: why share this information? What is the need, what is the necessity, why do they need to know, and how is it going to hurt the person that you're sharing this information about? - Video played: don't call my phone to gossip about nobody. That is the energy of the weak. Sitting around talking about others is the energy of the weak. Focus on your own so you can build. Worry about yourself and the kingdom that you're building. Proverbs 20:19 1:27:46 - He that goeth about as a talebearer revealeth secrets. These type of people tell your innermost darkest secrets. The stuff that you felt like you had to vent about, and you did it in confidence thinking that nobody was going to know, but you told the wrong person. A gossiper is going to tell someone. - And some of y'all know right now, after you've spoken to somebody and you see how they talk to you about everybody else's stuff, that your information ain't confidential. You're just waiting for it to come out. And that's scary. - Therefore meddle not with him that flattereth with his lips. These type of people try to get information out of you. You think they're trying to be helpful, be your counselor or something, but they're just trying to probe you for more information. Oh, you thought they were a listening ear. No. They want to know the tea. - Y'all realize there's some people that feel better about themselves and their lives by hearing the messed up things you're going through. Some people feed off that energy and feel good about their situation because they know somebody out here is suffering with whatever's going on. Meanwhile, I'm just searching for a solution; I need help. You can't go to a talebearer for help, y'all. Ecclesiasticus 19:6-8 1:29:49 - Rehearse not unto another that which is told unto thee, and thou shalt fare never the worse. This fundamental principle is unheard of to them. They don't understand the concept. They cannot abide by this. It's in them; they have to say something. - He that can rule his tongue shall live without strife. This is the type of person that's not caught up in the nonsense. They sit back and observe. They know that there's a time and a place for everything: a time to speak, and a time to be quiet. - He that hateth babbling shall have less evil. A person that babbles just feels they need to talk, rattling off at the mouth. You done told brothers everything that's going on in your household, and you wonder why they look at your wife like she got issues. You ran to them with everything she can't do right; meanwhile, you got everything else under the sun wrong with you, but you don't tell that part. Now brothers is looking at your wife a certain type of way based off the information that you've given them. - People who talk a lot are going to be the ones always caught up in the midst: why you say that, why are you telling this person this? Their names is going to be brought up constantly. - Whether it be to friend or foe, talk not of other men's lives. This is the type of character you supposed to possess. But a talebearer don't understand this rule of thumb. In their mind, I got to say something. 1 Peter 4:15 1:36:31 - Signs of a talebearer, first sign: they tell you other people's business. They're coming to you about somebody else's affairs. Once you've seen the flag, what do you need to do? Move around. And listen, you're supposed to make them feel uncomfortable. That is healthy in the body: making people who are talebearers, murmurers, gossipers feel uncomfortable, out of place, because it helps to stop that behavior. - Second sign: they always say, don't tell nobody I told you. Why? What's wrong? You know you about to say something out of order. Red flag: they already broke trust once, cuz they probably about to share somebody else's information. Gossipers can't hold no water. - Third sign: they fish for information, asking too many personal questions. These folks probe. They want to know all the details. Why? Cuz they ain't got nothing else to do. - Let none of you suffer as a murderer, or as a thief, or as an evildoer, or as a busybody in other men's matters. The same energy you have in making sure you not called a murderer, a thief, an evildoer: you don't want to be called a busybody. Nosy. If you have an issue with the title, you got to make sure you don't possess the behavior that is associated with a busybody. - Fourth sign: they thrive on drama. There are people who wake up and they need it. They wait on the drama, they grow in the drama. It makes them happy to know something that nobody else knows, like them soap operas; the suspense keeps you locked in. If there's something wrong with brothers, somehow you're always part of it. You're always the common denominator, every time. - They always know the mess. They are the central command of all problems and all issues. They are the TMZ of Israel in the body. They want to be the first to drop it: bro, did you hear about? Matthew 18:15-16 1:42:18 - Fifth sign: they talk about people, but never to the actual person. When you going to ask the golden question: did you talk to him, bro? As a man, you should feel uncomfortable speaking about a situation before you've dealt with that actual person. Sisters, same thing. - Now, there are times where people may go to their counselor because they might be thinking, I might be out of spirit or tripping. Let that be the basis of your conversation, and lead with: this is how I see it, this is what happened in my sight, I know they got a whole other story. That lets the person know right off the bat that you're coming from a neutral standpoint and you truly want to solve this problem. - Video played on a no-gossip policy: if someone is gossiping about another person, ask, have you told that person that yet? You have 24 hours to go to that individual and let them know, or else we'll go together and address them. There has to be accountability to end it with peace. - Moreover if thy brother shall trespass against thee, go and tell him his fault between thee and him alone. Is that not what Christ told us to do? You know how many issues you will alleviate if you just follow what Christ said? Boom, it's finished. - It don't say go and tell 10 people about what's going on so these 10 people can make you feel good about being right. Go to that person and deal with it. You don't need no audience. - You done told 20 people about what happened. Now them 20 people, if they're simple, are looking at this brother or this sister with a side eye. A lot of times, simple people don't understand that there is another side; they done came up with a whole conclusion on why this happened. It could have been one big confusion, a misunderstanding. But you wouldn't allow that. You need 20 people to cosign you first. Romans 1:32 1:45:14 - We read earlier about all those different spirits: whisperers, backbiters, haters of God. Watch what verse 32 says, cuz I think it went over a lot of people's heads. - They which commit such things are worthy of death: the whisperers, the backbiters. But watch this: not only do the same, but have pleasure in them that do them. It ain't just the ones doing the whispering and the backbiting. The ones that ain't saying nothing, just listening, being the ear to the murmurer and the complainer: you are taking pleasure in that. God said you're worthy of death as well. - So you ain't exempt. That's why you got to say something, because you give fuel to that murmurer and complainer. Psalms 12:1-2 1:47:22 - Sixth sign: they switch up depending on who's around.
