They'll say all types of stuff with you, and then the person walks in mid-sentence. Some of them stand bold in what they going to say, but some folks switch up: man, I really didn't understand it, I think we should just wait to hear what they got to say. Oh, hey, I didn't even see you there. Man, please. I spotted you. I see where you really at. - They speak vanity every one with his neighbour: with flattering lips and with a double heart do they speak. Double tongued. Don't let this be named amongst us. Ecclesiasticus 27:16-21 1:48:30 - Seventh sign: they can't keep confidential things confidential. They can't hold water. You can't tell them nothing or they going to tell everybody. You might as well have said it on the loudspeaker. - Whoso discovereth secrets loseth his credit, and shall never find friend to his mind. You will instantly lose credit, because now everybody knows he's a blabbermouth. That's why it makes it difficult for that person to make friends: they lack self-control. - Love thy friend, and be faithful unto him: faithful meaning when he's there with you and when he's not there with you. But if thou bewrayest his secrets, follow no more after him. You might as well let that person go, cuz to win them back again is damn near impossible. - As one that letteth a bird go out of his hand, so hast thou let thy neighbour go. The moment you let that bird out of your hand, the bird gone. Same as that friend whose secrets you told. - As for a wound, it may be bound up; and after reviling there may be reconcilement. How many of y'all fought your friends when you was young? Had a black eye and everything, and guess what? You cool, you let it go. But he that bewrayeth secrets is without hope. Bewray secrets and see what happens. Scripture says, let him go. - Like I said, that talebearer or that gossiper needs a listening ear, and some of y'all supply that for your neighbor. - Video played on people who never join in on gossip: psychology shows that people who avoid gossip tend to be emotionally intelligent. They know that the way someone speaks about others says more about them than anyone else in the room. They value trust; they understand that words once spoken can't be taken back; they prefer peace over drama, respect over attention, and integrity over momentary bonding. Ecclesiasticus 19:6 1:52:56 - You have to identify yourself. What does the scripture say? Examine yourselves, whether ye be in the faith; prove your own selves. Okay. Is this you? Be honest. - Do you find yourself on the phone talking to other people about things that's going on in this congregation or another congregation? About somebody in this congregation, and you ain't spoken to them about it, you ain't addressed it, you watched it happen and had nothing to say? But you have everything to say now that you're on the phone with somebody that has absolutely nothing to do with anything that's going on here. - Ask yourself: is this you? Cuz if it is, this is about you. And in order for it to stop, you have to recognize you. Be real with who you are, and stop. Otherwise you going to continue to have this ill name and continue to deal with the things you deal with. 1 Timothy 5:13 1:55:25 - This is talking about the younger widows. They learn to be idle, wandering about from house to house; and not only idle, but tattlers also and busybodies, speaking things which they ought not. - Brothers, you don't need to know everything. Some of you have been privileged to sit amongst leadership; you might be in the backyard and overhear a conversation. You would be a complete and utter idiot to utter anything you've heard, especially because it wasn't spoken to you; you just happened to be a fly on the wall. When leaders discuss certain things, we are coming to a solution to deal with it. If you're not dealing with it, you don't need the information. - Sisters, same thing. There's elder sisters and senior sisters that counsel, so certain information gets filtered, and they do discuss with each other because they're counseling to figure out how to help a person. That doesn't open up the door for you to think, oh, this is what we do, we're going to talk about sister so-and-so. There is a need-to-know basis. - I say this from a perspective for y'all: before I became a deacon, I didn't know anything, and Israel was so beautiful. Everything was so grand. You in the spirit: man, Christ going to come back any day now, we in this together. Then you get into a seat of leadership, and you find out about all the problems. Now things ain't so beautiful; the room got a lot darker. And I'm telling you, it was far better before you knew. - Stay in the place of not needing to know. I'm a deacon, and there's things that I don't ask about, cuz I don't want to know unless I have to know. There's things in other regions that I ain't got to be privy on, and I'm okay with that, cuz they got a whole deacon over there that's dealing with it. I trust he's handling his job. It's none of my business. Stop being so nosy. Leave it be. - Video played: nosy people may quickly say that they're your friend, or that they're trying to help you, or that you're being ungrateful. But really, they're just trying to protect their access to your life. Beware of them. Some people do it for alliance. 2 Thessalonians 3:11 2:01:30 - This has always been a problem. We hear that there are some which walk among you disorderly, working not at all, but are busybodies. - They ain't doing nothing. This is the type of people that got time to want to know about everything. They ain't got no business themselves; they're idle, like the scripture said earlier, wandering from house to house trying to get all the info. Proverbs 26:17 2:02:20 - Another word for it is meddling. Write that down. - He that passeth by, and meddleth with strife belonging not to him, is like one that taketh a dog by the ears. If you meddle around in strife, grabbing a dog by the ears is going to get you bit. - You over here being nosy, trying to be all in the Kool-Aid; you're going to mess around and get bit. What reaction did you think was going to happen? Now you're involved. You went around asking, and now: wait, he came to you and asked you? Why is this brother inquiring about this? Now you're in it. How about you just mind your business? Don't meddle in affairs that don't pertain to you. Ecclesiasticus 11:10 2:03:57 - My son, meddle not with many matters: for if thou meddle much, thou shalt not be innocent; and if thou follow after, thou shalt not obtain, neither shalt thou escape by fleeing. - Oh no, you're in it now. You wanted to know what the flavor of the Kool-Aid was; now you're making the Kool-Aid. It's all yours. All because you wanted to be in someone else's business. The scripture says, meddle not. Proverbs 20:3 2:04:48 - It is an honour for a man to cease from strife: that's what you supposed to want. But every fool will be meddling. So wait a minute: it says fools meddle. What does that make a nosy person? Mind your business. - You going to mess around and get caught up in whatever's going on, and now you're to blame. I have watched the whole situation shift from the people who were involved to the person that was just being nosy. Come to find out: it's your fault, you're the one running around telling everybody about this. You're the reason why they at odds with one another right now, cuz they got to defend themselves from all the stories being told. All cuz you can't keep your mouth shut. Don't let it be named amongst us. Luke 12:13-14 2:06:12 - Jesus didn't get caught up in that stuff. Here's an example. One of the company said unto him, Master, speak to my brother, that he divide the inheritance with me. What did this brother just try to do? Involve him in some strife that ain't got nothing to do with him. - And he said unto him, Man, who made me a judge or a divider over you? Christ didn't want none of that business. It wasn't his; he wasn't meddling with it. That's the same way we got to roll in other matters of people's business. It's brought to us: how may I help? Ain't got nothing to do with me. Go to them. Cuz I ain't trying to get bit, cuz now my name is associated with it. - And we live in a time now where something might get revealed to you, and that person being talked about might be crazy enough that everybody that knows got to go. Now they coming for you. A lot of the stuff that happens in the streets, where you see multiple people getting hurt over a process of time, is somebody that knows something. And it could have been stopped at the door: it ain't none of my business, man, I ain't meddling. That's an example from Christ. James 3:3-5 2:08:03 - All of these things could be alleviated if we just find out how to control our mouths. - Behold, we put bits in the horses' mouths, that they may obey us; and we turn about their whole body. Y'all know how much a horse weighs? Heavy, all that muscle. And you can control that whole horse by a bit that's in his mouth. That little bitty thing can have so much effect over the whole body. That's the tongue. - Behold also the ships, which though they be so great, and are driven of fierce winds, yet are they turned about with a very small helm. The little steering wheel controlling that big old ship. Same thing with the tongue. - Even so the tongue is a little member, and boasteth great things. Behold, how great a matter a little fire kindleth. Your tongue can mess up a whole lot of stuff. It has that much power. Knowing that, you better guard it. Be very careful about what comes out of it, so that you don't tarnish your name, or ruin your situation or somebody else's. Proverbs 18:20-21 2:10:13 - Death and life are in the power of the tongue: and they that love it shall eat the fruit thereof. This tongue can get you killed, or can give life. - Be mindful, because your mouth can either get you rewarded or get you in a whole lot of trouble. Psalms 34:13-14 2:10:58 - Keep thy tongue from evil, and thy lips from speaking guile. This takes practice. Ruling over your tongue takes practice, especially for those that don't know they ain't got no control. - They think it's normal. They think you're supposed to murmur, you're supposed to complain, you're supposed to talk about everybody else's problems and their business. It's been normalized; they grew up watching it. But it's not normal, it's not right, and it's not how we're supposed to move or conduct ourselves. - Depart from evil, and do good; seek peace, and pursue it. Proverbs 21:23-24 2:11:55 - Whoso keepeth his mouth and his tongue keepeth his soul from troubles. If you learn how to control your mouth, you will keep yourself from certain troubles. - I know it don't seem like a lot, but some of you all have dodged many bullets, many situations, because you held your tongue, or you didn't speak on something, or you just stayed out of something, and you don't even know the world of hurt you might have caused yourself. It's very hard to look back and see the things you've avoided, because it's everyday life. But trust and know: if you get good at holding your tongue, you'll avoid those things, and you'll never know what it's like to go through the things that a person who can't control their mouth has to go through. Ecclesiastes 5:2 2:13:05 - Be not rash with thy mouth, and let not thine heart be hasty to utter any thing before God: for God is in heaven, and thou upon earth: therefore let thy words be few. - Let your words be few. Control your mouth. There's a time and a place for everything. Be mindful of what you say, be mindful of the things you say to people, and the things you take in as well. Proverbs 13:3 2:13:38 - He that keepeth his mouth keepeth his life. That man that has the power, the control, to keep his tongue, to watch his mouth: you keep your life, you preserve yourself. - But he that openeth wide his lips shall have destruction. These are the examples that we've read over and over and over. The Lord put a whole generation of people to death because they was murmuring, complaining, couldn't control a mouth, gossiping and talebearing. God ain't playing with that, so we can't play with it either. In Closing I pray y'all got something out of today's class. All praise be to the Most High. We got Bishop up next; it's going down. Stay tuned. Shalom. --- Class Notes Index Transcript: full session

title: RECOVERING THE REMNANT: WORLDWIDE BLITZ
text: Introduction What a warm reception coming back to Babylon the great. The name of today's lesson is Recovering the Remnant: Worldwide Blitz, taught on the Sabbath of the new moon as the brothers return from celebrating the Passover across the world. A video from the art department opened the class: this is not just travel; this is sacrifice. Every step forward is a step into the unknown, because when truth moves, opposition follows. The men on these missions go not for fame or recognition, but because the mission is bigger than them and the word must go out through every nation. We may never go back to the old national Passover, because they need us out there in these other countries. Captain Yuri reads for the class. Scriptures Opened Matthew 1:17, 21 16:56 - All the generations from Abraham to David are fourteen generations, from David until the carrying away into Babylon fourteen generations, and from the carrying away into Babylon unto Christ fourteen generations. Prior to the Babylonian captivity you had the Assyrian captivity, and from Babylon to Christ you have the Persia Media captivity, the Greek captivity, and then Rome. Christ was born in the Roman captivity. - Thou shalt call his name Jesus, for he shall save his people from their sins. Why did we need saving? Because of the captivities: sin is the reason we went into Babylon, into Persia Media, into Greece, and finally into Rome. Sin has always been our problem. Matthew 15:24 18:56 - I am not sent but unto the lost sheep of the house of Israel. That verse proves he came for the Israelites, the same way the angel said he shall save his people. There are no contradictions in the book; the contradictions come from the doctrines of men. Matthew 24:29-31 19:37 - Immediately after the tribulation of those days: the stars falling from heaven are missiles, and the powers of the heavens shaken are countries and nations warring against each other. - He shall send his angels with a great sound of a trumpet, and they shall gather together his elect from the four winds, from one end of heaven to the other. Notice the angels do not go to one land to gather this people. Christ is letting us know the Israelites would not be in a land; the Israelites are scattered worldwide. Precepts: - Isaiah 45:4 For Jacob my servant's sake, and Israel mine elect. The elect are not anybody that worships; the elect is Israel. Psalms 50:4-5 21:32 - He shall call to the heavens from above: that is the angels he is calling to. And to the earth: the earth is you and I. So the commandment goes to the angels and to the prophets on earth alike: gather my saints together unto me, those that have made a covenant with me by sacrifice. Only the Israelites made a covenant with God by sacrifice. - We are not supposed to be looking for other races and nationalities, only the twelve tribes of Israel. Precepts: - Psalms 148:14 He also exalteth the horn of his people, the praise of all his saints, even of the children of Israel. The children of Israel are the saints. Isaiah 43:3-7 23:38 - I am the Lord thy God, the Holy One of Israel, thy Saviour: I gave Egypt for thy ransom, Ethiopia and Seba for thee. He destroyed the Egyptian army for our ransom, and Ethiopia and Seba, which is Somalia, for us. - Since thou wast precious in my sight, thou hast been honourable, and I have loved thee: therefore will I give men for thee, and people for thy life. God is saying, the same way I destroyed ancient Egypt, Ethiopia, and the Sabeans, I must destroy nations again for your deliverance. If you say you do not want God to destroy anybody, you do not read the Bible. - Fear not: for I am with thee: I will bring thy seed from the east, and gather thee from the west; I will say to the north, Give up; and to the south, Keep not back. Bring my sons from far, and my daughters from the ends of the earth, even every one that is called by my name. That is why we have to teach our people: you are the Israelites the Bible speaks of. Acts 2:5-15 25:44 - There were dwelling at Jerusalem Jews, devout men, out of every nation under heaven. Israelites came from every nation under heaven for the feast, and every man heard the apostles speak in his own language. Why did God not just have them teach in Hebrew? Because Hebrew was not the first language of these Israelites; their first language was the language of the countries they were born into. God anointed the brothers with the Holy Spirit so there would be no misunderstanding. - The roll call of lands is a map of the captivities: Parthians and Medes, that is Persia Media, modern day Iran; Elamites, toward India and Pakistan; Mesopotamia, which is Iraq, old Babylon; Cappadocia, Pontus, Asia, Phrygia, and Pamphylia, the region of modern Turkey; Egypt and the parts of Libya about Cyrene, which is Africa; strangers of Rome; Cretes from the Greek captivity; and Arabians from the Arab captivity. - Jews and proselytes: a proselyte is a convert, men and women who came back to the law of Moses. - Peter said, these are not drunken, as ye suppose, seeing it is but the third hour of the day: nine in the morning. Acts 20:1-5 29:42 - Disciple means student. Paul went into Macedonia and Greece, and there accompanied him into Asia Sopater of Berea, Aristarchus and Secundus of the Thessalonians, Gaius of Derbe, Timotheus, and of Asia Tychicus and Trophimus. - Why read this? Because Paul had a team of men he traveled with to teach the gospel. Most of these men are barely mentioned again, but they were there helping Paul spread the gospel. It is nothing different from what we are doing today with these missions. Deuteronomy 28:64 31:30 - This is what the churches stay confused on. The Lord shall scatter thee among all people, from the one end of the earth even unto the other; and there thou shalt serve other gods, even wood and stone. We would worship wood, the wooden cross, and the stone of the Kaaba. This scattering was the result of breaking God's commandments. James 1:1 32:06 - James writes to the twelve tribes which are scattered abroad. Even in the New Testament it tells you the twelve tribes were scattered; they would not be sitting in the land of Israel. - Captain Shay said it in the war room: what we did this past Passover is like throwing a stone into the water. We land in these countries and teach the gospel, and there is a spiritual ripple effect. You might not be able to see it, but the effects will be made manifest. Psalms 106:34-35 32:35 - They did not destroy the nations, concerning whom the Lord commanded them: but were mingled among the heathen, and learned their works. Our people on the continent of Africa mingled among the Canaanites, Philistines, Jebusites, and Hittites and learned their works. Our people on this side of the world mingled with Esau, which is why the complexions and the hair changed. Isaiah 11:10-12 34:07 - When you bring this out on the street, highlight the word Gentiles. Christ is the ensign, which for us today is the Bible, since Christ is not walking with us; to it shall the Gentiles seek, and his rest shall be glorious. - The Lord shall set his hand again the second time to recover the remnant of his people from Assyria, from Egypt, from Pathros in Sudan, from Cush in Ethiopia, from Elam toward Iran, Pakistan, and India, from Shinar in Iraq, from Hamath in Syria, and from the islands of the sea: Puerto Rico, Jamaica, Haiti, and the thousands of inhabited Melanesian islands. - Verse 12 identifies the Gentiles of verse 10: he shall assemble the outcasts of Israel, and gather together the dispersed of Judah from the four corners of the earth. Saying that the people in the land today are our people is erroneous and non biblical. Zephaniah 3:10-13 36:19 - From beyond the rivers of Ethiopia my suppliants, even the daughter of my dispersed. Beyond the Blue Nile is West Africa, South Africa, North Africa: a large portion of the scattered are on the continent of Africa. - I will take away out of the midst of thee them that rejoice in thy pride: the pastors and the parties rejoice in us going against God's commandments. Precepts: - Ecclesiasticus 10:12 The beginning of pride is when one departeth from God. - I will also leave in the midst of thee an afflicted and poor people, and they shall trust in the name of the Lord. We went throughout Africa on this journey of keeping the Passover and the feast of unleavened bread: are the brothers there not afflicted and poor? They must be taught to trust in the name of the Lord. - The remnant of Israel shall not do iniquity, nor speak lies. No, Jesus is not white; no, he was not born December 25th; no, we are not to pray to Mary or to the ancestors. They shall feed and lie down, and none shall make them afraid. Isaiah 42:22-25 39:39 - This is a people robbed and spoiled. The people of Africa are literally walking on gold, diamonds, bauxite, and lithium, and the only ones who benefit are the other nations. They are all of them snared in holes: Christianity, its denominations, and Islam are the holes we have been trapped in. They are hid in prison houses: the lands we now live in. - None saith, Restore. At the UN they could not even agree to acknowledge the transatlantic slave trade for what it was, and reparations could not be brought up. None of them says give back what is owed. - Who gave Jacob for a spoil, and Israel to the robbers? Did not the Lord, he against whom we have sinned? Slavery, black codes, Jim Crow, redlining, and our current situation are the fury of his anger poured out, for they would not walk in his ways. It hath set him on fire round about, yet he knew not; and it burned him, yet he laid it not to heart. We do not stop to consider that what we go through as a race is because of our sins. Book read in class: The Jewish Mystique, by Ernest van den Haag. The author writes that the enslaved had no common language, religion, history, or culture, no record of their own past, because enslavement destroyed the tribal units and their religion, self image, and ambitions were handed to them by their owners. He writes that Negroes did not feel that a code of conduct prescribed by their religion would lead to redemption, independently of the wishes of the white majority; they did not feel their sufferings were a chastisement imposed by a father who had been disobeyed, and that ultimate redemption would depend on studying and obeying his law; unlike Jews, they tended to feel their fate depended on outside secular forces, which further weakens initiative and independence. The point: even this scholar saw that our redemption comes through studying and obeying God's law, and that we can never have true independence while looking to outside secular forces for help. Our culture is found in the Bible, and our people do not know it. John 14:26 48:23 - The Comforter, which is the Holy Ghost, shall teach you all things, and bring all things to your remembrance. Why would we need to remember? Because we would be made to forget: the nations burned our records and beat us into submission, and we forgot what Christ said. - Christ said he would gather his elect from the four winds; Christ said he was sent only to the lost sheep of the house of Israel; and Christ said, if ye love me, keep my commandments. Precepts: - John 14:15 If ye love me, keep my commandments. The Holy Spirit causes us to remember these things; if you do not remember them, the Spirit is not on you. Isaiah 44:1-5 50:00 - Hear, O Jacob my servant, and Israel whom I have chosen. Fear not: I will pour water upon him that is thirsty. Thirsty for what? For the truth. Precepts: - Ephesians 5:26 That he might sanctify and cleanse it with the washing of water by the word. The water represents the word of God. - I will pour my spirit upon thy seed, and my blessing upon thine offspring: and they shall spring up as among the grass. That is what we are looking at now: the Israelites are springing up worldwide like grass. - Verse 5 gives three categories of Israelites waking up: one shall say, I am the Lord's, acknowledging we are the children of Abraham, Isaac, and Jacob; another shall call himself by the name of Jacob, taking on a new name; and another shall subscribe with his hand unto the Lord, and surname himself by the name of Israel. Zechariah 2:6-8 52:35 - Come forth, and flee from the land of the north: flee from North America. For I have spread you abroad as the four winds of the heaven, like we read in Matthew 24 and James 1. - Deliver thyself, O Zion, that dwellest with the daughter of Babylon. Many scriptures make Zion the twelve tribes, but in this context Zion is Judah, and God is pinpointing the group of Judah dwelling with the daughter of Babylon in the land of the north. Precepts: - Psalms 78:68 But chose the tribe of Judah, the mount Zion which he loved. That is the Zion of this prophecy. - Psalms 137:7-8 Remember the children of Edom in the day of Jerusalem, who said, Rase it, rase it. O daughter of Babylon: the scripture identifies Edom as the daughter of Babylon. So Judah would dwell among Edom in the land of the north. - He that toucheth you toucheth the apple of his eye: we are God's favorite. Deuteronomy 33:7 55:34 - This is the blessing of Judah: Hear, Lord, the voice of Judah. The voice of Judah is the teaching of Judah. And bring him unto his people: bring Judah to the other eleven tribes. And be thou an help to him from his enemies: help Judah as he teaches the other tribes. In these last days the tribe of Judah is raised up first to go out and find the other tribes. Zechariah 12:7 56:28 - The Lord also shall save the tents of Judah first. So the springing up like grass of Isaiah 44 starts with Judah, and per Deuteronomy 33 Judah goes out, researches, studies, and teaches the other tribes where they are located. Romans 10:14-15 57:11 - How then shall they call on him in whom they have not believed? Our people have believed in a strange god, a eurocentric god. We are the only race that has a god that does not look like us. Precepts: - Daniel 11:39 Thus shall he do in the most strong holds with a strange god: that white image is a strange god. He shall cause them to rule over many, and shall divide the land for gain: the land of Africa was divided for gain, exactly as written. - How shall they hear without a preacher? Preacher means prophet, one who foretells. And how shall they preach, except they be sent? That is what this Passover has been all about. Brothers do not realize the impact: you come from another country and teach a people that they are the Israelites, and even if it does not set in that night, it marinates in their souls; there is a spiritual ripple effect. - We only send brothers with a good name in this truth. Some brothers went to other countries and disgraced themselves, gossiping and stirring up murmuring, and were demoted, and one was put out. As it is written, how beautiful are the feet of them that preach the gospel of peace, and bring glad tidings of good things: you are the Israelites; Christ died for you and is coming back to save you. That is good news. Matthew 10:5-7 1:01:32 - Go not into the way of the Gentiles, and into any city of the Samaritans enter ye not: do not deal with the other eleven tribes or the northern kingdom yet, because it was not their time; Judah is raised first. But go rather to the lost sheep of the house of Israel, starting with Judah. And as ye go, preach, saying, The kingdom of heaven is at hand. - Christ still went to Samaria in John 4 and taught for a few days, because he knew the time was coming to deal with them. Precepts: - Acts 11:19 They which were scattered abroad upon the persecution that arose about Stephen traveled as far as Phenice, and Cyprus, and Antioch, preaching the word to none but unto the Jews only: primarily dealing with Judah first. - Romans 9:24 Even us, whom he hath called, not of the Jews only, but also of the Gentiles: not of Judah only, but also the other tribes. There is no contradiction once you know the order. 2 Chronicles 17:5-9 1:04:51 - King Jehoshaphat took away the high places and groves out of Judah, the false idols and their little churches, and in the third year of his reign he sent his princes, with Levites and priests, to teach in the cities of Judah. And they taught in Judah, and had the book of the law of the Lord with them, and went about throughout all the cities of Judah, and taught the people. - So what Christ did in sending out the twelve was not new, and what IUIC is doing is not new. In Jehoshaphat's day our people were worshiping Moloch, Chemosh, and Baal, and the remedy was to tear down the groves and send teachers through the land with the book. Books read in class, with mission reports from the worldwide blitz played between them: - The Lost Tribes a Myth, by Allen H. Godbey (1930): hundreds of thousands of slaves were brought to America from western Africa, and the author asks how much more of Judaism survived among West African Negroes in that earlier time; as persecuted communities they were more in danger than other groups of being raided by war parties and sold as slaves, and it may be considered certain that many partially Judaized Negroes were among the slaves brought to America. On the Cabinda coast was a group of black Jews known as Mavumba, connected by Ratzel with a colony of Jews expelled from Portugal to Sao Tome, where in 1484 King John II offered the Jews of his dominion the alternative of baptism or exile to the island. The book also records Bishop Matthew's claim of an immemorial Jewish ancestry that is Negro, and a Sierra Leone preacher's sermon from about 1860 teaching that Adam and Eve were colored people. - History read on Liberia: between 1822 and the late 19th century roughly 15,000 to 16,000 free black Americans and formerly enslaved people were relocated to Liberia by the American Colonization Society, a group of white politicians, philanthropists, and slaveholders, some of whom hoped removal of free blacks would strengthen slavery. The settlers arrived with a superiority mentality, set up a Masonic lodge as the gate to political office, and the country later suffered two civil wars totaling fourteen years. Never listen to anyone who says there are no Israelites in Africa; they are there in abundance. Do a little research; read a book. - History read on Sierra Leone: in 1792 approximately 1,200 black loyalists voluntarily left Nova Scotia for Sierra Leone, seeking freedom after harsh racism and denied land promises, and established Freetown. - The Genius of the Bantu (1920): Seligman's classifications aside, the book records the contention that the extraneous element of the Bantu was derived from tribes of Israel first carried away to Babylon, who afterward migrated through Egypt into equatorial Africa, and through mingling with native tribes upon whom they imposed much of their own religion and customs gave rise to the peoples now known as Bantu. - The Flaming Torch in Darkest Africa (1898): tribes living in booths constructed from branches at a certain season of the year, observing ceremonies identical with those of the children of Israel; the release of an animal into the wilderness to carry away the transgressions of the people; and circumcision so general among the Zulus as to link them with the period following the Exodus. - A Tribute for the Negro, by Wilson Armistead (1848): the empire of Congo contains many Jews settled in it who retain their religious rites and distinct habits; though separate from the rest of the population, they are black and resemble the other Negroes in every respect as to physical character; and Pennington's textbook states that the descendants of a colony of Jews originally from Judea settled on the coast of Africa are black. - The Jews: A Study of Race and Environment, by Maurice Fishberg (1911): the Falashas are not the only Jews of Negro race; Bastian speaks of Negro Jews on the Loango coast called Mavumba or Judeos, who hold a dominating or respected position because they have most of the commerce in their hands; in Madagascar natives called themselves Zafy Ibrahim, descendants of Abraham; and the most curious class of Negro Jews existed in Jamaica and Surinam, where there was a very large degree of intermarriage of the Spanish and Portuguese Jews, who were black men, with the surrounding population, leaving a large colored population bearing Jewish names. - Jews in Africa: in Mali, several thousand people in Timbuktu claim Jewish ancestry from Moors and Jews fleeing persecution in Spain who migrated south in the 14th century; Askia Muhammad came to power in 1492 and forced Jews to convert to Islam or leave, after which Judaism became illegal in Mali. In Nigeria the Igbo may descend from ancient Semitic and later Jewish migrations, with groups tracing to Gad, Zebulun, and Manasseh; in western Ghana the House of Israel community traces descent through Ivory Coast; in Uganda the Abayudaya practice Judaism; in Somalia the Yibir, the Hebrew tribe, are looked down on as descendants of Israelites; a tribe in Rusape, Zimbabwe claims ancient Jewish connections; and some 40,000 members of the Lemba tribe still claim Jewish roots. Old Jewish communities south of the Atlas Mountains are named in synagogue archives in Cairo, and Jewish, Arab, and Christian accounts cite Jewish rulers of tribal groups scattered throughout Mauritania, Senegal, the western Sudan, Nigeria, and Ghana. - General History of Africa, from the 16th to the 18th century: Africans settled along parts of the Malabar coast of India during the 17th and 18th centuries; these were black Jews who had left Cochin and Kerala in southern India to settle on that coast. - America, a 17th century volume on the New World: the king of Portugal sold all those Jews for slaves that refused to embrace the Roman religion, and caused their children to be baptized; colonists were settled first in Guinea, next in Angola, and lastly on the island of Sao Tome. They tried to force our people into white supremacist Christianity, and many refused and became outcasts. - The Solomon Islands and Their Natives, by H. B. Guppy (1887): reports of an island abounding in wealth and inhabited by Jews west of Peru, and the observation that the features of many Solomon Islanders and Papuans gave the face quite a Jewish cast. - Christopher Columbus and the Participation of the Jews in the Spanish and Portuguese Discoveries: mingled in South America with Jews of the ten tribes. - The updated twelve tribes chart was shown: Judah among the American blacks, with kindred communities from the Igbo of Nigeria to Liberians, Malagasy, Sierra Leone, the Kikuyu of Kenya, the Abayudaya of Uganda, the Falasha of Ethiopia, indigenous groups of North Africa, the Songhai and Ashanti of Ghana, and the Wasambaa of Tanzania. The history is vast, and the chart does not even include the northern kingdom tribes. Acts 10:1-2 2:10:15 - A certain man in Caesarea called Cornelius, a centurion of the Italian band. People read that and assume he was of another race; he was not. Caesarea was a city in the land of Manasseh. And he was a devout man, one that feared God with all his house, which gave much alms to the people, and prayed to God alway. This is not another race; this is Israel. Acts 13:46 2:12:12 - Paul and Barnabas waxed bold: it was necessary that the word of God should first have been spoken to you, Judah; but seeing ye put it from you, lo, we turn to the Gentiles. Who are these Gentiles? Precepts: - Matthew 4:15 The land of Zabulon, and the land of Nephthalim, by the way of the sea, beyond Jordan, Galilee of the Gentiles. The scripture calls the northern kingdom Gentiles. Acts 10:11-14, 28, 34-36 2:13:15 - Peter saw the vision of the sheet with all manner of beasts and heard, Rise, Peter; kill, and eat. Verse 28 is the breakdown: ye know how that it is an unlawful thing for a man that is a Jew to keep company, or come unto one of another nation; but God hath shewed me that I should not call any man common or unclean. The other nation here is the kingdom of Israel, the northern kingdom. Precepts: - Ezekiel 37:22 I will make them one nation in the land upon the mountains of Israel, and they shall be no more two nations. The kingdom of Judah was called a nation and the kingdom of Israel was called a nation: two nations, one people. - Of a truth I perceive that God is no respecter of persons: but in every nation he that feareth him, and worketh righteousness, is accepted with him. A Christian will stop you right there, but read verse 36: the word which God sent unto the children of Israel, preaching peace by Jesus Christ. That verse tells you who Cornelius and his kinfolk are: the children of Israel, in every nation where they were scattered. Acts 15:15-17 2:16:05 - After this I will return, and will build again the tabernacle of David, which is fallen down. The kingdom split: Judah, Benjamin, and Levi on one side; Ephraim and the rest on the other. Acts 15 is looking back at Acts 10: God bringing the northern kingdom and the southern kingdom back together, rebuilding the tabernacle of David. Acts 8:26-31 2:23:42 - A man of Ethiopia, a eunuch of great authority under Candace queen of the Ethiopians, had come to Jerusalem to worship and was reading the prophet Esaias in his chariot. Remember, at this point they were preaching to none but the Jews only; this man was a Jew. - Philip asked, Understandest thou what thou readest? And he said, How can I, except some man should guide me? That is a profound statement. Ecclesiasticus 6:32-37 2:25:04 - My son, if thou wilt, thou shalt be taught: and if thou wilt apply thy mind, thou shalt be prudent. Notice the ifs: if is a two letter word with a big meaning. Study, pray, apply. - Stand in the multitude of the elders; and cleave unto him that is wise. If thou seest a man of understanding, get thee betimes unto him, and let thy foot wear the steps of his door. Let thy mind be upon the ordinances of the Lord, and meditate continually in his commandments: he shall establish thine heart, and give thee wisdom at thine own desire. When you pray for wisdom, God gives it at thine own desire: if you only open the Bible on the Sabbath, your desire is telling the Lord you do not really want it. 1 Peter 5:2-3 2:27:00 - Feed the flock of God, taking the oversight thereof, not by constraint, but willingly; not for filthy lucre, but of a ready mind. Nobody is forced to do this work. If you do not want to travel, be that local prophet; if you do not want rank, be a member; that is fine. God only wants those with a willing mind. - Neither as being lords over God's heritage, but being ensamples to the flock. We are not in this truth to rule and dominate brothers and sisters or control their lives; be an example to the flock. Ecclesiasticus 38:31-34 2:28:15 - This chapter deals with the man whose whole occupation is his worldly craft. Without these cannot a city be inhabited; the work is needed. But they shall not be sought for in public counsel, nor sit high in the congregation, nor sit on the judges' seat, nor understand the sentence of judgment. If all you know is your job and not the scriptures, why would you be asked anything in counsel? Precepts: - Proverbs 28:5 Evil men understand not judgment: but they that seek the Lord understand all things. That is why some are always confused when leadership passes a judgment: they do not know the scriptures, so they do not understand the sentence of judgment. - But they will maintain the state of the world: Babylon the great is where that man's whole desire is, in the work of his craft. Ecclesiasticus 39:1-6 2:31:30 - Here is the flip side: he that giveth his mind to the law of the Most High will seek out the wisdom of all the ancient, and be occupied in prophecies. Where subtle parables are, he will be there also, wanting to learn; he will seek out the secrets of grave sentences, like the question Christ put to the Pharisees about David calling his own son Lord. - He shall serve among great men, and appear before princes: he will travel through strange countries. As we have traveled, brothers have sat before dignitaries: vice presidents, mayors, governors. In Uganda the protocol for sitting before the vice president was taught to us on the spot: sit in rank, speak in order of seniority after he raises his hand. In Liberia, doors opened that cannot even be explained, and a former president running for reelection sat down with the brothers while agents monitored the church and followed them to the meeting. If we are sitting down with vice presidents and heads of state, arguing online with those who do not believe is beneath the work. - He will give his heart to resort early to the Lord that made him, and will pray before the Most High. Remember the morning prayer that goes out at sunrise. When the great Lord will, he shall be filled with the spirit of understanding: you cannot rush your understanding. Nehemiah 8:6-8 2:39:00 - Ezra blessed the Lord, and the Levites caused the people to understand the law. They read in the book in the law of God distinctly, and gave the sense, and caused them to understand the reading. That is the model of teaching: read distinctly, give the sense, cause the people to understand. - From the Biblical and Theological Dictionary (1857), read in class: colleges and schools were erected in divers places for the prophets; the students were called sons of the prophets, not because they were literal sons of the former prophets but because they walked in their footsteps; they were numerous, at Naioth, Bethel, Jericho, and Gilgal; Obadiah hid a hundred of them by fifty in a cave from Jezebel; young men were educated under a proper master in the knowledge of religion and sacred music, and thither the people went on Sabbath days and at new moons to receive public lessons of piety and morality. Itinerant princes, priests, and Levites were sent through all the country to carry the book of the law and teach in the cities. Discourses were preached in camps, courts, streets, schools, cities, and villages, sometimes with great composure and coolness, at other times with vehement action and rapturous energy, sometimes in a plain blunt style, at other times in the magnificent pomp of eastern allegory, and preachers appeared in public with visible signs, implements of war, and yokes of slavery. So the schools, the camps, the signs, and the styles of teaching in IUIC are nothing new; and the same dictionary admits Christianity became sadly incorporated with pagan philosophy while its simplicity decayed within the first three centuries. Ezra 4:1-5 2:48:20 - When the adversaries of Judah and Benjamin heard that the children of the captivity builded the temple, they came saying, Let us build with you: for we seek your God, as ye do. The scripture calls them adversaries before they even speak; the forefathers discerned in the spirit that these were not friends. - Zerubbabel and Jeshua answered, Ye have nothing to do with us to build an house unto our God; but we ourselves together will build. Then the people of the land weakened the hands of the people of Judah, and troubled them in building, and hired counsellors against them to frustrate their purpose. 1 Esdras 5:70-73 2:50:11 - The same history in more detail: the heathen of the land, lying heavy upon the inhabitants of Judea and holding them strait, hindered their building by their secret plots, and popular persuasions, and commotions, and hindered the finishing of the building the space of two years, until the reign of Darius. - It is the same today. In India there are those who hate this gospel going to the police and the pastors saying, we have to stop those Israelites and shut down that school. Secret plots, popular persuasion, and commotions. - Book read in class: Racial Matters: The FBI's Secret File on Black America, 1960-1972, by Kenneth O'Reilly. Informants reported on obscure community activists and allowed the bureau to position itself ahead of the growth of these groups and leaders, to record their development and demise. Their practice with any group they label black nationalist is to have someone on the inside at the very beginning, before anyone takes the group seriously, so the informant looks beyond suspicion years later. So be mindful of people who just up and appear at young schools overseas with no counsel and no history; if you move to another country to an IUIC school, go through counsel, or you will not be received. - Video and article shown in class: the SPLC spokesman describing the strategy to bust up groups, sow discord, and make leaders appear corrupt so members reconsider; and the reported federal charges that between 2014 and 2023 the SPLC secretly funneled more than three million dollars to individuals associated with violent extremist groups including the Klan and Aryan Nations, while labeling others hate groups. An excerpt on COINTELPRO was also read: the program aimed to prevent the rise of a black messiah. Christ said in these last days he is raising up 144,000. - Closing video: what was scattered is being gathered; what was hidden is being revealed. Across the four corners of the earth, from villages to cities, the lost are waking up. In Closing As you can see from those videos, and there is plenty more that was not played, this Passover we had the chance to go out and spread the gospel, and a lot of work was done in a short time. In Liberia alone the brothers did at least fifteen radio shows, not counting television, and none of it was free. Liberia is only 23 years out of a fourteen year civil war, and there are brothers and sisters in the congregation there who cannot read; a council was held and teachers are being hired to teach them to read and write. That is what your donations are helping do, along with a commercial generator, air conditioning for the kids' rooms, and keeping the cameras and internet running through the blackouts every few hours. Some of you complain too much; when you see how the people live, some without running water, we should not be complaining. We cannot just pray for the hungry and leave; that is not scriptural. Continue to support us so we can support them. The work is not over; there is a lot of ground we have not covered. Get your passport and be in the right mindset. Most High, send more laborers. Announcements & References Worldwide blitz Passover mission recaps played during announcements: Mission 191 in Nassau, Bahamas; Mission 193 in Toronto; Mission 194 in Anguilla; Mission 195 in the Virgin Islands; Mission 197 in India, where a community cleanup was held and the people learned the image of Christ; Mission 201 in Malawi, with radio interviews at Farm Radio in Lilongwe; Mission 202 in Honolulu, Hawaii; Mission 203 in Malaita and the Solomon Islands; Mission 209 in Ecuador; Mission 210 in Guyana; Mission 212 in Puerto Rico; Mission 218 in Montreal, where four lambs were processed on the morning of Passover; Mission 219 in Belize; Mission 220 in the Congo, where the brothers taught in Kinshasa and appeared on the national news for preaching, cleaning the city, and running workshops against youth violence; Mission 222 in Australia; Mission 223 in Tanzania, one of the largest ports of the Arab slave trade; Mission 226 in Liberia led by the General; and Mission 228 in Chile. In India, after the captains left, Catholic clergy pressured members, threatening jobs and the children's school placements; support for those brothers and sisters is part of what donations cover. An intermission video unrelated to the class was played, a clip from a dating conversation, with the full clip and discussion scheduled for PSR the next day. Music and merchandise: the single All Sides by Ben Zion Judah featuring Jalil, Jeriah, and Omel drops tonight at originalroyalty.com; the first studio album Eternal Glory by Deacon Isaac drops June 21st; the LMB Royal Heritage Purple and Daughters of Sarah edition apparel is a limited drop with no restock. Israel Live top five: scan the QR code to cast your vote for next week's episode, Monday nights at 9:00 pm. Gifts were presented to the leadership on behalf of the nation for their labor on the missions. Closing reading: 1 Corinthians 11:23-29, the bread and the cup, in remembrance of the Lord's death till he come; let a man examine himself. --- Class Notes Index Transcript: full session

title: THE RETURN OF JIM CROW
text: Introduction Sabbath class from the New York school, taught by Deacon. Happy new moon: the new moon came in on the Sabbath this month, so it is like a double Sabbath. The school is open, and before the topic the class opens with comfort scriptures for the brothers and sisters that are sick, in the hospital, or going through their infirmities, then turns to some things that went on in the news during the week: the return of Jim Crow, and what is happening with voting rights. In The News Read in class, what is Jim Crow: Jim Crow laws are named after a derogatory 1830s minstrel character created by white performer Thomas Dartmouth Rice, who wore blackface and performed in a racist stereotyped manner. Rice claimed he modeled the character after a disabled enslaved black man he saw singing and dancing, turning it into a popular mocking minstrel act. The character was used by white society to perpetuate stereotypes of black people as inferior, buffoonish, and unworthy of equal rights. Following the Reconstruction era, Southern governments implemented Jim Crow laws, roughly 1877 to the 1960s, to legally sanction segregation: separate and inferior schools, segregated trains, streetcars and waiting rooms, segregated theaters, parks, pools, restaurants, hotels, water fountains and restrooms, bans on intermarriage, and disenfranchisement laws to prevent black citizens from voting, including poll taxes, literacy tests, and grandfather clauses. - These were laws; if you broke them you were beaten and put in prison. They said they let us go from slavery, but were we really free? They said they gave us equal rights and citizenship, but did we have equal rights? No. That was the situation until the civil rights era of 1964 and 1965. - This week the Supreme Court, in a six to three vote, gutted Section 2 of the Voting Rights Act, the 1965 law on districting that protected black representation. Southern states immediately began redrawing their voting maps. - Video played in class on the 2024 election: investigative reporting on a selective purge of over a million black and minority voters from the rolls in swing states like Georgia and Pennsylvania; in Georgia any voter can now challenge an unlimited number of other voters, with 48,000 challenged in Cobb County and over 200,000 challenges statewide by NAACP estimates; a 92 year old cousin of Dr. Martin Luther King Jr. who had voted in Georgia for 50 years was told there was no record of her voting at all. First they challenge your registration, then they purge you from the lists, then they redraw the map so your vote does not count. Jim Crow 2.0. - Videos played of voters in Texas told they are suddenly not registered despite voting in every election, and of separate, unequal voting locations. - The SAVE Act, passed in the House, would require a passport or birth certificate to register to vote; over 21 million citizens do not have them, it ends online registration and mail-in voting and shuts down voter drives, and it falls hard on married women whose ID no longer matches their birth certificate. Right after that, the State Department ordered nonprofit libraries, the places in poorer neighborhoods where people filled out passport applications for decades, to stop processing them. They change the law so you need a passport to vote, then close down the places where you get the passport. - Trump on the campaign trail told Christians, get out and vote just this time; in four years it will be fixed so good you are not going to have to vote anymore. Now you see him fulfilling what he said. - Marijuana was rescheduled from schedule one to schedule three under a December 2025 executive order, legal on a federal level for medical use; and at the same time a new law makes driving under the influence, including driving high, a felony. With a felony you cannot vote. That is the Jim Crow pattern. - If you owe child support past a lowered threshold, they take your passport, and the passport is what the new voting law requires. - A run of firings of black officials was recounted in class: the first black woman on the National Labor Relations Board, the chairman of the Joint Chiefs of Staff, the chairman of the Federal Energy Regulatory Commission, the vice chair of the National Transportation Safety Board, the first black Librarian of Congress, a member of the Surface Transportation Board, and an attempted firing of the first black woman on the Federal Reserve Board of Governors; over 300,000 black women have been laid off or pushed out of their jobs since the start of the administration. The only black governor in the country, the chair of the National Governors Association, was uninvited from its annual dinner. - The federal government removed the plaques at Independence Mall in Philadelphia telling the stories of the nine enslaved people owned by George Washington who lived in the President's House, after an order to flag displays seen as disparaging to America's past; a new Senate version of an education bill removes the writings of Frederick Douglass and Dr. Martin Luther King Jr. and the history of Native Americans while keeping white authors. - The Department of Education moved to declassify nursing as a professional degree, limiting access to funding for one of the careers that pulls our people, especially our sisters, out of poverty. - Trump passed a rule allowing federal contractors to have segregated facilities again. Segregation is back on a federal level. - Affirmative action and DEI existed because of Jim Crow, because we did not have equal rights; we would be overqualified for a job and not hired. It was not discrimination against white people. Our people are smart and work hard. Now all of it is being stripped away. Scriptures Opened 1 Peter 5:7 6:14 - For the brothers and sisters that are worried, that are in the hospital, that the doctor told, you might not have long to live: this is the state of mind to have. Casting all your care upon him, for he careth for you. When things get bad and you are hurting inside, we have to learn to cast all our cares upon the Lord, because the Lord cares for us, no matter what we are going through, even in sickness and death. Do not think death is the end of it. Psalms 94:19 8:11 - In the multitude of my thoughts within me thy comforts delight my soul. That is where your comfort comes from: your thoughts. You will be home by yourself while you are being afflicted, going through your trials. Whether you are in prison or sick at home alone, all you have is your thoughts, so you have to comfort yourself in your thoughts. How? You have to know the scriptures and trust in the Lord. 1 Thessalonians 4:13-14 11:13 - Concerning them which are asleep, sorrow not, even as others which have no hope. If you die in Christ, you are not like those with no hope. For if we believe that Jesus died and rose again, even so them also which sleep in Jesus will God bring with him. If you die right now and you are doing what is right, you are not really dead; the Lord is going to bring you back. - That is how you comfort yourself in your thoughts: the doctor tells me I do not have long to live, but I have been serving God and doing what is right, so this is not the end for me. Eventually every one of us has to leave this flesh; death comes to all men. But death for us is you leaving this wicked world and going back to the Lord. 1 Thessalonians 4:18 15:03 - Wherefore comfort one another with these words. These words, the word of God, is what you need in your thoughts. We are not going to be around you all the time; sometimes you might get depressed, might feel like giving up, and Satan will be whispering in your ear, God does not care about you, why is God allowing you to die. You have to learn to comfort yourself with these words. Matthew 22:32 16:25 - I am the God of Abraham, and the God of Isaac, and the God of Jacob: God is not the God of the dead, but of the living. What is that saying about Abraham, Isaac, and Jacob? They are living; they are not dead. Genesis 49:33 17:18 - After Jacob blessed his twelve sons and told them what would happen in the last days, he gathered up his feet into the bed, yielded up the ghost, and was gathered unto his people. When Jacob died he was gathered unto his people. That is what Christ was saying: he is not the God of the dead but of the living. Ephesians 3:14-15 19:01 - Of whom the whole family in heaven and earth is named: that family is Israel, princes that have power with God. So when it says Jacob was gathered unto his people, it means he went to paradise. That is the hope and the comfort you have to have: when Jacob died he was not really dead, he went back to paradise. Job 14:5-7 20:50 - Seeing his days are determined, the number of his months are with thee, thou hast appointed his bounds that he cannot pass. Our days on this earth are determined; there is a day and an hour that every one of us has to die, already ordained by God, and we cannot pass that bound. Though the scriptures show that if you fast and pray and really go in, the Lord can add years. - Till he shall accomplish, as an hireling, his day. A hireling is somebody you give work for a certain amount of time. God sends us on this earth with a job to do and a certain amount of time to do it, and once the job is finished and the time is up, he takes you back. The same with Abraham, Isaac, Jacob, David, Judah Maccabee and his brothers, Mattathias, Elijah: God has a purpose and a job for every one of us. - Turn from him, that he may rest: that rest is going back to paradise if you are righteous. For there is hope of a tree, if it be cut down, that it will sprout again: our hope for immortality is that tree; a class for another day. Romans 14:8 26:29 - Whether we live, we live unto the Lord; and whether we die, we die unto the Lord: whether we live therefore, or die, we are the Lord's. This is the mindset we have to have. Do not let fear of things mess with your spirit. We have to build ourselves up to where we are not afraid of being with the Lord. 2 Corinthians 5:8-9 29:02 - We are confident, I say, and willing rather to be absent from the body, and to be present with the Lord. Once we leave this body, we are going to be present with the Lord. That is the confidence you have to have; death for us is not what it is for everyone else that has no hope. - Wherefore we labour, that, whether present or absent, we may be accepted of him. The labor is doing what is right on this earth: keep the commandments, love each other, so you can be in his presence when you die. - And understand: even though you go to paradise, the Lord is bringing you back to this earth. The whole end of everything is the kingdom of God coming on this earth and us ruling this earth, not living up in the sky. Habakkuk 1:9-11 42:31 - They shall come all for violence: when the white man came to America, he came for violence; he murdered, he killed, and he took. They shall gather the captivity as the sand: the captivity is the twelve tribes of Israel. They shall scoff at the kings, and the princes shall be a scorn unto them: they enslaved our kings, and our chiefs were a scorn to them, here in America, in Puerto Rico, and in Africa. - They shall deride every stronghold: every stronghold in the western hemisphere was taken, whether the Aztecs, the Mayans, the Incas, the Zulu, the Ashanti, or the North American Indians. - Then shall his mind change, and he shall pass over, and offend, imputing this his power unto his god. After he murdered and took every stronghold, he starts teaching Christianity: in God we trust, God bless America. He imputes his power to his god, the white image of Christ, and calls himself a God fearing country. - When and why did his mind really change? After 1945, when America became the superpower. America could not push democracy in Africa and around the world and act like a loving, God fearing people about rights and justice while it still had segregation and Jim Crow laws at home. The other countries said, you have no moral standing; look how you treat the black people in your country. So he changed his image: I am going to keep oppressing, but in a slick way, not openly before the world. That is what happened in 1965 with civil rights. It was not because the white man loved you; it was international pressure. Lyndon Johnson is even quoted saying that if they give us these things, we will be voting for his party for the next hundred years. Isaiah 28:15 53:01 - We have made a covenant with death, and with hell are we at agreement. What is this hell and death we made a covenant with? Habakkuk describes America, and in Revelation 6 hell follows the pale horse. The hell and death is America. Our people made a covenant with America in 1964 and 1965: civil rights, integration, the whole agreement. That is what Martin Luther King understood at the end; he said, I fear I am integrating my people into a burning house. There is even a book called The Covenant with Black America. - Our forefathers did the same thing in the past. The hell and death back then was Rome; the gates of hell that would not prevail against the church was Rome. Our people said, we have no king but Caesar. It is the same state of mind today: they love voting for US presidents, they trust in this system. And the same way our people were destroyed in 70 AD after that covenant with Rome, the same is coming on our people in America. - When the overflowing scourge shall pass through, it shall not come unto us: that is what they think. For we have made lies our refuge: lies like Jesus Christ is a white man, Easter, Christmas, lies like the people in that land are the Jews. Our people live under these things and make them their refuge. Precepts: - Isaiah 30:1-3 Woe to the rebellious children, that take counsel, but not of me; and that cover with a covering, but not of my spirit: that covering is Christianity and politics, Democrat and Republican, adding sin to sin. That walk to go down into Egypt: literally our people went down to ancient Egypt for help against Babylon after God told Jeremiah to warn them not to. But there is a double meaning: the shadow of Egypt is America. A shadow is not the real thing; Revelation 11:8 says the great city is spiritually called Sodom and Egypt. Therefore shall the strength of Pharaoh be your shame, and the trust in the shadow of Egypt your confusion: those who put their strength in the presidents of America will be ashamed and confused. Isaiah 28:16-18 57:37 - Behold, I lay in Zion for a foundation a stone, a tried stone, a precious corner stone, a sure foundation: that is Christ. - Judgment also will I lay to the line, and righteousness to the plummet. The line is a plumb line, a tool to build a wall straight; the church of Christ is going to be built right. It also goes into teaching, like Psalms 19 where their line went out through all the earth. - The hail shall sweep away the refuge of lies, and the waters shall overflow the hiding place. The hail is destruction sweeping away all the lies our people trust in: Christ born December 25th, Easter, white Jesus. The waters are the word of God, revealing every secret thing they have done and tearing down every lie with the scriptures. - And your covenant with death shall be disannulled, and your agreement with hell shall not stand. The covenant black America made in 1964 and 1965, the civil rights, the Voting Rights Act, the integration, all of it is going to fall apart, and you are seeing it happen right now before your eyes. When the overflowing scourge shall pass through, then ye shall be trodden down by it: judgment is coming to this place. Micah 2:10 1:02:53 - Arise ye, and depart; for this is not your rest. Because of the covenant our people made with America, our people have been at rest; you think this place is your rest. You have been rocked to sleep, fed the democracy and the American dream. But God says arise and depart, because it is polluted, it shall destroy you. - Video played in class: Jesse Jackson, who passed a few months ago, one of the architects of civil rights, saying America will get better and better, keep hope alive. That is one of the leaders that made the covenant with hell and death. That is where the phrase keep hope alive came from. But is it getting better? No; it is going backwards. Zechariah 9:12 1:05:35 - Turn you to the strong hold, ye prisoners of hope. God warned us to turn to the stronghold, and the stronghold is our God, not America. Why does it call us prisoners of hope? Because we are always hoping, the same keep hope alive. But God says the covenant our leaders made with America is not going to stand. Isaiah 28:18 1:07:22 - Read again over the videos of the week: your covenant with death shall be disannulled, and your agreement with hell shall not stand. The week's news above is that disannulling in motion: the Voting Rights Act gutted, the SAVE Act, the passport offices closed, the purges and the firings. The white man allowed you to vote for 60 years and renewed your voting rights at least twice; right now they are scrapping the whole thing. - All the immigrants living here should understand: you have rights here because of Judah, because of that fight in the 60s. The black civil rights movement cracked the whole system open, and every minority group walked through that door; now it is being closed back up. Judah is an old lion, but the spirit of Christ is raising him up, and Judah is roaring. Lamentations 4:17 1:55:02 - As for us, our eyes as yet failed for our vain help: in our watching we have watched for a nation that could not save us. We came here as slaves, and we look to the people that oppressed and destroyed us to save us: give us rights, treat us as human beings, let us vote for a president or a senator that could better our community. We watch for a nation that cannot save us. The scripture tells you who saves: your savior is your King, and that is Christ, the black Messiah. Psalms 94:20 1:56:42 - Shall the throne of iniquity have fellowship with thee, which frameth mischief by a law? They frame mischief by law: all these laws they are setting up are to destroy our people, to take away your rights, to stop you from voting, to lock you up. The Jim Crow laws were the same; if you went against them you were locked up and put in prison. The throne of iniquity will have no fellowship with the Lord. Isaiah 32:5-10 1:58:43 - The vile person shall be no more called liberal. In 1965 we made the covenant with the vile person that calls himself a liberal. For the vile person will speak villany, and his heart will work iniquity, to practise hypocrisy: they say we love black people, then sign laws and set things up to destroy our people. The Democrats are not your defense from the Republicans; the Democrats are villains too. - To make empty the soul of the hungry, and he will cause the drink of the thirsty to fail: our people hungry and thirsty for the word of God are not being fed following these politicians. - The instruments also of the churl are evil: Section 8 with the father out of the house, welfare, food stamps, the independent woman that does not need a man. He deviseth wicked devices to destroy the poor with lying words. One of those devices was civil rights itself. There was never any real integration; we were assimilated. We no longer own our own farms, our own businesses, our own banks. They took away our power; that is what happened in the civil rights movement. - But the liberal deviseth liberal things; and by liberal things shall he stand. And all those liberal things are going to fail. - Rise up, ye women that are at ease; hear my voice, ye careless daughters. Why does God address the women at ease? Because the liberal things were set up around the black woman, to keep the house divided: Section 8 as long as the man is not around, food stamps as long as the man is not around, the career woman message. Now over 200,000 women in high positions have lost their jobs, the nursing funding is being cut, and even child support enforcement is being turned into a trap. All of it is failing, because God said it would. - Many days and years shall ye be troubled: affliction is coming here in Babylon, and everything the white man gave is going to be taken. God says rise up and hear my voice: it is the word of God you are hearing, and the time is now. Hosea 5:15 2:08:31 - I will go and return to my place, till they acknowledge their offence, and seek my face: in their affliction they will seek me early. Our people have not acknowledged their offense yet, but we are beginning to; that is why you see us coming together. Affliction is coming to America and all over the world, because God says that for my people to seek my face, I have to afflict them. - It has been 60 years since civil rights. What did our people do with them? The scoreboard is rap music about killing each other, drugs, and hating each other. So the rights are being taken back. God sent Trump to do what you see him doing, because he wants you to turn to him. Zephaniah 2:1 2:10:54 - Gather yourselves together, yea, gather together, O nation not desired. As affliction rises on our people, it is going to force us to gather together on an even higher level than you see right now. As Jim Crow comes back, our people are going to start separating, gathering together, doing things on our own, working together, learning to love each other and deal right with each other. That is what bringing back Jim Crow is going to do; there is a law behind it. - We are the nation not desired; the nations do not want us voting in their elections. The Lord does not want us assimilating with them. He said, I want you to gather together, so I am going to make it where they put you out of all their systems and all the benefits they gave you for the last 60 years. In Closing What you see them doing is one step closer to civil war: not black against white, but Democrat against Republican. The Most High is setting up the stage for them to fight each other. Watch the elections coming; the anger is only going to build. Remember the video that opened the lesson: you all just need to vote this one last time. Closing reading over the bread and the wine: 1 Corinthians 11:23-29, the bread and the cup in remembrance of the Lord's death till he come; let a man examine himself. Announcements & References - Video played at the end of class: the class thumbnail trailer made by the brothers in New Jersey, walking from make America great again through the civil rights era to today's purged voter rolls, firings, and whitewashed history: Jim Crow is back. - Book referenced: The Covenant with Black America. - Fellowship after class; the school closes at 12:30, and camp is tomorrow. --- Class Notes Index Transcript: full session

title: CALLED TO MAGNIFY THE LAW: LORD INCREASE OUR FAITH
text: Introduction The topic of today's class is going into faith. But not just faith: why we are called. Who called us, and what is our purpose? When we say called, that is a light way of saying we are requested of God to magnify his law. And in that process we must continue to build and increase our faith, and there is only one way to do that: with action and serving the Lord. Remember the scripture speaks of the great fiery trial of our faith: once we begin to keep God's commandments in the faith of Christ, the Lord starts testing us to show us that the faith he created us with is in you; you just have to bring it out. The meaning of this class is for us to increase our faith in the most high God in the spirit of Christ, to remember who we are, to bethink ourselves, to encourage endurance in righteousness, and to teach us how to stand against sin, deception, and spiritual wickedness in high places. Still coming off the Passover trips overseas, the flame has not gone out; oppression tried to lower it a little, but we have to keep it going. Scriptures Opened 2 Corinthians 13:1-5 07:41 - In the mouth of two or three witnesses shall every word be established: which is the law. Paul was in the spirit of Christ, explaining that all the things he speaks of, he is strong in Christ, strong in the power of the Lord. - For we also are weak in him: this mortal body has down times. We are not immortal yet, so Christ is here to maintain and build our faith. When we are at our weakest, that is when Christ is strong within us. As times get hard, we have an advocate with the Father, Jesus Christ the righteous. Paul understood that Christ is his source. - Examine yourselves, whether ye be in the faith; prove your own selves. We always have to look at that man or that sister in the mirror and measure your mind and your spirit against the scriptures. Teaching this class, I know I have a lot to work on; we all do. Take the oversight in the spirit of humility, because we must prepare our souls for the temptation to come. The Lord did not call you by mistake; he chose you. So when we are called, we must prove God to be right on the earth. - Prove your own selves: a lot of times we have self-doubt, but there is a level of confidence we must build to endure until the end. If you are in sin, just repent. If you are feeling depressed and down and out, the cure is not going out or only talking to a friend; the cure is building your spirit up in the face of these words. - How can you be in the truth and deny the truth? How can you be in the truth and want to continue as a whoremonger, a thief, a liar, deceitful? The truth is supposed to expose those things within us so we can examine ourselves and be closer to God. No temptation that we go through is uncommon to man, but the Lord is going to give you a way to escape. Romans 10:17 13:49 - So then faith cometh by hearing, and hearing by the word of God. It is that simple: study, pray, apply, every single day. You should be praying three times a day; it should be a habit. - Faith only comes by listening, reading, and studying the word of God. When you are down and out, open your Bible and read, and read the things according to what you are dealing with. When you do not do those things, you deprive yourself of your own salvation. 2 Esdras 7:69-70 16:02 - Them that are cured with his word: what cures our depression? His word. What cures our anger? His word. What cures our unbelief, or us not thinking we have a purpose in life? His word. - When we compare and examine our spirit with this Bible, you see yourself: I am right there in Isaiah, I am right there in Jeremiah, I am going through that. How do I overcome it? That builds your spirit up to endure and overcome. The Most High is genius enough to write your history and your life in this book, and only you are going to understand it. Being called to magnify God's law is no coincidence; the Lord chose you to make sure the earth knows that God is real. Ecclesiasticus 21:11 19:21 - He that keepeth the law of the Lord getteth the understanding thereof: that is how you start to understand what God is really saying and how it pertains to you. And the perfection of the fear of the Lord is wisdom. - In studying the law, in getting around your brothers and sisters, in seeking counsel, you start to perfect your fear of the Lord. Because contrary to popular belief, your sin does not just happen: you entertain it, you put it there, you leave it there, you make provision for it, because there is no fear. - Everybody that came into this truth could not put the Bible down at first: video after video, highlighters, up all night. Then it starts to get regular, and you start to not read as much, not study as much, not even pray. We have seen brothers and sisters that were doing well; then life came, sin started to happen, they got wrapped up in it, and they are unrecognizable now. That is why we say like David: Lord, please do not take your Holy Spirit from me. - We all are going to struggle with something, but the point is to struggle with it; do not let it defeat you. All manner of sin shall be forgiven; a brother dealing with drunkenness does not need to exile himself from the body. Israel United in Christ is built off the betterment of the souls of God's people, for you to grow and get better from your sin. Psalms 119:18 24:15 - Open thou mine eyes, that I may behold wondrous things out of thy law. These are not just your bodily eyes; these are your spiritual eyes. We need to delve into the scriptures and meditate so we can behold the wondrous things out of God's law. - The wondrous thing out of God's commandments: he wants me to be like him. God gave law so that we can be like unto him. Precepts: - Matthew 5:48 Christ said, Be ye therefore perfect, even as your Father which is in heaven is perfect. You see it right there in red. - Leviticus 19:2 That is what it meant in the Old Testament: Ye shall be holy, for I the Lord your God am holy. Holiness is us coming into perfection. Psalms 19:1-7 26:32 - The heavens declare the glory of God, and the firmament sheweth his handywork. You have the sun, the moon, the stars; outside the firmament you cannot breathe. How does the sun stay ablaze permanently where there is no oxygen? There must be a God. Nobody on this earth can make a star; you cannot even reach it, but people want to worship it. And with all this, if you know God is real, how much more should you realize him in your conversation and your actions of not sinning? - There is no speech nor language where their voice is not heard. From Genesis, when languages were confused, God's laws were not negated. In Acts 2, Israel and the nations heard in the languages of the lands, and God's laws remained the same. Thou shalt not kill means the same thing in every language and in every place; we just came from Malawi, and the commandment is the same in Chichewa. God's laws are magnified in all places, and the Lord opened our ears for us to go out and preach his gospel throughout the whole planet earth. We are fulfilling those things we read in the scriptures right now. - Their line is gone out through all the earth: our line, our lineage, our legacy, your teaching, the works that you put in for this gospel's sake. - In them hath he set a tabernacle for the sun, which is as a bridegroom coming out of his chamber, and rejoiceth as a strong man to run a race. That is when the Lord says, well done, my good and faithful servant: you are a vessel made for honor, because you fulfilled the purpose he created you for. - The law of the Lord is perfect, converting the soul. Why is the law perfect? Because God's laws are his ways, his habits, and he gave them unto his children. Converting us from darkness into light, from the power of Satan unto the power of God, for the salvation and redemption of our souls.
