The testimony of the Lord is sure, making wise the simple: we were simple, and now we have come back to understanding that we are Israel. Job 36:6 35:58 - He preserveth not the life of the wicked: but giveth right to the poor. So how have we become poor? In oppression the Lord will open up our understanding, our mind, our ears; after we understand and observe, we have to apply and be like our Father. Isaiah 42:22 38:11 - But this is a people robbed and spoiled. We were robbed of our land, our nationality, our culture, our heritage, our riches, our wealth, our resources. In Malawi they tried to say the colonizers brought civilization, but before that our people had wealth, resources, and economics. When we came from Jerusalem down into Africa and scattered through the world, we had this in our land. - Spoiled means destroyed: after we were robbed, we were destroyed for lack of knowledge and given a false heritage. We were destroyed with the religions of our oppressor. How can your oppressor be your god? It makes no sense. - They are all of them snared in holes, and they are hid in prison houses. That still takes effect to this day; we are going to see how it plays out in real time. - Our ancestors in slavery had much faith; that is why we are here today. They endured, and some like Nat Turner got the word and knew who they were. But the gift of sports, entertainment, and jobs made us feel assimilated and included; it weakened our endurance toward our God, and we forgot him. Only oppression maketh a wise man mad, and a gift destroyeth the heart. Isaiah 26:13 45:26 - O Lord our God, other lords beside thee have had dominion over us: but by thee only will we make mention of thy name. The same God that made the heavens by his handywork; not the sun, the moon, and the stars that some worship, for we have a God that created all of that. - This Bible has been preached to you by your oppressor, so it is uncommon to your ears when we bring it out. Your presidents and the rulers of the nations are not God; the Bible says the earth is given into the hand of the wicked. The Lord gave a prime example with the Egyptians of how he destroys all whom God's people think are gods. When we put our trust in our oppressor, we make an agreement with hell and with death. - When we come into this faith, that is not the end goal; that is the beginning of our trial. God did not call you for no reason; he called you for his purpose. It is not a coincidence that you understand and hear this word. Isaiah 14:32 48:44 - What shall one then answer the messengers of the nation? That the Lord hath founded Zion, and the poor of his people shall trust in it. Zion is the city of David; the twelve tribes of Israel. - How have we become poor? Through the parts of captivity, our identity has been polluted through indoctrination in the nations, robbed, spoiled, and destroyed. But the spirit remains the same: within our nation we have many shades of brown because the seed of Israel mingled amongst the nations, and the spirit that God chose still remains in us. That is why we go to all the nations and teach our people in those lands: because we are there. - The poor of God's people shall trust in the Lord, not in the ways of this world. Tobit 4:21 50:25 - And fear not, my son, that we are made poor: for thou hast much wealth, if thou fear God, and depart from all sin, and do that which is pleasing in his sight. Although we have been made poor, humbled, destroyed, and cut off, yet in 2026 we know we are the Israelites, we know that Christ is black, and we blitzed the entire planet earth with the word of God. The gates of hell cannot prevail. - Whatever trials you are going through, God said you are wealthy, if you fear him, depart from your sin, and keep the commandments; you are going to get the kingdom. James 2:5 53:10 - Hearken, my beloved brethren, hath not God chosen the poor of this world rich in faith, and heirs of the kingdom which he hath promised to them that love him? Why are we rich in faith? Because God chose you. He called you; he requested you. - In the time of our oppression, faith is the only thing that is going to keep us together, and you are not alone: your brother, your sister, your nation. Coming to keep the Sabbath builds your faith. Seeing us go to various places on the planet and fulfill the prophecies of God, seeing our people understand this word abroad, that builds your faith: not trust in man, but trust that God's prophecies are being fulfilled. - Them that love him keep his commandments and show it with their faith, preparing our minds for the return of our Messiah. Job 36:10 54:19 - He openeth also their ear to discipline, and commandeth that they return from iniquity. The Lord opened your ears to discipline: the Holy Spirit of discipline, which is his laws, statutes, and commandments. You had to subdue your understanding: the way I show I love God is to keep his commandments. - People say they hate camps, but the camps are the reason you understand the Bible the way you do. Your oppressor did not tell you that you were an Israelite; your own people did. God put the spirit on the men that came before us, the elders and those camps, and we got the fruits of that in our bishops today. The spirit continued to be carried out amongst us, a generation where we bethought ourselves and were brought back to our fathers. That is prophecy. Precepts: - Job 36:15 He delivereth the poor in his affliction, and openeth their ears in oppression. The oppressor is not poor; they are rich through robbery, and that continues to this day. Psalms 94:20 1:10:28 - Video played on the 13th Amendment: it officially ended slavery in America in December 1865, but the exception clause, except as punishment for crime, created a loophole still exploited today. Within 15 years, Southern states imprisoned black Americans at ten times the rate of whites. Today the US has about 2.3 million incarcerated people, roughly a quarter of the world's prisoners with about five percent of its population; prison labor generates billions annually while inmates earn cents per hour, and major companies have used that labor. Mass incarceration disproportionately affects black and Latino communities. - A satirical clip was played making the same point: after the amendment, the state simply criminalized our existence, with loitering and vagrancy made felonies, and the convicts leased to companies for forced labor. Read the fine print: slavery is abolished except if you are in prison. Why do we fill up the prison houses? Slavery evolved; it did not end. The illusion of democracy has given you the feeling of freedom, but as in Egypt, the oppressor dealt craftily with us. - Shall the throne of iniquity have fellowship with thee, which frameth mischief by a law? They framed deceit and mischief, misled us with democracy and freedom, and made it law. The throne of iniquity has no fellowship with Christ: not their holidays, not their man-made religions, and no, the president is not God, nor does he serve the one true God. - A court clip was played of a former warden testifying that a young defendant should be sentenced to life without parole rather than death because the prison would benefit from his labor: he is young, he is healthy, we need that sweat equity, and we will put him out there to work. That is slavery in real time, echoing the Willie Lynch instruction not to kill him because it is not good for economics. - Your calling is not to be a slave; your nine to five is for you to keep these commandments, to remember that you are called and requested of God to magnify his law upon the earth. We must obey the laws of God and the just laws of the land so we do not get caught up in the oppression. Some need to be locked up if they rob and steal; but what we institute is the keeping of God's commandments so you stay far from all of that. Precepts: - 2 Esdras 5:42 I will liken my judgment unto a ring: like as there is no slackness of the last, even so there is no swiftness of the first. God shall be known in his judgments: when we sin and find ourselves back in captivity and prison houses, his judgment stands, and his prophecies are fulfilled. Take heed and fear God. Isaiah 42:19-21 1:17:07 - Who is blind, but my servant? or deaf, as my messenger that I sent? Israel doth not consider; we did not even know that we are Israel. The ox knoweth his owner, and the ass his master's crib, but we did not consider that we ourselves are the servants, the messengers, the children of God. At one point we were blind, but now we see; we were deaf, but now we hear discipline. - The Lord is well pleased for his righteousness' sake: he is pleased when you are like him, when your ears are open to his discipline. That is my boy; that is my girl; that is the servant in whom I am well pleased. - He will magnify the law, and make it honourable. The Lord magnifies the law through Christ and makes it honorable, and Christ said greater works than these shall ye do; so we continue in that process of magnifying the law through Christ upon the planet. Marriage is honorable, and that is why Satan attacks it. Brotherhood, unity, nationhood, raising your children, not stealing, not killing, loving your nation as you love yourself: that is a superpower. Our love, our nation, and keeping God's commandments; that is the power they try to destroy. 2 Chronicles 6:36-37 1:20:30 - If they sin against thee, (for there is no man which sinneth not,) and thou deliver them over before their enemies, and they carry them away captives unto a land far off or near: far off means scattered throughout the nations; near means close to Jerusalem. - Yet if they bethink themselves in the land whither they are carried captive. Definition read in class: bethink means to remember, to recall, to cause oneself to be reminded or to consider. That is why the law says remember the Sabbath day; remember your heritage. The Sabbath is vital to our growth and understanding of our true heritage. - And turn and pray unto thee in the land of their captivity, saying, We have sinned, we have done amiss, and have dealt wickedly. In captivity we must learn how to suffer and be delivered with righteousness: continue to keep God's commandments while under oppression. You say, I am not oppressed, I have no chains; but that spirit of clocking in and working tries to dim the flame you have. That is why you have to build your faith up and understand this is not our rest. - How do we bethink ourselves? By hearing the word of God. When you see these words fulfilled in real time, when you are afflicted for righteousness' sake, it should increase your faith. When hard times come, it should increase your faith, family. Isaiah 51:20 1:25:29 - My sons have fainted, they lie at the head of all the streets, as a wild bull in a net. That is us: at the head of every corner, in every hood and ghetto throughout the earth, in Miami, in the Bronx, in all these places. Who do you find in those places? Our people. - They ignorantly call themselves young ones in the streets, and this generation culture is not your culture. Whatever happened to the ancients, the hoary head, the elders of our nation, the kings? When we bethink, we come back to our heritage and to knowing who we are. Precepts: - Job 8:8 Enquire, I pray thee, of the former age, and prepare thyself to the search of their fathers. Prepare yourself for the search of your ancestors: when you learn from their examples, it gives us a guide for today. That is called legacy. Romans 15:4 1:27:44 - For whatsoever things were written aforetime were written for our learning, that we through patience and comfort of the scriptures might have hope. The things our fathers and ancestors went through are written to increase our faith. - That spirit of comfort: when you hear the word and it lifts the hairs on your skin, that is the spirit of comfort, the spirit of Christ, confirmation that you are in this thing. Pride in the right sense: dignity and integrity of who I am. The scriptures give you hope to endure the times we are in. Job 1:20-21 1:29:54 - Naked came I out of my mother's womb, and naked shall I return thither: the Lord gave, and the Lord hath taken away; blessed be the name of the Lord. In all this Job sinned not, nor charged God foolishly. - Job lost children, lost wealth, had boils and sickness upon him, and he endured all of it to glorify and magnify the Lord. Job was called to prove that God is real. That is the mindset we must have in the process of building our faith. Romans 5:3-5 1:31:34 - And not only so, but we glory in tribulations also. It may sound crazy to pray for hard times, but we have to embrace that this mission is not for us to be comfortable; then you can prepare and build your spirit in faith on how to handle hard times. Our people mostly listen and turn to God when things go crazy; when you are low, depressed, and oppressed, you have an outlet, a sanctuary, a home. - When the pandemic came and the earth stopped, what grounded us? God's word, still keeping the Sabbath. If it was not for this word, many of us would have gone back into the world, and many did. It is going to get even worse, so we have to prepare ourselves. - Knowing that tribulation worketh patience; and patience, experience; and experience, hope. Thank the Lord for hard times, because they make you pure as gold; that pressure makes the diamond. Like exercise, the tears in your spiritual muscles make you stronger to endure. But the only way to get like that is to hear the word of God: study and prepare your mind for what is to come. - Prepare for the worst and hope for the best. Leadership has been preparing us: times are going to get hard, famine is coming, and judgment is like a wheel. If you believe, you prepare in your household: food stores, water, the prepping team. Some of us do not even have a bag of rice in a Mylar bag. We had storehouses; that is part of our heritage. - And hope maketh not ashamed: I am not ashamed, because my Lord is going to comfort me, and in hard times I have brothers and sisters, family, order, and structure within my household and our nation. Acts 4:31-32 1:38:10 - When they had prayed, the place was shaken, and they were all filled with the Holy Ghost, and they spake the word of God with boldness. And the multitude of them that believed were of one heart and of one soul, and they had all things common. - We have to stop living beyond our means. Be content with your wages and content in life. A family of seven needs a house with some room, but if you are a single brother, why are you buying a mansion and expensive cars? Do you know the times we are living in? Money, riches, and comfort should not be your god; the American dream is the American lie. We must have all things in common, in faith and understanding, so that we do not lose our souls. - We live in an era where vanity and attention are a drug. At the outreach last week, the kids all said they want to be streamers. What about a plumber, a mechanic, a builder, an architect, a lawyer, an engineer: the things that actually build nations? That is part of why we have been destroyed as a people. Precepts: - 1 Timothy 4:1-2 Now the Spirit speaketh expressly, that in the latter times some shall depart from the faith, giving heed to seducing spirits, and doctrines of devils: seducing spirits of money and wealth that distract us from God and our purpose; doctrines of devils, man-made religion; speaking lies in hypocrisy, like the politics that make you feel assimilated into a government that is pushing you out of it. - 2 Timothy 3:1-5 This know also, that in the last days perilous times shall come. For men shall be lovers of their own selves: going for likes and followers, me, me, me, when it is not about you, it is about your people. Covetous, boasters of vanity, proud, blasphemers, disobedient to parents, unthankful, unholy, without natural affection: this is the nature of them that go after the world, after the gift that destroys the heart. - Acts 4:34-35 Neither was there any among them that lacked: distribution was made unto every man according as he had need. This nation is big, and millions of our people lack; when you sacrifice your much, it is much to them that have little. That is also why we travel and spread this gospel abroad. Hebrews 11:1-2 1:47:36 - Now faith is the substance of things hoped for, the evidence of things not seen. It is a belief system first: you hear the word and you have faith it will come to pass. But unlike the Christianity we were taught, the thinking process is not where it stops: faith without works is dead. - For by it the elders obtained a good report. A report is action, a reputation of doing something. It was not just that Abraham believed and Sarah believed and Job believed; there were actions behind the faith they had. Hebrews 11:8-10 1:48:40 - By faith Abraham, when he was called: Abraham was requested of God to go out into a place which he should after receive for an inheritance. He obeyed, and obedience is an action; and he went out, not knowing whither he went, trusting in the Lord. - By faith he sojourned in the land of promise, as in a strange country, dwelling in tabernacles with Isaac and Jacob. He had wealth and camels, but no roof over his head; he dwelt in tents, as was common in our culture. If we do not sleep one night in our own house, we begin to lose faith; Abraham showed the example of integrity through hard times. - We are going to have to get back to the point of being able to sojourn and dwell outside our comfortability: plans and preparation for when things pop off, having those conversations with your children and building up your wife now, so she is not confused or afraid. The time is now. - For he looked for a city which hath foundations, whose builder and maker is God. 1 Peter 3:14 1:53:08 - But and if ye suffer for righteousness' sake, happy are ye: and be not afraid of their terror. We must learn how to suffer for righteousness' sake; happy are they that keep God's laws. - Peter laid the instructions for marriages in hard times. We see marriage counsels where a sister is upset because her husband's socks are on the floor, or a sister wants to give up the faith and go back to the world, or a brother wants to be a whoremonger instead of a man of his nation leading his people. There are more trying times coming where you will be worried about surviving; how much more in a household where husband and wife are striving against each other? Our best tools are praying, fasting, studying, and increasing our faith, following the instructions laid forth. Precepts: - Psalms 119:165 Great peace have they which love thy law: and nothing shall offend them. Offenses and fear of tribulation will not make you turn your back on Christ. - 1 Peter 3:1 Likewise, ye wives, be in subjection to your own husbands; that, if any obey not the word, they also may without the word be won by the conversation of the wives. Sisters, your tone and how you speak toward your husband, especially in hard times, means a lot: how you respect your lord and king in your household shows the level of your faith. And not just husband and wife: all you sisters must honor the men of your nation. Satan attacked the marriage, the foundation Adam set up, and he went through the woman first; that is why you sisters have to build yourselves up. Marriage is honorable, and the bed undefiled. 1 Maccabees 1:11-14 1:56:30 - In those days went there out of Israel wicked men, who persuaded many, saying, Let us go and make a covenant with the heathen that are round about us: for since we departed from them we have had much sorrow. Out of our own people come forth the wicked of our nation; the enemy uses our own people to turn our people back to the evil. It is the same thing they said in the wilderness: let us go back to Egypt and enjoy the melons and the cucumbers; Egypt took care of us. - Then certain of the people went to the king, who gave them licence to do after the ordinances of the heathen. They asked to be part of the government, the system, to be assimilated: to call themselves Antiochians then, or in this day, I just want to be an American. We were robbed and spoiled of our nation, we became poor, so we groped toward the closest thing we thought would bring comfort, and forgot our one true God. - Whereupon they built a place of exercise at Jerusalem according to the customs of the heathen: they began to be like them. How do we make a covenant with the heathen today? When we facilitate ourselves in their politics, their religion, their government, the gifts that destroy the heart. - This is the most easy time of our generation compared to what came before: before this was Jim Crow and the black codes, before that slavery, and our ancestors endured through all of it. We learn from those times what is coming back around. Revelation 13:5-6 1:59:51 - And there was given unto him a mouth speaking great things and blasphemies. A clip was played from a popular superhero series where the character styled as America's savior receives the crown of thorns from a white Jesus: that is a form of blasphemy, and it is predictive programming, preparing people until it becomes normal and you are desensitized. - First and foremost, Christ is not a Caucasian; the Bible explains plainly that Christ is black. That is common knowledge to you, but in other places of the earth they are deceived with the Cesare Borgia image. - The scripture says if it were possible, they shall deceive the very elect. These illusions, AI, holograms, religions, and agendas are going to be so strong that if it were possible even the elect would be deceived; but they are not, because they are God's chosen. Them that are not the elect will be caught up. - There is a safe haven, and you are looking at it: a people keeping the commandments and faith in Christ throughout the world, decoding ourselves out of the system and the lie we were taught. Psalms 64:8 2:02:41 - So they shall make their own tongue to fall upon themselves: all that see them shall flee away. Their pride has reached to the height of heaven: they will set themselves up as gods and saviors of countries, even in a golden statue. - News discussed in class: a golden statue honoring the president was unveiled, and a black pastor was seen praying over it and blessing it. Where did God say this? The first commandment says make no graven image, no likeness of any thing, and bow not down to it. That is the wicked of our own people making a covenant with the heathen in real time: our people gravitating to the worship of the gods of Babylon, men who make themselves God. Why do we bring this up? So you know what not to do. Do not be deceived; these are not your gods, family. Job 5:12-17 2:23:18 - He disappointeth the devices of the crafty, so that their hands cannot perform their enterprise: what they plan in their secret chambers and think tanks. He taketh the wise in their own craftiness: their own tongue falls upon themselves. One of the organizations that long marked this nation as a hate group got caught up in its own scandal; and if another one comes, so what? All we do is promote righteous marriage and family. We just held an event honoring righteous marriage: husband and wife, as the Bible shows with Adam and Eve, Abraham and Sarah, Joseph and Mary. - But he saveth the poor from the sword, from their mouth, and from the hand of the mighty. So the poor hath hope, and iniquity stoppeth her mouth. Though the times get hard, we will have deliverance and peace in those trying times if we endure and continue in this faith. - Behold, happy is the man whom God correcteth: therefore despise not thou the chastening of the Almighty. Nothing is more pure and more rewarding than being corrected for your sins before the Lord and continuing to endure and perfect your soul. No matter what you are going through, at least you are preparing and building up your soul. - Every time you pass out a flyer, brother, sister, child, that is fulfilling prophecy; that is the next generation. They esteem us as evil, but world peace does not come until the righteous are in rulership, when Christ returns; the people mourn when the wicked bear rule, and rejoice when the righteous are in authority. Proverbs 3:31-32 2:10:30 - Envy thou not the oppressor, and choose none of his ways: not his religion, not his way of thinking, not his economics, not his way of life. We have to bethink how we need to be, and use this world as not abusing it, so we do not lose our souls. - For the froward is abomination to the Lord: but his secret is with the righteous. The first step in building up your faith is to read and search the scriptures. John 5:39 2:12:44 - Search the scriptures; for in them ye think ye have eternal life: and they are they which testify of me. When you see tribulations coming to pass, captivity, persecution for righteousness' sake, the wicked of our people assimilating with the enemy, you should say: wait a minute, this is in the scriptures. And the other side of that is the salvation that is written for you. - Faith begins with knowledge, understanding, and study. You cannot really believe in something you do not know of; that is why we make it a habit to study. Moses gave the law, and the prophets spoke of what happened when we broke God's laws and when we received mercy for coming back to them. Ecclesiasticus 17:25 2:14:59 - Return unto the Lord, and forsake thy sins, make thy prayer before his face, and offend less. This is the second step: separate yourself from evil. You begin to repent; you learn what and what not to do. - Why does it mention his face? Because of our sins he turned himself from us; and his face and what he looked like matter, because we have been praying to the wrong god from the beginning. Since we got off those ships, our oppressors made themselves our god and had dominion over us. So we subdue our understanding and separate ourselves from the ways of the oppressor. - Offend less means stop the sin: be ye perfect, even as your Father which is in heaven is perfect. We are striving for perfection. Amos 5:10-11 2:16:40 - They hate him that rebuketh in the gate, and they abhor him that speaketh uprightly. Your treading is upon the poor; ye have built houses of hewn stone, but ye shall not dwell in them. Do not be comfortable, family; that is what Amos is saying. Precepts: - Amos 5:15 Hate the evil, and love the good, and establish judgment in the gate: establish judgment in you, your household, your nation, and your communities, and it may be that the Lord God of hosts will be gracious unto the remnant of Joseph. David said, I love thy commandments, and I hate every false way. We are supposed to hate sin, hate that there is sin in our community, and do something about it by keeping God's law. We do not tolerate evil amongst our people. Revelation 18:4 2:18:52 - Come out of her, my people, that ye be not partakers of her sins, and that ye receive not of her plagues. What are we coming out of? What this society promotes: adultery, murder, sodomy, drunkenness, drug abuse, idolatry, wicked entertainment, and corruption; all the things God hates. - We must expose this evil so you can learn how to save your own soul. Look at what they call the young ones on the screen: our people smoking, toting guns, little kids with bullets bigger than they are. And then they call us a hate group when we are trying to stop the evil within our community first. Precepts: - Isaiah 5:20 Woe unto them that call evil good, and good evil; that put darkness for light, and light for darkness. America has blurred the line between good and evil; sin is deceitful. Who blurs that line? Many a pastor on every corner facilitating the continuance of your oppression. Acts 26:18 2:21:40 - To open their eyes, and to turn them from darkness to light, and from the power of Satan unto God, that they may receive forgiveness of sins. That is our purpose. Not your bodily eyes: pray that in times of tribulation the Lord opens your spiritual eyes and ears, that you can see and hear his understanding, maintain your godly discipline, and endure to the end. - Whenever you see the organizations and agencies coming against us, understand: they do not want you to come to your repentance and salvation. They will call it a cult; but the people are going to prove who is of God, because you cannot stop it. If this work be of men, it will come to nought; but if it be of God, ye cannot overthrow it. 1 Thessalonians 5:23 2:26:36 - And the very God of peace sanctify you wholly; and I pray God your whole spirit and soul and body be preserved blameless unto the coming of our Lord Jesus Christ. Before the return of the Lord, we are commanded to preserve our souls blameless, and blameless translates into perfection: maintaining our spirit with our faith and enduring so we can come to perfection. Ephesians 4:11-13 2:28:48 - When Christ ascended, he set up leadership and order: apostles, prophets, evangelists, pastors, and teachers, for the perfecting of the saints, for the work of the ministry, for the edifying of the body of Christ, till we all come in the unity of the faith. - Why do we have camps and schools? Because we always had them: the school of the prophets under Samuel, the sons of the prophets, the apostles' doctrine, the bodies of believers. There was always order, a sanctuary set up to raise up the teachers of Israel. - Never let anybody tell you that you cannot join a body of believers striving for righteousness. When somebody has a problem with the body, nine times out of ten there was something they did not want to get right with God. We do not profess that we are perfect; we are striving for perfection and learning the riches of the Lord's mercies. It is the same spirit as the wicked men of 1 Maccabees 1 and as Dathan in the wilderness, trying to hinder the deliverance. - Why must we increase our faith? So that we are not unequally yoked with this world; so that we can heal toxic marriages and nurture them in hard times; so we can discourage sinful environments and encourage righteousness amongst our nation; to do away with corrupt doctrines, religions, and the worldly influence that weakens your faith; and to come back to our heritage, our people, our God, and our King. Romans 12:9-13 2:34:26 - Let love be without dissimulation. Abhor that which is evil; cleave to that which is good. Come home, family. - Be kindly affectioned one to another with brotherly love; in honour preferring one another. The Lord wants us to get our spirit right for the kingdom: honoring one another within our marriages, our relationships, and our nation. - Not slothful in business: our business is that we are called by God to magnify the law and increase our faith. Fervent in spirit; serving the Lord by doing the work and helping your people. Rejoicing in hope; patient in tribulation; continuing instant in prayer; distributing to the necessity of saints. What better life to live than to help your people? Precepts: - Romans 12:21 Be not overcome of evil, but overcome evil with good. Do not let this world destroy your faith; with the good of these commandments and the faith of Christ, knowing who you are, you overcome that evil with the good of this Bible. In Closing The steps laid out today: first, study, pray, and apply; faith comes by hearing the word of God, and you must see yourself in the scriptures. Second, separate yourself from evil: return unto the Lord, forsake thy sins, and choose none of the oppressor's ways. Third, channel the sin and the pain we have suffered into righteousness: from the power of Satan unto God, from darkness unto light. We are called, requested of God, to magnify his law and make it honorable, and in hard times our faith must increase, not fail. Family, we love you. Most High Christ bless you. Announcements & References The class followed recent trips abroad: teams returned from Malawi and other lands after the worldwide blitz that carried the gospel through the whole earth, and from an outreach blitz at a music festival in Orlando the week before. A "Marriage Is Honorable" event was recently held promoting righteous marriage between husband and wife. Media referenced in class: the film Nefarious (possession comes by a series of yeses; sin is entertained, not accidental), the fourth Matrix film (the system upgraded so the freed man forgot he was free), a superhero series episode used as an example of blasphemy and predictive programming, and clips on the 13th Amendment's exception clause and convict leasing. --- Class Notes Index Transcript: full session

title: INTEGRATING INTO A BURNING HOUSE
text: Introduction Shalom, Israel. The Deacon brings forth the class, following the brothers who taught earlier in the day. There is a lot going on in the world, and the way this class works is to go into what is happening and show it in the scriptures, to prepare you for what is about to take place. Before the topic, a word on something that has been irritating for the last couple of weeks: the xenophobia in South Africa. Then the topic itself: integrating into a burning house. The thumbnail montage set it up, from the I have a dream speech, to the promise of black spending power, to a politician boasting he would have us voting one way for the next two hundred years, to Dr. King's own confession: I fear I have integrated my people into a burning house. In The News - Videos played from South Africa: crowds attacking and looting the stores of fellow Africans, telling Nigerians, Malians, and Ethiopians to get out of the country. They call it xenophobia, prejudice against immigrants. Ask yourself: beating people is assault, so where are the police, where are the politicians, why is nobody doing anything? Because it is a setup. Esau is behind what you see taking place in South Africa. - Video played of a European visitor being warmly welcomed and celebrated in South Africa amid the xenophobia concerns. The question is why the anger lands on brothers who look just like them while the white man is embraced. - Definition read in class: afrophobia is a specific form of racism, prejudice, and discrimination targeting black people, people of African descent, and African culture, manifesting as structural violence, hate speech, and dehumanization stemming from colonial era stereotypes. What you see in South Africa is not really xenophobia; it is afrophobia, self hatred, the same black on black hatred you see in the streets of America. - Reading shown in class: approximately 40 to 50 percent of all the gold ever mined in human history has been found in South Africa, specifically within the Witwatersrand Basin discovered in 1886, considered the richest gold deposit on earth; that gold rush led to the establishment of Johannesburg. So if half the gold ever mined came from South Africa, why are the black people of South Africa not rich? The wealth went to the colonizers. That is who the anger belongs to, not the brother with a little cart selling shoes and handbags. That is also why apartheid lasted so long and why the powers never intervened: money was being made, and they are still extracting gold from that same ground today. Scriptures Opened Leviticus 19:17 19:40 - Thou shalt not hate thy brother in thine heart; thou shalt not avenge, nor bear any grudge against the children of thy people. What you see going on in South Africa is the same thing you see going on in the United States of America. We as a people were destroyed in slavery and colonization; we have been taught to hate ourselves and to bear grudges against each other, and it manifests itself through violence: the gun violence in the streets of America, and the mobs in South Africa. - The people doing it there are the Zulu, and the Zulu tribe is Israel; they are Simeon. That does not mean all of them enter the kingdom, and it does not mean everybody in South Africa is our people, but that is who they are. Jeremiah 4:22 21:24 - For my people is foolish, they have not known me; they are sottish children, and they have none understanding. Sottish means stupid. God says it himself about his own people. People that look just like you come in and open little stores, and you are angry at them, when you are not angry at who you are supposed to be angry at: the ones who colonized you and carried off half the gold in the world from your own land. Hosea 7:11, 9-10 31:00 - Ephraim also is like a silly dove without heart. This curse that fell upon Ephraim fell upon all the tribes, even the tribes that are in Africa today. - Strangers have devoured his strength, and he knoweth it not. The strength is the riches: the gold of South Africa devoured by strangers, and the people do not know it. Gray hairs are here and there upon him, yet he knoweth not: you got old under the robbery and never understood who was robbing you. - The pride of Israel testifieth to his face: and they do not return to the Lord their God. The misplaced anger at Nigerians and Ghanaians instead of the real enemy is the silly dove in real time. Ecclesiastes 1:9 41:21 - The thing that hath been, it is that which shall be; and that which is done is that which shall be done. The same thing that man did in the past, he is going to come back and do again. There is no new thing under the sun. If you were wicked in the past, you will be wicked again; he that is righteous, let him be righteous still, and he that is evil, evil still. The righteous gravitate to the righteous and the wicked to the wicked. - Why this matters: what was done to us in slavery is a circle coming back around again. God's judgment is as a ring. Slavery is not over; the white man put on a smile, and now he is showing his real face. Like Antiochus, who died long ago, yet the scripture says he shall stand up against the Prince of princes: the same spirit comes back and does the same thing again. Precepts: - Ecclesiastes 6:10 That which hath been is named already, and it is known that it is man. The thing that repeats is man himself. 2 Esdras 15:7-11 45:02 - Therefore saith the Lord, I will hold my tongue no more as touching their wickedness: this is speaking of the persecution and killing of our people here in America. Behold, the innocent and righteous blood crieth unto me: they will shed the blood of innocent black and Hispanic men, and the Lord says, I will surely avenge them, and receive unto me all the innocent blood from among them. - Behold, my people is led as a flock to the slaughter: that is the Israelites in captivity. I will not suffer them now to dwell in the land of Egypt: the Egypt here is spiritual Egypt, which is America. Much oppression is going to take place on our people here, and you already see things being put in place to bring us under heavy oppression. - But I will bring them with a mighty hand and a stretched out arm, and smite Egypt with plagues, as before, and will destroy all the land thereof. The same way the Most High smote Egypt in the past, he is going to do it again, and this time the whole land will be destroyed. Exodus 1:8-11 49:10 - There arose a new king over Egypt which knew not Joseph: a new kingdom that did not respect Joseph or the Israelites. And he said, behold, the people of the children of Israel are more and mightier than we. Seventy souls went into ancient Egypt, a minority, and over time we became the majority; and we were mightier, better than the Egyptians in trade, farming, and education, and those Egyptians knew it. - Come on, let us deal wisely with them, lest they multiply: dealing wisely was setting up institutions of slavery and oppression to keep us at the bottom of their society, and to stop us from multiplying. - The same thing is happening in America, spiritual Egypt. The census exists to keep track of the numbers, and the numbers are divided up between blacks and Hispanics to keep the count looking small; but the twelve tribes of Israel are the majority in this land now. News clips played: demographers reporting that the gains in child populations are coming from the so called minority groups, that Hispanic, black, and Asian toddlers now outnumber their white counterparts, and a commentator saying plainly that within a generation white Americans will no longer be the numerical majority, and that this frightens those in power who fear being treated the way they treated others. - That is why you see the laws changing now, the mass deportations, the push against the fourteenth amendment. They are saying again, let us deal wisely with them. In the last sixty years, since they allowed us into their society, we have become the majority, and now the response is the same as Pharaoh's. - Do not fall for the lie that our people are inferior. When our people apply themselves, we excel above the nations. It has nothing to do with any DEI; we are better qualified. That is exactly why it was once against the law for us to read, and why the institutions were built to keep us at the bottom. Revelation 11:8 1:06:36 - The great city, which spiritually is called Sodom and Egypt: America is spiritual Egypt. The same way ancient Egypt set up institutions of oppression and slavery to keep us down in their society, modern day Egypt has done the same thing. Isaiah 28:14-15 1:07:24 - Hear the word of the Lord, ye scornful men, that rule this people which is in Jerusalem: the scornful men are sinful leaders ruling God's people, then and now, the leaders of the black community. - Because ye have said, we have made a covenant with death, and with hell are we at agreement. In Egypt our forefathers covenanted with Egypt; in the time of Christ the leaders made their agreement with Rome to stay in power; and during the civil rights movement the leaders of that time made a covenant and agreement with white America and its political machine. That is what the civil rights bargain was. - For we have made lies our refuge, and under falsehood have we hid ourselves: our people are comfortable in the lies that were sold to us in the 1960s. We trust in the lies of Christianity, the lies of their politics, the lies of Santa Claus and Easter, and we teach our children the lies. And some of those leaders hid themselves under falsehood, acting like they were for the people while they sold the people out. Not all of them: Dr. Martin Luther King really loved his people, and that is why he was killed. To see who sold him out, always look at who benefited the most when he died, and who was put up as the next leader for the black community. Habakkuk 2:4-5 1:09:19 - Behold, his soul which is lifted up is not upright in him: God tells you plainly about the soul of this people. You can try to make them right as much as you want, but the scripture stands. But the just shall live by his faith. - He transgresseth by wine, he is a proud man, neither keepeth at home: he does not stay in his own land. Who enlargeth his desire as hell, and is as death, and cannot be satisfied: anything he wants, he takes, and the lands he takes it from catch hell. This is a prophecy about America coming into power, and it calls America what? Hell and death. - But gathereth unto him all nations, and heapeth unto him all people: which nation on earth gathers all people, the great melting pot? Mystery Babylon the great: the United States of America, where every nation dwells, including the twelve tribes of Israel. Matthew 16:18 1:13:04 - Upon this rock I will build my church, and the gates of hell shall not prevail against it. The church is the body of Christ, the twelve tribes. The gates of hell Christ was speaking of at that time was Rome. John 11:48 1:13:49 - If we let him thus alone, all men will believe on him, and the Romans shall come and take away both our place and nation. This shows the relationship our leaders had with Rome: they made a covenant and agreement with Rome to keep their place. The hell and death of the time of Christ was Rome; the hell and death our leaders made an agreement with in the 1960s is the United States of Babylon. A history run down through the covenant with hell and death. In 1619 we were brought to the shores of Virginia as slaves. In 1787 the constitution was written: all men are created equal, freedom of speech, freedom of religion, the right to bear arms. But when the constitution was written, where were we? We were their property, counted as three fifths of a man, with no freedom of religion and no standing to take a master to court; the men who wrote it owned slaves. So when they said all men are created equal, they were not talking about us. Then came the reconstruction era, 1865 to 1877, when they alleged they freed us; but the same period birthed Jim Crow, laws written to enslave us again legally through the criminal system. From Jim Crow came the civil rights movement of the 1960s. Understand what that was: only sixty years ago the white man did not consider us human. Rights and laws had to be written; a small group of white people had to come together and pass laws to make the rest of them stop lynching, raping, and oppressing other human beings. That is not a long time ago; some of the same people from that era are alive today, and some sit as judges and politicians. Footage played in class from March 7th, 1965: peaceful protesters marching for the right to vote met with clubs and gas at Selma; the teaching point is that civil rights was never just about voting, it was about the right to be treated as a human being. Footage played of a sheriff refusing a minister's prayer and declaring there is no such thing as equality: that spirit did not die; it is the spirit coming back into the open today. And on one point that official was accidentally right: the equality the politicians sold our people was an illusion, an agreement on paperwork. If there were real equality, we would be on equal economic standing, and we are not. - Video played in class: the I have a dream refrain beside Dr. King's later confession, "that dream that I had that day has at many points turned into a nightmare." The American dream is really a nightmare. He said he had to analyze many things over the last few years and months, that he had gone through agonizing soul searching, and that some of the old optimism was superficial. He saw the setup. - Reading shown in class: Stanley Levison, born in New York in 1912 to a Jewish family, was a key co-author of the I have a dream speech and is best known as an advisor and close friend to Dr. King, for whom he helped write speeches, raise funds, and organize events. Pay attention to where the funding came from; when Dr. King began speaking against the war, the money and the respect were pulled, and he answered, "I'm sorry, but you don't know me. I'm not a consensus leader. I don't determine what is right and wrong by looking at the budget of my organization." - Video played in class: Dr. King on Selma and Birmingham: "many of the people who supported us in Selma and Birmingham were really outraged about the extremist behavior toward Negroes, but they were not at that moment, and they are not now, committed to genuine equality for Negroes. It is much easier to integrate a lunch counter than it is to guarantee an annual income, to get rid of poverty, to make quality education a reality, to get rid of slums." Article shown in class on the Jewish voices from the Selma to Montgomery march: the same circles that marched with him are the ones he said were never committed to genuine equality. The movement was hijacked. Everybody benefited from the civil rights movement more than the black Americans it was intended for: the feminists, the homosexual movement, other nations that arrived afterward. Even our Caribbean brothers benefited from what our big brothers here fought, bled, and died for. - Video played in class: Dr. King five days before his death, recounted by a friend: "We fought long for integration. It looks like we're going to get it. But I'm afraid that we're integrating into a burning house. America's lost whatever little moral vision it had, and a nation not governed by moral principles is headed for an abyss. Black people may be getting into a system that in the final analysis is a Sodom and Gomorrah." He was shown something. And in the mountaintop speech the night before he was killed: "I may not get there with you, but we as a people will get to the promised land. Mine eyes have seen the glory of the coming of the Lord." The promised land he spoke of was not America; he had already said America was a burning house. His dream changed from little boys and girls holding hands to we as a people. He heard and saw things that got him killed, and none of you speak evil against this man, because this man died for his people. Which one of you is ready to die for your people? - The big six of the civil rights movement were shown, and footage played of one of the national leaders of that era, an advisor to presidents, whose stated program was to give the Negro a stake in the system and to have the business community consciously include us: integration into corporate America. That is the angle Dr. King was against. The bargain took away our spending power: we had our own restaurants, our own buses, our own doctors and nurses, and our money circulated among us; integration sent it all into their corporations. They pacified the people with jobs, the way relief programs did in 1932, and the votes were sold to one party for generations, exactly as the thumbnail boast said. 2 Maccabees 4:14-15 2:28:25 - Definition read in class: assimilation is the process where a minority group adopts the dominant culture's norms and becomes indistinguishable from them, often losing their original culture; integration allows individuals to join a new society while retaining their original culture. The Chinese in America kept their customs, their own city, their own economic power; the Arabs kept their religion and their garments. All nations integrate. But the children of the slave trade were not integrated into American society; we were assimilated. We lost our culture. - The priests had no courage to serve any more at the altar, but, despising the temple and neglecting the sacrifices, hastened to be partakers of the unlawful allowance; not setting by the honours of their fathers, but liking the glory of the Grecians best of all. That is what happened to our people here: we love the white man's culture, his ways, and his god better than our own. You do not see the other nations worshipping the god of the people who enslaved them. What holidays do we keep? Fourth of July, Christmas, Easter: European holidays we learned in slavery. Deuteronomy 28:29 2:32:33 - Thou shalt grope at noonday, as the blind gropeth in darkness, and thou shalt not prosper in thy ways: and thou shalt be only oppressed and spoiled evermore. When Jim Crow ended and civil rights began, they did not end the oppression; they implemented another form of it, through the prisons, through war and crime in our communities. Only oppressed and spoiled evermore, until the Lord ends it. Isaiah 30:12-13 2:33:11 - Because ye despise this word, and trust in oppression and perverseness, and stay thereon. What does it mean to trust in oppression? The people that enslaved you: you follow their god, you trust in their court system, you trust in their religion, you trust in their politics. It has been sixty years; what changed? The ghettos are still here. - Therefore this iniquity shall be to you as a breach ready to fall: the trinkets they gave us during the civil rights era, hijacked and handed to everyone, are a wall ready to collapse. Jeremiah 8:11 2:35:51 - For they have healed the hurt of the daughter of my people slightly, saying, Peace, peace; when there is no peace. That slight healing was the civil rights settlement: the leaders said peace, the white man has changed, he is not lynching us any more. But the institutions were built on racism and set up to keep us at the bottom of society, and the work simply moved out of sight. Slightly healed is not healed. Wisdom of Solomon 14:21-22 2:38:03 - Men serving either calamity or tyranny: the calamity is slavery, the bad thing that happened to us; the tyranny is the tyrant, the oppressive system we serve in. - Whereas they lived in the great war of ignorance, those so great plagues called they peace. There is a war going on and your leaders tell you it is peace. Ignorance means you know nothing: ask our people when Christ was born, what color Christ is, who the black man and the Puerto Rican man are, and hear the answers. The truth has been hidden from us, and we call the plagues we live in peace. Deuteronomy 28:68 2:43:01 - And the Lord shall bring thee into Egypt again with ships: not the Egypt of the past, for thou shalt see it no more again, but another Egypt reached by ships. And there ye shall be sold unto your enemies for bondmen and bondwomen: the cargo slave ships that brought us to America, spiritual Egypt. Deuteronomy 29:14-15 2:43:45 - Neither with you only do I make this covenant and this oath; but also with him that is not here with us this day: that is us, the generations to come, the slaves that would go into the second Egypt on ships. Chapter 29 is a continuation of chapter 28. Deuteronomy 29:19-23 2:44:30 - When he heareth the words of this curse, that he bless himself in his heart, saying, I shall have peace: that is our people in America saying, I follow white Jesus, I am good, I am happy, living under the illusion while walking in the imagination of their own heart. - The Lord will not spare him, but the anger of the Lord and his jealousy shall smoke against that man, and all the curses that are written in this book shall lie upon him. - The generation to come, and the stranger from a far land, shall say, when they see the plagues of that land, and the sicknesses which the Lord hath laid upon it, that the whole land thereof is brimstone, and salt, and burning, like the overthrow of Sodom and Gomorrah. Burning. That is America, that is Egypt, that is the burning house Dr. King said he had integrated his people into. He read of Sodom and Gomorrah and saw that this is America. Jeremiah 50:31-38 2:47:25 - Behold, I am against thee, O thou most proud, saith the Lord God of hosts: for thy day is come, the time that I will visit thee. The most proud shall stumble and fall, and none shall raise him up: and I will kindle a fire in his cities, and it shall devour all round about him. A fire in the cities of America: that is the burning Dr. King saw. - Thus saith the Lord of hosts; The children of Israel and the children of Judah were oppressed together: we are oppressed here in America, and we are together. And all that took them captives held them fast; they refused to let them go: proof that we are still slaves. They never let us go. - Their Redeemer is strong; the Lord of hosts is his name: he shall throughly plead their cause, that he may give rest to the land, and disquiet the inhabitants of Babylon. A sword is upon the Chaldeans, upon her princes and her wise men, upon the liars, upon her mighty men, upon her horses and chariots, and upon all the mingled people that are in the midst of her: all the nations living here in America are the mingled people. A sword is upon her treasures, and a drought is upon her waters. Jeremiah 51:25 2:50:53 - Behold, I am against thee, O destroying mountain, saith the Lord, which destroyest all the earth: and I will stretch out mine hand upon thee, and roll thee down from the rocks, and will make thee a burnt mountain. That is the burning house Dr. King saw. With that, shalom; the Bishop is coming up next. In Closing The thing that has been is the thing that shall be. Pharaoh said, let us deal wisely with them, and the same words are being acted out in America now that the count has turned. Our leaders made a covenant with hell and death, the movement was hijacked, and we were assimilated, not integrated: healed slightly, told peace when there is no peace. Dr. King saw the end of it and called it a burning house, and the scriptures call it brimstone, salt, and burning, like the overthrow of Sodom and Gomorrah. Do not trust in oppression; return to the Lord, because our Redeemer is strong, and he shall throughly plead our cause. Announcements & References This was the afternoon session of the Sabbath; the Bishop's class followed immediately after. Documents and media referenced in class: - Definition readings on afrophobia, and on assimilation versus integration - Readings on the Witwatersrand gold rush of 1886 and the founding of Johannesburg - Biography reading on Stanley Levison, co-author of the I have a dream speech and fundraiser for the movement - The big six of the civil rights movement, with archival interview footage of the corporate integration program of that era - Archival footage: the Selma march of March 7th, 1965; the Selma courthouse confrontation; Dr. King's Selma and Birmingham reflections, the nightmare confession, the account of the burning house conversation five days before his death, and the mountaintop speech - Article on the Jewish voices from the Selma to Montgomery march of March 21st, 1965 --- Class Notes Index Transcript: full session

title: SHAPEN IN INIQUITY: RESETTING THE NERVOUS SYSTEM
text: Introduction Sabbath class from Gastonia, in the Carolinas, taught by Captain Galayah, with Bishop Yahwasap in the building. Opening prayer: pour out your spirit, Father, and let thy words be in his mouth, to heal the nation quickly and speedily; gather the elect and the twelve tribes. Today's lesson is Shapen In Iniquity: Resetting The Nervous System. For the last year, almost two years now, Bishop Yahwasap and the captains here in the Carolinas have been having a lot of discussions about psychology and the mind, and how we have to heal our people, not only from a physical standpoint but from a mental standpoint. The number one health crisis in the United States of America and throughout the world right now is mental health, and every generation our people are declining. The Most High has found it fit to give us the truth of the scriptures; now it is our job to go into the Bible, and also into psychology, and help heal our people. Scriptures Opened Genesis 2:7 8:36 - The Lord God formed man of the dust of the ground, and man became a living soul. People talk about evolution, that man came from primates; that is not true. The Bible says man was made from the dust of the ground, and we are going to prove what we say out of the word of God. - Science is only good if it goes with the Bible; if it contradicts the Bible, we are not interested. Infographic read in class, "From dust to dust, the elements that connect us to Earth": the human body is primarily composed of elements also found in soil. The main six elements responsible for life, carbon, hydrogen, nitrogen, oxygen, phosphorus, and sulfur, are found in every cell, molecule, and structure in the body, and make up over 99 percent of our mass; the essential minerals, calcium, potassium, magnesium, sodium, and chlorine, and the trace elements, iron, zinc, silicon, and manganese, are the same nutrients found in the soil. We come from the earth, and to the earth we return, just like the Bible says. - The Most High is a mastermind, the author of beauty, the creator of all things. He knew what he was doing when he pulled Adam from the dust of the ground. The human body is literally a testament to God's word being true. - The other nations make sure we are deficient in these things; a lot of the foods we eat diminish them. So it is important that we maintain a healthy diet, brothers and sisters. Precepts: - Ecclesiasticus 33:10 All men are from the ground, and Adam was created of earth. The second witness. 1 Corinthians 15:47-49 15:48 - The first man is of the earth, earthy: that's Adam. The second man is the Lord from heaven: that's Christ. As is the earthy, such are they also that are earthy: just like Adam was earthy, so are we; we come from the same soil our father came from. - As we have borne the image of the earthy: we are mortal; Adam lost his immortality. We shall also bear the image of the heavenly: that is a promise from God. He is going to change our cellular structure and give us a new body, no longer this weak, frail body that has to die. Wisdom of Solomon 2:23-24 17:12 - God created man to be immortal, and made him to be an image of his own eternity: although Adam was made from the dust of the ground, in the beginning he could not die. - Nevertheless through envy of the devil came death into the world: and they that do hold of his side, that follow Satan's doctrine and his idolatry, are going to die with him. The only way back to immortality is to come back to the Lord. No idol can give you eternal life; not Buddha, Krishna, Vishnu, or the gods of the Egyptologists. Eternal life comes through one source: the Most High. John 5:21-24 18:56 - As the Father raiseth up the dead and quickeneth them, even so the Son quickeneth whom he will: quicken means to make alive. Christ has the same power. - A word for the trinitarians: the Father hath committed all judgment unto the Son. For me to commit something to you means I had it first and you did not. The Father gave judgment to Christ so that all men should honour the Son even as they honour the Father; the one who gives is the one with the supreme authority. There is no co-eternal, co-substantial confusion here. - He that heareth my word, and believeth on him that sent me, hath everlasting life: the only way to get life is to believe on Christ and keep the commandments. That is the immortality Adam had at the beginning and lost through sin. 2 Esdras 3:21-26 21:29 - The first Adam, bearing a wicked heart, transgressed and was overcome; and so be all they that are born of him. Since Adam sinned, everybody that comes after him, all of us that have borne his image, have sinned as well. - Thus infirmity was made permanent. Definition read in class: an infirmity is a physical or mental weakness, frailty, or ailment, often associated with old age, chronic illness, or a condition that reduces a person's vitality. Was Adam feeling physical pain when he was first created? When Adam got cast down, and his descendants with him, then came the backaches and body aches and headaches; the woman now has the menstrual cycle and feels the pains of childbearing. When our father fell, we all fell with him, and now we all face infirmity, physical and mental weakness. Focus on the mental. - The good departed away, and the evil abode still: the immortality departed, but that evil nature is still in our flesh. And in all things did even as Adam and all his generations had done, for they also had a wicked heart. 2 Esdras 4:30-31 25:20 - The grain of evil seed hath been sown in the heart of Adam from the beginning, and how much ungodliness hath it brought up unto this time, and how much shall it yet bring forth until the time of threshing come. The time of threshing is when Christ returns; until then we are going to be surrounded by evil. - That is why you hear Bishop Yahwasap and the elders say we are not trying to build a metropolis, but we are building a nation within a nation. Christ is the one who is going to correct all the wickedness and give us immortality; but while we are here, we have a job to do. It is our job to heal ourselves so that we can heal our people. 2 Esdras 7:48 27:05 - O thou Adam, what hast thou done? For though it was thou that sinned, thou art not fallen alone, but we all that come of thee. Our forefathers had understanding of why we are in the condition we are in; and we furthered our own affliction by sinning against the Most High God ourselves. We made it worse, and we are continuing to make it worse as a nation of people. Psalms 51:5 27:53 - Behold, I was shapen in iniquity, and in sin did my mother conceive me. An officer teaching on a college campus in San Antonio was approached by a Christian pastor with a film crew arguing about the virgin birth, and this scripture came up. The officer asked him: did Christ sin? No, he did not; yet he was born of a woman into this same flesh. What does that show? Although Christ was in this sinful flesh, he did not give in to it, which means we can do it too. He set an example that we should follow his steps. - Shapen in iniquity is talking about the sinful nature of this flesh, which you do not have to give in to. We can overcome the things in our mind; we can overcome what we have been through; we can overcome our trauma. But it is up to us to have our mind right with the Lord in order to do so. - When people are convinced to go back into their old environment, that is trauma they are going back to. They feel comfortable in that traumatic state, in who they used to be; it is more comfortable to sit in your mess than to stand up and change your mind. That is why some people stay overweight: they have not conditioned their mind that I am a man of God and I am going to do something about it. Matthew 26:41 31:13 - Watch and pray, that ye enter not into temptation: the spirit indeed is willing, but the flesh is weak. Christ did not give a license to sin here. He is saying: I know your spirit wants to do right, but do not sleep on that flesh you are in. I know what happened when Adam fell; I know you are tempted; do not fall into the temptation. He gave us the keys. Romans 7:14-25 31:54 - The law is spiritual, but I am carnal, sold under sin: carnal because I am in this carnal flesh. Paul is describing the mental battle: that which I do, I allow not; what I would, that do I not. Paul is not admitting himself to be in sin; he is telling you that mentally he is fighting against the flesh. - If then I do that which I would not, I consent unto the law that it is good. Every time you have an opportunity to sin and you choose God's word over sin, you are consenting that the law has been good the whole time. I could lie right now, but I am not going to, because the Bible says lie not one to another; I just consented that God's law is good. Every single time we refuse a sin, we are saying God is right and I am wrong. - So when somebody tells you that you cannot keep God's laws, that is a lie. They do not get up and murder people; they do not rob banks. Why not? Because they are consenting that God's law is good. Although we are in this carnal flesh, we prove daily that we can apply God's commandments to our life. - I find then a law, that, when I would do good, evil is present with me: sin is always hovering, the old man trying to pull you back into wickedness. I see another law in my members, warring against the law of my mind: this body does not play fair. - O wretched man that I am! Who shall deliver me from the body of this death? I thank God through Jesus Christ our Lord. With the mind I myself serve the law of God, but with the flesh the law of sin. This is the battle of every man and every woman on this earth. The difference between them and us is that we know why we battle it, and we have the keys to fix it. - That is why, when a brother makes a mistake, we do not instantly look at him as evil. Everybody does something for a reason; you have to ask why. The only way to healing is to know where it stems from. Wisdom of Solomon 9:14-15 38:08 - For the thoughts of mortal men are miserable, and our devices are but uncertain. Some of us do things and do not even realize why. Some of us have anger issues and do not know where they stem from; some of us are depressed and cannot find the source. Why is my heart rate always up? Why do I sweat when nothing is happening? Something is turning your wheel; some mental anguish is being dealt with in the moment. - For the corruptible body presseth down the soul, and the earthy tabernacle weigheth down the mind that museth upon many things. Definition read in class: to muse means to think deeply, meditate, ponder, or murmur on something, to consider closely or study in silence. Our minds muse daily upon many things: why did that person die, where did I go wrong, should I have married her, what could happen to my daughters. Most of you toss and turn every night, especially the man carrying the burden of his whole family. This earthy tabernacle is what causes us to overthink and overanalyze everything. Precepts: - Psalms 143:5 Listen to the word David used: I muse on the work of thy hands. He would think on why life is the way it is, why we suffer certain conditions. Even Esdras said it was not in his mind to know the deep things, but to know why Israel suffers what we suffer. Wisdom of Solomon 7:17-20 42:39 - God gave Solomon certain knowledge of the things that are: how the world was made, the operation of the elements, the natures of living creatures and the furies of wild beasts (zoology), the violence of winds (meteorology), and the reasonings of men. What is the study of the reasonings of men called? Psychology. - Solomon was not just a king; Solomon was a psychologist, and his father David was too. Go read Psalms and you will see things repeated in Proverbs that were written in Psalms. Abraham, Noah, Moses: these were the men of the Most High God, the sons of God. Stop picturing what the world painted; these men held the way of knowledge. - You will fall asleep reading the Bible but stay up watching TED talks about psychology, not knowing that all of that research stands on a foundation, which is the Bible. Baruch 3:35-37 45:04 - This is our God, and there shall none other be accounted of in comparison of him. He hath found out all the way of knowledge, and hath given it unto Jacob his servant, and to Israel his beloved. All the way of knowledge: psychology, and neurology too, how the brain works. Our forefathers knew how to heal people of their infirmities. - The nations have been trying to replicate what is in this book. At the United Nations they hand you an earpiece so every man hears in his own language; that happened at Pentecost. In Genesis 11 everybody spoke one language and the Lord confounded it. Read your Bible with new eyes; stop reading it from a place of boredom. - Afterward did he shew himself upon earth, and conversed with men: the Most High never came down and walked among men; this is the Son of God, Jesus the Christ. He came down and taught us the wisdom, and gave the apostles power to do what he could do for a season. Ecclesiasticus 40:1-8 48:12 - Great travail is created for every man, and an heavy yoke is upon the sons of Adam, from the day they go out of their mother's womb till the day that they return to the mother of all things: from birth to death. Their imagination of things to come, and the day of death, trouble their thoughts and cause fear of heart. - From him that sitteth on a throne of glory, unto him that is humbled in earth and ashes: it does not matter if you are rich or poor; every man and woman has the same issues. Money does not heal trauma; that is why many athletes and entertainers fall apart when they retire and have to actually be with themselves. - And in the time of rest upon his bed his night's sleep do change his knowledge: you overthink at night. Some of you wake up out of evil dreams, dreams of death, of losing a loved one, of losing your job, and you are troubled in the vision of your heart as if you escaped out of a battle; and when all is safe, you awake and marvel that the fear was nothing. Thank God it was just a dream. Every man and woman goes through this, because when Adam fell, we all fell. - Such things happen unto all flesh, both man and beast, and that is sevenfold more upon sinners. It is seven times worse if you are in sin. Hold that verse; we are coming back to it. - Teaching on the nervous system: the central nervous system is the command center, the brain and spinal cord; the peripheral nervous system is the communication network carrying signals between the brain and your organs, muscles, and skin. You put your hand on a hot stove, and the signal makes you feel the pain and pull away; the nervous system is built to protect you. The somatic system controls voluntary movement; the autonomic system regulates involuntary functions like heart rate, digestion, and breathing; the sympathetic side is fight or flight, activating the body for survival; the parasympathetic side is rest and digest, calming the body, conserving energy, and promoting healing. - Some of us have that rest and digest side jacked up: our bodies are not able to get into a state of calm, we barely sleep, and our bodies are not healing. The Bible is telling you all flesh goes through these things, but it is worse in sin. - How stress and trauma affect the nervous system: the amygdala is the threat detector that triggers fight or flight, releasing cortisol and adrenaline. If you have been through trauma, your threat detection fires all the time. Everybody is a threat: do not trust him, do not trust my wife, do not trust my co-workers; I will just be an introvert, alone in the house. A lot of us have lived that life. - Under extreme trauma the calming system can fail to downregulate, leading to a freeze or a fawn response. Freeze goes into numbness and dissociation. Fawn means you put yourself to constant work: OCD, I have to clean, I have to move, I cannot sit down. - Trauma causes long term changes to key brain regions: the amygdala (threat detection), the hippocampus (memory and context; that is why sometimes you cannot remember things), and the prefrontal cortex (decision making and regulation; some people keep making horrible decisions and do not understand why). Dysregulation symptoms: hyperarousal, constantly on edge, irritable, anxious, panicky; or hypoarousal, feeling numb, exhausted, disconnected, emotionally detached. Brother, why are you missing assignments, why are you not on the Telegram, what is going on in your life? The first thing we say is, he is out of the spirit; that may be true, but why is what we should be asking. - Video played on the vagus nerve: the longest cranial nerve in the body, running from the brain stem into the stomach, regulating stress, digestion, and emotional safety. When it is dysregulated you feel numb, exhausted, and dissociated, you self-isolate, and small tasks feel overwhelming; prolonged stress or trauma can put the body into a freeze state. And you can absolutely restimulate it and get your energy back. There is hope, and the word of God is how we are going to do it. - Ongoing traumatic stress leads to physical consequences: high blood pressure, digestive issues, chronic pain, weak immune function. This is where we come in as husbands and leaders: we set the example first, so we should not have unhealthy, out of shape men among us. The men lead the nation; nobody is coming to lead our nation for us. Luke 10:39-42 57:08 - Mary sat at Christ's feet and heard his word, but Martha was cumbered about much serving: that is a fawn response, moving around, I have to do this, I have to take care of that. - Christ answered, Martha, Martha, thou art careful and troubled about many things: but one thing is needful, and Mary hath chosen that good part. Some of us immerse ourselves in things to do so we do not have to deal with our thoughts. The Bible also says be not idle, so we have to find the balance: sometimes you have to sit down, let your brain and body rest, meditate in the word of God, fast, and pray. Psalms 109:20-22 1:08:17 - Definition read in class: the word trauma is Greek for a wound, a hurt, a defeat. When we say you are traumatized, we are saying you are wounded; and a wound has to be treated so it can be healed. - David said, I am poor and needy, and my heart is wounded within me. What is David describing? Trauma. I told you these men were psychologists; they understood emotions and emotional regulation long before the modern terms existed. Proverbs 15:13 1:09:48 - By sorrow of the heart the spirit is broken. A broken spirit: that is trauma. Psalms 34:18 1:10:10 - The Lord is nigh unto them that are of a broken heart, and saveth such as be of a contrite spirit. How is he near you? Through this Bible; you have the words to break it all. They did not count on us picking up this book and learning the truth of who we are, learning how to change our diet, control our desires, stop lying, and set up order and structure in our communities. And the Lord sent the Comforter, the Holy Spirit, to comfort us in our trauma. But you have to believe that you can heal from it. - TED talk played (about six minutes), from a pediatrician on childhood trauma: in the mid 90s the CDC and Kaiser Permanente discovered an exposure that dramatically increased the risk for seven out of ten of the leading causes of death in the United States; in high doses it affects brain development, the immune system, hormonal systems, and even the way DNA is read and transcribed, with triple the lifetime risk of heart disease and lung cancer and a twenty year difference in life expectancy. The exposure is childhood trauma: abuse, neglect, or growing up with a parent struggling with mental illness or substance dependence. - She opened a clinic in one of the poorest neighborhoods of San Francisco, and kids kept being referred for ADHD; but on a thorough history, most had experienced such severe trauma that something else was going on. In public health school they teach: if a hundred kids all drink from the same well and 98 of them develop diarrhea, you can write prescription after prescription, or you can walk over and ask what is in this well. The Lord is working on our people: writing the prescription keeps them rich, but she wanted to know why the people are sick. - The Adverse Childhood Experiences study asked seventeen and a half thousand adults about exposure to ACEs: physical, emotional, or sexual abuse; physical or emotional neglect; parental mental illness, substance dependence, incarceration; parental separation or divorce; domestic violence. Pause: did she not just describe our existence, everything our community has endured? ACEs are incredibly common: 67 percent of the population had at least one, and one in eight had four or more, with a dose response relationship: the higher the ACE score, the worse the health outcomes. - Back to Ecclesiasticus 40:8: such things happen unto all flesh, and that is sevenfold more upon sinners. And who did they teach to sin? What community do they keep in sin, knowing it leads to sickness later in life? The liquor store in our community, the drugs in our community, no banks, no loans; it is systematic, and every industry profits from what we have been through. This is why you brothers are called to heal: millions of our people are waiting on us to stand up, teach them the word of God, and help them heal. - From the ACE study PDF: the ACE score adds up the categories reported, from 0 to 10. The pyramid starts at adverse childhood experiences at the base, which lead to social, emotional, and cognitive impairment, which lead to the adoption of health risk behaviors, which lead to disease, disability, and social problems, and early death.
