Risk factors associated with the score: alcoholism, smoking, illicit drug use, obesity, suicide attempts, depression, anxiety, hallucinations, teen pregnancy, spontaneous abortion or fetal death, intimate partner violence, poor quality of life; diseases and early mortality: chronic obstructive pulmonary disease, ischemic heart disease, liver disease, sexually transmitted diseases, lung cancer, death before age 65. - Definition read: a spontaneous abortion, more commonly known as a miscarriage, is the unexpected ending of a pregnancy before the 20th week, affecting roughly 10 to 20 percent of recognized pregnancies. Many of the miscarriages our sisters suffer stem from stress and trauma; the body cannot carry a certain stress level in pregnancy. You have to believe the word of God, forgive, and let go; it is affecting your body. - Neglect goes hand in hand with abuse: if a child was harmed, that child was also unprotected. And physical neglect is broader than we think: feeding children nothing but processed food and sugar, never teaching them to exercise or eat, tuning your children out and handing them a tablet instead of time; that is leading them down a path to be sick as adults. A child is supposed to be able to talk to their parents. Ephesians 6:12 1:24:01 - We wrestle not against flesh and blood, but against principalities, against powers, against the rulers of the darkness of this world, against spiritual wickedness in high places. We are fighting against Satan, and Satan has an agenda to destroy the children of Israel; the rest of the people caught up in the system are collateral damage to him. - Book read in class, Trauma Letters, on Erik Erikson's stages of development: human development occurs across eight sequential stages, each presenting a critical psychological challenge. When a child successfully navigates each stage, they build the foundation for the next; when stages are disrupted by absence, neglect, trauma, or instability, the unresolved tension carries forward into every phase of life. The infant who does not develop trust carries a deep seated suspicion of the world; the toddler who is not affirmed grows into an adult plagued by insecurity and self doubt; the adolescent who does not form a stable identity may spend decades searching for themselves in the wrong places: relationships, achievements, or addictions. Is this not our life? And they knew it, and made sure we grew up in these conditions. - Childhood trauma is not merely a past event: when developmental steps are missed, the wound is carried forward, shaping adult thought patterns, relational expectations, and spiritual identity. Healing must address the stage at which the wound occurred, not the surface symptoms. That means you have to go back, find where it took place, and heal from that point: forgive your father, forgive your mother, and let it go. - The book also lays out the divine design of parental guidance: train up a child in the way he should go (Proverbs 22:6); parents are appointed as the primary conduit through which God's wisdom, law, and love flow into the next generation (Deuteronomy 6). When parents are absent, wounded, or disengaged, a door is opened for trauma, confusion, and spiritual vulnerability; we open up portals to Satan. - Born into a curse: Deuteronomy 28:19 speaks of a curse that follows those who fail to walk in the ordinances of God. A curse is a pattern of traumatic, oppressive, destructive conditions that operate generationally: systemic injustice, family dysfunction, cycles of addiction, emotional neglect, mass fatherlessness, poverty, broken covenant. These are not accidents; they are the fruit of generational curses left unbroken. That is Deuteronomy 28. Go back and read it and you will see trauma, trauma, trauma. 1 Maccabees 3:43 1:35:39 - They said one to another, Let us restore the decayed estate of our people, and let us fight for our people. That is our mission, brothers: we have to restore the decayed state of our people. That is why we have to learn this terminology, learn the word of God, apply it to our lives, and go out and teach our people. Jeremiah 2:21 1:36:14 - The Lord planted us a noble vine, wholly a right seed: he gave us the commandments and made us the top people on the earth. How then art thou turned into the degenerate plant of a strange vine unto me? Precepts: - Jeremiah 2:19 How did we become that degenerate plant? Thine own wickedness shall correct thee, and thy backslidings shall reprove thee. It is an evil thing and bitter that thou hast forsaken the Lord thy God. Look at our conditions. Deuteronomy 28:65-67 1:41:17 - Among these nations shalt thou find no ease; but the Lord shall give thee there a trembling heart, and failing of eyes, and sorrow of mind. What is a trembling heart? Trauma, a wounded heart. Sorrow of mind: constant depression and anxiety. The code switching alone: I have to be one way at work, then decompress before I walk through my own door so my wife and children do not feel the effects of what I endured all day. - And thy life shall hang in doubt before thee: you ever see your boss's number come up and your heart drops? No man should have that power over your life. That is stress; some of us still feel the phantom vibration of a work phone months after leaving the job. - In the morning thou shalt say, Would God it were even! and at even thou shalt say, Would God it were morning! for the fear of thine heart wherewith thou shalt fear. Is that not us? - Illustration from the series Them: a family moves from North Carolina to California during the Great Migration after their baby son is killed, hoping for a better life, and the neighborhood terrorizes them; in the next generation the daughter's children end up in foster care, abused and separated, and the boy is destroyed by it. That is intergenerational trauma dramatized. - Reading: intergenerational trauma is the transmission of the psychological and physiological effects of trauma from one generation to the next; untreated trauma such as systemic oppression or abuse alters a family's environment, behaviors, or even gene expression, leaving descendants susceptible to anxiety, depression, and PTSD. You feel a certain way and do not know why; you are feeling your father's pain. - Epigenetics: traumatic experiences can cause chemical modifications to genes. They do not alter the DNA sequence itself, but they affect how genes are expressed, leaving descendants with a lowered baseline for regulating stress. Exodus 20:5 1:47:37 - Visiting the iniquity of the fathers upon the children unto the third and fourth generation of them that hate me. What is that called? Intergenerational trauma: those conditions pass down generation after generation. And that is why the Willie Lynch letter said the cycle would continue unless a phenomenon occurs; that phenomenon is repentance and the knowledge of who you are as an Israelite. John 9:1-2 1:48:40 - The disciples asked, Master, who did sin, this man, or his parents, that he was born blind? Why would they ask that? These were not ignorant fishermen; these men had the wisdom of God. They understood epigenetics; they understood intergenerational trauma; they understood Deuteronomy 28. These men were psychologists. - Does that not light a fire under you? Your forefathers were the greatest men on earth and we descend from them. There is nothing we cannot do and no knowledge we cannot learn. We have to change our mindset, brothers. Ezekiel 18:1-3 1:50:06 - The fathers have eaten sour grapes, and the children's teeth are set on edge: the present generation punished for the offenses of their forefathers. Commentary read in class: the people were prone to plead their innocence, saying, I am this way because my father was this way. - As I live, saith the Lord God, ye shall not have occasion any more to use this proverb. The Lord is saying: I am not letting you use intergenerational trauma as your excuse. Precepts: - Ezekiel 18:14 If he beget a son that seeth all his father's sins which he hath done, and considereth, and doeth not such like: a son can see it and change. - Ezekiel 18:19-20 When the son hath done that which is lawful and right, and hath kept all my statutes, he shall surely live. The son shall not bear the iniquity of the father. Intergenerational trauma is real; but do you sit in it, or do you change? Just because our fathers were wicked, and our mothers did not know God's laws, that is not an excuse to stay in this. Recognize it and move on from it. Matthew 9:11-13 1:53:20 - They that be whole need not a physician, but they that are sick. I will have mercy, and not sacrifice: for I am not come to call the righteous, but sinners to repentance. Although we have been through traumatic experiences, the Lord says, I am still going to have mercy. That is every last one of us; Christ has given us a clean slate, so we cannot use what we have been through as an excuse anymore. - Reading on the brain's reward system: it is a network of structures that processes pleasure, motivation, and learning, releasing dopamine when we engage in vital behaviors so that we repeat them. This is why some people get addicted to sex, drugs, and overeating. We should be getting that reward from the fellowship and the work of the ministry; when you first come into the truth you are excited, but some fall numb and slide back into old ways. You have to change it. Hebrews 11:24-25 1:55:28 - Moses chose rather to suffer affliction with the people of God than to enjoy the pleasures of sin for a season. Because you grew up in a world of sin, your pleasures are in sin; your dopamine hits come from things that are against God. But the brain is not static: it can form new ideas and change habits. You control it. Romans 7:7-8 1:56:27 - I had not known sin, but by the law: the only way you know you are in sin against God is by referring back to his laws. When you read God's laws you say, he said do not do this; I have to change that. This is how you get the brain right. - Sin, taking occasion by the commandment, wrought in me all manner of concupiscence. Definition read in class: concupiscence is an intense longing or desire, a disordered human inclination or tendency to sin, stemming from selfish, worldly, or carnal appetites. That is the sinful nature, the shapen in iniquity. Ecclesiasticus 23:16-17 1:58:16 - A hot mind is as a burning fire, it will never be quenched till it be consumed: that is the inclination to sin, that concupiscence. All bread is sweet to a whoremonger: that dopamine he has to have. Speaking from experience of the old life: the men who stayed in the club until the lights came on were not there for a good time; that lifestyle is a chase that never satisfies. Hebrews 3:13 2:00:03 - Exhort one another daily, while it is called To day; lest any of you be hardened through the deceitfulness of sin. You get hardened because you have been in the sin so long you start to think that is the only way. No: God's laws are the way. - Psychological note read from the book: the concept of emotional triggers as conditioned responses was advanced by trauma researchers including Peter Levine (Waking the Tiger, 1997), who described how the nervous system stores unresolved traumatic experiences and reactivates them in response to environmental cues. Ecclesiasticus 27:12 2:01:20 - If thou be among the indiscreet, observe the time; but be continually among men of understanding. Be around likeminded people that are on the same healing journey. Proverbs 12:26 2:01:40 - The righteous is more excellent than his neighbour: but the way of the wicked seduceth them. It is impossible to sit among people who put you through traumatic experiences, or who remind you of the old life of drugs and drunkenness, and stay whole; those environmental cues reactivate what is stored. You have to separate yourself. - Some of you love your mama so much that you will sit at her house and hear her speak evil of what you believe, of your husband, of your lifestyle, and just take it, not knowing it is triggering and reactivating what you have been through. Around her you feel like that little child again who cannot say anything, and you will suppress the gospel to seek love. If they do not respect your beliefs, love them from a distance; do not keep bringing yourself back to that old place and hindering your walk in this truth. Romans 12:1-2 2:05:24 - Definition read in class: neuroplasticity is the brain's lifelong ability to reorganize itself, forming new neural connections and rewiring existing ones in response to learning, new experiences, or injury. Your brain is not hardwired; it constantly molds and adapts throughout your life. The concept was validated by neuroscientists including Michael Merzenich and explored by Norman Doidge in The Brain That Changes Itself (2007): the brain can be rewired through intentional, consistent thought patterns. - Wait a minute. Be not conformed to this world: but be ye transformed by the renewing of your mind. This is the Apostle Paul, roughly 1,900 years before there was ever a term called neuroplasticity. Our forefathers told you that you can change your mind. - So who is going to tell you that you cannot change, when God says you can? You are an Israelite; God gave you the commandments and sent his Son to die for you. You cannot let your traumatic experiences continue to shape your existence. Your identity was formed in a false self, a persona: let it go. - Stop saying you cannot lose the weight, you cannot get in shape, you cannot stop the sin. You can do it, thus saith the Lord. And Esau knows you can change; that is why he tells our people and our children, you cannot do it, that the sciences and law and medicine are not for you. They are for the Israelites, because our forefathers held this knowledge first. Ephesians 3:16-19 2:07:41 - To be strengthened with might by his Spirit in the inner man: if you believe this truth, he will strengthen your mind. The Lord will give you the power to overcome your lusts; if you keep falling into them, your belief is not there yet. You have to fight it within. - That ye might be filled with all the fulness of God: that deletes depression and anxiety. I do not sit around depressed anymore; I know who is in control of my steps, I understand what God called me to do, and I know I have brothers that love and care for me. When they correct me, I know it is not coming from a place of malice. But if you have not rewired your mind to believe that these are the men of God, every correction will send you right back into the old rut and the old excuses. Ephesians 4:22-27 2:09:23 - Put off the old man, which is corrupt according to the deceitful lusts, and be renewed in the spirit of your mind: that is neuroplasticity right there in the Bible, written by our forefathers long before the modern term. - How do you rewire the brain? Putting away lying, speak every man truth with his neighbour: catch yourself when you are about to lie. Be ye angry, and sin not: it is okay to be angry, but do not let it carry you into sin, and let not the sun go down upon your wrath. - Neither give place to the devil: that is the trauma. Satan can only use what is within you; if you deal with it, he cannot use it. He will whisper the old thoughts: see how they treat you, they never liked you, all of that. Wait a minute: when we paid your rent, was that hate? When we kept your kids for a week while your wife was in the hospital, was that hate? No; that is the same traumatic record replaying. The Lord said forgive. You have to let it go. - So the first key to rewiring the brain is repentance. The second is meditation in God's word. Joshua 1:8 2:11:27 - This book of the law shall not depart out of thy mouth; but thou shalt meditate therein day and night. For then thou shalt make thy way prosperous: we think that is money; the Lord is saying you are going to change your mind and live a better life. - We put our children through the same ACEs we went through and then want them to change; we have to give them an example of what change looks like, so the next generation has the tools and does not fall into what we fell into. We protect our daughters and our sons. We are a family in here. Psalms 119:48 2:12:40 - My hands also will I lift up unto thy commandments, which I have loved; and I will meditate in thy statutes. Where is the meditation? In the statutes. Ecclesiasticus 6:37 2:13:06 - Let thy mind be upon the ordinances of the Lord, and meditate continually in his commandments: he shall establish thine heart, and give thee wisdom at thine own desire. Isaiah 26:3 2:13:27 - Thou wilt keep him in perfect peace, whose mind is stayed on thee: because he trusteth in thee. Why is your mind at peace? Because you trust in the Lord. Isaiah 28:10-12 2:14:01 - Precept must be upon precept, line upon line, here a little, and there a little. This is the rest wherewith ye may cause the weary to rest; and this is the refreshing. What is the refreshing, brothers? Precept upon precept. - So David said it, Isaiah said it, Sirach said it, Joshua said it. What were these men, by definition, in today's terms? Psychologists, therapists, counselors. They knew how to heal their people, and we must develop the same skill: find out what makes our people tick, and help them heal from it. Wisdom of Solomon 16:12 2:15:07 - It was neither herb, nor mollifying plaister, that restored them to health: but thy word, O Lord, which healeth all things. We have been sedated with medication and weed and antidepressants, but the whole time the key to breaking this trauma has been the Bible, the laws of God. - The Most High put it on the spirit of Bishop Nathanyel to see it in the scriptures and bring it to the body: Revelation 14:12, keep the commandments of God and the faith of Jesus. The bishops taught the deacons, the deacons the captains, the captains the officers, the officers the soldiers, the soldiers the men, and the men their wives and children, and we take our kingdom back. That has been the solution the whole time. Ecclesiasticus 30:21-23 2:16:25 - Give not over thy mind to heaviness, and afflict not thyself in thine own counsel: stop overthinking. As Deacon Lahab, a psychologist, put it plainly years ago: you have to tell self to be quiet. When you keep talking to yourself from a place of trauma, you are convincing yourself that the way you have been living is okay. Convince yourself instead that God is right and you were wrong. - The gladness of the heart is the life of man, and the joyfulness of a man prolongeth his days. Love thine own soul, and comfort thy heart, remove sorrow far from thee: for sorrow hath killed many, and there is no profit therein. Sirach is speaking in what today they would call medical terms. - Book excerpt read (from a forthcoming volume), on the immune system and grief: research in psychoneuroimmunology, the study of how the mind, nervous system, and immune system interact, shows that chronic stress and grief measurably impact immune functioning. In a prolonged stress state, natural killer cell activity decreases and inflammatory markers increase, contributing to pain, fatigue, and vulnerability to infection. This is one reason some people get physically sick after losing a loved one: their body is not weak; it is overwhelmed, taxed by the emotional weight it is carrying. Foundational research by Irwin and colleagues (1987) documented reduced lymphocyte activity among bereaved individuals; untreated grief carries measurable physiological risk. Ecclesiasticus 38:17-21 2:22:39 - Weep bitterly, and make great moan, and use lamentation, as he is worthy, and that a day or two, lest thou be evil spoken of: and then comfort thyself for thy heaviness. The scripture gives you a time period for grief. - For of heaviness cometh death, and the heaviness of the heart breaketh strength. The psychosomatic illnesses come from the heaviness; a psychosomatic disorder is a very real physical condition caused or significantly worsened by mental factors like chronic stress, anxiety, or emotional trauma. It is not imaginary; it reflects the deep biological connection between your brain and your body. Sirach 30 told us that in ancient times; we just got the terminology now. - Take no heaviness to heart: drive it away. There is no turning again: thou shalt not do him good, but hurt thyself. You will not do the person that died any good. A lot of our illnesses are self inflicted, because we do not believe God's word and do not allow it to work in our life. Hebrews 11:6 2:24:20 - Without faith it is impossible to please him: he that cometh to God must believe that he is, and that he is a rewarder of them that diligently seek him. Believe that he is, meaning that he can heal you from your past and from your trauma. Luke 17:5 2:24:48 - After Christ taught them to forgive seventy times seven, the apostles said unto the Lord, Increase our faith. If we are going to let go of all of that, we need increased faith. That should be our prayer: Lord, increase our faith to get past these roadblocks. Romans 10:17 2:25:36 - So then faith cometh by hearing, and hearing by the word of God. That is how you build the faith. Matthew 17:21 2:26:00 - Howbeit this kind goeth not out but by prayer and fasting. That is the only way to get rid of certain demons: believe his word, meditate in his word, change your mind according to his word, and fast. James 5:16 2:26:36 - Now one you might not have expected: fellowshipping. Confess your faults one to another, and pray one for another, that ye may be healed. Not to yourself: to one another. If you want real healing, you need brothers around, people you trust, and the prayer of the righteous, for the effectual fervent prayer of a righteous man availeth much. You underestimate the power of unity. Ephesians 4:3-6 2:27:09 - Endeavouring to keep the unity of the Spirit in the bond of peace: one body, one Spirit, one Lord, one faith, one baptism, one God and Father of all. If you believe that God is in these men and women, you are going to fellowship, and that is going to help you heal from your trauma. Hebrews 10:24-25 2:28:00 - Let us consider one another to provoke unto love and to good works. When you come around the body, you get provoked to love and good works; you do not have time to sit back and pine away in your existence, because you have brothers and sisters exhorting you. - Not forsaking the assembling of ourselves together: stop missing the Sabbath, the new moon, the study circle, the Friday night fellowship. Be among these men willingly and sincerely; be sincere about your healing journey, because a lot of us have not yet healed. And so much the more as ye see the day approaching: a day is coming when we will have to lay our lives down for the Son of God, and if you cannot build with your brothers now, you will have no foundation in that day. 1 Corinthians 15:49-53 2:29:47 - Flesh and blood cannot inherit the kingdom of God; neither doth corruption inherit incorruption. What we are in now is corruption, and the Lord is going to change this nervous system. - Behold, I shew you a mystery: we shall not all sleep, but we shall all be changed, in a moment, in the twinkling of an eye, at the last trump. The dead shall be raised incorruptible: no more trauma, no more weak nervous system constantly breaking down. This corruptible must put on incorruption, and this mortal must put on immortality. Philippians 3:20-21 2:31:11 - We look for the Saviour, the Lord Jesus Christ, who shall change our vile body, that it may be fashioned like unto his glorious body: we are going to look and feel and be like him. - According to the working whereby he is able even to subdue all things unto himself: his power is so great that he is going to give us a piece of it, and there will be no traumatic hesitation left in the mind; the old record is gone. Hebrews 8:10-11 2:32:32 - This is the covenant that I will make with the house of Israel: I will put my laws into their mind, and write them in their hearts; and I will be to them a God, and they shall be to me a people. That is immortality: when the Lord gives it, you will never second guess him again. You will be made to move and function as God commands, the way Christ and the angels carry his laws in their mind. The power has been in God's laws the whole time. Ezekiel 36:24-28 2:33:41 - I will take you from among the heathen, and gather you out of all countries, and will bring you into your own land. Then will I sprinkle clean water upon you, and ye shall be clean: that clean water is the commandments of God. - A new heart also will I give you, and a new spirit will I put within you: a new mind, a new body, a new nervous system. I will take away the stony heart out of your flesh: the wicked heart Adam bore from the beginning of the class, removed. No more sicknesses, mental health issues, or trauma; the Lord said, I am taking all of that and cleaning you up. - And I will put my spirit within you, and cause you to walk in my statutes; and ye shall be my people, and I will be your God. Precepts: - Ezekiel 36:33-36 In the day that I shall have cleansed you from all your iniquities, the desolate land shall be tilled, and they shall say, This land that was desolate is become like the garden of Eden. First the Lord changes you; then he changes the land to conform to you. The world was made for us, but he cannot give us Jerusalem as it is supposed to be while we are in the midst of sin. He removes the sin, gives the new heart and the immortal body, then commands the land to transform, and we go right back to where we were in the beginning with our Lord. The heathen shall know that I the Lord build the ruined places: I the Lord have spoken it, and I will do it. In Closing The keys laid out today for resetting the nervous system are the keys of the scriptures: repentance, meditation in God's laws day and night, faith that comes by hearing the word of God, prayer and fasting, and sincere fellowship with the body of believers. Intergenerational trauma is real, but the soul that turns and does what is lawful and right shall surely live; the brain is not static, and be ye transformed by the renewing of your mind was written long before the world had a word for it. Y'all believe that, brothers? Twelve tribes, worldwide. With that we say shalom. Shalom, Israel. Happy Sabbath. Announcements & References Books and studies referenced in class: - Trauma Letters: Healing the Child Within, by Captain Galayah (read at length: Erik Erikson's stages of development, the divine design of parental guidance, and born into a curse, on generational bondage). - An excerpt was also read from a book not yet released, on the immune system and grief (psychoneuroimmunology). - The Adverse Childhood Experiences (ACE) study by the CDC and Kaiser Permanente, with the Prevent Child Abuse America summary PDF, and a TED talk by a pediatrician on how childhood trauma affects lifelong health. - Waking the Tiger, by Peter Levine (1997), on the nervous system storing unresolved trauma; The Brain That Changes Itself, by Norman Doidge (2007), on neuroplasticity. - A counselor in the body sent in the adverse childhood experience questionnaire used with clients in the field. - Series referenced as an illustration of intergenerational trauma: Them. Shout out to the ad team and the media department for the thumbnail video, and to Bishop Yahwasap and the captains, officers, and soldiers in the building in Gastonia. --- Class Notes Index Transcript: full session

title: In a Game of Fools Without The Rules
text: Introduction Thumbnail video: "These guys, none of them are in their 30s, and their lives, they will never see the light of day again. Let me say that again. They will never see the light of day again. They're going inside that prison and they will come out in a body bag with a number on it. You think they knew that before they went in there? No. Do you think the rap videos that they were influenced by showed them that? No. In a game of fools, and you don't have the rules to know what you're really dealing with." This is our impromptu classroom lesson. We are trying to make sure that our children don't get caught up in a web of evil, because the reason why God gave us parents is to make sure that we guide these children properly. With their young minds, they are easily manipulated, easily molded to come away from your safety umbrella and follow evil, and end up destroying their lives before they even hit the age of 18, 20, 21. They will make idiotic choices in the first two decades of their life, and it will ruin their life for the rest of the 60 or 70 odd years they have to live. Pictures shown on the board: the young men of valor being saluted and anointed, and the ladies in waiting. Many of us had the distinct honor of standing before these young men, congratulating them on their efforts and inducting them into the realm of righteousness. These young men have a lot of challenges ahead of them, so they need to see righteous examples ahead of them. Same thing with the sisters: there are many traps and temptations out there to try to shear our sisters off, and we have to step in and be fathers and mothers to them. And all praise to the Most High for the daddy and daughter get together last week; the daughters definitely need that connection with their fathers, because they need to know how to evaluate the husband they are looking for. The title, in a game of fools without the rules: if you came up like I did, you listened to a lot of righteous rap music, and this lyric was in one of Public Enemy's records. But that term goes further than the song itself. Picture being dropped off in a foreign country. You don't know the language, you can't read the road signs, you don't know what side of the road the car is supposed to be on, but you're told to navigate, to make it happen. You might be driving and you can't read that the sign says the bridge is out, so you drive off a cliff. That's exactly what's happening to us in this society, because we don't recognize the setup. This lesson is directed toward those youths among us who are tempted to disobey their parents, the parents who are keeping the commandments of God and teaching them to their children. Even parents who homeschool are facing the same challenges, because the temptation comes through the media, the phones, the social media. Video played: children around five, six, seven years old, not even in school yet, reciting the lyrics to a drill song about putting a switch on a Glock and shooting somebody. They probably can't even add two and two, but they know the lyrics, and the parent filmed it and put it up for likes. This is the temptation going in your children's ears and eyes when you hand them an iPad as entertainment. No architects get glorified, no Huxtables get glorified; our enemies took away things that could have been a cultural inspiration for us and gave us this instead. That's what I always call ADHD: ain't no daddy at home. The dads were chased out of the houses in the 70s, and the prison population soared at the same time as fathers were being removed from the homes. The prison industry was getting ready. Scriptures Opened Ecclesiasticus 17:16 21:28 - Every man from his youth is given unto evil. They know that from the time we're born, we're given to evil. So with that understanding, they're able to put homosexuality in cartoons; they're able to steer your children, if you're not careful about how you rear them up, in the direction they need them to go to provide sweat equity in the future. - Children are the most sought after prey to become victims to predators of criminal behavior. Their thought patterns are going to change; they're going to choose to go that way because they've already been wired into it by your television and your phones, and you will watch your children transform into demons right before you. - The way the media is shaped, you cannot get attention as a doctor, an architect, an engineer, or even a decent father. They suppress the proper imagery; that's why they knocked Cosby off. But shoot em up videos get billions of views. Our people love attention because we've been deprived of attention all our lives, so manhood got redefined and rewired. Criminal profilers tell you that once criminals do something heinous, they hope to find their case on the news; they get a high off the affirmation, because that's the only way they've been reduced to getting attention. - Look at what they do to IUIC for an example. We went into Englewood in Chicago, one of the roughest parts, and brothers on the side said, you don't recognize what you just did; you stopped violence for two hours. The media was there with their cameras and didn't put up one second of what we did. But when we left and shootings took place, the cameras got that and put that up. We understand the game, and we're trying to make sure you understand the game. Case discussed in class: the Julio Foolio murder. A drill rapper, 26 years old, was hunted down by a coordinated group of four men and a woman over rap rivalry. Nine days before, he had celebrated his birthday all over Instagram, and his rivals timed the assassination to his fame so the attention would be drawn to them. The detectives lined it all up: license plate readers, ankle monitors, phone pings, cameras everywhere, and all of them got caught. None of them are in their 30s, and they will never see the light of day again. - The woman involved was the honeypot. Definition read in class: a honeypot refers to a female operative who uses romantic or sexual attraction as a trap in espionage, sting operations, or blackmail; a honey trap entices a target into a false relationship to extract information, gather evidence, or ruin a reputation. She let the crew know exactly where he was at all points. She's in the courtroom and she gets 15 years, and she didn't touch a gun or anything. That's Florida; they don't have parole in Florida. She won't get out until about 40, no children, no husband, and by then starting a family is damn near nonexistent at that age, with that history behind her. Video played, the 20 year old who got life: the prosecutor asked a former warden whether the prison would benefit from him in a work capacity if he were sentenced to life without parole. The warden answered: he's young, he's healthy; in reality we need that labor, we need that sweat equity, and we will put them out there to work, because we have an aging prison population, and these young individuals actually can do the work. Then she asked what a life sentence without parole means in Florida, and he answered: from the minute they're brought in they're assigned an inmate number, and when he dies and leaves in a body bag he will still have that inmate number; an inmate serving life will never get out, and they're never allowed outside the razor wire of a secured facility. - That's the game itself. You mean to tell me the prosecutor doesn't know there's no parole in Florida? She knew. They wanted him to hear that, to break him. Esau is the devil for a reason; you're not going to out demonic him. He'll let a young man run around thinking he's terrorizing something, and say, let him destroy his own people, but when we get him, we've got him. They were just waiting on him. - The prosecution was originally going for the death penalty. But on death row, with appeals, he might sit 15 or 20 years; they have to feed him, house him, give him medical care, roughly 70 to 80 thousand dollars a year per inmate. They said no, we don't want that. Give him life without parole, and he works for pennies to earn his commissary until he leaves in a body bag. That's money the prison saves. - He heard "we need that sweat equity" and started rubbing his eyes, about to cry. They talked about him like he wasn't even in the room, but they knew he heard it. All that psychological torture brought down all the tough talk. Where were the gangster videos then? When you get locked up, nobody cares about you; whatever friends didn't go down with you are gone. He set up a GoFundMe to appeal the case and couldn't even collect 800 dollars. Nobody gave a damn. - This society is about making us slaves. The victim is dead, and the five involved are going to prison; that's six people out of the way, and the ones remaining become fuel. Once that gavel swings, your name is gone. The name on your birth certificate doesn't exist anymore. You become property of the state, and the 13th Amendment tells them what to do with you: involuntary servitude, slavery, sweat equity. Documents read in class: - The 13th Amendment, Section 1: neither slavery nor involuntary servitude, except as a punishment for crime whereof the party shall have been duly convicted. That's the loophole. When they abolished slavery, where was the fuel going to come from? The freed labor. Most of our people were happy with the top part of it, not realizing the society itself was set up to shape you into breaking laws. - Convict leasing: a system of forced penal labor prevalent in the southern United States from the 19th century until the mid 20th century, under which state and local governments leased incarcerated people, the vast majority of whom were black men, to private corporations and individuals to work for a fee. If you can't get a job and can't feed your family, people are reduced to crime, and when they go into so-called crime, they said, we got you now; now we get to use you as a slave, which is what we always wanted from the beginning of this country. America could not do without slaves, so they gave slavery by another name. - A slave auction bill from Banks' Arcade: Mary, aged 18 years, a field hand; Harriet, aged 21; Priscilla, aged 33, field hand and fair cook; Lewis, aged 24, wagoner; John Wilkinson, aged 28, number one dining room servant; Elizabeth, aged 20, fine washer and ironer and fair cook. Listen to how they describe the property, like features on a car you buy on a lot. Notice the ages: none of them are 45 or 60, because this is prime work, sweat equity. That's how they talked about us. - Dred Scott v. Sandford, December term 1856, read from the court record: a free negro of the African race, whose ancestors were brought to this country and sold as slaves, is not a citizen within the meaning of the Constitution of the United States. When the Constitution was adopted, they were not regarded in any of the states as members of the community which constituted the state, and were not numbered among its people or citizens; consequently the special rights and immunities guaranteed to citizens do not apply to them. The only two clauses in the Constitution which point to this race treat them as persons whom it was morally lawful to deal in as articles of property and to hold as slaves. No state can by any subsequent law make a foreigner or any other description of persons citizens of the United States; and the change in public opinion and feeling in relation to the African race which has taken place since the adoption of the Constitution cannot change its construction and meaning, and it must be construed and administered according to its true meaning and intention when it was formed and adopted. - That's the game. Even if they give you civil rights to make you think you're on an equal footing, the Constitution comes back and says that will not make you a citizen. That's why you had to have voting rights acts and all the rest. That's why people can be shot down and left in the street with nobody held to account. Our children are being fooled into thinking they can do all kinds of wickedness and be all right, and the Constitution is already set up to lock them up and get sweat equity out of them. Romans 13:3-4 40:18 - For rulers are not a terror to good works, but to the evil. The rulers, the powers that be, are not a terror to those of us that keep the commandments of God. Even though we be persecuted for it, it's not a terror to us, because we know what it's about. Blessed are they which are persecuted for righteousness' sake, for theirs is the kingdom of heaven. If I'm going to get locked up for doing what's right, I'll suffer for that; going in persecuted for righteousness' sake is a whole different mentality, because I know that after that, mine is the kingdom of heaven. - One of the titles for this class was going to be "suffer not as a murderer." When you suffer as one that follows Christ, that's one thing; but suffering as a murderer, you're going to get judged at the end anyway. You're not getting the kingdom. This young man can't say the Most High is going to repay them for what they're doing to him; the reason he's being judged is that he broke the laws of the Most High. - Wilt thou then not be afraid of the power? We were not afraid before; we broke the commandments, so the Lord said, since you did not want to learn of me, I'm going to put this virulent beast over you, and when you mess up with him, he isn't going to have pity on you. That's what we're hearing now. - That would be many of our sons and daughters who refuse to listen to their parents. If it isn't jail, it's a pregnancy, a disease, a marriage riddled with alcohol abuse and domestic violence. The parents in righteousness are supposed to oversee who their sons and daughters get hooked up with. That's why God gave children parents. Precepts: - 1 Peter 4:15-16 Let none of you suffer as a murderer, or as a thief, or as an evildoer. But if any man suffer as a Christian, one that follows Christ and the commandments of God, let him not be ashamed. - Matthew 5:10 Blessed are they which are persecuted for righteousness' sake: for theirs is the kingdom of heaven. A father took the microphone: I just wish my 22 year old was with me to see this, because he's not a bad kid, but he doesn't listen. He came in here one time and won't come back. He's got a good job, a supervisor, and I'm trying to get him to stop smoking dope; I told him they can test you any time, and he'd lose all of that. He says, Dad, I'll be all right. I don't want to put him in the street, because that would really mess him up, but that's the hardest thing I'm dealing with. - I'm sorry for your pain, brother, and you might have no choice. There's a saying in the islands: those who don't hear will feel. Those who will not listen must suffer the consequences. Isaiah 22:14 1:16:45 - It was revealed in mine ears by the Lord of hosts, surely this iniquity shall not be purged from you till ye die. Some of our people will not turn away from their wicked ways no matter how close they get to death. Isaiah 51:20 1:17:18 - Thy sons have fainted, they lie at the head of all the streets, as a wild bull in a net. Gang activity, on the corners doing nothing, looking for mischief to get into. Parents can't do anything with them; they're like wild bulls. Matthew 10:21 1:18:40 - The brother shall deliver up the brother to death, and the father the child. So listen, son: if you bring that madness into this house, you have to go. Call the authorities, get him out, because he's going to end up getting the whole house killed. I tried to teach my son not to do this; he brought that mess into the house and it's destroying the whole house. I'm delivering him up. He has to go. - And the children shall rise up against their parents, and cause them to be put to death. If they don't kill them themselves, they will set their parents up to be murdered. Some of these kids are that wild. There was a video a few years back where a father tried to intervene in a street fight his child was involved in, and they turned around and killed the father. I'm putting it out there. I know it isn't popular, but that's exactly what will happen. These kids have to know, because these politicians aren't playing anymore. Video played, the 1994 crime bill speech: let me tell you what is in the bill, and I'll let you all decide whether or not this is weak. The death penalty: the bill provides 53 death penalty offenses. We do everything but hang people for jaywalking in this bill. And the same speech: it doesn't matter whether or not they were deprived as a youth, it doesn't matter whether they're the victims of society; the end result is they're about to knock my mother on the head with a lead pipe, so I don't want to ask what made them do this. They must be taken off the street. Unless we do something about that cadre of young people, tens of thousands of them born out of wedlock, without parents, without supervision, without structure, without any conscience developing, because they literally have not been socialized. We should focus on them now, not out of a liberal instinct for love and humanity, but for simple pragmatic reasons. - You thought Biden was bad; Trump is the same thing. Biden and Trump are saying the same thing. Everybody talking about, let's vote Democrat: the Democrat was doing the same thing. They're all part of the game. - All the decades that have gone by with this wildness running loose, thinking nobody could do anything, then the Lord said, give them Trump. It's better to hear it from me than to hear it like that man in the courtroom being referred to as sweat equity. Luke 14:26 1:24:55 - If any man come to me, and hate not his father, and mother, and wife, and children: the hate here means you're not trimming your ways against what the Lord said to benefit them. These are persons closest to you, knit to your soul. But if you don't deliver that child up so he can be corrected, because you tried the Bible and it's not working, you're enabling the behavior, and eventually it will pull you out of the truth. 1 Corinthians 5:5 1:31:53 - Deliver such an one unto Satan for the destruction of the flesh, that the spirit may be saved in the day of the Lord Jesus. Hopefully they learn to get rid of that sin so their spirit might be saved. That's why they call the system corrections; they don't really get corrected, but you get the point. - We have to do that in here too. Certain spirits don't want to act right, judgment after judgment, still getting it wrong: listen, you have to go, because if you stay, you're going to poison the rest of these brothers and sisters. That's how fathers have to be. And when you put your foot down in your house to make sure that evil stops, your own son or daughter might cause you to die. You have to be aware of that. That's real talk. - If you don't discipline your sons and daughters today, even just with straight talk, they're going to be disciplined by the system: the cop with the nine millimeter, the nightstick, the stun gun, jail time, a potter's field death. They better learn now while they have the chance. Romans 13:3-4 1:34:57 - Do that which is good, and thou shalt have praise of the same. The enemies might not like what we're doing in resurrecting and straightening our people up, but can they really speak evil against it? No. Even certain outsiders will say, at least they are trying to curb things in a way that won't contribute to the mess out here. - For he is the minister of God. Esau, the powers that be, is God's helper. That doesn't sound good at all, but that's what it means. He is the minister of God to thee for good, for you to straighten up. - But if thou do that which is evil, be afraid; for he beareth not the sword in vain. He doesn't have the power to kill for no reason, but when you're out here stealing, robbing, committing murder, God isn't with that. Video played: a police chase that ended in a shootout, a man climbing out of a wrecked car with a weapon in his hand, shooting at police, and they took him down. That was ugliness, and that's somebody's son. It's letting you know they aren't playing. - All the smash and grabs, the running into stores while owners stood by and did nothing, psychologically wired our people into thinking they can't be stopped and can do these things with impunity. Lo and behold, the Lord was setting them up. Video played, the DC mayor: what happened this past Saturday night at Chipotle in the Navy Yard, and what we're seeing increasingly across the district, is not only unacceptable, it is violent, it is dangerous, and it is illegal, and I am here to tell you it is going to stop. And parents, I'm talking about you now: we are looking beyond the individuals committing the crimes, and we're looking at the parents to make sure they understand they are responsible. The residents are starting to feel like these out of control teens are taking away their happiness. - Notice she said they're looking at the parents regardless. A lot of times these young girls have the kids, want to keep playing in the street, and dump the child on grandma. They're saying: if the child is in your custody and doing this, you will be held responsible. They weren't talking about the kids; they were talking about the parents. - Why is this happening? The Most High is trying to wake us up. If we don't get our business together, a lot of examples are going to be made, and that's before the wilderness. Zechariah 13:1-3 1:42:15 - In that day there shall be a fountain opened to the house of David and to the inhabitants of Jerusalem for sin and for uncleanness. The fountain opened to the nation of Israel is the Bible, the laws of the Most High; the fountain represents the word, the water. This is in the wilderness, right before we get to our kingdom. It parallels Ezekiel: I will cause you to pass under the rod. Christ is going to teach us face to face, and if we have not learned to keep God's laws, that's the day of judgment. - I will cut off the names of the idols out of the land, and they shall no more be remembered. All that drill foolishness is going to be dead. Some of our people are going to be spared when destruction comes on this country just to be made examples in the wilderness. When the Lord smites the one that's teaching lies, everybody instantly drops what he taught; nobody talks about it anymore. Also I will cause the prophets and the unclean spirit to pass out of the land. - And it shall come to pass, that when any shall yet prophesy, then his father and his mother that begat him shall say unto him, Thou shalt not live; and shall thrust him through when he prophesieth. Why would his own father and mother do that? Because they will have already witnessed how Christ dealt with the rebellious. Once those parents see that Christ isn't playing, that's how the parents are going to be moving. I'm going back to you brothers and sisters with sons and daughters that refuse to change: don't put your life on the line for wickedness that refuses to repent. Precepts: - Revelation 22:15 For without are dogs, and sorcerers, and whoremongers, and murderers, and idolaters, and whosoever loveth and maketh a lie. None of that is going into the kingdom. Even liars, people that deal falsely, that lie by omission, that hold back when they know exactly what you're asking them: the Lord marks that down too. - Luke 19:27 But those mine enemies, which would not that I should reign over them, bring hither, and slay them before me. Everybody that's against what Christ said is an enemy of Christ, and that includes our people. You fathers and mothers are trying to rule over your children to keep them from going astray, and they say, I'm not having that; the hell with what you got to say. In the wilderness, Christ will be teaching the commandments face to face, and those still refusing, he said, bring them before me. - Ephesians 5:26 That he might sanctify and cleanse it with the washing of water by the word. The water is the word; that's the fountain opened. Ephesians 6:1-2 2:08:16 - Children, obey your parents in the Lord, for this is right. Honour thy father and mother, which is the first commandment with promise. Do you think children can go against this and expect to be spared by the Lord's sword, which is Esau and his system? - Do you realize we're not even supposed to be here, underneath these people? We were never supposed to experience this captivity. We're over here because we messed up with our Father. Jeremiah 49:12 2:09:27 - Behold, they whose judgment was not to drink of the cup have assuredly drunken. That's us. We were not supposed to drink of this cup of destruction, because we are God's people, his children, his heirs, his firstborn; but these things happened to us because of disobedience. - And art thou he that shall altogether go unpunished? Thou shalt not go unpunished, but thou shalt surely drink of it. The nations that did this evil to us, even though we deserved judgment, will not go unpunished. They shall drink the captivity, the punishment, the slavery, all of it. Obadiah 1:15-16 2:11:14 - For the day of the Lord is near upon all the heathen: as thou hast done, it shall be done unto thee; thy reward shall return upon thine own head. What they did to us shall be done to them. That's reap what you sow. And the ones it's going to happen by are those that keep his commandments; the ones that stay in disobedience are going to be done away with. - For as ye have drunk upon my holy mountain, so shall all the heathen drink continually; yea, they shall drink, and they shall swallow down, and they shall be as though they had not been. They shall be as though they were never a nation, the same way we are acting like we were never a nation of people. Precepts: - Revelation 13:10 He that leadeth into captivity shall go into captivity: he that killeth with the sword must be killed with the sword. Here is the patience and the faith of the saints. The saints are the ones that get that honor, like it says in Psalms 149: this honour have all his saints. Testimony played in class: a former gang member who went into the Texas prison system at 17 described the unit they call the burning hell. He said, I did not know slavery existed until I went to prison; I've been a slave. The 13th Amendment abolished slavery unless you've been convicted of a crime. He was made inventory, property of the state of Texas, sent out to actual cotton fields on a plantation to pick cotton, or to cut whole fields of grass in a line as human lawnmowers, depending on the season. When he refused, the guards on horseback drew their guns, made him get down on his hands and knees, and let him know they had the right to kill him if he posed a threat to leaving; the guards kept count of the men they had killed, and looking at that record alone was enough to break a man down. Refusal meant being handcuffed in an enclosed steel trailer in the heat until you came up with some sense. By day six, he said, he was the best cotton picker they had, because they have perfected mentally and physically breaking men. - Your tough son doesn't want to listen to what we're trying to tell him. To know that they have killed men before you that did what you thought about doing, and they wear it like a proud badge, means it's easy for them to add another. This is ugliness, but it's only ugly when you disobey the Most High, meaning you disobey what your parents are trying to keep you from. - There is a different mentality when you go in suffering for righteousness' sake, like the political prisoners; Dr. Martin Luther King was locked up. But when you're suffering as a murderer, the memories start coming: I remember when dad tried to tell me this, when mom tried to tell me this, when the elders tried to tell me this. And every time you close your eyes and wake up, you're still in the same place. - Don't think it's only the southern states. They're passing laws all over to reflect what's happening in these southern states. The Lord is tired of our people disobeying his commandments, and I'm being a spokesman for the Lord by telling you what he is about to do. The young men of valor took the microphone: what I'm getting from the class is that I need to start listening to my parents in the Lord, listening to the important talk my mother gives me, and hearkening to my spiritual fathers and mothers. Another: to keep the commandments more. Another: the honor of leadership and parents has to be in the forefront of all the young men's minds, because if we don't have it, we end up like what Bishop is showing on the screen. - Definition read in class: honor is an abstract concept and personal ethos embodying moral integrity, honesty, and a strong code of conduct; it can refer to the high respect and public esteem a person earns through their actions, or a special privilege and title. Matthew 15:4 2:32:31 - For God commanded, saying, Honour thy father and mother: this is not a commandment that man stated; this is what God commanded. To have moral integrity, honesty, and a strong code of conduct toward your father and your mother. - And, He that curseth father or mother, let him die the death. That's the judgment for not honoring your father and mother. Precepts: - Ecclesiasticus 7:27-28 Honour thy father with thy whole heart: the root word for integrity is integer, meaning whole. And forget not the sorrows of thy mother: the fact that she carried you for nine months and birthed you. How canst thou recompense them the things that they have done for thee? You can't pay them back for bringing you into this world. So your responsibility as the child is to honor that alone. - Ecclesiasticus 3:10-13 Glory not in the dishonour of thy father. Some of you who are older may have parents that are not in this truth, and you might think you don't have to give them the respect of a parent. That's not what the Lord said. My son, help thy father in his age: you are to be an aid to your parent at a certain age, and not just when you feel like it. If his understanding fail, have patience with him. Notice we're the only nation of people that don't take care of our elders; where do you think nursing homes come from? Deacon: I have a real disdain for children that do not honor their parents, because mine died when I was young and I went through the system with no mother and father. To have them, and be able to have a conversation with them, and still not respect that: that's a problem for me. Sentencing videos played in class: Alicia Andrews, 22 when convicted of manslaughter for her role in the June 2024 ambush killing of Jacksonville rapper Charles "Julio Foolio" Jones, was sentenced in May 2026 to 15 years in Florida State Prison. This just went down. - Felony murder: in most states, if the victim died as a result of you being part of the plot, you're as guilty as the one that pulled the trigger, even if you never touched a weapon. I say that because some of our young girls, the ones that walk away from their parents looking for a boyfriend, end up here. One of the defendants was her boyfriend, the main one; he gave her sweet nothings and she did whatever he told her to do. Now her boyfriend can't save her, and she will never see him again. - The mother of the victim read her statement to the court: my son was more than a rapper; he was my child. He was hunted, followed, and ultimately murdered in a coordinated plot. It is extremely painful to hear Alicia Andrews portray herself as someone who didn't know what was going on, while evidence showed she traveled with the others, tracked my son's movements, and remained involved throughout. Whether she pulled the trigger or not, my son would still be alive today had people not participated in carrying out this plan. A mother lives with instinct and intuition, and mine tells me this was not ignorance; this was participation. It was calculated. Every second of the drive there, they could have changed their minds and turned around, but they carried on the plan to hunt my son down like a deer in the woods. This was loyalty to violence over humanity. Alicia's family can still see her and talk to her, but I have to go visit my son at a wall in a cemetery. Choices were made, and those choices had deadly consequences. - Remember, her son was in that drill rap mess too; they're all in this foolishness together. And notice: our people will throw the book at each other, but when it comes to Esau, we talk about forgiveness and all good things in white Jesus. I did not want that to slide off the scale either. - Her defense cited eight supposedly similar cases, even cases where the defendant physically participated in a killing and got 15 years or less, asking the judge to depart downward, calling her a relatively minor participant. There was nothing minor about it. The state distinguished every case, and the judge sentenced her to 15 years, then moved straight to the next matter on the calendar. Look how nonchalant it is. That's it; her life is done. Ephesians 6:1-4 2:59:50 - Children, obey your parents in the Lord, for this is right. Honour thy father and mother, which is the first commandment with promise: that it may be well with thee, and thou mayest live long on the earth. The Most High means that. - And, ye fathers, provoke not your children to wrath. This is how fathers provoke their children to wrath: by coddling them, by covering for them when they do evil. Let that judgment roll. If you get in the way of it and coddle them, you're going to embolden them, and they will ultimately put you to death. Bring them up in the nurture and admonition of the Lord: the warnings of the Lord. Proverbs 1:10-16 3:00:51 - My son, if sinners entice thee, consent thou not. That sister was enticed to follow that evil; those brothers were enticed to follow that evil. Don't agree with it; be strong enough to walk away from so-called peer pressure. I'm talking to you young men of valor and you young sisters. - If they say, Come with us, let us lay wait for blood, let us lurk privily for the innocent without cause, let us swallow them up alive as the grave: that is what they did when they hunted that young man down. They plotted together. Cast in thy lot among us; let us all have one purse: let's all get paid together. Smash and grabs. - My son, walk not thou in the way with them; refrain thy foot from their path: for their feet run to evil, and make haste to shed blood. That's what you parents are trying to tell them. - If you hear evil being plotted, especially if it's coming from inside the congregation, tell on them. The Bible tells you to tell. You're saving their life; they would rather be dealt with by us than by the penal system. Habakkuk 2:15 3:04:23 - Woe unto him that giveth his neighbour drink, that puttest thy bottle to him, and makest him drunken also. Alcohol plays a part in these things. Alcohol is a drug; it tranquilizes, removes your inhibitions, and emboldens you to do the things you normally would not do because your common sense would kick in. - Think about high school. There were certain sisters that were pure, that kept themselves; certain brothers that were straight with the books and did not participate in the mess. And there would be a group that hated to see that sister shining like a diamond, hated to see that brother with his stuff together, because chances are those children have parents that care for them and watch over them. So they try to befriend your daughters and your sons, get them to drink a little to show they're sociable: oh, I didn't know you were this cool; I thought you were a square. Now they're in the batch, and now they're lying to you as parents: how was school today? Nothing. - That thou mayest look on their nakedness: that you may look upon their sin. They want to see your daughter drunk, losing her inhibitions, a full participant in the evil, and while they watch it, they sit back satisfied, because another one bites the dust. Once she's ruined or he's messed his life up, they don't care about them after that. There's no loyalty. - Oh, you thought you were all good; look at you now, you're no better than us. That's what they do, and that's what they say about us. These wicked camps want to see us in the same evil they're in, and they won't be satisfied until we join them. We're not joining them. They would love to sully us, to put us in the mud with them. That's what happened to Dinah: everybody in the town wanted her defiled and had her set up. - True story, and there are many cases like it: a young man graduated with honors and a four year scholarship, went back to a party to celebrate with his homies, and they ended up killing him at that party. Same thing goes with the daughters. In Closing There's beauty in being elite. There's beauty in being clean, upright, and perfect. Don't let anybody entice you out of that, and the main framers of that perfection are your parents when they are right in the Lord. That's the reason why the Bible says obey your parents in the Lord, for this is right. That's my warning to you young sisters and young brothers, and I pray you take heed to it, because if you go the wrong way, I'm not shedding tears for you. You've been warned. You've been told. You have righteousness all around you, and if you don't want to walk with righteousness, you will feel the consequences. If you're in a game of fools and you don't understand the rules: the rules are, obey the commandments of the Lord, and you can escape these things. Announcements & References - The Bible: The Book of Our Fathers aired last night with Captain Desawn, Officer Sariah, Officer Liam, and the brothers; they did a fantastic job with that class. Go back and check it out. - The daddy and daughter get together was held last week; all praise to the Most High for the beautiful pictures of fathers and daughters together. Those things mean a lot. - Closing montage: across the earth the prophets move from city streets to distant lands, and the message is the same: Israel must rise. Through every quest and every journey the truth spreads. We build our communities, we raise our children in royalty, we restore what was broken. This is Israel United in Christ. --- Class Notes Index Transcript: full session

title: Popular Persuasions: Fighting Against Heaven Defending Earth
text: Introduction All praises to the Most High, and all praises to the brothers on the IT squad that made that beautiful thumbnail. Before the class, a commentary on a podcast clip that Captain Getahiliah had responded to on Instagram: a panel of women, some from modern day Christianity, some who know they are Israelites. One sister cited Daniel 9:11, written from the Babylonian exile: Israel has transgressed thy law, and the curse and the oath written in the book of Moses has fallen upon us. That is clear proof that Israel is identified in scripture. The Christian apologist on the panel objected that the benchmarks of Deuteronomy 28:52-57, the siege and the eating of children, never happened in the transatlantic slave trade, only in 2 Kings 6. The sister answered that the judgments work like a ring: it happened in Babylon, it happened in Rome, and there are instances in the transatlantic slave trade. She is right. Write this down, brothers: the Arrogante, 1837, a Portuguese slave ship captured by the British Royal Navy off the coast of Cuba. The liberated African survivors testified to the British authorities that the crew had killed a captive and forced the remaining captives to eat; the record is one of several documented in the book The Delectable Negro showing that our people were forced into this during the transatlantic slave trade, which connects the judgments of Deuteronomy 28 to our history. Why is it so hard for our brothers and sisters caught up in this anti-Israelite movement to find the proper resources and connect it to our history? The information is there. If we found the book, they can find the book. The thing is, they don't want the book, because the minute you mention that we're the Israelites, they know the Most High is going to hold us accountable. They don't want God's laws and God's judgments. Remember, Satan's first weapon was persuasion. Today's class: popular persuasions, fighting against heaven, defending earth. Scriptures Opened Isaiah 5:20 5:10 - The Most High says destruction unto them that call evil good and good evil, that put darkness for light and light for darkness. - Video played: the Vice President, JD Vance, was asked about UFOs on a podcast and said, "I don't think they're aliens, I think they're demons," and that when he hears about extra natural phenomenon he goes to the Christian understanding that one of the devil's great tricks is to convince people he never existed. Notice what he is doing: he is calling the chariots of God, what the world calls aliens, UFOs, UAPs, demons. But the Bible says, woe unto them that call evil good and good evil. - Esau is setting the road map to persuade the minds of the people that the coming impending invasion is demonic. Why would they do such a thing? To justify attacking, to sway the minds of the people to view these black angels as enemies. We went over many classes on the chariots: the angels are black, and the chariots of God are the angels. Their job is to shift the mind of the people so they can be deceived into fighting Christ, especially our brothers and sisters in the military. - Article read from the Guardian: Republican US House member Marjorie Taylor Greene told Bill Maher on HBO's Real Time that she believes in demons, surmising that they might be aliens who fell from heaven. Asked whether demons and the devil are real, she answered, "Absolutely, I'm a Bible believing Christian, and I believe those could be fallen angels." Esau is mixing Jude the 4th chapter with Isaiah 14; misinterpretation and miseducation, because ultimately they know the truth. - Article read: Republican Anna Paulina Luna, acting chairwoman of the House Oversight Committee tasked with declassifying state secrets, claimed an ancient Bible story about a fallen angel depicts aliens invading Earth, telling people to read the Book of Enoch and the Book of the Watchers. She is going into all these other books. - Video played from a House Oversight Committee hearing: a witness testified, "UAP are real. Advanced technologies not made by our government or any other government are monitoring sensitive military installations around the globe. Furthermore, the US is in possession of UAP technologies." Esau likes to throw truths out there mixed with a lot of lies. Did y'all pick up the lie? He said they're in possession of UAP technology. You're not in possession of a thing, because these are chariots; these are spiritual; these are of God. There is no Area 51. All of that is lies to make America seem powerful. Now this is becoming talking points in various black churches because of popular persuasions. - So America shapes public perception, and they can persuade people to reject God's truth. What is God's truth? That we're the Israelites, the angels are black, and Christ is coming back with the heavenly armies, what the world calls UFOs and UAPs, coming back with destruction and with salvation for the Israelites. Ephesians 2:2 18:37 - Why does it call him the prince of the power of the air? Because they control the airwaves, the media, communication. That's why the book of Revelation refers to the mouth of the dragon and the mouth of the beast: communication through his media. - Everything that we do as a people is shaped by public opinion, shaped by the persuasion of Esau, the so-called white man, because he controls social media and the news, and his thoughts become our thoughts. That's why it's called networking or broadcasting: broadcasting his opinions. Now his opinions, which are lies, are stating that the chariots are evil and demonic, to persuade the minds of the people to fight against Christ. Isaiah 25:7 20:33 - He will destroy in this mountain the face of the covering cast over all people. Not just people in America: globally. Wherever you go, whatever church you sit in, whatever continent, country, or island, they all think the white man is God; they think Christ is white. Soon they are going to utter the same sentiment, that the UFOs are demonic fallen angels. - How did he spread this veil over all nations? His media, his network, his communication, because he is the prince of the power of the air. - And how is the Most High going to destroy the covering? He is using us to do that: to cast down the lies and reveal the lies Esau has been telling our people. Precepts: - Isaiah 13:1-2 The burden of Babylon: Babylon the great. Lift ye up a banner upon the high mountain: that high mountain is America. God says lift up the banner, and the banner is the Bible. Exalt the voice unto them: that's what we do every time we go to camp and every time we do these classes, casting down lies. So the mountain in Isaiah 25:7 is referencing Babylon the great, America. Jeremiah 51:55 23:28 - Because the Lord hath spoiled Babylon, and destroyed out of her the great voice: that's the communication, his airwaves. Jeremiah is speaking prophetically of America. - When her waves do roar like great waters: those waves are the evil communication, the lies he is spewing; his rhetoric has gone out into all nations, and that's how he caused all nations to fornicate. - Bishop recently sat for an interview on the Soft White Underbelly YouTube page. In Closing The popular persuasions are set in place to persuade the world that what is coming out of the heavens is demonic, so the nations will be gathered to fight against Christ and his army. Our answer is not carnal weapons; our only power in this fight is keeping the commandments of God as Israelites, studying four chapters a day, and immersing ourselves in the word so that when it comes, we will not be deceived. With that, brothers, all praises to the Most High. Tune in for Bishop's class next. A dramatized IUIC video closed the class: a national emergency, more sightings in the skies, the nations pooling their weapons for space war while the word declares that no matter what Edom does, the judgment of the Most High stands forever; and saviours shall come up on mount Zion to judge the mount of Esau, and the kingdom shall be the Lord's. Announcements & References - Bishop's interview is up on the Soft White Underbelly YouTube page: watch the whole video and leave a real, sensible comment. - Books referenced in class: The Delectable Negro (documented accounts of forced cannibalism during the transatlantic slave trade); Ringmakers of Saturn, by Norman Bergrun (the chariots making the rings of Saturn); The Book of Enoch and the Book of the Watchers were named in the Luna article as the sources Esau is misusing for the fallen angel doctrine. - Articles and media shown: the JD Vance podcast clip calling the phenomena demons; the Guardian article on Marjorie Taylor Greene telling Bill Maher extraterrestrials may be fallen angels; the Anna Paulina Luna posts; the House Oversight Committee UAP hearing testimony; the media ownership video on the billionaires who control the platforms; the Norman Bergrun interview; the Clark McClelland Stargate Chronicles account; early church paintings showing the chariots at the crucifixion. --- Class Notes Index Transcript: full session

title: THE BOLD AND THE BASHFUL
text: Introduction The name of the class: the bold and the bashful. This is a continuation of Deacon Malachi's class from two weeks ago on being just as a leader in Israel. Now we get the flip side: how you can fall as a leader that is bashful. Coming back from the overseas Passover trips, we have an issue, and it is not just overseas, it is here in America too, of brothers and leaders that are bashful. You do not want to rock the boat. You do not want to correct when you see something wrong. You turn a blind eye because he is your friend or she is your friend. So this class touches on what can possibly happen to you when you are a bashful leader. Definitions read in class: bashfulness is the quality of being shy, easily embarrassed, or overly modest in social situations. It typically involves an acute sense of self-consciousness, a tendency to avoid the spotlight, and feelings of timidity around others. Key characteristics: social timidity, a hesitance to interact, often caused by a fear of negative judgment; modesty; physical cues like blushing, a lowered gaze, or awkwardness. Timidity is a lack of courage or confidence. In a social situation like class, bashful brothers want to hide amongst the flock. You do not want to be seen, you do not want to be heard, you do not want to stand out; you just want to blend in and fall to the wayside. Why do you think brothers do not come to the war room all the time? Because you are bashful. You do not want brothers to correct you on your sin and your bad ways, because you are comfortable in those sins. A lot of brothers and sisters have lack of confidence and low self-esteem, which goes into a lack of faith: not just a lack of faith in the Lord, a lack of faith in yourself. Whatever institution you grew up in, your peers, your teachers, your pastors, your churches, created what we have in you today. Scriptures Opened Psalms 82:1-6 20:06 - God standeth in the congregation of the mighty; he judgeth among the gods. This is talking about you black men, you Hispanic men, you Israelite men. You have to believe what the Bible says, not because of the words coming out of a man's mouth; this is what God says. - How long will ye judge unjustly, and accept the persons of the wicked? We accept wickedness in our lives, in our neighborhoods, around each other, in our families. - Defend the poor and fatherless: this is what we are supposed to do as the gods on the earth. Deliver the poor and needy: rid them out of the hand of the wicked. How do you do that? We teach for you to change your life; that is how we rid you out of the hands of the wicked. - They know not, neither will they understand; they walk on in darkness. The gods on the earth right now do not know this Bible. Now we are in darkness, now we are in sin. - I have said, Ye are gods; and all of you are children of the Most High. God said it, not man. You are a god on this earth, black man, Hispanic man; why do we not act like it? Put your chest out and your chin up, and speak with some confidence in your voice. But how do we move through society? Nobody cares about me, I make all kinds of mistakes, I just want to curl up in bed. That is the mentality we have, but that is not supposed to be so. Exodus 1:8-10 24:04 - There arose up a new king over Egypt: a new king means a new kingdom arising, the 17th dynasty, which knew not Joseph. - Behold, the people of the children of Israel are more and mightier than we. America did the same thing: the children of Israel are more than us and stronger than us, so let us deal wisely with them, lest they multiply, and when there falleth out any war, they join also unto our enemies and fight against us. Psalms 83:3-7 25:42 - They have taken crafty counsel against thy people: that is the nations dealing wisely with us. How did they do it? They oppressed us, they exploited us, they colonized us, they took our identity: the transatlantic slave trade, the sub-Saharan slave trade, the black codes, colonization. You have the United Nations where they counsel; they have secret councils we are not privy to. - They have said, Come, and let us cut them off from being a nation. They cut us off from being the nation of Israel; now you are African-American, Haitian, Jamaican, Kenyan, Ugandan, Tanzanian, Ghanaian, all these new labels. But you are still one race: the Israelites. - They have consulted together with one consent: they are all in agreement.
