Announcements & References Field reports played: - The prophets came together in Boston at the Haitian Flag Day parade, teaching blacks and Hispanics that Haitians and Dominicans are one nation, Levi and Simeon, and must unite; the division on Hispaniola was created by the colonizers. - The Boston takeover, May 2026: eight camp sites in a single weekend from Massachusetts to Rhode Island, two podcasts, a radio appearance, and the parade march, with nine captains and over 200 soldiers from headquarters, Jersey, Philly, DC, Canada, Ohio, Detroit, Miami, and Raleigh. - IUIC Sacramento blazed the streets of San Jose at the Cinco de Mayo celebration, teaching the Northern Kingdom tribe of Issachar their true heritage. - IUIC Jacksonville held their monthly cleanup on Moncrief, a street they have taught and battled on for years and have now officially adopted in IUIC's name. - IUIC Rochester held their first Biblical Smoke live event at Buffalo State College, with strong engagement and more campus events being planned. - Captain Gideon of IUIC Boston taught on one of Montreal's most popular Haitian radio stations; subscribe to the IUIC Canada channels. - The young men of valor of Gastonia held a skill and trade day: lawn equipment, vehicle maintenance, self defense, and entrepreneurship, toward self sufficiency. - IUIC Diaspora released the Hebrews Journal, Isles of the Sea Guyana edition, on the lives of our people scattered to Guyana, the Bahamas, and the Caribbean. - We celebrated the righteous union of Officer Isaiah and Sister Abaya; the foundation of nation building is a godly marriage. Music and media: Original Royalty released the single Superstars by Zipporah of Philly; new leather goods are available at originalroyalty.com; scan the QR code Monday nights at 9:00 pm to vote for the Israel Live top five. Dates: tonight starts the Day of Simon, the high priest and leader of Israel. The second quarter voluntary fast begins May 29th at sundown. The Feast of Pentecost is June 6th at sundown; Texas Pentecost 2026 registration is open. Men's conference registration closes Sunday, May 31st. title: WHY THEY HATED US: WALKING IN THE FOOTSTEPS OF THE PERSECUTED
text: Introduction Shalom, Israel. Happy Sabbath. Deacon Malachi brings forth the class. I have been watching a couple of videos on social media, and this question always comes up: why they hated us? Believe it or not, there is an easy answer to this. Those who have difficulty with that question, those who have difficulty finding the answer, it is because they are not in the truth. Christians cannot answer that; as a matter of fact, Christians say not all of them hate us. Here is the answer: they were created to hate us. White people and all the other nations were created to hate the Israelites. That is the answer, and I am going to prove it in the Bible. But before we get there, you ask the question, why do you hate us? We hate ourselves too. We are going to be real: some of us actually hate each other more than the white man hates us. For every action there is a reaction, and this class is not what you think it is going to be. The scriptures will show both sides: how rebellious we have been as a people, why the judgment came, and the good news of what is coming for the Israelites who endure. In The News - Video commentary played: the world does not respect black people because we have not done crimes against humanity. We only commit crime against each other; we gangbang against somebody who looks just like us on the other side of the same neighborhood. Other nations steal whole countries, steal people, steal children and sell them off, and get reverence for it. America dropped two bombs on Japan, one in Hiroshima, one in Nagasaki, and today the Japanese still love white people while hating black people, and we never dropped a bomb on anybody. But we are the most hated. - Video commentary played: white society's obsession with black people is centuries old. White wealth in America was built off the backs of black bodies: sugar, cotton, tobacco, rice. While trying to dehumanize us, white culture has always been obsessed with us: jazz, rock, hip hop, fashion, all born out of black genius, taken, watered down, and sold back to the world. The speaker concluded, "not every white person acts like this." He understands the hatred, then says not all of them; that is not what the Bible says. Typical Christian. - Video commentary played: the world uses power dynamics against black people because it depends on us; without our exploitation the world economy would collapse. There would be no United States, no Brazil, no Caribbean without slave labor building these countries for free, and black labor is still exploited today, from sub-Saharan Africa's minerals for phones and car batteries on out. The speaker said the United States is lucky black Americans want equality and not revenge. Deacon: oh, we are going to have revenge; the day is coming. America's days are numbered. - News read in class: the United Nations voted to recognize the enslavement of Africans as the gravest crime against humanity, a resolution brought by Ghana. The proposal was adopted with 123 votes in favor and three against: the United States, Israel, and Argentina. 52 countries abstained, including the United Kingdom and European Union member states. Silence is consent. That is Psalms 83 in real time: they have consulted together with one consent. - News shown in class: black Americans never got reparations, but the administration found 1.776 billion dollars for January 6th defendants. The Department of Justice announced a new fund of about 1.7 billion dollars, with the president saying it is reimbursing people that were "horribly treated." Under the DC Compensated Emancipation Act, slave owners were paid up to 300 dollars per enslaved person for the loss of their human property; the people who were enslaved got nothing. Black people built Greenwood, Black Wall Street, and America let mobs destroy it. Reparations are called unrealistic, but insurrectionists may get taxpayer-funded compensation. America always finds money when it wants to, just never for the people it actually owes. - Videos played on abortion: 40 percent of the abortions performed in this country are performed on black women, who are supposed to be 13 percent of the population; the other 60 percent is divided among all other groups. 20 million black babies have been aborted since 1973, and that is only talking about the southern kingdom. Margaret Sanger, who started Planned Parenthood and opened the country's first birth control clinic in 1916, was a member of the American Eugenics Society and wrote in 1919, "I personally believe in the sterilization of the feeble-minded, the insane, and the syphilitic." She used the black church to advance it. Before you ask why they hate us, ask why we hate our own children by continuing to kill them. - Video played of a sister explaining that she cannot hate men because she had a really good father, and the pushback she received for honoring him. Anytime fathers get any type of respect, they have to come with "what about your mother." That shows how far we are from where we need to be. Scriptures Opened Genesis 4:8 12:19 - Let us open with Genesis, because Genesis means the beginning. This is for the Christians who believe in the Bible and have difficulty with the answer. - Cain represents the spirit of Esau in this verse; Abel has the spirit of Jacob. Cain rose up against Abel his brother and slew him. That spirit did not start yesterday; it started in the field. Genesis 3:15 13:15 - I want you to look up the word enmity, because a lot of times we read the Bible over and over again and skip words. Definition read in class from Merriam-Webster: enmity is positive, active, and typically mutual hatred. Enmity means deep hatred. - This is God talking: I will put enmity between thee and the woman. The serpent represents Esau; the woman represents Jacob, the Israelites. God said he would put deep hatred between them, and you cannot change that. - A lion's nature is to have no fear; it does not matter if you are bigger than him. A snake, whether poisonous or not, will eventually bite you, because that is its nature. In the same way, the hatred of the nations toward Israel is their nature. You can marry them if you want to; you cannot change their nature. That is how God set it up. Exodus 32:1-4 21:57 - We have been rebellious against God's laws since before we even left Egypt, and today is no different. Nothing new under the sun: those rebellious spirits from back then are still in the earth today. - We are the same people who saw God use Moses to split the Red Sea right in front of us. It was not even long after; Moses said I will be right back, and the people gathered themselves unto Aaron: up, make us gods which shall go before us. - They took the golden calf and said, these be thy gods, O Israel, which brought thee up out of the land of Egypt. They forgot the God that brought them out of Egypt that fast. That is how rebellious we are. Exodus 32:25-28 24:26 - Moses stood in the gate of the camp and said, who is on the Lord's side? All the sons of Levi gathered themselves together unto him, and there fell of the people that day about 3,000 men. - That day 3,000 of us dropped. We had just left Egypt; we had not reached the promised land yet. Because of rebelliousness. Numbers 14:21-24 26:18 - All those men which have seen my glory and my miracles: we saw his glory in the way the sea split, we saw the pillar give us light at night, we saw all the plagues when Moses went before Pharaoh. - And have tempted me now these ten times: in the wilderness we tested God ten times already, and have not hearkened to my voice. Surely they shall not see the land which I sware unto their fathers. - But my servant Caleb, because he had another spirit with him, and hath followed me fully, him will I bring into the land. Out of all the people that came out of Egypt, only Caleb and Joshua saw that land; the men that came out died in the wilderness and their children went in. That is how rebellious we were, and that is how rebellious we still are. Exodus 14:11-12 28:28 - They told Moses, it had been better for us to serve the Egyptians than that we should die in the wilderness. It was better for us to stay in Egypt. - You do not think some of our people think that right now? America is the spiritual Egypt today. You think all of our people want to leave this place, want to see this place judged? Some of our people want this to go on forever. The same spirit back then is the same spirit today. - They were slaves in Egypt, and still said it was better to stay. Do we not slave in America? And we built this country. Exodus 15:24-26 30:57 - The people murmured against Moses, saying, what shall we drink? He cried unto the Lord, and the Lord showed him a tree which made the waters sweet. - There he proved them: if thou wilt diligently hearken to the voice of the Lord thy God, and keep all his statutes, I will put none of these diseases upon thee which I have brought upon the Egyptians. He is talking about those curses. But we did not listen; we complained about everything. Numbers 11:1-10 33:16 - When the people complained, it displeased the Lord, and the fire of the Lord burnt among them at Taberah. Then the mixed multitude fell a lusting, and the children of Israel wept again: who shall give us flesh to eat? - So far in the wilderness they had not gone hungry: God fed them manna and provided water. Still they said, we remember the fish which we did eat in Egypt freely, the cucumbers, and the melons, and the leeks, and the onions, and the garlic. In Egypt we were eating good. You cannot make this stuff up. - I know what you are saying: if I was there I would never complain. Oh yes, you would. You would do exactly the same thing. Some of us will say the same thing when Christ brings us back into the wilderness: I remember the fast food. We hear the complaints every year at the Feast of Tabernacles: you do not like where your tent spot is, some bring AC and flat screens out to the wilderness. The Lord hears your murmuring in your tents. Numbers 14:1-4 35:45 - When we were in Egypt, were we loved by the Egyptians? No. The same way we are hated in America, we were hated in Egypt also. Yet the whole congregation said, would God that we had died in the land of Egypt; were it not better for us to return into Egypt? - Some of us have it good here. America has spoiled some of us; that is why some of you never go anywhere but stay here. It was the same in Egypt: the taskmasters had it good. Look at the so-called black leaders and politicians today: some have been in Congress for over 30 years and never done one thing for the black community. Pastors living in multimillion dollar houses and flying private jets do not want America to fall. - And they said one to another, let us make a captain, and let us return into Egypt. They basically said, let us remove Moses, raise up another leader, and go back. Ten plagues it took for Pharaoh to let us go, and they said, we do not care, let us go back to Egypt. That is how rebellious we are as a people, but yet we are complaining about why they hate us. Numbers 25:1-9 41:12 - Israel abode in Shittim, and the people began to commit whoredom with the daughters of Moab, and bowed down to their gods, and Israel joined himself unto Baalpeor. - While the Most High God was passing judgment and the congregation was weeping before the door of the tabernacle, one of the children of Israel brought a Midianitish woman in the sight of Moses and all the congregation. No fear; all he cared about was fulfilling his lust. - Phinehas, the son of Eleazar, the son of Aaron the priest, rose up from among the congregation, took a javelin in his hand, and thrust both of them through. And those that died in the plague were 24,000. In one day God killed 24,000, because of sin. Judges 20:14 43:41 - Judges is talking about the civil war; some of you do not know we had a civil war in Israel. History recounted in class: in Judges 19 the men of Gibeah of Benjamin abused a man's wife until she died, he sent the evidence of it to the rest of the tribes, and all the tribes rose up against Benjamin. - The children of Benjamin gathered themselves together out of the cities unto Gibeah, to go out to battle against the children of Israel. Judges 20:34-35 44:56 - The Lord smote Benjamin before Israel, and the children of Israel destroyed of the Benjamites that day 25,100 men. In that civil war 25,000 of us died in a day. 1 Samuel 4:10 45:42 - The Philistines fought, and Israel was smitten, and there was a very great slaughter: there fell of Israel 30,000 footmen in a day. - Keep in mind, every time you see this judgment, it is because of sin. God allowed those numbers to die like that because we decided to turn our back on the Most High God, just like you see today. Nothing new under the sun. Isaiah 22:14 46:48 (Captain's precept) - Surely this iniquity shall not be purged from you till ye die, saith the Lord God of hosts. They were dropping by the tens of thousands, and the Lord is showing that the sin within some could not be purged out of them through mercy, through great miracles, or through the word of God. - It is going to be the same thing today. We are out there teaching, the word is going out, it makes perfect sense to our people; some just do not want to do it. 2 Samuel 24:10-15 47:46 - David's heart smote him after he had numbered the people; today they call that a census. So the Lord sent a pestilence upon Israel, and there died of the people from Dan even to Beersheba 70,000 men. - God killed 70,000 because David decided to number the people. Same way God used the nations back then to correct us when we were disobedient, it is the same thing today. Malachi 3:6 52:02 - According to Christians, God can change; it is a new day now. Let me show you what the Bible says: for I am the Lord, I change not; therefore ye sons of Jacob are not consumed. - You know what that verse is saying? The reason the Israelites are still alive is because God does not change. If he changed, we would have been consumed. The same God who chose Israel to be his people is the same God today, yesterday, and forever. He does not evolve. Malachi 1:4 53:49 - Edom is Esau. Whereas Edom saith, we are impoverished, but we will return and build the desolate places; thus saith the Lord of hosts, they shall build, but I will throw down; and they shall call them the border of wickedness, and the people against whom the Lord hath indignation for ever. - The scripture is telling you that where you see wickedness at work in the earth, Esau's hand is behind it, even when you do not see him physically: financing it, in the background of what you see going on in Africa, in Haiti, in Jamaica, in Sudan, in the Congo. - Some say, no, some of them are good, some of them can repent. What does the Bible say? The people: against whom the Lord hath indignation for ever. You cannot pray this away. God does not hear the prayer of save America. This place will go down; that is what the scripture says. Psalms 83:1-5 1:01:34 - It is not only white people that hate us; we are the most hated people on the whole planet. Our job as the Israelites is to help our people understand why this thing is happening to us, because the answer is in the scriptures. It is not my opinion or your opinion; it is what God says. - Keep not thou silence, O God: God has been silent for over 400 years. They have done to us evil after evil, and God stayed silent. But what you see right now is the spirit of God back on the earth; the Israelites are waking up, and the nations fear, because they know what they did to us. - They have taken crafty counsel against thy people. Crafty counsel is them coming together. The UN vote read in the news above is a perfect example: they have consulted together with one consent. It is not a coincidence that everybody feels the same way about black people no matter what country you travel to; it is a spiritual thing. - Let us cut them off from being a nation, that the name of Israel may be no more in remembrance: today nobody knows who the Israelites are, and another people is called Israel in our place. - Go ahead, Cap: that is a form of Zechariah 11:5, them holding themselves not guilty. Them admitting it is the greatest crime against humanity would mean admitting who did it. They are not going to do that. Wisdom of Solomon 12:10-18 1:14:23 (Captain's teaching) - The issue is we look for equality from the wrong people. Habakkuk 2 talks about how their soul is not upright in them. Instead of begging for reparations from your enemy, we have to wait on the Lord to give us that equality. - Executing thy judgments upon them by little and little: remember the ten plagues in Egypt; the Lord executed judgment little by little, not being ignorant that they were a naughty generation. Just like today: they are not going to repent for the evil they have done to us. - Their malice was bred in them, and their cogitation would never be changed: no matter what you do, bribery or service, the way they feel about you is never going to change. For it was a cursed seed from the beginning. The Lord never gave them pardon; a lot of people think the Lord is okay with it, but he never forgave it. It is a matter of time before the Lord brings the recompense. - Who shall say, what hast thou done? Or who shall withstand thy judgment? No president, no prime minister, no government official is going to be able to stand or speak against the Lord's judgment, because it is going to be just. - But thou, mastering thy power, judgest with equity, and orderest us with great favour: when the Lord brings the judgment, it is going to be equal. For all the evil done to us, they get destruction; that is the vengeance of the Lord, and that is real equality. And we are ordered with great favor. Deuteronomy 7:6 1:17:59 - For thou art an holy people unto the Lord thy God: holy means separate. We are a separate people. - The Lord thy God hath chosen thee to be a special people unto himself, above all people that are upon the face of the earth. Listen: there is no equality. We were chosen to be above all nations, and you wonder why they hate you? They know something about you that you do not know. Your answer is in the scriptures. Psalms 83:5-8 1:19:24 - They are confederate against thee: confederate means they all agree; that is what you see at the UN. They all have the same mindset. - The tabernacles of Edom: do you think it is a coincidence God put Edom first? Edom is the head of the confederacy. And the Ishmaelites: the Arabs. Of Moab, and the Hagarenes: the nations are being described one by one, Gebal, and Ammon, and Amalek. Those are the nations that came together against us. Amos 3:1-2 1:21:25 - Hear this word that the Lord hath spoken against you, O children of Israel, against the whole family which I brought up from the land of Egypt. You know what is so heavy about that verse? God did not bring any other family out of Egypt. So when did God start loving all the nations the same? He brought one family out. - You only have I known of all the families of the earth: does only mean one? Yes. Only means only. Do not get mad at me; that is what he is saying. - Therefore I will punish you for all your iniquities. You want to know why they hate you? God said he is going to punish us for all our sins. Right now we are going through it because of our sin. It is a father punishing his children for breaking his law. It is time we get our minds right. John 15:18-20 1:37:59 - If the world hate you, ye know that it hated me before it hated you. Brothers, we are what you call pilgrims. This is not our world; this is not our kingdom. We were put here to teach a lesson and to learn a lesson. - Because ye are not of the world, but I have chosen you out of the world, therefore the world hateth you. Why are you surprised that nobody likes you? The problem is some of you are seeking love in the wrong places, dying to be loved by people who will never accept you. - The biggest propaganda right now on social media is turning the black man against the black woman and the black woman against the black man. Who do you think is behind it? Esau, pushing us apart. We are the only people who put our own down in front of the other nations to please them. No other nation does that. Judgment is coming for those who go against what the law says, if they do not repent. - Remember the word that I said unto you, the servant is not greater than his lord. We are servants of Christ; if they persecuted him, they will persecute us too. Stop seeking love where there is no love. Jeremiah 30:3 1:43:28 - But brothers and sisters, the scripture has good news. For lo, the days come, saith the Lord, that I will bring again the captivity of my people Israel and Judah: both kingdoms, northern and southern. - And I will cause them to return to the land that I gave to their fathers, and they shall possess it. We shall possess the land. Jeremiah 32:27 1:44:00 - Behold, I am the Lord, the God of all flesh: is there any thing too hard for me? Exodus 1:9-10 1:44:52 (Captain's teaching) - The enemies of Israel have always capitalized off of our self-hatred. Behold, the people of the children of Israel are more and mightier than we: the enemy knows this. - Come on, let us deal wisely with them: crafty counsel, putting plays together. Lest they multiply, and join also unto our enemies, and fight against us, and so get them up out of the land. It is called strategy. Precepts: - Exodus 1:16-17 What they were hoping for was to run into Hebrew women who hated themselves and hated their people, so their plan could be executed: when ye do the office of a midwife to the Hebrew women, if it be a son, then ye shall kill him. That is what the attack on our children has evolved into: make the babies that come out of Israelite wombs vanish. They were doing it by proxy of the midwives. But the midwives feared God: that means the midwives loved their people, and did not as the king of Egypt commanded, but saved the men children alive. Now the mind has been so twisted that no edict is needed; it is done by the millions willingly. That is why we must be the ones to correct this, restore the love of ourselves and the fear of God, and show that the enemy hates us. Jeremiah 32:37 1:47:35 - Behold, I will gather them out of all countries, whither I have driven them in mine anger; and I will bring them again unto this place, and I will cause them to dwell safely. Remember the prophecy: we were scattered, and the Most High God is going to bring us back to our own land. Revelation 5:9 1:48:06 - They sung a new song: thou wast slain, and hast redeemed us to God by thy blood out of every kindred, and tongue, and people, and nation. This hatred is not going to go on forever; whatever we are going through, the Most High God is going to bring us back again. Jeremiah 29:14 1:48:44 - I will be found of you, saith the Lord, and I will turn away your captivity, and I will gather you from all the nations. Why does it say from all nations? This is for the Israelite who says there are no Israelites in Africa. No matter where you go on the planet, you are going to find Israelites. - And I will bring you again into the place whence I caused you to be carried away captive: that is Jerusalem. That is our land. Everything you see here is temporary. You already know the end of the movie; you win. So why are you bugging out? Last week the Bishop was teaching how some of us turn to liquor to deal with the hatred and the trauma. You have to expect the hatred; the problem is you are dying to be loved by people who will never love you. Precepts: - Matthew 28:19 Go ye therefore, and teach all nations: teach the Israelites scattered in all nations. That is the prophecy, and that is why IUIC travels to all these countries and just carried out one of the biggest worldwide blitzes: to bring back our people to who they are. - Matthew 10:22-23 And ye shall be hated of all men for my name's sake: Christ himself said it, so why am I surprised when they hate me? But he that endureth to the end shall be saved. When they persecute you in this city, flee ye into another: for verily I say unto you, ye shall not have gone over the cities of Israel, till the Son of man be come. We are not going to be able to wake every single Israelite before Christ comes back; that is what he is saying. Amos 9:14 1:55:08 - I will bring again the captivity of my people of Israel, and they shall build the waste cities, and inhabit them; and they shall plant vineyards, and drink the wine thereof. - What you see right now is the beginning of the bringing back. We are repenting; now when we read the Bible we say, wait a minute, that is us. You are watching the rise of the greatest nation, and nothing is going to stop this. - Look at your life before you came here and look at your life today: a whole different person. That is the building up. And guess what? Some of your families hate the new you; they liked the old you better. That shows you the Bible is a true book. Ezekiel 36:24-36 1:57:50 - For I will take you from among the heathen, and gather you out of all countries: he keeps repeating it, because we are scattered all over the earth. And will bring you into your own land: I thought Haiti was my land, I thought America was my land, I thought Jamaica was my land. He said your own land. - Then will I sprinkle clean water upon you, and ye shall be clean: from all your filthiness, and from all your idols, will I cleanse you. A new heart also will I give you, and a new spirit will I put within you: he takes away the stony heart and puts his spirit within us, causing us to walk in his statutes. - When you read this, brothers, this should give you hope. Whatever I am going through right now is nothing compared to what is coming. - Then shall ye remember your own evil ways, and shall lothe yourselves in your own sight for your iniquities. The land that was desolate shall become like the garden of Eden. This prophecy also tells you the people over there now are not the ones it speaks of, because this prophecy has not happened yet; their land does not look like the garden of Eden right now. I the Lord have spoken it, and I will do it. Jeremiah 31:31-34 2:02:42 - Behold, the days come, saith the Lord, that I will make a new covenant with the house of Israel, and with the house of Judah: not according to the covenant that I made with their fathers when I brought them out of Egypt, which my covenant they brake. - I will put my law in their inward parts, and write it in their hearts; and I will be their God, and they shall be my people. They shall teach no more every man his neighbour, saying, Know the Lord: for they shall all know me, from the least of them unto the greatest of them. This is talking about the kingdom: all of us are going to know the law. Isaiah 49:22-23 2:04:23 - I will lift up mine hand to the Gentiles: they shall bring thy sons in their arms, and thy daughters shall be carried upon their shoulders. Kings shall be thy nursing fathers, and their queens thy nursing mothers: they shall bow down to thee with their face toward the earth, and lick up the dust of thy feet. - We can hardly fathom these words right now. Who is going to bow down before Israel? People will say you are dreaming. But guess what? That is what the scripture says. Let God be true, and every man a liar. Precepts: - Revelation 3:9 Behold, I will make them of the synagogue of Satan, which say they are Jews, and are not, but do lie; behold, I will make them to come and worship before thy feet. That is the bowing down. Isaiah 60:21-22 2:06:38 - Thy people also shall be all righteous: they shall inherit the land for ever. All of us are going to be righteous, brothers and sisters. Imagine living in a society where every one of us is righteous; imagine the peace. - There was a time we were righteous, a time we did not play with breaking God's laws. That is coming back again. - A little one shall become a thousand, and a small one a strong nation: I the Lord will hasten it in his time. The kingdom of Israel is going to grow fast, real fast. So do not worry about the hatred, and do not worry about who got paid what down here. They are talking about reparations; we are not going to ask for reparations. What is coming to us is greater. That fund is a down payment. - Do not be fooled by the voices saying the black community's problem is finance. We had Black Wall Street; we had Oscarville here in Georgia; nothing changed, because there is no unity without the Bible. Everything we did that never succeeded, this book was not involved. This right here is built around the scriptures; God is behind this, not men. Micah 7:18-19 2:17:21 - Who is a God like unto thee, that pardoneth iniquity? He retaineth not his anger for ever, because he delighteth in mercy. Remember earlier we read that God does not change: if he had changed, all Israel would have been consumed. - Think about it, brothers: before you came here, some of the things you did were worthy of death. Why are you still alive? Because of God's mercy. - He will turn again, he will have compassion upon us; he will subdue our iniquities; and thou wilt cast all their sins into the depths of the sea. He is not going to remember them any more. We serve a merciful God. Luke 13:1-3 2:19:30 - Suppose ye that these Galilaeans were sinners above all the Galilaeans, because they suffered such things? I tell you, Nay: but, except ye repent, ye shall all likewise perish. - That message is for us today. Do not think you are better than the men that were before you. You are here because of God's mercy; every day when you pray, you should thank the Lord that you are still here. Zephaniah 2:1-2 2:20:59 - Gather yourselves together, yea, gather together, O nation not desired: we are the nation nobody desires. Even a comedian's joke made the point: the poorest of them will not trade places with a rich black man. Guess what, brothers? We should have the same resolve: I am going to ride this Israelite thing out, because I know at the end of the tunnel I am getting the kingdom. Whatever a billionaire has is temporary; what I am about to get is eternal. - Before the decree bring forth, before the fierce anger of the Lord come upon you: God is telling us to come together as one before he brings his judgment on the earth. Unity. Build ourselves up; separate ourselves. Zephaniah 3:14-15 2:23:25 - Sing, O daughter of Zion; shout, O Israel; be glad and rejoice with all the heart, O daughter of Jerusalem. Rejoice in the law; today is the Sabbath; be happy you are among the brothers and sisters. Who cares why they hate you? You already know why. It is a good thing they hate us: they hate us when we are in our righteousness, not when we are in the streets. Keep giving them something to hate; become the righteous vessel God created you to be. - The Lord hath taken away thy judgments, he hath cast out thine enemy. Brothers, our judgment is almost ended. We have a short time here; so why are you bugging out? Precepts: - Luke 1:68-72 Blessed be the Lord God of Israel; for he hath visited and redeemed his people, and hath raised up an horn of salvation for us: that horn of salvation is Christ. As he spake by the mouth of his holy prophets: that we should be saved from our enemies, and from the hand of all that hate us. You want to know the answer? Christ is coming back to save us from the hand of all that hate us. Your enemies are not supposed to love you; the problem is you think you have no enemies. To perform the mercy promised to our fathers: the promise is that the kingdom is ours. Zechariah 5:1-4 2:28:12 - I looked, and behold a flying roll. This is the curse that goeth forth over the face of the whole earth: for every one that stealeth shall be cut off, and every one that sweareth shall be cut off. - It shall enter into the house of the thief, and into the house of him that sweareth falsely by my name: America is the house of the thief. This place was stolen. And it shall remain in the midst of his house, and shall consume it with the timber thereof and the stones thereof: that is the judgment coming on America. - They put out the story that they have been ruling the earth since Genesis: no mention of slavery, of Egypt, of Babylon, of Persia; they make it as if they were all of them. Believe it or not, some of our people believe that. Book read in class: The Complete Works of Flavius Josephus, on the nations after the flood: "There were some also who passed over the sea in ships, and inhabited the islands: and some of those nations do still retain the denominations which were given them by their first founders; but some have lost them also... and they were the Greeks who became the authors of such mutations. For when in after-ages they grew potent, they claimed to themselves the glory of antiquity; giving names to the nations that sounded well in Greek... as if they were a people derived from themselves." - Just like the Deacon said: they claim to be the first founders of everything, the first man, the beginning. Josephus records that they claimed to themselves the glory of antiquity. They do that because a lot of our people do not read, so we do not know our true history. Precepts: - 2 Maccabees 7:31 But thou, that hast been the author of all mischief against the Hebrews, shalt not escape the hands of God. They have been the author of all mischief against God's people, and they are not going to escape the hands of God. Ezekiel 35:5-6 2:33:42 - Because thou hast had a perpetual hatred, and hast shed the blood of the children of Israel by the force of the sword in the time of their calamity. That is why it says perpetual: the hatred did not start yesterday and it does not stop. - You are standing in a bloody land. How much of the blood of our forefathers and foremothers spilled in this land? And after they did it, they built churches: come worship God. - When we went to Africa, a brother on a radio show said he wanted Liberia to be like America, a democracy. The Bishop asked him, do you know what you are saying? How many people were killed for America to be America in the name of democracy? - Therefore, as I live, saith the Lord God, I will prepare thee unto blood, and blood shall pursue thee: sith thou hast not hated blood, even blood shall pursue thee. God said blood is going to pursue Esau. Some of you have no idea what is about to come here. And what is being done in the Middle East right now, do you think those nations are going to forget? They are not going to forget. Zephaniah 3:15-20 2:38:38 - The Lord hath taken away thy judgments: thou shalt not see evil any more. In that day it shall be said to Jerusalem, Fear thou not: the Lord is going to remove all our fears. The Lord thy God in the midst of thee is mighty; he will save, he will rejoice over thee with joy; he will rest in his love, he will joy over thee with singing. - Behold, at that time I will undo all that afflict thee: God said he is going to undo all the nations that afflict us. And I will get them praise and fame in every land where they have been put to shame. Where were we put to shame? In America, in Haiti, in Jamaica; all of our lives we have been put to shame. But God says he is going to give us praise and fame: they are going to know your name, and your children's names. You have not seen fame yet. - For I will make you a name and a praise among all people of the earth, when I turn back your captivity before your eyes, saith the Lord. Among those same nations that hate us today. 12 tribes, worldwide. In Closing Why they hated us? The answer was never a mystery: the nations were created with enmity toward Israel, and our own rebellion brought the curses on top of it. So stop asking the question and walk in the footsteps of the persecuted: the prophets, the apostles, and Christ himself were all hated before us. Do not seek love where there is no love; do not trade the eternal for the temporary. Rejoice, be glad, gather together, and ride this Israelite thing out, because the judgment on our enemies is prepared, our judgment is almost ended, and the kingdom is ours. 12 tribes, worldwide. Announcements & References Books referenced in class: - The Complete Works of Flavius Josephus (the Greeks claiming to themselves the glory of antiquity; read at length above) - Definition read in class from Merriam-Webster: enmity, positive, active, and typically mutual hatred Zechariah Isaac is next after the class close. --- Class Notes Index Transcript: full session

title: Acts 10 Reloaded: Call No Man Common
text: Introduction A feast of Pentecost class from Austin, Texas. The opening prayer thanked the Most High for the feast of weeks, and the whole nation gathered to keep the feast day together: teaching first, then the breaking of bread, then a night of fellowship and performances. Bishop set up the lesson: I was going through Acts 10 recently and there is some information I would love to share. The key that unlocks the whole class: everything that the prophets or our Lord and Savior Christ spoke in the New Testament was reiterating what we call today the Old Testament, so that it could substantiate the points they were making. When they said something, they had to be able to use the text to justify their saying. That is what leads us into Acts 10, and into Peter's vision: call no man common. Scriptures Opened John 10:14-16 9:56 - Christ taught that he has other sheep which are not of this fold. The fold he was talking about were the Jews in Jerusalem, primarily Judah, Benjamin, and Levi. I have other sheep that are not of this fold: them also I must bring, and they shall hear my voice, and there shall be one fold and one shepherd: gathering the two nations, the southern and northern kingdoms, together under one shepherd, which is Christ. - The prophecy was that all twelve tribes were going to be brought back together. The beginning of it coming to fruition was when Christ came and began to teach, and his death was the beginning of the twelve tribes being gathered back together. That is what his death was about. - For all of us, there was a time that we heard this voice. We heard the word of God and it triggered us to repentance, to change. Something innate in us made us acknowledge the word of God by hearing his voice and changing our life. Precepts: - Psalms 95:1-7 The rock of our salvation is Christ. We are the people of his pasture, and the sheep of his hand: to day if ye will hear his voice. The same thing Christ said in John 10: they shall hear my voice. - Micah 2:12 I will surely assemble, O Jacob, all of thee: all twelve tribes. I will put them together as the sheep of Bozrah, as the flock in the midst of their fold. The same thing Christ was saying: them also I must bring, that there may be one fold and one shepherd. John 7:32-35 14:58 - Yet a little while am I with you, and then I go unto him that sent me. Who sent Jesus? He was sent from his Father to gather the twelve tribes of Israel. - Ye shall seek me, and shall not find me. Then said the Jews among themselves, whither will he go, that we shall not find him? Will he go unto the dispersed among the Gentiles, and teach the Gentiles? This lets you know the Pharisees and the chief priests were studied men. They understood the prophecies that there was a dispersion: they understood Isaiah 11 and the dispersed, Tobit and the dispersed, Ezekiel 36 and the dispersed. - The majority of the masses did not have what we call the Old Testament. It was the learned men that had the parchments, and it was their job to instruct the people. But now God gave it to the apostles to teach. Precepts: - John 5:30 I seek not mine own will, but the will of the Father which hath sent me. - Isaiah 11:1-3 There shall come forth a rod out of the stem of Jesse, and a Branch shall grow out of his roots: that Branch is Christ; you can read that in Zechariah 6. He shall not judge after the sight of his eyes: the same exact thing he said in John 5:30. So what did God send him to do? - Isaiah 11:10-12 To it shall the Gentiles seek. Who are the Gentiles in this regard? A brother answered: stay in the passage; verses 11 and 12 explain it. The Lord shall set his hand again the second time to recover the remnant of his people, and he shall assemble the outcasts of Israel, and gather together the dispersed of Judah from the four corners of the earth. The Gentiles he is talking about are the outcasts of Israel. That was God's will in sending his Son: to gather the twelve tribes. - Proverbs 1:27-28 Ye shall seek me and shall not find me: when your fear cometh as desolation, then shall they call upon me, but I will not answer; they shall seek me early, but they shall not find me. - Deuteronomy 28:64 The reason Isaiah 11 says he shall set up an ensign for the nations is because we were going to be scattered among all people, from the one end of the earth even unto the other, and live as Gentiles. - Tobit 3:4 Israel was delivered for a spoil, unto captivity, unto death, and for a proverb of reproach to all the nations among whom we are dispersed. - Tobit 13:5 He will scourge us for our iniquities, and will have mercy again, and will gather us out of all nations among whom he hath scattered us. Again it uses the word nations, explaining that it was Israel being scattered. - Ezekiel 36:19 And I scattered them among the heathen, and they were dispersed through the countries. - Acts 21:21 Paul taught all the Jews which are among the Gentiles. We know from the text that the Jews were going to be dispersed among the Gentiles and live like Gentiles. The New Testament shows Paul going out to find the Jews scattered among the other nations, living like strangers and heathens, and bringing them back to God. The job was to raise up the twelve tribes of Israel again. Matthew 4:15 27:52 - The land of Zabulon, and the land of Nephthalim, by the way of the sea, beyond Jordan, Galilee of the Gentiles. Precepts: - Isaiah 9:1 Galilee of the nations: so the nations also means the Gentiles. What we read in Matthew 4:15 was already recorded in the Old Testament. When the prophets spoke, they substantiated their points from this text. John 4:1-14 30:03 - Christ asked the woman of Samaria for water to drink, and she said, how is it that thou, being a Jew, askest drink of me, which am a woman of Samaria? For the Jews have no dealings with the Samaritans. These Samaritans were Israelites. Samaria is north of Jerusalem, as the map showed: the Jews of Jerusalem did not deal with our people located in Samaria. - Art thou greater than our father Jacob? That shows you she understood she was part of the twelve tribes of Israel; she just knew the Jews had no dealings with them. - Whosoever drinketh of the water that I shall give him shall never thirst, but it shall be in him a well of water springing up into everlasting life. The water, the understanding he was going to give her, would bring about the kingdom and salvation for them, because they were disconnected from it for so long. Precepts: - Hosea 4:17 A brother answered why the Jews stopped dealing with them: Ephraim is joined to idols: let him alone. - Hosea 1:6-11 Call her name Loruhamah: for I will no more have mercy upon the house of Israel. They fully went into idolatry. Call his name Loammi: for ye are not my people, and I will not be your God. That was the message to the northern kingdom because of their idolatry. But then it comes back: in the place where it was said unto them, Ye are not my people, there it shall be said unto them, Ye are the sons of the living God. What is he saying? I am going to bring you back together again. All the prophets spoke from a place of prophecy, judgment, and eventually redemption. That is what gives us hope to repent: if there were no endgame where we come out of this, there is no incentive. - Isaiah 7:8 Within threescore and five years shall Ephraim be broken. It was already prophesied: God already told them that in 65 years the northern kingdom would be destroyed, and that is what Hosea 1 is recording. - Ephesians 5:26 A brother answered what the living water is: that he might sanctify and cleanse it with the washing of water by the word. The living water is the word of God, the understanding that the tribes were going to be gathered back together. - Colossians 1:23-29 Even the mystery which hath been hid from ages and from generations, but now is made manifest to his saints. It was hid for ages that the northern kingdom had a place in this, to repent and come back. The riches of the glory of this mystery among the Gentiles: the secret that was hid for ages is being revealed; it is no longer gatekept. The apostles were going to go throughout the earth and teach the people that you are not Puerto Rican, you are not Dominican, or whatever name was put on them: you are the children of Israel. And that is what is happening to us now in this present time: the understanding of who we are was hid for ages, but the Lord said in this hour the true worshippers are going to wake up. John 4:20-23 43:55 - Our fathers worshipped in this mountain: the mountains of Samaria, Mount Gerizim and Mount Ebal on the map. And ye say that in Jerusalem is the place where men ought to worship. - Woman, believe me, the hour cometh, when ye shall neither in this mountain, nor yet at Jerusalem, worship the Father. He was telling her there is a time coming, which was 70 AD, when Jerusalem would be toppled by the Romans; neither place would matter, because he was destroying it. It was him explaining that his purpose was to gather in one the twelve tribes of Israel. - Ye worship ye know not what: we know what we worship: for salvation is of the Jews. When he says Jews, he is talking about all Israel. We know what God's will is for us, for his people, and for the nations, and our job is to teach those things, and in teaching them, to gather in one the twelve tribes of Israel. Precepts: - Joshua 8:30-35 Then Joshua built an altar unto the Lord God of Israel in mount Ebal. That is why she said our fathers worshipped in this mountain: when we first came into the land, the first place we came into would have been called Samaria, and the first altars were set up in Mount Ebal and Mount Gerizim. When the nation split, the northern kingdom went back up top and worshipped there; but God called his home Jerusalem, where he set up his temple. Notice also: as well the stranger, as he that was born among them; half against mount Gerizim and half against mount Ebal; and the strangers were conversant in the laws of God. When we came into the land we had a mixed multitude among us, and they had to learn the laws; we taught them how to keep the Sabbath day: neither thy manservant, nor thy maidservant, nor the stranger that is within thy gates. Acts 11:1-19 51:02 - The apostles and brethren in Judea heard that the Gentiles, which were the Israelites that were scattered, had also received the word of God. When Peter came up to Jerusalem, they of the circumcision, the Jews of Judah, Benjamin, and Levi, contended with him: thou wentest in to men uncircumcised, and didst eat with them. You went and dealt with the heathen Gentiles, Israelites that were cut off. Peter, do you not remember Hosea 1? These are no longer God's people. - But Peter rehearsed the matter from the beginning and expounded it by order unto them: the vision of the great sheet let down from heaven by four corners, the voice saying arise, Peter, slay and eat, and the answer, what God hath cleansed, that call not thou common. - When they heard these things, they held their peace, and glorified God, saying, Then hath God also to the Gentiles granted repentance unto life. What would Peter have had to tell them to make them hold their peace? A brother answered: he would have had to expound what was written in Ezekiel 37 and Isaiah 11, that the northern kingdom would be grafted back in. He had to use scripture to explain the vision, to show this is not something I am coming up with; this is based on scripture. The vision was an allegory of the message God was sharing: the time is at hand to wake them up; it is time for them to come in. - Verse 19 shows that those scattered abroad upon the persecution that arose about Stephen traveled as far as Phenice, Cyprus, and Antioch, preaching the word. Some people would not accept this and persecuted the believers, and the people scattered further out and took this gospel with them. Acts 10:1-8 57:03 - There was a certain man in Caesarea called Cornelius, a centurion of the band called the Italian band. Caesarea, named after Caesar, was on the north coast of the land of Israel. - A devout man, and one that feared God with all his house, which gave much alms to the people, and prayed to God alway. His prayers and his alms came up for a memorial before God, and the angel told him to send men to Joppa and call for Simon, whose surname is Peter. Precepts: - Acts 22:12 What does devout mean? Ananias was a devout man according to the law, having a good report. So when Acts 10 says Cornelius was a devout man, he was a law abiding man; he kept the laws of God. - Tobit 12:15 I am Raphael, one of the seven holy angels, which present the prayers of the saints. These are the angels that bring your prayers before the Most High God. - Tobit 12:8 Prayer is good with fasting and alms and righteousness. When you pray to God, if you combine it with alms and fasting, the prayers are heard before the Most High. That is exactly what we read of Cornelius in Acts 10:2 and 10:4. Acts 10:9-19 1:01:42 - Peter went up upon the housetop to pray, fell into a trance, and saw heaven opened and a certain vessel descending, as it had been a great sheet knit at the four corners, wherein were all manner of fourfooted beasts of the earth, and wild beasts, and creeping things, and fowls of the air. Rise, Peter; kill, and eat. But Peter said, Not so, Lord; for I have never eaten any thing that is common or unclean. - The vision was not really talking about food. That is why it says Peter doubted in himself what this vision should mean: is the Lord telling me to eat unlawful animals? When visions come from God, they are an allegory, referring to something else. Precepts: - Hosea 12:10 I have multiplied visions, and used similitudes, by the ministry of the prophets. A similitude shows you one thing, but it is really something else he is trying to explain. That is what Peter was pondering. Acts 10:21-28 1:05:00 - The men from Cornelius told Peter: Cornelius the centurion, a just man, and one that feareth God, and of good report among all the nation of the Jews, was warned from God by an holy angel to send for thee. - As Peter came in, Cornelius fell down at his feet and worshipped him. But Peter took him up, saying, Stand up; I myself also am a man. - Ye know how that it is an unlawful thing for a man that is a Jew to keep company, or come unto one of another nation; but God hath shewed me that I should not call any man common or unclean. When he saw him, he came to the understanding: the vision was not talking about food and unclean animals; it was talking about not calling another man common and unclean. Why? Because he learned Cornelius was a just man, a devout man. Acts 10:34-35 1:07:06 - Then Peter opened his mouth, and said, Of a truth I perceive that God is no respecter of persons. Northern kingdom, southern kingdom: he is no respecter of persons. - But in every nation he that feareth him, and worketh righteousness, is accepted with him. That is what he came to understand: Israel, the ones that were called not God's people, would one day be joined back in. Precepts: - Acts 2:1-5 There were dwelling at Jerusalem Jews, devout men, out of every nation under heaven, come together for the feast of Pentecost: devout Jews, devout like Cornelius, out of every nation. God is no respecter of persons; those that keep the commandments have a place of repentance. Acts 10:11-12, the vessel decoded 1:09:10 - Now the scriptures substantiate the vision Peter had. The vessel knit at the four corners is Israel, and the beasts within it are men. This is why the nations cannot handle us right now: when we speak, we can use the Bible to explain itself. When they hear it, they think it is everybody. No: God said Israel was the vessel. Precepts: - Hosea 8:8 Israel is swallowed up: now shall they be among the Gentiles as a vessel wherein is no pleasure. Israel was that vessel. - Isaiah 11:12 The four corners: he shall assemble the outcasts of Israel, and gather together the dispersed of Judah from the four corners of the earth. It was Israel scattered through the four corners of the earth, living as beasts. - 2 Esdras 8:29 Let it not be thy will to destroy them which have lived like beasts. The beasts refer to man. - Psalms 73:22 So foolish was I, and ignorant: I was as a beast before thee. - Isaiah 51:20 Thy sons have fainted, they lie at the head of all the streets, as a wild bull in a net. When Peter explained the fourfooted beasts and wild beasts, he would have to refer to these scriptures: remember, it is written that we lived as beasts, that we were as a wild bull. - Habakkuk 1:14 And makest men as the fishes of the sea, as the creeping things, that have no ruler over them. When we were without God, with no ruler, we were like creeping things; without the laws of God we were like beasts. - Hosea 7:11-12 Ephraim also is like a silly dove without heart: I will bring them down as the fowls of the heaven. The fowls of the air also refer to man. Imagine those of the circumcision hearing Peter refer to Hosea: remember, he called us fowls. That is why the scripture says prove all things: everything must be proven as it is written, that thou mightest be justified in thy sayings, and overcome when thou art judged. Acts 10:13, rise, kill, and eat 1:17:14 - We know now the vision is referring to man. So what is the rise talking about? What was the whole purpose of the vision? A brother answered: to gather the northern and southern kingdoms back together, to gather us back together from where we were scattered, east to west, north to south. - Rise, Peter: it is time to gather the twelve tribes of Israel. Kill: kill the old man, mortify yourself, discipline yourself. Eat: devour wisdom, learn the scripture. And then go out and teach. But in that time there was no New Testament: Peter would have to explain it to those of the circumcision using the Old Testament. Precepts: - Baruch 5:5 Arise, O Jerusalem, and stand on high, and look about toward the east, and behold thy children gathered from the west unto the east by the word of the Holy One. By this word is what is going to gather the children of Israel back together. He is telling Peter: it is time; awake; rise; now it is time to gather the twelve tribes of Israel. - 2 Esdras 8:12 A brother said kill means kill the old man, as in Romans 6; but Peter would have needed the Old Testament: thou shalt mortify it as thy creature, and quicken it as thy work. Mortify, deaden, kill the old man, and be quickened. - 2 Esdras 8:4-5 Swallow down understanding, O my soul, and devour wisdom: that is the eating; you have to learn. For thou hast agreed to give ear, and art willing to prophesy: after you learn, you go out and prophesy. Rise, Peter: it is time to gather the twelve tribes. Kill the old man; mortify yourself. Eat; devour wisdom. Then go out and prophesy. - Revelation 10:9-11 The same pattern: take the little book and eat it up; and thou must prophesy again before many peoples, and nations, and tongues, and kings. You have to eat, learn, and then you must go out and prophesy. Acts 10:14-15, common and unclean 1:25:09 - Not so, Lord; for I have never eaten any thing that is common or unclean. In other words: I have never dealt with sin; I have never dealt with people that were evil. - And the voice spake unto him again the second time, What God hath cleansed, that call not thou common. The subject matter of the cleansing is man; and to explain that cleansing, Peter would have to use the Old Testament. Precepts: - Ecclesiastes 6:1 There is an evil which I have seen under the sun, and it is common among men. Peter understood that common was tied to evil. - Baruch 6:11 They will give thereof to the common harlots: common used again for evil. So when Peter said, I have never eaten anything common or unclean, he was saying, I have never dealt with sinners. Ezekiel 37:16-23 1:27:52 - Where would Peter go to explain that God has cleansed them? A brother answered: Ezekiel 37:23. I will save them out of all their dwellingplaces, wherein they have sinned, and will cleanse them: so shall they be my people, and I will be their God. - Behold, I will take the children of Israel from among the heathen: that is where he is gathering them from; they were living among the Gentiles, the nations. He will gather them, cleanse them, take the two kingdoms and make them one kingdom. - Take thee one stick, and write upon it, For Judah; then take another stick, and write upon it, For Joseph, the stick of Ephraim. This is what Peter would have had to read to them, to convince them that the cleansing of the northern kingdom was going to happen and they would be brought back in. Precepts: - Hosea 1:10-11 Then shall the children of Judah and the children of Israel be gathered together, and appoint themselves one head. In the place where it was said unto them, Ye are not my people, there it shall be said unto them, Ye are the sons of the living God. The time has come, Peter: we have to gather them together. And guess what: that is happening now. It has been going on since back then until now: we are out in South America gathering God's people, out in Africa gathering God's people, here in the States bringing God's people back together. Galatians 2:9-14 1:33:31 - James, Cephas, and John gave Paul and Barnabas the right hands of fellowship; that we should go unto the heathen, and they unto the circumcision. The heathen: talking about the northern kingdom. - But when Peter was come to Antioch, I withstood him to the face, because he was to be blamed. Before certain came from James, he did eat with the Gentiles: but when they were come, he withdrew and separated himself, fearing them which were of the circumcision. Paul said: you already learned this, Peter; God showed you that you cannot call any man common or unclean. You sat with them; you convinced many of the Jews that these men were all right. But now you are wavering. - And the other Jews dissembled likewise with him; insomuch that Barnabas also was carried away with their dissimulation. The class looked up dissimulation: deception, hypocrisy, pretense, deceit; in other words, being fake. - If thou, being a Jew, livest after the manner of Gentiles, and not as do the Jews, why compellest thou the Gentiles to live as do the Jews? Peter knew better. He was corrected in front of them all, and he would have been embarrassed and ashamed. But he repented; and as a teacher, what do you teach after that? What you repented from: do not be fake. Precepts: - 1 Peter 1:22 Seeing ye have purified your souls in obeying the truth through the Spirit unto unfeigned love of the brethren, see that ye love one another with a pure heart fervently. Peter came back and taught it after he learned: we cannot have fake love for the brethren, because God already showed me; and when I was put to the test, I was influenced not to accept them. So now the message is: do not have feigned love for the brethren. Acts 2:1-17 1:42:26 - When the day of Pentecost was fully come, they were all with one accord in one place. Suddenly there came a sound from heaven as of a rushing mighty wind, and they were all filled with the Holy Ghost, and began to speak with other tongues, other languages. - Devout men, out of every nation under heaven: according to Deuteronomy 28 we were going to be scattered into all nations. Every man heard them speak in his own language, and they marvelled: are not all these which speak Galilaeans? That is because we were scattered among the heathen; we learned their languages. - The list of nations: Parthians, and Medes, modern day Iran; Elamites; the dwellers in Mesopotamia, down into Iraq and Babylon; Cappadocia, Pontus, Asia, Phrygia, Pamphylia, Asia Minor; Egypt, and the parts of Libya about Cyrene, Africa; strangers of Rome, Jews and proselytes; Cretes and Arabians. The point: Jews and proselytes. There were people being gathered that were not out of Jerusalem; they were scattered, and people were converting back to the laws of God. This is what Ephesians 2 speaks of: at one time you were without God, and now you are being brought back into the commonwealth of Israel. - Others mocking said, These men are full of new wine. But Peter, standing up with the eleven, said, these are not drunken, as ye suppose, seeing it is but the third hour of the day. But this is that which was spoken by the prophet Joel: in the last days, saith God, I will pour out of my Spirit upon all flesh, and your sons and your daughters shall prophesy. Prophesy about what? The gathering of the twelve tribes of Israel; teaching the people who they are. The masses did not know; it was the job of the priests and the prophets to teach the people. But in the last days God is raising the message back up, and we are going out to raise our people back up and show them they are not Arabs and Muslims and African Americans or whatever label was put on them: we are the children of Israel. Precepts: - Acts 4:31 When they had prayed, the place was shaken, and they were all filled with the Holy Ghost, and they spake the word of God with boldness. When the apostles spoke and the Holy Ghost filled them, they were bold, because they knew what they were saying was sent of God and they could prove it. - Ecclesiasticus 48:12-13 Elias was covered with a whirlwind, and Eliseus was filled with his spirit: he was not moved with the presence of any prince, and no word could overcome him. Men, study: when you are out in the street, there should be no word that can confound you. We should not hear men teaching who cannot explain basic scriptures. We are going up against, for the most part, Christians, and they do not know the Bible. We should know who we are and how to explain it: Galatians 3, Ephesians 2:11-16; this is elementary. When the spirit of God is on you, no word should be able to overcome you. - Ezekiel 37:9-10 Prophesy unto the wind: come from the four winds, O breath, and breathe upon these slain, that they may live. That is the word of God coming upon them; and the breath came into them, and they lived, and stood up upon their feet, an exceeding great army. That is what was happening in Acts: they taught, and the people came in and gathered. All of you are here because the word of God was inspired on you, and it was not because the people teaching were shaky. So for you men out there teaching: study to shew thyself approved. - Psalms 19:3 There is no speech nor language, where their voice is not heard. In Closing The whole class was one demonstration: Peter's vision in Acts 10 was never about food. The vessel knit at the four corners was Israel; the beasts, creeping things, and fowls were our people living as beasts among the nations; and the command to rise, kill, and eat was the commission: it is time to gather the twelve tribes, kill the old man, devour wisdom, and go out and prophesy. What God hath cleansed, call not thou common. And the same gathering is happening now, from South America to Africa to the States. Stay godly, stay fervent, and do the work. Closing reading at the breaking of bread: 1 Corinthians 11:23-30, the bread and the cup, in remembrance of the Lord's death till he come; let a man examine himself. Announcements & References - Class was taught by Bishop for the feast of Pentecost in Austin, Texas, with leadership and congregations traveling in from across the region; the previous Sabbath's class was Colossians 2. - The creative and AV team was honored on stage: the brothers and sisters behind the thumbnails, graphics, and videos, from the days of no thumbnails and PowerPoint to today's cinematic work. Officers Emmanuel (Houston), Baruch (Mississippi), Daniel, Caleb, Kim (Tampa), Malachi (Bahamas, who builds thumbnails from his phone), Aaron (Tallahassee), Kaziel (Carolinas), Jeremiah (Jacksonville), Luke (Boston), Gabriel (Louisville), young brother Malachi, Sister Emma, and Sister Zamara (Arizona) were acknowledged, with a whole army of young men trained behind them. None of them hide their talents; each one teaches one. They brought the word of God to a visual level that helps our children envision what the Bible is saying. - The rest of the feast night was music and performances from the nation's artists, celebrating Pentecost 2026 with joyfulness and gladness of heart. --- Class Notes Index Transcript: full session

title: FORGED BY FIRE
text: Introduction Class opened in Rochester, New York, with the reading of Psalm 116 at the trumpets: I love the Lord, because he hath heard my voice and my supplications; I will pay my vows unto the Lord now in the presence of all his people. The thumbnail showed gold being forged and poured, because we are not just in the fire; we are being turned into something. Something is being burned out of us to turn us into the next element. A soldier from the congregation set the frame for the class: forged by fire is the trials we go through that purify us, the tribulations that clean out the wickedness we have inside of us. Scriptures Opened Ecclesiasticus 2:1-5 13:05 - For gold is tried in the fire. It is not just something burning; it is something being purged, being tried, being cleaned. Fire is a purifier, one of the best purifiers, and the Most High uses fire all through the Bible to purify, because it burns out the impurities, the bad elements, the things that will corrupt you. If he did not use the fire, you would not get cleaned. The metalworkers do the same thing: they heat up the elements to burn out the impurities and get the best element. That is us. To get the best you, the impurities have to be burned out. - My son, if thou come to serve the Lord, prepare thy soul for temptation: that is the qualifier. When you sign up to do the Lord's work, now you are in the furnace; now the fire turns on. - Set thy heart aright, and constantly endure: because the fire never turns off. The impurities never stop; you are constantly being bombarded, constantly pressured to do the wrong thing. Look at social media; look at how the world is being turned upside down. Everything that is wrong in the earth right now is because the people over the earth are wicked. So if you find yourself at rest, that means you are not being purged; you are off the stove, you are cold; matter of fact, you are in the refrigerator. - Make not haste in time of trouble: the fire has to stay on you to burn the impurities out. If you make haste and leave, you cool down and go back to the state you were in. And once you turn your back to him, who is going to turn the fire back on? Satan makes it easy for you; Satan gives you your heart's desire, everything you want. You want your coworker, you can have him; you like watching porn, here is your whole algorithm. The restraint is the fire: putting the phone down, putting blocks on the phone, throwing the phone in the trash if it got too bad for you. The fire is the restraint, turning away from evil. - Cleave unto him, and depart not away, that thou mayest be increased at thy last end. A brother answered what the increase at the last end is: getting the kingdom. That is why we go through this; the fire has a reason, the restraint has a reason. You have to go through this to get to the next level. There is no neutral gear; either you are moving forward or you are moving backwards, either you are hot and fervent or you are ice cold. Christ said pick one; if you are in the middle, you are going to die. - Whatsoever is brought upon thee take cheerfully: whatever trial comes, take it cheerfully, because the trials have to come to purge it out of you. You go through trials and it feels like your family is against you; do you turn back, go eat the ham sandwich and open the Christmas gifts? Do you give up ten or fifteen years in this truth because you lost your job, so your family can welcome you back with open arms? When you give up on the brothers and sisters that labor in this truth with you, where are you going back to, and what is waiting for you when you get there? Absolutely nothing. Putting the ball down is easy; walking on and laboring with your brothers is the hard part, because we labor together. - Unity is knowing my brother is going through it the same way I am going through it, and being able to lean on each other: hey, I know you lost your job; you good, your family good? If you need something, let me know. Imagine going through this together for ten years and I act like I do not know you when you are going through something. And if you walk away from the battlefield and leave your men on the field, in the military they declare you a deserter and put you to death, because leaving your people on the field is saying, I hope you die too. James 1:2-4 26:09 - My brethren, count it all joy when ye fall into divers temptations, knowing this, that the trying of your faith worketh patience. We are supposed to go through this, and as we go through it we grow in the spirit. It is like working out: the muscle breaks down and grows as you work it, but if you never work out, your muscles never grow. The more you go through trials and tribulations, the stronger you get at going through them. - If you never go through anything, the first trial that comes will trip you up and throw you out. That is why some brothers bug out at the first trial: they never have been through anything. That is also why leadership will say, I cannot trust you yet; I have never seen you go through anything. I have to see you experience something; I have to know your temperament, whether you are going right or left when you go through it, whether you will betray me the first chance the pressure comes around the corner. - The brothers who deserted in 2018 peeled out over nonsense: I got so much on my plate, it is too much, I am going to do the same thing but on my own terms. If you would leave over that type of stuff, what would a real trial bring? - But let patience have her perfect work, that ye may be perfect and entire, wanting nothing. God does not want to destroy you with your trials; he wants to build you with your trials. He is perfecting you, making you stronger with each trial. It is levels to this thing: each trial takes you up to the next level, and as you grow, your spirit grows and you are able to endure the next level. Proverbs 17:3 30:58 - The fining pot is for silver, and the furnace for gold: but the Lord trieth the hearts. All those vessels are used for different reasons, but the Lord tries your heart, your mind; he sees what you are really about. How are you really going to deal with issues, with problems, with each other, with your wife, with your kids, with the congregation? - Some brothers cannot deal with anything; you do not even deal with yourself, so how are you going to deal with the next man, or with the sisters? It is spiritual: you think you are hiding it, but you are not hiding it at all. The Lord is trying you; this is the furnace, and how you deal with the matter is your first trial. 1 Corinthians 3:12-15 33:58 - We all go through it, but we go through it together; we push and we endure a little at a time. Some things are easier for some than for others, but if we work together it balances out, because we bear each other's burdens. If you are a one man gang, then I guess you do not need us, and I guess we do not need you. - Every man's work shall be made manifest: for the day shall declare it, because it shall be revealed by fire. By fire means by trial. Nobody is pouring lighter fluid on you; your trials are what reveal you. As your trials come, that is where you get your grades: how you deal with the matter, how strong you are in the spirit when things come. You lose your job and you bug out; your wife loses her job and you throw yourself out the window. Is this the first time you have ever seen poverty? We thrive in poverty; we became a nation under slavery. But you do not see it, because you think it is all about you; you are a one man nation. - Everybody has their own trials and tribulations, and they are all fit for you, custom made by the Lord to try you and your spirit, to see what you are made of. Your trial is not my trial; what comes easy for you might never come easy for me, and what comes easy for me might never come easy for you. But we are all joined together; that is 1 Corinthians 12. We all have skill sets unique to us: one officer speaks Spanish, so he goes where the Spanish is needed; another brother only has passing out flyers, but he is going on the mission, because we are going to do the Lord's work together. - And the fire shall try every man's work of what sort it is. If any man's work abide, he shall receive a reward; if any man's work shall be burned, he shall suffer loss: but he himself shall be saved; yet so as by fire. That fire is going to burn up the work, but the man is going to be saved. A brother brought it home: a leader went through something and others bugged out, but the leader stayed in the fight. The trial was for everyone; the leader endured while others fell to the wayside. That is what this is about: endurance, going through it, enduring to the end. It might not be pretty, you might get scuffed up, but keep pushing. The Lord is not trying to kill you with this; he wants to see what you are made of. 1 Corinthians 10:13 40:19 - God is faithful, who will not suffer you to be tempted above that ye are able. He is not going to put more on you than you can endure. And he does not tempt you; you tempt yourself. You are an alcoholic: he does not give you the alcohol; you walk into the bar and buy it. You put yourself in that situation. He tries you, but you tempt yourself. - You cannot play word games with God and say, God, you tempted me; God did this to me. No, you did that to yourself, and you are going to pay. You leave your men on the battlefield and say God put us in this situation; no, you left your men on the field. - With the temptation he will also make a way to escape. If you are going through trials and tribulations, all you have to do is pick up the phone: hey my brother, I am going through it. Go to leadership: hey, I have this going on. But your pride will not let you, and it boils down to sin. Why can you not fix your family? Sin. Why is your house out of control? Sin. Still dealing with porn? Sin. You will not let the tail of that snake go until it bites you; you will not stop until it puts you to death. It is you, not God, and it is always going to be you until there is nothing left. Romans 8:28-39 43:52 - And we know that all things work together for good to them that love God. We have to go through this; we have to suffer, because we deserve it, and because we have to get fixed. In order to get to heaven, you have to walk through hell; you cannot see heaven if you do not walk through hell. And when you elevate to the next level, guess what is waiting on you there: more trials and tribulations. But you train your mind to recognize it: okay, this is a trial I have to work through. I need to train my eyes to stop looking that way; I make a covenant with my eyes. My algorithm is starting to look crazy; I need to stop clicking on that kind of stuff, stay off social media. Is it going to stop? No; it is on YouTube, Instagram, Facebook, the commercials, even the t-shirt section in the store, because it is a trial in you that you have to deal with at different levels. - If God be for us, who can be against us? The Most High is giving us ways out of these problems. He is never going to put you in a situation you cannot back out of. I offended my brother; we were joking, I thought it was funny, he did not. What do I have to do? Make the phone call and make it right, right then and there: hey bro, my fault; we good. Problem solved. Not the phony call the day before the Day of Atonement: brother, if I have offended you in the slightest bit over the past two years; that is not authentic and you do not mean it. And do not carry an offense for years until it becomes a part of you, where nothing the brother says can fix it. That is how the world does; not righteous people. These trials are geared toward fixing us; we cannot keep doing it the same way and expect something to change. - He that spared not his own Son, but delivered him up for us all, how shall he not with him also freely give us all things? He is trying to give us a kingdom. Christ went through the furnace, and we are the ambassadors of Christ; do you think you are not going to go through the same thing? - Who shall separate us from the love of Christ? The class worked through why it says who and not what: anybody and anything you put in front of Christ becomes your idol, to include yourself, your mother, your sister, your baby.
