A brother tied it to Matthew 10:34: Christ came not to send peace but a sword, and if you put mother, father, sister, or brother before him you are not worthy of him; you are allowing a person to come between you and the Lord. - Then it names the events: shall tribulation, or distress, or persecution, or famine, or nakedness, or peril, or sword? The persecution is coming; it is already here. Look at the young brother Carmelo Anthony and how he could be framed and face thirty five years. And it is not hard for social media to persecute you now: AI will have you watching a video of yourself doing something and make you question yourself, and it is getting so sophisticated that your own people will say, I did not think he would do something like that, and testify against you instead of being your alibi. Technology is putting us right where the scripture said it is going to put us; when we read this we think we are far off, but we are not. Being put on trial for this truth is already here; being put to death for this truth is already here. If you give up or turn your back to this truth because of the trials, shame on you. - As it is written, for thy sake we are killed all the day long; for the sake of Christ we are accounted as sheep for the slaughter. Nay, in all these things we are more than conquerors through him that loved us. - For I am persuaded that neither death, nor life, nor angels, nor principalities, nor powers, nor things present, nor things to come, nor height, nor depth, nor any other creature, shall be able to separate us from the love of God, which is in Christ Jesus our Lord. And there is a period at the end of that. Nothing should be able to separate you, because you know what is at the end of this: paradise is waiting on us. You are being put in a furnace to be tried and turned into pure gold. Your wicked family turning their back on you? Good. When I came in this truth I got rid of a whole lot of dead weight and useless conversations; the only people that call me now call about the truth. If it is not about the scriptures, do not talk to me; that is beneficial for me and for you. Precepts: - John 13:15-17 Verily, verily, I say unto you, the servant is not greater than his lord. Christ was the example, and we are going to walk the same footsteps; you are going to get punished the same way. It is not going to be easy; it is not supposed to be easy. If our Lord and Master went through it, do you not think that you are going to go through it? If ye know these things, happy are ye if ye do them. Hebrews 12:6-7 1:04:27 - For whom the Lord loveth he chasteneth. Why would he correct us or rebuke us if he did not love us? The correction comes because of the love, not the opposite. If he did not love us, he would cut us off; look at Esau: he cut him off because he hates him. - Some of you are going through it and pouting; no, you are supposed to go through it. You got three flat tires? So what: you got one more tire than you deserve, and all praise to the Most High, we are going to get you three more. We all go through it, but we keep pushing, because a whole kingdom is waiting on us; the world being turned right side up is waiting on us. The whole world is waiting for us to stand up, and we have to do it manfully, the right way; we cannot skate by. We push together, or we do not do it at all. - For what son is he whom the father chasteneth not? As a father you have to correct your son, because if you do not correct him, you do not love him; and as a father you want to see your son do better than you. It is the same in the truth: the heads of the school are fathers over the congregation and treat you as sons, and our leadership are fathers over us; we get chastised just as much as you do, if not more. But that is out of love. And some will turn their back to that and take their ball and go home. Precepts: - Ecclesiasticus 27:5 An officer tied it back to the fire: the furnace proveth the potter's vessels, so the trial of man is in his reasoning. When the Lord turns up the heat, he is trying your heart, and your reasoning gets revealed. You lost the job, and now you want to pick up a job on the Sabbath: your reasoning is off; covetousness is revealed. You get checked and you argue and have strife: ego is revealed. As the fire goes up in your life, different spirits rise to the top like metal in the melt. He is dealing with you as a son; are you going to respect him as a father? That is why it says take it cheerfully: you are getting purged as he tries your reasoning, and you get to show forth whether everything you have been hearing is actually being learned and applied. Malachi 3:16 1:10:39 - Then they that feared the Lord spake often one to another. When you are getting tried, there is another element the Lord is showing you: a lot of brothers and sisters like to suffer in silence, and the Lord is showing you your communication is weak and you need to grow in that area. He is giving us lifelines; we have to use them. - Spake often one to another is not, I only speak to you on the Sabbath. We ask brothers, how are you doing; I am good, I am enduring. That was an opportunity right there, and you played games with it. And you are really not suffering in silence, because we see the spirit on you. We ask, are you okay, sister? I am okay. You look bugged out completely; are you all right? Because of pride we suffer in silence, then start being offended with everybody around us, and next thing you know you find yourself out the door: they do not really love me, where is the charity? That is how brothers and sisters go down. Psalms 133:1 1:12:48 - Behold, how good and how pleasant it is for brethren to dwell together in unity. The Bible is about unity, not separation; we separate from the wicked, not the righteous. We join together to get over the hurdles and push through, because by unifying we are stronger; the fist is strong together. - When brothers do not apply the opportunity for unity, they are saying they have no hope in anything; you hope everything fails. At that moment you are the spot in the feast: the scripture says when we come to the unity of the faith we are able to purge those things out of the body, but the spot is holding that sin in so tight that you would rather be a spot in the feast than let go. You might be the reason things are not moving in the body, because you are holding it in. Jude 1:19-23 1:16:25 - These be they who separate themselves, sensual, having not the Spirit. That fleshy, sensual spirit is the spirit that does not want to fix it, does not want to do right, does not want to be unified with everybody else. They want to separate and hope that this fails, because they do not want to succeed themselves. - And others save with fear, pulling them out of the fire; hating even the garment spotted by the flesh. God does not deal in that separating manner; it is more about building than separating. Any time you see anything about separation in the body, it is about getting the sensual spirit out so the body can continue to grow. You cannot keep that spirit and think you are going to grow inside the body; no, you go out of the body. Ezekiel 20:32-38 1:18:58 - That which cometh into your mind shall not be at all, that ye say, We will be as the heathen, to serve wood and stone. With a mighty hand, a stretched out arm, and fury poured out, the Most High will rule over us and gather us out of the countries where we are scattered. - And I will bring you into the wilderness of the people, and there will I plead with you face to face. A brother laid out the premise: this is our deliverance from Babylon, when Christ deals with us in the wilderness and teaches us the laws again; and what he is doing to us there is purging. - Like as I pleaded with your fathers in the wilderness of the land of Egypt, so will I plead with you. The class established what pleading means here: it is not begging. It is killing and smiting. - And I will cause you to pass under the rod, and I will bring you into the bond of the covenant: and I will purge out from among you the rebels, and them that transgress against me. Even after; even after the deliverance, there is still going to be a purge. There will still be bad actors among us that need to be purged, people that still need to get right, and Christ is the one who is going to give it to them. They shall not enter into the land of Israel: and ye shall know that I am the Lord. Precepts: - Isaiah 66:15-16 A brother brought the proof of what the pleading is: for behold, the Lord will come with fire, and with his chariots like a whirlwind, to render his anger with fury, and his rebuke with flames of fire. For by fire and by his sword will the Lord plead with all flesh. - Joel 3:2 I will also gather all nations, and will bring them down into the valley of Jehoshaphat, and will plead with them there for my people and for my heritage Israel. No begging for them either. - Matthew 3:12 Whose fan is in his hand, and he will throughly purge his floor, and gather his wheat into the garner; but he will burn up the chaff with unquenchable fire. Zechariah 13:8-9 1:26:40 - And it shall come to pass, that in all the land, saith the Lord, two parts therein shall be cut off and die; but the third shall be left therein. We are still talking about the purge. The Lord is not going to give the kingdom to the wicked; the kingdom will not be open to the wicked among our people. In order to get the kingdom, you have to go through this fire and get right; there is no other way. You cannot keep doing what you do and think you are going to get the kingdom. - That is why we have to fight for this and help each other. Where I see you weak and say nothing to you, that means I hate you. So when I tell you, hey bro, you know you have to fix that, I am trying to save your life. But we are so used to not being able to take correction from each other that it feels like hate, because you have never been corrected; everybody has coddled you, nobody says anything, and it is okay to keep kicking the can down the street until you are out on the street, back on the corner doing what you used to do. - And I will bring the third part through the fire, and will refine them as silver is refined, and will try them as gold is tried. Even the third that the Most High saves still has to be sifted, refined, made right, purged. - They shall call on my name, and I will hear them: I will say, It is my people: and they shall say, The Lord is my God. That is how we get saved: as the Most High refines us and burns the iniquity out of us, as we overcome these trials. There is no other way: the fire on one side, the deep water on the other, and the only way through is the straight line. There are no shortcuts for our people; you have to take the long route, because the Most High has to prove you to see if you are worthy of a kingdom. Precepts: - Ecclesiasticus 11:25 An officer connected it to losing patience in the trial: in the day of prosperity there is a forgetfulness of affliction, and in the day of affliction there is no more remembrance of prosperity. When things go well you forget what the low estate was like; take heed lest you fall. And when the heat gets turned up, you forget the last end, the increase the Lord is going to give you, and the things he has in store. If you would just purge your spirit, you would be able to receive all the things the Lord has promised; but you quit because you forgot what the goal was, you forgot the mission, so you want to abandon ship. Be patient in your lowest state and do not forget the prosperity to come; that strengthens your faith. - Matthew 24:10-13 And then shall many be offended: in this purging process a lot of people are going to turn their back to the Lord. And that is what people forget: you are not turning your back to us; we are nothing but humble servants working together in the vineyard. You are turning your back to the Master, saying, I do not want to do the work anymore. And shall betray one another: when you turn your back to your brother, it is called betrayal. And many false prophets shall rise: the ones that say, I can do the work outside the body, I can do my own thing. If you were going to do the work somewhere else, why would you not do the work here? Because you were never going to do the work; you had no intentions of doing the work. And because iniquity shall abound, the love of many shall wax cold. But he that shall endure unto the end, the same shall be saved: that is the only way you get salvation. You have to walk through hell to get to heaven; there is no shortcut to the kingdom, no roundabout. You walk straight through, and if you do not want to do it, do not do it. Revelation 22:14 1:37:35 - Blessed are they that do his commandments. As we keep these commandments we are proving our worthiness; we are passing the grade, going from one grade to the next, one trial to the next, one temperament to the next. We have to grow in this truth. You see brothers that have been in this truth ten, fifteen years; Bishop almost thirty. You see what it looks like to do the work. Do you think there is a shortcut, that you can be in here one, two, three years and that is it, then go do your own thing with Bishop's precept book and start something new? You have leadership that has labored twenty plus years to do this work, and here you come, a brand new fool, with other fools following you. - That they may have right to the tree of life: meaning you earned it. When he puts the crown on your head, you earned it; you fought to the end, you did everything that was asked of you, you went from grade to grade. Job well done: you have been proven like fine gold; you passed the grade. You are not junk metal. Some are junk metal; fool's gold, just looking shiny, with the appearance of godliness. 1 Peter 1:7 1:40:47 - That the trial of your faith, being much more precious than of gold that perisheth, though it be tried with fire. The whole class we have been talking about gold, and it says your tried faith is valued much more than gold; not just more, much more. People die looking for gold, and what you are going to be is worth more than gold. - Might be found unto praise and honour and glory at the appearing of Jesus Christ. That is what we are looking for when Christ comes: job well done, my faithful servant; you are worthy of a kingdom. That is what we are all putting this work in for, fighting day and night hoping for a kingdom. I know you are tired; we all get tired, and you are going to push past your limits, but do not give up. Because once you step out, who is to say you can step back in? Once you get off the offramp, who is to say you have enough gas to get back on? Do not play games with God; do not put yourself in a position to lose when you do not have to; do not roll the dice with God. - If you want to hear God laugh, tell him your plan. Your plan is not God's plan. What God has planned for you is keep his commandments and live; that is his only plan for you, and everything else happens because you do what he told you to do. Nothing he puts in your path is there to destroy you; everything adverse that happens to you is because you did it. Your family is out of order because you are out of order; your kids are out of order because you and your wife are out of order; backdoor marriage, you are always going to have a problem, and do not look at leadership about it, because you started out of order. Proverbs 7:2 1:47:16 - Keep my commandments, and live; and my law as the apple of thine eye. Is there anything after that about doing what you want to do? No. Keep God's commandments and live: that is the secret recipe. That is what they hid from us, put on the shelf right over our head. The pastor says, do what I say and it is going to be all right; it has not worked out for us. God's commandments are in this Bible, and we have to do what this Bible says. Luke 9:62 1:48:16 - And Jesus said unto him, No man, having put his hand to the plough, and looking back, is fit for the kingdom of God. You cannot do what you want to do; you have to do it the right way, straight. - An officer opened up the agriculture in it: plowing is the first step; you plow, then you sow, then you harvest, then you replenish. When people stop doing the work, they get disenchanted with the things they did first. The scripture says remember thy first love, and hold the beginning of your confidence stedfast unto the end. Do not get disenchanted with the things you did when you first came in; go back to that first love, because when you lose the plowing, you cannot do the other prerequisites to harvest. - A Rochester officer spoke on preparation: a lot of the Bible is agriculture related, because that was our culture back then; we had our own, and we are going to have our own again. If you do not know how to self sustain, learn it; there are skills out there. Get the body together, unify, be communal, so that those serious about the walk can be fed and sought for in that day. The Lord said he has never seen the righteous forsaken, nor his seed begging bread; when the grinding is low, as prophecy says, it is the local congregation's job to be self sufficient for the people. That is what love is. Revelation 3:18-19 1:51:55 - I counsel thee to buy of me gold tried in the fire, that thou mayest be rich; and white raiment, that thou mayest be clothed, and that the shame of thy nakedness do not appear; and anoint thine eyes with eyesalve, that thou mayest see. - As many as I love, I rebuke and chasten: be zealous therefore, and repent. That is what we all have to do: we all have to repent and get ourselves right, because at the end of the day it is to our benefit. In Closing The fire is not punishment for its own sake; it is the furnace of adversity turning us into something. The Most High tries the heart, custom fits the trial, and always leaves a way to escape: the phone call, the brotherhood, the correction taken in love. Endure the chastening, stay in the body, keep the commandments, and come out the other side proven like fine gold, worthy of the kingdom. Announcements & References - Class was held in Rochester, New York, with brothers in from across the region, including the congregation's Canadian visitors. - The class opened with recognition of the IT department: most of them never went through the schools Esau charges thousands for; they are self taught, each one teaching one, building each other up through the spirit of the Lord. - IUIC Rochester is building communal self sustainability: growing food and learning skills so the local body can feed and care for those serious about the walk when the grinding is low. If you need tips on how to grow something, reach out to them and grow something. --- Class Notes Index Transcript: full session

title: God, Purpose, and Sacrifice
text: Introduction The 12:00 pm Sabbath class. Today's topic is God, purpose, and sacrifice. We all must understand who our God is. In understanding who your God is, you are going to understand your purpose. And in understanding your purpose, you will have to make sacrifices. Before the topic, two things on the teacher's mind: the pope, and South Africa, this time focusing on Cape Town. In The News - Rumors that Iran has a nuclear bomb, and Trump is not talking tough anymore; he is trying to make a deal and pushing to open the straits. With the Strait of Hormuz closed there will be a big world recession if it stays closed. They say if by June it is not open, a lot of European countries are going to feel it. The key thing they use to make fertilizer comes from oil, from Saudi Arabia and those countries, so a lot of farmers were not able to plant this year. The whole world is going to feel it. What are we living in right now? The beginning of sorrows. The scripture says watch and pray: the Lord is behind all of it. The Lord says, I will raise up the Medes against you. The pride of your heart hath deceived thee: the white man is prideful and thinks nobody can test him, and now what they did is affecting the whole world and they cannot undo it. - Video played: Pope Leo is apologizing for the Holy See's role in legitimizing slavery, calling the Vatican's role in the 15th century slave trade "a wound in Christian memory," the first time a pope has apologized for past pontiffs giving explicit authority for people to enslave others. Some of you feel good inside when you see that. That apology is to keep you asleep. An apology is only an apology if there is justice and restitution. If you steal my house and my land and tell me you are sorry while you are still living in my house and my land, you are not sorry. If you really sorry, you give back what you stole. The scripture says if you steal from someone you make restitution, five times more. And it was not just theft: murders, rapes, and kidnapping took place. Justice still has to take place. - Article read in class on the doctrine of discovery: a 15th century legal and theological concept based on papal decrees that allowed European nations to claim non-Christian lands. Key decrees included Dum Diversas (1452), Romanus Pontifex (1455), and Inter Caetera (1493), which authorized Spain and Portugal to conquer non-Christian lands. Terra nullius, nobody's land: European powers claimed the right to acquire land not occupied by Christians even if it was populated by indigenous peoples, treating indigenous people as uncivilized, justifying colonization, the displacement of indigenous communities, the reserve system and the residential school system in North America, land theft and resource extraction. The doctrine has been cited in modern court cases, including City of Sherrill v. Oneida Indian Nation of New York (2005). In March 2023 the Vatican formally repudiated the doctrine, acknowledging the papal bulls were manipulated for political purposes. So it is much more than the transatlantic slave trade: all these lands they occupy, they took by a permit from the Roman Catholic Church, in the name of a white Jesus. Christianity as they set it up is white supremacy. If the pope really felt sorry, he would give back the land. - Video played: Pope Francis, the one that just died, apologizing to an indigenous delegation from Canada for the Catholic Church's role in the residential school system, which locked away more than 150,000 indigenous children; an estimated 4,000 to 6,000 died from abuse, disease, and malnutrition. That is one of the curses of Deuteronomy 28: thy sons and thy daughters shall be given unto another people. The North American Indians, our brothers of the tribe of Gad, had no power to take their kids out of those schools. And the delegate's response was, the next step is for the Holy Father to apologize at our home. What is the sense of an apology without restitution? - South Africa, Cape Town. Video played on Phil Craig, who left the UK in 2004, ten years after apartheid was dismantled, received permanent residency, and co-founded the Cape Independence Advocacy Group, whose singular mission is to separate the Western Cape from South Africa and align it with Western interests. He flew to Washington and claims he met members of the Trump administration to lobby for Cape secession, and wrote an open letter to Trump comparing Cape Town to Panama and Greenland. Private donors are pouring money into it. After 1994, the wealthy white people moved to the western part of South Africa, Cape Town. In his interview Craig said the US will support them "in a heartbeat," that they have allies behind the scenes, that private security personnel outnumber government personnel ten to one in the Western Cape, and that if the Western Cape people were "provoked into a response it would probably be helpful for Cape independence." So what they are going to look for is a provocation, something fabricated. The commentator added that they are recruiting from Ukraine, Israel, and Australia, getting firearm licenses that black South Africans do not get, and that the biggest private security companies in South Africa are American, British, and Israeli. - Video played: the US military was spotted training in Cape Town, in April or February of this year. The city's safety official JP Smith called it an informal training session where US Marines took Metro Police cadets through their standard routine; a GOOD party councillor, Jonathan Cupido, said the presence of a foreign military raised legal, governance, and accountability concerns and could not be dismissed as a simple workout. When is it regular for US Marines to train cadets in another country without notifying that country's leaders? Marines train for war. All that xenophobia and afrophobia you see in South Africa is being created to cause confusion so the Western Cape can secede. They are even putting up a wall separating poor black South Africans from white areas, saying the wall is to separate crime. Civil war is about to take place in South Africa, and most likely before Trump leaves office. Instead of seeing the big picture, you are fighting your own brothers and telling black people to leave your country. Scriptures Opened Job 20:18-22 37:32 - This goes into the restitution. That which he laboured for shall he restore: everything the white man is laboring for, all that gold and wealth they are storing up on the earth, the Most High says he is going to restore it. And shall not swallow it down: he is not going to enjoy it. According to his substance shall the restitution be: all the gold and pearls and rubies and diamonds. That is going to be our restitution. When Christ returns, all the wealth the white man has, he has to give it up. - Because he hath oppressed and hath forsaken the poor; because he hath violently taken away an house which he builded not. This is what the white man did: he violently took away people's houses that he never built. So the restitution for stealing people's houses and lands is that you give up everything you have. - Surely he shall not feel quietness in his belly: you are not going to be at peace. He shall not save of that which he desired: all that riches, you are not going to be able to save it for yourself. - Every hand of the wicked shall come upon him: that is what is going to happen to America. Saudi Arabia, Russia, Persia which is Iran, China. Haggai 2:5-9 41:10 - Yet once, it is a little while, and I will shake the heavens, and the earth, and the sea, and the dry land; and I will shake all nations. This is talking about the third woe: the Lord is going to destroy all nations. - The desire of all nations shall come: their desire is the gold, silver, pearls, the riches that they have. And I will fill this house with glory: this is the third temple. It is going to be beautiful because all the gold and silver these nations have been stealing and storing is coming back to us. - The silver is mine, and the gold is mine, saith the Lord of hosts: all the silver and gold on this earth belongs to the Most High. - The glory of this latter house shall be greater than of the former: greater than the temple Solomon built, because the nations are going to bring their wealth. When it says restitution, it means gold and silver and precious things, real wealth, not the US paper dollar. Isaiah 61:6 43:54 - Ye shall be named the Priests of the Lord: men shall call you the Ministers of our God. Ye shall eat the riches of the Gentiles: all their riches are going to belong to us. - And in their glory shall ye boast yourselves. There is another scripture that says the way the nations will show they are subjected unto us is that they are going to bring their gold. Jeremiah 50:7 50:03 - The new thing white people say when you talk about slavery and the institutions of oppression is that you have a victim mentality, a victim culture: pick yourself up by your bootstraps. But when the Jewish man talks about the Holocaust, do they tell him that is a victim mentality? It is like a rapist telling the woman he raped, get over it, you are acting like a victim. She was a victim, and she wants justice. Here is the oppressor telling the oppressed to stop acting oppressed. - When we try, they destroy it. We came together in Tulsa and built Black Wall Street, and they destroyed it. They set up Jim Crow, they lynched us, they set up institutions to keep us from progressing, they brought drugs into our community and then set up the war on drugs, and when we speak about it, they say stop acting like a victim. - All that found them have devoured them: and their adversaries said, We offend not. All the nations that found us devoured us, and then they turn around and say, we did nothing wrong, because they have sinned against the Lord: you Israelites keep breaking God's laws, so God made this happen to you. - Let me tell you straight: I do not want anything from white people. But I will let them know about all the evil they have done, and that judgment is coming to them from the God of the twelve tribes of Israel for what they have done. Zechariah 11:4-5 51:03 - Feed the flock of the slaughter: the flock of the slaughter is us, the twelve tribes of Israel. We are being slaughtered and oppressed. - Whose possessors slay them, and hold themselves not guilty: our possessors are the nations ruling over us. They slay us and say, we are not guilty; forget about it, it was just 50 years ago, stop being a victim. But we charge you in the name of the Lord: you are guilty of kidnapping, murder, and theft, and you are going to be judged for every one of them, and for all the land you stole on this earth. - And they that sell them say, Blessed be the Lord; for I am rich. That is what the white man says, because he did it in the name of white Jesus. The Roman Catholic Church set up those edicts to enslave and colonize Africa and the new world in the name of the Lord. - And their own shepherds pity them not: our own shepherds had no mercy and never helped us. Revelation 13:7-10 56:07 - And it was given unto him to make war with the saints. A lot of you think the Roman Catholic Church just enslaved people and brought slaves from Africa. No: it was war, to destroy the twelve tribes that were living all over Africa and here in the new world. The first slaves came from Spain, our people that were ruling over there, the Moors. When they finished with us there, they went to the new world, then to Africa. They took our nationality and our identity. Slavery was war. - You hear a lot that black people sold black people into slavery. The Roman Catholic Church made edicts and laws legalizing slavery before they ever went to Africa. Slavery was a system set up by Christianity, by white Europeans, to conquer Africa; then they had black people fighting among each other, the same way they put us to fight each other today like you see in South Africa. And chattel slavery, where your children and grandchildren are all slaves, is different from any form of slavery that was set up on this earth, like working off a debt. - And power was given him over all kindreds, and tongues, and nations, and all that dwell upon the earth shall worship him: everybody started worshiping the white man as Christ and Savior, whose names are not written in the book of life. - He that leadeth into captivity shall go into captivity: he that killeth with the sword must be killed with the sword. That is the judgment for the verse above. Here is the patience and the faith of the saints: this is what the saints are patiently waiting for. If you are a saint, you want justice for what was done to your forefathers. Isaiah 1:2-3 1:27:52 - Now the topic: God, purpose, and sacrifice. The children that God nourished and brought up are the twelve tribes of Israel, you so-called blacks and Hispanics, and they have rebelled against him. - The ox knoweth his owner, and the ass his master's crib: but Israel doth not know, my people doth not consider. We do not know who our master is. Our master is our God, and we do not know who our God is, and we do not know where our land is. - You cannot separate God and nation; they go hand in hand. If you forget your God, you are going to forget your nation. That is what happened to us as a people. The Arabs have Islam, the Chinese have Buddha and their land, the white man has his white image of Christ. But we forgot who we are, who our God is, and where our home is. Jeremiah 2:11 1:31:54 - Hath a nation changed their gods, which are yet no gods? Have the Chinese changed their god? The Japanese? The Arabs? No. But we as a people have changed our God. - But my people have changed their glory for that which doth not profit. What does not profit us? Christianity and Islam. Christianity as the colonizer set it up was built on white supremacy; it is the colonizer religion. We are the children of Israel, the people Christ came and died for. Christ was a black man, and the apostles were black men. - The reason we are in this condition today is because we forgot our God. Right through the Bible he says, I am the God of Abraham, Isaac, and Jacob; the God of Israel. Understanding who Israel is and where Israel's land is, you must understand who your God is. Psalms 137:3-8 1:35:36 - They that carried us away captive required of us a song; and they that wasted us required of us mirth. How shall we sing the Lord's song in a strange land? - If I forget thee, O Jerusalem, let my right hand forget her cunning. This is David speaking, and David will come back in the future. What is the Israelite man's job on this earth? To serve God and keep his laws: unto me the children of Israel are servants. If you forget your nation, you are going to forget what your right hand is supposed to be doing, which is serving God. That is what happened to us in slavery: because we forgot Jerusalem, we forgot our God. - If I do not remember thee, let my tongue cleave to the roof of my mouth: you are not going to be able to teach the Bible if you do not know that you are an Israelite. The first thing you must learn to understand this book is who you are. You have to read this Bible with the understanding that it is talking about you. - If I prefer not Jerusalem above my chief joy: Jerusalem is supposed to be your chief joy. - Remember, O Lord, the children of Edom in the day of Jerusalem; who said, Rase it, rase it, even to the foundation thereof. David was not there, but David was a prophet and saw in a vision Edom helping the Babylonians and 70 AD when the Romans came. - O daughter of Babylon, who art to be destroyed: Edom did the same thing ancient Babylon did, so that is their judgment. Jeremiah 17:4 1:41:58 - And thou, even thyself, shalt discontinue from thine heritage that I gave thee. When you read the Bible, did Jeremiah ever forget who he was? No. Jeremiah stood stiffly for the Lord, and when Nebuchadnezzar destroyed Jerusalem, Jeremiah was let go free and taught the people left in the land. So this is talking about when Jeremiah comes back in the future: he will forget his heritage, his God and his land. - And I will cause thee to serve thine enemies in the land which thou knowest not. The Babylonians did not take Jeremiah into Babylon as a slave, and Jeremiah knew nothing about the United States of America. Jeremiah is here in the last days, serving his enemies in the land of his captivity. But he will remember who he is: he will remember that he is an Israelite, his God, and his land. Hosea 3:4 1:46:05 - For the children of Israel shall abide many days: those many days are the roughly 350 years. Without a king and without a prince: we had no sovereignty; we were colonized and enslaved. - Without a sacrifice: no religious establishment teaching us true religion or teaching us about our God. In slavery the white man taught us his lies and his god. - And without an image: image goes into nationality, and into what your God looks like, because your God was created in your image. For many years we were without an image, without a sacrifice, without a culture. With culture you have your God and your nation, your feast days, how you worship: that is your heritage, and for many years we were without it. Deuteronomy 33:29 1:48:34 - Happy art thou, O Israel: who is like unto thee, O people saved by the Lord? Who is going to be saved and happy? Israel. Everybody is not going to be happy; this is salvation we are reading about. - And thine enemies shall be found liars unto thee. The prophecy is that our enemies are going to be found out lying to us. When is that? Today. All of us inside this truth understand: the white man lied to me. He lied about your culture, your God, and your nationality. He calls himself a Jew and a Christian, which he is not. - And thou shalt tread upon their high places: that is future prophecy. 2 Corinthians 11:4 1:50:52 - For if he that cometh preacheth another Jesus, whom we have not preached: the white man came and taught another Jesus, a Jesus with green eyes and pale skin. The apostles never taught that image of Christ. - The land of Israel was called the land of Canaan, and Canaan is the son of Ham: Hamitic tribes, black people, lived there. The Canaanites and the Philistines we fought were black people. So do not fall for the line that Christ was some beige Middle Easterner; everybody in that region was black. - Or another spirit, which ye have not received, or another gospel: the gospel our people follow today is another gospel. Revelation calls it the image of the beast and the false prophet. With the other Jesus comes the other gospel, and that other gospel is white supremacy: worship the white man. Matthew 24:3-6 1:54:43 - The disciples asked Christ privately, what shall be the sign of thy coming, and of the end of the world? What do we look for before the end? - For many shall come in my name, saying, I am Christ. Christ means anointed. Who came saying they are the anointed ones? It began in the 1400s during the Renaissance. And shall deceive many: billions of people on the earth today have been deceived, worshiping a white man as Christ. - And ye shall hear of wars and rumours of wars: see that ye be not troubled. 1 Kings 8:46-48 1:56:11 - If they sin against thee, and thou be angry with them, and deliver them to the enemy, so that they carry them away captives unto the land of the enemy, far or near. Were we carried captive into the land of our enemies? Yes, as slaves, all the way to the Americas, because God was angry at us. - Yet if they shall bethink themselves in the land whither they were carried captives. To bethink yourself is to remember: remember your nation, remember who you are, and in remembering who you are, you are going to remember your God. - And repent, and make supplication unto thee, saying, We have sinned, and have done perversely, we have committed wickedness. We must change our lives. As we wake up learning we are the children of Israel, we have to get rid of the fornication, the hatred, the jealousy, the bad mind. - And so return unto thee with all their heart, and with all their soul, and pray unto thee toward their land. Where is your land? It is not Africa, and it is not Jamaica or Trinidad or Nigeria or the lands where we were scattered, and it is not the land of your captivity. Once you know who your God is, you are going to know where your land is, because your nation and your God go hand in hand. - The state of mind we all must have is a nationalist. Do not let anybody tell you being a nationalist is wrong: you must love your nation. A nationalist wants his nation, his land. Zechariah 1:3-4 2:03:15 - Turn ye unto me, saith the Lord of hosts, and I will turn unto you: when we turn unto God, God will turn unto us. - Be ye not as your fathers, unto whom the former prophets have cried, saying, Turn ye now from your evil ways; but they did not hear. We cannot be like our forefathers who did not listen to the prophets. Brothers hearing these teachings, listen and turn to God with all your heart. Deuteronomy 10:12-13 2:04:32 - And now, Israel, what doth the Lord thy God require of thee? To fear him, to walk in all his ways, to love him, and to serve him with all thy heart and with all thy soul. - To keep the commandments of the Lord, and his statutes, which I command thee this day for thy good. We serve God and show him we love him by keeping the commandments. Do not listen to these Christians saying the law is done away with, that you can eat pork and shrimp and live however you want. Matthew 22:36-38 2:06:29 - Master, which is the great commandment in the law? Thou shalt love the Lord thy God with all thy heart, and with all thy soul, and with all thy mind. Thy God: that is why God and nation go hand in hand. - This was not a new commandment; it was said in Deuteronomy. The thing is, we never kept it. So how do you love God? Is it a tingly feeling inside, jumping around like these churches? Loving God is an action. John 14:15 2:08:40 - If ye love me, keep my commandments. Everybody on this planet says they love God. Christ says, if you love me, keep my commandments. That is how you show God you love him. 1 John 5:3 2:09:05 - For this is the love of God, that we keep his commandments. We have to keep them with all our heart, willingly, loving doing it, training ourselves to hate evil and love good. You follow the dietary laws, you keep the feast days, you deal right with your brothers and sisters. - And dealing right starts in your house. You married couples: if you hate each other, you hate God. Brothers, deal right with your wife; she is the weaker vessel; do not be abusive. Sisters, one point in time you loved him, and all of a sudden the love turned into hate and you want a divorce. When the Bible says love thy neighbour as thyself, that starts at home first. God wants us to love each other and deal right with each other; that divorce stuff has to stop. 1 John 2:4-6 2:11:54 - He that saith, I know him, and keepeth not his commandments, is a liar, and the truth is not in him. That is for the Christians saying you do not have to keep God's laws, that the Sabbath changed to Sunday. God says remember the Sabbath day, to keep it holy. - But whoso keepeth his word, in him verily is the love of God perfected. - He that saith he abideth in him ought himself also so to walk, even as he walked. Did Christ keep the Sabbath? Did Christ wear fringes? Did Christ keep the Passover? If you say you love the Lord, you are going to do the same things he did when he walked on this earth. Deuteronomy 30:1-3 2:13:47 - When all these things are come upon thee, the blessing and the curse. The blessings came upon us in the land of Israel under David and Solomon, years of peace. And we are living in the curses right now, in the land of our captivity, oppressed, our resources stolen. - And thou shalt call them to mind among all the nations, whither the Lord thy God hath driven thee. Everything mentioned in Deuteronomy 28 came to pass, including going into slavery on cargo slave ships. Our people are all over the world, in China, India, Africa, and the Caribbean islands, and some of you are calling these curses to mind right now. - And shalt return unto the Lord thy God, and shalt obey his voice, thou and thy children, with all thine heart, and with all thy soul. God did not say you alone repent: you and your children have to turn to him. A nation starts with family. That is why we always tell you brothers we want to see your family. - Then the Lord thy God will turn thy captivity, and have compassion upon thee, and will return and gather thee from all the nations. You cannot read that as a Christian and understand it. You must read it as an Israelite, understanding you were scattered through the four corners of the earth in slavery, and God is going to gather you if you turn back to him with all your heart, soul, and mind. Matthew 20:1-4 2:18:16 - After you know your God and you know what nation you come from, God will give you purpose. The kingdom of heaven is like a householder who went out early in the morning to hire labourers into his vineyard: the vineyard is the nation of Israel, and he went looking for workers. - He went out about the third hour, and saw others standing idle in the marketplace: he saw people who had no purpose. That is us. You were going to the club, partying, caught up in Christianity. We were all idle; none of us had purpose. - And said unto them, Go ye also into the vineyard; and whatsoever is right I will give you. The Lord called us, and he has a job, a purpose, for every last one of us. We were without purpose, but God called us and hired us. John 6:44 2:20:02 - No man can come to me, except the Father which hath sent me draw him. If you are in these doors, in any IUIC school, or online right now and you can understand what we are teaching, the only way is because the Father is drawing you to Christ. Even if you were skipping through videos or somebody on your job said something to you, that is the Father lining you up to draw you in. 1 Corinthians 1:26-29 2:21:22 - For ye see your calling, brethren. Your calling is your purpose, the job you have to do in this truth. Every last one of us has a mission from the Lord. Ask yourself: do you see your calling? Why did God call you? After a while, every one of us should see it; if you do not see it yet, you have not fully understood yourself yet. - How that not many wise men after the flesh, not many mighty, not many noble, are called. Not many, but we do have some: Paul was a Pharisee, one of the elite in society, and well educated brothers are going to come among us. - But God hath chosen the foolish things of the world to confound the wise, and the weak things to confound the things which are mighty; and base things, and things which are despised: that is us. We are despised and hated, and God is going to use us to confound these Christians and to bring to nought the things that are, to destroy governments and societies on this earth with our teachings. - That no flesh should glory in his presence. Nobody can say, I understand the Bible because I am so smart, I went to theology school. If you did not go to theology school and you are confounding people who did, understand it is not you; it is the power of God. That is why God chooses the weak things: so he can show his power, and so nobody glories in themselves. Ephesians 4:7-9 2:26:55 - Unto every one of us is given grace according to the measure of the gift of Christ. Every last one of us, Christ gave gifts, and your gift goes hand in hand with your calling, with your purpose. What gifts God gave you is according to what he wants you to do on this earth. - When he ascended up on high, he led captivity captive, and gave gifts unto men. My wife never learned to sew; I asked her to make me a garment when I was in my twenties, just coming into this truth, and she started sewing and making garments self-taught. That was a gift from God. Captain Zev was never into IT, and all of a sudden he started dealing with all the IT work. God gives us gifts to build his nation. Some of you went to school to be a doctor: you thought that was for you to become rich in this world. No, it is for you to help your people. Even you sisters cooking and serving, that is a gift of hospitality; and some who help financially, that is a gift. Romans 12:3-10 2:31:32 - Not to think of himself more highly than he ought to think. As you grow in this truth and God gives you gifts, stay humble, because those gifts can puff you up. The Lord deals with the base things so no man can glory in his presence. - God hath dealt to every man the measure of faith: a different measure, a different amount of gifts. We are not to envy or be jealous of each other over it. - As we have many members in one body, and all members have not the same office. Some things you can do that I cannot do, and some things this brother can do that another brother cannot. God gave us different gifts, and it is about learning to work together and seeing the best in each other. We are building a nation and setting up a government; in that nation there is an army, but there is a lot more that needs to be set up than the army. - Having then gifts differing according to the grace that is given to us: whether prophecy, let us prophesy according to the proportion of faith. You might see the bishop or the deacons go into some things and think you can go into that. No: prophesy according to the measure God gave you. If you are not there yet, do not try to go there; take your time. - Or ministry, let us wait on our ministry; or he that teacheth, on teaching. Some of us are teachers; some might be a prophet; some of us God gives multiple gifts. - He that giveth, let him do it with simplicity; he that ruleth, with diligence; he that sheweth mercy, with cheerfulness. Be cheerful in showing mercy. - Let love be without dissimulation: we should not be trying to break each other down, especially because a brother has a gift you do not have. Abhor that which is evil; cleave to that which is good. Be kindly affectioned one to another with brotherly love. Ephesians 4:10-12 2:39:09 - And he gave some, apostles; and some, prophets; and some, evangelists; and some, pastors and teachers. Some of you brothers in IUIC are a prophet. Some are evangelists, and there are different forms of evangelism: you can travel to different states, different countries, different boroughs, going forth and teaching the word. - For the perfecting of the saints, for the work of the ministry, for the edifying of the body of Christ. Why did God give these gifts? Not for me to glorify myself. My job as a teacher is to help you become perfect through the scriptures. I am not doing this class for no reason: it is to help you navigate to find your purpose, to see your calling, to know you are not just here for no reason. And as you grow in the spirit, you are going to do the same thing for the men that come after you. Romans 8:28 2:43:09 - And we know that all things work together for good to them that love God, to them who are the called according to his purpose. God has a purpose for every last one of us. Whether you are brothers on the IT, on the audio, editing videos, making the thumbnail, on security: everyone has a purpose. - You do not have to have rank to have a purpose. You do not have to be a soldier to do the work of God. We have programs set up: the medical team, the stewardship program. Rank is for order and structure; it is not for you to be lord over anybody. But you still have to do the work. Matthew 22:14 2:45:12 - For many are called, but few are chosen. What is going to tell whether you are chosen is your actions. If you stay in the midst of adultery and all types of wickedness, carrying grudges and hatred toward your brothers and sisters, being deceitful, God is not going to choose you. He called you, but you will not be chosen. 1 Corinthians 11:19 2:46:53 - For there must be also heresies among you, that they which are approved may be made manifest among you. How do you tell who is approved by God? Heresies have to take place. Colossians 4:16-17 2:47:20 - Say to Archippus, Take heed to the ministry which thou hast received in the Lord, that thou fulfil it. Take heed to your ministry: your ministry is your calling, your purpose. We all have one, and we all have to make sure we fulfil it. Eventually every last one of us is going to see our calling and see why God called us. 2 Peter 1:10 2:48:24 - Wherefore the rather, brethren, give diligence to make your calling and election sure. Only you can make your calling and election sure. How? Keeping the commandments, dealing right with each other, and understanding your purpose. Sit down and ask yourself: what can I do to help build this nation? What gifts do I have? - There is a lot that has to be done, and we have to take it to another level and separate ourselves from this system. Why are we buying chickens from the store? Why every Passover are we buying lambs from these farmers? Why do we not have our own land, and we are talking about being a nation within a nation? Are we really a nation if we depend on everybody for everything? God is going to give some of you the gift to go into farming. Matthew 19:27 2:50:42 - As you find your purpose, Satan is going to come after you, and a lot of us will have to make sacrifices. You are not going to serve God without making sacrifices. - Then answered Peter and said unto him, Behold, we have forsaken all, and followed thee. Peter forsook everything to follow Christ. My question to you: do you have that state of mind, that you are willing to forsake everything to follow after Christ? Kanye was not willing to do that. Nick Cannon was not willing to do that; they would lose billions of dollars. Are you willing to lose everything to follow after Christ? That is what this truth is about. Luke 14:26-33 2:51:40 - If any man come to me, and hate not his father, and mother, and wife, and children, and brethren, and sisters, yea, and his own life also, he cannot be my disciple. And whosoever doth not bear his cross, and come after me, cannot be my disciple: you cannot be Christ's disciple if you are not willing to carry your cross, your burdens, and follow after him. - Which of you, intending to build a tower, sitteth not down first, and counteth the cost, whether he have sufficient to finish it? You had better sit down and count the cost. People will mock you if you start in this truth and give up: brothers and sisters, you talk all that good talk to your family, and then you go back; they are going to laugh at you. This man began to build, and was not able to finish. - So likewise, whosoever he be of you that forsaketh not all that he hath, he cannot be my disciple. This is the point of hating mother and father: if you are not willing to forsake all you have, to make sacrifices, including your own life, you cannot be Christ's disciple. You have to be willing to die for what you believe in. In Closing God, purpose, and sacrifice. Know your God: your God and your nation go hand in hand. After you know your God, you must find your purpose and see your calling. And as you walk in that purpose, count the cost, because this truth requires sacrifice. Lord's will, the next class will go deeper into sacrifice. Deacon Malachi and the deacons are coming up next. Shalom. Most High Christ bless. --- Class Notes Index Transcript: full session

title: JOSEPH IN EGYPT: THEN & NOW
text: Introduction Today's class is entitled Joseph in Egypt: Then and Now. Reading the four chapters today, I'm back in Genesis again, looking at the history on Joseph. It's long, so we're going to chop it up and read certain verses out of the chapters. Before we get into the scriptures, we go to the proofs of the color of the Jews, the Israelites, first. Books opened on the board before the scriptures: - Nature Knows No Color Line, by J. A. Rogers. It could be that the Jews before they left Egypt imbibed some color prejudice, but it could not have been strong among them because they were dark or even black. One rabbi says the passage "black but comely" from the Song of Solomon means, I was black in Egypt but comely in Egypt. There is no doubt that after four centuries in Egypt the Jews had mixed much with Egyptians and Ethiopians, whom their legends describe as black and woolly haired. The main difference between Hebrew and Egyptian was not racial but religious. We have no proof that the original 70 Jews who went into Egypt were white; according to their legends they originated in Chaldea, and there is considerable evidence the inhabitants of that region in earliest times were Negroid. Some writers said the Jews were an African people; Strabo said many of his time believed they were. So when you have the Holy Bible as your primary source, then you have books like these as your secondary source, you should never be deceived and go back into Christianity. - Wait says an interesting gradation of all shades down to the black is exhibited by the Jews; especially dark were the Jews of Spain and Portugal. The Duchess d'Abrantes said the Jew, the Negro, and the Portuguese could be seen in a single person. So dark were the Jews of Portugal and southern Spain that many whites thought all Jews were black. And the first slave ships over here came from Spain and Portugal, and the slaves all had Spanish names. - Negroes were imported into Christian Spain and Portugal in droves from 1440 until the abolition of slavery in Portugal in 1773. Before the discovery of America, thousands of Negro slaves from Senegal, Guinea, and the Congo were working in Lisbon, in Algarve, in Seville, and in all Andalusia. The Catholic sovereigns were dealers in Negro slaves; remember, the Catholic Church under Pope Nicholas V was the first to orchestrate the transatlantic slave trade. The Negro came first to the Indies from Spain, not from Africa. - Sex and Race, volume one, by J. A. Rogers: the earliest Jews were in all probability Negroes. Abraham came from Ur of the Chaldees; Chaldea was the seat of Sumerian civilization, long considered to be white Aryan, but it was proved to be a Negroid people. Only 70 Jews went to Egypt, but according to the Bible 600,000 men left it. Since the Jews were slaves, after more than three centuries almost every trace of the first generation must have been lost together with their culture; Jewish culture was Egyptian culture. Think of what has happened to Negroes in the United States: they are so Americanized that were it not for their color, one would forget they ever came from Africa. That's how Americanized, or Europeanized, our people have become. Moses himself was black. - Lost Civilizations: Ramses II, Magnificence on the Nile: inside the tombs you see the slaves in Egypt working for the Egyptians, and they are black. The 18th Dynasty of the New Kingdom is the dynasty of the new king that knew not Joseph; Seti I of the 19th Dynasty adopted Moses, and Ramses II was the pharaoh Moses took the Israelites out from under. Before the New Kingdom, the Hyksos from Palestine, who were shepherd kings, took over the Delta region and founded the 15th Dynasty, until the Thebans declared war and liberated the Delta. Joseph was very familiar with the history regarding the Hyksos; that history comes back later in the lesson. - Pictorial History of Israel, by Jacob A. Rubin: the first page in the book is a mural depicting Israel's bondage in Egypt, found in the Theban tomb of Rekhmire, governor and vizier at the time of Thutmose III, about 1450 BC, with the scripture from Exodus 1:13-14. The Kemetic community says there's no historical data that the Israelites ever existed; they are on the tombs of Egypt, and they are black. The yokes with hooks at the ends on those captives are just like what America used; America did the same things from ancient Egypt. - The Israelites (Time-Life Books): an 1800 BC wall painting from the palace at Mari on the Euphrates shows a Semitic tribesman, and we come from Shem. The frescoes discovered in the synagogue of Dura-Europos on the Euphrates in Syria, preserved under a sand pack from 256 AD, show Moses parting the Red Sea, black with an afro, Aaron beside him black, the twelve tribesmen black, the hand of God over Israel. When they started bombing over there, they made sure to destroy the relics that were discovered. You cannot look at that fresco and say the people running Israel today are these Israelites. - Our Living Bible: the priests on the fresco from Dura-Europos, third century AD, are all black. And one of the earliest depictions found of Christ, from the oldest known Christian church at Dura-Europos, shows Christ healing the paralyzed man who takes up his bed and walks; everybody in the painting is black. They pay archaeologists hundreds of thousands of dollars to do these digs, they uncover the black Egyptians of the past, and then Hollywood gets access to all of it and makes Moses white and the Pharaohs white. You ever notice Christians can never dispute the archaeology? They'll argue with the Bible all day, but when we show the archaeology that coincides with the biblical text, they become blind all of a sudden. Scriptures Opened Psalms 64:6 35:12 - They search out iniquities; they accomplish a diligent search. This is what's called a diligent search: the archaeological digs. Both the inward thought of every one of them, and the heart, is deep. - And when they find these things, America incorporates the holidays and customs these people have discovered. America said, we'll take Christmas, we'll take Easter, Ishtar. That's what they did. Genesis 37:1-2 52:39 - I wanted verse two to give you Joseph's age. His age at this time is 17 years old. Everybody got that. Genesis 37:25-35 54:05 - Judah said, what profit is it if we slay our brother and conceal his blood? Come, and let us sell him to the Ishmaelites. Then there passed by Midianites merchantmen, and they drew and lifted up Joseph out of the pit, and sold Joseph to the Ishmaelites for 20 pieces of silver. - There's always questions about the Midianites and the Ishmaelites. They were working together; they were roaming the land together, all Abraham's kids. So when it says Midian here and then Ishmael and then Midian again, these groups were together, and they looked very similar. - Reuben returned unto the pit, and Joseph was not in the pit, and he rent his clothes. Reuben suggested the pit because his plan was to go back and save Joseph. Remember the characteristic of Reuben; it's going to play a part later on. - Now they couldn't explain Joseph not being there, so they concocted the story that a wild animal killed Joseph, and dipped the coat of many colors in the blood of a kid of the goats. The brothers were so envious of Joseph. Envy will have you do some evil stuff. Precepts: - Genesis 25:1-4 Keturah has six sons from Abraham, and Midian is one of them. - Genesis 25:12-16 Abraham had Ishmael from Hagar the Egyptian, and Ishmael had twelve princes according to their nations. Abraham's children from Keturah and Abraham's children from Hagar always lived together and worked together. Genesis 39:1-6 59:14 - Potiphar, an officer of Pharaoh, captain of the guard, an Egyptian, bought him of the hands of the Ishmaelites. And the Lord was with Joseph, and he was a prosperous man; his master saw that the Lord was with him, and made him overseer over his house. - The Lord blessed the Egyptian's house for Joseph's sake. You notice the theme is the same: just like when Jacob worked for Laban all those years, Laban was blessed for Jacob's sake. Precepts: - Luke 16:10 He that is faithful in that which is least is faithful also in much. This explains why Joseph was faithful. He's in slavery now, but he was faithful to Potiphar, and Potiphar raised him up. A lot of brothers and sisters have jobs; the Most High is observing us in whatever we're doing. The least that we're faithful in is these little jobs out here. Just like Joseph was in captivity, we're in captivity, but that doesn't mean we can steal, lie, or rob. When you're on your jobs, deal right. God is watching each and every one of us. Genesis 39:7-12 1:02:58 - His master's wife cast her eyes upon Joseph, and she said, lie with me. But he refused: there is none greater in this house than I, neither hath he kept back anything from me but thee, because thou art his wife. How then can I do this great wickedness, and sin against God? Notice Joseph wasn't blaming God that he was in slavery. - She spake to Joseph day by day; she was trying to wear him down day by day. And remember, the Egyptians loved beautiful women; when Abraham went down, Sarah was in danger because of her beauty. Potiphar's wife was not bad looking, and Joseph still said no. - She caught him by his garment, saying, lie with me; and he left his garment in her hand, and fled. Put yourself in Joseph's place at 17 years old. He saw sin like a snake and he ran like a rabbit. - Everybody's demon is not the same. For some it's food, but generally it's sexual demons that get the brothers. Take a page out of what our forefather Joseph did. Precepts: - Ecclesiasticus 21:2-3 Flee from sin as from the face of a serpent: that's what Joseph did. If thou comest too near it, it will bite thee. The teeth thereof are as the teeth of a lion, slaying the souls of men. If a snake fell in this room right now, everybody would be out of here. That snake is your sin. Genesis 39:13-20 1:07:07 - She called unto the men of her house and said, he came in unto me to lie with me, and I cried with a loud voice. She couldn't get her way, so she lied. And she laid up his garment by her until his lord came home; she kept his clothes as false evidence. - A lot of brothers have been locked up the same way: a woman starts a fight and expects the man to defend her, or lies on him when he refuses her. Don't deal with a woman like that. - Deacon: as you're reading this, this is the same spirit our people met in slavery. A lot of us were put to death because of this spirit. Emmett Till was put to death for the lying woman, and there's a lot of cases like that. - His master's wrath was kindled, and Joseph's master took him and put him into the prison, the place where the king's prisoners were bound. Remember how old Joseph is: 17. Precepts: - Ecclesiasticus 28:14 A backbiting tongue hath disquieted many; strong cities hath it pulled down, and overthrown the houses of great men. Somebody that lies on you can do much destruction. - Ecclesiasticus 28:18 Many have fallen by the edge of the sword: but not so many as have fallen by the tongue. The tongue does a lot of evil, and that's what Potiphar's wife did to Joseph. - Ecclesiasticus 2:1-4 My son, if thou come to serve the Lord, prepare thy soul for temptation. Joseph understood this, because his father taught him. Make not haste in time of trouble: don't leave this truth in your time of trouble, because Satan will tell you that you had it better when you served him. Whatsoever is brought upon thee take cheerfully, and be patient when thou art changed to a low estate. Joseph's family was rich; Jacob was wealthy. Joseph was taken from all that, and now he's in the midst of poverty, in prison. Just as it goes for us, it went for our father Joseph. Genesis 39:21-23 1:12:56 - But the Lord was with Joseph, and shewed him mercy, and gave him favour in the sight of the keeper of the prison. The keeper committed to Joseph's hand all the prisoners; whatever Joseph did, the Lord made it to prosper. Precepts: - Proverbs 16:7 When a man's ways please the Lord, he maketh even his enemies to be at peace with him. That's what happened with Joseph. Genesis 40:1-23 1:14:26 - The butler and the baker of the king of Egypt offended their lord and were put in ward where Joseph was bound. They dreamed a dream, both of them, and Joseph said, do not interpretations belong to God? Tell me them, I pray you. - Joseph said, think on me when it shall be well with thee, and make mention of me unto Pharaoh, and bring me out of this house: for indeed I was stolen away out of the land of the Hebrews, and here also have I done nothing that they should put me into the dungeon. Notice this calls the prison a dungeon, like Lamentations says of Israel in captivity. - The interpretation came to pass on the third day, which was Pharaoh's birthday: the chief butler was restored, and the chief baker was hanged, as Joseph had interpreted. Wherever you read of Pharaoh's birthday or Herod's birthday, something bad always happens. We never celebrated birthdays; it's a day of proclaiming yourself to be God. - Yet did not the chief butler remember Joseph, but forgat him. Precepts: - Ecclesiasticus 34:1-3 Dreams lift up fools; whoso regardeth dreams is like him that catcheth at a shadow. Don't chase dreams. But verse 3 gives you a clue to understanding dreams from God: the vision of dreams is the resemblance of one thing to another, even as the likeness of a face to a face. You could dream about somebody you know, but it's not them; it's someone similar, in age or in what they do. You just have to know the people in your circle. - Lamentations 3:53 They have cut off my life in the dungeon, and cast a stone upon me: meaning he would never get out. It's talking about Israel in captivity, which goes with political prisoners who have been in there a long time. - Job 3:3 Let the day perish wherein I was born. This is how the Hebrews felt regarding birthdays. - Jeremiah 20:14 Cursed be the day wherein I was born. Jeremiah is saying the same thing Job said. We never celebrated birthdays; that custom came from the nations, from what they dug up in their archaeological digs. It is not of God. Genesis 41:1-57 1:21:58 - At the end of two full years Pharaoh dreamed: seven well favoured fat kine eaten up by seven ill favoured lean kine, and seven good ears devoured by seven thin ears blasted with the east wind. None of the magicians could interpret. Then the chief butler remembered his faults and told Pharaoh of the young Hebrew in the prison. - Verse 1 says at the end of two full years; it's not telling you how long Joseph was in prison altogether. Joseph answered Pharaoh, it is not in me: God shall give Pharaoh an answer of peace. - The dream is one: seven years of great plenty, and after them seven years of famine; and for that the dream was doubled unto Pharaoh twice, it is because the thing is established by God. That famine shall surely happen. - Joseph didn't sleep; he told them exactly what to do: appoint officers, take up the fifth part in the plenteous years, and lay up corn against the famine. To every problem, brothers, we must have a solution. You got some spirits among us: for every solution, they got a problem. Stay away from brothers and sisters like that. - Pharaoh said, can we find such a one as this, a man in whom the Spirit of God is? He took off his ring and put it upon Joseph's hand, arrayed him in vestures of fine linen, made him to ride in the second chariot, and they cried before him, bow the knee. We're going to tell the nations that too: bow the knee. - He gave him to wife Asenath, the daughter of Potipherah priest of On. Could he marry an Israelite? There were no other Israelites there. - Joseph was 30 years old when he stood before Pharaoh. He went in at 17; he was 13 years in prison and servitude, and came out at 30. - Manasseh means made to forget: God hath made me forget all my toil. Ephraim means fruitful: God hath caused me to be fruitful in the land of my affliction. - The famine was over all the face of the earth, and all countries came into Egypt to Joseph for to buy corn. That's what it's like when you have a plan, a solution. Joseph didn't sit around and wait for the dearth; the Most High showed him what was coming, and he made moves of preparation. This is how we have to be in IUIC. Precepts: - Proverbs 22:29 Seest thou a man diligent in his business? He shall stand before kings; he shall not stand before mean men. Business meaning God's business. This is why you see us meeting dignitaries across the world: because we've been diligent in God's business. Mean men are obscure men; stop wasting your time debating obscure people on the internet who only want clout. - Romans 12:11 Not slothful in business; fervent in spirit; serving the Lord. That's the proof that the business is God's business. Genesis 42:1-38 1:35:53 - Joseph's ten brethren went down to buy corn in Egypt, and bowed down themselves before him with their faces to the earth. When they were younger, Joseph had a dream that the brothers bowed down to him, and they got mad at that thing. Now it's actually coming to pass. - Joseph knew his brethren, but they knew not him. They saw a black man dressed in Egyptian garments and assumed he was an Egyptian. That lets you know Joseph looked just like the Egyptians; he could not have been a Caucasian, or he would have stood out. - They knew not that Joseph understood them, for he spake unto them by an interpreter. Joseph made it as if he didn't speak Hebrew, which made it more convincing that he was Egyptian. - They said one to another, we are verily guilty concerning our brother, in that we saw the anguish of his soul, when he besought us, and we would not hear. And Joseph turned himself about from them, and wept. Although they did evil to Joseph, he still loved his brothers; he had to turn from them and cry privately. - He took from them Simeon, and bound him before their eyes, and commanded to restore every man's money into his sack. When they and their father saw the bundles of money, they were afraid. - Reuben spake unto his father, saying, slay my two sons, if I bring him not to thee. There's the characteristic of Reuben again, from when they first put Joseph in the pit. Genesis 43:1-10 1:43:43 - And the famine was sore in the land. It's always been famines. The only difference is now we think a famine could never happen, because we've been accustomed here. - Judah said unto Israel his father, send the lad with me, and we will arise and go; that we may live, and not die. I will be surety for him. - News read in class: the Texas GOP's new congressional map would move Representative Jasmine Crockett's home out of her district. They're changing district lines so black representatives lose their seats, and then our people have no voice in Congress. Scourges come, like what happened with George Floyd, and our people tend to forget, the same way people act like apartheid never happened in South Africa. Civil rights was 62 years ago and people said it could never happen again; now they're bringing back vagrancy laws under the 13th Amendment, where the homeless get arrested and prison labor becomes slavery again. And while food is cheap and everybody thinks things are fine, they're moving supermarkets out of our communities and pricing our people off the cruise lines and airlines. - Discussion of Idi Amin, Uganda, and South Africa: Idi Amin expelled the Asian and European merchants from Uganda and handed their businesses to Ugandans who had no experience in the imports and exports of that merchandise, and the stores collapsed. Today in South Africa the xenophobia is the same error: legal migrants from Ghana, Nigeria, and the ECOWAS region with legitimate small businesses are being beaten, driven from hospitals, and flown home, while about 90 percent of the businesses and the land are owned by white people. They turn against their own brothers while the real owners of the country are standing in front of them. Black people in America do the same thing when we riot and burn down stores in our own neighborhoods instead of saving our money and opening our own. Nobody has solutions to the problems, and the white man's solution is jail time. Precepts: - Acts 11:28 Agabus signified by the Spirit that there should be great dearth throughout all the world, which came to pass in the days of Claudius Caesar. He dreamed it under Caligula, and it took place years later under Claudius. We're telling y'all famine is coming; some of y'all are preparing, some are not. - 2 Esdras 16:19-22 Behold, famine and plague, tribulation and anguish, are sent as scourges for amendment; but for all these things they shall not turn from their wickedness. Vittles shall be so good cheap upon earth that they shall think themselves to be in good case, and even then shall evils grow upon earth: sword, famine, and great confusion. Many shall perish of famine, and the other that escape the hunger shall the sword destroy. - Isaiah 34:16 Seek ye out of the book of the Lord, and read: no one of these shall fail, none shall want her mate. You cannot mate another book with the Bible. Esau is loading the Bible apps with additional books like Enoch and Jasher. Book read in class: the Book of Jasher, chapter 54, was read at length as an example of why we stay away from these added books. In Jasher's telling, Judah crushes a 400 shekel stone into dust with his strength, Naphtali runs on the ears of corn without breaking them and numbers the twelve streets of Egypt, Simeon offers to level Egypt with one stone from the mount, and the Egyptian army flees in terror from Judah's scream. That did not happen; it makes nice fairy tale stuff, but it contradicts the biblical text. Genesis 46:5-11 2:13:16 - Jacob rose up from Beersheba, and his sons carried him and their little ones and their wives in the wagons which Pharaoh had sent, and all his seed came with him into Egypt. Genesis 46:26-34 2:14:13 - All the souls of the house of Jacob which came into Egypt were threescore and ten: 70 souls. - Joseph fell on his father's neck, and wept on his neck a good while. And Israel said, now let me die, since I have seen thy face, because thou art yet alive. - Joseph instructed them: when Pharaoh shall ask, what is your occupation, ye shall say, thy servants' trade hath been about cattle from our youth; for every shepherd is an abomination unto the Egyptians. Joseph was fully aware of the history of the Hyksos, the shepherd kings from Palestine who had taken over the Delta and ruled Egypt in the 15th Dynasty. That's why he told his father and brothers to tell Pharaoh they were shepherds, so they would be placed apart in Goshen. Genesis 43:30-32 2:16:16 - They set on bread for Joseph by himself, and for his brethren by themselves, and for the Egyptians by themselves: because the Egyptians might not eat bread with the Hebrews; for that is an abomination unto the Egyptians. - What we read about ancient Egypt is not just for back then. In the Jim Crow era it was an abomination for Esau to sit and allow us in their restaurants. Signs read in class: we serve whites only, no Spanish or Mexicans; no dogs and no Mexicans, El Paso, Texas, 1929; and the rest of the signs all across the South forbidding us their restaurants, toilets, and water fountains. Issachar was included in that too, no matter how light their skin was; after that time period a lot of Mexicans petitioned to be classified as white, because they had been classified as Negroes. - You had your 62 years since civil rights, and what have we done in those years? The same thing South Africans have done since apartheid ended in 1994. We have not organized into any faction of society; we still don't have our own hospitals, and we gave up the bus lines and institutions we did have in order to integrate. Now Esau is taking the integration rules and laws away. Precepts: - Revelation 11:8 The great city is Babylon the Great, which spiritually is called Sodom and Egypt, where also our Lord was crucified. This isn't the real Sodom or the real Egypt; it is a spiritual Sodom and a spiritual Egypt. On the dollar bill you have the pyramid with 1776 at the bottom, Novus Ordo Seclorum, and the obelisk stands in Washington. America knows this is a spiritual Egypt where they have captured tribes of Israel. And our Lord was crucified in Jerusalem; those same spirits that hated and murdered Christ are here again. They hate his image and they hate his teachings. Genesis 47:1-4 2:23:12 - Joseph took five of his brethren and presented them unto Pharaoh, and they answered as Joseph instructed: thy servants are shepherds, both we and also our fathers; for to sojourn in the land are we come. The Hyksos history is why that answer secured them Goshen. Genesis 47:15-20 2:26:10 - When money failed in the land of Egypt, all the Egyptians came unto Joseph and said, give us bread. Listen good to this: money failed. What good is money during the time of famine? Money is useless. - The first year they gave their cattle for bread.
