The second year they said, there is not ought left but our bodies and our lands: buy us and our land for bread, and we and our land will be servants unto Pharaoh. And Joseph bought all the land of Egypt for Pharaoh, and the land became Pharaoh's. - Video played, KRS-One: the smarter our intellectuals become, the more cowardly they become; the paycheck dictates what comes out of the mind, and feeding your family becomes more important than speaking truth to a people that will treat you like they treated Dr. King. We never lost our lands; we lost our minds. - Video played on Agenda 21: a master plan to change the political and economic system of the world to total collectivism. People must be dependent on the state for everything; they cannot have private property or land of their own; they are to live in high-rise apartments provided as a benefit, because anybody with a couple of acres, his own water supply, and his own food is a threat to a collectivist society. You see BlackRock and Blackstone buying up housing across America, trying to get rid of private homes. It correlates to what happened in Egypt in Genesis 47: give us food, take care of us, and we give up our property and become servants. You don't think that will happen again? The things written aforetime were written for our learning. Precepts: - Daniel 8:23 In the latter time of their kingdom, when the transgressors are come to the full, a king of fierce countenance, and understanding dark sentences, shall stand up. This is the era we're in now. There are people in this administration studying the scriptures from sunup to sundown; they do a diligent search, like Psalms 64:6 says. While you do your four chapters, they're taking notes. - Hosea 12:10 I have also spoken by the prophets, and I have multiplied visions, and used similitudes, by the ministry of the prophets. - Isaiah 19:1-4 The burden of Egypt: this Egypt is Babylon the Great, like we read in Revelation 11:8. I will set the Egyptians against the Egyptians: that's civil war, everyone against his brother, city against city, kingdom against kingdom. Don't be surprised if it's blue states against red states, Democrats against Republicans, and everybody picks a side. And the Egyptians will I give over into the hand of a cruel lord; and a fierce king shall rule over them. Psalms 105:17-22 2:38:51 - He sent a man before them, even Joseph, who was sold for a servant: whose feet they hurt with fetters: he was laid in iron, meaning chains, until the time that his word came. The king sent and loosed him, and made him lord of his house, to bind his princes at his pleasure, and teach his senators wisdom. Joseph taught the men of Egypt wisdom. Genesis 49:1-2 2:39:39 - Jacob called unto his sons and said, gather yourselves together, that I may tell you that which shall befall you in the last days. Highlight those last four words: in the last days. This prophecy is for the last days. Genesis 49:22-26 2:40:11 - Joseph is a fruitful bough by a well: they would live by waters, on islands, in the last days. Whose branches run over the wall: walls were built, forts like El Morro that the Spanish built to keep other European powers out of places like Puerto Rico. - The archers have sorely grieved him, and shot at him, and hated him: the conquistadors sorely grieved him. But his bow abode in strength, and the arms of his hands were made strong by the hands of the mighty God of Jacob. - Blessings of heaven above: good climate and weather. Blessings of the deep that lieth under: fish and the things beneath the waters. Blessings of the breasts, and of the womb: children upon children. - The blessings of thy father have prevailed above the blessings of my progenitors: what God promised to Abraham, Isaac, and Jacob was not yet fulfilled in their day, but Joseph ruled all Egypt. Canaan wasn't ours yet, and Joseph already had the crown. Book read in class: Lost Tribes and Promised Land, with passages from Spanish records, 1528 to 1543. Duran came to see elements of a Judaic character in the old Aztec religion: the eating of only unleavened bread on certain days of the year, the prohibition of drinking liquids after certain ritual food, the use of baths for purification; in time this seemed to him overwhelming evidence that the Indians are descended from the lost tribes of Israel, and he opens The History of the Indies of New Spain with an unqualified assertion to this effect. In Peru in the 1560s and 70s a Dominican friar declared a war to the death against the Indians to bring on the final redemption, because they were the lost tribes of Israel. And in the account of the Portuguese Marrano Antonio de Montesinos: the Indian guide Francisco declared his countrymen would be avenged upon the Spaniards by means of a people now hidden; Indians came by canoe and recited to Montesinos in Hebrew, Shema Yisrael, Adonai Eloheinu, Adonai Echad; they told him they were of the tribe of Reuben, and that the tribe of Joseph lived on an island nearby. That island speaks of Puerto Rico, with Cuba beside it. Their tablets said that at the end of days they will be lords of all the nations of the earth. Precepts: - Psalms 83:3 They have taken crafty counsel against thy people, and consulted against thy hidden ones. The same words the record used: a people now hidden. - Daniel 7:27 The kingdom and dominion, and the greatness of the kingdom under the whole heaven, shall be given to the people of the saints of the Most High: that's the whole earth, exactly what the tablets said. - Deuteronomy 33:1 and Deuteronomy 33:13-17 Moses blessed the twelve tribes before his death. Of Joseph he said, blessed of the Lord be his land: the precious things of heaven, the deep that coucheth beneath, the precious fruits brought forth by the sun and the precious things put forth by the moon; there are things on Cuba and Puerto Rico that only come forth by the moon. The goodwill of him that dwelt in the bush: that's Christ. His horns are like the horns of unicorns, meaning the rhinoceros: with them he shall push the people together to the ends of the earth; and they are the ten thousands of Ephraim, and they are the thousands of Manasseh. Ephraim and Manasseh were used instrumentally by God to push the ten tribes from the eastern hemisphere to the western hemisphere. - 2 Esdras 13:40-45 The ten tribes carried away captive by the king of Assyria took counsel to leave the multitude of the heathen and go forth into a further country where never mankind dwelt, that they might there keep their statutes which they never kept in their own land. The journey was a year and a half, and the same region is called Arsareth. - Hosea 11:10 When he shall roar, then the children shall tremble from the west. How did they get to the west? Deuteronomy 33:17 and 2 Esdras 13 just told you. - Hosea 7:8-9 Ephraim, he hath mixed himself among the people; Ephraim is a cake not turned. Some are very light because they mixed with Esau, some that did not mix are very dark. Strangers have devoured his strength, and he knoweth it not. Gray hairs are here and there upon him: Ephraim grows old and does not know his own history. - 1 Esdras 8:70 The holy seed is mixed with the strange people of the land. There's the precept for the mixing. - Hosea 9:3 They shall not dwell in the Lord's land; but Ephraim shall return to Egypt: that's the spiritual Egypt of Revelation 11:8. And they shall eat unclean things in Assyria. - Ezekiel 4:13 Even thus shall the children of Israel eat their defiled bread among the Gentiles, whither I will drive them. Just like Ephraim, so all the tribes. - Hosea 9:11-16 Ephraim is planted in a pleasant place, the islands, but Ephraim shall bring forth his children to the murderer: willingly seeking to mix their children lighter to improve the race, as the doctrine of la raza taught. Give them a miscarrying womb and dry breasts: God says he will deal himself with the seed of the oppressor mixed in. Ephraim is smitten, their root is dried up. Acts 10:1-4 2:58:37 - Cornelius was a centurion of the Italian band, a devout man that feared God with all his house. Where was he from? Caesarea. On the map, Caesarea sits right above Samaria: that's Manasseh's land. Cornelius was northern kingdom, not a Gentile of the nations. Do some research; do some study. Precepts: - Matthew 4:15 The land of Zabulon, and the land of Nephthalim, by the way of the sea, beyond Jordan, Galilee of the Gentiles. That's what they called the northern kingdom: the Gentiles. Christians haven't figured that out yet. - Acts 15:15-17 To this agree the words of the prophets; as it is written, after this I will return, and will build again the tabernacle of David, which is fallen down. What does that mean? Bring back the twelve tribes: the southern kingdom and the northern kingdom. When God accepted Cornelius and his kinsmen, James quoted this. - Amos 9:11-12 This is what James and Peter were quoting: I will raise up the tabernacle of David that is fallen, and close up the breaches thereof; that they may possess the remnant of Edom, and of all the heathen, which are called by my name: those that call themselves Jewish, and those that call themselves Christian. Christian is a Greek word meaning anointed ones, and we are the anointed ones. - Revelation 7:4-8 There were sealed 144,000 of all the tribes of the children of Israel. Manasseh is mentioned by name, and of the tribe of Joseph were sealed 12,000: Joseph here is Ephraim. - Ezekiel 37:19 Behold, I will take the stick of Joseph, which is in the hand of Ephraim. See that? Joseph, which is in the hand of Ephraim. That's how you know Joseph stands for Ephraim in Revelation 7. And he will put them with the stick of Judah, and make them one stick. Genesis 50:15-20 3:05:11 - When Jacob died, the brothers were scared that Joseph would seek revenge, and they sent a messenger begging forgiveness. And Joseph wept when they spake unto him. - Joseph said unto them, fear not: for am I in the place of God? But as for you, ye thought evil against me; but God meant it unto good, to bring to pass, as it is this day, to save much people alive. - Only a spiritual man can understand that. Joseph was on another level of understanding: he sat back and reflected on all that happened to him and knew it was God's divine plan. He may not have understood it while he was in the midst of it, but going through the years of plenty and famine he realized his purpose, and God set that whole thing up. Precepts: - Romans 8:28 We know that all things work together for good to them that love God, to them who are the called according to his purpose. We all go through things we don't understand while we're going through them. Whether you're suffering poverty, health problems, eviction, trials, or temptations, endure to the end; there's a purpose. - Job 42:10-15 The Lord turned the captivity of Job when he prayed for his friends; the Lord gave Job twice as much as he had before, and blessed the latter end of Job more than his beginning. Endure to the end and God shall restore everything. - Ecclesiasticus 2:7-11 Ye that fear the Lord, wait for his mercy, and go not aside, lest ye fall. Believe him, and your reward shall not fail. Look at the generations of old, and see: did ever any trust in the Lord, and was confounded? Was Job confounded? No. For the Lord is full of compassion and mercy, and saveth in time of affliction. Isaiah 43:3-7 3:10:13 - I gave Egypt for thy ransom, Ethiopia and Seba for thee. Since thou wast precious in my sight, thou hast been honourable, and I have loved thee: therefore will I give men for thee, and people for thy life. When it says give men for thee, it means the nations fall in Israel's place; we don't have to do a thing. - I will bring thy seed from the east, and gather thee from the west; I will say to the north, give up; and to the south, keep not back: bring my sons from far, and my daughters from the ends of the earth. Precepts: - Wisdom of Solomon 18:7 So of thy people was accepted both the salvation of the righteous and destruction of the enemies. There can be no salvation of the oppressed without the destruction of the oppressor. That is so plain, but for Christians it's so difficult to understand. Isaiah 11:13 3:12:16 - The envy also of Ephraim shall depart, and the adversaries of Judah shall be cut off: Ephraim shall not envy Judah, and Judah shall not vex Ephraim. Whatever the northern kingdom has against the southern kingdom must depart. Precepts: - Leviticus 19:17-18 Thou shalt not hate thy brother in thine heart; thou shalt not avenge, nor bear any grudge against the children of thy people, but thou shalt love thy neighbour as thyself. Northern kingdom and southern kingdom must apply this law if they want salvation. - Matthew 22:36-39 Thou shalt love thy neighbour as thyself. When it says thy neighbour, like we read in Leviticus, it means the children of thy people: your own nation. That's something we have not learned; you look at South Africa and they have not learned it either, despising their own people. God's laws must continue to be pushed and taught in this earth. No one is entering New Jerusalem with hatred in their heart. Zechariah 9:11-17 3:14:28 - As for thee also, by the blood of thy covenant I have sent forth thy prisoners out of the pit wherein is no water. The blood of the covenant is the new covenant blood of Christ. We are the prisoners; the pit is the same valley as Ezekiel 37, and that pit is Babylon the Great. No water means no truth in this land. - Turn you to the strong hold, ye prisoners of hope: the strong hold is the Holy Bible. We are the prisoners of hope, hoping for New Jerusalem. Some of our people are hoping for equality; we are not hoping for equality. When the nations say we're all equal, think about what that translates to: them on top, us on the bottom. - I will raise up thy sons, O Zion, against thy sons, O Greece: he's going to raise up all twelve tribes against Esau, and make thee as the sword of a mighty man. He's going to transform us from these weak, frail bodies into the sword of a mighty man. - The Lord shall be seen over them, and his arrow shall go forth as the lightning: it's going to be God's doing, no question. You're going to see the chariots of God above our heads; the whirlwinds of the south are the chariots. - The Lord their God shall save them in that day as the flock of his people: for they shall be as the stones of a crown, lifted up as an ensign upon his land. Not a brick, not cement: stones of a crown, rubies, jewels. That's how we're going to be. Precepts: - Hebrews 13:20 The God of peace, that brought again from the dead our Lord Jesus, that great shepherd of the sheep, through the blood of the everlasting covenant. That's the blood of the covenant Zechariah speaks of. - Deuteronomy 7:6 For thou art an holy people unto the Lord thy God: the Lord thy God hath chosen thee to be a special people unto himself, above all people that are upon the face of the earth. Does it say equal? It says above. In Closing With that, brothers and sisters: twelve tribes. The class was much more intricate than we got to today; it would run long, so the rest of this history will be taught in a coming class. Joseph, from age 17, endured slavery, false accusation, and 13 years in the dungeon without blaming God, stayed faithful in the least things, prepared solutions for the famine before it came, and lived to see that what his brothers meant for evil, God meant unto good, to save much people alive. Whatever you are going through, endure it to the end. title: DECEIVED BY ENTICING WORDS: COLOSSIANS 2
text: Introduction Thumbnail video: "For I would that ye knew what great conflict I have for you and for them at Laodicea, and for as many as have not seen my face in the flesh. Let no man therefore judge you in meat, or in drink, or in respect of an holy day, or of the new moon, or of the sabbath days: which are a shadow of things to come; but the body is of Christ. Let no man beguile you of your reward. These pastors have no understanding. Let me show you what Paul is referring to in Colossians chapter 2 verse 16." It is good to be back in Austin, Texas. We are doing a study on Colossians chapter 2: Deceived by Enticing Words. The reason for touching on Colossians is that there have been some wacky breakdowns of this chapter going around, so we are going to go through it somewhat slowly and gain some understanding. Books read to open the class: - From Diaspora Themes: rabbinic literature almost totally ignores the vast western diaspora that existed at the time, particularly compared with the relatively large number of places in this diaspora mentioned in Acts chapter 2, in the chapters describing the journeys of Paul (Acts 13), and in the Pauline epistles, which give a comprehensive picture of the geography of the western Jewish Greek-speaking diaspora in the first century. That Greek-speaking diaspora was around Asia Minor. Paul was born in Tarsus; they were Greek-speaking, and his father sent him to Jerusalem to learn Hebrew and become a scholar in the scriptures. - From a second book, on the results of Paul's teachings: it is not what happened to Paul personally that is important, but what happened to his teachings. Even while he lived, ample evidence proves that the people to whom he preached had misunderstood him. Most of the people who listened to Paul remembered only the connection between believing in Jesus and meriting God's mercy and ultimate resurrection, and they skipped the middle step: the need to live godly lives, the need to keep the commandments. Thus faith in Jesus came to be the only and entire basis of the religion adopted by the pagan Christians, while the Judeo-Christians who lived in Palestine continued to observe the law. But it was the pagan Christian attitude which won in the end, and Christianity spread most easily and rapidly in those cities in which Jews had lived for a long time. That is the church today: believe in Jesus and mercy is all they think or talk about. Christianity spread worldwide because it was a pagan religion with no commandments. Scriptures Opened Colossians 2:1 25:17 - Laodicea is in Asia Minor. And for as many as have not seen my face in the flesh: when you read the book of Acts, it is not written specifically that Paul went to Laodicea. He did go to Asia Minor, but it does not specifically say he went to Laodicea. One of his companions did go. - On the map of Asia Minor you see Pergamos, Thyatira, Sardis, Smyrna, Philadelphia, Ephesus, and Laodicea, with a river that splits between Ephesus, Philadelphia, and Laodicea. - Paul had a group of fellow soldiers that were about the work, not being pressured. That is the sense of receiving a man as an angel; it is not Michael and Uriel coming down from the heavens to talk to you. - Colossians 1:9-11 We do not cease to pray for you, that ye might be filled with the knowledge of his will in all wisdom and spiritual understanding; that ye might walk worthy of the Lord unto all pleasing, being fruitful in every good work, and increasing in the knowledge of God. That is how you are not beguiled. - John 11:45-46 Many of the Jews which had seen the things which Jesus did believed on him: they saw Christ raise Lazarus from the dead. But some of them went their ways to the Pharisees, and told them what things Jesus had done. You just saw the Son of God raise somebody from the dead, and you run to the enemies of God. Those same evil spirits are around today. - Acts 15:1-5 Certain men from Judaea taught the brethren, except ye be circumcised after the manner of Moses, ye cannot be saved. Paul and Barnabas had no small dissension and disputation with them, and went up to Jerusalem unto the apostles and elders about this question, declaring the conversion of the Gentiles, the diaspora. But there rose up certain of the sect of the Pharisees which believed, saying that it was needful to circumcise them, and to command them to keep the law of Moses: not only circumcision, but back to animal sacrifice. This is intruding into those things not seen, vainly puffed up: the bright idea that they had to do all those sacrifices of Numbers 28 or they could not be saved. Is that what Christ told the apostles? - Acts 15:24-26 Certain which went out from us have troubled you with words, subverting your souls, saying, ye must be circumcised, and keep the law: to whom we gave no such commandment. The apostles said that order did not come from us. It seemed good to send chosen men with our beloved Barnabas and Paul, men that have hazarded their lives for the name of our Lord Jesus Christ. - Ephesians 4:15 But speaking the truth in love, may grow up into him in all things, which is the head, even Christ. These men were not holding Christ as the head. Colossians 2:20-22 2:43:45 - Wherefore if ye be dead with Christ from the rudiments of the world, why, as though living in the world, are ye subject to ordinances? Why are you going back to those ordinances? Those ordinances go back to the sacrifices, the carnal ordinances imposed until the time of reformation. - Touch not; taste not; handle not; which all are to perish with the using; after the commandments and doctrines of men. Stop following man. Christ has come; he taught us that those animal sacrifices were temporary and his sacrifice is supreme. Precepts: - Leviticus 7:15-16 The flesh of the sacrifice of his peace offerings for thanksgiving shall be eaten the same day that it is offered. You had to eat these offerings; touch, taste, and handle belong to that service. - Matthew 15:9 But in vain they do worship me, teaching for doctrines the commandments of men. - Galatians 1:8-9 Though we, or an angel from heaven, preach any other gospel unto you than that which we have preached unto you, let him be accursed. Paul repeats himself: if any man preach any other gospel unto you than that ye have received, let him be accursed. - Acts 3:22-23 Moses truly said, a prophet shall the Lord your God raise up unto you of your brethren, like unto me; him shall ye hear in all things. And it shall come to pass, that every soul, which will not hear that prophet, shall be destroyed from among the people. You reject Christ and what he said, that is your outcome. This is what Paul was warning them about. Colossians 2:23 2:50:06 - Which things have indeed a shew of wisdom in will worship, and humility, and neglecting of the body. It has a show of wisdom because it is in the scriptures, but it was temporary. Will worship is voluntary worship of what men say; humility here is humbling yourself to man; neglecting of the body deals with fasting. - Not in any honour to the satisfying of the flesh: other translations read, but are of no value against the indulgence of the flesh. These men were fasting, praying, and sacrificing, yet they were still sexually indulgent all over the place. When it came to satisfying the flesh, they had no honor. Precepts: - Leviticus 23:27 On the day of atonement ye shall afflict your souls: fasting, no eating and no drinking for the entire day, and offer an offering made by fire unto the Lord. - Acts 27:9 Sailing was now dangerous, because the fast was now already past. The margin note points that fast to the tenth day of the seventh month, Leviticus 23:27. Paul kept the day of atonement, but was he sacrificing on the day? No, because he had faith in Christ. - 2 Timothy 3:6 For of this sort are they which creep into houses, and lead captive silly women laden with sins, led away with divers lusts. Fasting was meant to curb the desires; not with these men. - Jude 1:4 There are certain men crept in unawares, ungodly men, turning the grace of our God into lasciviousness, and denying the only Lord God, and our Lord Jesus Christ. Everything in the Bible with them turned into sexual immorality. Those spirits are back today. Colossians 3:1-5 2:59:34 - The thought continues into chapter 3. If ye then be risen with Christ, seek those things which are above: seek heavenly things, godly things. Set your affection on things above, not on things on the earth: is he saying do not get a job, do not become an entrepreneur, do not get married? No. It goes back to the bottom of verse 23: the satisfying of the flesh. - For ye are dead, and your life is hid with Christ in God. The old man that ran around chasing sin should be dead. When Christ, who is our life, shall appear, then shall ye also appear with him in glory. - Mortify therefore your members which are upon the earth: mortify means to deaden. Fornication, uncleanness, inordinate affection, evil concupiscence: sexual sins. And covetousness, which is idolatry: because when your god is your own flesh and you want to please that and only that, it is idolatry. Precepts: - Philippians 3:19 Whose end is destruction, whose God is their belly, and whose glory is in their shame, who mind earthly things. That is what minding earthly things means, and that is how it is with many Israelite camps today: everything becomes about the flesh instead of the godly things of the Lord. - Ecclesiasticus 29:21-24 The chief thing for life is water, and bread, and clothing, and an house to cover shame. Paul is not saying to ignore what we need on earth; you need that to survive. Better is the life of a poor man in a mean cottage than delicate fare in another man's house: it is better to have your own place, no matter how humble, than to live sumptuously in somebody else's house. Be it little or much, hold thee contented. It is a miserable life to go from house to house: where thou art a stranger, thou darest not open thy mouth. - Jeremiah 29:4-6 To all that are carried away captives: build ye houses, and dwell in them; and plant gardens, and eat the fruit of them; take ye wives, and beget sons and daughters; and take wives for your sons, and give your daughters to husbands, that ye may be increased there, and not diminished. So Paul was not contradicting the Bible and telling anybody to reject work, education, marriage, or building. Increase even in Babylon. In Closing The Pharisees beguiled with the same scriptures the apostles used; the Christian preachers do the same today with enticing words and fair speeches. The way you are not beguiled is to study, pray, and apply, so that no man spoils you through philosophy and vain deceit, and so that you hold the Head, which is Christ, in whom dwelleth all the fulness of the Godhead bodily. Announcements & References Books read in class: - Diaspora Themes (on the Greek-speaking Jewish diaspora of Asia Minor in the first century) - A history text on the results of Paul's teachings (how pagan Christianity kept faith and mercy but dropped the commandments) Field reports played: - The prophets of the Most High blitzed Black Bike Week in Myrtle Beach to bring the true gospel of repentance and salvation; as recent violence during bike week has shown, our people do not need more entertainment, they need truth and guidance from the word of God. - IUIC Sacramento, accompanied by the prophets on the coast, cast down the 2026 carnival event in San Francisco; the gospel went out and many souls were edified. - IUIC Milwaukee flooded the Cinco de Mayo celebration with the laws of God, calling the tribe of Issachar to repentance; a man of Mexican and Puerto Rican descent learned he is an Israelite. - Officer Solomon and the brothers cleaned up the Apache Manor community again; the word of God went out and the streets are clean. - IUIC Diaspora 2.0 carried the gospel to Grenada: your means of transportation was slave ships; you are the children of Israel, made in the image of Christ. Music and media: - New podcast: My Tabernacle, discussing societal issues, trauma, and mental health through a biblical lens focused on repentance. - Dropping tonight on Original Royalty Recordings, just in time for Pentecost: the single Switched Up by Sultry, and the video Light Up from the album Saving Sarah's Daughters by The Pen. - The first studio album Eternal Glory by Deacon Isaac is officially dropping July 12th. - Original Royalty's Royal Range Collection, western inspired pieces, coming soon. - Israel Live Top Five: scan the QR code to vote for next week's episode, Mondays at 9:00 pm. - Men's Conference 2026 registration reopens Monday, June 8th; Quest number nine registration coming soon. Dates: the Lord's feast of Pentecost begins tonight at sundown; it is a double Sabbath, no buying nor selling, but you can cook. The new moon is June 30th at sundown. The upcoming fast is Friday the 12th at sundown. Closing reading: 1 Corinthians 11:23-29, the bread and the cup, in remembrance of the Lord's death till he come; let a man examine himself. --- Class Notes Index Transcript: full session

title: MEMBERS OF THE BODY  PT2
text: Introduction This class continues last week's topic on the members in the body. Last week we spoke a lot about our accomplishments and where we have gotten thus far in this truth. Sometimes it is good to reflect: you got to look back to see where you started so that you could truly appreciate where you are now, and it puts into perspective where we are going. This truth did not look like this 20 years ago in 2006. What is it going to look like in another 20 years? There are individuals in here that are going to take this thing to a whole other level, but those individuals got to be able to see themselves in order to do those great things. Old photographs from the early days of the school were shown through the class: the few brothers at the beginning, the fold-up table with a cloth on it, the 12 passenger van with 15 people in it, and now a grown school. That is unity over the years multiplying itself and endeavoring to stay there. Scriptures Opened Romans 15:4 7:52 - For whatsoever things were written aforetime were written for our learning, that we through patience and comfort of the scriptures might have hope. This Bible is not a book that just sits on the counter. We believe on it and we apply the things that we learn, because we know the things promised to us from the scriptures are going to come to pass. Therefore we continue to strive and work hard so that the kingdom of heaven will come upon us. Psalms 133:1 9:41 - Behold, how good and how pleasant it is for brethren to dwell together in unity. If you cannot explain this verse and you have been sitting here, especially with a purple shirt on, shame on you. Meaning: when we are together, unified, there is nothing we cannot accomplish. - The unification of the nation of Israel is the highest known threat to this evil world we presently live in. It scares them. - If you are spiritual, you understand this unity is not talking about gang banging, not the fraternities, not Freemasonry, none of that worldly foolishness some of us came out of. This unification is talking about being unified in Christ. Hence the name Israel United in Christ. To be united in the Lord is true unity. Precepts: - Ecclesiasticus 25:1 In three things I was beautified, and stood up beautiful both before God and men: the unity of brethren, the love of neighbours, and a man and a wife that agree together. All three are unity in righteousness. It is not that oogly googly feeling about your neighbor; it is unity in righteousness. A sanctified holy marriage that has come together in the Lord is a beautiful thing before the Lord. Anything other than that is not beautiful; the Lord is not beautified. Remember how Paul wrote to the different schools: you are puffed up, there are all types of schisms among you. That is not unity. To be unified means to come together in holiness and righteousness the way God meant it to be. John 17:21 14:43 - That they all may be one, as thou, Father, art in me, and I in thee, that they also may be one in us. This is not talking about us joining a Trinity; the Most High and his son are not the same person. Christ says me and the Father are one, and we got to be one with Christ. - That the world may believe that thou hast sent me. Do you realize the world is waiting on the sanctification and unification of the nation of Israel? This whole earth is going to get right once we come together and truly become one. Ephesians 4:3-6 16:12 - Endeavoring to keep the unity of the spirit in the bond of peace. It says endeavoring because it takes work. As you come together you are going to have issues with your brethren, and you got to know how to apply the scriptures to remain unified. - The work is being able to spot Satan when Satan comes through the door. Satan is coming in to destroy unity, because unity is the biggest threat to this present world. That is what Satan is trying to destroy constantly. - What does that look like in real time? Somebody comes in with schisms, with different doctrines, putting certain spirits on brothers or sisters: we got to be able to spot that and call it out. When somebody goes astray and you see them drawing back, we are supposed to bring them home into the fold. Forgiving your brother when you are offended. - It also means dealing with the people that have been here for years: having the fortitude to look your good friend in the eye, who you do not want to make upset, and because you love them and you love this nation, say: hold on, you got the devil on you. Did you address that with him to his face? Why are you telling all of us? When somebody is comfortable spreading things and not dealing with things the scriptural way, it only spreads, and now gossip is normalized in the congregation. - One body, one spirit, one Lord, one faith, one baptism: everything is unified, of the selfsame spirit. We got to be the exact same way. If a brother or sister is going the wrong direction, they should hear the exact same response over and over, with the same intensity, whoever they bring it to. Do you know what that does to Satan? It makes him have to work hard to get in here. When everybody is of the same mind, it cannot happen. 1 Corinthians 12:1-3 27:14 - 1 Corinthians 12 is the embodiment of what a body takes in order to function. We would not be where we are right now if we did not understand that, but there is still more we got to put our brick in for to go to the next level. - Now concerning spiritual gifts, brethren, I would not have you ignorant. When you read this, understand Paul is addressing the body; this is a letter to a congregation just like us. Imagine Paul writing to this school. It is essential to understand the functioning of the body: you got to realize what every individual is worth. You are special because you are part of the body, but do not think you are more than another part. - It is easy to come here, sit down, and think everybody is just doing what they do. But when you understand how intricate this thing is: some of you came in, got patted down, dropped your kids off, and did not think twice about it. You get a plate of food brought to you and have no idea how many hands were involved to make that plate possible. - Wherefore I give you to understand, that no man speaking by the Spirit of God calleth Jesus accursed: and that no man can say that Jesus is the Lord, but by the Holy Ghost. By him actions are weighed. Somebody speaking of Christ and calling him accursed, that is not of the Lord; somebody who confessed Christ is Lord, this person believes. Precepts: - Ecclesiasticus 5:15 Be not ignorant of anything in a great matter or a small. You got to understand things in great matters as well as small. Do not be ignorant in the functionings of this body. - Romans 12:2 When you come into this truth you are supposed to transform the way you think; the scriptures are supposed to be inside you now. That you may prove what is that good, and acceptable, and perfect, will of God: to prove means you are not ignorant. It is the ability to process, to identify, to differentiate. Your antennas are up now. In the church you were ignorant, just walking along the line doing what everybody was doing: Christmas, birthdays, Mother's Day, Easter, Thanksgiving, never asking why. Now everything has to make sense: what does the scripture say, where is that in the Bible? - Psalms 40:8 I delight to do thy will, O my God: yea, thy law is within my heart. The will of God, the laws of God: to process, to understand, to see clearly, bouncing things off of the scriptures. You no longer conform to this world; you do not move like everybody else anymore. - Ecclesiastes 12:13 You have one job on this earth: fear God and keep his commandments. You have been given a brain to understand how to fear God, what the commandments of God are, and how to apply the laws of God in your life. That is why you got a mind. If you are using your mind for anything else, filling it up with video game moves and the stats of every player, you are on that broad road to destruction. Fill your mind with thus saith the Lord: how do I deal with my wife, how do I deal with my kids, what can I do to become stronger so the Lord can use me? - Matthew 6:19-21 For where your treasure is, there will your heart be also. Wherever your treasure is, that is where your mind is going to be occupied. If your mind is filled with games and sports statistics, that is where you are building your treasures, and all of that is going to be destroyed. Occupy your mind in the laws of God: how to unify, how can I be used as a tool for the Lord's army, how can I be utilized to push this truth further. That is laying up treasures in heaven, where neither moth nor rust doth corrupt. 1 Maccabees 1:43-49 42:15 - Paul led with "ye know that ye were Gentiles" because the spirit behind that word has been around a long time. The teachers took up the racial slur that this country put on our people. That word is another form of Hellenization: if somebody refers to you by it, they are telling you that you are unrepentant, that you have fully learned the customs of the heathen, and that the Hellenization worked. A dictionary definition was read in class confirming it is an inflammatory and deeply offensive racial slur, one of the most hateful epithets in the English language, which over time has been reappropriated in hip hop and youth culture as if it were casual or empowering. There is nothing empowering about it. Your oppressor named you that to demean you; you did not call yourself that. Changing the ending does not change what it is. The Spaniards have their own versions of the same thing for our Issacharite brothers. - In this time frame, many of the Israelites consented to the religion of the Greeks: idolatry. They gave up what God told them to do and said we are going to do what they want us to do. This is Hellenization. They profaned the sabbath, left the feast days, sacrificed swine's flesh and unclean beasts, left their children uncircumcised, and made their souls abominable with all manner of uncleanness. - To the end they might forget the law, and change all the ordinances. That was the goal, and this is the successful mission Esau set out to create within our nation: to take away our heritage and make us become something that we are not. Brothers and sisters, we are not that word. We never have been, and Lord's will, we will never be again. That word is a mind frame, and that is what you see amongst our people. Precepts: - Ephesians 2:11 Wherefore remember, that ye being in time past Gentiles in the flesh. Why were they called uncircumcision? Because it was their fathers back in the day, in the time of the Maccabees, that decided they were not going to circumcise their children. The circumcision in the flesh were those whose fathers stayed, who did not allow their children to become Hellenized. Paul reminds them: you were living like heathens. 1 Corinthians 12:2 49:30 - Ye know that ye were Gentiles, carried away unto these dumb idols, even as ye were led. Why does he bring this up before what he is about to go over? Because they were not accustomed to godly order or sound doctrine. They were following dumb idols, doing what those idols' customs wanted instead of what the most high God wanted. To try to teach organization to a Hellenized Jew is extremely difficult; you got to let them know, that is not us anymore, you got to renew your mind. Precepts: - Habakkuk 2:18-19 Think about the mind frame of a person that follows idols. Somebody created this thing, formed it, then turned around and said this is the god that brought you out of Egypt. Woe unto him that saith to the wood, Awake; to the dumb stone, Arise, it shall teach. You are on a fast track to destruction following dumb idols. - 1 John 5:21 Little children, keep yourselves from idols. Stay away from it. 1 Corinthians 12:4-6 55:45 - There are diversities of gifts, but the same Spirit. There are differences of administrations, but the same Lord. Definition read in class: administration refers to the organization, management, and supervision of the daily operations of a business, institution, or government; it involves coordinating people and resources to achieve specific goals. - There are diversities of operations. Definition read in class: operations refers to the daily behind the scenes processes, systems, and activities an organization uses. Administrations are the different offices that exist; operations are the inner workings, the processes that actually make the thing happen. - But it is the same God which worketh all in all. Different administrations and different operations all work for the same thing. Write this down: diversity does not mean division. Though it is a different administration, though it deals with something you do not deal with, it is not separate. And write this down as well: different roles do not mean inequality. We cannot look at any function, operation, or administration as though it is not needed. There is a reason why it is there. The body is alive because these administrations and operations function; it all works hand in hand, even the uncomely things. Romans 12:4-5 59:19 - For as we have many members in one body, and all members have not the same office. Everybody does not do the exact same thing. We are evolving; things are changing; we are growing, as Bishop says, expeditiously. With this growth comes responsibilities and the organizing of these different operations and administrations. - So we, being many, are one body in Christ, and every one members one of another. Many different administrations, many different operations, many different parts, one body in Christ. 1 Corinthians 12:7-11 1:01:23 - But the manifestation of the Spirit is given to every man to profit withal. Everyone has a gift, but it is going toward the same goal in unison. It is not just for you. - To one is given by the Spirit the word of wisdom: these are the wise brothers that can tell you, if you do that, this is what is going to happen. How many times have we gone against wisdom and found out the hard way, wishing we would have listened? A hard head makes a soft behind. To another the word of knowledge by the same Spirit: some people have that retention, near photographic memory for where every scripture is. That is a gift. - To another faith by the same Spirit. There are people in the body whose faith benefits you. The Deacon got personal: when Bishop was going through his health battle, having lost his own mother to cancer, he was scared inside. Another Deacon looked him in the eye and said, you think the Lord is going to let him go this way right now? No. Have faith. That spirit of faith was for him too, so he would not be around Bishop with doom and gloom. Spirits like that drag everybody down; we got to keep each other in check. - All these worketh that one and the selfsame Spirit, dividing to every man severally as he will. God has divided to every man as he wanted. Everyone has received something. New brothers and sisters, you are trying to discover what the Lord wants you to do here, because you woke up in this time period for a reason. What are you bringing to the table? How are you going to benefit your people and carry this truth to the next level? Sisters, the same: this is not just about the brothers, it is about a nation. Precepts: - 1 Peter 4:10 As every man hath received the gift, even so minister the same one to another, as good stewards of the manifold grace of God. The gift comes from the Lord, and it is used to minister one to another. You have not been given a gift just for you. If you only use it for yourself, it did not come from the Lord. These gifts are supposed to be utilized for the building of the body; that is the stewardship. - Philippians 2:4 Look not every man on his own things, but every man also on the things of others. How can I apply this gift to help somebody else, to benefit my people, to benefit the school? Some brothers had the gift of reaching people on the flyers: they can get a flyer into the hand of a man that just refused everybody else. You might have used that gift to hustle in the world, but that is not why you were given it. When your mind has been renewed you understand: God gave me that gift so I can get the word out. If you are not using the gift for the Lord, the Lord did not give it to you. God gives these gifts with purpose. - Romans 12:6-8 Whether prophecy, let us prophesy according to the proportion of faith; or ministry, let us wait on our ministry; or he that teacheth, on teaching. Everybody staying in their lane, working within the gift and skill set you have been given, not trying to force things that are not you. At camp, you cannot put the brother that is 105 pounds at the front sentry; he might be the fire teacher, or real good on flyers, but the wind will carry him off and we will not have a front sentry. When you operate outside your character, things get messy, and the person that should be in that position cannot operate the way the body needs, so we lack in different areas. Years ago a certain brother was put over the bills; one Sabbath the lights were off, and we learned that day he is not the one to put over the bills. We found where he belongs, and he is operating within his place now. Everybody does not belong everywhere. Exodus 31:1-11 1:18:13 - The Lord called Bezaleel by name and filled him with the spirit of God, in wisdom, in understanding, in knowledge, and in all manner of workmanship, to devise cunning works in gold, silver, brass, cutting of stones, and carving of timber. God created him for this purpose and brought him to them. - Do you think Bezaleel ever thought God gave me this gift? In his mind he just thought he was good at something. No: God gave you this talent for this purpose right here, so that the tabernacle, the ark, the mercy seat, the garments, everything the Lord commanded could be made. - And in the hearts of all that are wise hearted I have put wisdom, that they may make all that I have commanded thee. God gave it to them so they could do it. The Lord will literally send souls in so that these things get accomplished. This school went from a fold-up table with a cloth to brothers that could build a stage, because the Lord brought in builders. But we cannot sit on people's talents, and you cannot come in here and sit on your hands. Everything in its time and order, but when you have a gift, you got to utilize it. Ephesians 4:4-13 1:22:43 - Unto every one of us is given grace according to the measure of the gift of Christ. When he ascended up on high, he led captivity captive, and gave gifts unto men. A lot of people do not understand what happened when Christ gave his life for the nation and what opened up for us. It is a miracle that we even know who we are right now; us coming back to who we are shows the power of God. - And he gave some, apostles; and some, prophets; and some, evangelists; and some, pastors and teachers. Evangelists are the ones that go out and spread the word. - For the perfecting of the saints, for the work of the ministry, for the edifying of the body of Christ. That is the function and purpose of an apostle, prophet, evangelist, pastor, and teacher. This is why you were sent. - Till we all come in the unity of the faith, and of the knowledge of the Son of God, unto a perfect man, unto the measure of the stature of the fulness of Christ. That is us coming into the fullness of the body, into what God created us to be. 1 Corinthians 12:12-13 1:26:10 - For as the body is one, and hath many members, and all the members of that one body, being many, are one body: so also is Christ. The brothers were asked for precepts, and they brought them. - For by one Spirit are we all baptized into one body. A video of a church baptism in a filthy pond was shown, and the teachers had some fun with it, but this verse is not talking about getting dunked in water. Baptized means cleanse; write that down and look it up yourself. Baptized does not automatically mean dipped in water; that is what a lot of Southern Baptists think. Precepts: - 1 Corinthians 1:10 Now I beseech you, brethren, by the name of our Lord Jesus Christ, that ye all speak the same thing, and that there be no divisions among you. - Colossians 2:19 Not holding the Head, from which all the body by joints and bands having nourishment ministered, and knit together, increaseth with the increase of God. - Ephesians 1:22-23 God hath put all things under Christ's feet, and gave him to be the head over all things to the church, which is his body. Who is the church? Us. - Colossians 1:17-18 He is before all things, and by him all things consist. And he is the head of the body, the church: that in all things he might have the preeminence. Christ is the head of the body. - Ecclesiasticus 20:30-31 Wisdom that is hid, and treasure that is hoarded up, what profit is in them both? There is no profit in hiding the gift or the administration that God has set you in. Better is he that hideth his folly than a man that hideth his wisdom. If you know you are good at something and God has blessed you with that spirit, use it to push the truth and grow the unity God has called us to. - Matthew 3:11 I indeed baptize you with water unto repentance. If baptism automatically meant water, why would John need to say I baptize you with water? Water baptism was John's administration, a tool to show forth repentance; it was never a requirement for the kingdom. He that cometh after me is mightier than I: he shall baptize you with the Holy Ghost, and with fire. Did you hear anything about water? The baptism we must come under is through Christ. - Luke 3:16-17 Says the same thing. You want the baptism of the spirit, because the fire is coming to clean up everything else. Whose fan is in his hand, and he will throughly purge his floor; the chaff he will burn with fire unquenchable. That is talking about judgment. Galatians 3:28 1:38:52 - There is neither Jew nor Greek, there is neither bond nor free, there is neither male nor female: for ye are all one in Christ Jesus. This is another one they pull, not understanding what Paul is talking about. When you bring the history, they are going to start singing and clapping and try to overtalk you so you cannot bring them back to what the Bible is actually talking about. Ezekiel 37:15-23 1:39:35 - One stick written for Judah: the southern kingdom, Judah, Benjamin, Levi. Another stick for Joseph, the stick of Ephraim, and all the house of Israel his companions: the northern kingdom. And join them one to another into one stick; and they shall become one in mine hand. The kingdom was split under Rehoboam, Solomon's son, and Jeroboam, when the northern kingdom said, what portion have we in David? See to thine own house. Christ is the one making us one again. - Behold, I will take the children of Israel from among the heathen, whither they be gone, and will gather them on every side, and bring them into their own land: and I will make them one nation, and one king shall be king to them all: and they shall be no more two nations, neither shall they be divided into two kingdoms any more at all. No more division. - Neither shall they defile themselves any more with their idols. That is what the northern kingdom was doing: idolatry, living like heathens, like the other nations. But I will save them out of all their dwellingplaces, wherein they have sinned, and will cleanse them: so shall they be my people, and I will be their God. This tells you it is a specific people. Ephesians 2:11-22 1:44:29 - Paul brings up the exact same thing. Remember, ye being in time past Gentiles in the flesh: you were living like heathens, like Greeks. At that time ye were without Christ, being aliens from the commonwealth of Israel; the Jews had no dealings with the Samaritans, no dealings with the northern kingdom. Strangers from the covenants of promise, having no hope, and without God in the world: you were lost and hopeless before the Messiah came. - But now in Christ Jesus ye who sometimes were far off are made nigh by the blood of Christ. For he is our peace, who hath made both one. What is the both? The two sticks: one that had Judah, one that had Ephraim. And hath broken down the middle wall of partition between us: that wall is the hatred, the enmity, the envy, the vexation between the kingdoms. - Having abolished in his flesh the enmity, even the law of commandments contained in ordinances, for to make in himself of twain one new man, so making peace. The ordinances there is the sacrifice; that is how he ended the beef. When Christ gave his life he died for the whole nation and removed every excuse: forget who sacrificed where or who was first, you got to go through Christ now. - That word reconcile: to reconcile means you had to have once been together. At one time we were, then the split happened and that wall of partition was built, and it has not been right since. But through Christ, both kingdoms have opportunity to make it to the kingdom. He came and preached peace to you which were afar off, and to them that were nigh. That is why Christ dealt with the Samaritan woman in John 4: Christ understood his mission. The ushering in of the Messiah was for the unification of the body, bringing back Israel as one. - Now therefore ye are no more strangers and foreigners, but fellowcitizens with the saints, and of the household of God, built upon the foundation of the apostles and prophets, Jesus Christ himself being the chief corner stone; in whom all the building fitly framed together groweth unto an holy temple in the Lord. Right now in this room we got northern and southern kingdom back together again. That wall of partition is done. Precepts: - Isaiah 11:11-13 The Lord shall set his hand again the second time to recover the remnant of his people, from Assyria, from Egypt, from Pathros, from Cush, from Elam, from Shinar, from Hamath, and from the islands of the sea. Has this happened yet? No, we are waiting on this second coming. This is why unification is so important: we got to go back to all these places, because our people are there. He shall assemble the outcasts of Israel: those that were kept afar off, living amongst the other nations. The envy also of Ephraim shall depart, and the adversaries of Judah shall be cut off: Ephraim shall not envy Judah, and Judah shall not vex Ephraim. All that division, light skin against dark skin, northern kingdom looking at us and us looking at them, is going to be gone. We have all been through changes and look different today, but we are all the same people. 1 Corinthians 12:14-18 1:55:22 - Whether we be Jews or Gentiles: northern or southern kingdom. Whether we be bond or free: a bondman or a free man, because you could purchase your freedom. We have all been made to drink into one Spirit: there is one way to the kingdom, and we are all partaking of the same thing. - The body is not one member, but many. If the foot shall say, because I am not the hand, I am not of the body; if the ear shall say, because I am not the eye, I am not of the body: if the whole body were an eye, where were the hearing? God hath set the members every one of them in the body, as it hath pleased him. - Name the functions of this body: security, kitchen, medical, maintenance, AV, the brothers that clean, hospitality, outreach, fundraising, the kids corner. Everybody is important. The brothers wiping the doorknobs saved you from a heap of trouble you never thought about. Take the kitchen out of here and the Sabbath feels completely different. Let all the kids sit in class and see if we can get through it. Different offices help this whole thing function. Romans 12:3 2:01:14 - Not to think of himself more highly than he ought to think, but to think soberly, according as God hath dealt to every man the measure of faith. Thinking soberly is thinking with a clear mind, understanding that God has given severally to the body and there is importance in every single person. - When you think like that, you have more respect for every individual that walks through that door. You are not dealing harshly with the people coming in or looking down on folks like you are better. You started in the same place; you remember what it was like coming in, when you did not even have a Bible, or came in with the wrong Bible. It could be Daniel walking through the door day one, Isaiah, Peter, James, any of the apostles waking up in their time. You are going to treat them like crap? We are all in this together, and there is not nary a person in here better than the next. Ecclesiastes 4:9-10 2:03:29 - Two are better than one; because they have a good reward for their labour. When we work together, there is reward. The more of us there are, the more we can do. They are looking at us crazy right now because somehow we inhabited a ship with hundreds of people and took the gospel to about eight different countries without asking anybody's permission. Because we work together, collectively we are strong. - Woe to him that is alone when he falleth; for he hath not another to help him up. The Deacon knew what it was like to be alone here in 2006, before anybody: he had to leave and go where two are better than one and get built up. There is strength in numbers: we hold each other accountable, support each other, and look after each other, if we truly love the Lord. But if we come into this thing like Hellenized Jews, the numbers will not profit us. Philippians 2:3 2:05:31 - Let nothing be done through strife or vainglory; but in lowliness of mind let each esteem other better than themselves. This is the humility we got to bring ourselves to with each other. We got to prefer one another and not do anything in strife or vainglory, like you are doing it to glorify yourself. The reward is never of the Lord when you do it like that. When you look at it from a collective stance, it is so much better. 1 Corinthians 12:21-25 2:06:15 - The eye cannot say unto the hand, I have no need of thee: nor again the head to the feet, I have no need of you. Imagine somebody saying to another member, your job is not that important. You are not in the spirit of the Lord. Anything you remove, the whole body feels the change. - Nay, much more those members of the body, which seem to be more feeble, are necessary. What seems feeble? The janitorial work, the kids corner, the offices that never get seen, like the brothers back there hitting the buttons on the screen; yet the buttons sometimes bring clarity to the class. When we are at camp and a point is made, everybody sounds off, and that makes a person really consider what was said. It may seem small, but nothing we do in this body is small; everything has a purpose. - Our uncomely parts have more abundant comeliness. The class named uncomely parts of the physical body, and the point stood: let the most uncomely part of your body close down and you will die within days. The uncomely parts make the world go round just like everything else. The counsel you give in secret is not for vainglory; you are truly trying to help somebody, and even though it is in secret, it matters, all the time. - But God hath tempered the body together, having given more abundant honour to that part which lacked: that there should be no schism in the body. John 16:33 2:12:18 - Are schisms going to happen? Oh yes; it is promised to happen. These things I have spoken unto you, that in me ye might have peace. In the world ye shall have tribulation: but be of good cheer; I have overcome the world. There is a whole lot of pain and sorrow contained in this verse, but Christ said I overcame the world. 2 Esdras 7:57-59 2:13:22 - This is the condition of the battle, which man that is born upon the earth shall fight. This is the reality we live in. Pain, sorrow, tribulation, struggle, poverty, and death are waiting for every man the moment we are born, and all of us are going to deal with it. - If he be overcome, he shall suffer as thou hast said: but if he get the victory, he shall receive the thing that I say. Getting the victory means you endure until the end. You keep fighting, you never give up, you continue to endeavor to keep the unity. - This is the life whereof Moses spake unto the people while he lived, saying, Choose thee life, that thou mayest live. We all have to deal with this battle and we all got to choose. Look around this room: you are not going to see everybody in here ten years from now. There will be a grand story in their mind as to why they left, but the truth of the matter is they did not want to fight; they allowed Satan to overcome them. All you can do is make sure you do what you got to do and endure until the end. 2 Timothy 3:12 2:16:59 - Yea, and all that will live godly in Christ Jesus shall suffer persecution. It is going to happen; it is inevitable. Remember Ecclesiasticus 2: my son, if thou come to serve the Lord, prepare thy soul for temptation. You caught hell coming into this truth; Satan did not want to let you go. Old acquaintances from years ago suddenly contacting you: Satan wanted you. He does not want one of us to wake up. But we are here. Precepts: - Ecclesiasticus 2:1 My son, if thou come to serve the Lord, prepare thy soul for temptation. 1 Corinthians 11:18-19 2:18:16 - When ye come together in the church, I hear that there be divisions among you; and I partly believe it. For there must be also heresies among you, that they which are approved may be made manifest among you. A lot of folks do not understand how heavy that is: it has to happen. Everybody still sitting here made it through whatever trial; somebody else got weak and decided they were not going to do this anymore. - Bishop said it in San Diego: pressure either bursts pipes or makes diamonds. Which one are you? If I want to find the weak points in a body, I apply pressure; pressure exposes weak points. You may have to repair the patch, but now you see where the repairs need to be made. We hear what the offenses were, why somebody flipped out, and we see the weak point. Then there are those that go through heavy things, and they are still here; they did not flip, did not give up, did not say curse God and die. Pressure manifests who is built for what. Do not ever run from pressure or confrontation, because that is what reveals what is there. Luke 17:1 2:21:04 - It is impossible but that offences will come. You are not going to stop it. In this truth somebody is going to disappoint you, misunderstand you, correct you, overlook you, frustrate you. You are going to take something one way and they meant it another way, and now it is a big misunderstanding. The question is what you are going to do. - How many misunderstandings did you have with your siblings? Did you run away from home? You stayed and dealt with your problems, and you did not stop loving them; they were your family. Same thing here. It is going to be hard times, difficult times, awkward times; well, we are spending all that time together. We are in the trenches, we are not going anywhere. I will be here to correct you, and you had better correct me if I am wrong, and we will figure everything else out. Mark 3:24 2:23:18 - Satan attacks unity. That is why the scripture says we are not ignorant of his devices. Any good event, anything positive, Satan tries to come in and ruin it, because he hates us unified. - If a kingdom be divided against itself, that kingdom cannot stand. Imagine a body divided against itself; can you imagine punching yourself in the nose? A definition of autoimmune disease was read: a condition where your immune system mistakenly attacks your own healthy cells, tissues, and organs. What do we look like gnashing and biting against one another, working against each other, trying to step over each other for rank, position, authority, or pride? You got an autoimmune disease in the body when you work against yourself. Everybody is getting a crown, but you want a bigger crown; you better just try to get in the door. That is the mission: get in the door. - A PowerPoint was shown on the clear signs that a body is fractured or fracturing: constant murmuring; cliques forming, where brothers do not want other brothers around; isolation, people distancing themselves; secret conversations and hidden discussions; prideful individualism, people that cannot be corrected; emotional decision making instead of doing it scripturally; lying or dealing falsely; and refusal to forgive. Holding a grudge destroys the body; we have to forgive like Christ told us to forgive. - Then the signs of a healthy body, fitly joined together: healthy communication; patience, members forbearing one another; forgiveness, moving past things without holding them over each other's heads; structured leadership; congregational support, showing up when a brother needs help; humility, where a teacher that does not know an answer says I do not know instead of freestyling a made-up answer that creates a breakdown; shared mission, because a body that understands the goal is the strongest body; and endurance through pressure, which reveals faith, strengthens unity, and develops spiritual maturity. Those that have been through some things and are still standing, we see you: not easily moved, a rock, standing on Christ. Hebrews 2:1 2:32:27 - Therefore we ought to give the more earnest heed to the things which we have heard, lest at any time we should let them slip. In Closing I pray we got something out of today's topic. It is definitely necessary, especially with the direction that we are going. Big change is coming to Israel United in Christ, and it is for the better; the Most High is doing big things. Stay tuned. Announcements & References The class closed with a video montage on the history of the body: before the marches, before the crowds, there was a man, a Bible, and a mission. The word came first, the work came next, and from the beginning the body started forming, on corners, in cities, in the heat and the cold. As the body grew, the order grew. No part was small, no hand was wasted; every member had a purpose. Then the streets began to see what unity looked like. Definitions read in class: administration, operations, the racial slur discussed under 1 Maccabees 1, and autoimmune disease. Bishop taught next after this class. --- Class Notes Index Transcript: full session

title: Member's In The Body
text: Introduction The 2:00 class, taught by the deacons in Killeen, Texas, about an hour from Austin, on the same Sabbath the Bishop taught in Austin. Today's topic is one mind, one body. Deacon Malachi is in the spirit, especially after the conversation we had last night. We are going to take a look back and see where we began, because sometimes that is what you have to do, especially to understand where you are going. Scriptures Opened Romans 15:4 10:45 - Whatsoever things were written aforetime were written for our learning, that we through patience and comfort of the scriptures might have hope. We go into the scriptures to find comfort in the things we are going through; whatever trials and tribulations we face, we find the answers in the scriptures. - We are not the Christian church. These so-called Christians out here do not rely on the Bible for their understanding or their faith. What you see in the world today is a social religion, like a superstition for our people; they believe what society has told them to do. We rely on the scriptures and believe on the Lord according as it is written. Deuteronomy 6:4-5 12:38 - Hear, O Israel: the Lord our God is one Lord. We start with the order first. We as a body have to be one, in unison, in sync. This is why we have been able to accomplish the amazing things we have in this congregation: because we are one. Precepts: - John 10:30 Christ said, I and my Father are one. Is there a division between Christ and his Father? No, they are on one accord. - John 5:30 I can of mine own self do nothing: as I hear, I judge: and my judgment is just; because I seek not mine own will, but the will of the Father which hath sent me. Christ does not do what he wants to; he does what the Father tells him to. Yet the scripture says he and his Father are one. - John 14:20-21 At that day ye shall know that I am in my Father, and ye in me, and I in you. Christ does what his Father tells him to do, and Christ tells us what to do, and we keep those commandments; all of them, not picking and choosing and cherry picking like Christians. He that hath my commandments, and keepeth them, he it is that loveth me; and I will love him, and will manifest myself to him. He is explaining how you receive the Holy Spirit: in order to have the Holy Spirit, you must be one with the Most High and his son. John 17:18-22 17:13 - As thou hast sent me into the world, even so have I also sent them into the world: the apostles. - Neither pray I for these alone, but for them also which shall believe on me through their word: through the apostles spreading this gospel, which is why we have the word today. He is praying for us as well. - That they all may be one; as thou, Father, art in me, and I in thee, that they also may be one in us. And the glory which thou gavest me I have given them; that they may be one, even as we are one. Where does that leave any room for that trinity doctrine nonsense? None. It shows that we also are to be one with the Lord, and for us to be one, we must move in the spirit of one: one mind, one body. 1 Corinthians 12:12 19:46 - For as the body is one, and hath many members, and all the members of that one body, being many, are one body: so also is Christ. A body is made of different parts that all work together: the heart that pumps blood, the brain that thinks, the arms and legs that move. - We here at Israel United in Christ are not many bodies. This is IUIC Austin; IUIC OKC, IUIC Atlanta, and IUIC Arkansas are in the building. We have many members, but they are not different bodies. We are one body, the same mind, the same spirit. Regardless of where you travel, it should have the same feel and the same teachings, because we are one. - Video played from the grassroots: it was only three families. No garments, little three piece suits, unleavened bread, lamb, bitter herbs, wine, and music from the families. This is what longevity and endurance look like. At one point the bishops would serve all the people at Passover; changes had to happen because of expansion and growth, and those changes were not comfortable, but they were necessary to bring us to where we are today. Precepts: - Ephesians 4:4-6 There is one body, and one Spirit, even as ye are called in one hope of your calling; one Lord, one faith, one baptism, one God and Father of all. There are not different ways, different types, or different forms of God and how to worship God, no matter what Oprah said. There is only one way, one truth: keeping the commandments and faith in his son. That is what brought us together. If fellowship or friendships are what brought you here, you are in the wrong place. There is no separatism in the body of Christ; we are all one. 1 Corinthians 3:11-13 26:28 - For other foundation can no man lay than that is laid, which is Jesus Christ. Every man's work shall be made manifest. Do you understand what this body was built on? Other organizations started building before Israel United in Christ, with far more members and far more resources, but when you look at the outcomes today, there was no growth, no expansion, no change. - Video played from the early years: why do you always talk about the commandments? All the other Israelites talk about Illuminati and curse the white man. What did God give Moses to give us? Not the Catholic religion, not Islam: all his commandments. - Back in 2006 you could see the separation. Everybody was doing YouTube videos, and the focus in many camps was conspiracy: 9/11 was an inside job, the back of the dollar bill, FEMA camp doctrine, plastic coffins at Walmart. Meanwhile: how do you get to the kingdom? How do I make my marriage better? How do I deal with my wife, my kids? How can I be a better brother? What is the plan, what is the vision? None of that was being taught. The content on the early page was not getting the views, but the content is what changed my life. - You had congregations built on fear: they fled Babylon because they thought the judgment was coming in 2012, and some literally fled into a civil war, talking about safety and security. We are not built like that; this foundation is built on the rock. - We have a different mindset: make sure we have our own, never depend on anybody, because the enemy can shut you down any minute. Nobody is backing us up; we do not need anybody to back us up. We need each other. For those in the Israelite camps who want to know the secret: the secret is keeping the laws. As long as we stand in the spirit, the Most High is going to bless us, and this is just the beginning. - On the 501c3 accusation: a 501c3 is just a tax classification, meaning we do not pay tax; when we spend at the store we keep the tax money and buy more unleavened bread. It is not a check that gets cut. And if you think we had to stop teaching the commandments and faith in Christ for it, look what we are teaching; nobody cut the feed and nobody cut the funding. Precepts: - Psalms 111:10 The fear of the Lord is the beginning of wisdom: a good understanding have all they that do his commandments. I learned that very early in this truth: if they were not keeping the commandments, they could not teach me anything. - Proverbs 29:18 Where there is no vision, the people perish. Early on there was really no direction in the other camps: talking crazy in the streets with no plan. Whose congregation is thriving with hating the black woman and hating the nations as the basis of their teaching? - Romans 12:2 Be not conformed to this world: but be ye transformed by the renewing of your mind. I knew I was in the right place when I was surrounded by men and women that decided to put everything behind them and do what God said, whether it was fashionable or not. At one point fringes were not fashionable; at one point modest apparel for the women was called oppression. We are not oppressing them; we are giving them what God said. - Matthew 7:24-25 Whosoever heareth these sayings of mine, and doeth them, I will liken him unto a wise man, which built his house upon a rock. These sayings are Christ's words: if you love me, keep my commandments. We have built this house, this congregation, on Christ, on the laws of God and faith in him. - Revelation 14:12 Here is the patience of the saints: here are they that keep the commandments of God, and the faith of Jesus. Look at the back of your shirts: we built this body on the commandments of God and the faith of Christ. Is there any other way to build? - Psalms 127:1 Except the Lord build the house, they labour in vain that build it. Go ahead and try to do it another way; a lot of these organizations are finding out what happens when you build on anything other than the Lord. 1 Corinthians 12:18 46:10 - But now hath God set the members every one of them in the body, as it hath pleased him. God organizes the body; God is who made us great. The reason we are considered the vanguard is because God appointed us to be, and if we move any differently than that mindset, God will remove us and put somebody else there. - Each and every one of you has been gathered here for a purpose, brought into this body to benefit the nation. For those who think you are insignificant: God called you in here, so you had better apply your gifts and talents, because if you do anything other than that, you are going against God. Precepts: - Romans 12:4 For as we have many members in one body, and all members have not the same office. The mind does not have the same function as the hand; the hand does not have the same function as the foot; but they all need each other. The body cannot function with all hands; if everybody comes in trying to be the feet, what happens? Disorder. - 1 Corinthians 14:40 Let all things be done decently and in order. The Lord is about order; he is not going to keep bringing the same member into the body. Can everybody be a teacher? Then who is going to read? - Preparation is not just food and water. We need lawyers, doctors, nurses, and farmers; that is how you prepare as a nation. So yes, go to school, get an education; do not listen to anybody saying Christ is coming soon so do not go to school. That is a bum mentality, and the same camps that taught their congregants not to prepare cannot open one building to this day, because they taught their people not to achieve greatness. You are the Israelites with the spirit of Christ on you: master any skill, any trade, and bring that mastery back to benefit your nation. Right now the biggest thing is AI: if you can go to school and learn AI, go do it. And brothers do not want to marry a sister with no aspirations either; we want sisters with that revolutionary mind to help her nation. - Video played from 2016, the Bishop teaching on this same chapter: all of those different members make up the nation. Original Royalty, the kitchen, the school with the kids, security, video, music: all of these things are components in a society, and the concept comes from this verse. The body is Israel under Christ; it involves different parts, but it all works together for the common good of the whole nation. An architect does not do what an electrician does, but when it comes to uniting for what they believe in, they all come out and support it. You might be good at filming, another brother at teaching; we are all linked together because we all keep these commandments, and when a brother falls low, we all support him. This was ten years ago; what was vision then is old news now, because that is what vision does for a nation. 1 Corinthians 12:12-20 1:00:13 - For by one Spirit are we all baptized into one body, whether we be Jews, those who grew up knowing who they were, or Gentiles, the diaspora scattered and calling ourselves by different names. That spirit is the laws and Christ; the spirit of this book called us into one body. - If the foot shall say, because I am not the hand, I am not of the body; is it therefore not of the body? God gave you every member and every limb of your body for a reason. What part of your body do you not need? Lose your pinky toe and see if you walk the same. This passage is telling you that all of us were put in here for a reason and a purpose. - Nobody should be bogging down your talents and gifts; we should be accentuating those gifts, furthering them, and teaching others those talents where possible.
