Precepts: - Ephesians 4:11-13 He gave some, apostles; and some, prophets; and some, evangelists; and some, pastors and teachers; for the perfecting of the saints, for the work of the ministry, for the edifying of the body of Christ. Though they had different offices and administrations, it was all for one goal. You see it in the teachers today: some focus on prophecy, some on organization and structure, some on marriage; each has his specialty, and you learn where to go glean from. - 1 Peter 4:10 As every man hath received the gift, even so minister the same one to another, as good stewards of the manifold grace of God. Shame on you if you come in here and sit on the talent God has given you. You have been given that gift for a reason: to utilize it and benefit your nation. - Proverbs 18:16 A man's gift maketh room for him, and bringeth him before great men. When you have a talent, at least come in and say what you are able to do. Story told in class: when the OKC building was first acquired in 2017 it was in terrible shape, and brothers started coming out of the woodwork; a carpenter showed up, looked at the downed wires, and told them what was a fire hazard. The Lord brought those people in so they could build up the school, and after completion that brother disappeared: he served his purpose. - Matthew 25:24-28 The parable of the talents: the man who hid his talent in the earth did nothing with the understanding God gave him, and his Lord called him a wicked and slothful servant, and said, take therefore the talent from him, and give it unto him which hath ten talents. A lot of you think your gift gives you job security; realize that when you do not utilize that gift, God will take it from you and put the spirit on somebody else to take this truth even further. If you cannot be used, you are useless; and none of you are useless, because we all have been called for a reason. There is something in you that you have to give to the nation. - Romans 12:3 Not to think of himself more highly than he ought to think, but to think soberly. We are all expendable and can be replaced if we do not put something into this truth. When members begin to think they are more important than another, dysfunction comes into the body, and members start treating other offices like they are less important. Where would we be without security? Unsafe. Without the brothers and sisters that clean? Infested. Without the kitchen? Hungry. There is not one office we can say is more important; they all play a part. Even with leadership: a deacon is not better than you. I have to keep the commandments and believe on Christ just like you. If you start to think you are better because of your office, this body is going to suffer. Respect the sisters changing diapers; respect the brother folding flyers, who in his tenure has probably put a million flyers into rotation in the earth. - Philippians 2:3 Let nothing be done through strife or vainglory; but in lowliness of mind let each esteem other better than themselves. That striving spirit will unravel things, and people can see it when you move like that. Some security brothers, be careful: you get ahead of yourself ordering people around. That is your brother and your sister; deal with somebody like you want to be dealt with. No member is better than the next; we are all working toward the same goal, the kingdom. If we have this mind frame, we are going to move mountains. Psalms 133:1 1:21:40 - Behold, how good and how pleasant it is for brethren to dwell together in unity. Why is that good and pleasant? Because we cannot be stopped when we are unified. Precepts: - Deuteronomy 32:30 How should one chase a thousand, and two put ten thousand to flight? Unity. Through us together, unified in Christ, hence the name Israel United in Christ, we can move mountains. Some others do not aspire to do anything; they are fine doing videos from their garages. But the vision here has been set at a worldwide standard. If you do not have worldwide aspirations, you are not going to do worldwide things; if you think small, you will stay small. Amos 3:3 1:34:56 - Can two walk together, except they be agreed? No. Video played from 2013: the sixty man camp waging war against the wicked church system, waking up our people. Of those sixty men, there are not many left. Be mindful: the Lord will bring you into this to temporarily do what he needs you to do, and if you think more highly of yourself than you ought, you will be discarded and someone else will fill your stead, and this mission will continue without you. The Lord does not need any one of us. - What was achieved back then set a standard in the nation: it showed you can organize, you can unify, and we can all be under one. Other schools have so many different doctrines among them; they do not even agree on the same things, but now they all want to say they are one too. - You cannot watch that video and tell me the Most High is not working with IUIC. It was sixty men then; right now we can make one phone call and have a thousand men here. - What is unique about this body is that individuals here understand order. Everybody cannot be the bishop; everybody is not going to be deacons, captains, officers; but everybody plays their part. This is why a deacon or a captain can be demoted to a brother and they are going to be the same way: they are who they are. Flattering titles only give you a name; do not let a title create who you are. You have to be who you are to get the title, with or without the name. 1 Corinthians 12:4-11 1:37:07 - There are diversities of gifts, but the same Spirit; differences of administrations, but the same Lord; diversities of operations, but it is the same God which worketh all in all. Is that all talking about camp, camp, camp? No. We are so much more than that now: youth violence committees, Saving Sarah's Daughters, community cleanups, prison ministry, the colleges, music with Original Royalty, which now even has a modeling section. Back in the day we had two songs in rotation. - Wisdom, knowledge, faith, healing, miracles, prophecy, discerning of spirits, tongues: all the gifts are for the same purpose, the perfecting of the saints, to profit the ministry and build up the nation. You were not given the gift to hold on to it or keep it to yourself; you were given the gift so it could help somebody else. - Look what we have been able to accomplish. We came out of the world: Christmas was a big deal for some of us, and now you have children that were born in Israel United in Christ that have never known anything other than the high holy days of the Lord. That feeling people used to get around the world's holidays, they get ten times more when the feast days come up. Acts 2:41-44 1:49:01 - There were added unto them about three thousand souls, and they continued stedfastly in the apostles' doctrine and fellowship. Look what the Lord has done with Israel United in Christ: thousands of brothers and sisters have come into repentance, learned who they are according to the Bible, and keep God's commandments and faith in his son. The Lord continues to increase us because we never let go of the true mission. If we get sidetracked, he will destroy all of this; we would look up and there would be nobody here. - And all that believed were together, and had all things common. This is the level of unity we have to get to. We have made it far, but we can do a lot better. Acts 4:32 1:50:42 - The multitude of them that believed were of one heart and of one soul, and had all things common. What were they able to accomplish with that mindset? Whatever they wanted to. They believed enough to give up certain things so that others could have. - We have done this on this level. Any leader who is not forwardly thinking about building and maintaining Israelite owned institutions is not worth your time; he is playing games. - Videos played: the brothers came together and bought the building in New York with their own hands and skills, sheetrock to ceilings. In 2023 the Bishop said we are not going to have the big Passovers anymore; we are going to collect money and buy property, so no anonymous phone call can get us shut down, no more depending on Esau at all. In March 2025 came the land blitz fundraiser, and then the announcement: we got the land. Phase one purchased 40 acres of prime land in a strategic location; leadership paints the vision, but the execution happens through your faith and your willingness to contribute, just as we read in Acts 2 and Acts 4. The goal is to build spaces of our own, places to meet, to gather, and to fellowship, so we no longer have to rent or lease from others. James 2:14-17 1:53:14 - What doth it profit, my brethren, though a man say he hath faith, and have not works? Every Israelite leader says they have faith. If a brother or sister be naked and destitute of daily food, and one of you say unto them, depart in peace, be ye warmed and filled, notwithstanding ye give them not those things which are needful to the body, what doth it profit? Even so faith, if it hath not works, is dead, being alone. Matthew 5:14 2:02:35 - Ye are the light of the world. The scriptures tell us this is a global mission, worldwide. We have to have our aspirations and goals set to a global standard, not a local one. Precepts: - Matthew 24:14 And this gospel of the kingdom shall be preached in all the world for a witness unto all nations; and then shall the end come. How is it going to be preached in all the world if you have no plans and no implementation to do anything worldwide? The Lord sent his prophets with vision and goals to take it to the ends of the earth. - Isaiah 11:11 The Lord shall set his hand again the second time to recover the remnant of his people, from Assyria, from Egypt, from Pathros, from Cush, from Elam, from Shinar, from Hamath, and from the islands of the sea. How are these people going to rise out of these places if they are never told? They ridicule us for going to Africa, India, Australia, Papua New Guinea; but the people have been scattered to the four corners, and you err, not knowing the scriptures. How are you going to reach them if your aspirations are just down the street? Where would we be today if this truth never left the streets of Harlem and Brooklyn? Where a lot of these other camps are. 1 Corinthians 1:10 2:13:14 - Now I beseech you, brethren, that ye all speak the same thing, and that there be no divisions among you; but that ye be perfectly joined together in the same mind and in the same judgment. - The video before this was St. Louis: we went there because a brother, an officer, was shot. The brothers were of the same mind and the same spirit: they touched one of our own, so I have to be in the building to support. We have to be like that in everything; each congregation, including internationally, has to show up for one another, because it is going to take that level of dedication to move to the next level. 1 Thessalonians 5:12-13 2:15:03 - This is to the leaders, dealing with these different offices and administrations: you must know your men. Know them which labour among you: you have to pay attention to the spirits in your school, spot the different talents brothers have, and utilize them. You will have a soul in your school who has a gift, and if you as a leader are not utilizing them, that is what keeps you in the same spot. Sometimes you have all the answers there among you in the congregation. - And to esteem them very highly in love for their work's sake: understand the spirits, like the spirit of exhortation, and place them where they will build up other brothers. - Video played: a reaction to finding the IUIC channel on Roku. Because we came together and put our money where our faith is, the gospel is now on streaming platforms. What are you going to do when you see us on Netflix? I am not saying it is happening; I am just saying, what are you going to do? Job 8:7 2:23:31 - Though thy beginning was small, yet thy latter end should greatly increase. I joined in 2006; IUIC was not the most revered school, and the early YouTube page was not the grandest. Others covering conspiracies got far more views, but the content here changed my life: I understood this is what we need as a people. Look at us now; look at where this body has grown, because there were people that understood what was necessary for the nation. It took true vision and true dedication, and we did it together. This is not a one man show. - The booster club is genius: they wonder how we put boots on the ground all over the world. It is because we come together with the same mind. Though I cannot be there physically, here is some money so you all can get over there and make it happen. - Video played, the bishops on what makes this body different: at Israel United in Christ we are sincere about bringing the truth to the people; there is no ulterior motive to take advantage of people, and there is a sincere love for our people. Our people need the medicine that the Most High has in that Bible, and we need it too, so there is no room for trying to get over on our people or on each other. Other congregations have simply given up the fight and do not want anyone to show them up; that is where the hatred comes from. - Video continued: what separated this school was going into the law with precepts, not pushing things that are not there: not a six pointed star, not that you must learn Hebrew to be saved. Meanwhile our people are on drugs, killing each other; husbands do not know how to be husbands, wives do not know how to be wives, and the kids are out of order. The focus here was on the family, instilling morals, principles, and values, teaching men how to be brothers and how to be friends. When the Most High cast us out of his sight, we knew Hebrew and we knew who we were; the problem was that we were ungodly, so first we take responsibility for our actions, repent, and keep the law. - The separation was made long ago, and it was not us that did it; the Lord did it. We are just the ones that decided to do what he said. When the Lord said be ye separate, it means just that: this body is too important to be affiliated with any nonsense. Ephesians 4:15-16 2:30:45 - Speaking the truth in love, may grow up into him in all things, which is the head, even Christ. Christ is truly the head of this body. - From whom the whole body fitly joined together and compacted by that which every joint supplieth, maketh increase of the body unto the edifying of itself in love. We have been purposely put together; there are no coincidences here. You wonder how there are so many talented brothers here: because God has a plan. Hebrews 2:1 2:32:24 - Therefore we ought to give the more earnest heed to the things which we have heard, lest at any time we should let them slip. In Closing We have to move as one: not separately, not as individual entities, but one mind, one body. Look at what we have done, and think about what we are going to do. We are just getting started. All praise be to the Most High for this congregation. The bishops are up next. --- Class Notes Index Transcript: full session

title: SEEKING JUSTICE IN AN UNJUST SYSTEM
text: Introduction Thumbnail video: scenes of the Carmelo Anthony verdict, "rejected your claim of self-defense, and found you guilty of first degree murder in the death of Austin Metcalf; they have assessed your punishment at 35 years," followed by anti-immigration mobs chanting "get out, we don't want you here, this is our country," and the words: we have to act now; now is the time; we must fight or we die. Seeing what was going on this week, the teacher put this lesson together. Our people have been seeking justice not just for decades but for centuries, marching, "no justice, no peace," and we are seeking it from an unjust system. Let me tell you something: there will be no justice until Christ returns. Neither can we take it into our own hands and form a military to go fight for justice; we are not forming a justice league on this earth. When our King returns, there will be justice. But do not expect justice from this unjust system. In The News - The war has restarted in Iran. Trump was bombing Iran this week; Iran was bombing US bases and Israel. What I want you all to understand is the time we are living in: these are the last days, and it is going to get worse and worse, not just in America but all over Europe, all over the world. No matter where you run to, things are going to be bad. Oppression is about to be risen on our people, and it is my job to show you in the scriptures what is going to happen and help build you up so you could prepare for what is coming. - Shout out to Officer Zion from Jersey, the brother behind the recent thumbnails, holding it down for this class and for Captain Joel. Scriptures Opened Deuteronomy 28:15, 46, 68 20:08 - If we will not hearken unto the voice of the Lord our God, to observe to do all his commandments and his statutes, all these curses shall come upon us and overtake us. - And they shall be upon thee for a sign and for a wonder. A sign like a street sign or a restaurant sign: so you could identify who the Israelites are today. We identify who the Israelites are through these curses; that is our genetic marker. And a wonder: for us to wonder why these things keep happening to us. And upon thy seed for ever. - The Lord shall bring thee into Egypt again with ships. Egypt here means the house of oppression, the house of bondage. Definition read in class: Egypt, from the Hebrew Mizraim, means shut in, restraint, misery, tribulation, distress. This time on ships: cargo slave ships. The biggest one we know is the transatlantic slave trade of the 1600s, though it happened many times in history. - By the way whereof I spake unto thee, Thou shalt see it no more again: Moses is making it plain that he is not talking about ancient Egypt. - There ye shall be sold unto your enemies for bondmen and bondwomen, and no man shall buy you. Buy means redeem: no man shall redeem us. The only one that came that could redeem us is Christ. Deuteronomy 28:29 24:26 - Thou shalt grope at noonday, as the blind gropeth in darkness. At noonday the sun is high; you are supposed to see clearly. But our people are blind, groping into Christianity, into Islam, not even knowing who we are as a nation. We are asleep. - And thou shalt not prosper in thy ways. This does not mean we cannot prosper because of anything lacking in us. It means when we try and we do prosper, our enemies come and destroy it. Tulsa, Black Wall Street: we were prospering, and they came and bombed us and destroyed it. We had our own banks and they took that. The same system keeps our people impoverished in Africa: the IMF, destabilization, terrorists suddenly appearing all over the continent. Our enemies create conditions to keep us beneath them. - And thou shalt be only oppressed and spoiled evermore. There will always be injustice against us; we will never get justice until our King returns. For decades our people kept marching, "I am a man," "no justice, no peace," and the oppression never stopped. They use one thing to replace the next: after slavery came Jim Crow and the black codes; during civil rights came redlining and dividing the houses, getting the father out of the home; then crack was brought into the community; then the war on drugs. The oppression is always there. That rap music they push is oppression too: celebrities are paid to keep us in the midst of sin to keep their prisons full. Jeremiah 2:14 31:20 - Is Israel a servant? is he a homeborn slave? why is he spoiled? A homeborn slave is born in captivity; his mind is the mind of servitude and does not think about freedom. - Through history we have been in captivity after captivity: out of the Assyrian captivity, then the Babylonians had us in slavery, then the Persians and the Medes, then the Greeks enslaved us, then the Romans subjugated us, destroyed Jerusalem, and exiled us from the land, and we fled into Africa and other parts of the world. Then in the 1400s Britain, Spain, and Portugal came and enslaved us again. Every nation that rises up to rule this earth puts the children of Israel under subjugation. The difference with this last slavery: they destroyed who we are. Other nations enslaved us but never took our nationality; the white man took our nationality. Leviticus 26:17 34:23 - I will set my face against you, and ye shall be slain before your enemies: they that hate you shall reign over you. The people that hate us are the ones that taught us religion, set up the court system, set up the laws, and govern over us. If the people that hate you are ruling over you, can you get justice from those people? You are not going to get justice from the people that hate you. That is why we cannot find justice in an unjust system. - A clip was played: racism is built into the DNA of America. This system was built on racism; it was built on injustice. - Videos of hidden history were played, each a record of injustice that never saw justice, summarized here: the true story behind The Green Mile, George Stinney Jr., a 14 year old, 90 pound boy in Jim Crow South Carolina, convicted by an all white jury in ten minutes with no evidence and executed, his story later softened into a Hollywood fantasy; Mary Turner, a pregnant 21 year old lynched with her unborn child in Georgia in 1918 after a mob killing spree, with no one ever punished; Lena Baker, a black mother of three, the only woman executed in Georgia's electric chair, tried and sentenced within four hours in 1945 for defending herself against a violent white man, pardoned 60 years later in 2005; Recy Taylor, abducted and assaulted by seven white men in Alabama in 1944, whose confessed attackers were twice refused indictment by all white grand juries, receiving only a state apology in 2011; Emma and Lillie Mike, sisters aged six and four, lynched by a mob in Calhoun County, Georgia in 1884, with no arrest, charge, or conviction; the Wilmington, North Carolina massacre of 1898, an armed white mob that burned the black newspaper, killed scores of black residents, and overthrew the elected government in the only successful coup in American history, unpunished and called a race riot for a century; Sam Hose, burned before a cheering crowd of 2,000 in Georgia in 1899, part of over 4,000 documented lynchings between 1877 and 1950 that were advertised in advance and turned into postcards, with a federal anti-lynching bill failing 200 times before finally passing in 2022 and not one person ever prosecuted for a lynching; the Scottsboro Boys, nine black teenagers falsely accused in 1931, eight sentenced to death without evidence, collectively serving over 130 years for a crime they did not commit; and Ona Judge, who escaped enslavement in George Washington's own presidential house and outran his federal manhunt, dying free. - Tulsa: survivors of the Black Wall Street massacre described planes raining down bullets and homes set on fire. There has never been justice for these things. Never. But guess what? The most high God is going to bring forth justice. - They are trying to erase black history from the schools now, because they do not want white guilt. They do not want to hear about slavery or oppression anymore, because history shows what they did. Some of you say that was the past and it will not happen again. Let me tell you: the things I just showed you are going to happen again, and the fire has already been stoked. Remember what the scripture says: in her was found the blood of the saints. - Wilmington held a lesson: black people prospering, in government and voting, became a competition and a threat, so a white militia rose up and took the town. The same thing happens today: black politicians attain power, so they redraw the districts. Remember the verse: thou shalt not prosper in thy ways. Isaiah 30:12 1:09:22 - Because ye despise this word, and trust in oppression and perverseness, and stay thereon. Everything shown above is oppression, and yet our people still trust in that judicial system, still trust in the religions and systems that were set up in slavery. We trust in oppression. We think we are going to get justice from an unjust system. We have been marching for years, even last Monday, and nothing changed. All that changed is they made some of you millionaires and let some of you live in their neighborhoods. - A recent video was shown of a former North Carolina officer repeatedly punching a woman during an arrest. Why do they treat our people like that? Remember the scripture: they that hate you shall reign over you. Our life is worthless in their sight; that is why a child can be put to death or locked away for life. Deuteronomy 19:4-5 1:19:17 - This is the case of the slayer, which shall flee thither, that he may live: whoso killeth his neighbour ignorantly, whom he hated not in time past. Under God's law there were cities of refuge for the one who killed accidentally: what we call manslaughter. - The key is that you hated him not in time past: it was not premeditated. You got into a fight, you got jumped, you were defending yourself, and a life was lost that you never intended to take. Righteous judgment under God's law says the judgment for that should not be stiff; your life should not be taken away, because your intent was not to kill. - The Carmelo Anthony trial was followed in class, with an eyewitness account of the recording: he was under the tent minding his business, four came and surrounded him, an immediate attack, he tried to back out and get away, was grabbed and put in a headlock while the rest were still hitting, and in defending himself with a knife the other young man died. He was threatened; he was a small dude; he defended himself. Even so, a life was still lost, and the family of the young man that died is feeling it too; that is why you have to be careful with things like this. Leviticus 19:15 1:24:00 - Ye shall do no unrighteousness in judgment: thou shalt not respect the person of the poor, nor honour the person of the mighty: but in righteousness shalt thou judge thy neighbour. If the intent was not malice and it was not premeditated, the judgment should not be so stiff. Even five years, because a life was still lost; but 35 years for defending yourself is not righteous judgment. - Definition read in class: respect of persons refers to showing partiality or favoritism toward individuals based on external factors such as wealth, social status, or appearance. There was respect of persons in that verdict. People that did worse things were not given 35 years. There are images circulating of the father together with the judge; if you are friends with the judge and the jury is all white, is there partiality? The verdict was racially biased. But the Lord is behind all of that; God has a purpose behind everything he does. - A similar case from July 2025 in Midlothian, Texas was shown: a young black man attacked, outnumbered, spit on, called slurs and told a gun was present; in defending himself he injured the son of a sheriff's deputy, and he was the one charged with assault with a deadly weapon, his family harassed with death threats. - A pardoned January 6 rioter appeared outside the Carmelo Anthony trial calling for the young man to be lynched in front of the courthouse, and was arrested for terroristic threats. That is how a lot of Americans feel today, and the system is always for them. The father of Austin Metcalf was shown mocking the case with a racist nickname; from the heart of men proceed evil thoughts, and you can see why the son behaved as he did. There are reported threats against Carmelo Anthony in prison; if anything happens there will be riots, and that is exactly what the elites want, order out of chaos, so they can change the laws and bring you into subjection. Ecclesiastes 7:7 1:44:47 - Surely oppression maketh a wise man mad. When you see injustice, if you are a wise man it is going to make you angry. The teacher got up angry putting this lesson together. But when you get angry, what are you supposed to do? Use the wisdom of God to help your people come out of that oppression: go even harder to teach your people and show them what they have to do to change so these injustices stop. We are not joining any civil rights movement and marching with them; we show our people the solutions. - And we have to be honest about ourselves: the culture our people created here perpetuates violence, music about killing each other and selling drugs to each other, and you know who is behind that: it keeps the prisons full. Our people do not commit the most crime, but we are the only ones who glorify it. We have to change our people's minds and change the way they look at us. Isaiah 30:20-22 1:50:18 - Though the Lord give you the bread of adversity, and the water of affliction: the bread of adversity is this injustice, this unjust system, our people killed in the street, our brothers put in prison at a high rate, the school to prison pipeline. The water of affliction is the tears coming down from mothers' eyes. - Yet shall not thy teachers be removed into a corner any more, but thine eyes shall see thy teachers. When our people are afflicted, that is when the teachers have to rise up. That is how a wise man gets mad: he goes out and teaches when he sees the oppression of his people. Our job is not to hide when these things happen; we have to teach on it and show people why these things are happening: because you trust in oppression. - And thine ears shall hear a word behind thee, saying, This is the way, walk ye in it. We tell them: you are Israelites; keep God's commandments; come out of Christianity. God brings the affliction because that is the only time our people will listen. - When we do march, we march to bring awareness, because after every march we set up camp and teach. We are not marching for justice from this system, thinking this system will help us. - Ye shall defile also the covering of thy graven images of silver: our people will change and cast the idols away, but affliction comes first. Jeremiah 3:15 1:57:32 - And I will give you pastors according to mine heart, which shall feed you with knowledge and understanding: leaders and teachers after God's heart, who will tell you who you are and that you must keep God's commandments. Wisdom of Solomon 14:22 1:58:04 - They lived in the great war of ignorance, and those so great plagues called they peace. There is a war going on, and that war is to keep our people ignorant. What is a plague? Worshiping a god that does not look like you. You cannot say you are against white supremacy and racial injustice while you worship your oppressor's god. You support white supremacy when you go to church every Sunday and worship a white Jesus, because that religion was used to enslave and destroy you. What changed in that religion from the time of the Klan until now? Nothing. - Our people do not really want God's justice. When you talk about the kingdom and God's justice, they never ask about the other nations; they always ask, what about the white man? That is Stockholm syndrome. God's justice is a righteous judge's justice, and a lot of people have to answer in it. - The teacher sang the song: I have no white God; do not teach me anything wrong; how can a white God save me from white man oppression? It has been over 400 years praying to that God, and you are still living in oppression. Hosea 5:15 2:02:26 - I will go and return to my place, till they acknowledge their offence, and seek my face: in their affliction they will seek me early. God wants us to acknowledge our offense and come back to him. We are the children of Israel, the real children of Israel. - Things are about to get very bad all over this earth because our people do not want to turn to God; they are still worshiping a white Jesus, still in fake religions, still partying. So God is afflicting us, and how he is afflicting us is by turning the white man back into who he was in the 1800s and the 1940s and 50s. He is changing back into his real nature. 2 Esdras 7:18 2:04:38 - Nevertheless the righteous shall suffer strait things, and hope for wide. Strait things are hard things: the righteous of our people are going to suffer too. Some of us will be killed here in America for teaching the word of God, and we hope for the kingdom. - They that have done wickedly have suffered the strait things, and yet shall not see the wide: the unrighteous of our people will suffer the same affliction and still not get the kingdom. The affliction is going to be risen on Israel as a whole, all over the world, in Europe, in South America, on the northern kingdom too, because they hate all black people. Revelation 18:4, 13 2:06:48 - Come out of her, my people, that ye be not partakers of her sins, and that ye receive not of her plagues. The her is mystery Babylon the great. Her sins we should not partake in are her religion, her politics, her policies, her whole unjust system. - Who are God's people? The merchandise list ends with slaves, and souls of men. God's people are the slaves that were brought here, traded by the merchants of the earth. And souls of men: souls are sold here too; they sell you the American dream. Zephaniah 2:1-2 2:08:47 - Gather yourselves together, yea, gather together, O nation not desired. Coming out of her does not mean running from the country; it means separating yourself. And when we separate, we gather together. Gathering together is not just coming together on the Sabbath: it is establishing the kingdom, working together, getting things done on our own, creating farms. - They are moving to cut Medicaid and social security. Remember in the 50s our people had no medical care, and programs had to be set up to help our people; we will have to set up programs to facilitate our people. In my opinion we have maybe ten years or so before things get really bad; we are in the beginning of sorrows, but the end is not yet. So we have time to put things together, to become self sufficient and produce our own food. - As leaders, what we put together is mainly for the elderly, the young, the widows, and the fatherless. You young brothers and sisters that are working with money right now: you are supposed to be coming together and setting things up now, not waiting until the last minute, because in the end we will not be able to help millions of people. - A nation not desired means a hated people. You twelve tribes of Israel that are hated, gather together before the decree bring forth, before the Lord brings judgment on this earth. 2 Esdras 9:1-4 2:27:31 - Measure thou the time diligently in itself: and when thou seest part of the signs past, then shalt thou understand that it is the very same time wherein the Highest will begin to visit the world which he made. That is the time we are living in right now. - When there shall be seen earthquakes: there was an earthquake in the Philippines this week. And uproars of the people in the world: the white man is rising up all over Europe and all over America saying he does not want black people around him anymore. We are seeing uproars all over the earth, civil unrest, just as God said from the days that were before. - Videos were shown of what is stirring: a preacher overseas rejecting democracy outright and telling his children they must fight and resist because migrants have the same rights; crowds giving fascist salutes again; and riots in Belfast this week, where after a Sudanese asylum seeker was arrested and charged in a horrific attack, mobs went door to door hunting migrants, burning homes, buses, and shops, and beating any black person they saw on the street. The man arrested should go to jail and face charges, but they used it to show how much they hate black people. And one of the richest men on earth told white people plainly: you either fight back or you die. Our people are clueless to what is coming. - The last time these people turned into their real nature was World War II: over 80 million people died. This time it is going to be billions. After 1945 they had time to reflect, decided to change their image to the world, gave the slaves some rights, set up a system they called justice and equality, and opened their countries to the people they had colonized and oppressed. Decades later they are saying they should never have let any of them in. That is what you see happening in Europe and in America. Daniel 2:40-43 2:31:50 - The fourth kingdom shall be strong as iron. The image runs Babylon, Persia and Media, Greece, Rome; and America and Europe are the extension of Rome, the iron, the feet and toes. This fourth kingdom broke in pieces and bruised and subjugated all nations, just as Rome did. - The feet and toes, part of potters' clay and part of iron: the kingdom shall be divided. Europe is divided and America is divided, partly strong and partly broken, because the same people they colonized and destroyed, they brought to live among them. Trump is trying to fix the system, and Europe is trying to fix the system, but it is too late. - They shall mingle themselves with the seed of men: but they shall not cleave one to another, even as iron is not mixed with clay. The iron mingled itself with the seed of men after 1945: Britain opened itself to its colonies, and America opened after civil rights. But God says they will not cleave one to another. White people and everybody else are not going to get along. That is what you see going on in Europe and in America. Precepts: - Ecclesiasticus 12:10-11 Never trust thine enemy: for like as iron rusteth, so is his wickedness. Who is the iron? That fourth kingdom. In the 50s and the 1800s you understood who your enemy was. As iron rusts, the rust will always come back: even though he said we changed, we gave you civil rights, you see the wickedness coming back now. Though he humble himself, and go crouching, yet take good heed and beware of him, and thou shalt be unto him as if thou hadst wiped a lookingglass, and thou shalt know that his rust hath not been altogether wiped away. He did not change; he is the same person, and you are seeing it today. 2 Esdras 11:37-46 2:43:08 - A roaring lion chased out of the wood, sending a man's voice unto the eagle: the roaring lion is the spirit of Christ in the prophets, and the eagle is the fourth kingdom of Daniel 2. - Art not thou it that remainest of the four beasts, whom I made to reign in my world, that the end of their times might come through them? The end comes through them because they have created weapons that can destroy everybody on this earth, and they will use them on themselves. - The fourth came and overcame all the beasts that were past, and had power over the world with great fearfulness, and over all the compass of the earth with much wicked oppression. That is how this kingdom rules, dwelling in the seat acting like a righteous Christian nation. - For the earth hast thou not judged with truth. They say justice is blind; this kingdom does not judge with truth. It is not just America: Patrice Lumumba and Thomas Sankara were executed because they stood against this unjust system, and there has never been justice for that. Look at what is going on in Palestine, in Lebanon, in the Congo: who is bringing forth righteous judgment on the earth? - Thou hast afflicted the meek, thou hast hurt the peaceable, thou hast loved liars, and destroyed the dwellings of them that brought forth fruit, and hast cast down the walls of such as did thee no harm. God is describing this people. - Therefore is thy wrongful dealing come up unto the Highest: the Highest hath looked upon the proud times, and, behold, they are ended, and his abominations are fulfilled. And therefore appear thou no more, thou eagle. What is the symbol of America? Ecclesiasticus 16:22 2:48:25 - Who can declare the works of his justice? or who can endure them? A lot of you say you want justice, but you do not understand what God's justice is. You think because the murderers of the past died, that was it for them? God is bringing them back from the dead to judge them; that is Daniel 12. The covenant is afar off, and the trial of all things is in the end. In the end God is judging everybody for what they have done on this earth. Ecclesiasticus 40:12 2:51:05 - All bribery and injustice shall be blotted out. Every last injustice that was done to us, the Lord is going to deal with them concerning it. - You saw what happened the other day with the Epstein files: western leaders named, unspeakable crimes against children, victims crying to the court system to release the files, and no judgment. This is an unjust system. But even though there is no justice from this unjust system, the most high God is going to bring justice on them. In Closing Do not seek justice in an unjust system. There is no justice we are going to get here. Our justice we are going to get when Christ returns. With that, brothers, shalom. Lock it off, seal it off. Most High and Christ bless. Announcements & References Definitions read in class: Egypt (Mizraim: shut in, restraint, misery, tribulation, distress) and respect of persons (partiality or favoritism based on external factors). Names remembered from the history videos: George Stinney Jr., Mary Turner, Lena Baker, Recy Taylor, Emma and Lillie Mike, Sam Hose, Jesse Washington, the Scottsboro Boys, Ona Judge, the survivors of Black Wall Street in Tulsa, and the victims of the Wilmington 1898 massacre. The opening prayer asked the Lord for mercy and healing for the sick among us, including brother Gabriel, and strength to endure these last days. --- Class Notes Index Transcript: full session

title: Daily Bread for a Dying Man
text: Introduction Deacon Yashua teaches this Sabbath morning class. I was meditating on the movement that we have had recently. People leave all the time; people leave jobs; people quit life. So whenever I see movement, it does not faze me. But especially when certain people who appear like they are grounded and rooted leave, and you hear the reasons that they state for leaving, it starts making you think. I started to examine how it is that so many of us get to the point where we go off in our understanding. Today's class will also explain why some of us do not even grow. Every day, whether we realize it or not, there are two processes happening within you at the same time. From the day you are born, you are on a path to death: you peak, and then everything starts to break down. There is a daily decay that happens, not just physically but in this walk spiritually. The flesh does not stand still, the cares of this world are always pressing, temptations always rise, and sin is always deceptive. If you leave that alone, the natural man does not drift toward God; he drifts away from him. At the same time, if you are a repenting Israelite, there is a process of daily renewal in the spirit. A lot of us think we repented and we are done, but all these things constantly pressing you mean you have to counteract them. We understand the principles of nourishment: you eat every day, because if you do not eat, your body weakens. Likewise the scripture tells you that you need to feed yourself God's word daily to nourish your spirit. Many of us come to the Sabbath, treat it like church, get the classes, and then go a whole week starving the spirit. Then it is no wonder you get to a point where you fade, where you doubt, where you see things happen in the body and feel conflicted rather than seeing clearly. You would not eat once a week and think you can make it to the next week on that one meal, so why do you do it with the scripture? This is going to be a scripture heavy class. Scriptures Opened Deuteronomy 8:1-3 18:01 - The Most High always intended it this way from the beginning. Thou shalt remember all the way which the Lord thy God led thee these forty years in the wilderness. What happened physically to our forefathers in the wilderness was there as a witness for us, an example. It was not just something historical: there are so many details in the things that happened, and why they happened, that are examples for us to apply today. - The wilderness was to humble thee, and to prove thee, to know what was in thine heart, whether thou wouldest keep his commandments, or no. Much like we must do every day in this walk. - He humbled thee, and suffered thee to hunger, and fed thee with manna, which thou knewest not, that he might make thee know that man doth not live by bread only. But was not manna a form of bread? So what is he talking about? There is a spiritual element here. The manna represents something that was supposed to nourish us later: not the feeding of literal bread into your mouth every day, but to teach us that our nourishment is dependent on God. - Every word that proceedeth out of the mouth of the Lord provided instructions to survive the wilderness. That is why the whole adult generation had to die: they did not heed those words. Every word was designed to show how to survive the wilderness and to show our dependency on God. Where was our dependency prior to that? Egypt. That is why they kept complaining: in Egypt we had this, in Egypt we had that. This is not our rest. - What is being set up with the example of the manna is what we later understand was a foreshadowing of Christ. Christ comes in the volume of the book; Christ is everything, even in the little details of the examples. Matthew 4:4 22:25 - When you read Deuteronomy 8:3, this is what Christ was quoting to Satan in his temptation in the wilderness. Satan was tempting him because he was weakened and hungered from his fast. There is a lot going on here: it was not just to eat, but to not have God as his supply. Satan was going to be the thing that gave him ease in that moment, and Christ knew that was not it. He was setting an example for us to lean on the Most High in all these things. - What he is really telling you, and you read it much later, is that the flesh profiteth nothing; the words are what is real life. All the prophets understood this. If you read and study, they always spoke about consuming the word, eating the word: it tasted like this, it was in my belly like that, it strengthened me. God wants us to acknowledge dependence on him, and not just in general, but daily. Exodus 16:2-20 24:28 - The whole congregation murmured against Moses and Aaron: would to God we had died in Egypt, when we sat by the flesh pots and did eat bread to the full. They wanted to go back to Egypt for dependency on Egypt, not realizing how much greater a thing God had in store for his people. - I will rain bread from heaven for you; and the people shall go out and gather a certain rate every day. There was a portion for each day, and it was different for everyone: based on appetite, family size, your needs, because everybody needs a different level of nourishment. Some of us need more than others when it comes to the nourishment of the word of God. - That I may prove them, whether they will walk in my law, or no. Were they not keeping the Sabbath? What he is really talking about is whether they would stay on him daily, seeking him as the source and the supply. - At even ye shall eat flesh, and in the morning ye shall be filled with bread: quails in the evening, manna in the morning. And ye shall know that I am the Lord your God. - They said one to another, It is manna: for they wist not what it was. The word literally means, what is it? And Moses said, This is the bread which the Lord hath given you to eat. What they did not know yet in that moment, and what we need to understand, is that he was talking about Christ. The bread we were given to eat, the spiritual food from heaven, was talking about Christ. - Gather of it every man according to his eating: he that gathered much had nothing over, and he that gathered little had no lack. According to what was needed for nourishment and appetite. - Let no man leave of it till the morning. You were not supposed to store this. Some of them left of it until the morning, and it bred worms, and stank. If the bread represents the word of God, what it is really telling you is that yesterday's studies, yesterday's class, yesterday's nourishment for your spirit is not enough for the following day. Not that it has no value; it is not enough. You need to eat every day, and you need to be in the word every day. - The perfect scenario is you read your four chapters a day, you watch a class, you have it all set up. But life is not always thrown at us that way. You can listen to something; you can read a couple of verses at a bare minimum, and not just random verses. The things that are most heavy unto thee, seek them out in the scripture and meditate on them. Sometimes too many verses is not good; maybe what you lack is to focus on one or two verses that get you right on what you are dealing with. - The Bible talks extensively about bitterness and grudging, yet we still fall into it. That is how you know that somebody who says they are leaving because they are offended by somebody, and claims they will still keep God's laws, is not being honest. They left because they held a grudge and grew bitter against somebody, and then left. You have to be careful when feelings start coming up about people that are personal, and not about the sin they are doing. - I will be candid: I am not in it every day, and I feel it when I am not. It does not manifest like hunger or thirst, but it is your mind that starts to stray; it is your spirit that starts to look at things differently. The ones that are most seductive and subtle are the things that deal with emotions, what you feel about others, or the weariness you get in the mission. - Christ was saying in Matthew 4:4 that your spirit needs daily nourishment to survive the wilderness. And make no mistake, this is a wilderness. The Bible says we are pilgrims and strangers here; this is not our rest. This is a proving ground where we have grace, much like our forefathers had forty years of grace, to get it right. Ecclesiasticus 33:27 35:50 - Idleness teacheth much evil. A lot of times we look at this verse and talk about kids, or responsibilities in the body. But when you look at it individually, the idleness is that you are not feeding yourself with the scriptures every day; you are not doing something spiritual every day. The pull of the flesh will draw you in a direction where evil starts to creep in. - You cannot just have an awareness of these things and not nourish your spirit every day, knowing that your flesh is fighting every minute, every moment, to maintain and revive the old man. That is why you see the pattern with people who have been here for years. An unspotted life is gray hairs unto him: it does not matter how long you have been here; what has been your reputation while you have been among us? Matthew 6:11 37:16 - This is the Lord's prayer, and I wonder if anybody ever stopped to ask: why, in all of this, is he asking for food? Does anything else in the Lord's prayer pertain to food, or does the whole prayer pertain to the kingdom of heaven? It is not talking about the food that you eat. It is talking about the spiritual: God's word. Give us this day our daily bread is a reminder, in one of the foundational prayers, of the spiritual nourishment we should have every day. - When he says that, understand it is connected to the history we read in Deuteronomy 8 and Exodus 16. It would seem so out of course in the whole prayer to just ask for daily sustenance; it is all a reminder of the manna. 1 Corinthians 10:1-6 39:02 - Everybody tells you the Corinthians were Gentiles. If these were Gentiles, how is it that all our fathers were under the cloud and all passed through the sea in the wilderness? Reading is fundamental. Sometimes it is as simple as that. - They were all baptized unto Moses in the cloud and in the sea. The baptism is the receiving of the laws and the doing of the laws, in the faith of Christ. Moses did not dip the six hundred thousand men and all the rest into rivers; where was the water? The Lord had to provide water from a rock. - They did all eat the same spiritual meat, and did all drink the same spiritual drink: for they drank of that spiritual Rock that followed them, and that Rock was Christ. It is letting you know that the manna represents Christ. Everything that happened to them in the wilderness was the foreshadowing, the setup, to let them know of the dependency that we would need on Christ. - With many of them God was not well pleased, for they were overthrown in the wilderness. Was there some enemy that overthrew them? No: they were overthrown by their own lusts, their own desires of the carnal man that they did not subdue. - These things were our examples, to the intent we should not lust after evil things, as they also lusted. And how do you avoid lusting after those things? By feeding yourself with the word of God. - To summarize: Israel needed manna every day to survive the wilderness, and Christ compared that to needing the word of God. I am not saying simply read your Bible. The point is that spiritual life requires consistent, continual nourishment, just as physical life requires continual food. Those of you who think you are ten toes down: when Jacob's trouble magnifies itself, you are going to survive that with this diet? You need to be training all the time for that day. Be the warrior in the garden instead of a gardener in a war. There is a big difference between trials and tribulation; the scripture says we have not yet resisted unto blood. Precepts: - Ecclesiasticus 45:5 He made him to hear his voice, and brought him into the dark cloud, and gave him commandments before his face, even the law of life and knowledge, that he might teach Jacob his covenants, and Israel his judgments. The baptism unto Moses goes back to the commandments, because that represents Christ. Job 23:12 45:10 - The forefathers understood that this was food. I have esteemed the words of his mouth more than my necessary food: more than the food I have to eat so that I do not wither away. God's word is above that. You have got to want this word that much. Jeremiah 15:16 45:43 - Thy words were found, and I did eat them; and thy word was unto me the joy and rejoicing of mine heart. You would think that is random, but it all ties back to their foundational understanding of what we read in Deuteronomy and Exodus. Jeremiah understood this. Ezekiel 3:1-3 46:38 - The messenger tells Ezekiel: eat this roll, and go speak unto the house of Israel. The roll is the scrolls, the scriptures. Eat this, and then go speak; strengthen yourself first. The rest of Ezekiel gives the parallels: I made your forehead strong against theirs; they are stiffnecked and rebellious. You have to build yourself up in the spirit to be able to deal with our people. Remember, Moses wanted to die dealing with Israel. - Cause thy belly to eat, and fill thy bowels with this roll. With physical food you should be mindful of portions, but that is not the case with God's word. You can stuff yourself with God's word: it says fill thy bowels. - Then did I eat it; and it was in my mouth as honey for sweetness. When they describe the manna, they say it had a taste like honey. That is a subtle callback to understanding how the word is sweet in our mouth. Psalms 1:1-2 50:43 - Meditation is not something you do once in a while, and not only when you are dealing with something. Meditate means to think upon it, muse upon it, keep it with you. Do not just read it and check it off. - In verse 1 he walketh not in the counsel of the ungodly, he standeth not in the way of sinners, he sitteth not in the seat of the scornful. But verse 2 is how he accomplishes that: his delight is in the law of the Lord, and in his law doth he meditate day and night. Because of the way he is nourished in his spirit, he does not even want to sit among the ungodly. - Consider why murmurers feel comfortable coming to you. Quote read in class: "Don't tell me what they say about me. Tell me why they feel comfortable telling you." You have to question that and examine it. Why is somebody so comfortable coming to you with something you know in your spirit is not right to be spoken? If your delight is in the law of God, you will be instant in season with that correction the minute you hear evil. Joshua 1:8 53:23 - This book of the law shall not depart out of thy mouth: you are always going to keep it with you, never without it. But thou shalt meditate therein day and night. Day and night again: prophets separated by hundreds and thousands of years are on one mind and one accord, because they understood the message our forefathers received in the wilderness. That daily bread. - Then thou shalt make thy way prosperous. This is not talking about prosperity doctrine, sow your seed and you will have money. It is the prosperity in the scriptures, the promises. Remember Revelation says, I know thy poverty, but thou art rich. Then thou shalt have good success: then you will be like the man in Psalm 1. Psalms 119:97, 148 55:35 - Oh how love I thy law! it is my meditation all the day. When Galatians 5 says walk in the spirit and ye shall not fulfil the lust of the flesh, this is what he is talking about: your mind stayed on the word all the day. - You get a craving for some tacos and you know you cannot get them until after work: you think about those tacos all day. Where is that same zeal for the word of God? - Mine eyes prevent the night watches, that I might meditate in thy word. In other words, I stay up all night to consume your word. As a king, David had all his responsibilities during the day; he could not wait to get into his private chambers and get into the word, and sometimes he did not even sleep at night. - Some of us were like that in the beginning, when you first came in. And then, because you stopped nourishing yourself every day, you do not have that yearning anymore. And when it comes to the Bible, it is not the same food every day: you have prophecy, laws, examples, history, exhortation, adventure. It is a buffet; it is a cornucopia. Ecclesiasticus 6:37 59:53 - Let thy mind be upon the ordinances of the Lord, and meditate continually in his commandments: he shall establish thine heart. Your heart is your mind. If you do that, then you can say you have the mind of Christ. - And give thee wisdom at thine own desire: meaning, if you want it, I will feed you. If you are hungry, I will give it. But you have to be on it. That is why it says in Isaiah 34, seek ye out of the book of the Lord, and read. Romans 1:28 1:02:48 - They did not like to retain God in their knowledge. That is the retention: you are not on it day and night, so what eventually happens is God says, all right, now I am not going to give it. God gave them over to a reprobate mind: now everything is contrary to God, contrary to the commandments. - That is why it says a dog returns to his vomit. If there was ever a more proper similitude for what it is like to be in this truth and then go back to the things you put behind you, the things Romans said you were ashamed of, that is it. It becomes alluring for reasons you cannot understand from this side. Ecclesiasticus 39:1 1:03:23 - He that giveth his mind to the law of the Most High: you have to give it. That is what it means when it says lean not unto thine own understanding. And the way you give your mind to the Lord is the same way you thought about those tacos all day. - Ecclesiasticus 39, the first fourteen or fifteen verses, is the step by step on how you increase in wisdom and understanding: occupied in the meditation thereof, seeking out the wisdom of all the ancient, occupied in prophecies. You are always in the scripture. Galatians 5:17 1:06:33 - The Bible does not present men as spiritually neutral. You have to be cold or hot; if you are lukewarm, he will spue you out. The flesh is always pulling and the spirit is always fighting. - The flesh lusteth against the Spirit, and the Spirit against the flesh: and these are contrary the one to the other. There is always a pull against what you want to do. The spirit pulls you from the fleshly things, and the fleshly things pull you from the spiritual. We read that, we know it, and we do nothing about it, or not enough. This is what Paul is really talking about in Romans 7. Matthew 26:41 1:07:34 - Watch and pray, that ye enter not into temptation. He is giving you other words for Galatians 5:17: the spirit indeed is willing, but the flesh is weak. And we must embrace that. You know when you are hungry physically; some of you are just so accustomed to having food in your mouth. How come those same instincts do not move over to the scriptures? You will go from level one to level five in the best ways possible if you just apply what the Lord intended from the beginning. - The wilderness was an opportunity not just to hear the word, but to apply it and consume it. There is a didactic portion of learning, and then there is application. Definition read in class: didactic refers to the theoretical instruction of concepts through lectures, readings, or structured lessons; application is the hands on execution of those theories, testing knowledge through practical experience. Like an electrician or a plumber: you go through the books, but on the job you are an apprentice, then a journeyman. The same principles apply in this walk. Every time you go through the repetition, it reinforces, and the Most High establishes your mind, so that when the problem comes up, you are instant in season and out of season. Romans 8:5-6 1:10:45 - They that are after the flesh do mind the things of the flesh. Where your heart is, there will your treasure be also. But they that are after the Spirit mind the things of the Spirit. - To be carnally minded is death; but to be spiritually minded is life and peace. Notice it is not just life, it is peace. You know why some of you still have so much drama in your lives? Because you are not applying this. You have no peace because you are trying to seek peace in things that are not God. The Bible talks about God's perfect peace, the peace of God which passeth all understanding: it will overcome anything you are dealing with. If it does not seem to work for you, you are still not applying what you need to apply. Precepts: - Romans 6:21 What fruit had ye then in those things whereof ye are now ashamed? for the end of those things is death. The fruit of the things you now realize were sinful behavior ends in death. He is dealing with the carnality. - Isaiah 26:3 Captain's precept: thou wilt keep him in perfect peace, whose mind is stayed on thee, because he trusteth in thee. When we meditate day and night on the Lord, we build up our trust in him. That is what the second generation had to do in the wilderness that the first generation did not. - It is unbelievable, when you really think about it, how much goes back to your faith. If you are weak in spirit, your faith is weak too. If your faith is only strong when things are going your way, that is not faith at all. If it is only when things benefit you that you feel confident trusting God, then you do not trust in God. Ecclesiastes 9:3 1:14:33 - The heart of the sons of men is full of evil, and madness is in their heart while they live. If it is not of God, it is madness. There is something about being here in this flesh: if you feel the pressure driving you to frustration and anger, the scripture already told you pressure will do that. Do not act on it. - Knowing that this is the condition of our flesh, you have to acknowledge that we have a tendency to drift. It is what the body does; it is what carnal mindedness does. It does not always manifest as rebellion. Rebellion is the escalation, the next level: when you give in to the drift, that is when you go into rebellion, a willful way of saying, I know that is wrong, but I am going to do it. Psalms 106:13-14 1:16:22 - They soon forgat his works; they waited not for his counsel. It did not even take long. They lusted exceedingly in the wilderness. We hear lust and think sex, but what were they lusting for? The flesh pots, the leeks and the onions, everything Egypt provided. Despite the miracles, despite the deliverance from Egypt, they were willing to go back into captivity to have their bellies filled. - This is a meditation for you: our minds cannot fathom what those miracles looked like, because we did not witness them with our own eyes. They saw God's power firsthand in the wilderness, and they forgot. That is when God devised the manna: a spiritual message that they needed him daily. Hebrews 2:1 1:18:35 - We ought to give the more earnest heed to the things which we have heard, lest at any time we should let them slip. The margin says, let them run out as leaking vessels. There is always leakage if you do not refill. - To understand Hebrews you have to know what happened in the Old Testament; the audience was those who understood it already. Boats do not have to fight the current; they just stop rowing, and the current takes them. We just have to go with the program. Psalms 119:16, 93, 109, 176 1:20:13 - I will delight myself in thy statutes: I will not forget thy word. I will never forget thy precepts: for with them thou hast quickened me. They are spirit and they are life. - David is writing about it because he experiences that drift too. He is telling you, I deal with these things, but I do these other things that will not let me forget. - My soul is continually in my hand: yet do I not forget thy law. That is the retention. - Then the last verse of the psalm: I have gone astray like a lost sheep. Here is the acknowledgement. We know his sin, and he is letting you know how he got to it: that lack of daily nourishment, that lack of meditation. That is how any of us go from one point to the next. Hosea 4:6 1:22:30 - It was not just David: as a people, the whole northern kingdom forgot all that was established. My people are destroyed for lack of knowledge. How do you reject knowledge? By not consuming it daily. - If you have a school or a camp with a dead spirit, I guarantee you they are not consuming the word daily. You can look busy: camp, missions, all the programs. But if the individuals are not consuming this thing the way they need to, dead spirits. Of course they are dead; they are not eating. They are not feeding the spirit. Hebrews 10:20 1:24:43 - By a new and living way, which he hath consecrated for us, through the veil, that is to say, his flesh. Christ's flesh was like a veil to him. Our bodies are the same: the flesh conceals us from fully seeing anything spiritual clearly. Think of a wedding veil: it is see through, but not clearly. You can make out the outline of things. That is what it is like to be in this flesh. - So what understanding we do have must be treated that much more precious, and that makes it even more important that we nourish our spirits daily. Wisdom of Solomon 9:14-18 1:25:48 - The thoughts of mortal men are miserable, and our devices are but uncertain, because we are in this veil. The corruptible body presseth down the soul, and the earthy tabernacle weigheth down the mind that museth upon many things. Your mind is never void and blank; you are always meditating on something. That is why you have to direct your paths into the scriptures. - Hardly do we guess aright at things that are upon earth, and with labour do we find the things that are before us. Our understanding of the scriptures comes through great labor, through revelation; God gives the increase. And that labor is consuming it every day. - Thy counsel who hath known, except thou give wisdom, and send thy Holy Spirit from above? Just as the manna was sent from above, the spiritual meat. So the ways of them which lived on the earth were reformed, and men were taught the things that are pleasing unto thee, and were saved through wisdom. - This perfectly explains why understanding requires continual renewal. When you start drifting, verses like these are supposed to come to your head and anchor you. It starts with acknowledgement: a hard stop, then you assess and get precise about what scriptures you need to meditate on for what you are dealing with. Until you acknowledge that you are going off, you cannot prescribe what you need to fix it. This is what leads people to drift to the point of walking away. Psalms 73:26 1:29:25 - My flesh and my heart faileth: but God is the strength of my heart, and my portion for ever. Your flesh and your heart are going to fail, but God is the strength of the heart. Romans 7:23-24 1:29:52 - I see another law in my members, warring against the law of my mind. This is Galatians 5:17. The mind is where the soul resides, and the flesh is trying to fight the soul, to bring me into captivity to the law of sin which is in my members. - Anybody who pretends that this fight is not present in them is not going to be able to endure in this walk. You have to acknowledge what your vices are, what your members are; you have members for good and members for sin. You have to own those things. - O wretched man that I am! who shall deliver me from the body of this death? From the day you are born, you are heading toward death, and the only thing on the other side is the preservation of your soul, which only God can do. Fear him which is able to destroy both soul and body, versus men who can only destroy the body. 2 Corinthians 5:1-4 1:31:36 - The flesh is a veil; now we hear it is also an earthly house, a tabernacle, a place where your soul resides in this realm, this present world. We have a building of God, an house not made with hands, eternal in the heavens. - In this we groan, earnestly desiring to be clothed upon with our house which is from heaven. We have a real tabernacle waiting for our spirit where we do not have to fight it: no aches, no ailments, everything that comes with this body gone. All the things we groan over in the body, and the way it draws us and fights our spirit. It is like living with a spouse where you hate each other; that is what it is like to be in this body as your spirit grows in understanding, because before you understood this, you were quite comfortable in that relationship with your body. That is why it says mortify your members. - If so be that being clothed we shall not be found naked: right now we are without defense, which is why it says put on the whole armour of God. - Not for that we would be unclothed: it is not that we want to be without a tabernacle. It is just this one we do not want. But clothed upon, that mortality might be swallowed up of life. Romans 8:23 1:34:49 - We ourselves groan within ourselves, waiting for the adoption, to wit, the redemption of our body. The adoption is the redemption of our real body. No body that we have ever had here is your real body; that is not how you look. The perfection made without hands is waiting for you after Christ's return. - That is why it says bodily exercise profiteth little. There is profit in maintaining your vessel; it is the only one you have, like a car you could never replace, so you do the maintenance. But it is not going to lead you to salvation. We yearn to get out of the groaning. 1 Corinthians 13:12 1:36:23 - For now we see through a glass, darkly; but then face to face. We see through this veil: Christ's body was a veil, letting you know the flesh is a veil; this body is a tabernacle, and we groan in it, waiting for the redemption of our bodies. Once we have our real body, no more obstruction from the groanings of this physical body. - The only way you are going to have clarity in this body is if you feed your spirit every day, in some way, shape, or form: audio classes, a few verses even if the day was intense and you cannot do your four chapters. Four chapters is the standard, but if you cannot do that, still engage with God's word and feed your spirit. - The glass is like a mirror: it is hard to see your true inner man in this flesh, and the only way to have some clarity is to wipe that mirror clean by feeding yourself daily. Know ye not your own selves, that Jesus Christ is in you, except ye be reprobates? The way you become reprobate begins with not consuming the word every day. James 1:22-25 1:39:17 - Every time you open this Bible, if you really examine it, the reason a lot of you do not want to engage with the scriptures is because it shows you things about yourself that are uncomfortable for your flesh to see. Your spirit rejoices to find those things, because it knows it can change something. But there is an aversion, because you are more preoccupied with feeding your flesh. - Be ye doers of the word, and not hearers only, deceiving your own selves. You are just a hearer if you come on Saturday and do nothing to feed your spirit the rest of the week. Or every other day, or every four days. It is daily. - A hearer only is like a man beholding his natural face in a glass: he beholds his carnal self, goes his way, and straightway forgetteth what manner of man he was. He forgot the spiritual man, the inner man, and now he is out there naked, without the armor of God. - But whoso looketh into the perfect law of liberty, and continueth therein: that is the part we glaze over. Continueth therein is the daily. Class was fire, and then there is nothing else all week; you do not continue therein. He being not a forgetful hearer, but a doer of the work, this man shall be blessed in his deed. Remember Joshua 1:8: meditate, do not let it depart, and then thy ways will prosper. - The harmony of all the scriptures: different forefathers separated by years and spaces of time, and yet they all spoke on one accord. These scriptures are powerful. - On fasting: we often speak about fasting as denying your body basic sustenance, showing you the power to abstain from sin. Think about it in reverse: the hunger and thirst you feel when you fast is what is happening to your soul when you do not give it this word every day. When the headache comes, when you cannot think right, when it is blurry and hazy, that is how your soul feels when you deny it God's word. It is hungry, it is tired. - Definition read in class: neuroplasticity is the brain's lifelong capacity to adapt, reorganize, and rewire its physical structure and functional connections in response to learning and new experiences; connections between neurons strengthen or weaken depending on how often they are used. Science observed what God already had in place. The stuff you feed gets stronger, and the stuff you do not nourish gets weaker. Feed the flesh, the flesh stays strong; feed the spirit, the spirit gets strong and overcomes the flesh. There is a physical change in your brain when you start repenting, and you maintain it by nourishing it daily. - Significant rewiring requires constant, repetitive, and often difficult stimulation, which can become exhausting and difficult to maintain. When Paul said the flesh fights against the spirit, there is a literal process going on every day that makes it exhausting. That is why the scripture says lift up the hands which hang down, and the feeble knees, and be not weary in well doing. There will be days when you are tired, and everything is hard, and it is hard to pick up this book. That is when even more you have to press. Psalms 1:2 and Ecclesiasticus 14:20 1:52:53 - Video played in class: a teacher recalls learning martial arts, standing in one stance and repeating the same motion for months until, one day, a punch flew at his face out of nowhere and he blocked it without thinking. The discipline was built through boring repetition. The real issue, he says, is that you have not come to the point where you truly believe that if you do not consume this book and learn to pray, you are going to die. And you will. - You have to get to that point: if you do not consume this book every day, if you do not pray three times a day like we are supposed to, it has death. I am guilty sometimes of missing my noon prayer; that goes to show you how you drift. It is not enough to just show up; it is not enough to wear your fringes. It is never enough, none of it that we do, without the daily. - Blessed is the man that doth meditate good things in wisdom, and that reasoneth of holy things by his understanding. There is a reasoning that goes on in your head. That old trope of Satan on one shoulder and an angel on the other: that thing is real, and it happens in every interaction that you have. Wisdom of Solomon 6:12 1:53:59 - Wisdom is glorious, and never fadeth away: but only if you retain it. She is easily seen of them that love her: it becomes clear; the veil is not so obscure. And found of such as seek her: your desire has to be that you want it and need it. Romans 12:2 1:54:50 - Be not conformed to this world: conformed means you are only focused on the things of this world and you do not feed your spiritual man. But be ye transformed by the renewing of your mind: that is the transformation, every day that you give your mind the scriptures. Then in the moment when the punch comes, when you are not ready, you react instantly; you know how to deal with the situation. - That ye may prove what is that good, and acceptable, and perfect, will of God: we know what he wants, and you prove it by the transformation of your mind. - The fitness parallel: if you train consistently for six months, your body changes; if you stop for six months, it regresses. You do not expect one workout to last forever, so why do you expect one class, one feast day, one emotional moment to carry you indefinitely? Daily lust strengthens lust. Daily anger strengthens anger. Daily worldliness strengthens worldly things in you. But daily meditation strengthens godliness, daily study strengthens understanding, and daily prayer strengthens spiritual awareness. Prayer is the communing with the Lord. Hebrews 5:14 1:57:38 - Strong meat belongeth to them that are of full age, even those who by reason of use have their senses exercised to discern both good and evil. By reason of use: repeated practice, repeated exposure, repeated exercise. That is how the renewal works. Luke 9:23 1:58:25 - If any man will come after me, let him deny himself, and take up his cross daily, and follow me. There is that daily again. How do you do it? You deny the carnal man and you feed the spiritual man. 1 Corinthians 15:31 1:58:55 - I die daily. Paul is talking about that same daily: you starve the carnal man and feed the spiritual man. Precepts: - 1 Corinthians 9:27 I keep under my body, and bring it into subjection: that is the dying daily. Lest that by any means, when I have preached to others, I myself should be a castaway. Paul knew he would drift if he did not die daily and give life to the spiritual man daily. Romans 8:13 1:59:56 - If ye live after the flesh, ye shall die: but if ye through the Spirit do mortify the deeds of the body, ye shall live. And you cannot do that without constant connection to the scriptures. - A lot of you have issues, depression, sin, and you say I am battling. You are not battling anything; you do not even open your Bible every day. I am enduring. No, you are not. What are you enduring, the righteous spirit that is trying to tell you to do right? - I was meditating on why people bug out, why they leave, why somebody with good works and a good reputation moves to the left or to the right.
