They have taught their tongue to speak lies; there are some very good liars out there. - Ecclesiasticus 26:5-7 There be three things that mine heart feareth: the slander of a city, the gathering together of an unruly multitude, and a false accusation: all these are worse than death. Simon did all three: he slandered the city, gathered the Greeks together to get the money from Jerusalem, and falsely accused Onias. - Exodus 20:16 Thou shalt not bear false witness against thy neighbour. These are basic laws, but for some reason in the black community they are so difficult. - Proverbs 25:18 A man that beareth false witness against his neighbour is a maul, and a sword, and a sharp arrow. Because that man will get people hurt and get people killed. - Ecclesiasticus 7:13 Use not to make any manner of lie: for the custom thereof is not good. - James 4:1-3 From whence come wars and fightings among you? Ye lust, and have not: ye kill, and desire to have, and cannot obtain. Simon wanted the upper hand over Onias and couldn't get it. Ye have not, because ye ask not; and when ye ask and receive not, it is because ye ask amiss, that ye may consume it upon your lusts: a lustful purpose that is not for the benefit of the nation. - Matthew 5:21-22 Whosoever is angry with his brother without a cause shall be in danger of the judgment; the name calling continues the sin, and whosoever shall say, Thou fool, shall be in danger of hell fire. That is when God has to step in. - 1 John 3:15 Whosoever hateth his brother is a murderer. That is Simon. The domino effect: he coveted power, from there it turned to anger, from there to slander, and from there to murder. Holding on to anger is like drinking poison and expecting the other person to die; the only one affected is you. - There is always that one brother or sister that all the murmurers draw to, telling them all the things they don't like about people. Ask yourself: why do they feel so comfortable telling you? Story told in class: a deacon pointed at a sister and called her loose because of her high heels; the Bishop called the other deacons over, they saw nothing wrong with her, and he blew the brother's spot up in front of them. You cannot come to me with evil. We must train ourselves to hate evil. 2 Maccabees 4:4-6 1:11:55 - Onias, seeing the danger of this contention, and that Apollonius as governor of Coelosyria and Phenice did rage and increase Simon's malice, went to the king: not to be an accuser of his countrymen, but seeking the good of all, both public and private. He didn't even go there to accuse Simon. These are the characteristics of Onias III, a great and upstanding elder man. - For he saw that it was impossible that the state should continue quiet, and Simon leave his folly, unless the king did look thereunto. Blessed are the peacemakers, but peace does not always work with some people; some spirits are grimy, and at the end of the day they don't want peace with you. Precepts: - 1 Maccabees 11:21 Then certain ungodly persons, who hated their own people, went unto the king. You will always have certain ungodly men and women among us who hate their own people. Videos played in class of black commentators on the Carmelo Anthony verdict: one celebrated the guilty verdict and blamed the family for spending the defense fund; another said he was overjoyed there were no black people on the jury. Whatever happened to a jury of your peers? That is the same thing they did back then: an all-white jury, and a judge that allowed it, with connections to the other family. A video was also played of a woman calling black supremacy the most dangerous ideology and saying every race is tired of black people; the teaching point: where does black supremacy exist? She is not the only one who thinks like that, and there are even those calling themselves repented Israelites who think exactly like that. We had a bunch of them leave in 2018. - 1 Peter 2:1-2 Wherefore laying aside all malice, and all guile, and hypocrisies, and envies, and all evil speakings, as newborn babes, desire the sincere milk of the word, that ye may grow thereby. If you apply these two verses, everyone will see a substantial change in your life. But if you are the same grimy brother or sister from last year to the year before that, we know you have not been applying 1 Peter 2:1-2. - Matthew 5:9 Blessed are the peacemakers: for they shall be called the children of God. - Romans 12:18 If it be possible, as much as lieth in you, live peaceably with all men. That is: if it be possible. - Hebrews 12:14 Follow peace with all men, and holiness, without which no man shall see the Lord. - 2 Thessalonians 3:1-2 Pray that we may be delivered from unreasonable and wicked men: for all men have not faith. Some men you cannot reason with; there is no sitting down with two witnesses. There are Israelite camps like that: a brother said shalom to one of their men and got cursed out for it. They have no faith; they are teaching now that Moses is in a lake of fire and that John the Baptist was a wicked Israelite. Blasphemous doctrines, filled with hatred, and unreasonable. 2 Maccabees 4:7-17 1:31:04 - After the death of Seleucus, when Antiochus called Epiphanes took the kingdom, Jason the brother of Onias laboured underhand to be high priest. This is his own blood brother. Not only does Onias have to deal with Simon of the tribe of Benjamin; his own blood brother is trying to take the priesthood from him. Put yourself in his sandals: his good friend Simon turned on him, and now his brother. - Jason promised the king by intercession three hundred and threescore talents of silver, and of another revenue fourscore talents. That is called bribery. And the priesthood goes through bloodline. Sometimes it is not good enough for a brother to be the support brother; Jason said, I think I can do a better job, plus have access to all that money. You got to look at a man's motives. - Beside this, he promised to assign an hundred and fifty more, if he might have licence to set him up a place for exercise, and for the training up of youth in the fashions of the heathen. He convinced the king: I can get these Israelites to join your Olympics and become Hellenized. Onias wasn't rolling like that, but his brother said, I'll be the one to do it. - When he had gotten the rule into his hand, he forthwith brought his own nation to the Greekish fashion; he put down the governments which were according to the law and brought up new customs against the law; he built gladly a place of exercise, brought the chief young men under his subjection, and made them wear a hat: the hat of Hermes, shown in class alongside the discus statue. Such was the height of Greek fashions and increase of heathenish manners, through the exceeding profaneness of Jason, that ungodly wretch, and no high priest. Though he had the rule, the writer says he is not the true high priest. - The priests had no courage to serve any more at the altar, but despising the temple and neglecting the sacrifices, hastened to be partakers of the unlawful allowance in the place of exercise, after the game of Discus called them forth; not setting by the honours of their fathers, but liking the glory of the Grecians best of all. We see that same thing today: our people love white society more than their own forefathers. Go to the colleges; they love Greek society greater than anything else on the planet, and some of them will come against you for pointing out the injustice. - By reason whereof sore calamity came upon them: for they had them to be their enemies and avengers, whose custom they followed so earnestly, and unto whom they desired to be like in all things. Imagine: at one time they were our enemies; now we go to them as our avengers. All you men that teach on the street must know this history; this is what Paul was constantly referencing when he says there is neither Jew nor Greek. - For it is not a light thing to do wickedly against the laws of God. Sometimes we take the laws of the Most High for granted with the mentality, I can sin and God won't do nothing. Precepts: - Ecclesiasticus 7:4-5 Seek not of the Lord preeminence, neither of the king the seat of honour. The priesthood fell to Onias III; that was his lot. His brother said, I want it; I should have it. - 2 Timothy 2:5 If a man also strive for masteries, yet is he not crowned, except he strive lawfully. You want to be an officer, a captain, a deacon; you are not crowned except you strive lawfully. Story told in class: a brother who kept failing the officer of 50 test got a copy of the answers and disseminated it. You might think it is just cheating. No: officers of 50 counsel people. Now a brother who could not pass it is counseling marriages, and he is not qualified for that rank yet. Counsel must be accurate, on point, and scriptural, not from your heart. - 2 Timothy 4:8 Henceforth there is laid up for me a crown of righteousness, which the Lord, the righteous judge, shall give me at that day. - 2 Esdras 2:43-47 In the midst of them there was a young man of a high stature, taller than all the rest, and upon every one of their heads he set crowns. Christ is a young man; he was crucified at 33, so art department, don't make him look old. And taller than all the rest means by feet, not inches. These be they that have put off the mortal clothing, and put on the immortal, and have confessed the name of God; it is the Son of God, whom they have confessed in the world, that crowneth them and giveth them palms. - Amos 5:12 For I know your manifold transgressions and your mighty sins: they afflict the just, they take a bribe, and they turn aside the poor in the gate from their right. - Ecclesiasticus 40:12 All bribery and injustice shall be blotted out: but true dealing shall endure for ever. The Most High deals with bribes. - 1 Corinthians 12:1-2 Ye know that ye were Gentiles, carried away unto these dumb idols, even as ye were led. That goes back to what we just read: this is when we became Greek citizens and worshiped idols. Everything Paul writes is referenced in the histories; Paul didn't just make stuff up. Where can we find it? In the book of Maccabees, which Esau conveniently took out, so our people in Christianity are lost and confused. - 2 Esdras 9:9-12 Then shall they be in pitiful case, which now have abused my ways, and they that have cast them away despitefully shall dwell in torments. For such as in their life have received benefits, and have not known me, and they that have loathed my law, while they had yet liberty, and when as yet place of repentance was open unto them, understood not, but despised it; the same must know it after death by pain. Discussed in class: a commentator who said he is not oppressed because he makes ten million dollars a year; that is a benefit received while not knowing God. He once posted Revelation 3:9 with no commentary, got attacked for it, and quickly deleted it. Who says when you die you don't get punished? Nobody escapes. 2 Maccabees 4:23-38 1:49:37 - Three years afterward Jason sent Menelaus, the aforesaid Simon's brother, to bear the money unto the king. Remember Simon of the tribe of Benjamin: his brother is Menelaus. But he, being brought to the presence of the king, magnified him for the glorious appearance of his power, and got the priesthood to himself, offering more than Jason by three hundred talents of silver. He came bringing nothing worthy the high priesthood, but having the fury of a cruel tyrant and the rage of a savage beast. - Then Jason, who had undermined his own brother, being undermined by another, was compelled to flee into the country of the Ammonites. Now the high priest is of the tribe of Benjamin. You cannot make this stuff up. - Menelaus, supposing that he had gotten a convenient time, stole certain vessels of gold out of the temple, gave some of them to Andronicus, and sold some into Tyrus and the cities round about. When Onias knew of a surety, he reproved him, and withdrew himself into a sanctuary at Daphne, by Antiochia; the map was shown in class of where Onias had to flee. - Wherefore Menelaus, taking Andronicus apart, prayed him to get Onias into his hands; who, coming to Onias in deceit, gave him his right hand with oaths; and though he were suspected by him, yet persuaded he him to come forth of the sanctuary: whom forthwith he shut up without regard of justice. He killed Onias III, the real high priest. - Not only the Jews, but many also of other nations, took great indignation, and were much grieved for the unjust murder of the man, because Onias had a good report even among the other nations. The king was heartily sorry, and moved to pity, and wept, because of the sober and modest behaviour of him that was dead; and being kindled with anger, he took away Andronicus his purple, rent off his clothes, led him through the whole city unto that very place where he had committed impiety against Onias, and there slew he the cursed murderer. Thus the Lord rewarded him his punishment, as he had deserved. Precepts: - Job 34:11 For the work of a man shall he render unto him, and cause every man to find according to his ways. However you deal in this earth with your brother and your neighbor, it is going to come back on you. - Colossians 3:25 He that doeth wrong shall receive for the wrong which he hath done: and there is no respect of persons. The world calls it karma; the Bible says you shall receive for the wrong you have done. - Galatians 6:7 Be not deceived; God is not mocked: for whatsoever a man soweth, that shall he also reap. If you decide to undermine the brother next to you or do deceitful stuff to your sister, it is going to come back to you. It might not be this year; it might be next year, but it is going to come. - Ecclesiasticus 28:7-15 Remember the commandments, and bear no malice to thy neighbour; remember the covenant of the Highest, and wink at ignorance. Sometimes brothers and sisters do something simple; wink at it. It does not always have to be a counsel for small matters. Abstain from strife, and thou shalt diminish thy sins. If thou blow the spark, it shall burn: if thou spit upon it, it shall be quenched: and both these come out of thy mouth. A backbiting tongue hath disquieted many, and driven them from nation to nation: we just read that Onias had to flee from Jerusalem to Syria. It hath pulled down strong cities, and overthrown the houses of great men. - 1 Timothy 3:7 Moreover he must have a good report of them which are without. Onias had a good report among the Jews and the other nations, and he was not trying to join with the other nations. Without means outside the truth: you must have a good report outside this truth. - 1 Thessalonians 4:12 That ye may walk honestly toward them that are without, and that ye may have lack of nothing. You can't be outside this school robbing, stealing, lying, using drugs, whatever little secret things you have going on. Why lack of nothing? Because people are going to look out for you in the world: this is a good brother, a good sister right here. - Colossians 4:5 Walk in wisdom toward them that are without, redeeming the time. Be aware of the time you are in. - 1 Peter 2:12 Having your conversation honest among the Gentiles: that, whereas they speak against you as evildoers, they may by your good works, which they shall behold, glorify God in the day of visitation. Our people living like Gentiles will repent based on your conduct out there in the world. 2 Maccabees 5:1-14 2:03:57 - Through all the city, for the space almost of forty days, there were seen horsemen running in the air, in cloth of gold, and armed with lances; and every man prayed that the apparition might turn to good. - When there was gone forth a false rumour, as though Antiochus had been dead, Jason took at the least a thousand men and suddenly made an assault upon the city, and Menelaus fled into the castle. Now Menelaus is running from his one-time friend Jason, whose priesthood he took. But Jason slew his own citizens without mercy, thinking they had been his enemies, and not his countrymen, because he despised his own people. - Howbeit for all this he obtained not the principality, but at the last received shame for the reward of his treason, and fled again into the country of the Ammonites. You think you can be a traitor and be honored and respected? Nobody likes a traitor; even in Rise of the Planet of the Apes, they spray painted the word donkey on the traitor apes. That is the brothers that left in 2018 and the brothers that just bugged out in LA. You cannot be trusted. - In the end therefore he had an unhappy return: accused before Aretas the king of the Arabians, fleeing from city to city, pursued of all men, hated as a forsaker of the laws, and being had in abomination as an open enemy of his country and countrymen, he was cast out into Egypt. Thus he that had driven many out of their country perished in a strange land, retired to the Lacedemonians (that is Sparta); and he that had cast out many unburied had none to mourn for him, nor any solemn funerals at all, nor sepulchre with his fathers. All that evil he did came back on him. - When these doings came to the king's ear, he thought that Judea had revolted; he took the city by force of arms, and there were destroyed within the space of three whole days fourscore thousand, whereof forty thousand were slain in the conflict, and no fewer sold than slain. - Yet was he not content with this, but presumed to go into the most holy temple of all the world; Menelaus, that traitor to the laws, and to his own country, being his guide. An Israelite guided Esau on what to do. And besides Menelaus, the governors he left were worse than all the rest, bearing a heavy hand over the citizens, having a malicious mind against his countrymen the Jews. That is why to this day they look for those who will be harder on us than Esau, because they have something to prove. - Apollonius, pretending peace, forbare till the holy day of the Sabbath, and taking the Jews keeping holy day, commanded his men to arm themselves, and slew all them that were gone to the celebrating of the Sabbath. But Judas Maccabeus with nine others withdrew himself into the wilderness, and lived in the mountains after the manner of beasts, and fed on herbs continually, lest they should be partakers of the pollution. Precepts: - Matthew 18:6 It were better for him that a millstone were hanged about his neck, and that he were drowned in the depth of the sea. - Matthew 26:24 Woe unto that man by whom the Son of man is betrayed! it had been good for that man if he had not been born. That is what the scripture says about the betrayer. 2 Maccabees 13:3-8 2:18:38 - You don't find out what happened to Menelaus until chapter 13. Menelaus joined himself with them, and with great dissimulation encouraged Antiochus, not for the safeguard of the country, but because he thought to have been made ruler. If I can't be high priest again, I'll be governor. - But the King of kings moved Antiochus's mind against this wicked wretch: one day you are friends, and the Most High says, no, that is not your friend. Lysias informed the king that this man was the cause of all mischief, so the king commanded to bring him unto Berea and to put him to death: a tower of fifty cubits high, full of ashes, into which men thrust whosoever was condemned of sacrilege. - Such a death it happened that wicked man to die, not having so much as burial in the earth; and that most justly: for inasmuch as he had committed many sins about the altar, whose fire and ashes were holy, he received his death in ashes. He got his just reward. 2 Corinthians 13:5 2:21:00 - Examine yourselves, whether ye be in the faith; prove your own selves. Today's class is about self-examination, for all of us. What we read pertains to us even today, because there are men and women with those same hateful attributes. - We had one brother just leave saying Captain Abiel kept putting too much pressure on him. What do you mean pressure? He is forcing me to go out and teach and do God's work, forcing me to be accountable. Spirits like that: just leave. Nobody is going to cry over spilled milk. Precepts: - Ecclesiasticus 18:20 Before judgment examine thyself, and in the day of visitation thou shalt find mercy. Matthew 22:34-40 2:22:19 - Thou shalt love the Lord thy God with all thy heart, and with all thy soul, and with all thy mind: this is the first and great commandment. The ten commandments were read in class: the first four deal with that one. - And the second is like unto it: thou shalt love thy neighbour as thyself. Commandments five through ten deal with loving your neighbor as yourself. And remember, thou shalt not covet, although it is number ten, is where all the others start: coveting is an internal thing within you and me. - On these two commandments hang all the law and the prophets. What we read in Maccabees today pertains to those two great commandments. In Closing Notice: nothing we read today had anything to do with lust for women. That was not these men's problem. A brother came to the mic and answered: covetousness. What kind? Wanting to be the top dog. Power. Some men covet power and authority; everybody does not have your demon. What we read today dealt with covetousness and lust for power and authority, hatred, betrayal, a traitor, lies, theft, and murder. Why did these things occur? Because of covetousness: men wanting certain seats of authority. Christians never discuss or examine themselves when it comes to these sins. Examine yourselves. The class closed with a music video (shout out to Judah Blood) asking whether people ever get tired of a faith where you keep no laws but keep sinning, where the pastor teaches lies but you keep listening. Announcements & References Books referenced in class: - Who's Who in the Bible: the Old Testament and the Apocrypha, and the New Testament (two volumes in one, by Joan Comay and Ronald Brownrigg): once mandatory for all the men - The Zondervan Compact Bible Dictionary: also required - The Complete Works of Flavius Josephus (deeper history; a few errors, since Josephus was a slave to Rome) Field reports played: - IUIC Milwaukee hit the Puerto Rican festival with one message: Ephraim, it is time to wake up. A young man interviewed said he never knew Hispanics were Israelites and that he came in upset and left calm. - IUIC New York headquarters taught at the Puerto Rican Festival in the Bronx, their second year at the event; a brother took off his cross as a fruit of repentance. Also the 152nd Street Cultural Festival in the Bronx, with literature and the Holy Bible. - IUIC New Jersey completed their first community cleanup of the year in Newark: nine blocks, applying Judith 8:24, letting their light shine one block at a time. - IUIC St. Louis annual park day: family fun and nation building. - Pentecost 2026 in Austin with Bishop Kenai: the feast of weeks of Deuteronomy 16:16, a day of deliverance. We have days of deliverance, yet our people would rather celebrate days of oppression. - IUIC Sacramento celebrated the marriage of the house of Officer Eliakim: marriage is honorable in all. Music and media: - Subscribe to IUIC TV ($1.99 a month): movies, music videos, and more. Support our own network. - Subscribe to IUIC Diaspora 2.0: the kingdom awaits, twelve tribes. - Deacon Isaac's album Eternal Glory arrives July 12th: kingdom-focused music glorifying our Lord and Savior. - The Royal Range collection is coming soon at originalroyalty.com: genuine Nappa leather, premium cotton denim, suede fringes with the border on top. - Israel Live Top Five: scan the QR code to vote for next week's episode, Mondays at 9:00 pm. Dates: the upcoming fast day begins June 26th at sundown. The new moon is June 30th, sundown to sundown. IUIC is calling a worldwide prayer vigil on July 4th, as Babylon the Great marks its 250th anniversary, praying for mercy on the Israelites scattered abroad and for the judgment of our enemies. Closing reading: 1 Corinthians 11:23-29, the bread and the cup, the same night in which he was betrayed; let a man examine himself. --- Class Notes Index Transcript: full session

title: Satan's Kiss To Your Demise
text: Introduction Satan's kiss to your demise. When you see that title, you got to pay attention, because the kiss can come as a gift; it can come as opportunity. That is the whole point of this class: Satan uses these devices to appear good, to appear like something righteous, but it ends up ultimately being something evil. And within our lust and the things that we deal with, we will pursue those things, because sin feels good. Remember the clip out of Vampire in Brooklyn: evil is good. The objective of this class is to understand how sin rarely presents itself as destruction. Instead, it presents itself as opportunity, pleasure, love, comfort, success, escape, and validation. All of those things sound great, but you have to be in the spirit to discern if it is in righteousness or if it is Satan's kiss to you. And you have to be in the scriptures to understand how to discern those things. Scriptures Opened 1 Peter 5:8 5:56 - Be sober, be vigilant; because your adversary the devil, as a roaring lion, walketh about, seeking whom he may devour. We might read that and think, he is coming at me as a roaring lion; I am going to see it. No. You have to stay vigilant and pay attention, because the kiss can come as a gift, as an opportunity. James 1:12-15 8:32 - Blessed is the man that endureth temptation. Why? Because everything in the world right now is against the person that is trying to be righteous. Everything is based off keeping us in the midst of sin and wickedness. The way your work schedule is set up has you in the midst of sin on the weekend; the holidays you want off are based off wickedness. All of these things are against us. So you have to be around righteous individuals, other people that are going to hold you accountable. - For when he is tried, he shall receive the crown of life, which the Lord hath promised to them that love him. You are going to be tried. - Let no man say when he is tempted, I am tempted of God. God is not tempting you. It is your own lust that is within you that is tempting you; Satan using those devices is what is tempting you. - But every man is tempted, when he is drawn away of his own lust, and enticed. That means there is some attraction there, something that makes us gravitate toward certain elements in us that cause us to sin. It seduces us: it looks like it is right for us, but it is not. The only way you are going to see if it is good for you or not is by filtering it through the scriptures. - Then when lust hath conceived, it bringeth forth sin. Temptation begins internally; that lust is in you. When temptation presents itself, you begin to get drawn to it, sin starts enticing you, and it grows through agreement: you get enticed by it, then you agree with it. - And sin, when it is finished, bringeth forth death. It becomes action; that sin is the action you take after you have been enticed by your lust. And it always ends in destruction. That is why we have to be on point. Precepts: - Ecclesiasticus 2:1-5 My son, if thou come to serve the Lord, prepare thy soul for temptation. You are going to be tempted by Satan; he is going to use devices to tempt you. Set thy heart aright: get your mind right, get yourself together, because this is not going to be a fair fight. And constantly endure: you have to constantly endure these temptations, because you have things in you that you need to purge off, and some of these things keep coming back. That is why Paul in Romans 7 asked the Lord to take the thorn away, and the Lord said no, this is what you are going to have to battle. But on the flip side, dealing with those battles is what keeps us going in this truth: always trying to get better with our life, how we communicate, how we deal in relationships, how we deal with one another. Make not haste in time of trouble: things are going to happen and you cannot fold up; you have to fight. Everybody is not going to make it victorious. Whatsoever is brought upon thee take cheerfully, and be patient when thou art changed to a low estate: for gold is tried in the fire. You are going to be tried, so make sure you are on point. - 1 Timothy 4:1 In the latter times some shall depart from the faith, giving heed to seducing spirits. A seducing spirit looks like it is good for you, but it is going to destroy you; like drugs: that crack feels real good, but you are not able to see around you, and your whole life is being destroyed. That is why it is important to be studying, reading your four chapters, being around godly men and godly women, so somebody can have your back. Proverbs 14:12 16:28 - There is a way which seemeth right unto a man. In our mind we think it is the right thing: this sounds real good. But the end thereof are the ways of death: at the end is death and destruction, because you have no discernment of what is going on. - Every time you counsel with yourself, you are going to be 100 percent right every time. You are always going to be right in your own mind. Ecclesiasticus 6:2 17:06 - Extol not thyself in the counsel of thine own heart. Do not big up your own counsel. In your mind you are always going to think that you are 100 percent right. This is why we say get counsel. And a lot of you hate counsel, or you will appear like you want counsel: you sit down and do all the things you are supposed to do when it comes to counsel, but in your mind you have already made your mind up. Then when it goes wrong, you come back and want us to fix the mistake you made after we told you not to make it. It happens all the time, because in your mind you think you know it all. - One of those mistakes is the one you cannot do anything about. We told you: do not mess with that brother, he is not ready, let him come and learn. But they already made their mind up. Then they lay with the person, then they marry the person, and now they want you to make that person right, when we told you about that person from the beginning. - Understand what counsel is. Our job is to reason with the scriptures on how to deal with certain things, to give you advice based off scripture and experience on a way to maneuver in your situation. Our job is not to make the decision for you. It is up to you to apply what is being said. So when you make your decision, that is on you. That is what counsel is for. - A lot of you think your feelings are your spiritual guidance. Feelings are not a spiritual guide. Your feelings will get you jacked up. Nobody really cares what you think; it is about what the Bible is saying. That is why Bishop always says, I do not listen to myself. Your thoughts, your emotions, your intuition will destroy you. You have to be in the word. Jeremiah 17:9-11 21:38 - The heart is deceitful above all things. Your mind is deceitful; it will deceive you, just like we pulled in James. You think what you are thinking is right: I know me, I understand me, they do not understand me, I know what I have been through. And it is desperately wicked: who can know it? You do not even know it. It is dangerous. You do not understand the danger zones you are in by going and deciding for yourself without counsel. - I the Lord search the heart, I try the reins, even to give every man according to his ways, and according to the fruit of his doings. - As the partridge sitteth on eggs, and hatcheth them not; so he that getteth riches, and not by right, shall leave them in the midst of his days, and at his end shall be a fool. Precepts: - Jeremiah 17:5-8 He shall be like the heath in the desert, and shall not see when good cometh. But blessed is the man that trusteth in the Lord. That is the man who gets counsel, who reads the Bible and applies the commandments. The Lord set up men to guide us. But our people hate guidance. When they see you, it is low self-esteem: they see themselves in you, so they think, I am not anything, so I know he is not anything. That goes back to what was done to us in slavery. Ecclesiasticus 18:30-31 24:11 - Go not after thy lusts, but refrain thyself from thine appetite. Lust is not just temptation; it is an appetite. That lust is a buildup of things you deal with, and it becomes an appetite that wants more and more and more. And what it does is multiply: it goes into different things. A sexual appetite might go to gambling; it transfers. It is like you can never get enough if you do not check it. But the Most High demands restraint: do not indulge in it. - If thou givest thy soul to the desires that please her, she will make thee a laughingstock to thine enemies that malign thee. A lot of people be mad after they did the sin. Especially when you get put out and you come back: you think everybody is looking at you and your sin. Nobody is thinking about what you did; that was a long time ago. You are still guilty because you have not forgiven yourself yet, and Satan has your mind messed up, so you think everybody is thinking something evil about you. See how Satan will start putting things in your head based off the things you deal with. Ecclesiasticus 23:5-6 26:40 - Turn away from me vain hopes and concupiscence. Definition read in class: concupiscent describes a feeling of intense, powerful desire. It is strong. - Video shown in class: a man in a public place, pretending to tie his shoe, committed a lewd act against an unsuspecting woman at a counter. A man that cannot control himself in public like that will do all manner of wickedness, because he cannot control that lust; that appetite was so strong he did not care about cameras, jail, or consequences. That is a lot of you with pornography, and a lot of you out and about at work or at the store, wanting to see if you still got it, talking to women, enticing that spirit. - What he is doing openly has likely been done to him behind closed doors since he was young; those spirits do not just pop up out of nowhere. That is why you have to watch your kids and really be able to trust the people that are around your kids, because you never know what demon is on these people, no matter how righteous they may appear. - Let not the greediness of the belly, nor lust of the flesh, take hold of me. This is the prayer: do not let my lustful appetite overtake me and destroy me. That is how we have to pray, honestly, with supplication, because we know what we deal with. - Satan comes in secrecy, when you are by yourself. When you are at the Sabbath, you are cool; everybody is watching, so there is no room to do anything wicked. But when you leave, that lust that is internal starts to mess with your mind, because now you are not around people that will hold you accountable. Romans 6:12-16 31:38 - Let not sin therefore reign in your mortal body. The scripture says do not let sin control you, have that dominion over you. - Neither yield ye your members as instruments of unrighteousness unto sin: but yield yourselves unto God. The body that God gave us is used as an instrument to serve God. The life God gave you is not your own; you cannot just do what you want to do with the body. This is supposed to be a temple, a holy thing. - Know ye not, that to whom ye yield yourselves servants to obey, his servants ye are to whom ye obey; whether of sin unto death, or of obedience unto righteousness. Whatever you decide to do, you become that servant. As long as you are serving sin, you are serving sin unto death; that is the road you are heading down. Luke 18:8 40:06 - It is going to get so bad. Christ is closing the parable about prayer, because of how badly the enemy is going to be treating us. Nevertheless when the Son of man cometh, shall he find faith on the earth? Shall he find believers? Sin is going to be so rampant in the earth, taking people over. It is going to get to the point where people just start grabbing people. - That is why we are here to push the laws and the faith of Christ, because that is what is going to get us through it. If you do not have the law and that faith, you are not going to get through it. 2 Corinthians 11:13-14 42:38 - For such are false apostles, deceitful workers, transforming themselves into the apostles of Christ. Some people around you are going to seem good but be evil, with no good intentions whatsoever for you. A lot of these pastors are deceitful workers: they say they are apostles of Christ, but they carry the most allegations of infidelity, abuse of the young people in their congregations, and embezzlement, taking your money. A lot of the people you look at with high regard are the biggest phonies. - And no marvel; for Satan himself is transformed into an angel of light. Satan is not going to appear to you as evil, because you would see it and know it. He comes to you as good opportunity, as things you might think are a healthy relationship, as harmless fun, or just business, or just a friendship, but it can all be wrapped up in evil. - And it is not just pastors. It can be your auntie, your mama, your daddy, the family member that raised you, that cooks the good food; you love her, she can do no wrong, but she can be a demon in reality. You have lived your whole life with these people, and that is why you have problems in this truth letting go of people that harm you spiritually. Genesis 3:1-6 46:05 - What happened with Eve? What ultimately messed us all up? This fruit is idolatry. A lot of our people indulge in idolatry; we have a lot of different idols. Be honest: we are a spiritual people, and if you read throughout history we always try to find something to believe in, instead of what we were supposed to believe in: keeping the commandments and having faith in the Lord and his son. Same way in Egypt, same way now in America. Everything seems better on the other side; we live in a grass is greener society. But we have not seen any fruits of any of it. There are no fruits in Christianity, no fruits in Islam, no fruits in Buddhism, no fruits in Judaism, none of this religion stuff at all. It looks good and it sounds good, but when you read the Bible as it is written, people get offended. - And the serpent said unto the woman, Ye shall not surely die. You see that? Satan has enticed this woman: nothing is going to happen to you, you are good, what I am presenting to you is good. - And when the woman saw that the tree was good for food, and that it was pleasant to the eyes, and a tree to be desired to make one wise: she saw it, she was visibly attracted to that doctrine, that idolatry, and she was enticed by it. She thought it was good for her. She took of the fruit thereof, and did eat, and gave also unto her husband with her; and he did eat. He indulged in the idolatry too. - You see the power of the woman to be able to convince a man. That is why, for a lot of you men leaving the truth, a spiritual wife is the last line of defense to speak sense into her husband. That is where the help meet comes in: help your husband. Instead, a lot let the pillow talk pull the man the wrong way. Marriage reveals where your allegiance is. - The pattern of sin: it comes with attraction, then justification. You justify in your mind why you want to do it: it is one time, it will not hurt anybody. Then you take action, and the consequence happens. The man who commits adultery does not think about the consequences of losing everything he built in his marriage, splitting his family, seeing his children once a month instead of every day. You ruined a good thing because you could not keep yourself together. Wisdom of Solomon 2:21-24 53:49 - Such things they did imagine, and were deceived: for their own wickedness hath blinded them. Stuff that you have in your mind, you get deceived by; you think you are right. And you can interchange wickedness with appetite: their own lust, their own desires have blinded them, so they cannot see anything else. That man in that public place was blinded by his lust, and he is not the only one. - As for the mysteries of God, they knew them not: they were not in the scriptures. Neither hoped they for the wages of righteousness. The wages of sin is death, so the wages of righteousness is life. But you did not consider that when your mind was messed up. You did not count the cost. - For God created man to be immortal, and made him to be an image of his own eternity. Think about how important we are: the Lord created us to be righteous, to be here forever, in his image. - Nevertheless through envy of the devil came death into the world. Through the devil, your appetite, your lust, came death, which is sin. Sin brought that thing in here; that is why we die today. It happened in Genesis. - It is a setup, and it is your decisions: most of the problems in your life are decisions, dumb decisions that you made. The Most High gives you his spirit so you can discern through decisions and prosper, but we get overtaken in our faults. Once desire leads, reasoning follows desire. Sin blinds judgment. Proverbs 7:1-5 57:24 - My son, keep my words, and lay up my commandments with thee. Keep my commandments, and live; and my law as the apple of thine eye. Say unto wisdom, Thou art my sister; and call understanding thy kinswoman: that they may keep thee from the strange woman, from the stranger which flattereth with her words. - We have to tighten up in our marriages. As men, it is up to you to fix the problems in your marriage. Sometimes the wife is the problem; but it is not always that. Sometimes you are the problem, and your wife has been trying to speak out about it while you mask it so you can continue the evil you are doing. You have to step up and fix the things in your marriage. It is not the leadership's job to fix your marriage; it is yours. Use the scripture to fix your marriage. - Why does the scripture say keep the commandments close, like a sister, like kin? Because they keep you from the strange woman: she is unpredictable, and she flattereth with her words. You do not get words of affirmation from your wife; she does not love on you. But the first woman out and about that compliments you, you are done: oh, I still got it. That demon knows exactly what you are lacking, exactly the words and the triggers that set off your lust. You better be paying attention. Proverbs 7:6-27 1:00:33 - I discerned among the youths, a young man void of understanding. He does not see the signs; he is spiritually young and cannot discern certain things. - And, behold, there met him a woman with the attire of an harlot, and subtil of heart. She is dressed with everything you like on display, but there is deceit behind it. Definition read in class: subtil of heart is a poetic phrase describing someone who is cunning, deceitful, or harboring hidden motives under a gentle exterior. Satan knows what you desire, knows the things that you like, so he puts that in front of you. This is a temptation, and you have an avenue to move away from it. - I have decked my bed with coverings of tapestry, with carved works, with fine linen of Egypt. I have perfumed my bed with myrrh, aloes, and cinnamon. The silk sheets, the perfume; she looks good and smells good. That does not mean it is not destruction. - Come, let us take our fill of love until the morning. And you are living in a sexless marriage, and this woman says let us make love all night. He is going to be taken. You have decisions to make, and you have to make them on a dime. A lot fail in this decision-making process. And you have time: the Lord gives you clues, that little spiritual check that says, I should not be doing this. That is the Lord telling you. - Hearken unto me now therefore, O ye children. Let not thine heart decline to her ways, go not astray in her paths. Keep the commandments; keep it simple. Do not let Satan use the appetite in you to fulfill that hunger. - For she hath cast down many wounded: yea, many strong men have been slain by her. A lot of men and women out there are wounded, and to a wounded person everything that appears good looks good. They have been down for so long, they are weak; that is when Satan comes in. 1 Esdras 4:13-14 1:06:37 - This was Zorobabel, in the contest to reason out what is the strongest thing we deal with. O ye men, it is not the great king, nor the multitude of men, neither is it wine, that excelleth; who is it then that ruleth them, or hath the lordship over them? are they not women? Precepts: - 1 Esdras 4:26-27 Yea, many there be that have run out of their wits for women, and become servants for their sakes. Many also have perished, have erred, and sinned, for women. Men have died behind the woman. We had a brother whose wife was jumping out of a moving car; we told him, you are tripping, she does not believe, and he said, I cannot leave. You can be enticed by many different things if you cannot help yourself, willing to go through years of demise and despair. And vice versa: a lot of you sisters will follow after a man when we told you, sis, he is not right; he is tall, dark, and handsome, but he is a demon. We warned you. When you decide to lay down with that man and it does not go the way you want, it is not on the counsel to fix it; you made him your lord, and now the counsel cannot come in and dictate his house against the law of marriage. Our job is to use the scriptures to give wise counsel, not to change somebody's rules in their own household. Everything in America is dictated on the aspect of the woman. Men will do much evil to get attraction from women: the way they dress, the jewels, the car, the money; all of that is to entice a woman, and it is deceitful. Ecclesiasticus 21:2 1:16:20 - Flee from sin as from the face of a serpent. You have to get away from that thing. You do not negotiate with temptation; you flee immediately. If it seems wrong, get away from it. If you have any doubt about the judgment you are about to commit, leave it alone; that means something is not right with it. - Satan does not force sin. He might suggest it, wrap it up in something else, beautify it, rationalize it; but ultimately you have to agree with it. So do not let Satan give you that kiss on the cheek. It is not always good. 1 Corinthians 7:3-4 1:18:06 - Somebody might think this class is justifying a man stepping out. No. This is how you defend your home. Let the husband render unto the wife due benevolence: and likewise also the wife unto the husband. The wife hath not power of her own body, but the husband: and likewise also the husband hath not power of his own body, but the wife. - The scriptures say due benevolence. There are cases on both sides, but this is particularly toward the women here: do not starve your marriage, because you create that void, and the next thing you know a work husband comes in place. It brings other levels of sin, and that level of sin can go anywhere. Judges 16:4-7 1:19:58 - And the lords of the Philistines came up unto her, and said unto her, Entice him, and see wherein his great strength lieth. It was a setup the whole time. Other men told a woman to go in and entice this man. In his mind Samson is thinking, I love this woman, I can trust her; but at the same time he is being played. - And Delilah said to Samson, Tell me, I pray thee, wherein thy great strength lieth. Why do you need to know that? That is a setup. He was so gone he was not even paying attention to it. - Samson gave in; she cut the locks while he slept, and it was a done deal. You see how it goes today: people will do all types of wickedness to their own spouse. The woman can manipulate you into certain things if you are not spiritually sound. Do not let anybody manipulate you; be mindful of the wiles of the devil. - Samson's downfall was compromise: emotional attachment, physical relationship, and he ignored all the warning signs. That is what gets us caught up. Ecclesiasticus 9:8 1:23:45 - Turn away thine eye from a beautiful woman, and look not upon another's beauty; for many have been deceived by the beauty of a woman. Just like it said in 1 Esdras 4: many have erred behind a woman. Do not be lustful after her because she looks good, because things start going into your mind. - There are women that are fine, with the body, all dainty, and blessed with a full-fledged demon. Be careful with that. The Bible is telling you to beware; the Lord is saying, I know what I created, and I know what is powerful. Some of you brothers are weak; do not be deceived by it. 2 Samuel 11:2-5 1:25:54 - David arose from off his bed, walked upon the roof of the king's house, and from the roof he saw a woman washing herself; and the woman was very beautiful to look upon. He saw her and sent to inquire after the woman: I have power, let me send some people over there. - And one said, Is not this Bathsheba, the daughter of Eliam, the wife of Uriah the Hittite? Somebody with a spiritual mind made it clear: this is somebody's wife. And David sent messengers, and took her anyway. Wisdom and understanding were right there, and he ignored them. - And she came in unto him, and he lay with her. She was not right either: she did not resist, she was not opposed; she thought she came up. And the woman conceived, and sent and told David, and said, I am with child. - You see how Satan can deceive you. Satan put that lust in him to where he just did not care, and he went the extra mile: later in the story he put Uriah in the front of the battle and got him killed, then took the wife. What he saw became desire, desire became action, he tried to cover it up, and the consequences came: the child died. Precepts: - Ecclesiasticus 47:1 And after him rose up Nathan to prophesy in the time of David. So we know who this is speaking of. - Ecclesiasticus 47:11 The Lord took away his sins, and exalted his horn for ever: he gave him a covenant of kings, and a throne of glory in Israel. The Lord forgave David; he loved David, and David messed up badly. A lot of times we are going to fall and do things that are not comely according to the scriptures. That does not mean you bunker down into a fetal position and say woe is me. You get yourself together, you repent, and you move forward. What did Christ say? Go, and sin no more. You pick up the pieces and keep moving. We are all going to make mistakes; it is how you handle the mistake. Matthew 26:14-16 1:30:17 - Then one of the twelve, called Judas Iscariot, went unto the chief priests, and said unto them, What will ye give me, and I will deliver him unto you? Imagine that: somebody around you willing to give you up, lie, steal, and cheat for money. We had a whole Israelite camp back in the day break up because of money. - And what do you see now? Certain brothers get pushed on every platform, and it is not the bishops and deacons that are really out here teaching the word of God; they push the lesser out there and try to make them the face of the Israelites. You do not think money is involved in that? This is war, and people will give you up for money. It runs through history: the Black Panther Party, Martin Luther King, Malcolm X. If you are weak in spirit, betrayal comes with money. - This man walked with Christ. He saw the healing, he was around the commandment keeping; but that money lust is never enough. He desired money and riches more than anything. And they covenanted with him for thirty pieces of silver. And from that time he sought opportunity to betray him. Ultimately Judas betrayed Lord Jesus Christ. Precepts: - Ecclesiasticus 31:5-8 He that loveth gold shall not be justified, and he that followeth corruption shall have enough thereof. Gold hath been the ruin of many, and their destruction was present. Sometimes money is your ruin: you stop making sound decisions, you are willing to do anything for it. That is why you see these young women degrading themselves on these platforms for money; what morals do you have, and then you go home and kiss your kids? It is a stumblingblock unto them that sacrifice unto it. If money is all you think about and all you talk about, if your existence is based off money, then that is your god; you made a sacrifice to it. But blessed is the rich that is found without blemish, and hath not gone after gold. Why? Because it is hard to have riches and keep the commandments; with money you can be enticed so many ways, because you can do whatever you want. But when you are without blemish, you use those finances properly and it does not mess with your head. You have a lot of money, but you have not made it your god. - Wisdom of Solomon 1:12 Seek not death in the error of your life: and pull not upon yourselves destruction with the works of your own hands. When you put that sin above everything, that is what you are seeking: death. Money can be your destruction. Women can be your destruction. Food, alcohol, drugs can be your destruction. That is the appetite in us that we constantly want to feed, and we have to stop it. Genesis 39:1-9 1:37:44 - This is the example of what to do when you are in the confined space, when your back is against the wall. Joseph had everything in his favor: the Lord was with him, his master saw the Lord made all he did prosper, and he was made overseer over the house. - And it came to pass after these things, that his master's wife cast her eyes upon Joseph; and she said, Lie with me. Satan had to come in: it is too good in here, you got promoted, the Lord is with you; I have to test you now. - But he refused. He said, my master has trusted me with everything in this house, and he has kept back nothing from me but thee, because thou art his wife. You are off limits. Joseph is reasoning; he is painting the picture: the Lord gave me favor to be in this position. - How then can I do this great wickedness, and sin against God? This is a person that immediately resisted the devil. He did not have to think; that lets you know the scripture was always in his mind. Easy decision, no negotiation, no emotional engagement whatsoever. And you know Pharaoh's officer's wife was attractive; Joseph did not care about any of that. - The modern day Satan kisses are today's traps, and the pattern holds through all the examples: Eve engaged, rationalized, and fell into idolatry. Samson was compromised and lost his strength. David looked, acted on it, and brought judgment on his family. Judas chased money and destroyed himself; money was his demise. Joseph fled immediately, and the Lord promoted him with blessings. Sometimes you pray, Lord take this away from me, and then immediately you get put in a situation to prove yourself on the very thing you asked him to take away. Recognize the test when it comes. 1 Corinthians 6:18 1:45:14 - Today's traps: the thirst traps. Flee fornication. Get away from it. Every sin that a man doeth is without the body; but he that committeth fornication sinneth against his own body. Once you go outside of Christ, you are sinning against your own self; you put yourself in that predicament. Precepts: - Proverbs 6:25-26 Lust not after her beauty in thine heart; neither let her take thee with her eyelids. For by means of a whorish woman a man is brought to a piece of bread. A lot of us are weak to the woman. The eyelashes are there for a reason; that dainty look is designed to take you. Do not let it take you over. And the adulteress will hunt for the precious life. Matthew 5:28 1:47:25 - Pornography and private sin. Whosoever looketh on a woman to lust after her hath committed adultery with her already in his heart. A lot of you brothers and sisters be doing that: scrolling until something catches your eye, then down the rabbit hole, not caring about any consequences, fully convinced and convicted in your sin. Precepts: - Job 31:1-2 I made a covenant with mine eyes; why then should I think upon a maid? How do you fix it? You have to control what you view. You have to control what you desire. Seeing a beautiful woman does not mean you should think lustfully about her. Especially you married men: you should have a covenant with your eyes with your wife. 1 Corinthians 10:13-14 1:49:37 - Addiction. There hath no temptation taken you but such as is common to man: but God is faithful, who will not suffer you to be tempted above that ye are able. All these temptations you go through, the Lord still gives you enough strength not to be overtaken; he always gives a way to escape, that ye may be able to bear it. But it is up to you. Sometimes we are weak in the faith: you do not read your four chapters a day, your conversation is not about the scriptures, you are not around the brothers. Satan gets a hold of you. - Temptation always comes with an exit. Addiction forms when we stop taking the exit. You have to flee from those things. - Wherefore, my dearly beloved, flee from idolatry. Why is idolatry the word here? Because you idolize these temptations. That appetite, the lust within you, becomes an idol to you: you idolize that demon inside of you and you feed it, and it is never enough. Precepts: - Ecclesiasticus 14:20-21 Blessed is the man that doth meditate good things in wisdom, and that reasoneth of holy things by his understanding. When we do not study, we have nothing in our spirits to combat Satan; we are defenseless. Even Christ, when he was tempted, used the word of God: is it not written? When you meditate good things, you can reason in the scriptures: wait, the scripture says this; I cannot do that. When you go before the magistrates, think not what ye shall say; but you have to have something in your spirit for the Lord to work with. If you have no scriptures about lust in your head, where are you going to pull from? Give the Holy Spirit something to work with. When Joseph was tempted, he referred straight back to the law: I would be sinning against God. That was what came to his mind first, because his mind was always on the scriptures. Proverbs 16:18 1:55:55 - Pride. Pride goeth before destruction, and an haughty spirit before a fall. You think you know it all, you think you have all the wisdom and understanding; but pride is the progenitor of your destruction, because pride removes correction. You do not want to hear it. Pride isolates you, and pride precedes the collapse. Precepts: - Ecclesiasticus 10:12-13 The beginning of pride is when one departeth from God, and his heart is turned away from his Maker. For pride is the beginning of sin: it is the beginning of you falling to your temptation, falling to your lust, falling to feed that appetite; because you knew better, you had all the warning signs, you were given a way out as we read in 1 Corinthians 10, but pride overcame you and your mind was not on the Lord when your back was against the wall. And he that hath it shall pour out abomination: and therefore the Lord brought upon them strange calamities. When that pride overtakes you, the Lord adds to your demise and leaves you to Satan, because your mind is not right. - Wisdom of Solomon 1:3 For froward thoughts separate from God. Being froward means you are thinking outside of the Bible. When your mind is not on the Lord, you are separated from him; you cannot be both. - Ecclesiasticus 25:1-2 In three things I was beautified, and stood up beautiful both before God and men: the unity of brethren, the love of neighbours, a man and a wife that agree together. Why is that last one beautiful? Because it is hard for two different personalities to come together and be on one accord. Marriage takes time, brothers and sisters; it takes years and experience. But three sorts of men my soul hateth, and I am greatly offended at their life: a poor man that is proud, a rich man that is a liar, and an old adulterer that doateth. A poor man that is proud has no humility whatsoever: nobody can tell him anything, he has all the answers and no fruits in his life. That is how much the Lord hates pride. 1 Timothy 6:10 2:02:44 - Money. For the love of money is the root of all evil. Why is money the root? Because money brings all those other elements you deal with to the surface. With money comes attention, power, respect, desirability; that is what people desire in America, rather than to be viewed with righteousness: this is a good brother, he is loyal, he reasons with you with the scriptures, he gives good and wise counsel. That is what you want to be remembered as. But a lot of you have made money your god. - Which while some coveted after, they have erred from the faith. And a lot of you women in marriages covet other people's marriages based on what they have. You see somebody else with a big house and feel your marriage is inadequate; they got a new car, they go on trips, why are we not doing that? But what are you doing to fix the things in your own marriage? You do not know what they have been through: they may have struggled fifteen or twenty years before any financial establishment came into that relationship. You see the here and now, not the hardships and the pain on the way. You think the grass is greener, and you do not know what happens in that house at night. When you desire what another man is doing in his house, you are coveting, breaking the ten commandments. Precepts: - Proverbs 14:1 Every wise woman buildeth her house: but the foolish plucketh it down with her hands. Instead of watching what that other husband is doing, study that wise woman. Go ask her: what are you doing? Why is he so happy? Every time you ask for something, he gives it; what is the secret? She has a mind to what is going on in her house: these are the things I need to fix to make my household better, this is how I assist my husband. That is the desire of Genesis: she shall desire her husband. That means studying him: you know what he likes, his dislikes, when to leave him be, and when to come speak. But pride, sister, will keep you from doing it. You think he is supposed to give you everything first before you do what you do as a wife; that is not what you are in the marriage for. You do your job, and that man does his job. And if reciprocation only flows one way, you might be the reason your marriage is the way it is. Proverbs 29:25 2:17:28 - Social media and validation. The fear of man bringeth a snare: but whoso putteth his trust in the Lord shall be safe. Social media can be a trap, a snare, a device to keep our mind off the Lord. It is not just our children; it is us as adults. It takes time away from studying, from good conversation with your wife, from your children, while you are always on your phone. And the content is engineered filth; the more you are consumed with social media, the more desensitized you are to the evil going on in the world. - Video played in class, from tech industry insiders: everything you do online is being watched and tracked; every action is monitored and recorded. There are entire teams of engineers whose job is to use your psychology against you; one speaker was the co-inventor of the Facebook like button. What you type in builds the algorithm toward you: they know how you think and how you move, and what pops up is not chance, it is made up for you. You say, I was just talking about that and it popped up; no, they have you. And what does it all go back to? Sex, money, power: sin. Your social media is not there to make things convenient for you; it is out to destroy you, and you do not even see it. Proverbs 6:27-29 2:25:57 - The work husband, the work deception. This usually happens with a sexless marriage, or when a spouse is not doing what the other needs, so there is a void. You go to work eight hours a day around other people. Brothers in those warehouses, be careful: these young women are predators; they are aggressive, and they know when you are not happy at home. And vice versa: they know when the women are not happy. We also have to watch it in the body: work husbands and work wives in the same office, in the same kitchen, developing those close relationships. - It starts small: you smell good today. Thank you. And the seed is planted. Over months the compliments get bolder, the talks get longer, now you are texting each other. And you start to justify it: they understand me, they understand what I am going through, we just talk at work, they listen more than my spouse does. Harmless joking, playing, hitting each other; the next thing you know it is full adultery. Frequent conversation, emotional comfort, private communication, keeping a secret, complaining about your spouse to somebody else: that emotional dependency is the trap. Leave that stuff alone. - This goes back to Satan transformed into an angel of light: it looks like this person is just diligent in their office, just occupied in the work, and all of a sudden they care so much about your corner. The devil is in the details. Pay attention. - Can a man take fire in his bosom, and his clothes not be burned? Can one go upon hot coals, and his feet not be burned? So he that goeth in to his neighbour's wife; whosoever toucheth her shall not be innocent. You put fire that close to you, you are going to get burned. The Bible has everything in it to fix us; but when you are not in the Bible reading it, the Bible becomes an enemy: am I therefore become your enemy, because I tell you the truth? Galatians 6:7-8 2:27:41 - Be not deceived; God is not mocked: for whatsoever a man soweth, that shall he also reap. When you put in the sin, the consequences are going to happen. For he that soweth to his flesh shall of the flesh reap corruption: you will be judged by it. But he that soweth to the Spirit shall of the Spirit reap life everlasting: when you sow yourself into the scriptures, the Lord gives blessings, favor, mercy, and abundance. Precepts: - Joshua 1:8 This book of the law shall not depart out of thy mouth; but thou shalt meditate therein day and night, that thou mayest observe to do according to all that is written therein: for then thou shalt make thy way prosperous. When we meditate on the scriptures day and night and do them, the Lord makes our way prosperous and gives the increase we desire, spiritually and emotionally, when we put our mind on the Lord. - Romans 6:23 For the wages of sin is death; but the gift of God is eternal life through Jesus Christ our Lord. What you put in, you are going to receive as a reward. - Deuteronomy 30:19 I call heaven and earth to record this day against you, that I have set before you life and death, blessing and cursing: therefore choose life, that both thou and thy seed may live. - Joshua 24:15 Choose you this day whom ye will serve. You cannot serve two masters. You cannot serve the flesh and serve God at the same time; you have to choose, and there is no in between. That is why he said, I would thou wert cold or hot: if you are lukewarm, battling that middle ground and playing games, I will spue thee out of my mouth. But as for me and my house, we will serve the Lord. In Closing Satan's kiss comes wrapped as opportunity, pleasure, love, comfort, success, escape, and validation. Temptation begins internally, grows through agreement, becomes action, and ends in destruction; and the whole class is the counter: be sober and vigilant, prepare your soul for temptation, get counsel instead of the counsel of your own heart, flee from sin as from the face of a serpent, make a covenant with your eyes, and meditate on the word day and night so the Holy Spirit has something to pull from when your back is against the wall. There was more prepared than time allowed; look for a part two. Choose you this day whom ye will serve: as for me and my house, we will serve the Lord. And with that, shalom. --- Class Notes Index Transcript: full session

title: THE BOTTLE, THE BATTLE, AND THE BIBLE
text: Introduction Thumbnail video: "I'm just not good enough. God ain't with me. There's no point in even trying." Captain Gad teaching from the West Coast. Today's topic is going to be a topic that a lot of brothers and sisters don't really want to go over. Being here on what they call the rest coast, I'm hearing a lot of brothers saying they deal with low self-esteem, depression, anxiety. And a lot of times what they are doing, they are using alcohol as a coping mechanism. Instead of dealing with those issues, they turn to the bottle. So today's class we are going over the bottle, the battle, and the Bible. The bottle: the coping mechanism. Alcoholism, addiction, escapism. The battle: the underlying struggle. Depression, shame, failure, hopelessness, trauma, sin, spiritual warfare. The Bible: the solution and source. Hope, truth, healing, transformation. All praise to the Most High for the hope and healing program; you brothers who know you deal with alcoholism need to be in that program. I wanted to go over Juneteenth, but Juneteenth makes no sense. What is a black holiday when black people are still being murdered? What is a black holiday when babies are being murdered, and brothers are being thrown in prison for self-defense? You say no justice, no peace, but thank God for Juneteenth. That had to be said before we start. Video played from the Soft White Underbelly interviews: a man about 50 years old recalls his mother pulling off in a truck and leaving him outside at night when he was three or four; a neighbor took him in, fed him, and bathed him. Pause it. That is what trauma sounds like. These are the events that a lot of brothers are using alcohol and drugs to cope with. Scriptures Opened John 5:39 27:48 - Christ says search the scriptures, for in them ye think ye have eternal life. The solutions are in the Bible. Hope is in the Bible. Romans 15:4 28:29 - Whatsoever things were written aforetime were written for our learning, that we through patience and comfort of the scriptures might have hope. We got to find comfort in the Bible. - A lot of us are not finding comfort in the scriptures because a lot of us lack faith. You don't believe that the Bible can transform you, that the Bible can turn you into another man. 1 Samuel 10:6 29:35 - The Spirit of the Lord will come upon thee, and thou shalt be turned into another man. You don't believe that you could become a whole different person; the scripture says you can. Precepts: - John 3:3 Except a man be born again, he cannot see the kingdom of God. - 2 Esdras 14:34 If so be that ye will subdue your own understanding, and reform your hearts, ye shall be kept alive, and after death ye shall obtain mercy. We got to be transformed in the renewing of our minds. Romans 15:13 32:29 - Now the God of hope fill you with all joy and peace in believing. Hope and healing: the God of hope. Knowing that you can get through this battle, you can put down the bottle. - Christ is that hope. A lot of brothers lack hope and lack faith. They lack faith in Christ; therefore there is no hope, no ability to see yourself without your addiction. - You got brothers coming up to the table: I drank a whole fifth in one night. Bro, are you an alcoholic? No. You are an alcoholic. Even the white man knows that; the first step of recovery at AA is to admit you are an alcoholic. You got to realize that you need help, that you are sick. - Video played from the Soft White Underbelly interviews: a homeless alcoholic says he never stopped drinking, calls drinking his occupation, and says the drink is more important than water and more important than his girlfriend. That is what hopelessness looks and sounds like. A lot of brothers think like that, and they don't tell nobody. Ephesians 5:26 38:10 - That he might sanctify and cleanse it with the washing of water by the word. Your drink has become more important than the washing of water by the word of God. Christ said whosoever drinks of the living water shall never thirst again; now that drink has become more important than that. Psalms 39:7-8 38:48 - And now, Lord, what wait I for? My hope is in thee. Your hope must be in the Lord. - Deliver me from all my transgressions. Drunkenness is a sin. It is in the same category as adultery, in the same category as lying. Those are demons, demonic entities. 2 Corinthians 12:9 39:57 - My grace is sufficient for thee: for my strength is made perfect in weakness. These things that you have within you, you got to fight them things. That is how the power of Christ is manifest. You can't keep giving in to alcoholism, to I'm depressed, to I got low self-esteem. - You are the greatest people on the face of the planet. Brothers go out and teach blacks, Hispanics, Native Indians that you are God's chosen people, while still inside of themselves they believe they are nothing. That is sickness. You got to get over that spirit. You are greater than what you think. You are stronger than the alcohol, stronger than the pornography, stronger than what you are dealing with. - Brothers leave the truth over nothing. I'm leaving because a brother dealt with me as a father would deal with his son and told me to get in the green. I'm leaving because I don't get along with the man over me. But you get along with the white man at your job; every other nation can be over you, but your own people can't tell you nothing. Proverbs 24:10 43:39 - If thou faint in the day of adversity, thy strength is small. Brothers are not even falling because they are about to die; brothers are falling out over correction, over being put in the red, over being made less of a rank. You are not facing life-altering decisions like your whole family dies or you fall out of the truth, yet you make these low-level decisions and still choose death. - That means you are not prepared for when the real trials come. And your memory is going to fade away like the wind in six months; nobody will remember who you are. - Alcoholism: it starts to help you forget, then it becomes the only thing you remember. I'm depressed, my wife is being evil, I got corrected, I got demoted, I lost my job; I'm going to turn to the bottle. It starts to help you forget, but then it becomes the only thing you remember. Proverbs 20:1 47:12 - Wine is a mocker, strong drink is raging. Brothers say I'm good, I can drink two, three, four glasses; next thing you know you are pissy drunk, an old southern term. Strong drink raging is what they call liquid courage: now you think you can fight the bouncer, and you wake up not knowing what happened. - Whosoever is deceived thereby is not wise. You see brothers taking shot after shot saying I don't feel it yet, and fifteen minutes later it hits them like a brick. - Addiction: it promises freedom, it delivers chains. It is kind of like the white man; he promises freedom but delivers chains. - News discussed in class: the Carmelo Anthony case. He was sentenced on a Saturday and taken to prison the next day, when it normally takes a month or more sitting in county before they send you up the road, and they put him in a prison where the uncle of Austin Metcalf, the young man he fought with, is the warden; the judge and prosecution were friends of the family. And y'all tell me the system isn't rigged. That is the 13th Amendment at work: sweat equity. - Escapism: running from reality only makes it louder. In this context we are talking about alcohol, but it could be porn, TikTok, video games, anything you use to escape reality. Galatians 5:19-21 53:07 - The works of the flesh are manifest. Adultery, fornication, uncleanness, idolatry, witchcraft, hatred, variance, emulations, wrath, strife, seditions, heresies, envyings, murders, drunkenness. We just named all those spirits, and brothers say I don't deal with hatred, I'm not trying to kill nobody. That is why you got to take a self-evaluation: which one of these do you deal with? - Drunkenness is in the same sentence as envy and murder and idolatry. These are all spirits, all demons. That is why they call liquor spirits. You get drunk, you become a whole other person: an angry drunk, a crying drunk crying about something from fifty years ago. That is the Hennessy talking. - They which do such things shall not inherit the kingdom of God. We don't put drunkenness in the same sentence as murder, in the context of not getting into the kingdom, because the brother says I don't get drunk. If you need a shot before you go to work, or you got to take a shot while at work, you are a drunkard. If you get the shakes, if you go into withdrawal from not drinking in a day, you are an alcoholic. And alcohol is one of the few drugs whose withdrawal can kill you; that is how your body becomes dependent on it. 1 Corinthians 6:9-11 58:01 - Know ye not that the unrighteous shall not inherit the kingdom of God? Nor thieves, nor covetous, nor drunkards. There it is again: drunkards in the same sentence as the effeminate and abusers of themselves with mankind. Brothers say I'm not a homosexual, but I do get drunk sometimes. It is the same vein of sin. - And such were some of you: but ye are washed, ye are sanctified, ye are justified in the name of the Lord Jesus. Ye are washed with the word of God, like we just read in Ephesians 5. That is that transformation. Isaiah 5:22 1:00:03 - Woe unto them that are mighty to drink wine, and men of strength to mingle strong drink. You got brothers on these podcasts drinking a bottle every single episode. Look at Shannon Sharpe's show: expensive Hennessy with every interview. Why? Because the liquor loosens the lips; it promotes gossip and strife. They said Cat Williams was already tipsy before he even started talking. Ecclesiasticus 31:27-30 1:02:56 - Wine is as good as life to a man, if it be drunk moderately. Wine measurably drunk and in season bringeth gladness of the heart and cheerfulness of the mind. The scripture is not saying you can never drink; it says moderately. - But wine drunken with excess maketh bitterness of the mind, with brawling and quarrelling. You know the functioning alcoholics: drunk and acting normal, driving drunk with the kids in the car, pregaming before you even get to where you are going. - When you are drunk you let spirits in. People get drunk and do unspeakable things to their own households; that is a real thing, and it is demonic. Summarized: the teacher gave examples of the abominations people commit while drunk and the state they wake up in, to show how alcohol brings out demons. - Drunkenness increaseth the rage of a fool till he offend: it diminisheth strength and maketh wounds. Your discernment leaves you; you are not able to make good choices. That is why you see brothers with DUIs: what would make you think you can drive in that condition? - The ten major signs you are addicted to alcohol were read: you drink more than you intend to; you can't control your drinking; you spend a lot of time drinking; you crave alcohol; alcohol hurts your relationships; it hurts your responsibilities; you drink to escape; you need more to get the same effect, which means your liver is failing; you experience withdrawal; you keep drinking despite the consequences. Honesty is the first step; freedom is the next. - The work in this truth is impacted because you are so busy drinking. Some of y'all brothers can't even go to camp, but you got enough time to drink. You are in the red and still drinking; you cannot lose weight while drinking the way you do. A lot of these big brothers can't lose weight because they are alcoholics on the low. - A sister seven months pregnant wanted to drink, and her husband came to ask if it was okay. You can't even stop drinking for the baby in your belly; that is addiction, and you don't need another man to tell you no.
