You are the husband. - Escapism is using alcohol to escape the pain without ever solving the real issue. Emotional pain, heartache, grief, loneliness don't go away; they get buried. Bills and responsibilities don't disappear; they get bigger. And why are you buying liquor when you got bills? Use that liquor money to pay the bills. - The bottle may quiet the pain, but it never heals the wound. You drink to forget what you can't forgive yourself for. It promises connection but leaves you even more alone, because nobody wants to be around a drunkard: you lose the faith of the brothers, your spouse, your kids, your job. - You may be able to bury it for a year, but year two the health issues start. There is only so much your liver can clean out, only so much your heart and your blood pressure can take before your body starts to shut down. What you have become is a shell of who you really are, a vessel of Satan. Psalms 42:11 1:24:53 - Why art thou cast down, O my soul? Hope thou in God: for I shall yet praise him, who is the health of my countenance, and my God. The Bible acknowledges emotional suffering, despair, and discouragement. Why is your soul cast down? Why don't you have any hope? Why do you turn to alcohol? Hope thou in God. - People say it isn't that simple. It is simple: you put your hope in the bottle, and you prove it because you do it every day and can't stop. The same way you are faithful to that bottle is how you are supposed to be doing the word of God: reading every day, desiring wisdom. Proverbs 17:22 1:26:36 - A merry heart doeth good like a medicine: but a broken spirit drieth the bones. That broken spirit is the battle: the loneliness, trauma, guilt, shame, depression, fear of failure. And what does it do? It dries the bones. No life in you, and now you are making decisions that don't even make sense. 2 Corinthians 10:3-5 1:27:23 - The weapons of our warfare are not carnal. What weapons are used against us? Christianity, the legal system, white Jesus, media, depression, trauma, loneliness, post-traumatic slave syndrome. - But mighty through God to the pulling down of strongholds, casting down imaginations, and bringing into captivity every thought to the obedience of Christ. Our weapon is the Bible. You cannot defeat loneliness with a gun; you can't defeat shame and depression with alcohol; you can't defeat these doctrines coming against us with a physical object. You have to use the Bible. Psalms 34:18-19 1:29:22 - The Lord is nigh unto them that are of a broken heart, and saveth such as be of a contrite spirit. - Many are the afflictions of the righteous: but the Lord delivereth him out of them all. We are going to be afflicted; we got to be prepared for what is to come, prepared to be thrown in prison, to have our lives put on the line. How are we going to jeopardize our lives when we can't even get over depression, when we still turn to alcohol to get through the day? You are not ready to go across the world if you can't get over alcoholism in America. Psalms 55:22 1:31:29 - The bottle says forget your pain; the Bible says cast thy burden upon the Lord, and he shall sustain thee. - And understand this about alcohol: you think it is a coincidence that there are liquor stores in every black neighborhood? Your enemy put them there. The Chinese, the East Indians, the Arabs all have liquor stores in our neighborhoods, to keep you drunk and stupid. Now they got the weed stores everywhere too: high, drunk, and stupid. - The bottle says numb your sorrow; the Bible says come unto me, all ye that labour and are heavy laden, and I will give you rest. - The bottle says you are a failure and you can't change; the Bible says there is therefore now no condemnation to them which are in Christ Jesus. You can repent and become a new man; the law of the Lord is perfect, converting the soul. - The bottle says take another drink; the Bible says be not drunk with wine, wherein is excess, but be filled with the Spirit. - The bottle says you are alone, nobody understands us, I love you more than anybody. The bottle starts talking to you like it is scripture: drink me and I will take away thy sorrows, I am the comfort of them all. That is a spirit having a conversation with you. Precepts: - Matthew 11:28 - Romans 8:1 - Psalms 19:7 - Ephesians 5:18 Isaiah 41:8-10 1:36:55 - But thou, Israel, art my servant, Jacob whom I have chosen, the seed of Abraham my friend. You got to understand: we come from the seed of a man that God calls his friend. Nobody else on the earth can say my ancestor was the friend of God, the same God that flooded the whole earth. It is like getting invited to VIP by the owner of the club. - I have chosen thee, and not cast thee away. The Lord did not cast us away. Fear thou not, for I am with thee: be not dismayed, for I am thy God: I will strengthen thee; yea, I will help thee; yea, I will uphold thee with the right hand of my righteousness. The Lord said he has got us. These are the encouraging words we got to remind ourselves of. - But you got to acknowledge: I am an alcoholic, I am a fornicator, a liar, a thief, covetous, an idolater. You got to acknowledge these things; that is where the change happens. But acknowledging is not enough; you also got to work at them. Psalms 94:16 1:41:36 - Who will rise up for me against the evildoers? Who is going to stand up for the injustice going on against our people? - News discussed in class: in Mississippi a one-year-old baby was killed when police fired on a mother they suspected of shoplifting diapers. Even if she was, you are going to kill her and her baby over diapers, a petty crime? That should make you angry; that should make you want to go out and teach. - How do you fall out of the truth right after the Carmelo Anthony incident, after seeing your people oppressed, after seeing the brothers in Africa stoned for teaching, after seeing our general go through what he went through and come out enlightened with more wisdom? Those men did not fall out after being hit with stones; a brother falls out because he was called fat, or because there is a brother over him he doesn't like. - Health reading on alcohol, weight, and nutrition: alcohol is high in calories, nearly the same calories per gram as fat; the body stores fat around the tummy, increasing risk of heart disease, high blood pressure, and type 2 diabetes; alcohol increases appetite and reduces the hormones that make you feel full, and it steers you to food high in fat and sugar. There is such a thing as a beer belly; it builds visceral fat around your organs. That is why you can't climb a flight of stairs. - The periodic table of booze was read: 120 to 125 calories in a glass of Chardonnay, 100 to 120 in a shot of whiskey, up to 200 per IPA, 200 to 500 in a margarita, 240 to 650 in a pina colada. And nobody takes one shot; you take four or five every drink. That is thousands of calories a week in liquor alone, and you wonder why you can't lose weight. Weight loss is calories in, calories out. - Deacon Yashua said you should be able to just drop it for six months. Drop the alcohol for six months and watch how fast you get in the green. Psalms 73:26-28 1:57:52 - My flesh and my heart faileth: but God is the strength of my heart, and my portion for ever. They that are far from thee shall perish. But it is good for me to draw near to God: I have put my trust in the Lord God. Brothers, let the alcohol go. Sisters, let the alcohol go. 1 Kings 2:1-3 1:58:57 - David charged Solomon his son: be thou strong, and shew thyself a man. That is what we all got to realize in these last days; we see things coming to pass. We cannot be sidetracked or pulled away with addiction and alcoholism. Now is the time to show forth the wisdom you learned. - All I hear from brothers on the West Coast is low self-esteem, I'm depressed, I'm messed up. You don't realize how great you really are; you teach it, but you don't believe it. Men don't run. Men of God cannot be bound with addiction, alcoholism, or pornography. Those men are going to break free. - And keep the charge of the Lord thy God, to walk in his ways, to keep his statutes and his commandments, as it is written in the law of Moses, that thou mayest prosper in all that thou doest. Ephesians 6:11 2:01:48 - Put on the whole armour of God, that ye may be able to stand against the wiles of the devil. The teacher referenced The Book of Clarence: the character is told the only place he can be killed is his heel, his Achilles. That made me think about how the strongest part of a brother's armor is in the places he is strongest at, but your Achilles is that little crack that Satan can enter in: the things you are hiding that you haven't dealt with. - You may not deal with pornography, but you deal with alcoholism that you keep to yourself. You are not building up the strength to overcome it because you are hiding it. Brothers will confess any sin except the one that is killing them. - It is like an armor set in a game: if one piece is weak, one hit kills you. It is spiritual. We got to build up our armor, confess and overcome these things, not go home and get drunk back at the ranch. 2 Timothy 2:3-4 2:06:56 - Endure hardness as a good soldier of Jesus Christ. No man that warreth entangleth himself with the affairs of this life. Our people run the same cycle of holidays every year: July 4th is coming, then Thanksgiving, Halloween, Christmas, New Year's. And around these holidays is when our people get killed the most. - In these last days there is no excuse for not knowing who the enemy is; they tell you to your face on social media that they want to wipe us off the planet, and the comment gets a hundred thumbs up. Those thumbs up are your friendly neighborhood coworkers, teachers, doctors, lawyers, judges, police officers. They had a rally telling white men to stand up and fight back, to take America back. Take it back? You still got it; we never took America. Acts 3:19 2:10:41 - Repent ye therefore, and be converted, that your sins may be blotted out. We got to repent as a nation, and in the context of this topic, repent from alcoholism. It is not something you can play with; you cannot play with sin. Precepts: - Ecclesiasticus 21:2 Flee from sin as from the face of a serpent: for if thou comest too near it, it will bite thee. The teeth thereof are as the teeth of a lion, slaying the souls of men. You know which sins you deal with, yet you still entertain them. 2 Chronicles 7:14 2:13:20 - If my people, which are called by my name, shall humble themselves, and pray, and seek my face, and turn from their wicked ways; then will I hear from heaven, and will forgive their sin, and will heal their land. What goes into humility? Confession. Humbling down and realizing you have a problem, realizing that maybe you are the problem. People never put themselves in the seat of being the problem; they always put themselves in the seat of solving it. Isaiah 61:1-2 2:14:50 - The spirit of the Lord God is upon me; because the Lord hath anointed me to preach good tidings unto the meek. Who are the meek? The Israelites are the meek. He hath sent me to bind up the brokenhearted: we are the brokenhearted, crying out in the streets to this day. - To proclaim liberty to the captives, and the opening of the prison to them that are bound. We are the captives, yet this day in captivity, and we fill the prison houses. How can you say you are free? How can you celebrate Juneteenth while our brothers are still getting shot down and babies are still getting murdered, when your day was given to you by Joe Biden? White people say they don't even want the day off. And Trump says he is removing the historical slavery landmarks, but you can keep Juneteenth. It is the same with the Hispanics: ICE comes for you, but you celebrate Cinco de Mayo, and with the World Cup going on you fill a whole stadium when you were scared to go to Walmart. How quickly we forget that we are oppressed. - To proclaim the acceptable year of the Lord: that is our redemption, Christ coming to save his people. And the day of vengeance of our God: vengeance is coming. What is there to hope for outside of the body of Christ? What vengeance can you hope for as an African American or a Mexican? Nothing has been promised to you outside of knowing who you are. - But you want to leave the truth. A sister left the body saying the men walking the women to the bathroom at Feast of Tabernacles isn't biblical. You experience what protectors look like, real men watching over you, and call it not biblical; but the moment something happened and the men were not vigilant, you would blame the men. Precepts: - Job 36:15 He delivereth the poor in his affliction, and openeth their ears in oppression. The Lord is telling you there is going to be so much oppression that you are going to have to listen to the word of God. The Carmelo Anthony situation is oppression; the same week of his verdict, a baby was shot dead in Mississippi. These things are going to continue to happen so that God's people realize who they are. In Closing Closing graphic: people often reach for the bottle because of the battle, but God gave us the Bible so we can win the battle without the bottle. Brothers, sisters, don't let this class slip past you. For those dealing with alcoholism, addiction, escapism: now it is time to repent. Take that self-examination of yourself and realize that you need help. We have the hope and healing program and many tools on our tool belt that the Lord has given us in these last days, so none of us have excuses. Happy Sabbath. Announcements & References - The hope and healing program is available for brothers and sisters dealing with alcoholism and addiction. - Take that liquor money and donate to the booster club: send the prophets across the four corners of the earth to teach God's people. - Deacon's class is up next after this one. - Media referenced in class: the Soft White Underbelly interview series (Bishop appeared on the podcast; two interview clips were played to show what trauma and hopelessness sound like), The Book of Clarence (the Achilles heel scene), and Shannon Sharpe's Club Shay Shay (an example of drinking culture on podcasts). --- Class Notes Index Transcript: full session

title: The Madmen Of China And Their Hatred For Black People
text: Introduction The class opens with the reading of 1 Maccabees 1:24-29 and the prayer of 2 Maccabees 1:24-29: O Lord, Lord God, Creator of all things, who art fearful and strong, and righteous, and merciful; gather those together that are scattered from us, deliver them that serve among the heathen, look upon them that are despised and abhorred, and let the heathen know that thou art our God; punish them that oppress us, and with pride do us wrong. Sad news before class: the seven year old son of a brother in the Ghana school passed away from malaria; the funeral was held yesterday. Prayers and condolences to the family, and whatever they need from us, we will do. The thumbnail for today's class: The Madmen of China and their hatred for black people. The class takes up the boycott of Asian-owned businesses now spreading among our people, identifies who the Chinese, Japanese, Koreans, Vietnamese, and Mongolians are in the scriptures, and reads the prophecies of what the Most High says he will do to Moab and Ammon in the latter days. In The News Videos played in class around the boycott: - An Asian man online mocked the boycott of Asian businesses: get rid of the takeout, the dry cleaners, the beauty supply; you are being outworked by immigrants; boycott, I am all for it. Well, now the boycott is on, and I am all for it. Sisters, stop buying that fake hair from them. They do not like you; they hate you. - The angry Chinese lady: she blamed our people for the killing of a black boy by a store owner, saying if you had disciplined your boy he would not have been in someone's store trying to steal a fifty cent bottle of water, and pointing to the black jurors who found the shooter not guilty. But the boy did not steal any water: he left his bag at the front, took the water out and put it back, showed his pockets, and left the store. They chased him for a hundred and thirty yards and shot the boy in the back. He ran because he was scared; he is a boy with two grown men chasing behind him. - A response video exposed that woman: her online persona and accent are fake, public records contradict her story, and she has her own record of victimizing people; after it circulated she deleted her accounts. And on the victim mentality talking point: when a rapist rapes somebody, is that person a victim? Did we get raped during slavery? We are victims, and we are not going to forget it. That talking point is designed to get us to be quiet, and it does not work on us. If you rob me, I am going to keep saying you are a robber. - Another commentator said the boycott will not hold: where are you going to get your weave, Walmart? It is still made by the Chinese; Amazon, still made by the Chinese; and the moment the paycheck comes, it is right back to the hair, feet, and nails. That proves the point: too many of our women have been raised to despise the way they look, running after fake hair, fake nails, and lashes China makes. Sisters, love your hair and your complexion. And brothers, some of you are the reason for it, talking about the hair textures and complexions you prefer; you hate the way you look, and that spirit lands on the women. - Statistics read in class: black consumers spend about 9.4 billion dollars a year on beauty products, around 11 to 12.5 percent of the total US beauty market; black hair care is a 2.5 billion dollar industry, and black women spend roughly nine times more on ethnic hair products than non-black consumers. - The Natasha stress doll: a stress relief toy resembling a small black baby is going viral, with users squeezing, stomping, throwing, and running it over for content. The dolls come in multiple colors, yet the trend focuses on this specific version. Make your own decision about what that trend is. - A man who admitted burning a cross in Grant Park, Chicago, topped with a MAGA hat, gave a softball interview claiming he never learned what a burning cross means in America. What man gets an interview first before the police lock him up? You cannot make this stuff up. Scriptures Opened John 5:39 15:55 - Search the scriptures; for in them ye think ye have eternal life: and they are they which testify of me. Our job is to search the scriptures. The nations do not search the scriptures; they leave their searching from Matthew to Revelation with their misunderstanding through Christianity. If you start from Genesis, you find out that salvation and rulership of the earth is for the Israelites through Christ. Precepts: - Acts 17:11 These were more noble than those in Thessalonica, in that they received the word with all readiness of mind, and searched the scriptures daily, whether those things were so. When Paul presented the truth of Christ, they searched the scriptures daily to see if what Paul taught was accurate. That is what we have to do. - Proverbs 25:2 It is the glory of God to conceal a thing: but the honour of kings is to search out a matter. When God conceals something in parables, metaphors, and allegories, it is our job to figure out what the Lord means. - Deuteronomy 29:29 The secret things belong unto the Lord our God: but those things which are revealed belong unto us and to our children for ever. What God has kept secret and then revealed is for our children and our children's children. What we bring out in the scriptures is meant for our sons and daughters; teach them, and do not let this truth fall by the wayside. Jeremiah 48:1 18:34 - Against Moab thus saith the Lord of hosts, the God of Israel. Unless you search the scriptures and pray to the Lord, you read that and say, I do not know who Moab is, and move on to the next chapter. Jeremiah 49:1 19:07 - Concerning the Ammonites: I do not know who the Ammonites are, and I do not know who Gad is, so I will stick to Matthew through Revelation. That is what the churches do. They stay confused, unable to identify who these nations are today. Christians do not know; Muslims do not know. 2 Esdras 15:46 19:55 - And thou, Asia, that art partaker of the hope of Babylon, and art the glory of her person. Definition read in class, the primary countries and territories of East Asia: China, the largest country in the region by landmass and population, a global economic and manufacturing powerhouse; Japan, an island nation known for technological innovation; South Korea; North Korea; Mongolia; and Taiwan, a global leader in semiconductor production. That is the Asia this prophecy addresses. 1 Maccabees 11:21 26:41 - Then certain ungodly persons, who hated their own people, went unto the king. The Chinese lady made a point to say black jurors found the man who shot the boy not guilty. There has always been a certain remnant of our people who love other races better than their own. What was true during the time of the Maccabees is true today: you have got Christians who hate their own people. - And on the handout talking point: everybody knows the Asian community had a hand out. When the government was giving them loans to open businesses in the black community, the government was denying black people loans; that is documented history. And during World War II, when America put the Japanese in internment camps, they paid them reparations when they let them out. So it is very amusing that they use this talking point on us. Genesis 19:29-38 42:01 - Sodom and Gomorrah have just been destroyed, and Lot dwells in a cave with his two daughters. They think everybody on the planet is dead: our father is old, and there is not a man in the earth to come in unto us after the manner of all the earth. Both the daughters of Lot were with child by their father. - And the firstborn bare a son, and called his name Moab: the same is the father of the Moabites unto this day. And the younger bare a son, and called his name Benammi: the same is the father of the children of Ammon unto this day. - When I came into this truth in the nineties, our elders already taught us that Moab is the Chinese and Ammon is the Japanese. It was not until recently that we found the books. - Book read in class: The Japanese: Who Are They?, by Thomas W. Plant. From the highlighted sections: after a careful study of the whole of the arguments, "the author had definitely established his case, namely that the Japanese are the children of Ammon"; by the family tree of Abraham and Lot "you will see at once that Japan and China, versus Ben-ammi and Moab of old, are of Shemitic origin"; and "the proving of Japan to be the children of Ammon carries with it the claim that the Chinese are the children of Moab." - Book read in class: The Dragon, Image, and Demon: The Three Religions of China (Confucianism, Buddhism, and Taoism). On page 363 the author applies Jeremiah's words directly: "As of Moab, it may be said, We have heard the pride of China; he is exceeding proud, his loftiness, and his arrogancy, and his pride, and the haughtiness of his heart." You see how Moab was translated to China. - Genetics read in class: Koreans are genetically slightly closer to Japanese than to Chinese populations, so write it down: the Koreans, North and South, are Ammonites. Vietnamese people are significantly closer to Chinese people: the Vietnamese are Moab. Mongolia is genetically closer to China than to Japan: Mongolia is Moab. Jeremiah 48:29 46:56 - We have heard the pride of Moab, (he is exceeding proud) his loftiness, and his arrogancy, and his pride, and the haughtiness of his heart. If you did not know the Chinese man was proud, you learned it these last few weeks. Isaiah 15:1-2 48:38 - The burden of Moab. Ar and Kir are cities in Moab, laid waste and brought to silence. This took place under Nebuchadnezzar, when Babylon came in smiting Moab; but these scriptures carry a dual meaning for the last days. - On all their heads shall be baldness, and every beard cut off. Moab shaves the hair in mourning, and it remains in their religions: definition read in class, in Chinese religious traditions head shaving is an absolute obligation for ordained monastics; in the Buddhist tradition the shaving of the head, the tonsure, carries significant meaning, and fully ordained monks and nuns must shave. Precepts: - Revelation 11:8 Their dead bodies shall lie in the street of the great city. The great city is Babylon the great. - Revelation 14:8 Babylon is fallen, is fallen, that great city, because she made all nations drink of the wine of the wrath of her fornication. This place, America, is a spiritual Babylon; God calls it Babylon the great. So when Babylon under Nebuchadnezzar smote Moab, know that there is dual significance behind it. Isaiah 16:1-5 52:23 - Send ye the lamb to the ruler of the land from Sela: Sela is Petra, that is Edom. Unto the mount of the daughter of Zion. - Hide the outcasts; bewray not him that wandereth. The outcast is us, the Israelites. During the time of Nebuchadnezzar many Israelites fled and hid amongst Moab: let mine outcasts dwell with thee, Moab; be thou a covert to them from the face of the spoiler. The spoiler was Nebuchadnezzar. - And in mercy shall the throne be established: and he shall sit upon it in truth in the tabernacle of David, judging, and seeking judgment, and hasting righteousness. The throne that is going to be established is the throne of Christ. Precepts: - Jeremiah 40:11 Likewise when all the Jews that were in Moab, and among the Ammonites, and in Edom, heard that the king of Babylon had left a remnant of Judah. There is the proof of where our people fled. - Isaiah 9:6-7 For unto us a child is born, unto us a son is given: and the government shall be upon his shoulder. A lot of people do not understand why Christ is called the everlasting Father: because the one you think is the heavenly Father in the Old Testament was actually Christ. Of the increase of his government and peace there shall be no end, upon the throne of David, to order it, and to establish it with judgment and with justice. That is law and order. Some do not like law and order because they like chaos; the Bible can break that spirit, but only if you let it. This is the beginning of God's government: that is why we establish law, order, and rank, and teach the laws, commandments, and statutes of the Holy Bible. - Matthew 13:31-32 The kingdom of heaven is like to a grain of mustard seed, the least of all seeds: but when it is grown, it is the greatest among herbs, and becometh a tree, so that the birds of the air come and lodge in the branches thereof. We are at that mustard seed stage now. It did not end with Nat Turner; the history of the Israelite schools continues, and we here are part of that mustard seed that, when it is grown, is the greatest of all. All nations are going to submit to the King of kings. Isaiah 16:6 1:00:03 - We have heard of the pride of Moab; he is very proud: even of his haughtiness, and his pride, and his wrath: but his lies shall not be so. Whatever China boasts, God is going to shut it all down. Jeremiah 48:1-9 1:01:31 - There shall be no more praise of Moab. You know how black people praise Moab: everybody was kung fu fighting; we love those Chinese movies. We will praise Moab quick, but Moab does not have that same love for us. Even today people say the next world superpower is going to be China; the prophecy says there shall be no more praise of Moab. - Also thou shalt be cut down, O Madmen. See what God calls Moab: madmen. That is the class title. When you read the history of Moab, they hated and despised our people; I will show you that. - For because thou hast trusted in thy works and in thy treasures, thou shalt also be taken: captivity, prisoners of war. And Chemosh shall go forth into captivity with his priests and his princes together. Chemosh was the favorite idol god of Moab. - The spoiler shall come upon every city, and no city shall escape. Nebuchadnezzar destroyed Moab then; Jeremiah's prophecy carries the duality, because Moab today, China, is a world superpower, and they will be destroyed once again. This goes with 2 Esdras 15:46-63 on the destruction of Asia and Babylon. - Give wings unto Moab, that it may flee and get away. When Nebuchadnezzar came through, a lot of them fled far east. Some got caught; some did not. Daniel 11:41 1:07:48 - Speaking of the Greeks: he shall enter also into the glorious land, and many countries shall be overthrown: but these shall escape out of his hand, even Edom, and Moab, and the chief of the children of Ammon. So during the time of the Greeks there were still remnants of Moab and Ammon in those lands; everybody did not leave at once. 2 Maccabees 5:6-9 1:09:20 - Jason, the wicked Israelite who slew his own citizens without mercy, fled again into the country of the Ammonites, and in the end was accused before Aretas the king of the Arabians. Why? Because by that time the Arabs controlled the land of the Ammonites. - Book read in class: The Antiquities of the Jews, by Flavius Josephus, book 13 chapter 15: Alexander Jannaeus "was forced to deliver back to the king of Arabia the land of Moab and Gilead which he had subdued," so that the Arabians would not join the war against him. The king of Arabia had the land of Moab as well. Context read in class: during the reign of the Hasmonean king Alexander Jannaeus (103 to 76 BC), the Nabataean kingdom, ruled by the king of Arabia, took those territories. The Nabataeans were Arabs; that is why foolish people online read that Edom was ruled by the Nabataeans and say Edom are the Arabs. The Nabataeans came later, during the time of the Maccabees. - Reading from the research summary: the Moabites and Ammonites did not leave their ancestral lands in a single voluntary exodus; they vanished from the region between the sixth and first centuries BC through military devastation and forced exiles, from the time of Nebuchadnezzar to the time of the Greeks, in increments. But the claim that they simply blended into the newer Arab populations is not true; the AI summaries and search engines will mislead you on purpose so you never find out who Moab and Ammon are. Remember who controls them. Jeremiah 48:26-27 1:15:48 - For was not Israel a derision unto thee? Since thou spakest of him, thou skippedst for joy. Why were they skipping for joy? Because Moab helped destroy us, and they were happy about it. - Video played in class: black images on the ancient cave walls and monasteries of China, including Africans diving for pearls. Your Chinese friends will not tell you about any of this. It is just like Rome: the catacombs and churches full of black images, and they cannot stand us. All nations stick together and keep it hidden. Ezekiel 25:1-11 1:19:31 - Son of man, set thy face against the Ammonites, and prophesy against them. But in order to prophesy against them, you must first be able to identify who they are. - Because thou saidst, Aha, against my sanctuary, when it was profaned; and against the land of Israel, when it was desolate; and against the house of Judah, when they went into captivity. Ammon mocked us and laughed at us when we went into slavery. - Behold, therefore I will deliver thee to the men of the east for a possession. That began with Nebuchadnezzar, followed by Persia and Media; but the party is not over. - Because that Moab and Seir do say, Behold, the house of Judah is like unto all the heathen: the Chinese and the white man say there is nothing special about Judah. Therefore I will open the side of Moab from the cities: God is going to have the side of their cities destroyed. I will execute judgments upon Moab; and they shall know that I am the Lord. Jeremiah 49:1-2 1:23:09 - Hath Israel no sons? hath he no heir? why then doth their king inherit Gad, and his people dwell in his cities? Historically, when Gad was moved out of the land by the Assyrian captivity, Ammon moved into our land and dwelt in our cities. - Therefore, behold, the days come, saith the Lord, that I will cause an alarm of war to be heard in Rabbah of the Ammonites. Nebuchadnezzar burned their daughters with fire. - Then shall Israel be heir unto them that were his heirs, saith the Lord. Precepts: - Amos 1:13-15 For three transgressions of the children of Ammon, and for four, I will not turn away the punishment thereof; because they have ripped up the women with child of Gilead, that they might enlarge their border. When Ammon caught our people, they slaughtered the pregnant women of Gilead, and God says he is not letting them slide on that. There will be a day of battle: and their king shall go into captivity, he and his princes together. Image shown in class: the leader of North Korea. I do not know if it is that particular man, but whoever is the leader in the land of Ammon at that time is going to be a prisoner of war; that is what the prophecy says, so look for it. - Romans 8:17 And if children, then heirs; heirs of God, and joint-heirs with Christ; if so be that we suffer with him, that we may be also glorified together. That is what "Israel shall be heir unto them that were his heirs" jumps to. - Obadiah 1:19 They of the south shall possess the mount of Esau; and they of the plain the Philistines: and they shall possess the fields of Ephraim, and the fields of Samaria: and Benjamin shall possess Gilead. The prophecy says God is going to give the land of Gilead to the tribe of Benjamin in the future. - Numbers 32:29 Moses had it mapped out: if the children of Gad and the children of Reuben will pass with you over Jordan, then ye shall give them the land of Gilead for a possession. - Numbers 32:39 And the children of Machir the son of Manasseh went to Gilead, and took it. So Gad, Reuben, and Manasseh held that land. Map shown in class: Ammon sat right next to Gad, and when Gad was carried off, Ammon moved in; and on the modern map that whole area, spelled Amman, is what America calls Jordan today, in Arab hands, exactly as the history in Maccabees explains. Books opened on the hidden history 1:31:58 - Encyclopedia of Japanese History: paintings from the 1400s and 1500s showing black faces in Japan. The Portuguese and Spanish brought black slaves over, and the black faces in these paintings are slaves. You do not learn this in school, and you definitely will not learn it in Sunday school. - Paintings of the Kunlun: African slaves in ancient China. The first African slaves in ancient China were given as tribute gifts by the Srivijayan empire of Indonesia to the Chinese empire during the Tang dynasty (618 to 907 AD), long before the Portuguese. Article read in class, from the African American Registry: African slavery in China peaked during the Tang and Song dynasties (960 to 1279 AD); the Kunlun were portrayed in stories of the period as heroic, resourceful, and culturally Chinese; the number taken to China during this six hundred year period is unclear. - Enslaved Africans were first brought to China in large numbers by the Portuguese in the sixteenth century, following the establishment of the trading post at Macau in 1557, a distinct branch of the global Portuguese slave trade. The majority were trafficked from Southeast and East Africa, the Zambezi valley and coastal Mozambique. Roles read in class: enslaved Africans formed the core of Macau's defensive military force, and in the 1622 Battle of Macau a Dutch invasion force was decisively defeated primarily by an armed force of African slaves; they frequently served as armed retainers, bodyguards, and private armies; many escaped across the border into mainland China. The presence of black Africans in China predated the Portuguese via Arab trade routes from the eighth to fourteenth centuries; the Chinese associated people of darker skin with the sweeping term Kunlun. - Article read in class, The Forgotten History of the African Slave Trade in China: the first Africans arrived as gifts from the king of Kalinga in Java to the Tang emperor in 813 AD, treated as exotic ornaments; the Chinese called them Zangzhi, a reference to Zanzibar, which then described the whole east African coast. The journey took approximately six months, shipwrecks were common, and many captives died. The Chinese thought Africans had immense physical strength, so slaves were mainly forced into hard labor. - Who's Who in Philadelphia, by Charles Frederick White, 1912: the Negro learns from history that Hannibal was of Ethiopian blood; that King Solomon proudly acknowledged that he was black; that the Jews were of African blood; that Jesus Christ himself was as much a Negro as some of the race you persecute. And on Japan: Jimmu Tenno brought Negroes with the sun and fire worship from Mesopotamia through Manchuria; and the old proverb said, "To be a good samurai, one must have half black blood in one's veins." In those days they were not ashamed to acknowledge it. - The Ancient Jewish Diaspora in Japan: a Japanese sect holds that their ancestors came to Japan from western Asia about 660 BC, during the time of Babylon; the name samurai recalls ancient Samaria; carvings preserved by the samurai show early immigrants clothed very much like the ancient Assyrians; the samurai observed rites like those of the Jews, such as the redemption of the firstborn and the wearing of a phylactery-like box by Japanese priests; and the six-pointed star is common in Japan, worn by children on their hats. The Israelites of Samaria were the samurai. There is so much they covered up, and now we are learning it. - Same book, page 27: the Great Wall of China, "architectural masterpiece by the hands of Jewish diaspora." The author marvels "at the fabulous amount of hard labors and splendid skills that those Jewish captives had to render." And from the Account of the Eastern Barbarians in the latter Han period: in building the Great Wall these captives were brutally oppressed by Chinese kings, "who were much like the Pharaoh in Egypt." Some of these captives escaped and eventually made their way to Japan by way of Korea. I did not write the book, but God revealed the book. - French art book of Nanban screens: black slaves in the Japanese paintings of the 1500s, carrying loads, rowing the boats, carrying the litters on their shoulders, the same thing we had to do for the white folks over here. Why are these books not in English in America? We had to go to foreign countries to dig this up, because they keep it secret. Precepts: - Deuteronomy 28:64 And the Lord shall scatter thee among all people, from the one end of the earth even unto the other. We were scattered everywhere, and that includes, as we are finding out, China and Japan. 2 Esdras 15:46-53 1:58:32 - And thou, Asia, that art partaker of the hope of Babylon: woe be unto thee, thou wretch, because thou hast made thyself like unto her. Asia has made herself like Babylon the great, decking her daughters in whoredom to please and glory in her lovers: that is the corporations, the fornication of Revelation 17 and 18, the business deals with all nations. - Thou hast followed her that is hated in all her works and inventions. This is how you know it is China and Japan: in all of America's works and inventions, China either reverse engineered it or stole the technology. - Therefore saith God, I will send plagues upon thee; widowhood, poverty, famine, sword, and pestilence, to waste thy houses with destruction and death. This is prophecy; it has not occurred yet. - If thou hadst not always slain my chosen, exalting the stroke of thine hands, and saying over their dead, when thou wast drunken. This is why you do not see the descendants of all those black slaves over in China and Japan today: they were always killing us. Remember, they said we had great physical strength; they could not take the strong men one on one, so they waited until the drinking feasts, when everybody was drunk, and then they would slaughter our people. That is what God is answering. Jeremiah 48:10-13 2:02:57 - Moab hath been at ease from his youth, and he hath settled on his lees, and hath not been emptied from vessel to vessel, neither hath he gone into captivity. Vessel to vessel means taken captive and brought from one slavery to the next, like we were. That did not happen to Moab: therefore his taste remained in him, and his scent is not changed. Their hatred has not changed from their beginning until now. - And Moab shall be ashamed of Chemosh, as the house of Israel was ashamed of Bethel their confidence. Precepts: - 1 Kings 12:28-33 Jeroboam made two calves of gold and said, Behold thy gods, O Israel, which brought thee up out of the land of Egypt; and he set the one in Bethel, and the other put he in Dan, and this thing became a sin. He made priests of the lowest of the people, and ordained a feast in the eighth month, on the fifteenth day of the month, devised of his own heart, in place of the feast of tabernacles. That is the shame of Bethel. Images shown in class: the horned gods of Chinese religion, carved with the cow's head and body, very similar to Baal, the calf god. More proof of who they are. Jeremiah 48:14-20 2:07:19 - How say ye, We are mighty and strong men for the war? Moab always says that; they think they can defeat anybody. I will give them this: they have order. But Moab is spoiled, and his chosen young men are gone down to the slaughter, saith the King, whose name is the Lord of hosts. - The calamity of Moab is near to come, and his affliction hasteth fast. How is the strong staff broken, and the beautiful rod! Dibon, Aroer, Arnon: cities of ancient Moab, in the land America calls Jordan today. - Article shown in class, from the Guardian: the MOAB, the "mother of all bombs," used in Afghanistan. America named their biggest conventional bomb MOAB, and it is slated for a fight with China. Is it a coincidence? Maybe you believe in coincidences; I do not. Jeremiah 48:25-30 2:13:00 - Make ye him drunken: for he magnified himself against the Lord. Notice why God says make Moab drunk: that is what they did to us. Moab also shall wallow in his vomit, and he also shall be in derision. For was not Israel a derision unto thee? You danced when you slaughtered us; you skipped for joy when we fell. So now they are going to get judged the same way. - Commercial played in class: the Chinese laundry detergent ad in which a black man is stuffed into a washing machine and comes out a fair-skinned Chinese man. This is how they mock us. And some black people see nothing wrong with that; they still want to date them, marry them, have kids by them. - O ye that dwell in Moab, leave the cities, and dwell in the rock. Images shown in class: China's bunkers in the mountains, little bunkers, big bunkers, all kinds of bunkers. The prophecy already saw it. - I know his wrath, saith the Lord; but it shall not be so; his lies shall not so effect it. Video played in class: a Chinese commentator boasting that China will not fire the first shot but will never allow a second, describing an ICBM carrying dozens of warheads that can reach any corner of the world in under twenty minutes, and promising that whoever wants to destroy China will be destroyed. Now that is some pride right there. Whatever China says, God says it shall not be so: his lies will not affect the outcome of what God says is going to happen to him. Jeremiah 48:35-42 2:15:20 - I will cause to cease in Moab, saith the Lord, him that offereth in the high places, and him that burneth incense to his gods. Video played in class: the incense counts of Chinese devotion, 108 sticks to the Buddhas, 32 to the devas of the four directions, 21 praying to one's father, sticks for every deity and ancestor. China is known for burning incense to its gods; more proof of who Moab is. - Every head shall be bald, and every beard clipped: the mourning of Moab returns. For I have broken Moab like a vessel wherein is no pleasure, saith the Lord. - For thus saith the Lord; Behold, he shall fly as an eagle, and shall spread his wings over Moab. Whose symbol is the eagle? America. The eagle spreads his wings over Moab, and Moab shall be destroyed from being a people, because he hath magnified himself against the Lord. Precepts: - 2 Esdras 15:56-63 Like as thou hast done unto my chosen, saith the Lord, even so shall God do unto thee. Thy children shall die of hunger, thy cities shall be broken down, and they that be in the mountains shall die of hunger and eat their own flesh: everybody thinks they have a plan for when Armageddon takes place, we will go into the bunkers and survive there; no, that is not going to happen. And in the passage they shall rush on the idle city, and shall destroy some portion of thy land, and shall return to Babylon that was destroyed. Although the country of Babylon the great is wiped out, her military is not finished; that is why America keeps over 800 military bases worldwide, which no other nation has, not Russia, not China. That is how they reach Moab even after the homeland is destroyed. Thy children shall they carry away captive, and look, what thou hast, they shall spoil it, and mar the beauty of thy face. Jeremiah 48:43-47 2:25:17 - Fear, and the pit, and the snare, shall be upon thee, O inhabitant of Moab. He that fleeth from the fear shall fall into the pit; and he that getteth up out of the pit shall be taken in the snare. Article shown in class: the hidden metropolis, the Dixia Cheng, a sprawling cold war bunker city beneath Beijing. They think they will be safe in these underground bunkers; the Lord is telling us in the scripture that it is not going to work. - Woe be unto thee, O Moab! the people of Chemosh perisheth: for thy sons are taken captives, and thy daughters captives: prisoners of war. - Yet will I bring again the captivity of Moab in the latter days, saith the Lord. Although it happened with Nebuchadnezzar, God said it is going to happen again in the latter days. Thus far is the judgment of Moab. Precepts: - 2 Esdras 5:42 I will liken my judgment unto a ring: like as there is no slackness of the last, even so there is no swiftness of the first. A steady flow of judgment comes upon all nations. So are we promoting harm to the Chinese? No. Some of you work for them and go to school with them; fine. Our job is to tell you what God says is going to happen to these nations, not just the Chinese, but all nations. 2 Corinthians 6:14-18 2:28:40 - Be ye not unequally yoked together with unbelievers: for what fellowship hath righteousness with unrighteousness? and what communion hath light with darkness? That goes for you men and women: do not be marrying these other nations. - For ye are the temple of the living God; as God hath said, I will dwell in them, and walk in them; and I will be their God, and they shall be my people. - Wherefore come out from among them, and be ye separate, saith the Lord, and touch not the unclean thing; and I will receive you, and will be a Father unto you, and ye shall be my sons and daughters, saith the Lord Almighty. So why are we always trying to mingle and integrate? God says be separate. And for those of you who came up of mixed parentage: fine; but find yourself an Israelite woman or an Israelite man, and do not do this any more. Psalms 108:9 2:31:02 - Moab is my washpot; over Edom will I cast out my shoe; over Philistia will I triumph. God says Moab is going to serve. Precepts: - Isaiah 11:14 But they shall fly upon the shoulders of the Philistines toward the west; they shall spoil them of the east together: they shall lay their hand upon Edom and Moab; and the children of Ammon shall obey them. We shall lay our hands upon Edom and Moab, and the children of Ammon, the Japanese, shall obey us. - Zephaniah 2:8-9 I have heard the reproach of Moab, and the revilings of the children of Ammon, whereby they have reproached my people, and magnified themselves against their border. You think they love us? God says they reproach us; they hate us. Therefore as I live, saith the Lord of hosts, the God of Israel, Surely Moab shall be as Sodom, and the children of Ammon as Gomorrah: that has not happened yet. And the residue of my people shall spoil them, and the remnant of my people shall possess them. Nobody escapes what they did to God's chosen people. And with that we say: twelve tribes. In Closing Nobody gets away with what they did to God's chosen people. Moab and Ammon, the madmen of the east, despised us, enslaved us, slew the chosen when they were drunken, and skipped for joy at our fall; and the same God who sent Nebuchadnezzar against them the first time says he will bring their captivity again in the latter days. Our job is not to harm anybody; our job is to search the scriptures, identify the nations, tell you what God says is coming, and come out from among them and be separate. Moab is his washpot; the children of Ammon shall obey; and the remnant of his people shall possess them. Announcements & References Field reports played: - IUIC attended the march and rally for Carmelo Anthony after the jury sentenced him to 35 years, reading Ecclesiastes 4:1 over the oppression of our people in the courts. Bishop Kenny to the family: we understand this is a painful time; we are not going to find justice in America, because they frame the law by mischief. We get justice when we repent, keep the commandments, and return to the laws of God as the Israelites. - IUIC Philly invaded the Odunde festival, casting down the idolatry of the Yoruba fertility goddess and preaching the gospel; many came to the table with questions and were excited to learn their true heritage. - The prophets of the Northeast, hosted by IUIC Rochester, brought the word of God to the Juneteenth celebration in Buffalo, statistically the second largest Juneteenth festival in America; thousands of flyers were distributed and the city was extremely receptive. - IUIC Austin launched the first Taking Back the Community (TBTC) event in Texas, returning in full force to a neighborhood that had threatened the camp, with missing persons outreach, the Hope and Healing community cleanup, and Show Thyself a Man; one man gave up vaping on the spot and asked God to keep him for his wife and family. - The prophets went down to Senatobia, Mississippi, to stand with the family of one year old Cohen Wright, killed when an officer responding to a shoplifting call fired at the vehicle he was inside; the Walmart there is closed amid protests and boycott, and IUIC joined the call for charges and accountability. - National land update: septic tanks dropped, roads being widened from single lane to two lanes and stabilized, trees cleared, parking planned, all in preparation to keep the feast of tabernacles on our own land. Where there is no vision, the people perish (Proverbs 29:18). Nobody else is doing this; through your prayers, faith, and contributions, the vision is being established. It is nation time. Media and events: - IUIC Watch and Read: The History of the Israelites, animated teaching for the youth, available now. - Getting Battle Ready meal plans (keto or shred down) by Moses Ben Israel, plus his credit repair book; all proceeds go back to Israel United in Christ. - Deacon Isaac's debut album Eternal Glory releases July 12 on Original Royalty Recordings, with the video single King of Terrors out now; guest features include the Sons of Thunder and Captain Mattathias. - Israel Live: scan the QR code to vote for next week's episode, Mondays at 9:00 pm. - Comic: Yahawashi Invades France, issue 4, available at the comic shop. Dates: the new moon is Tuesday, June 30th at sundown. The next fast day is Friday, June 26th at sundown. Sisters, keep the pantry discipline in mind: groceries are getting more expensive, and the brothers and sisters abroad who cannot afford it are depending on us. Closing reading: 1 Corinthians 11:23-29, the bread and the cup, in remembrance of the Lord's death till he come; let a man examine himself. --- Class Notes Index Transcript: full session

title: BORN FOR ADVERSITY
text: Introduction Thumbnail video: "You asked for this. You asked for strength, not comfort. You asked to be unshakable, not untouched. You asked God to use you. So why are you shocked that it hurts? This is what you prayed for. Not peace: pressure, isolation, silence with nothing but him. A warrior does not question the fire while he is inside it. He stands. You say it hurts. Good. Let it. That pain is doing its job. It is burning out everything in you that was never meant to survive this level. Strength is not built in comfort. It is built right here in the middle of the battlefield. He did not keep you alive to watch you quit. He trusted you with this weight, this pressure, this pain, because most would break. But you didn't. So stand. Because this is the life you asked for, and God answered. You were chosen." Shalom, Israel, happy Sabbath. The topic today is born for adversity. My job as a teacher is to go into the scriptures and show you the things that are happening in the world, to show you that this is a true book. This is not a story book; it is a history book and a book of prophecy: what happened to us in the past and what is going to happen in the future. Before the topic, we touch on some things going on in the world right now. In The News Video played on the earthquakes: in 18 days the world experienced five earthquakes measuring 6.8 or greater in magnitude. On June 8th the Philippines had a 7.8 magnitude earthquake. On June 24th Venezuela had a 7.2 magnitude earthquake followed 39 seconds later by a 7.5. On June 25th Japan had a 6.9 off Hokkaido, and on June 26th Indonesia had a 6.8 in the Celebes Sea, felt across southern Mindanao with aftershock warnings. Add California's 5.6 on the same morning of June 24th. Six significant shocks in under three weeks, all on active margins around the Pacific and Caribbean; the pattern is unusual even in a seismically active year. - The report says over 1,500 people died thus far in Venezuela from that earthquake. - You see the wars taking place: Russia and Ukraine, Lebanon, Israel and Iran, Sudan, the Congo. What you see happening now is going to get worse. China will go to war with Taiwan. You think what Russia is doing in Ukraine is going to stay in Ukraine? It is going to go further. - Iran walked out of the negotiations this week. The vice president went over there to sign the peace deal, and Iran walked out. They were promised 300 billion dollars, but according to the scriptures Iran does not care about the money. You killed their leaders; no money you give them is going to stop what they are going to do. - Trump is trying to make a deal with the Iranian government to open the strait of Hormuz, because the European economy and the world economy would collapse. And the Israeli government keeps bombing Lebanon; they said they are not stopping, because it is really about taking the land. - You have to watch what is going on, because the news does not tell you truth anymore; the news is censored. When was the last time you saw a video of what is going on in Palestine? The Palestinian journalists were killed, and those videos do not reach the United States, because they want to keep our people here asleep to what is going on. Scriptures Opened Matthew 24:3-8 12:51 - The disciples asked Christ privately, what shall be the sign of thy coming, and of the end of the world? Christ gave us clues: what we have to look for before he returns. - Take heed that no man deceive you. For many shall come in my name, saying, I am Christ, and shall deceive many: that is Christianity and Judaism. They come in the name of Christ; they say they are Christians, they say they are Jews. - Ye shall hear of wars and rumours of wars. You see the wars taking place. But see that ye be not troubled: all these things must come to pass, but the end is not yet. - Nation shall rise against nation, and kingdom against kingdom: and there shall be famines, and pestilences, like the coronavirus, and earthquakes, in divers places. That is what we see in Venezuela and all these countries: the earth is shaking. That is a sign that Christ is about to return. It could be 10 years, could be 25, but these are the signs. - All these are the beginning of sorrows. That is the time we are living in. There is much pain and sorrow coming on this earth. 2 Esdras 16:14-21 18:13 - Behold, the plagues are sent, and shall not return again, until they come upon the earth. Those wars and rumours of wars and earthquakes: that is plagues that the Most High is sending on the earth. Like an arrow shot of a mighty archer that returneth not backward, they shall not return. - The beginning of sorrows and great mournings: the same thing we read in Matthew 24. There will be great mournings all over the earth. You see the Palestinians mourning, being starved out; the Lebanese mourning; the Ukrainian mothers mourning. - The beginning of famine, and great death; the beginning of wars, and the powers shall stand in fear; the beginning of evils. Famine and plague, tribulation and anguish, are sent as scourges for amendment. Amendment means judgment: the Most High is judging the nations right now, and he is afflicting us that are among these nations so we wake up. - For all these things they shall not turn from their wickedness. Our people are not going to change, and the nations are not going to repent. - Little shall be so good cheap upon earth, that they shall think themselves to be in good case. Right now gas went down, food is cheap, clothing is cheap, so people think everything is good. But even then shall evils grow upon earth: as the evils multiply, the prices on everything are going to multiply, because there will be food shortage and high demand. Things are cheap now; you had better be buying and putting things in place, because victuals are not going to stay cheap forever. Isaiah 13:17-19 27:15 - Behold, I will stir up the Medes against them, which shall not regard silver; and as for gold, they shall not delight in it. This literally happened back then: the Medes destroyed ancient Babylon. And the same way the Lord used the Persians and the Medes in ancient times to destroy ancient Babylon, he is going to use them in this time to play a role in destroying mystery Babylon the great, which is America and Israel; they are one. - They shall not regard silver: that is why the 300 billion dollars will not buy Iran off the way they buy off Saudi Arabia and these other countries. What we see taking place, God is doing this. - And Babylon, the glory of kingdoms, shall be as when God overthrew Sodom and Gomorrah. How did God overthrow Sodom and Gomorrah? With brimstone and fire. Ancient Babylon was not destroyed with brimstone and fire; the Persians conquered it from within. So we know this scripture is twofold, and this part is a future prophecy. Isaiah 14:4-11 32:48 - Thou shalt take up this proverb against the king of Babylon: how hath the oppressor ceased! the golden city ceased! The Lord hath broken the staff of the wicked: the golden city, America, is also called the staff of the wicked. God is going to break them; this is future prophecy. - Hell from beneath is moved for thee to meet thee at thy coming: that is all the nations rising up against America and Israel. It stirreth up the dead for thee, even all the chief ones of the earth: all the kings of the nations, China, Europe, Russia, Iran, raised up from their thrones. They shall say unto thee, art thou also become weak as we? art thou become like unto us? All that pride is brought down to the grave. - The fir trees rejoice at thee, and the cedars of Lebanon, saying, since thou art laid down, no feller is come up against us. This means the Israeli government is going to keep making war with Lebanon, because after Babylon is destroyed, Lebanon says since thou art laid down, nobody has come up against us. The war in Lebanon is not going to stop. Habakkuk 2:15-17 35:24 - Woe unto him that giveth his neighbour drink, that puttest thy bottle to him. That drink goes into the cup the Lord gave to Babylon, that all nations should drink of it: affliction, death, and destruction. That is Israel and America oppressing the people over there, looking on their nakedness, on their shame. - Thou art filled with shame for glory: drink thou also. God says now you have to drink the same cup you were making the Lebanese and the Palestinians drink. The cup of the Lord's right hand shall be turned unto thee. - And it tells you why: for the violence of Lebanon shall cover thee, and the spoil of beasts, which made them afraid, because of men's blood. Because of all the murdering and bombing being done in Lebanon. Netanyahu says he is not stopping; but God says Lebanon is not going to be destroyed. You might take little pieces of land over there, but the violence of Lebanon shall cover thee. 2 Esdras 15:20 38:57 - Behold, saith God, I will call together all the kings of the earth, from the rising of the sun, from the south, from the east, and Libanus, to turn themselves one against another, and repay the things that they have done to them. Libanus is Lebanon; God is going to have them fight against each other. - And repay the things that they have done to them: it is because of what they did to us, going into slavery. - Lebanon in the Bible is referred to as Tyrus, and also as Tyre and Zidon. Zidon is lower Lebanon, the part the Israeli government occupies right now in southern Lebanon, and Tyre is upper Lebanon. So when you read Joel about Tyre and Zidon, you understand. Originally Hamitic tribes occupied that land; the Arabs conquered them and took it. And the same thing the Hamitic tribes did, the Arabs did too: they did the same thing to us, going into slavery. John 3:6-8 52:01 - That which is born of the flesh is flesh; and that which is born of the Spirit is spirit. Marvel not that I said unto thee, ye must be born again. - The wind bloweth where it listeth: that wind blowing where it will is the word of God. You do not know who the word of God is going to affect. Thou hearest the sound thereof: we heard this truth, we heard that call, and it activated us. The Lord has his agents on the earth; you hear a certain word and you wake up. So is every one that is born of the Spirit. Precepts: - Isaiah 30:20-21 Though the Lord give you the bread of adversity, and the water of affliction, yet shall not thy teachers be removed into a corner any more. And thine ears shall hear a word behind thee, saying, This is the way, walk ye in it. That word that you hear is how you are born of the spirit. Proverbs 17:17 55:49 - A friend loveth at all times, and a brother is born for adversity. This goes two ways. Number one, you and your brothers are going to go through things together. But also, when a brother comes into this truth, when you are born into this truth, you will have to go through adversity. - Why is it that when you learn this truth, that you are an Israelite, and you start keeping the commandments, you have to go through adversity? That is what the rest of the lesson shows. Isaiah 59:15 57:07 - Yea, truth faileth; and he that departeth from evil maketh himself a prey. Departing from evil is what we read in John: being born again. You wake up to this truth, you say let me serve God, you depart from evil. - You make yourself a target. Not just everyone against you, but the number one enemy: Satan. Once you change your life and you are trying to do right, Satan is coming for you. Here comes the ex you have not seen in five years, hitting you up now that you changed your life. Satan's job is to destroy every last one of us that is born. Romans 7:9-10 59:25 - Paul says, I was alive without the law once: that is when he was under the old covenant. But when the commandment came, sin revived, and I died. And the commandment, which was ordained to life, I found to be unto death. - Sin revived: when you come to serve God, after a while you say, I was not dealing with this before; where did this demon come from? Satan is trying to destroy you. Sin becomes harder to battle now because you are aware of it and you have changed your life; it is warfare. 1 Peter 5:8-10 1:00:51 - Be sober, be vigilant; because your adversary the devil, as a roaring lion, walketh about, seeking whom he may devour. That is the hunter. He is trying to devour those of us that depart from iniquity. This is the spiritual demon; his children also do the same, but the focus right now is that old demon you cannot see. - Whom resist stedfast in the faith: when those lusts and desires come, you must resist him. Resist the devil and he shall flee. - Knowing that the same afflictions are accomplished in your brethren that are in the world. The same lusts and fights you are going through, your brothers are going through the same thing. Do not think it is just you alone struggling. Satan is coming for all of us. - But the God of all grace, who hath called us unto his eternal glory by Christ Jesus, after that ye have suffered a while, make you perfect, stablish, strengthen, settle you. None of us is getting the kingdom unless we suffer. You want to be established? You want to be strengthened? You have to suffer. We have to embrace the suffering, because when you suffer, it makes you perfect. - When you ask God to make you strong, you are asking him to send affliction your way. Even in the gym you do not become muscular and strong without pain. And when you keep working out, the pain gets more bearable, because you are becoming stronger. Job 1:6-22 1:09:51 - Satan came also among the sons of God, from going to and fro in the earth. What is Satan doing going to and fro in the earth? He is looking whom he may devour. Satan has a role to play: his role is to tempt us, to bring affliction, and to try us. And in fighting him, it makes us perfect in the sight of God. - Hast thou not made an hedge about him? A hedge is protection. The hedge is angels; you have bodyguards. Remember Elisha, and the angels and chariots around him protecting him. Some of our kids are under our house, under our protection, so Satan has not come for them yet; but when that hedge is removed, eventually Satan comes. - The Lord said, all that he hath is in thy power; only upon himself put not forth thine hand. The Lord will not allow you to be tempted more than you are able to bear. Sometimes you get in an accident and the car is totaled but nothing happened to you; everything that happens to us in this truth has a reason behind it. - Satan used the Sabeans to take the oxen and asses; fire fell from heaven and burned up the sheep and the servants; the Chaldeans took the camels; and a great wind smote the house and all Job's children died. Remember who is doing this: Satan. He uses people. When somebody comes at you on your job trying to get you fired, that is Satan using that person. And all of this happened in one day. - Then Job arose, and rent his mantle, and worshipped, and said, Naked came I out of my mother's womb, and naked shall I return thither: the Lord gave, and the Lord hath taken away; blessed be the name of the Lord. In all this Job sinned not, nor charged God foolishly. He did not say, God, why did you do this to me? That is the state of mind we have to have. Did it hurt him? He was feeling it. But when bad things happen to us, we have to know the Lord allowed it, and trust him that there is a reason why. - When Job did not break, Satan told the Lord, let me touch his flesh, let me get him sick. It is the same today. Some brothers and sisters are sick right now. But sometimes the Lord allows a brother or sister to get sick to build their faith, because when do you pray the most? When the doctor gives you a year to live. And when the Lord heals you, it increases your faith and teaches you the power of prayer. - Job's life is a template for what each one of us will have to go through. 2 Esdras 7:6-14 1:26:00 - A city is builded and set upon a broad field, and is full of all good things; the entrance thereof is narrow, and is set in a dangerous place to fall, like as if there were a fire on the right hand, and on the left a deep water, and only one path between them both, so small that there could but one man go there at once. That city is the kingdom of heaven. Only one man can go at a time: all of us have to go through it ourselves. I cannot hold your hand. The most I can do is give you the scriptures; whatever it is, imprisonment, sickness, loss of a family member, you have to go through it and bear it. - If this city now were given unto a man for an inheritance, if he never shall pass the danger set before it, how shall he receive this inheritance? Those dangers are the pain, the affliction, what Job went through. And he said, even so also is Israel's portion. Those of us that wake up to this truth of who we are, that is our portion. - When Adam transgressed my statutes, then was decreed that now is done. Before, the kingdom was given to us; now we have to work for it, fight Satan, and go through the pain to get the kingdom. Then were the entrances of this world made narrow, full of sorrow and travail; they are but few and evil, full of perils, and very painful. The years we are on this earth, we have to be fighting Satan; and that pain is good, because it molds you. It makes you who you are. - For the entrances of the elder world were wide and sure, and brought immortal fruit. The elder world is when Adam was ruling before he fell; we all were immortal. If they that live labour not to enter these strait and vain things, they can never receive those that are laid up for them. 2 Esdras 7:57-58 1:30:55 - This is the condition of the battle, which man that is born upon the earth shall fight: that, if he be overcome, he shall suffer as thou hast said; but if he get the victory, he shall receive the thing that I say. If you allow Satan to overcome you, you will suffer damnation. But if you get the victory, and that is what we all want, you receive the kingdom of heaven. Micah 4:10 1:32:38 - Be in pain, and labour to bring forth, O daughter of Zion. That pain is affliction; that pain is tribulation; all the bad things that happen when you come to serve the Lord. - And while you are going through that pain, you still have to labour to bring forth. Even though bad things are happening to us, we still have to labour. Matthew 10:16-22 1:33:46 - You pray, God, use IUIC, push thy word to the four corners of the earth. But you need to understand what you are asking for; you have to pray with understanding. - Behold, I send you forth as sheep in the midst of wolves: be ye therefore wise as serpents, and harmless as doves. This is the Lord using us; he sent us among wolves. - But beware of men: for they will deliver you up to the councils, and they will scourge you in their synagogues; and ye shall be brought before governors and kings for my sake. Why would you be brought before kings and nobles? Because you are locked up, arrested, in chains, labeled a terrorist. Remember what the Lord told Peter: when thou shalt be old, another shall carry thee whither thou wouldest not. Remember Jeremiah, locked in the dungeon. If you want God to use you, you might go to jail. - But when they deliver you up, take no thought how or what ye shall speak: for it shall be given you in that same hour. For it is not ye that speak, but the Spirit of your Father which speaketh in you. That means God is using you, even while you are bound. - And the brother shall deliver up the brother to death: if God is using you, people will betray you. - And ye shall be hated of all men for my name's sake. Are you ready to be hated by all men? The only people that are going to love you are the people that love God; and this world does not love God. If you have the state of mind that you want to be loved by everybody, this is not the place for you. 2 Corinthians 11:23-33 1:38:38 - Are they ministers of Christ? I am more: in labours more abundant, in stripes above measure. Paul was beaten above measure. Why? Because God was using him. This is the affliction and suffering every last one of us will have to go through if we want to serve God. - In prisons more frequent: Paul went to jail on the regular. Of the Jews five times received I forty stripes save one: that is nearly 200 lashes, just from the Jews. Thrice was I beaten with rods, once was I stoned: that is when he was stoned and left for dead and came back. - Thrice I suffered shipwreck, a night and a day I have been in the deep. Who was doing all these things to Paul? Satan. In perils of waters, of robbers, by mine own countrymen, by the heathen, in the city, in the wilderness, in the sea, and among false brethren: fake, phony brothers. - In weariness and painfulness, in watchings often, in hunger and thirst, in fastings often, in cold and nakedness; beside those things that are without, that which cometh upon me daily, the care of all the churches. Why was Paul going through all these things? Because he turned to righteousness, and Satan came for him. - In Damascus the governor kept the city with a garrison, desirous to apprehend him; they were trying to lock Paul up for teaching the word of God, and through a window in a basket was he let down by the wall, and escaped. It was not his time yet; but that was Satan there too, trying to destroy Paul. 2 Corinthians 1:4-11 1:45:06 - Who comforteth us in all our tribulation, that we may be able to comfort them which are in any trouble. As the sufferings of Christ abound in us, so our consolation also aboundeth by Christ. Whether we be afflicted, it is for your consolation and salvation, which is effectual in the enduring of the same sufferings. The key thing is that we have to endure. - Bad things are going to happen on personal levels first; then it goes to another level, where the dragon makes war with us, where the government comes against us and labels us a hate group. First it starts with the personal, with the things in your flesh the Lord wants to get out of you. - We would not have you ignorant of our trouble which came to us in Asia, that we were pressed out of measure, above strength, insomuch that we despaired even of life. But we had the sentence of death in ourselves: Paul and the brothers with him made up their minds that they were ready to die. Christ said, whosoever he be of you that forsaketh not all that he hath, he cannot be my disciple. That is the level we have to build our faith and spirit to as soldiers in Christ. - That we should not trust in ourselves, but in God which raiseth the dead: they had the sentence of death in themselves because they knew the Lord would bring them back. - Ye also helping together by prayer for us. This is the key thing: when bad things are happening, we have to pray. Fasting and prayer, that is our power right now. Paul thanked them for the prayers sent up, because the Lord delivered them. 2 Thessalonians 1:4-6 1:50:44 - We glory in you for your patience and faith in all your persecutions and tribulations that ye endure. You keep reading about the persecutions our forefathers and the believers in Christ went through; the same thing is going to happen again. We must endure; we cannot give up when things get bad. - Which is a manifest token of the righteous judgment of God, that ye may be counted worthy of the kingdom of God, for which ye also suffer. When you go through affliction and endure it, that is how the Lord counts who is worthy. - Seeing it is a righteous thing with God to recompense tribulation to them that trouble you. The people that bring affliction on us and trouble us, God says he is going to pay them back. So do not worry. Ecclesiasticus 38:22 1:52:05 - Remember my judgment: for thine also shall be so; yesterday for me, and to day for thee. Sometimes you watch a brother going through things, a brother sick, a sister sick, a house burned down, a brother that lost his son; and because it is not you, you disconnect, you do not feel it. - But your time is coming when tribulation and affliction come on you. Yesterday for me, tomorrow for you. So when you see brothers going through things, we have to pray for each other. The scripture says when one member suffers, all the members suffer with it, and to bear ye one another's burdens. You hear a brother is sick and you are not sending up a prayer? Come on. Hebrews 12:1-8 1:57:24 - Let us lay aside every weight, and the sin which doth so easily beset us: everybody has that one sin that is hard to fight. And let us run with patience the race that is set before us: you cannot run this race fast. - Looking unto Jesus the author and finisher of our faith; who for the joy that was set before him endured the cross. He could have called angels, but he had to endure it, despising the shame. Consider him that endured such contradiction of sinners against himself, lest ye be wearied and faint in your minds. Some people become weary and give up and go back into the world, because nobody wants to suffer; and it starts in your mind. We have to use how Christ suffered as our example. - Ye have not yet resisted unto blood, striving against sin. Right now we are all being built up, but we have not resisted unto blood yet. What does that mean? When Christ said, whosoever shall deny me before men, him will I also deny, it is talking about when your life is on the line: whether you will turn your back on Christ while you are being persecuted, being tortured, facing years in prison for teaching the word of God. That is resisting unto blood: enduring this truth while you go through that. Some of you will remember this class and say, Deacon talked about these things, because I see what is coming. - My son, despise not thou the chastening of the Lord, nor faint when thou art rebuked of him: for whom the Lord loveth he chasteneth, and scourgeth every son whom he receiveth. Why are bad things happening to you? Because God loves you. - If ye endure chastening, God dealeth with you as with sons; for what son is he whom the father chasteneth not? But if ye be without chastisement, then are ye bastards, and not sons. If you are not going through anything, either you belong to Satan, or the Lord is just not ready for you yet; he is still building you up. All of us have to go through things; that is what molds us and makes us perfect. Hebrews 12:11-16 2:07:35 - Now no chastening for the present seemeth to be joyous, but grievous: nevertheless afterward it yieldeth the peaceable fruit of righteousness unto them which are exercised thereby. When you go through things, that affliction and correction make you better; you bring forth fruits. - Wherefore lift up the hands which hang down, and the feeble knees: because sometimes when things go bad in your life, or you get corrected, you hang your hands down, sad all the time. Make straight paths for your feet, lest that which is lame be turned out of the way: you do not want to be in this truth four or five years and turn back into the world because of correction. But let it rather be healed. Let that correction heal you; do not sit and listen to Satan telling you they hate you. - Follow peace with all men, and holiness, without which no man shall see the Lord. You could end up hating the person that corrected you; if you become bitter over correction, you are not going to see God. - Looking diligently lest any root of bitterness springing up trouble you, and thereby many be defiled.
