The rest Christ offers is rest from the sorrow, the fear, and the hard bondage of Israel's captivity. That is who come unto me is addressed to. Prayer of Azariah 1:1-6 2:48:58 - The three Hebrew brothers walked in the midst of the fire praising God, and Azarias prayed in the midst of the fire: blessed art thou, O Lord God of our fathers; for thou art righteous in all the things that thou hast done to us. Imagine that: cast into the fire by Nebuchadnezzar, made eunuchs, the temple destroyed, and they said, thou art righteous in all that thou hast done to us; in all the things thou hast brought upon us, and upon the holy city of our fathers, even Jerusalem, thou hast executed true judgment. - For according to truth and judgment didst thou bring all these things upon us because of our sins. They understood that thing. We deserved what we got. Our people today have a hard time understanding that: for we have sinned and committed iniquity, departing from thee. Isaiah 14:1 2:50:58 - For the Lord will have mercy on Jacob, and will yet choose Israel. We are messed up as a people, but because of the covenant with Abraham, Isaac, and Jacob, he will yet choose us. That is mercy. Thank God for mercy. Lamentations 4:1-2 2:51:35 - How is the gold become dim! how is the most fine gold changed! The precious sons of Zion, comparable to fine gold, how are they esteemed as earthen pitchers, the work of the hands of the potter! At one time we were the gold, the jewels, the golden cup; today we are esteemed as clay pots. One has value, one does not. That is us today, and that is what this whole class has been looking at. Leviticus 26:44-45 2:52:52 - And yet for all that, when they be in the land of their enemies, I will not cast them away, neither will I abhor them, to destroy them utterly, and to break my covenant with them: for I am the Lord their God. But I will for their sakes remember the covenant of their ancestors, whom I brought forth out of the land of Egypt in the sight of the heathen. Who said bloodline is not important? The Bible says he will remember the covenant of your ancestors. Precepts: - Luke 1:68-74 The New Testament says the same thing: blessed be the Lord God of Israel; for he hath visited and redeemed his people, and hath raised up an horn of salvation for us in the house of his servant David; that we should be saved from our enemies, and from the hand of all that hate us; to perform the mercy promised to our fathers, and to remember his holy covenant; the oath which he sware to our father Abraham. Hebrews 8:8-10 2:54:55 - Here is a question to ask Christians who know about the split of the kingdom: where is the northern kingdom in the New Testament? They do not know. Behold, the days come, saith the Lord, when I will make a new covenant with the house of Israel and with the house of Judah. Both kingdoms are mentioned right here. - For this is the covenant that I will make with the house of Israel after those days, saith the Lord; I will put my laws into their mind, and write them in their hearts: and I will be to them a God, and they shall be to me a people. The new covenant is God's laws written in Israel's mind and heart, not the laws done away. 2 Chronicles 7:14 2:56:24 - A famous scripture that hung in many of our mothers' houses, that all the churches use but do not understand. If my people, which are called by my name, shall humble themselves, and pray, and seek my face, and turn from their wicked ways: turn means repent. Then will I hear from heaven: remember, his ear is not heavy that it cannot hear, but our iniquities separated us. Now he gives the solution. And will forgive their sin, and will heal their land. 1 Samuel 2:6-8 2:57:36 - The Lord killeth, and maketh alive: he bringeth down to the grave, and bringeth up. The Lord maketh poor, and maketh rich: he bringeth low, and lifteth up. Who did you think made us poor? - He raiseth up the poor out of the dust, and lifteth up the beggar from the dunghill. This is Hannah's prayer; the Holy Spirit through a woman said this. Why beggars? Because we are the ones always begging another race of people for reparations, for jobs, for services, instead of building with our own, because our own are not well as a people. And the dunghill is not just one poor country; wherever we live in this captivity has been made a dunghill compared to what we came from, because we came from ruling. - To set them among princes, and to make them inherit the throne of glory: for the pillars of the earth are the Lord's, and he hath set the world upon them. From the dunghill to the throne of glory: that is planet rulership. Isaiah 59:16-21 3:00:33 - And he saw that there was no man, and wondered that there was no intercessor: therefore his arm brought salvation unto him. The arm is Christ; sit thou at my right hand. - For he put on righteousness as a breastplate, and an helmet of salvation upon his head; and he put on the garments of vengeance for clothing, and was clad with zeal as a cloke. He is not coming back for handshakes; he put on the garments of vengeance. According to their deeds, accordingly he will repay: fury to his adversaries, recompence to his enemies, and to the islands he will repay. And not only the other nations: unrepentant Israelites get the same judgment. - So shall they fear the name of the Lord from the west: prophetically, we are in the west, the western hemisphere. And his glory from the rising of the sun: the eastern hemisphere. When the enemy shall come in like a flood, the Spirit of the Lord shall lift up a standard against him: he is only going to allow Esau to do but so much. - And the Redeemer shall come to Zion, and unto them that turn from transgression in Jacob, saith the Lord. See who he is coming for: them that turn from transgression, because of everything listed from verse two down to verse fifteen. My spirit that is upon thee, and my words which I have put in thy mouth, shall not depart out of thy mouth, nor out of the mouth of thy seed, nor out of the mouth of thy seed's seed, saith the Lord, from henceforth and for ever. Matthew 5:14 3:05:48 (Deacon's addition) - We read in Corinthians a whole list of sins, and then it says, and such were some of you. That is the black community. Christianity wants us to forget God's commandments and confuses the law with animal sacrifice, but it is the commandments that identify if I am a thief, a fornicator, a liar, a covetous man. The law of God has to expose those demons, sin has to be brought out, and repentance has to come forth. That is how we become the righteous city. - Ye are the light of the world. A city that is set on an hill cannot be hid. The black community is basically the city, and it is the kingdom. If we do not get rid of the sin, we can never be that proper city the Lord is building where the light shineth. We have to learn how to apply God's commandments; that is how we build that city and grow like that mustard seed into great righteousness. Genesis 1:26-28 3:07:32 (Officer's addition) - Men, we want dominion, we want rulership, we want to subdue the nations. The government must be in place, and in that we must be keeping the commandments; it is the only way we are going to get it. - And God said, Let us make man in our image, after our likeness: and let them have dominion. Be fruitful, and multiply, and replenish the earth, and subdue it. Being made after his image, we were supposed to subdue the earth and bring everything underfoot. At that time everybody was of color, but God gave a specific people rulership; so when you read likeness, understand it is more than what you look like. Precepts: - Psalms 17:15 As for me, I will behold thy face in righteousness: I shall be satisfied, when I awake, with thy likeness. His likeness is not just appearance; it is being righteous. And in being righteous we will subdue and have dominion. That government cannot happen unless we are righteous. In Closing We definitely needed those commandments tonight, brothers and sisters. The class was a mirror: the wasteland is real, the curses are real, and the same Bible that describes our condition gives the solution: humble ourselves, pray, seek his face, and turn from our wicked ways, and he will hear from heaven, forgive our sin, and heal our land. Also premiered after class: the Watch and Read video telling the history of the Israelite movement from the beginning, from Adam through the twelve tribes, Egypt, the kingdom, and the split of the two kingdoms. If you are going to call yourself an Israelite, you need to know this history; do not let anyone else put our history together for us. Announcements & References - Sit down, with Fred Price Jr.: Captain Mattathias, Captain Galayah, and Captain Zakar sat down this week with Fred Price Jr.; clips were reviewed in class on salvation, works, the law, and the feast days. - Field report: the prophets blessed Chicago's 2026 Puerto Rican Day parade, waking our people up to their true nationality; though facing much hatred, mockery, and resistance, the word was preached boldly in both English and Spanish. - Field report: IUIC Lawton, teamed up with the Northern Kingdom events office and schools from Austin, Dallas, Tulsa, New Mexico, and OKC, held a neighborhood takeover with two barbershop sit downs and two camps. - Field report: IUIC Orlando spoke at the Luster African American Museum's Black History festival; portraits of the bishops, Paul, Moses, and the black Messiah, Jesus the Christ, will now be on permanent display in the museum. - Diaspora outreach: a video on the AfroIranians, our people scattered along Iran's southern coast through the Indian Ocean slave trade; the true twelve tribes are waking up in every corner of the earth. To support the diaspora work, email iuic.diaspora at israelunite.org. - Original Royalty: Deacon Isaac's album Eternal Glory arrives July 12th, dedicated to the memory of his late wife Sister Yoella, with features from the Sons of Thunder, Samson, Yurion, and Captain Yuri. Also released: the Royal Range clothing line, premium cotton twill and Nappa leather fringes under the border of blue, at originalroyalty.com. - The Until All Are Served fundraiser returns August 1st, bigger and better: twenty dollar adult plates, ten dollar kids plates, with meals prepared from IUIC kitchens everywhere; New York City won the first round. - Israel Live: scan the QR code to vote for next week's episode, Monday nights at 9:00 pm. - Memorial: IUIC Augusta celebrated the life of Levia Joanna Israel, of the house of Captain Tobias, giving thanks for every moment shared with her; we look toward the coming kingdom, where we shall see our sister again. Dates: the new moon is June 30th, Tuesday, at sundown. The upcoming voluntary fast is July 3rd, Friday, at sundown. Closing reading: 1 Corinthians 11:23-29, the bread and the cup, in remembrance of the Lord's death till he come; let a man examine himself. --- Class Notes Index Transcript: full session

title: SEXUAL DISCIPLINE
text: Introduction Happy new moon, Israel. Tonight is a new moon feast, so we are going to touch a couple of scriptures concerning the new moon and then go into the lesson prepared for tonight. The topic is sexual discipline. The summer is here, and the job of a leader and a teacher is to know the state of the flock. A lot of brothers and sisters keep falling into sexual sins. This is going to be a two part lesson. Some of you young men are caught up with pornography; a lot of you are battling that right there, and this class goes into the scriptures you can use to help you overcome that demon. Not just you brothers, but you sisters too, because everyone has to learn sexual discipline; some sisters get caught up in fornication and some sisters watch porn too. Sometimes we forget to talk about that. What I am hoping out of this lesson is to give you what you need to fight and to overcome the demons you are fighting. Our forefathers always exercised sexual discipline. In this society today it is hard, and it is hard for a reason. It is hard by design. Scriptures Opened Psalms 81:3-4 10:22 - Blow up the trumpet in the new moon, in the time appointed, on our solemn feast day. The trumpet was blown to gather Israel together, and not just on the new moon: it was blown on the Sabbath, on all the solemn feast days, over the offerings. When you read Numbers, the trumpet was also blown when we had to go to war, it was blown for alarm, and it was blown if we wanted God to come and fight for us. That is why in the seventh month we celebrate the memorial of blowing of trumpets. - For this was a statute for Israel, and a law of the God of Jacob. It is a statute to blow up the trumpets in the new moon and to come together every new moon. Every new moon is a solemn assembly. It is a law. Numbers 10:10 12:52 - Also in the day of your gladness: the days of our gladness are our feast days, the days where we come together and have fun. In your solemn days: your holy days. And in the beginnings of your months: the beginning of every month. We blew the trumpets over our burnt offerings and over the sacrifices of our peace offerings, that they may be for a memorial before your God. - So in the beginning of the months God commanded us to come together. It is a solemn feast day. That is why we are here. Matthew 19:12 23:31 - First understand what sex is for. God put Adam in the flesh and told him to be fruitful and multiply. Sex was designed for procreation, and it is done between a married man and a married woman. It is also pleasurable, and while you are procreating it brings you and your wife closer; when you lay down with that woman you build a bond with her, and you and her become one flesh. What our people have done today, and what our people did in the past, is take away the procreation and the becoming one, and just use it for pleasure. That is the whole society now: it is just about getting that feeling. Some deal with prostitutes, some watch porn. Our righteous forefathers practiced sexual discipline, and if we want the kingdom of heaven we also have to learn to practice it. - Some eunuchs were so born from their mother's womb: born with the manhood not working. Some were made eunuchs of men, like Daniel when he went into captivity. And some have made themselves eunuchs for the kingdom of heaven's sake: like Paul. Paul could have married, but he disciplined himself not to have sex and not to get married because of the kingdom of heaven's sake; he had a lot of work to do. - Christ also did that. Christ had sexual discipline. Did Christ have sexual urges? Yes; he was tempted in all points, everything you could think of, but he did not give in to them. Paul did not give in to his sexual urges. John the Baptist practiced sexual discipline. They made up their minds for the kingdom of heaven's sake to abstain from marriage and abstain from sex. 1 Timothy 5:11-12 29:46 - What is the opposite of the eunuch for the women? The widow. A lot of times when people read about widows they think it is just a woman whose husband died, but it was much more than that. There are two types: a sister whose husband died, and a woman who makes a vow to serve God, to fast and pray, and to help the brothers and sisters in the body. Judith was young when her husband died, and she said, I will dedicate my life to the Lord; she was fasting most of the week, and she made a vow to God not to marry again. The same way some men became eunuchs for the kingdom of heaven's sake, some women made a vow to follow the Lord and not deal with a man, for the kingdom's sake. - But the younger widows refuse: when they have begun to wax wanton against Christ, they will marry, having damnation, because they have cast off their first faith. Is it wrong for them to get married? No; the damnation comes because they took the vow of widowhood, they made a vow to control their desires and serve God, and they broke that vow. So Paul said refuse the young women that come around saying they want to be widows, because they are going to bring condemnation on themselves. Leviticus 19:30 33:46 - Ye shall keep my sabbaths: not just the seventh day; the new moon, the Passover, all the high holy days. And reverence my sanctuary: because on his sabbaths there is a holy convocation, a holy gathering, and it was commanded for all of us to go up and serve the Lord. Leviticus 15:16-18 34:58 - If any man's seed of copulation go out from him, he shall wash all his flesh in water and be unclean until the evening. If it touched any garment or skin, that had to be washed too. And when a man lay with his wife, they both had to bathe themselves in water and be unclean until the evening. So by the law, after sex you were unclean until evening. Leviticus 15:31 36:21 - Thus shall ye separate the children of Israel from their uncleanness, that they die not in their uncleanness, when they defile my tabernacle that is among them. The tabernacle was the temple. So could you have sex and go up to the temple on the new moon or on the Sabbath? No, because you would be unclean, and you cannot go up to the temple unclean. The priests doing the service, and all of us, since it was a commandment to come up to the tabernacle and worship God every high holy day, had to control the sexual appetite. Our forefathers practiced sexual discipline. - Tonight is a feast day, but this is not the tabernacle, so that law does not apply today, and we are not going to put that burden on you. But it shows you the discipline that was required. Isaiah 66:23 39:17 - And it shall come to pass, that from one new moon to another, and from one sabbath to another, shall all flesh come to worship before me, saith the Lord. When Christ returns, all of us have to go up and worship before Christ. When that third temple is built, guess what: we cannot go up in there unclean. So the discipline our forefathers had to practice is going to be the same thing when Christ returns. 2 Esdras 5:1-2 40:54 - Why is it so hard for us today? It is by design. The days shall come that they which dwell upon earth shall be taken in a great number: this is talking about the time of the Lord's return, the third woe. The way of truth shall be hidden: that is the time we are living in right now; the teaching that we are the Israelites is hid. The land shall be barren of faith. - But iniquity shall be increased above that which now thou seest, or that thou hast heard long ago. Sin is going to increase above anything you have ever seen on this earth, and above what you heard long ago: what you heard was taking place in Sodom and Gomorrah. In the last days it is going to be worse than Sodom and Gomorrah. So you ask yourself, why am I dealing with lust all the time, why do certain thoughts keep coming into my mind? It is because of the society you are living in. It is by design, and that means the fight we have to fight is even harder. Isaiah 60:2 43:30 - For behold, the darkness shall cover the earth: darkness is wickedness and sin. And gross darkness the people: the people there is the twelve tribes of Israel. Darkness covers the earth, but on the children of Israel there is even more darkness. Look around society today: who is the one oversexualizing everything, being promiscuous and killing babies on a higher level than anyone else? It is us, the Israelites, the blacks and Hispanics. And the nations make proverbs of us, saying our culture is nothing, because the culture being pushed on us is sex, money, and murder. This week was the BET Awards: that is a very destructive culture; all it pushes is sex, money, murder, women shaking half naked on the television. - When you are in this flesh and exposed to certain things, it messes with your psychology. We are being attacked with psychological warfare. Revelation 11:8 47:04 - Their dead bodies shall lie in the street of the great city: dead bodies because we are in a dead state of mind; we do not know who we are and we are in the midst of sin. Which spiritually is called Sodom and Egypt: America is spiritually called Sodom and Egypt. Egypt, because we were enslaved here, we are oppressed here, we are in bondage here. But why Sodom? - When you read about Sodom, what runs through your mind is homosexuality. But in Sodom and Gomorrah it was not just that: it was women being promiscuous, it was every kind of uncleanness; everything was sexualized. If America is spiritually Sodom, you think it is one sin alone here? You have adultery everywhere, every kind of perversion, women and men promiscuous, not for marriage and procreation but just for pleasure. Everywhere you turn, everything is sexualized. That is exactly how it was in Sodom and Gomorrah, and that is how it started. - Documentary played in class: a 1980 documentary filmed on 42nd Street in New York, showing very young black and Hispanic children being bought and sold for sex in Times Square. The teaching point: remember, in Sodom old and young came after the angels; this land is spiritually Sodom, and it has been preying on our children for decades. Jeremiah 23:14 50:07 - I have seen also in the prophets of Jerusalem an horrible thing: they commit adultery, and walk in lies; they are all of them unto me as Sodom, and the inhabitants thereof as Gomorrah. God said his people, our people, back in the time of Jeremiah were like Sodom and Gomorrah: adultery and all types of filthiness. So this is not new to our people, and it is not just one sin; it goes into adultery and promiscuity. Today you meet a woman you like and she has already been with many men and none of them married her; I am just having fun, I am enjoying my life. That was the same spirit back then in Sodom and Gomorrah. Videos played in class on the design behind it: - Why is porn so easily accessed today? Any device these kids have, it pops up on it. When the teacher was growing up you had to get a VHS to see it, and there was one TV in the house. Today they make it easy on purpose. It is by design. - A clip was played where the speakers said studies show porn functions like a hardcore drug, stronger than any substance measured; because you always need a harder hit, it escalates you into darker and darker content, until people end up questioning their own nature. It is the best way to destroy a civilization that has no moral muscle left to be a threat to evil. The teacher confirmed it from experience: I used to watch porn when I was young, and stopping was very, very hard. The Most High had to correct me more than once. - News read in class: two Philadelphia pastors were charged with sexual exploitation and abuse of children, accused of soliciting explicit videos from minors in exchange for money or food. The teaching point: that is where this road ends; keep playing with porn and the demon takes you into full perversion. - News played in class: a Chinese company opened pre orders for a full size humanoid robot built for emotional companionship, in male and female versions. Brothers, there is no statute in Babylon against buying one, but that is where the porn road leads: robots, dolls, everything except a real covenant marriage. - A comedy skit was played of a wife demanding rough, porn style treatment from her husband. The question is, where is she getting those ideas from? When a woman is demanding that, she is either watching porn or she got that experience from a promiscuous past. Porn defiles the sisters also. In marriage, what a husband and wife agree on between themselves is between them; but when porn is scripting your desires, that is out of order. Mark 3:27 1:13:59 - No man can enter into a strong man's house, and spoil his goods, except he will first bind the strong man. You are the strong man of your house. When you as the leader of the house are watching porn, it does not just affect you. It affects your wife, it affects your kids, and you do not even see it. You are inviting demons into your house; all of a sudden your kids start acting different and your wife has demons on her. Why? Because you opened that door. - Much worse, she opens your phone one time and sees that thing on your phone. Now she is saying, you do not find me attractive, you do not desire me, and she starts dealing with low self esteem. Porn will destroy our marriages. It is not worth it. When you open that door, you are allowing Satan up in your house. - Satan tells you it is not that bad, you are not literally sleeping with another woman, it is just something you are watching. That is Satan making you downplay it, but really and truly it is destroying your house. 2 Thessalonians 2:10 1:16:40 - And with all deceivableness of unrighteousness in them that perish. A lot of times we read this about Esau deceiving the earth with Christianity, but pay attention: our people that perish are deceived in unrighteousness. How do they deceive us with unrighteousness? You are in the movie theater watching a regular action movie and suddenly there is perversion on the screen, or a sex scene so explicit it is pornography in itself. When you keep watching that, you think it is okay, and kids watching it think it is okay. That is deceivableness in unrighteousness. - The white man understands psychology, so he is planting seeds in our minds. You are a single brother battling porn, and you watch that scene: that urge is going to creep up on you. You sisters battling the same thing, that spirit creeps up on you the same way. These things are designed to deceive you into committing sin. - Why do they put women half naked all over the music videos and social media instead of stopping it? Because it is deceivableness in unrighteousness. It makes it a norm, so society thinks it is okay, and it keeps our people in the midst of sin, battling. For those of us living in this time, it is going to be even harder than in the days of our forefathers, because evil has multiplied. That is why we need the mercies of Christ. Romans 7:10-11 1:23:34 - Sin, taking occasion by the commandment, deceived me. Sin will deceive you. Brothers want to do right; I know you want to stop certain things. But why do you still go back and do it? Because sin deceives you. If this whole society is built on sin and you are around it all the time, it will deceive you. In the beginning God took the righteous away so the wickedness would not corrupt them; it is the same thing today. This society is very evil and wicked, and if all you see every day is certain things, it will affect you. 2 Corinthians 2:11 1:25:51 - Lest Satan should get an advantage of us: for we are not ignorant of his devices. You cannot be ignorant of the things Satan uses to get an advantage over us. What are some of them? Movies. Social media. Everything in this society, and the devices are literal too: these phones. His job is to deceive you to commit sin. Once you understand his devices, you are already ahead in the game. If you are watching a movie and a sex scene comes on, do not sit there with the popcorn taking it in; you are being deceived, and you will go home and that thought will come to your mind to go back to the porn. 1 Corinthians 15:33 1:28:53 - Be not deceived: evil communications corrupt good manners. What you look at, what you listen to, who you talk to: it can deceive you. You are in this truth; why are you talking to your ex? She calls just to see how you are doing, and you are supposed to cut it short, but you are on the phone for hours reminiscing. That is evil communication. Now you are over at her apartment, and sin is conceived, and sin bringeth forth death. And do not tell me you went over there to teach her some scriptures; that is what brothers always say. Galatians 5:16-19 1:32:26 - Walk in the spirit, and ye shall not fulfil the lust of the flesh. The flesh lusteth against the spirit, and the spirit against the flesh: it is a war going on. You want to do good, but that lust is inside you. You want to stop; you stop for a week, two weeks, then it comes back; you pray and it is still there. It is a war between the spirit of Christ in you and this body that wants pleasure. And these are contrary the one to the other, so that ye cannot do the things that ye would. - The works of the flesh are manifest, which are these: adultery, fornication, uncleanness. All of these fall under the sexual sins. - Sexual discipline applies inside marriage too. When your wife gives birth, you have to wait forty days, sometimes eighty. When your wife is in her seven days you cannot touch her. And guess what: Satan does not come when you are dealing with your woman; he comes when you are not getting any. That is where the fight starts. So those days are the days you get closer to the Lord: I am going to fast more, I am going to occupy myself with the Lord. That is how you train yourself to have sexual discipline. As men we cannot let pleasure control us. Precepts: - Romans 13:14 Put ye on the Lord Jesus Christ, and make not provision for the flesh, to fulfil the lusts thereof. To make provision is to make a way for you to fulfil that lust, to leave doors open for that sin. Why be on the phone with your ex? If you are struggling, delete the apps; put controls on your phone so you cannot go on certain things. People say, I made a mistake, I slipped and fell. No: there was planning, you were talking first, you planned what day to meet up; it was already in your mind. It was a decision, not a mistake. If it is that bad, get rid of social media. Do not say, I can handle it, I am good; that is Satan telling you that, and leaving it open keeps fueling that lust. 1 Peter 2:11 1:44:00 - Dearly beloved, I beseech you as strangers and pilgrims, abstain from fleshly lusts, which war against the soul. Satan tells you it is not that bad because you are not literally sleeping with anyone. But understand: it destroys your soul. When you keep watching these things, it shows in your countenance; your spirit weakens. You come to the Sabbath feeling weak and distant, feeling like you are not worthy, and it weighs down on your soul and you start changing. - It brings guilt and shame. You stop praying because you are ashamed to go before God; Satan is whispering in your ear that God is not going to use you, and you let those sins weigh you down. There was a young brother that used to be among us who could not overcome this addiction no matter what counsel he was given, and he ended up leaving the truth. It can become a demon. - Parents, keep an eye on these young kids. They have phones. Check their phones, and put things on their phones so they cannot access certain things. 2 Peter 2:7-8 1:48:30 - And delivered just Lot, vexed with the filthy conversation of the wicked: for that righteous man dwelling among them, in seeing and hearing, vexed his righteous soul from day to day with their unlawful deeds. The things Lot saw taking place in Sodom and Gomorrah vexed his spirit. In order to survive in this wicked world, you have to be like Lot. - So you have to ask yourself: do these things vex you? Or do you see them and get aroused and entertained? The reason a lot of brothers still watch porn is that the soul is not vexed yet. We have to mold our minds so that when we see these things, they vex us. That comes with time, but we have to bring ourselves there. Psalms 97:10 1:52:17 - Ye that love the Lord, hate evil. If you love God, you have to hate evil, the same way Lot saw evil and it vexed him. Train yourself to hate evil: that is going to help you with the porn and with the lust of the eyes. There is nothing wrong with being attracted to your own wife; that is how God made us, and that is why God made our women the way he did. But looking at a woman and lusting after her for sex is wrong. You cannot be telling sisters on the street to dress right and then watching and enjoying the very thing you preach against. 1 John 2:15-16 1:53:33 - Love not the world, neither the things that are in the world. If any man love the world, the love of the Father is not in him. For all that is in the world, the lust of the flesh, and the lust of the eyes: the lust this flesh desires, and the lust of what you see. We have to hate this world and train our soul to hate it. 1 John 3:19-20 1:54:28 - Hereby we know that we are of the truth, and shall assure our hearts before him. For if our heart condemn us, God is greater than our heart, and knoweth all things. If your heart condemns you, that is your mind condemning you: you know what you are doing, you know what you are battling, and you are not trying to overcome it. And God knows all things. James 1:22-25 1:55:16 - Be ye doers of the word, and not hearers only, deceiving your own selves. A lot of us hear the scriptures but do not do the scriptures. Every man has to bring himself to that level: no matter how many scriptures come forth, until you literally sit down and say, I have to control this, I have to fight this, you are going to keep going through it over and over. There came a time in the teacher's own life when he said, I am not messing with this any more, and it is going to be the same for every one of you. - He is like unto a man beholding his natural face in a glass: the glass is the Bible. You behold who you are supposed to be, and after you fall, your conscience bothers you because you know the word. Then you go your way and straightway forget what manner of man you were, and you go back to the same sin, and afterward you feel the guilt, and all you hear in your mind is that God is going to judge you. - But whoso looketh into the perfect law of liberty, and continueth therein, being not a forgetful hearer, but a doer of the work, this man shall be blessed in his deed. 2 Timothy 2:22 1:59:04 - Flee also youthful lusts: but follow righteousness, faith, charity, peace, with them that call on the Lord out of a pure heart. A lot of you young brothers are the ones dealing with the porn. That is youthful lust. Flee it. Stop it. 1 John 2:14 1:59:46 - I have written unto you, young men, because ye are strong, and the word of God abideth in you, and ye have overcome the wicked one. The young men in the time of the apostles overcame the wicked one; what were they overcoming? That youthful lust. Those lusts and desires are inside you, and Satan comes and tests you with them. But the word of God abiding in you is how you overcome him. Ecclesiasticus 17:25 2:02:07 - Return unto the Lord, and forsake thy sins, make thy prayer before his face, and offend less. Here is the first solution: offend less. God does not expect you to come into the truth and just be perfect. But can you go a week without watching porn? You passed a week: try two weeks. You did two: go three, then four, then five, then six months, then a year. And if you fall, get back up and keep going; do not just keep falling because you fell once after two months clean. - When you offend less, the demon becomes less strong. The more you feed it, the stronger it gets, like an addiction, and the harder it is to stop. But if you start starving the demon, week after week, it weakens. It is a heavy addiction, and the withdrawal is real, but you starve it out. 2 Corinthians 12:6-9 2:05:55 - This is for those of you that fasted and asked God to take the porn spirit away, and a week later you were back on it. Paul was given a thorn in the flesh, the messenger of Satan to buffet him, lest he should be exalted above measure. That thorn in the flesh goes into evil concupiscence, strong sexual desire; Paul was dealing with wicked thoughts in his mind. For this thing he besought the Lord thrice, that it might depart from him. - And he said unto me, My grace is sufficient for thee: for my strength is made perfect in weakness. God is not just going to take that lust away from you. If he took away every weakness inside of you, he would be making you perfect, and you would never learn how to fight. How would you be able to teach somebody else to overcome their lust if you never fought it and dealt with it yourself? Christ's mercy is enough for us: if you fall, get back up, fix it, and stop doing it. You have to keep fighting that demon and slay it. That is how you become stronger, and as you overcome it, you become able to teach other brothers how to overcome it. - Videos played in class: every man in the Bible who had a rise and a fall, sexual discipline was in the downfall: David and Bathsheba, Samson and Delilah, Solomon. Our great forefathers fell, but they got back up. If you cannot master your own urges, you will burn down everything you built. Another speaker: leaving porn alone is the simplest first discipline a man can master, and if you cannot do that, what harder thing will you do? Take the thirty day challenge: either you find out you have a problem you need to address, or you prove your life is better without it, with a clearer mind and more presence in your relationships. - Another video: demons do not attack your sexuality because they are obsessed with your pleasure; they attack it because they understand your power. When a chosen one is sexually scattered, the mind gets foggy, prayer gets weak, confidence leaks, and destiny feels delayed. The enemy does not just want you to fall; he wants you to lose respect for yourself after you fall, saying, I cannot be chosen if I still struggle with this. That is a lie. Your struggle does not cancel your calling, but your refusal to master the struggle can delay your throne. - That is why the world can live recklessly and feel nothing, but when you do it you feel guilt and shame. You are one of the chosen ones; your conscience is supposed to be telling you something. And I see it on you all: the confidence gets low, the reading gets weak, you start forgetting scriptures, because your conscience already condemned you. Satan is trying to make us weak; that is why they put all this out there. But we have to learn to overcome it. Ecclesiasticus 4:17-18 2:23:06 - Here is the number one thing that helped the teacher overcome that spirit. For at the first she will walk with him by crooked ways: the she is wisdom, the Holy Spirit. When you first come into this truth, you are still meddling with your sins, and wisdom still walks with you; you are still in here learning. That is the voice that keeps telling you, what are you doing, the Lord is going to judge you. - And bring fear and dread upon him, and torment him with her discipline, until she may trust his soul, and try him by her laws. That is the secret: fear. Bad things happen to you to correct you, because whom the Lord loves he chastens. You might have been in your sin and something happened, and you know why it happened. In life, ask yourself two questions about everything that happens: why did it happen, and what is God trying to teach me? - The reason a lot of you are not going to stop is that you have no fear. It is pleasurable. But when you understand that God is going to judge you, and that he will correct you, you leave it alone, the same way a child does not go against the parent's order because the child knows correction is coming. - Then will she return the straight way unto him, and comfort him, and shew him her secrets. When wisdom can trust your soul, you are comforted, and that is when you start understanding the secrets of the Bible. Hebrews 10:31 2:29:16 - It is a fearful thing to fall into the hands of the living God. Do you want to fall into the hands of God? Brothers, stop watching the porn. If the Lord loves you, he will chasten you until you stop. Some of us will not stop doing certain things until the correction comes. Philippians 2:12 2:30:11 - Wherefore, my beloved, as ye have always obeyed, not as in my presence only, but now much more in my absence: because you can come up in here and act holy in our presence while dealing with demons in private. God sees you in the absence too. - Work out your own salvation with fear and trembling. It is up to every last one of you dealing with lust to work it out. The scriptures can be given to you, but it was up to the teacher to work out what he was dealing with, and it is up to you to work out yours. Work it out with fear, because the Lord will judge you, and if you are chosen, the Lord is not going to sit back and watch you destroy your soul. In Closing Some of you are cut in the spirit right now, saying, that class hurt. Welcome to the club. Just fix it, brothers. Fix it. The lesson continues in part two, Lord's will. Closing reading: 1 Corinthians 11:23-29, the bread and the cup on the new moon feast, in remembrance of the Lord's death till he come; let a man examine himself. --- Class Notes Index Transcript: full session

title: 250 YEARS OF CELEBRATION; 400 YEARS OF SWEAT EQUITY!
text: Introduction The class opened with Psalms 91 read in full, and prayer: strengthen us and free us, Father, from this captivity; open up our minds and our understanding; give us the water of thy word. Well, today is definitely a demonic day out here. It is a reminder that this day is celebratory for our enemies; to us it is detrimental and derogatory. It represents our complete abuse, our complete exploitation, and us being dominated. The class opened with Richard Pryor's old bicentennial routine: the caricature of a man in blackface with stars and stripes on his forehead, thrilled to be here after 200 years, thrilled that 360 of the 400 who came over on the boat died on the way, thrilled that his family was split apart. "Y'all probably done forgot about it. But I ain't gonna never forget it." Pryor was a conscientious comedian who put the real problems of our communities on the stage, and America would rather hide what has been done to us than let it reach the world stage. 250 years of celebration: America celebrating its independence from Great Britain, 1776. And 400 years of sweat equity: longer than 250 years, because we were slaving and toiling before this place even became America. We have been catching total abuse from the moment we were dragged off the ships. America is more prosperous after slavery, in terms of exploiting us, than when we were in slavery: in physical slavery we still had our minds and fought to be free, so an indoctrination program was built to make us willing slaves, to make us enslave ourselves and do evil to each other, while the merchants drain every dollar we work for. That is what they are celebrating: 250 years of shaping us into the sweat equity vehicles that allow all of them to prosper, while some of us jump up and down with them in red, white, and blue. This class goes into the psychology of how we got here, to compound with the classes that came before it today. Scriptures Opened Deuteronomy 32:26 15:00 - I said, I would scatter them into corners, I would make the remembrance of them to cease from among men. That scripture is perfect for what was just said: it is not only written in prophecy, it is a way on how this is done. Your story does not get told in schools or on television; they do not want you to have anything to tell the world what you are experiencing. Even the term for our exhaustion gets turned around into "stop complaining," a total dismissal of your pain and anguish. - So they would rather hide us, abuse us, and then give us just enough dope to rejoice and say that we are okay. The celebrating of the so-called 4th of July, the 4th of You Lied, is basically a covering for a sick mind. How many more Sandra Blands, how many more Rasheem Carters, are we going to have with all this celebration? And it does not have to be all Esau: the mindset we have against each other came from them. We are basically men with black bodies and the oppressor's mind, and we do it to each other. Revelation 12:3 23:34 - And behold a great red dragon: this red dragon is talking about red people, a red nation. That is why the Most High said red. Why would he even call it red if it was not talking about you? Revelation 17:3-5, 18 24:35 - The woman which thou sawest is that great city, which reigneth over the kings of the earth. The woman is the eighth head that came from the seven. The seven heads: Greece, Rome, Spain, France, Germany, Russia, and Great Britain. From that seventh head came America, and that is what they are celebrating: 250 years broken away from Great Britain. Why did the Lord have to explain this to John? Because this eighth head was a mystery to him: the other seven were back there under different names, but the eighth head did not yet exist in actuality. It existed in spirit, in prophecy, without a physical footprint on the earth. - I saw a woman sit upon a scarlet coloured beast: a red beast. This chapter is going into America; no Christian is ever going to tell you anything about this. - Full of names of blasphemy: full of lies. America calls themselves Christians and calls themselves Jews and they are neither one. They lied on us: we are the real Jews that they dragged over here and subjugated into all kinds of evil. They came over here and murdered the brothers and sisters that were here in this country, and nearly wiped out Gad and Reuben. - Having seven heads and ten horns: horns mean power. America extracts its power from the ten; they are set up to fortify the endeavors of the main beast. That is NATO, basically. They add different names and cut it up, but you fit the prophecies of this Bible. - The woman was arrayed in purple and scarlet colour, and decked with gold and precious stones and pearls: she was decked out. Why? Because she stole the riches of the other nations. - Having a golden cup in her hand full of abominations and filthiness of her fornication: this place is loaded with abominations. She reigneth over the kings of the earth and made them all drunk with the wine of her fornication: that is what their foreign policy is all about. They make the nations drunk with weapons and with the lies of their religious programs, and indoctrinate and subjugate the nations to follow their dictates. - And upon her forehead was a name written, MYSTERY, BABYLON THE GREAT, THE MOTHER OF HARLOTS. Mystery means: who is it? It had to be said that way, because nobody at that time knew about this eighth head. It was in the spiritual prophecy of coming; that is why John was able to write it. Christ showed it to him. 2 Thessalonians 2:7 33:14 - For the mystery of iniquity: the mystery of sin. Who is the devil? Who is the evil one? Who is that man of sin? It is a mystery, meaning nobody is directly pointing at it. We are about to clear the mystery up. Isaiah 14:12-14 33:49 - How art thou fallen from heaven, O Lucifer, son of the morning! This chapter is future prophecy of the destruction of this very kingdom that we are in, written in the past tense. Lucifer means light bearer: they told everybody that they are the bright star of wisdom, the bright star of education, the bright star of justice. That is what the so-called Lady of Liberty is about; these people make all these symbols and statues up, and they know what they are doing when they set them up. Come to us if you want to talk about justice and judgment: a complete lie, a facade that hides the evil they have done to us. - Which didst weaken the nations: they weakened the nations with bombs, with their religion, with their so-called democracy and lies. That is how they got all the nations to serve them: the beast that reigneth over the earth weakened the nations until they had no strength to fight against it. - For thou hast said in thine heart, I will ascend into heaven: airplanes and space travel. I will exalt my throne above the stars of God: the Most High said we are supposed to dwell on this earth; this one says, I will go beyond your boundaries and put things out in the heavens, because I am God. That is how he thinks. - I will sit also upon the mount of the congregation: the congregation is the Lord's people. I will sit upon God's congregation in captivity: bewilder them, bewitch them, lie to them, give them false religion and evil holidays, and make them think the Bible is not talking about them. They are sitting on your thinking and your mentality. In the sides of the north: this hemisphere, where we are. Jeremiah 16:14-15 37:44 - It shall no more be said, The Lord liveth, that brought up the children of Israel out of the land of Egypt: that deliverance is still on the people's minds now. But the way they sat on our mentality, the world does not know the Bible is talking about us. That is how well they hid us; they manufactured a people and said these are the people the Bible speaks of. A total lie. You are the Jews; you are the Israelites. - But, The Lord liveth, that brought up the children of Israel from the land of the north: something so spectacular, so magnificent, and so marvelous has to happen that it makes us stop talking about ancient Egypt, the Red Sea, and the ten plagues. That is going to be when he delivers us from here, from the land of the north: the same place where we are being oppressed. Wisdom of Solomon 5:1-2 40:34 - Then shall the righteous man stand in great boldness before the face of such as have afflicted him. In the middle of the psychological tyranny and the physical tyranny that we face, the Most High says we are still going to stand in great boldness before the face of those that afflicted us. In their mind, there is no way we are supposed to be standing up: we afflicted them, and we mean to keep them hidden in the corners. - And made no account of his labours: they made no account of all the work we did beyond 250 years. What is a man celebrating in a top hat and stripes when in 1776 he was still in chains? - The teacher noted the Statue of Liberty: visitors do not see the feet of the statue, and there are chains at the base, a symbol of liberty breaking away from the grip of Britain. They understand breaking away for themselves, but we cannot want that for ourselves. People come to Ellis Island looking to that symbol while we are in slavery underneath this very system. - When they see it, they shall be troubled with terrible fear: when our enemies see us stand up in boldness, they shall be shaken, because they know who they have in captivity. The point is for you not to know who you are; they know who you are. As long as you do not know who you are, you will subject yourselves to inferior behavior and mediocrity, and shortchange yourselves, thinking no more of yourselves than what they taught you to think. - The terrible fear is you breaking out of that sickness and recognizing who you truly are, because they said that means the God of these people is soon to come. Our rise tells them we expect a deliverer; we expect Christ to come back. Once we start looking for that, you cannot buy us off. - And shall be amazed at the strangeness of his salvation: not only the people he is going to save, but how he is going to do it. The strangeness of his salvation was written in the Psalms we opened with: a thousand shall fall at thy side, and ten thousand at thy right hand, but it shall not come nigh thee; only with thine eyes shalt thou behold and see the reward of the wicked. - Drapetomania was brought up: the invented diagnosis that said a slave who seeks freedom from his master is mentally sick. He calls it sickness when you try to get away from him. That is the arrogance we are dealing with, and their mentality has not changed. Ezekiel 1:12 51:31 - And they went every one straight forward: whither the spirit was to go, they went. The chariots. Wherever the spirit went, the chariots were there. They move at the speed of thought: as fast as you can think of a place, they can be there. They turned not when they went: they did not have to aim themselves; they just be, and they are. What could anybody do against the strangeness of that kind of salvation? No jet fuel, no propulsion, no sound, the wind undisturbed. - Discussion of what the astronauts saw: the maneuvers and technology of the chariots made the whole space program look like a bicycle. Do you think those beings need all of that to get two men up there? Zechariah 5:1-4 54:08 - Then I turned, and lifted up mine eyes, and looked, and behold a flying roll: the length thereof is twenty cubits, and the breadth thereof ten cubits. That is a sizeable ship. And how could Zechariah make out the words written on it from where he stood, like reading a billboard, unless the thing was enormous? - This is the curse that goeth forth over the face of the whole earth: the Lord is saying, I am going to send a chariot to terrorize my enemies. On one side: every one that stealeth shall be cut off. On the other side: every one that sweareth shall be cut off. - America is a major thief, and an amazing liar: swearing that they are the Israelites, swearing In God We Trust while the very ground the courts sit on is stolen property. - I will bring it forth, saith the Lord of hosts, and it shall enter into the house of the thief, and into the house of him that sweareth falsely by my name: those that lied on the Bible, that told the nations the Bible was about them while the children of Israel suffered under their brutality. And it shall remain in the midst of his house, and shall consume it with the timber thereof and the stones thereof: fire and brimstone destruction. They know what those chariots represent. Jeremiah 23:7-8 1:01:43 - The same prophecy again, and this one uses the word country: which brought up, and which led the seed of the house of Israel out of the north country. The Most High is coming back to take us home from the north country. Isaiah 14:15-17 1:03:20 - Yet thou shalt be brought down to hell, to the sides of the pit: you are not going to stop your downfall. - They that see thee shall narrowly look upon thee, and consider thee, saying, Is this the man? The man of sin: Lucifer is a man. To narrowly look means you are squinting, taking a good look, really examining that thing. You remove the rose-colored glasses, the facade, the glitz and glamour, the imagery everybody goes crazy over, and you see exactly who he is. What is going to cause them to see? The Bible. The Bible is going to reveal who these people really are. - Is this the man that made the earth to tremble, that did shake kingdoms: by dropping bombs on the kingdoms. Coming to another man's land and taking him out of his land while everybody stands by: that is the kind of terror we are talking about. - That made the world as a wilderness, and destroyed the cities thereof: destroyed the air, the water, and the people's minds. Folly is set in great dignity: when the wicked bear rule, the people mourn. 2 Thessalonians 2:3-8 1:10:28 - Let no man deceive you by any means: for that day shall not come, except there come a falling away first: Paul telling the Israelites that day would not come except Israel go into complete captivity, like where we are now. All of this is prophesied, and our deliverance is also prophesied. - And that man of sin be revealed, the son of perdition: there is the mystery again. They shall take a good look at him, narrowly look upon him, and recognize that this man is the devil the Bible speaks of. Perdition means destruction: he was made to be destroyed by God, the vessel of God's wrath. Keep that word in mind, because when we go back to Revelation you will see it again. - Who opposeth and exalteth himself above all that is called God: he opposed God, the Bible, and all righteousness. Thou enemy of all righteousness, thou child of the devil: Acts 13, Elymas the sorcerer. - So that he as God sitteth in the temple of God, shewing himself that he is God: he built the churches and monuments and made everybody think that he is God. - For the mystery of iniquity doth already work: Paul takes it back to when they were literally under Rome. The wicked was already ruling; Paul was letting you know who the devil was. - Only he who now letteth will let, until he be taken out of the way: only the Lord who now allows him to rule will let him rule, and when their time is up, they are done. The sand is running out of the hourglass, and everyone who is tied up with them goes down with them. Revelation 17:5-11 1:16:32 - Mystery, Babylon the great: Babylon, land of great lies, land of confusion. The mother of harlots: America makes all the nations get in bed with her and follow her ways. If you do not accept her foreign policies and political agendas, they cut your money off, cut your food off, put embargoes and sanctions on you until you cannot even sell your own goods. What other country can do that? Nobody. Only this beast. - And abominations of the earth: the worst abominations of all time are right here, and the sickness is so pervasive that the people subject to the abominations think they are in heaven. We are drowning in abominations while thinking this is Utopia. - And I saw the woman drunken with the blood of the saints: America drank our blood in captivity, robberies, murder, and slavery. And with the blood of the martyrs: a lot of our people trying to do right have been knocked off. - And the angel said unto me, Wherefore didst thou marvel? I will tell thee the mystery of the woman, and of the beast that carrieth her, which hath the seven heads and ten horns: I will tell you about the eighth head, America, and about the seven that carried her. - The beast that thou sawest was, and is not: it was in John's vision, but it was not in existence in his time. And shall ascend out of the bottomless pit: out of Europe, out of Britain and the rest. And go into perdition: there is that word again from Thessalonians. - The seven heads are seven mountains, on which the woman sitteth: seven mountains means seven governments. And there are seven kings: five are fallen, and one is: Rome, the one that had John on the isle of Patmos, was in power; Greece, Spain, France, Germany, and Russia were not. And the other is not yet come; and when he cometh, he must continue a short space: Great Britain was still coming along. - And the beast that was, and is not, even he is the eighth, and is of the seven: America is of Great Britain and the rest of the seven heads. And goeth into perdition: this kingdom is going to be destroyed. That is the history of it, and there is no getting out of it. Revelation 12:10 1:34:15 - For the accuser of our brethren is cast down, which accused them before our God day and night. Esau is the accuser, accusing our people before our God: look, the Israelites are in sin; we have them in adultery, in dope, drunk, celebrating the false holidays; these are your people, and they know better. That is them accusing us, like somebody telling your parents your children are worthless, while setting the children up to fail. - Clips from the film 1492: Conquest of Paradise were played: Columbus arguing that he could cross the ocean, and when asked how he could be so certain of the distance, citing his sources: the calculations of mariners, and Esdras. The Bible. Columbus had logbooks and records; he was looking for the twelve tribes of Israel. He knew there was land out there because he read the book. Movies are not made for our entertainment: they put things out there because they know our people are asleep, and they measure whether we are waking up. If too many wake up, they adjust the dope: the religion dope, the education dope, the television dope, the music. Once you think outside the box, they call you a radical, an extremist, a hate group: all of it designed to put you back in your place. - A lecture clip was played on the Huxtable effect: when positive images of our people were broadcast, test scores rose, 75 percent of black males graduated high school in 1990, and enrollment at Morehouse College went up 37 percent. Then came the opposite effect: scores went down, and by 2010 graduation had fallen to 47 percent. The music our people ask for is chosen by executives worth billions who market racist images of black people. It is the corporate sale of racism. Nothing is put out here for your entertainment: everything allowed to reach your ears and your screen is carefully sculpted to produce a thought, which becomes your actions, which become your destiny. They allowed the positive images as a test, saw that we respond to imagery, and then changed the music and the images to put us back to sleep: sweat equity. Judith 5:3-4, 17-21 2:01:40 - Before this, history was read from The Complete Works of Flavius Josephus: Demetrius Phalereus, library keeper to king Ptolemy, was endeavoring to gather together all the books that were in the habitable earth, and reported he had collected about two hundred thousand books and would soon have five hundred thousand; and he had been informed that there were many books of laws among the Jews worthy of inquiring after, written in characters and in a dialect of their own, which would cause no small pains to get translated into Greek. He wrote: this legislation is full of hidden wisdom and entirely blameless, as being the legislation of God, and asked the king to send for six elders out of every tribe to make an accurate interpretation, to be deposited in the library at Alexandria. The nations know that our Bible is what is happening. It is not just a book; it is a weapon. You are the children of that book, but you are not made to understand that, on purpose. - The Greeks, Columbus's ancestors, learned to search out everyone's history: their strengths and their weaknesses. Esau takes care of Esau: when they died, they passed the books down. The Romans came from the Greeks, Spain from the Romans, so that knowledge went all the way down to Columbus. Scholars of ours who got too close to those records in the universities were slandered and pushed out of tenure. - Tell me now, ye sons of Chanaan, who this people is, that dwelleth in the hill country, and what are the cities that they inhabit, and what is the multitude of their army, and wherein is their power and strength: this is what nations do when they want to conquer you. They need to know what held you together as a nation, what your strong man at the door is. The strong man in our case is the Bible and our adherence to the Bible. When we stop adhering to the Bible, the strong man is gone and our goods can be spoiled. - And whilst they sinned not before their God, they prospered, because the God that hateth iniquity was with them. He is warning the captain of the army: if they are not sinning, you cannot take them. Their objective, then and now, is to make sure we do not keep God's commandments. - But when they departed from the way which he appointed them, they were destroyed in many battles very sore, and were led captives into a land that was not theirs. When we departed from God's commandments, it was easy to destroy us. So they must keep us in sin. Think about that. - Now therefore, my lord and governor, if there be any error in this people, and they sin against their God, let us consider that this shall be their ruin, and let us go up, and we shall overcome them: that is what is happening today. As long as they can keep us in sin, they can exploit, dominate, rob, and pillage, and leave us in a wilderness of foolishness. - But if there be no iniquity in their nation, let my lord now pass by, lest their Lord defend them, and their God be for them, and we become a reproach before all the world. They do not want that to happen; that same knowledge persists even today. That is why they accuse us to the Father day and night, and why they operate the conditioning: they throw the rock and hide their hand, giving us the opportunity and the influence toward every evil, then standing back as though they had nothing to do with it. The Most High is going to deal with them for that; we have to get our minds right and repent. 2 Esdras 13:40-45 2:11:58 - Those are the ten tribes, which were carried away prisoners out of their own land in the time of Osea the king, whom Salmanasar the king of Assyria led away captive. Assyria moved against the northern kingdom first; then Babylon took down Assyria and took her captives, then moved down and took Judah; then the Persians came in, and under Cyrus a proclamation was made allowing Israel to go back and build Jerusalem. Four books detail this history: Ezra, Nehemiah, 1 Esdras, and 2 Esdras. - But they took this counsel among themselves, that they would leave the multitude of the heathen, and go forth into a further country, where never mankind dwelt, that they might there keep their statutes, which they never kept in their own land. The bulk of the tribes said, we are not staying; we are going to a further country. Columbus read this, and he knew the Israelites were here: the northern kingdom, Gad and Reuben and those tribes, before he ever sailed. - And they entered into Euphrates by the narrow passages of the river: for the most High then shewed signs for them, and held still the flood, till they were passed over. - For through that country there was a great way to go, namely, of a year and a half: and the same region is called Arsareth. A year and a half of travel means stops along the way: the maritime ports. From the book Maritime Trade and the Movement of Culture, by the sister the teacher interviewed on the Quest voyage and whose museum in Charleston the nation plans to visit: the Red Sea and Indian Ocean connected Africa to the wider world as early as the third century BCE, trading gold, ivory, spices, and textiles with Arabia, India, Persia, and China, with cultural diffusion along the coasts. Precepts: - Ezra 1:3-4 This is the counsel, and it is Cyrus speaking: who is there among you of all his people? his God be with him, and let him go up to Jerusalem, which is in Judah, and build the house of the Lord God of Israel. And whosoever remaineth in any place where he sojourneth, let the men of his place help him with silver, and with gold, and with goods, and with beasts. That was the proclamation charged to Israel. - 1 Kings 9:26-28 And king Solomon made a navy of ships in Ezion-geber, which is beside Eloth, on the shore of the Red sea. Hiram sent shipmen that had knowledge of the sea: the maritime men. And they came to Ophir, and fetched from thence gold, four hundred and twenty talents. Ezion-geber sits at the northern tip of the Red Sea's Gulf of Aqaba, near the region where the tribes entered the Euphrates. We had maritime trade going in Solomon's time, so it was no mystery for us to make it from Persia over to the Americas: the ports were there. Ivan Van Sertima's They Came Before Columbus speaks of Solomon's ships. - Isaiah 13:12 I will make a man more precious than fine gold; even a man than the golden wedge of Ophir. We read this often without going deeper into what the gold of Ophir is: an exceptionally fine, pure gold prized in the ancient world, whose exact source remains one of the great archaeological mysteries. That is what the Most High is going to make you: that pure fine gold. - Definition read in class: reference works call Arsareth a mythical region mentioned in 2 Esdras, described as another land, a year and a half's journey beyond the Euphrates, where the ten lost tribes of Israel migrated and will dwell until the end of time. It is not mythical: the historians have it in their records, and it is in the Bible, but they hope we are content to read the word mythical and discredit everything. The Jewish Encyclopedia entry itself states: Columbus identified America with this land. It was passed down from the records of the Greeks; they share that information among themselves so they can know your strengths while you do not even know your own. - From The History of the American Indians by James Adair, a trader who lived among them forty years, as republished by Samuel Cole Williams: the book presents observations and arguments in proof of the American Indians being descended from the Jews: their division into tribes, their worship of Jehovah, their notions of a theocracy, their belief in the ministration of angels, their prophets and high priests, their laws of uncleanness and abstinence from unclean things, their marriage and punishment of adultery, their cities of refuge, and raising seed to a deceased brother. That is Bible. Adair also records a remnant tribe called Kanaai, resembling the Hebrew proper name Canaan. - From Lost Tribes and Promised Lands by Ronald Sanders, in the passages from the Spanish explorers of the Southern United States, 1528 to 1543: only the sorcerers of his tribe had perceived that they were a special people, and had given warning that they should be left alone. "The God of these children of Israel is the true God," they had said, "and everything inscribed on their tablets is true. At the end of days, they will be lords of all the nations of the earth. One nation will come bringing many things to this land, and after we have all been provided for, these children of Israel will go forth from where they now are, and reign over the whole earth, as they once did." The same warning Achior gave Holofernes: if these people are following the laws of God, leave them alone. - One nation will come: the ships with Judah. That is why Zechariah says the Lord shall raise the tents of Judah first, and bring him to his people: Judah was going to teach the rest of the tribes. Here they are in the 1500s, before the 1611 King James Bible was ever printed, carrying that record. In Closing To be continued: this class picks up right from here, and the whole teaching will be put together in one video. They knew what they were coming here to do; the records prove it. The lands were promised, and at the end of days the children of Israel will go forth from where they now are and reign over the whole earth, as they once did. Twelve tribes. Happy Sabbath, and stay tuned for Bishop Nathaniel coming up next. Announcements & References Books referenced in class: - The Complete Works of Flavius Josephus (Ptolemy's library at Alexandria and the request for the Hebrew scriptures) - Maritime Trade and the Movement of Culture, by Kim Cliett Long (the sister interviewed on the Quest voyage; her museum is in Charleston, South Carolina) - The History of the American Indians, by James Adair (edited by Samuel Cole Williams) - Lost Tribes and Promised Lands, by Ronald Sanders (including the chapter Enter Columbus) - They Came Before Columbus, by Ivan Van Sertima - Jewish Civilization (the used copy with the 1987 gift inscription, shown as an example of how they pass books down) Films referenced in class: Richard Pryor's bicentennial stand-up routine, 1492: Conquest of Paradise, The Book of Eli, Natural Born Killers, and Scarface.
