title: JOB SEES AMERICA'S 250TH ANNIVERSARY
text: Introduction Thumbnail video: "Hast thou considered my servant Job?" Well, this is Babylon's 250th anniversary. Job sees America's 250th anniversary: we are going to take a look, through the prophet Job, at today's class. America is in the Bible and is described in several ways. Bishop Yahwasap went over Revelation 17, so we are not going to touch the whole chapter, but we did want to hit Revelation 18:1-4, because this is one way that you know Babylon is America and the children of Israel are here. The opening prayer asked the Most High to look upon America in their pride as they celebrate their 250th year, to deliver his people from the four corners of the earth, and to bring us to righteousness, love, and unity. Scriptures Opened Revelation 17:16-18 10:24 - Revelation 18 continues from Revelation 17, so we start at 17:16. The ten horns are the EU, the European common market: Belgium, Luxembourg, Netherlands, Germany, the UK, Italy, Greece, France, Denmark, Ireland. The seven heads: Greece, Rome, Spain, France, Germany, Russia, Great Britain. The eighth head is America, the great whore that sitteth upon many waters. - These shall hate the whore: the European Union will eventually turn on the United States of America. You saw the disrespect toward them with the raising of tariffs. You might ask why he is doing that: God is creating his scenario for them to have hatred for America. - For God hath put in their hearts to fulfil his will, and to agree, and give their kingdom unto the beast, to support America, until the words of God shall be fulfilled: until prophecy is fulfilled. - The woman which thou sawest is that great city, which reigneth over the kings of the earth. What other kingdom is reigning over all the kings of the earth? The United States of America. Verse 18 lets you know crystal clear. You might say, is it not the Vatican? No. The Arab world and Islam do not respect the Vatican, but everybody respects the United States of America, whether they want to or not. Revelation 18:1-4 12:41 - John continues: he sees the fall of the United States of America. And is become the habitation of devils: unclean creatures, lizards, alligators. The hold of every foul spirit: foul spirits are caged here. A cage of every unclean and hateful bird: owls and eagles are here. - All nations have drunk of the wine of the wrath of her fornication: her political policies. Everybody obeys America. The merchants of the earth are waxed rich: the merchants are her corporations and companies. Nations only become rich dealing with the United States of America. People like to bring up China: China was a third world country back in the 50s. How did they become a world superpower? America allowed them into the stock market, allowed them to buy, sell, and trade with all nations. And America does not allow Africa to do what they allow China to do; they do not even allow Africa to manufacture their own weapons. - Come out of her, my people: so where is God's people? In Babylon. Zechariah 2:6-9 15:34 - Ho, ho, come forth, and flee from the land of the north: North America. That is Babylon. - Deliver thyself, O Zion, that dwellest with the daughter of Babylon. Zion is sometimes a reference to Jerusalem as a city, sometimes to the twelve tribes, but Zion here is the tribe of Judah. Judah is living here in the land of the north. Benjamin can go back to the Caribbean islands, Ephraim can go back, Levi can go back; it is Judah that is always here. - He that toucheth you toucheth the apple of his eye: he that toucheth Israel touches the apple of God's eye. - For behold, I will shake mine hand upon them, and they shall be a spoil to their servants. Write this down: the servants there is us. Right now we are their servants, but God will shake his hand upon the nations and they shall be a spoil to their servants. Precepts: - Psalms 78:68 But chose the tribe of Judah, the mount Zion which he loved. That is the Zion it is talking about. - Psalms 137:7-8 Remember, O Lord, the children of Edom. E D O M: that is the people you call so-called white folks. Rase it, rase it means destroy it. Watch what David calls Edom: O daughter of Babylon, who art to be destroyed. Edom is the daughter of Babylon, destined to be destroyed. Happy shall he be, that rewardeth thee as thou hast served us. - Deuteronomy 33:7 And this is the blessing of Judah: hear, Lord, the voice of Judah, and bring him unto his people. Judah is the one the spirit comes on first to go gather the tribes. And be thou an help to him from his enemies. - Zephaniah 2:9 Surely Moab shall be as Sodom, and the children of Ammon as Gomorrah. The residue of my people shall spoil them, and the remnant of my people shall possess them: own those nations. Obadiah 1:1-7 20:54 - The vision of Obadiah, concerning Edom. Remember what we just read in Psalms 137: the daughter of Babylon is the children of Edom. An ambassador is sent among the heathen: somebody rises up among the nations and says, arise ye, and let us rise up against her in battle. The nations go against America and her allies. - Behold, I have made thee small among the heathen: thou art greatly despised. America is small compared to the dark nations of the earth, which represent about three quarters of the planet; Esau is less than a quarter. And you see the evil that the fake Israel is leading America to do: all nations are getting angry. People ask why America keeps destroying countries for them. They have to do it, so that the prophecy can be fulfilled. On the map, the land of Israel is a tiny speck next to the Arab world: small amongst the heathen, greatly despised. - The pride of thine heart hath deceived thee: make America great again. All nations have to pay their wages when it comes to America. - Thou that dwellest in the clefts of the rock: in Genesis 36 they dwelt at Mount Seir, but it also refers to the middle ages when they lived in the Caucasus mountains of Georgia, Russia. That is why they call themselves Caucasian: Jewish Caucasian, Russian Caucasian, English Caucasian, American Caucasian, Australian Caucasian, South African Caucasian, Dutch Caucasian. They are telling you with that word where they come from. - Whose habitation is high: they like skyscrapers. That saith in his heart, Who shall bring me down to the ground? To say that you have to have power to back it up. America has the arsenal and the weaponry to say nobody can conquer us. - Though thou exalt thyself as the eagle: not only would Edom be prideful and have power, their symbol would be the eagle. The great seal of the United States of America is the eagle: arrows in one claw representing war, and the olive branch of peace in the other. They come to you with peace, but war is in their heart, like it says in the book of Psalms. - And though thou set thy nest among the stars: that is space travel. That is not China, not Africa, not the Arabs. When they landed on the moon in 1969, they said profoundly, "The eagle has landed." - Thence will I bring thee down, saith the Lord. And from the 1960s the truth has been coming out like never before. Vietnam pushed them out of the country. - If thieves came to thee, would they not have stolen till they had enough? A regular thief steals till he has enough, but not this man. If grape gatherers came, would they not leave some grapes? Esau leaves nothing behind: he takes every grape, the stem, the root, and the ground the grape was in. - How are his hidden things sought up: the evils Esau has done are being sought out now. It is only recently we found out about Lake Lanier in Georgia, and Seneca Village, the black community that was destroyed to make Central Park. All of that is surfacing now. - All the men of thy confederacy have brought thee even to the border: the men of thy confederacy is the European Union, the precept to Revelation 17:16 that we just read. The men that were at peace with thee have deceived thee, and prevailed against thee. Do not think the EU will let America get away with the tariffs and the disrespect. Obadiah 1:15-16 28:53 - For the day of the Lord is near upon all the heathen: as thou hast done, it shall be done unto thee: thy reward shall return upon thine own head. - For as ye have drunk upon my holy mountain: notice it goes from America to the fake Israelis, because they work together. How did they drink upon the holy mountain? Murder and bloodshed. They came back to the land in 1948, and what did they bring with them? Murder and bloodshed. - So shall all the heathen drink continually; and they shall be as though they had not been. These nations shall be as though they had not been. 2 Esdras 12:11 30:25 - When you read Daniel 7, it talks about the fourth kingdom, more dreadful than all the kingdoms before it, but Daniel does not give the animal symbol. Ezra gives the animal symbol: the eagle. America is included in that near the end. - News read in class: the United States is celebrating its semiquincentennial, its 250th anniversary, with the official milestone of American independence taking place on July 4th, 2026, honoring the adoption of the Declaration of Independence in 1776. They said we hold these truths to be self-evident, that all men are created equal, and for some reason our people think that included them. It did not. - America held a national prayer vigil for the 250th, a ministry video calling the nation blessed and asking God's mercy to endure. They are praying, but not to the God of Israel. We started our own prayer vigil first: yesterday evening for judgment, this morning for mercy, and at 12 noon, increase our faith. Psalms 109:4-7 34:12 - For my love they are my adversaries: but I give myself unto prayer. Like David said, we have to give ourselves unto prayer. - They have rewarded me evil for good. They told our people to get away from them, so we got away and built our own: Greenwood, Rosewood, Seneca Village. Then they said, they are doing better than us, and destroyed them. Soon as we separate and survive, they come to destroy, then tell us to pull ourselves up by our bootstraps. Nobody brings that out on the news. - Set thou a wicked man over him: and let Satan stand at his right hand. When he shall be judged, let him be condemned: and let his prayer become sin. All their prayers are sin. God is not accepting their prayers, according to the Holy Bible. - News shown in class: on the morning of America's 250th anniversary, hundreds of masked men carrying Confederate flags marched through Washington DC from Union Station, chanting for the country to be reclaimed. Black Christians think white Christians and them are together. No. They have told their own non-white allies plainly: when we get rid of everybody else, you have to go too. There are no exceptions with them, and if you keep saying there are good ones you will get a rude awakening. All through the scriptures God says he will exalt the nation of Israel as his chosen people; if you fight against that, you are fighting God. Daniel 11:39 38:47 - Thus shall he do in the most strong holds with a strange god. Many think the white man serves the same God we read about. No: the Bible says they serve a strange god, a god that looks like them, that does not mind genocide, mass murder, poisons in the food, redlining, or school-to-prison pipelines. - And shall divide the land for gain: they divided Africa for financial gain. That is the Berlin Conference. It started with the four generals of Alexander, Ptolemy, Lysimachus, Cassander, and Seleucus, dividing up the lands; white folks continued the same thing. - News read in class: 140 million Americans under heat alerts on the 4th of July, feeling like at least 100 degrees from the Midwest to the East Coast, 110 in Washington DC, holiday events cancelled or delayed, storms knocking out power for about a million customers, and 1,600 Philadelphia utility workers on strike. France recorded about 2,025 excess deaths at the peak of the heat wave as Europe braces for more extreme weather. Who controls the sun? The Most High. Keep praying, keep fasting. Habakkuk 1:10-11 44:05 - And they shall scoff at the kings: when the white man came throughout the Americas, they scoffed at the kings that were already set up here, and the princes were a scorn. They shall deride every strong hold: every stronghold they found, they took down. For they shall heap dust, and take it: they heaped religious confusion and took the land by violence. - Then shall his mind change: his mind changed around the civil rights era in the 60s. They said, let us appear gentler, kinder, more Christian: you can come into our schools, sit next to us in a restaurant, for the time being. They took religion out of the schools; you could not even say certain things. Then the administration changed and the mind changed again: the mask is off. - And he shall pass over, and offend, imputing this his power unto his god: unto the strange god we just read about in Daniel 11:39. It is not the God of the Bible, although they say it is. Job 1:1-19 49:12 - Job is a true man, but he is also a metaphorical representation of the twelve tribes of Israel. There was a man in the land of Uz whose name was Job, perfect and upright, one that feared God and eschewed evil: seven sons, three daughters, 7,000 sheep, 3,000 camels, 500 yoke of oxen, 500 she asses. This man was the greatest of all the men of the east. - Everyone his day means their birthday. Job sanctified his children and offered burnt offerings according to the number of them all, for Job said, it may be that my sons have sinned and cursed God in their hearts. He knew what his sons were doing. Thus did Job continually. - Now there was a day when the sons of God came to present themselves before the Lord, and Satan came also among them. These sons of God here are the angels. They are not the same sons of God in Genesis 6: in Genesis 6 those sons of God are our people, before we were called Israelites we were called sons of God. - Satan answered the Lord: doth Job fear God for nought? Hast not thou made an hedge about him, and about his house? Job's life was blessed, and Satan brings it all out before the Lord: but put forth thine hand now, and touch all that he hath, and he will curse thee to thy face. - Then came the trials, one messenger on top of another. The Sabeans took the oxen and the asses and slew the servants: the first trial, dealing with his businesses and finances. The fire burned up the sheep and the servants: the second, again his business and finances. The Chaldeans made out three bands and carried away the camels: the third. Then a great wind smote the four corners of the house and his sons and daughters were dead: the fourth trial, dealing with Job's family. Precepts: - Ecclesiasticus 2:1 My son, if thou come to serve the Lord, prepare thy soul for temptation. Soon as we give our life to the Lord, repent, and start to do the work, Satan comes before the throne and says, have you considered your servant such and such? They are doing well now, but let me try them and they will curse you, leave the truth, and go right back to me. And the Lord says, you can try, but do not take their life. You have got to understand the pattern, because it still operates today. Job 2:4-7 55:03 - Satan answered the Lord: skin for skin, yea, all that a man hath will he give for his life. But put forth thine hand now, and touch his bone and his flesh, and he will curse thee to thy face. - And the Lord said unto Satan, Behold, he is in thine hand; but save his life. So Satan smote Job with sore boils from the sole of his foot unto his crown: the fifth trial, Job's health in decline. Isaiah 1:3-6 55:51 - Job's life represents the twelve tribes of Israel. The ox knoweth his owner, and the ass his master's crib: but Israel doth not know, my people doth not consider. We do not consider who our God is. - Ah sinful nation, a people laden with iniquity, a seed of evildoers, children that are corrupters: they have forsaken the Lord, they are gone away backward. We went backwards, backsliding. - The whole head is sick, and the whole heart faint. From the sole of the foot even unto the head there is no soundness in it; but wounds, and bruises, and putrifying sores: like Job had. What Job went through, we go through as a nation of people. Why? Because we were the servants of God, and when the trials came, we lost. We gave in to sin and turned our back on the Lord. Job 4:1-5 57:24 - Eliphaz the Temanite, one of Job's friends, answers him. Behold, thou hast instructed many, and thou hast strengthened the weak hands. You were the one that strengthened men and women when they were weak. Thy words have upholden him that was falling, and thou hast strengthened the feeble knees. - But now it is come upon thee, and thou faintest: now judgment has come upon you, Job, and now you have given up, you have lost the spirit. Where is that mighty man that helped all the people? Precepts: - Ecclesiasticus 37:19 There is one that is wise and teacheth many, and yet is unprofitable to himself. That is what Eliphaz was telling Job: you were the guy that comforted everybody, but now that your turn has come, you are fainting and want to give up. We should all be mindful of that. Job 29:1-25 59:02 - Who exactly was Job? In this chapter Job is reflecting on his life. Oh that I were as in months past, as in the days when God preserved me: when my life was good, my kids were with me, my businesses were flourishing. - When his candle shined upon my head: the Holy Spirit was on me. And when by his light I walked through darkness: we can only walk through darkness, like Job did, with God's commandments. - When the secret of God was upon my tabernacle: God reveals his secrets to the Israelites. - When I washed my steps with butter: a smooth life. And the rock poured me out rivers of oil. - When I prepared my seat in the street: Job was a judge. The young men saw me, and hid themselves: and the aged arose, and stood up. The princes refrained talking, and laid their hand on their mouth. When Job rolled on the scene, princes covered their mouths, young men moved out of the way, and the old men stood up and saluted him. The nobles held their peace. - When the ear heard me, then it blessed me: total respect and honor. Because I delivered the poor that cried, and the fatherless, and him that had none to help him. - The blessing of him that was ready to perish came upon me: and I caused the widow's heart to sing for joy. When somebody is about to die and wants to speak to you, sometimes you are at a loss for words. Job was the type of man who knew exactly what to say, and then he comforted the widow in her mourning. You have to pray to the Lord: give me the words, because it is a hard thing. Even in death, a believer can be told: it is going to be okay; even when you leave this world, you are going to be all right. - I put on righteousness, and it clothed me: my judgment was as a robe and a diadem. The way Job dressed, his righteousness reflected it. - I was eyes to the blind, and feet was I to the lame. I was a father to the poor: and the cause which I knew not I searched out. Whatever Job did not know, he did not fake: he searched it out. We have to get to that point. Get your study tools: the who's who with the Apocrypha, your Bible dictionary, your Complete Works of Josephus, your concordance. Before you ask a question, search it out, then ask after you have done research. - And I brake the jaws of the wicked, and plucked the spoil out of his teeth: whatever the wicked stole, Job took it back. That is forefather Job right there. He was not a pushover. - Unto me men gave ear, and waited, and kept silence at my counsel. After my words they spake not again: after Job spoke, you had nothing to say. And my speech dropped upon them, and they waited for me as for the rain, and they opened their mouth wide as for the latter rain: he was dropping blessings and understanding on them. - If I laughed on them, they believed it not: Job had an austere spirit. I chose out their way: he counseled and directed them. And sat chief, and dwelt as a king in the army, as one that comforteth the mourners. Job sat like a king in the army. Precepts: - Proverbs 6:23 For the commandment is a lamp; and the law is light. That is the light Job walked by. - Deuteronomy 29:29 The secret things belong unto the Lord our God: but those things which are revealed belong unto us and to our children for ever, that we may do all the words of this law. That is the secret of God upon Job's tabernacle, and the relationship between Job and us. - Deuteronomy 16:18 Judges and officers shalt thou make thee in all thy gates, and they shall judge the people with just judgment. Job prepared his seat in the street: he was one of these judges. - Deuteronomy 10:18 He doth execute the judgment of the fatherless and widow. Delivering the fatherless and the poor goes into God's law. - John 5:39 Search the scriptures; for in them ye think ye have eternal life: and they are they which testify of me. - Acts 17:11 These were more noble than those in Thessalonica, in that they received the word with all readiness of mind, and searched the scriptures daily, whether those things were so. That was the attribute Job had, and we have to be the same way. - Exodus 18:19 Be thou for the people to God-ward, that thou mayest bring the causes unto God. That is what Job was doing when men gave ear and waited at his counsel. - Deuteronomy 32:2 My doctrine shall drop as the rain, my speech shall distil as the dew. When Job spoke it was like that; and that right there is prophetic, it is going to come again in the future. - Psalms 132:9 Let thy priests be clothed with righteousness; and let thy saints shout for joy. Job put on righteousness and it clothed him. Isaiah 1:25-31 1:12:43 - And I will turn my hand upon thee, and purely purge away thy dross, and take away all thy tin. Definition read in class: dross is a noun that refers to waste, refuse, or any worthless matter. God will turn his hand upon the Israelites and purge away everything within us that is wasteful and useless: the sins. - In order for the dross to be purged away, we have to go through some things: tribulation. - And I will restore thy judges as at the first, and thy counsellors as at the beginning: the judges of Israel restored as in the days of Moses and before, when we were little gods on the earth. Afterward thou shalt be called, The city of righteousness, the faithful city. - Zion shall be redeemed with judgment, and her converts with righteousness. And the destruction of the transgressors and of the sinners shall be together: wicked Israel gets the same judgment as Esau. They shall be ashamed of the oaks which ye have desired: the idols. Confounded for the gardens that ye have chosen: the churches. As an oak whose leaf fadeth: your understanding is gone. As a garden that hath no water: no water of understanding. And they shall both burn together, and none shall quench them: God gets rid of what he cannot use. Precepts: - Mark 7:21-23 For from within, out of the heart of men, proceed evil thoughts, adulteries, fornications, murders, thefts, covetousness, wickedness, deceit, lasciviousness, an evil eye, blasphemy, pride, foolishness. Every one of them is dross and tin. All these evil things come from within, and defile the man. - Romans 5:3-5 We glory in tribulations also: knowing that tribulation worketh patience. When you read Paul in Hebrews 12, nobody rejoices in tribulation, but he gives you the after effect. When you go through hell, you learn patience; and patience, experience: a lot of us come into this truth with experience in the world but no experience in the truth of God. And experience, hope: and hope maketh not ashamed, because we endure to the end. That tribulation goes back to Ecclesiasticus 2: when thou comest to serve the Lord, prepare thy soul for temptation. - 2 Timothy 2:20-21 But in a great house there are not only vessels of gold and of silver, but also of wood and of earth. The great house is the nation of Israel, the twelve tribes. In every school there are men and women who are gold and silver, and it is up to you to discern who they are; and in every school there are also brothers and sisters of wood and of earth. This is not about new brothers and sisters who just walked through the door: it is about men and women in this truth for years who have not changed, still murmurers and gossipers, no work, no effort to study, treating this like a social club, a place to hang out. If a man therefore purge himself from these: you have to know your circle. When the Bishop came into the truth he had a circle of brothers he was always in trouble around, and he had to change his circle and get around leadership and the elders to get his mind right. Do not worry about hurting feelings: if you know they are not right, separate from them. Then shall you be a vessel unto honour, sanctified, and meet for the master's use: then can God use you, send you to a city and you could grow a whole congregation. Like Isaiah said to the Lord: send me. And this is also why we cannot join with other camps that practice what God condemns: it is based on what we just read. Job 35:9 1:27:17 - By reason of the multitude of oppressions they make the oppressed to cry: they cry out by reason of the arm of the mighty. This was Elihu speaking to Job prophetically about times to come. Are we not oppressed today? Precepts: - Deuteronomy 28:29 And thou shalt be only oppressed and spoiled evermore. That is what Elihu was talking about. Ecclesiastes 4:1 1:28:49 - So I returned, and considered all the oppressions that are done under the sun: this is King Solomon speaking prophetically. And behold the tears of such as were oppressed, and they had no comforter: looking for justice in all the wrong places. - And on the side of their oppressors there was power: they have the weapons, the court system, all of it. We have nothing. But they had no comforter. Psalms 102:19-20 1:29:38 - From heaven did the Lord behold the earth; to hear the groaning of the prisoner. We are the prisoner. You know what it is like to be the son of God and you are in prison: in a weak body, ruled and dominated by a wicked race of people, subject to their laws. - To loose those that are appointed to death: he said he is going to loose those appointed to death. Precepts: - Romans 8:22-23 For we know that the whole creation groaneth and travaileth in pain together until now. And not only they, but ourselves also, which have the firstfruits of the Spirit, which is Christ: waiting for the adoption, to wit, the redemption of our body. We want our godhood back. We want rulership back, dominion back; we want to reign on this planet like we once did. Isaiah 47:1, 6 1:31:15 - Come down, and sit in the dust, O virgin daughter of Babylon: the daughter of Babylon is Edom, like we read in Psalms 137. - I was wroth with my people: God was angry with us because we broke his laws and commandments. I have polluted mine inheritance: he scattered us amongst the nations. And given them into thine hand: given us into Edom's hand. - Thou didst shew them no mercy: the white man showed us no mercy here. Upon the ancient hast thou very heavily laid thy yoke: even upon the older men and women they laid a heavy yoke. They polluted us with their holidays and their filth. - Why is it so hard for our people? Discussion of the Cosby effect: when positive images of our people in college were on television, black college enrollment climbed; when those images were replaced with degrading ones, it declined. Esau figured out the psychology that image is everything: if the people can see themselves in greatness, they will become that. That is why they put the lowest of black society in the forefront globally, and why they remake or destroy every positive black show, and why the roles they reward are the degrading ones. That is why the art and video work of this nation matters: put positive images out there. Deuteronomy 28:64-68 1:37:56 - And the Lord shall scatter thee among all people: all people means exactly what it says, even amongst Amalek. Documentary referenced in class: Little White Lie, the true story of a woman raised Jewish who grew up sensing she was different and learned as an adult that her father was a black man. When the Bible says all people, that is what it looks like. She is Israel, our people. That is why we have to be mindful what we say: just teach, and let the spirit handle the rest. - And there thou shalt serve other gods, wood and stone: Christianity and Islam are the world's two largest religions. - And among these nations shalt thou find no ease: do not think we had it easy amongst the Arabs; record reads that the Arabs castrated the slaves they took, and in China they got us drunk and murdered us. One line each, but the record is there. - But the Lord shall give thee there a trembling heart, and failing of eyes, and sorrow of mind: and thy life shall hang in doubt before thee. We thought when we got emancipated we were free. Then the white robes and hoods came out, patterned after the capirotes of Spain from the Inquisition: pictures were shown in class of the Spanish penitent hoods, and that is where the Klan uniform comes from. Spain was in this country, and what they had over there, they brought here. - Thou shalt fear day and night, and shalt have none assurance of thy life: imagine building your own town because they did not want you in theirs, your own cab company, hospital, and bank, and then hearing the planes. Summarized from class: the record of Tulsa was read, where dynamite was dropped from planes on the city and many of our people were murdered; the teaching point is that the curse of having no assurance of thy life was fulfilled even in prosperity. The first episode of the series Watchmen was recommended for its portrayal of that history. - Discussion: media works on the subconscious. The class discussed how films and music carry subliminal messaging that shapes our people toward violence and self-hatred, and why parents have to train their children on what they watch and listen to. - In the morning thou shalt say, Would God it were even, and at even, Would God it were morning: for the fear of thine heart, and for the sight of thine eyes which thou shalt see. What did we see? Hangings, mutilations, bombings: we saw it all. - And the Lord shall bring thee into Egypt again with ships: slave ships, by the way whereof Moses spake unto thee. And there ye shall be sold unto your enemies for bondmen and bondwomen: once we got off those ships we were sold unto our enemies. - And no man shall buy you: no man shall redeem us from the curses. There is only one redeemer, brothers and sisters, and that is Christ. Precepts: - Zechariah 1:15 And I am very sore displeased with the heathen that are at ease: for I was but a little displeased, and they helped forward the affliction. God was a little displeased with us, and they afflicted us more and more. Isaiah 51:20-23 1:51:00 - Thy sons have fainted, they lie at the head of all the streets: that is why our young men hang on the corners. As a wild bull in a net: uncontrollable. This system is a trap. - They are full of the fury of the Lord: the fury of the Lord is Deuteronomy 28:15-68, the curses upon our young men, even madness. - Therefore hear now this, thou afflicted, and drunken, but not with wine: we are an afflicted people, and we are drunk with lies, religions, and falsehood. - Behold, I have taken out of thine hand the cup of trembling: that is why we are waking up now. Even the dregs of the cup of my fury: the dregs is the bottom of the cup, the last few drops. Thou shalt no more drink it again: after this captivity is over. - But I will put it into the hand of them that afflict thee: Esau and the nations. Which have said to thy soul, Bow down, that we may go over: lower yourself, humiliate yourself. Footage was shown of our people being paid coins to carry tourists on their backs: a perfect example of laying thy body as the ground, and as the street, to them that went over. - And thou hast laid thy body as the ground: our people will weep publicly for men who never said or did anything for them, but will not cry for each other. That is Isaiah 51:23 in action. Precepts: - Deuteronomy 28:28 The Lord shall smite thee with madness, and blindness, and astonishment of heart. Some of our young men are mentally deranged under the curses, and the music glorifies it. - Micah 2:11 If a man walking in the spirit and falsehood do lie, saying, I will prophesy unto thee of wine and of strong drink; he shall even be the prophet of this people. Wine there symbolizes lies: that is what our people are drunk with. Psalms 44:11-22 2:04:14 - Thou hast given us like sheep appointed for meat; and hast scattered us among the heathen: that is Deuteronomy 28:64. - Thou sellest thy people for nought, and dost not increase thy wealth by their price: God was not looking for financial gain when he allowed us to be sold. - Thou makest us a reproach to our neighbours, a scorn and a derision to them that are round about us. Thou makest us a byword among the heathen: they have nicknames for us. A shaking of the head among the people: when we come around, they shake their heads. - My confusion is continually before me: this psalm is of the sons of Korah, who saw the vision of us going from the top nation down to the bottom, and could not reconcile what he was seeing. Bring it up to today: our people are confused. We get the education, we talk like them, walk like them, imitate them down to the hair, and we are still cast off. News read in class: black women with stable federal jobs were an easy target of the purge, with hundreds of thousands dismissed. Why? Because we were not brought to this country to prosper and stay here. We were brought here to serve out our punishment, learn to repent of our sins, and then go back to greatness. Christians do not understand that. - For the voice of him that reproacheth and blasphemeth; by reason of the enemy and avenger: at one time we knew the white man was our enemy. Now we see him as our avenger, our helper, our bosom buddy. A few decades ago he was your enemy; now he is your lover? It makes no sense. Precepts: - Romans 8:36 As it is written, For thy sake we are killed all the day long; we are accounted as sheep for the slaughter. Paul is quoting Psalms 44:22: that is why he always said bring the books and the parchments, because his letters referenced things already written. - Matthew 24:9 Then shall they deliver you up to be afflicted, and shall kill you: and ye shall be hated of all nations for my name's sake. A speaker in a clip shown in class admitted plainly that the whole world is anti-black; Christ said the same thing here first. Lamentations 4:17 2:10:40 - As for us, our eyes as yet failed for our vain help: the vain help is our enemy and avenger. In our watching we have watched for a nation that could not save us. - The courtroom scene was recalled where a convicted officer was consoled, her hair stroked by a court officer, and the judge came down to hug her and hand her a Bible, while the victim's brother offered forgiveness. Only with our people. That is watching for a nation that cannot save us. Deuteronomy 7:6 2:14:16 - A commentary clip was played responding to a wrestler's insult of Michelle Obama at a 250th anniversary event, defending the Declaration of Independence and its promise that all people are created equal. The brother means well, but he is misled: there is no Bible scripture that says all men are created equal. You can search until you are blue in the face. - But here is what is in the Bible: for thou art an holy people unto the Lord thy God: the Lord thy God hath chosen thee to be a special people unto himself, above all people that are upon the face of the earth. That is not equality: God said, I chose you, I love you, I am setting you above everybody. - When the powerful talk about equality, they mean themselves at the top and you at the bottom. That is their form of equality. Ezekiel 35:5 2:17:50 - Because thou hast had a perpetual hatred, and hast shed the blood of the children of Israel by the force of the sword in the time of their calamity, in the time that their iniquity had an end. When our iniquity had an end, they helped forward the affliction, like we read in Zechariah 1:15. - A 1965 interview was played in which a southern judge explained calmly that segregation and the negro's place had been taught to him, that he taught it to his children, and that they would teach theirs. Those children are in their 60s and 70s now, with children and grandchildren of their own, and some of you think they changed. They did not change. They are your judges, politicians, and some of them your doctors: the class noted reporting that black mothers face the worst birth outcomes in Mississippi. Amos 1:11-12 2:18:50 - Thus saith the Lord; For three transgressions of Edom, and for four, I will not turn away the punishment thereof. It might look like Edom is not being punished; God says, I will not forget my punishment on them. - Because he did pursue his brother with the sword, and did cast off all pity, and his anger did tear perpetually, and he kept his wrath for ever: perpetual means forever. - But I will send a fire upon Teman, which shall devour the palaces of Bozrah: when you read Isaiah 34, it goes into Christ's return destroying the capital cities of Edom. Isaiah 47:10-15 2:23:33 - For thou hast trusted in thy wickedness: thou hast said, None seeth me. They believed nobody would ever know what was done at Tulsa or Seneca Village. - Thy wisdom and thy knowledge, it hath perverted thee: all their technology has perverted them. And thou hast said in thine heart, I am, and none else beside me: they are saying they are God. - Therefore shall evil come upon thee; thou shalt not know from whence it riseth: and desolation shall come upon thee suddenly. - Stand now with thine enchantments, and with the multitude of thy sorceries, wherein thou hast laboured from thy youth: 1776 is their youth; America is one of the youngest nations on the planet. Image shown in class: the street plan of Washington DC, designed by Freemasons, forming an inverted five-pointed star with the White House at the bottom point. That is the star some of our people wear while barbecuing on their holiday. - A new film about the young George Washington released this week is no coincidence: they want to bring the patriot spirit back for the 250th anniversary. It is witchcraft. - A clip was played on the three stages of every fallen empire: first the death of God, then sexual liberation, then men no longer willing to maintain social cohesion, citing the study Sex and Culture. That is why they are trying to bring religion back now: the country is going to be destroyed soon. - Another clip argued that the internet, the search engines, and the social platforms were all founded on government military technology handed to the public, the better to watch everything. The technology we use is outdated military technology. - Let now the astrologers, the stargazers, the monthly prognosticators, stand up, and save thee from these things that shall come upon thee. Behold, they shall be as stubble; the fire shall burn them: they shall not deliver themselves from the power of the flame. There shall not be a coal to warm at: no comfort. - Thus shall they be unto thee with whom thou hast laboured, even thy merchants, from thy youth: they shall wander every one to his quarter; none shall save thee. Everyone goes back to their homeland. Precepts: - Revelation 18:21-23 A mighty angel took up a stone like a great millstone, and cast it into the sea, saying, Thus with violence shall that great city Babylon be thrown down. Thy merchants were the great men of the earth: their corporations. For by thy sorceries were all nations deceived: the imagery, the television, the movies that manipulate the people, like the discussion earlier about images and enrollment. And do not think there are two different Babylons: this is the same Babylon the great. Job 19:23-28 2:36:40 - Oh that my words were now written! oh that they were printed in a book! And they are now. - For I know that my redeemer liveth: the redeemer is Christ. And that he shall stand at the latter day upon the earth: Christ shall stand on the earth in the latter days. - And though after my skin worms destroy this body, yet in my flesh shall I see God: that is regeneration. Whom I shall see for myself, and mine eyes shall behold, and not another: my spirit is not going to be in another person's body; my own eyes will look upon the redeemer. - Job understood regeneration. He knew that Christ would return in the latter days and that Job would be back to see him for himself. Who Job is today, we do not know; the Lord knows. Job 20:5-11 2:38:16 - That the triumphing of the wicked is short, and the joy of the hypocrite but for a moment: we have to believe that thing. This is Zophar speaking, but it is prophetic. - Though his excellency mount up to the heavens, and his head reach unto the clouds: that goes back to Obadiah 4, space travel and planes. - Yet he shall perish for ever like his own dung: they which have seen him shall say, Where is he? He shall fly away as a dream, and shall not be found: yea, he shall be chased away as a vision of the night. Another name for a vision of the night is a nightmare. Dealing under this rule, God said when you wake up it is going to be like a nightmare was chased away, and you will look for that man and he will be gone. The eye also which saw him shall see him no more. - His children shall seek to please the poor, and his hands shall restore their goods: so do not worry about begging for reparations. Everything that was taken from us, the Bible says his hands shall restore. Think of the wealth, the gold, and our records held in the Vatican: we are going to get everything back. - His bones are full of the sin of his youth, which shall lie down with him in the dust. Precepts: - Isaiah 14:13-14 For thou hast said in thine heart, I will ascend into heaven, I will exalt my throne above the stars of God: space travel. They did not put their flag on the moon for anybody but themselves. I will sit also upon the mount of the congregation, in the sides of the north: the sides of the north is where we were taken. I will be like the most High: I will be like God. - Obadiah 1:18 And the house of Jacob shall be a fire, and the house of Joseph a flame, and the house of Esau for stubble; and there shall not be any remaining of the house of Esau; for the Lord hath spoken it. Who spoke it? The Lord spoke that thing; we did not say it. Israelites who purposely ignore these scriptures and only read love scriptures are trying to change the narrative of what God is saying. Genesis 4:14 2:42:54 - Behold, thou hast driven me out this day from the face of the earth: talking about Cain. I shall be a fugitive and a vagabond in the earth: a fugitive is somebody always on the run from justice, who never pays for his crimes; a vagabond is in everybody's land and everybody's home. - The fugitive and vagabond speaks of his descendants. Has America paid for its crimes? Have the whites in South Africa paid? In Australia? None of them has paid for their crimes yet. Precepts: - Wisdom of Solomon 10:3 But when the unrighteous went away from her in his anger, he perished also in the fury wherewith he murdered his brother. Cain murdered Abel, and Cain was killed the same way. The judgment catches up. Job 20:12-29 2:44:28 - Though wickedness be sweet in his mouth, though he hide it under his tongue. Two explanations, both correct. When we got those little civil rights, there were certain things the white man could not say any more: he had to watch the name calling, he had to give us jobs. He hid the wickedness under his tongue. But now he is not hiding it any more: the immigrants are told to get out, the old words are coming back, the programs are ended. - Though he spare it, and forsake it not; but keep it still within his mouth: it is still there. Job is saying the same thing Ecclesiasticus says. - Yet his meat in his bowels is turned, it is the gall of asps within him: it is poison within him. - He hath swallowed down riches, and he shall vomit them up again: God shall cast them out of his belly. That is reparations, that is restitution. Wherever they have it hidden, God said, I am going to bring up all the wealth they stole. - He shall not see the rivers, the floods, the brooks of honey and butter: verse 17 is saying he is not going to enjoy the kingdom of heaven. - That which he laboured for shall he restore, and shall not swallow it down: according to his substance shall the restitution be. So while you are in the street crying for reparations, God says, do not worry about it: I have got you. Everything they took from us is coming back. And he shall not rejoice therein: he will not be happy about it, and God does not care. Because he hath oppressed and hath forsaken the poor; because he hath violently taken away an house which he builded not: he took houses, lands, and people violently. - Surely he shall not feel quietness in his belly: he shall not save of that which he desired. There shall none of his meat be left; therefore shall no man look for his goods: because it is all coming to us. - In the fulness of his sufficiency he shall be in straits: every hand of the wicked shall come upon him. And this is important: it says every hand of the wicked, because there are Israelites saying we are going to execute this. No. It is the other nations that are going to attack America for the atrocities, for the bombings, for the displacement. The Most High is going to raise up the other nations against them; we walk in righteousness. - When he is about to fill his belly, God shall cast the fury of his wrath upon him, and shall rain it upon him while he is eating: when they shall say, Peace and safety, then sudden destruction, 1 Thessalonians 5. - He shall flee from the iron weapon, and the bow of steel shall strike him through: the iron weapon is the missiles. It is drawn, and cometh out of the body: it comes out of the body of the earth, the silos. Yea, the glittering sword cometh out of his gall: terrors are upon him. - A fire not blown shall consume him: when you light a fire you blow it to make it grow; nuclear fire you do not blow on, it grows of its own. - The heaven shall reveal his iniquity; and the earth shall rise up against him. The increase of his house shall depart, and his goods shall flow away in the day of his wrath. - This is the portion of a wicked man from God, and the heritage appointed unto him by God: that is the portion of Esau. His heritage is destruction. Precepts: - Ecclesiasticus 12:10-12 Never trust thine enemy: for like as iron rusteth, so is his wickedness. Though he humble himself, and go crouching: images were shown from 2020 of officials and crowds kneeling, hugging, and weeping before our people, and many said, see, they love us. Yet take good heed and beware of him: thou shalt be unto him as if thou hadst wiped a looking glass, and thou shalt know that his rust hath not been altogether wiped away. The wickedness is still there. Even the apology and the kissing of feet means nothing without restitution: if I steal your wallet and apologize, I give you your wallet back. - Isaiah 14:16 They that see thee shall narrowly look upon thee, and consider thee, saying, Is this the man that made the earth to tremble, that did shake kingdoms? That is what they will say in that day. - Isaiah 13:13-19 Therefore I will shake the heavens, and the earth shall remove out of her place: when Christ returns, the earth moves off her axis. And it shall be as the chased roe: a roe is a deer; they shall be as a sheep that no man taketh up, and they shall every man turn to his own people, and flee every one into his own land. Every one that is found shall be thrust through; and every one that is joined unto them shall fall by the sword: those joined to them get the same judgment. The scripture says the invaders show no pity in that day, not even to the children. Behold, I will stir up the Medes against them, which shall not regard silver; and as for gold, they shall not delight in it: they do not care about the money. And Babylon, the glory of kingdoms, the beauty of the Chaldees' excellency, shall be as when God overthrew Sodom and Gomorrah. In Closing So you see, Esau's funeral is written in the Bible. The Most High's judgment on this wicked man is the portion appointed unto him by God: his heritage is destruction. And with that, twelve tribes, we say shalom. Announcements & References Field reports played: - Alaska takeover: from Dallas, Austin, and across the country, men answered the call and traveled to Anchorage, Alaska to build up the lost sheep and preach repentance. Contrary to popular belief, there are blacks, Hispanics, and Native Americans in Anchorage. The mission never stops. - The prophets of IUIC Milwaukee brought the fire of God's word to the Juneteenth festival: false Christs were challenged and our people were called to repentance and their true biblical identity. - IUIC had the opportunity to reach over 65 million television screens appearing on the Cassandra Show; the episode is live on YouTube and rerunning on stations across America. - The mighty prophets of IUIC Jamaica, led by Captain Tobias, traveled to the far west side of the island to blitz Savannah-la-Mar, Westmoreland, bringing the truth to the tribe of Benjamin. - Captain Abigail and Officer Issachar led the prophets to break ground in Muzquiz and Nacimiento, Mexico, where the tribes of Issachar and Reuben willingly received the word of God. - The Gideon's Army challenge: do the most work possible in the shortest amount of time. IUIC Rochester and Toronto, in only four straight days, did 111 events including 78 camps, 27 barbershops, three church blitzes, and four TV and podcast appearances, all with only 25 men. What will you do? - IUIC Houston celebrated the going home of our beloved brother Abner, who has gone on to be with the Lord: a brother whose presence, labor, and memory will not be forgotten. Precious in the sight of the Lord is the death of his saints. Music and media: - Deacon Isaac's debut album Eternal Glory drops July 12th, with a listening party and album release in Dallas, Texas: live performances and an exclusive first listen. Support, support, support. - Grab your favorite pieces from the Royal Range collection at originalroyalty.com: premium cotton and genuine Nappa leather. - Israel Live top five: scan the QR code to cast your vote for next week's episode, Monday nights at 9:00 pm. - Subscribe to IUIC Diaspora 2.0: the kingdom awaits, twelve tribes worldwide. Films referenced in class: Watchmen (the first episode, on the history of Tulsa), Farming (the director's own true story of a Nigerian boy fostered by a white family in the UK), Little White Lie, The Vernon Johns Story, Enemy of the State, Syriana, and They Cloned Tyrone. Dates: the next voluntary fast begins July 10th at sundown. Closing reading: 1 Corinthians 11:23, the bread and the cup, in remembrance of the Lord's death till he come. --- Class Notes Index Transcript: full session

title: KNOW YOUR ENEMY: GOD'S FOES & OURS
text: Introduction Congregation rose and faced Jerusalem; opening readings: Ecclesiasticus 36 and Psalms 146, followed by prayer: "Today, Father God, America is getting ready to celebrate. America is ready to celebrate the destruction they did to thy people. America is about to celebrate the murder, the raping, the stealing they did to our people, and they're still doing it today. Lord, do not forget the tabernacle of Esau. Let their celebration turn to mourning. Let their celebration turn to destruction on their own head. They're about to celebrate 250, but we all know it been way longer than 250 that they've been killing and murdering; not only here, in the continent of Africa, in Haiti, in Jamaica, all over the world thy people scatter. As for thy people, bring repentance. As for thy people, bring peace. Redeem thy people, Father God." Shalom, shalom brothers. That's the name of the class: Know Your Enemy, God's Foes and Ours. In The News - She had a lot to say about Haitians, but she missed a couple of key points. This is what happen when you do not open a book and read, when you don't know your own history. - For some of you who don't know what's going on in the news: this week the Supreme Court upheld Donald Trump, saying it's okay he can cancel the TPS program for over 400,000 so-called Haitians. In other words, he can deport them. That happened this week. Scriptures Opened Obadiah 1:3 12:12 - The pride of thine heart hath deceived thee. We just saw the white woman's pride: we build this, we build America, we don't want you here. A white woman like this will fool a negro quick; the negro that don't know the history of America. Cuz some of us, the truth is, some of us are stupid, I'm being honest with you. And they know we stupid. - She's not going to tell you though about the 66 million so-called American Indians they murdered to take this land. She ain't going to tell you we are standing on stolen land. She ain't going to tell you the reason Haiti is the way it is: the white men did that. Oh no, no, no, don't tell them that; I'm talking to a bunch of stupid people, they don't know that part. - But I'm telling you right now, she's definitely not talking to the Israelites, because we know who you are, devil. Oh yes, Megyn Kelly, we know who you are. You are the devil the Bible speak of. You talking to people that don't know your history, where you come from. We know who you are, and you cannot help yourself. You're the devil. - You thinking it's only Megyn Kelly? Oh no, no, no. It's not only Megyn Kelly. - This is what you call when dumb black people do not know history, when dumb black people do not read. Their book is social media, television, sport. They never pick up a book and sit down and read. This is what happened when you drop out of high school. - And you know what's so crazy? That's an older guy. He's supposed to teach the young man. If this guy knew just a little bit about the history, he would know that the ignorance that's coming out of his mouth make no sense. Deuteronomy 33:7 20:46 - What I'm about to read, I want all you 12 tribes, actually all you 11 tribes, to understand what this is saying. This go deeper than you guys think. - And this is the blessing of Judah. Judah is the only tribe that do not have a country to go to. I'm going to repeat that again. When you look at all the 12 tribes: the Haitian can say, hey, I'm going back to Haiti; the Jamaican can say, I'm going back to Jamaica. Judah don't have that. That's why in Genesis 49 he said, thy hand shall be in the neck of thine enemies: in other words, Judah's going to live with the enemy. - And he said, Hear, Lord, the voice of Judah, and bring him unto his people. Judah is the one, not Levi, not Benjamin, not Issachar. Judah is the one who's going to be on the forefront fighting. The wake up is going to start with Judah; Judah is going to wake up and wake up the rest of them. That's what that's saying. And that go deeper than that, because that also go into Christ. - A lot of you, Levi and Benjamin coming here to the United States, running your big black mouth against Judah: you have no idea what you're talking about. Some of you seriously need to just shut the hell up, cuz some of you don't know history. - Let his hands be sufficient for him; and be thou an help to him from his enemies. Leave that; I'm going to come back to this later on. - I grew up in a household where I heard that; I was a kid, I didn't know any better, I heard my family when they badmouth against Judah. The people from the islands coming to this country always run their mouth. And you got to forgive them; they run their mouth because they do not know. There was a sister I was watching this week; she said, I don't give a f about no Haitian going back home; you guys never understand what we going through here in this country. There's a part I agree with her: nobody understand what Judah went through. She's 100% right. - The reason a lot of the tribes run their mouth against the so-called African-American: they do not know the history. 90% of them do not know the history. A lot of people get fed with social media, television, whatever the media push, that's what they believe. They want you to believe Judah is the laziest. That's not true. They never tell you after slavery there was Judah still getting lynched. They never tell you about Jim Crow, redlining, black codes. There's a lot of things they don't tell you. Image shown: a tree. - You see this tree right here? This tree got beautiful leaves; the leaves look green. What you notice about the root of the tree? Did that tree begin with the green, or did that tree begin at the root? The problem with us: when we look at the so-called African-American, you look at the leaves; you do not look at the root of the tree. No tree grow from the leaves. The tree began with a little seed; you drop it in the dirt, it grow, become that tree. - The problem with a lot of us is we look at the problem; we don't look at what caused the problem. Judah, the African American, is lazy. Why? I don't know, they're just lazy. You stupid for just saying that; you don't know why, you just say stuff out of your mouth. - America, the media, do not tell you what they did to the root of the tree; they just tell you to look at the leaves. You think black people just in the city of Chicago woke up one day and decided to kill each other, and nothing happened? You stupid if you believe that. The last time I looked, I don't know no black man who can create a gun. I don't know no black man who have cocaine in his backyard, go and cook it in his backyard. None. Something happened. Before you open your big black mouth, find out what happened. - I was watching Captain Gideon's class this morning: the history, how many towns white people flooded. That was Judah. Judah been trying to get away from the white people forever, and every time Judah tried to get away, they say no. Guess what? Megyn Kelly is not going to tell you that. She's going to say, look how much they're killing each other; but they're not going to tell what caused the problem. That's what's wrong with the so-called Haitian, the so-called Jamaican, those of you who come in this country running your big black mouth: you believe everything the white man say. - This is for you so-called African-Americans who said, oh yeah, I'm happy they're going to deport 400,000. I forgive you, because you don't know history, you don't know any better. But listen, you really underestimate the white man. Some of you are sleeping on the white man. I'm talking to Judah. - Let me tell you something, man. This is why I hate Christianity. Oh yes, I hate Christianity with a passion. Because Christianity is the worst thing that ever happened to our people. The things that's coming out of your mouth: you have to be a Christian to talk trash like that. Because some of you, I truly believe, no matter what the white men done to us, some of you still love this beast, some of you still love this animal. - I went to Walmart the other day. All these negroes who was talking about, we got to boycott the Asian businesses: I could not find no parking. Walmart was filled. You know what they was doing? Buying charcoal, buying grills; they had a big tent selling firecrackers. Those are the same people who was saying, let's boycott Asian. So spiritual Sodom is back, spiritual Gomorrah is back, and they're just happy doing it. So happy, they send up a gay flag unto the sky. - As a beacon of hope for all the countries of the world, especially the Middle East. What hope? I didn't see the prisoners that the Israelis caught and then raped come out of that moment with hope in their face. You had to drag them; they couldn't even walk. These people are delusional. They're sick. - Oh, the freedom to just be sinners. That's the true definition of democracy: just be gay. Wherever democracy goes is gay, lesbian, bisexual, trans; even their dogs is gay. That's America in a nutshell. That's Israel. That's democracy. That's why a lot of countries be like, keep that democracy to yourself. - They're just enjoying themselves, kids around, grown folks around. What's different than Sodom and Gomorrah? Not a damn thing. Genesis 19:1-11, 25-26 2:23:28 - There came two angels to Sodom at even, and Lot sat in the gate of Sodom. Lot had them: hey, listen, it's dangerous out here, man, come in my house. - But before they lay down, the men of the city, even the men of Sodom, compassed the house round, both old and young. Old homos, young homos. All the people from every quarter, cuz they've never seen such handsome men before. They came and compassed the man's house. Bring them out unto us, that we may know them: you think they wanted to just say, hey, how you doing, buddy? Nope. They wanted to rape them. - Lot offered them his two daughters, virgins. And they pressed sore upon the man, even Lot, and came near to break the door. That's how inflamed they were in their pride. And even though they were blinded, they were still trying to get into the house; they wearied themselves to find the door. You got to listen how sick you got to be. But his wife looked back from behind him, and she became a pillar of salt. Now why would his wife look back? Jeremiah 49:7-8 2:31:53 - Esau thought he was going to do all these things and nothing going to happen to him. Concerning Edom, thus saith the Lord of hosts: is wisdom no more in Teman?
