title: 250 YEARS OF CELEBRATION 400 YEARS OF SWEAT EQUITY (PT 2)
text: Introduction We are continuing with what we were dealing with last week. The title was changed just a little so it does not conflict in the search engines, but the subject is the same: 250 years of celebration, 400 years of sweat equity. We know we have been over here longer than 400 years, but this lesson focuses on the sweat equity part. Look at the thumbnail: slaves for sale, the chains on the brothers, Gad the Native American having his land taken and set on fire, the ships in the background that brought us here, the colored waiting rooms and segregated drinking fountains, and the fireworks of them celebrating over the robbery of what happened to us. Shout out to the previous classes that went down today: Deacon Ithan's class on Christianity, indoctrination without explanation, which is exactly what happens in the churches; and Captain Yadiah this morning on Perilous Times: Judges and Soldiers, about understanding the times that we are in, judging situations properly, and not being dragged by our emotions into these wicked holidays and the people that deal with them. Last week we opened Revelation 17 on the eighth head, which is of the seven. The seven heads carried this beast: Greece, Rome, Spain, France, Germany, Russia, and Great Britain. The eighth head is a materialization and compilation of the seven, a different color on the rendering the brothers and sisters made, and it was going to be a real problem on this earth. We are in the midst of that. The mindset and psychology of this eighth head, Babylon the Great, is to enslave our children for sweat equity. You were not brought over here to enjoy the prosperity of this place; it was stolen from your brothers Gad and Reuben. They need us to be the sweat equity so that they can have a great time. This is not teaching hatred and it is not teaching racism; it is teaching what the Bible says. Scriptures Opened Revelation 12:1-6 15:44 - There appeared a great wonder in heaven, a woman clothed with the sun. This woman is the twelve tribes of Israel. The commandments are a lamp and the law is light, and that was only given to the Israelites. Upon her head a crown of twelve stars: the twelve tribes. - She being with child cried, travailing in birth, and pained to be delivered. The woman, the nation of Israel, was travailing to bring forth Christ to save us from the hand of the Romans, who had taken the kingdom of Israel by force. Pained to be delivered means we were persecuted. - And there appeared another wonder in heaven: our heaven. Behold, a great red dragon having seven heads and ten horns, and seven crowns upon his heads: seven different rulers among this beast, Greece, Rome, Spain, France, Germany, Russia, and Great Britain. The eighth head was not here yet at this point. - His tail drew the third part of the stars of heaven, and did cast them to the earth. The stars of heaven are the twelve tribes; the third part is mainly Judah, Benjamin, and Levi, with stragglers of the other tribes still in Jerusalem, like Anna of the tribe of Aser. By the time Rome came in, the bulk of the tribes had already gone; that is the counsel of the northern tribes under Cyrus that we read last week. Cast them to the earth: put them into captivity, going into 70 AD. - The dragon stood before the woman which was ready to be delivered, for to devour her child as soon as it was born. Who was this dragon? Rome, the house of Herod. Herod was an Idumean; Idumea is a word for Edom, and that is in the history books. The same beast that was rebirthed into this beast here has the same mentality. - She brought forth a man child, who was to rule all nations with a rod of iron: and her child was caught up unto God, and to his throne. He was transfigured, taken up. - The woman fled into the wilderness, where she hath a place prepared of God. The wilderness is Africa; we fled out of Jerusalem into Africa, the same place where Joseph took the young child and his mother. Then a place was prepared, which is the Americas. A thousand two hundred and threescore days: 1260 days, three and a half, the same period written as forty and two months and as a time, times, and the dividing of time in Daniel 7 and 8. Precepts: - Jeremiah 6:2 The Lord has likened the daughter of Zion to a comely and delicate woman. That is the woman Revelation 12 is talking about: the twelve tribes of Israel. - Psalms 147:19-20 He sheweth his word unto Jacob, his statutes and his judgments unto Israel. He hath not dealt so with any nation. That law and light was only given to the Israelites. - Matthew 2:13 Herod sent an edict to look for Christ to kill him, killing our children from two years old and under. The angel told Joseph: arise, take the young child and his mother, and flee into Egypt, for Herod will seek the young child to destroy him. If Christ did not look like the people of Egypt, how could you hide him there? He was able to hide among the people because he looked like them. That is the persecution Revelation 12 is talking about. - Matthew 11:11-12 Among them that are born of women there hath not risen a greater than John the Baptist: notwithstanding he that is least in the kingdom of heaven is greater than he. The subject matter is the kingdom of heaven. From the days of John the Baptist until now the kingdom of heaven suffereth violence, and the violent take it by force. The kingdom of heaven where the Most High is suffered no violence; the violence was happening to us, in our kingdom. The Romans came into our heaven and took our kingdom by force. That is why the disciples asked in Acts 1:6, wilt thou at this time restore again the kingdom to Israel? - Revelation 13:3 I saw one of his heads as it were wounded to death. That is Rome, overthrown in 193 AD by the Israelites, which brought on the dark ages, all the way up to the Renaissance, where that head was rebirthed. That is what renaissance means. When they came back they ran a campaign of iconoclasm to destroy the black images painted all over Europe; the books from Harvard, Yale, and Oxford have those pictures. His deadly wound was healed: the Spaniards came, took the tribes, and started the slave trade. And all the world wondered after the beast: all the world wondered after America. This is when the eighth head started to bud, from the 1500s up to 1776, when it completely broke away from the seventh head, Great Britain. - Luke 21:20-24 When ye shall see Jerusalem compassed with armies, the Roman armies, then know that the desolation thereof is nigh. It was prophesied that Jerusalem would be destroyed. Let them which are in Judaea flee to the mountains: our people fled into Africa. Rudolph R. Windsor's book Babylon to Timbuktu records that the Israelites fled from Roman persecution and slavery, that the slave markets were full of black Jewish slaves, and it records the outrageous atrocities the Romans committed against our people in that destruction. These be the days of vengeance, that all things which are written may be fulfilled: the judgment of Deuteronomy for breaking the laws all the way back to Moses. They shall fall by the edge of the sword, and shall be led away captive into all nations: our people were led into slavery into all nations, and everywhere we have gone we have been their sweat equity. The world economy was built off of our destruction. And Jerusalem shall be trodden down of the Gentiles, until the times of the Gentiles be fulfilled: the people on the land now calling themselves Jews are the Gentiles the Lord spoke of, and when their time is up, Psalms 149 is what awaits them. - Hosea 1:10-11 In the place where it was said unto them, Ye are not my people. This is where they destroyed our nationality, called us out of our name, called us undocumented workers, and when we try to pick up the Bible and gain our nationality back they label it a hate crime, because they propagated a set of people and said these are the Jews. That is why Psalms 83 says they have consulted that the name of Israel may be no more in remembrance. There it shall be said unto them, Ye are the sons of the living God: that is what is happening to you, brothers and sisters, right here in Babylon the Great, which means they cannot stop this gospel. Then shall the children of Judah and the children of Israel be gathered together, and appoint themselves one head: that is Christ, and they shall come up out of the land. That is when we go home. - Revelation 11:8-11 Their dead bodies shall lie in the street of the great city, which spiritually is called Sodom and Egypt. This great city has both traits: you cannot find a place on earth with more sodomy in it than right here, and it mimics Egypt because the twelve tribes went into bondage here again, brought in with ships. Where also our Lord was crucified: Christ was not crucified here physically, but they gave us Christianity and destroyed the minds of our people. Dead bodies means mentally and spiritually dead: dead to who we are, because they said you are not the children of Israel. Three days and an half: 350 years. They shall not suffer their dead bodies to be put in graves, because we are not physically dead. They that dwell upon the earth shall rejoice over them, and make merry, and shall send gifts one to another: the nations are rejoicing and celebrating over our destruction. Because these two prophets tormented them that dwelt on the earth: they know our history and remember the power we once ruled with. And after three days and an half the spirit of life from God entered into them, and they stood upon their feet: after the 350 years, this goes into Ezekiel 37, the dead bones coming to life. That is how you are waking up to the truth. And great fear fell upon them which saw them: they know our God is coming back. Revelation 12:14 52:43 - To the woman were given two wings of a great eagle: a great escape out of Jerusalem when Rome came against us, that she might fly into the wilderness, into her place, where she is nourished for a time, and times, and half a time. Time is one, times is two, and the dividing of time: three and a half again, just as in Daniel. - Where she is nourished from the face of the serpent. Who is feeding us in this captivity? The serpent, the same power the scripture identifies as the dragon. That is why we go to Deuteronomy 28. Precepts: - Deuteronomy 28:47-48 Because thou servedst not the Lord thy God with joyfulness and with gladness of heart for the abundance of all things. We are not happy to keep the Most High's holy days; we show joyfulness and gladness of heart to celebrate pagan holidays instead, but for Passover, the Sabbath, the day of atonement, and the feast of unleavened bread, the beautiful holy days the Lord gave us, we are mad. Therefore shalt thou serve thine enemies in hunger, and in thirst, and in nakedness, and in want of all things: for everything you need, food, water, clothing, hospital care, you have to go to the same enemy, because we broke God's law. And he shall put a yoke of iron upon thy neck, until he have destroyed thee: until you are dead bodies in the street of America, not even knowing who you are, celebrating the Fourth of July when your people were in slavery on that same date. Jeremiah 23 says woe be unto the pastors that destroy and scatter the sheep of my pasture; the preachers that deceived our people with his Bible will answer for it. Revelation 17:11 1:07:08 - The beast that was, and is not, even he is the eighth, and is of the seven, and goeth into perdition. The seven heads carried and gave birth to this eighth beast, the one we are in now. And it goes into perdition: the Most High is going to make it go into perdition because the Israelites are here and because of what it did to us. - Their philosophy is might makes right. They have the power to legitimize criminality: to murder, rob, and steal the land from our brothers the Native Americans, then set up court systems and tell you to come learn about justice, and set churches on top of blood and bones and say come learn about Jesus, and feel completely absolved of any judgment. - Last week I said we had to make it through that wicked weekend, and that I had to wait for the holiday to pass to find out how many of our people got put to death. Sure enough, the brother Nolan Wells, on that very holiday, was out with white acquaintances, taken onto an island, and drowned, and suddenly nobody knows anything. In the tenth grade I had a classmate from the Bronx named Jerry; he went swimming with white acquaintances, and by eleventh grade he was gone. The word was that he panicked and drowned. It is always these mysterious accidents where you are the only one dead. The message is for us to watch over and guide our children, and to get our mind out of the pipe dream of what this country is going to do for us. That does not mean do not go to school or do not do well on your jobs; all of those things are to be used for your benefit and your nation's benefit, so that we can be found in favor in God's eyesight when he comes to redeem us. 2 Esdras 13:40-46 1:15:00 - Entry read in class from the Jewish Encyclopedia on Arzareth, by Morris Jastrow Jr. and Kaufmann Kohler: the name of the land beyond the great river, far away from the habitation of man, in which the ten tribes of Israel will dwell, observing the laws of Moses, until the time of the restoration, according to 4 Ezra 13:45; Columbus identified America with this land. The fourth book of Ezra is 2 Esdras in the Apocrypha: the first book of Ezra is Ezra, the second is Nehemiah, the third is 1 Esdras, and the fourth is 2 Esdras. - Those are the ten tribes which were carried away prisoners in the time of Osea the king, whom Salmanasar the king of Assyria led away captive. Assyria took the northern kingdom; then Babylon rose and took Assyria's captives; then under Cyrus of Persia all the tribes were allowed to go back and build. But they took this counsel among themselves, that they would leave the multitude of the heathen and go forth into a further country, where never mankind dwelt, that they might there keep their statutes which they never kept in their own land. - They entered into Euphrates by the narrow passages of the river, for the Most High then shewed signs for them, and held still the flood till they were passed over. Through that country there was a great way to go, namely of a year and a half: they made stops at the ports along the route, the same ports Solomon's navy already knew. And the same region is called Arsareth: the region Columbus identified with America. Then dwelt they there until the latter time. That is why we are here in the latter times. - A route video was shown in class: the tribes coming down from the Euphrates into the ocean, around Africa, and across to the islands and the mainland: Nepthalim, Aser, Ephraim, Simeon, Manasses, Zabulon where the haven of ships is, and up into the United States where Gad and Reuben are. - Book shown in class: They Came Before Columbus, the African presence in ancient America, by Ivan Van Sertima. The reviews on the book: I cannot praise this book enough; this book is long overdue; of first importance in the history of the Americas; brilliantly, I think he has demonstrated that there is far more to black history than the slave trade; there is no question but that the book is a landmark. Inside the book: worldwide winds and currents emphasizing Atlantic drift routes from Africa to America, which Issachar understood; an East African trading ship of great antiquity that sailed the Indian Ocean between Africa and China; pre-Columbian seafaring capabilities in the Lesser Antilles from the Antigua Archaeology Society; the Ra I, a papyrus boat built by African boatmen from Lake Chad along the pattern of the ancient Egyptians, which left North Africa in 1969 and sailed as far as Barbados, proving an ancient drift journey using the Africa-to-America currents was feasible; a carved figure holding up a pre-Columbian altar in Costa Rica; and the Olmec stone heads, compared side by side with the head of a Nuba chief from Africa. Look at the features: these were the Israelites that came on the ships during the time we read in 2 Esdras, in pre-Columbian time. - Semitic primarily refers to a major language family of the Middle East and the Horn of Africa which includes Hebrew, Arabic, and Aramaic: the people of Shem. But when it comes to the Israelites, the Most High is only dealing with the twelve tribes. Precepts: - 1 Chronicles 12:32 Of the children of Issachar, which were men that had understanding of the times, to know what Israel ought to do. They were able to read the stars and lead the ships; they knew how to navigate the waters. Zechariah 9:6 1:23:28 - And a bastard shall dwell in Ashdod. The word is in the Bible, spelled out. Ashdod is the seaport city the Philistines used to occupy, which is by modern day Tel Aviv. A bastard in scripture is one without the Father: Hebrews says, if ye be without chastisement, then are ye bastards. The Lord is not their father; the Lord is your Father. 1 Kings 11:1-9 1:32:28 - In the archaeological records you will see a six pointed star in the ears and carvings of some of these figures. Do not bug out; here is where it came from, so that you are not ignorant. - King Solomon loved many strange women, of the nations concerning which the Lord said, Ye shall not go in to them, neither shall they come in unto you: for surely they will turn away your heart after their gods. It did not say maybe; it said surely. That is why we are not supposed to be dealing with the other nations. - He had seven hundred wives, princesses, and three hundred concubines: and his wives turned away his heart after other gods. Solomon went after Ashtoreth the goddess of the Zidonians: Ashtoreth is where Easter comes from, the goddess of fertility. Then did Solomon build an high place for Chemosh, the abomination of Moab, and for Molech, the abomination of the children of Ammon. That is where that star came in: the star of Remphan, the star of Molech, witchcraft. Solomon did evil in the sight of the Lord, and the Lord was angry with Solomon, because his heart was turned from the Lord God of Israel, which had appeared unto him twice. - Being that Solomon was into it, the navy was involved in it; that is the reason you see those symbols in some of the records of the people that came over. But that is not a symbol we are supposed to be dealing with. It is not the Star of David; that is not in the Bible. Song of Solomon 8:6 1:39:05 - An old class video was played from the early days, on the so-called Star of David: people take a square peg and try to fit it inside a circle, searching for scriptures that use the words shield or seal and trying to make the Bible say it is talking about that hexagram. That is a complete lie. - The Song of Solomon is a metaphor: the whole book represents the Lord's relationship with his chosen people Israel. Set me as a seal upon thine heart, as a seal upon thine arm. The heart is the mind. What is the seal? The law, the words of God. Precepts: - Deuteronomy 11:18 Therefore shall ye lay up these my words in your heart and in your soul, and bind them for a sign upon your hand, that they may be as frontlets between your eyes. In ancient times Israel would wear the laws wrapped around their arms and on their foreheads. That is the seal Solomon meant. - 2 Esdras 10:21-23 Our sanctuary is laid waste, our altar broken down, our temple destroyed, our psaltery laid on the ground, our song put to silence, the light of our candlestick put out, the ark of our covenant spoiled, our virgins defiled, our wives ravished, our righteous men carried away, our children put to shame, and, which is the greatest of all, the seal of Sion hath now lost her honour. What is the seal of Zion? Not the six pointed hexagram. - Isaiah 8:16 Bind up the testimony, seal the law among my disciples. The law is the seal. - Revelation 7:3-4 Hurt not the earth, neither the sea, nor the trees, till we have sealed the servants of our God in their foreheads. And there were sealed an hundred and forty and four thousand of all the tribes of the children of Israel. What is the seal? Go right back to Isaiah 8:16: the law, in the forehead, in the mind. Ecclesiastes 12:8-14 1:47:50 - Now the question is, did Solomon repent? Vanity of vanities, saith the preacher; all is vanity. This is what Solomon realized. And moreover, because the preacher was wise, he still taught the people knowledge: he came out of that foolishness and taught the people properly, and set in order many proverbs. The proverbs that we read, Solomon wrote those. - The words of the wise are as goads, and as nails fastened by the masters of assemblies, which are given from one shepherd: a goad is the stick a shepherd uses to keep the sheep from straying, and Christ is the shepherd. - Of making many books there is no end; and much study is a weariness of the flesh. All those other gods, books, and philosophies profit you nothing but weariness. Let us hear the conclusion of the whole matter: fear God, and keep his commandments: for this is the whole duty of man. That is the whole reason God put you on this earth. God said have no other gods before me; celebrating the Fourth of July is putting gods before the Most High. For God shall bring every work into judgment, with every secret thing, whether it be good, or whether it be evil. Solomon understood that, repented, got himself right, and dealt with his people properly. Just like Solomon, we can repent. Get yourselves right, brothers and sisters. Mark 12:29 2:06:38 - Book read in class: Lost Tribes and Promised Lands. If something is promised, there must be a promiser. The chapter, a lost tribe discovered in New York: in September 1644 a Portuguese marrano named Antonio de Montezinos arrived in Amsterdam, after having lived for some years in South America, and told the leaders of the Jewish community there a story. Two and a half years before, while traveling in the wild mountains of Quito, he had heard his Indian guides remark that the natives of that country deserved their sufferings at the hands of the Spaniards, because, they said mysteriously, we so badly treated a holy people, the greatest in the world. - Upon his return to Cartagena, Montezinos was accused by the Inquisition and put in prison. Praying in his cell one day, reciting the formula blessed be the name of the Lord, who has not made me an idolator, a barbarian, a negro, an Indian, he suddenly stopped: those Indians, he told himself, they are Hebrews. Released, he went back to Francisco the guide, revealed himself as a Jew, and asked to be led to his brothers. - The two men marched into the rugged mountains for a week, and on a Saturday came to a great river. Francisco signaled with a banner; a canoe appeared bearing three men and a woman, all of them Indians. When the woman explained the situation, the men rose, came over to Montezinos, and to his utter astonishment said: Shema Israel, Adonai Elohenu, Adonai Echad. Hear, O Israel: the Lord our God is one Lord. They had recited in Hebrew the fundamental credo out of the book. That is Mark 12:29: Christ said the first of all the commandments is, Hear, O Israel; the Lord our God is one Lord. What would an Indian be doing saying this? - They told him that they were themselves of the tribe of Reuben, and that the tribe of Joseph lived on an island nearby: Ephraim and Manasseh, the two tribes of Joseph, in the islands. The day when they were at last to issue forth into the world was coming soon, they explained. - Francisco told Montezinos all he knew from his own traditions: his ancestors, to their eternal shame, had made war on them and persecuted them; only the sorcerers of his tribe had perceived that they were a special people and warned that they should be left alone. The God of these children of Israel is the true God, they had said, and everything inscribed on their tablets is true. At the end of days they will be lords of all the nations of the earth; one nation will come bringing many things to this land, and after we have all been provided for, these children of Israel will go forth from where they now are and reign over the whole earth as they once did. That is in the history. That is the time of restoration, and that is why Judah is going to teach the tribes. - The book also contains passages from Spanish explorers in the southern United States, 1528 to 1543, with dates, and carries a Library of Congress catalog card number, meaning you can pull the records where this came from. They keep the records and hide them among themselves; they are the ones that know who you are. - Book referenced from last week: The History of the American Indians by James Adair, who lived among the Indians about forty years and came to the conclusion, with arguments and proofs, that these people are descended from the Jews. The same book records that about thirty years earlier there was a remnant of a nation, or subdivided tribe, of Indians called Kanaai, resembling the Hebrew proper name. Wondering out loud, not to start any doctrine: is that where the name of the land above the Americas came from? I leave it to the scholars among us to go deeper. In Closing Book read in closing: Puerto Rico: The Flame of Resistance, an old Latin American legend about a foreign tyrant who tried to bury the truth. The tyrant used arms to conquer another nation, enslaved the people, and forced them to work for his benefit; he had a ceaseless drive for more wealth and power, but he was not yet all powerful, because the truth stood in his way. Before a conqueror looks to conquer you, he must find out what fortified you in the first place: remove the strong man and you can spoil his house. So they took our language, our names, our God, and our images, leaving a shell of a people; that is the dead bodies Revelation was talking about. The tyrant crept into the jungle, dug a deep hole, shouted the truth into it, and buried it. That's why he called us minorities. - And there ye shall serve gods, the work of men's hands: Caesar Borgia, the work of the hands of Leonardo da Vinci. Wood and stone: Christianity. - But if from thence thou shalt seek the Lord thy God, thou shalt find him, if thou seek him with all thy heart and with all thy soul. When they going to seek God? When thou art in tribulation, and all these things are come upon thee, even in the latter days: that's the time we in now. My people getting lynched left and right. You going to boat ride: your last boat ride. You going to the elevator with all white folks: that's your last time going up. That elevator door closed, you see white folks, you like, oh no, y'all go ahead up. We living in some perilous times. Ezekiel 3:17-19 1:15:11 (second teacher) - Hey, this a heavy class right here, because a lot of evil are going on in our society. And when the scripture say oppression make a wise man mad, it do. But we got to behave wisely. We can't just be in our emotion at all. This is our job for our people. - Son of man, I have made thee a watchman unto the house of Israel: that's our job, a watchman for our people, those that are in the truth and those that outside the truth. Therefore hear the word of my mouth, and give them warning from me: so we warn the wicked. That's our job. Our job is to give them warning, because if you sin, the judgment comes. A lot of times our people die because of sin. They in the calamities because of sin. - Our job is to speak to warn the wicked from his wicked way, to save his life. That's why everywhere you go, you see purple and gold. The same wicked man shall die in his iniquity, but his blood will I require at thine hand: we don't want that. That's why we teach the gospel: leave sin, flee sin. - Yet if thou warn the wicked, and he turn not from his wickedness, nor from his wicked way, he shall die in his iniquity, but thou hast delivered thy soul. That's why you be seeing what's going on at times: a lot of our people die in their iniquities. They love the white Jesus. You tell them to stop sinning, they curse you out. They don't want to listen. It hurt us to see our people in such condition, but it's all the Lord doing. Can anything happen on the earth and the Lord don't know about it? Ezekiel 18:4 1:15:11 - Behold, all souls are mine: the righteous and those that is not keeping God's laws, all souls are his. The soul that sinneth, it shall die. We got to know the scripture and see those things. It hurts, yes, but we got to see these things right. Ezekiel 18:32 1:15:11 - For I have no pleasure in the death of him that dieth: that's what the Lord said. Same with us: we don't see those things in a happy body, because we share the same blood, the same complexion. That's our people. That's our brother; that's our sister. It hurt us, but we got to move in wisdom. - Wherefore turn yourselves, and live: that's what the Lord want for all his people. Turn yourself, and live, and live, and live. That's all you got to do. That's what we got to do as a people. Titus 2:6 1:19:35 - So, Israel, we got to play our position as disciplined soldiers, soldiers with a biblical education. We can't get caught up. We cannot get caught up. - Young men likewise exhort to be sober minded: when it say be sober minded, a lot of times we think, okay, yeah, don't smoke weed, don't be drunk. Yeah, absolutely. But it's also going to keep a clear head in all situations. Keep a clear head. Possess your soul. Ephesians 6:10-15 1:19:35 - We got to keep a clear head. We cannot be emotional. Men cannot be emotional; soldiers cannot be emotional. Do we feel emotion? Yes; we proved that earlier. The prophets have always had a heart and a compassion for their people. But as servants of God, we got to move in the spirit of Christ, who was an austere man. - For we wrestle not against flesh and blood, but against principalities, against powers, against the rulers of the darkness of this world: this whole world is dark; this whole system is corrupt; against spiritual wickedness in high places. - Wherefore take unto you the whole armour of God: so we got to walk in the whole armor of God. Not with emotions, not with feelings, not with opinions. Having your loins girt about with truth: the loins of your mind, as written in Peter. It's telling you everything that we got to arm ourselves with is the word of God: the word of God, God's faith, the mission at hand. It didn't say take opinions with you, take emotions with you, be sensual. No, no, no. 2 Corinthians 10:3-6 1:19:35 - For though we walk in the flesh, we do not war after the flesh: though we walk in this flesh, we got to make a living in this present world, but we don't war after the flesh. We can't operate like those in the world either. For the weapons of our warfare are not carnal, but mighty through God to the pulling down of strongholds. - Casting down imaginations, and every high thing that exalteth itself against the knowledge of God: our people imagine that America has their best interest. Our people imagine they can marry a white woman. Our people imagine there's a such thing as having white friends. Our people imagine some strange things. We love learning the hard way. And bringing into captivity every thought to the obedience of Christ: we got to bring every thought to the obedience of Christ, in our armor that we walk in this present world with; no emotions in our armor, none of our own opinions in our armor. - And having in a readiness to revenge all disobedience, when your obedience is fulfilled: so you know what we got to do, Israel? We got to be ready to use these different situations, these calamities, atrocities, especially when our people are actually innocent; when we listen to the facts, hear out the whole matter, the whole conclusion, and we realize that our people were actually innocent, they were murdered unjustly, they were incarcerated unjustly, things were planted on them. These things do happen. And guess what? We got to be ready to use those situations to bring our people to Christ, to teach them the gospel. Isaiah 59:9-12 1:23:56 - Therefore is judgment far from us: the Bible says judgment is far from our people. We got to understand that. Therefore we cannot be shocked when police do all manner of evil, use unreasonable force, and they say, oh, well, you know, I fear for my life. We can't be shocked when they get off. Stop being shocked. If you shocked, that mean you don't study. Neither doth justice overtake us: we don't know what justice look like. We wait for light, but behold obscurity: we always confused. - We grope for the wall like the blind: we blind. We grope in thinking that there's going to be change in democracy. We grope and think, maybe I should be a Republican; we groping over here, maybe I should be a liberal. We think that all these things is going to make a difference. It's not. We stumble at noon day as in the night: the prophets is on the corner saying, this is the way, but our people stumble as in the night. We are in desolate places as dead men: we are the walking dead right in Babylon the Great; spiritually dead. - We roar all like bears: that's that civil unrest right there. Hands up, don't shoot. Black lives matter. Say his name. And mourn sore like doves: and that's the heart that we got to have for our people; we always crying. We look for judgment, but there is none: we look for judgment from a crooked system; there is no judgment for us. For salvation, but it is far off from us: somebody to save us from our lowest state. - Why is all this happening? For our transgressions are multiplied before thee, and our sins testify against us: we evil as hell. Our people are rotten. So it's going to always be controversy, civil unrest, whether people are innocent or guilty. So we got to use these high controversial moments; we got to use these things to edify people and bring them to Christ and show them the right way. Isaiah 30:20-21 1:23:56 - And though the Lord give you the bread of adversity, and the water of affliction: adversity is oppression, and the water of affliction, that's our tears crying daily. Mothers sobbing daily, just like the mother of our brother Cyrus Belton. She saying, y'all want our culture, y'all want our music, y'all want to dress like us, y'all want to hire us, but y'all don't even treat us like human beings. - Yet shall not thy teachers be removed into a corner any more, but thine eyes shall see thy teachers: there is a time, there is a place where we show up. Like for our brother Kendrick Johnson: we show up for Kendrick Johnson. You can't even go to high school without getting put to death; rolled up in a gym mat stuffed with newspapers. So there is a time where the prophets, the purple army, is going to show up. That great army written in Ezekiel 37 will show up. It will manifest for our people, and we're going to stand with solidarity, showing that we love and we will defend our people. - And thine ears shall hear a word behind thee, saying, This is the way; walk ye in it. Because a lot of our people, when we trying to give them the answer after something happens, they walking away from us; that's why you shall hear a word behind thee: cuz they walking away from the truth. This is the way, you so-called blacks, Latinos, our people who are of the diaspora spread across the four corners of the earth: you must repent in Christ. Keep the commandments. Keep the laws. That's going to fix our broken people. That's going to fix our broken communities. Repent. Walk ye in it. 1 Peter 3:15 1:28:00 - But sanctify the Lord God in your hearts: nothing comes before God's mission. We got to sanctify the Lord God in our mind. We cannot let emotions fill our mind, or cloud ourselves with anger and fury. - And be ready always to give an answer to every man that asketh you a reason of the hope that is in you, with meekness and fear: we got to always be ready to give an answer to our people, because a lot of times our people don't understand what's happening to them, because they want to go around God. They want prosperity, but they don't want God in the equation. Isaiah 9:13 1:28:00 - For the people turneth not unto him that smiteth them: who's smiting our people? It says our people don't turn unto him, which is Christ, that's jacking them up. But who do they turn to? The white man. Mr. White man, can you give us justice? Mr. White man, can you give us freedom? Mr. White man, can you give us our manhood? Like it's sold at Walmart on a shelf. Our eyes see the white man, but in the spirit we should know that it's God who's allowing it; it's God who brought it upon us; but our people so simple. Neither do they seek the Lord of hosts. So that's why we got to be ready always to give an answer. Jeremiah 16:10-12 1:32:38 - When we go into the scriptures, as we stand on those corners and prophesy, they going to say, wherefore hath the Lord pronounced all this great evil against us? I thought y'all said we was his chosen people. What is our iniquity? What is our sin that we have committed against the Lord our God? When we go to Zechariah 11, we show them: whose possessors slay them, and hold themselves not guilty. When we go into Isaiah, we show them we're going to be massly incarcerated, hidden in prison houses. - Then shalt thou say unto them, Because your fathers have forsaken me: your mother taught you birthdays. Your daddy taught you Christmas. And have walked after other gods: and your grandma taught you white Jesus. And have served them, and have worshipped them: and you serve them with that cross around your neck. And have forsaken me, and have not kept my law: you don't keep commandment one. - And ye have done worse than your fathers: our people have done worse than their parents. For behold, ye walk every one after the imagination of his evil heart, that they may not hearken unto me. So we got to remember: Christ was not emotional. Christ ain't get caught up. He understood what was going on. It's all part of the program. Isaiah 55:4 1:32:38 - Behold, I have given him for a witness to the people, a leader and commander to the people: God already gave us an example. Christ is our commander. Commanders are not moved with emotions. Commanders are not easily swayed. Commanders think it through; they are strategic. Commanders are calculated. Commanders have contingencies in place. They understand that one thing creates another; they understand that dominoes fall. They consider the end before they make any moves. It ain't checkers. That's what Christ is for us: a leader and a commander. 2 Timothy 2:3-4 1:32:38 - So if Christ is our commander, what do that make us? Thou therefore endure hardness, as a good soldier of Jesus Christ: the Bible says we have to endure hardness as a good soldier of Jesus Christ. - No man that warreth entangleth himself with the affairs of this life: we are at war. Spiritual war. We don't use guns, weapons, none of that stuff, but we are at spiritual war. Spiritual war is the most powerful mode of warfare. Our forefathers understood that this gospel, this mission that we on, we are all soldiers on the battlefield. That's how Paul would refer to his fellow laborers. - That he may please him who hath chosen him to be a soldier: in order for us to please God, who have called us to be a soldier, we cannot be entangled with the affairs of this life. If you entangled with the affairs of this life, that means you want to please men. We can't move like that. We got to be good soldiers with the mind of a judge, which comes from that biblical education. Precepts: - Philippians 3:20 For our conversation is in heaven, from whence also we look for the Saviour, the Lord Jesus Christ. We can't be entangled with the affairs of this life. What does God want us to do? What does God require of us? What is God's mission? Gather the twelve tribes of Israel from the four corners of the earth. Let the elect be sealed; let the 144 be sealed, so we can go home. 1 Timothy 1:18-19 1:36:40 - We can't be weak, soft, mushy, and emotional. We're not choir boys in here. - That thou by them mightest war a good warfare: brothers, we got to war a good warfare. Not emotional. Not caught up with the wicked. Not striking hands with thieves and murderers and people stealing cars and guns and going to shootouts with police, and muddy our good works. - Holding faith, and a good conscience; which some having put away concerning faith have made shipwreck: you get caught up moving off of emotions. Listen, we all going to feel a certain type of way. There's been a lot going on; now Nolan Wells is missing. I totally understand. But we got to remember: everything is of the Lord. Hebrews 10:30 1:36:40 - And remember, our God is not to be played with. Vengeance belongeth unto me, I will recompense, saith the Lord: God gonna pay back the wicked. God will pay back the wicked. And again, The Lord shall judge his people: that's what we always got to remember, cuz we seeing all this death, and we get caught up sometime. God gonna repay the heathen, and God dealing with his people. Remember where judgment starts at first. Amos 9:10 1:40:54 - All the sinners of my people shall die by the sword, which say, The evil shall not overtake nor prevent us: because we prophesy on the corners and we warn them that God's judgment is going to come upon our people if they remain in their sins. So God says all the sinners of my people shall die, because they say, no, ain't nothing going to happen to us. Oh, here y'all go with that Bible. Here y'all go again. But surely evil does come. Evil do overtake them. A lot of times when we prophesy, what happens? We go to an event, we leave the event: gunfire, stabbings, shootings. 1 Peter 4:15-17 1:40:54 - For the time is come that judgment must begin at the house of God: that's the nation of Israel. Listen, even us inside this truth, we are going to suffer. Understand that what's happening to Jake in the world, whether they being wrongfully incarcerated, murdered by police, murdered by random everyday blue collar, white collar heathen, all those same things is going to happen to us as well. But let none of you suffer as a murderer, or as a thief, or as an evildoer, or as a busybody in other men's matters: we going to die in our innocency. We going to die in our faith and our righteousness. Don't suffer and get caught up as a busybody in other men's matters. We got to be very mindful. - Yet if any man suffer as a Christian, let him not be ashamed: if we suffer in this truth as followers of Christ, we're not going to be ashamed when we suffer, because we know there's a kingdom in store for us. We know Christ going to say, good job, my good and faithful servant. But let him glorify God on this behalf. - And if it first begin at us: we seeing what's going on with both kingdoms of the house of Israel. And it's not just the police. We see what's going on in the medical industry: one of the most unsafe places for our women is in the hospital. They going there for a random checkup and never come home. We've been having babies since babies was babies; we taught them how to have babies; we was they mammies; we dealt with their children. But now the black woman, she have a baby, she die left and right. We see the oppression. We see the iniquities. We see the eugenics tree in full effect. But it says, what shall the end be of them that obey not the gospel of God? Revelation 18:4-6 1:44:59 - You sick of this place? Me too. You sick of this place? God is too. - Come out of her, my people, that ye be not partakers of her sins, and that ye receive not of her plagues: we got to tell our people, come out of her, so you don't get jacked up with this place. Yeah, our people is getting jacked up, but as long as there's breath in their body, there's hope for them. They can repent. They can come out of all of that. Repentance is for Israel and Israel only. The white man cannot be saved. Sorry, not sorry. The Arab man, he cannot be saved. - For her sins have reached unto heaven: Tamir Rice, Eric Garner, Mike Brown, Sonia Macy, Sandra Bland, Cyrus Belton. Her sins have reached unto heaven. And God hath remembered her iniquities: Martin Luther King, Patrice Lumumba, Emmett Till. How soon we forget. Jake got short-term memory. But the Bible says God remembers all that; God remembers things unspeakable. God remember Tulsa. God remember all those iniquities. - Reward her even as she rewarded you, and double unto her double according to her works: so it's judgment in store for them. Jeremiah 49:12 1:44:59 - We don't got to get caught up. There is judgment in store for them. There is a God. He showed us his face; we know there's a God. We can go into the curses and see that God don't play. What make you think he gonna play with them? - Behold, they whose judgment was not to drink of the cup have assuredly drunken: that was God's will for us, to give us the kingdom of heaven on earth. What cup? The cup of God's fury: Deuteronomy 28, Leviticus 26. God never wanted us to drink that. God never wanted us under the hand of our enemies. God wanted us to be living in peace and safety in our own land. We are surely drunk of the cup, and we still drinking it. - And art thou he that shall altogether go unpunished? Thou shalt not go unpunished, but thou shalt surely drink of it: God say to the white man, you think you shall be unpunished? Thou shalt not go unpunished. They shall surely drink of God's judgment. They shall surely drink of God's fury. Ezekiel 25:12-14 1:49:13 - Because that Edom hath dealt against the house of Judah by taking vengeance: he used the legislative branch to take vengeance, the judicial branch to take vengeance, the executive branch to take vengeance. He weaponized the police against us; they the original slave catchers. He weaponized ICE against us. And hath greatly offended, and revenged himself upon them: out of his envy and his hatred, he revenged himself upon us. - Therefore thus saith the Lord God, I will also stretch out mine hand upon Edom, and will cut off man and beast from it: and you know the white man love his animals. I will cut off man and beast. Air Bud got to go. Lassie got to go too; and you know they love Lassie. - And I will lay my vengeance upon Edom by the hand of my people Israel: you know why that's written right there? Because we soft. We see a little white boy, we've been conditioned to care for them; they slipping and fall, you want to help them up. You see the white lady come, and she old and feeble, you want to hold the door: let me get that for you. God says, no, no, no: y'all going to do according to mine anger. I remember when they put y'all on them ships. I remember when they slayed y'all by the thousands. I remember when they hung y'all up by the 13, symbolizing Christ and the apostles. I remember when they lynched y'all. I remember when they boiled you in pots and cauldrons. I remember when they took our forefather Nat Turner the prophet and they made wallets out of his skin, belts and shoes out of his skin, took his skull and drunk wine out of it. God says, no: what you're doing is not enough. The day going to come, brothers and sisters, for righteous vengeance. But now is not that time. - And they shall know my vengeance, saith the Lord God: Esau is going to know God's vengeance. Ishmael going to know God's vengeance. Moab going to know God's vengeance. Ammon is going to know God's vengeance. Revelation 13:10 1:49:13 - He that leadeth into captivity shall go into captivity: the white man, the Arab man, they all going in chains. We done built the great wall. We done built the White House. They all going in chains. He that killeth with the sword must be killed with the sword: they murdering our people. They still selling us on auction blocks in Mauritania, all throughout Northeast Africa. - Here is the patience and the faith of the saints: what we need as good soldiers, patience. What we need as a good judge, patience. And we must maintain our faith. In Closing We can't stray from the mission. We can't stray from the protocol. We got to be just as good soldiers and judges in these last days. I pray y'all got something from the class. Most High and Christ bless. Happy Sabbath. We in the building, Israel. --- Class Notes Index Transcript: full session

title: RAISING UP THE TABERNACLE OF DAVID THAT FELL
text: Introduction Class opens with music from the brothers ("I am the son of a God, prince of the power with God"; the freeborn samurai track; the sisters' track: "I come from a long line of angels, four mothers, Rebecca and Rachel"). Opening prayer from Psalms 140: deliver me, O Lord, from the evil man; preserve me from the violent man. "We need them deacon prayers. We don't need the little kid prayers. We need God to hear our prayers." Well, today's not going to be a long class. I'm tired. Malachi got everybody sick; this guy just comes over, just sneeze on everybody. Who's reading for me today? Officer Nick from Riverdale, Georgia. Today's lesson is called Raising Up the Tabernacle of David That Fell. Scriptures Opened Book read in class: The Jewish Mystique by Ernest van den Haag. Shout out to Captain Lemuel who showed me this book. Pay attention to what Esau writes regarding us; this is Amalek that wrote this book: - "Negroes lacked all of these intangible but immensely important advantages. They did not share a common language, religion, history, or culture. They had no literature, no record of their own past, no laws, no leaders, and no community." Notice he says that about us, but all that, Esau destroyed everything when they conquered us. That's what the writer is not revealing. - "Tribes did have at least some of these common bonds. But enslavement destroyed the tribal units. And the Negroes kept on a plantation could communicate with each other only in English. Even their religion, their self-image and their ambitions were those handed to them by their owners." See that? That's Christianity. - "Negroes did not feel that a code of conduct prescribed by their religion would lead to redemption. They did not feel that their sufferings were a chastisement imposed by a father who had been disobeyed, and that ultimate redemption would depend on their studying and obeying his law." You see what the white man wrote? So the white man knows that our redemption comes through studying and obeying God's law. But he's saying black people don't believe that. - "They tended to feel that their fate depended on outside secular forces, on the behavior of the white majority. Thus, they are led to pull or push that majority into helping them, and into repairing the damage done, which further weakens their own initiative and independence." There's voting: politics is the way. We want reparations. Now, this is some heavy writing there. Some telling writing. Job 20:12-13 21:17 - Though wickedness be sweet in the white man's mouth: that's what it's talking about. Though he hide it under his tongue: meaning he hid the evil speech for about 60 years, from the civil rights. Now he said the time is up. We're tired of feeling bad. We ain't humbling ourselves to y'all no more. We going to tell you exactly how we feel. They call it black fatigue. - Though he spare it and forsake it not: meaning it's still there. But keep it still within his mouth. Precepts: - Ecclesiasticus 12:10-12 Now it gives a name to this wicked man: never trust thine enemy. But in order to understand this, you must be able to identify who the enemy is. You know what black people do? You're my enemy, you're my enemy. They'll never look at their oppressor and say that white man enslaved us, that's the enemy. Though he humble himself and go crouching: he's nice to you today; they smile with that plastic smile in your face. The white man gave me a raise. That don't mean nothing; they had a budget. Affirmative action? They get rid of that too, thanks to that negro Clarence Thomas. He became a judge based on affirmative action; now he getting rid of that thing. He said, I made mine, now I'm ending it. Thou shalt know that his rust hath not been altogether wiped away: like a looking glass covered with dust that you wipe; now you can see through the glass. That wickedness from verse 10 is still with him. Set him not by thee, lest when he hath overthrown thee, he stand up in thy place: that's what we did. The black Jews wanted to fight against the Muslims; we went to the Caucasus Mountains and said, we need the help of the Khazars. Those are the wildlings, by the way, in Game of Thrones. They converted to Judaism, they joined our army, we set them by us all over through our military. Now he's the Jew and you're the Gentile; he's the Christian and you're the Gentile. That's what happened. Neither let him sit at thy right hand, lest he seek to take thy seat: you ever notice when black people get in business with white folks, it'll be the black man's business, and for some reason the white man take that thing over? Remember that Edomite that had a steakhouse getting no business, and the old black dude, Tenderism, made that thing booming; a brother helped him and got it all copyrighted. Don't trust these white folks. Y'all be like, he's different, he's not like the rest. Yeah, right. And thou at the last remember my words: when they tell you to put your teeth on the curb, like American History X, now you're going to remember God's words. - Movie referenced: Othello, starring Laurence Fishburne (late 80s, early 90s), where he's the last of the Moorish kings in Spain and all his Edomite friends, unbeknownst to him, are plotting to kill him. They want all black people out of Spain. If you never saw this, check it out. Very good movie. In the news, played in class (public service announcements, by the way): Nolan Wells, missing on Horn Island, Mississippi. His mother Christine Wesley's post read in class: "Guys, my husband and I going to have to stop posting for a little bit. We've been up for close to 48 hours now and my body feels like it's shutting down. Please contact the Jackson County Sheriff Department if you have any leads on his whereabouts. We need to know if he left the island and with who." Second post: "This is our Nolan Wells aka No. One of the sweetest and kindest souls you could ever meet. He went missing on Horn Island on July 4th. Please help us find our sunshine." - His mother is what they call Blasian, mixed with Chinese and black; if you look at him, you can see in his eyes he got a little bit of her. - This brother, his wife, and this young man went celebrating July 4th with a bunch of . That's not the black man or black woman's holiday. - Now, this young lady, I like what she says, but when I see black women with yellow hair, I just get a little annoyed. But what she says, I'll give you one point for that. - Now, this white guy thinks this is about class, rich whites opposed to poor blacks. It's not so much about that; it's about Esau and Jacob. I have to let Esau say it, cuz black people don't believe when other black people say it: oh, you're being racist. Okay, let the white man tell you that. - Remember Kendrick Johnson: the brother that was murdered, allegedly; the white boy he was fighting, his father is part of the FBI and was involved in the cover up, allegedly. - And that is exactly why he's no longer with us: because y'all keep trying to play this integrated game. This will continue to happen until black people accept that you're different and they don't like us. - I like her. That was all right. Listen, you need some racial anger; it gets you done. You need anger sometimes. And that's from black Christians, literally. - So she makes up for bonnet girl. She got the nice head wrap and all that. Definition read in class: replacement theology, or supersessionism, is the Christian doctrine that the church has replaced national Israel as God's chosen people. It teaches that God's covenants and promises to the Jewish people have been spiritually transferred to the church. Core beliefs: adherents view the universal Christian church as the new Israel; Old Testament promises of restoration and blessing for the nation of Israel are interpreted as spiritual blessings for Christians. - This came up around the time of slavery, during the time of the pope, the Catholics. This is their theology which has been going on forever; we may have slept on it. This is why when you ask them a basic question, where are the 12 tribes of Israel in the New Testament, they never have an answer. 2 Peter 3:15-16 41:35 - Peter is addressing Paul's writings; Peter had to read all the letters that Paul wrote. Some things hard to be understood: the Most High had him write it difficult for a reason. Which they that are unlearned and unstable wrest: meaning you struggle, you wrestle with the writings, as they do also the other scriptures, the Old Testament scriptures, unto their own destruction. - This is why it made it easier today: they said all the prophecies in the Old Testament about Israel, that's really about the Christian church today. And you have black people and Latino people that will believe that BS, those lies. Jeremiah 31:31-37 41:35 - Behold, the days come that I will make a new covenant with the house of Israel and with the house of Judah: cuz there was a split; that's why he separates us like that. I never read that one. - Verse 28 is where he breaks down the dream: God hath shewed me that I should not call any man common or unclean. Any man. title: AS IN THE DAYS OF NOAH: PAST & PRESENT
text: Introduction Happy Sabbath, y'all. Shout outs to the friends and shout outs to our frenemies who watch and hate us; for some reason they hate us, but they watch us anyway. Today's topic is going to be called As in the Days of Noah: Past and Present. And we may not get through this class. It's a lot. I have a lot to cover, so let's jump into it. Scriptures Opened Ecclesiastes 1:4-11 9:10 - One generation comes, another generation goes. The old die, the young are born. The sun has a cycle; the wind has a circuit or cycles, just as generations have circuits and cycles. Oceans flow into rivers, rivers flow back into oceans. It's a cycle. - The thing that hath been is that which shall be, and there is no new thing under the sun. Is there any thing whereof it may be said, See, this is new? It hath been already of old time, which was before us: before our generation, it was in the past. And there is no remembrance of former things. Precepts: - Ecclesiastes 3:15 That which hath been is now; and that which is to be hath already been; and God requireth that which is past. - Ecclesiastes 6:10 That which hath been is named already, and it is known that it is man. So he explains it: the thing that have been is man. - Ecclesiastes 8:1 Who knoweth the interpretation of a thing? The wise man. The thing that have been is talking about man. Man has been around before, but there's no remembrance of us being around before. - Just like the wind, the sun, the moon, rivers have a flow, likewise man: we come and we go. Meaning you and I have been here before. Different cycles of life. That's why you call it deja vu: I remember this. Definition read in class: deja vu is the psychological sensation of having already experienced a current situation even though you know it's happening for the first time; the term translates literally from French as already seen. - Already seen, meaning you see it because you're already meant to be there. When you examine the prophecies, the prophets saw things that came to pass. When the prophets saw us going on slave ships, we had to live out what they saw. So when John saw America in flames, we have to live out what John already saw. We're catching up to the prophecies. That's why we have deja vu: because the things that's leading up to what John saw is already set in motion. You can't change it. 2 Esdras 5:42 17:25 - The Lord said, I will liken or compare my judgments to a ring. What's a ring? It's round, just like time, like a clock. It goes around like the wheels on the bus go round and round. So life, or man, is like a ring; judgments also have a circuit or cycle in which they happen over and over and over again. - I'm just going to say it: America is a compilation of every captivity we've been in, from Egypt all the way to Rome. That's why America is the worst and the last, because America is an amalgamation of every captivity we've served from the beginning of our time as a nation until Rome, even until Spain, Portugal. America took all those ancient civilizations and merged them into itself. - America is young; America is 250 years old this year. That's very young. Persia goes back thousands of years. But America acquired a lot of power in very little time because America learned from the mistakes of all the other ancient fallen civilizations before it. Genesis 2:7, 21-24 17:25 - God formed Adam from the dust of the ground, from the soil. Meaning he was a brown or dark man. The richer the soil, the darker the soil. So Adam was a very, very extremely dark man. Not a single scientist will tell you that Adam and Eve were two Caucasian people that gave birth to negroes; it is impossible for two recessive genes. Adam and Eve were the most dark and gave birth to every spectrum of color known to mankind. The original man and woman were black. Even a white man says, you got me, I can't argue that. - The white man is new compared to other black civilizations way before his time: Egypt, Babylon, every ancient civilization was black people. And we're new as well in a way, because Jacob was born a few moments after Esau; we were the last nation on earth. But in terms of color, Esau is brand new, cuz everybody was dark. - She shall be called woman, because woman means out of man, or of man. Therefore shall a man leave his father and his mother, and shall cleave unto his wife: and they shall be one flesh. This is the institution we read about for the first time of marriage. Genesis 3:23-24 21:27 - Satan goes to Eve, he tempts her, he seduces her into partaking in idolatry, and they end up getting chastised for it. Adam got evicted; Adam and Eve got kicked out of the garden, out of paradise. - And he placed at the east of the garden of Eden cherubims, angels, and a flaming sword which turned every way, to keep the way of the tree of life: meaning to keep you away from it; you cannot enter there again. There were angels placed there to cause confusion so you cannot go back. They were placed at the east of the garden. Genesis 4:1-16 21:27 - Adam knew his wife; she conceived and bare Cain. These are the children they had when they were cast out of the garden; Cain, their firstborn that they had when they were cast out. I'm emphasizing that. And Eve said, I have gotten a man from the Lord. - Abel was a keeper of sheep; he was a shepherd. But Cain was a tiller of the ground. So where did Cain spend most of his time? In the field. - In process of time doesn't tell you how long, but over time this took place gradually. Cain brought of the fruit of the ground, because Cain spent most of his time in the field. Abel brought of the firstlings, the best, of his flock, and of the fat thereof, because Adam and Eve, once they were cast out, had to sacrifice animals from that point on. The Lord had respect unto what Abel provided, but not what Cain provided. The Lord said, Cain, what is this? You brought me fruit; is that what I asked you to give me? Cain got sick and tired of bringing animals; he started to gain a certain level of resentment for offering to the Lord. Cuz Cain was a man of the Lord; keep that in mind. - And Cain was very wroth: Cain was pissed off, and his countenance fell. If thou doest well, shalt thou not be accepted? And if thou doest not well, sin lieth at the door: sin, which is the devil, Satan, lies at the door in here, your mind. If you don't do well, Satan will take control of you. And unto thee shall be his desire: you'll want to do what Satan wants you to do. And thou shalt rule over him: meaning Satan shall rule over you, use you as a vessel. - Cain talked with Abel his brother: hey, Abel, come talk to you for a second, man. And it came to pass, when they were in the field, that's where Cain spends his time, that Cain rose up against Abel his brother, and slew him. - The Lord, knowing exactly what happened, decides to test Cain to see where his mind is, if he has a conscience: where is Abel thy brother? And he said, I know not. That alone is disrespectful. Am I my brother's keeper? Am I his babysitter? Now you're talking smart to the Lord. - The voice of thy brother's blood crieth unto me from the ground: yo, your brother's right here with me; why is he here with me? You killed your brother. And now art thou cursed from the earth, which hath opened her mouth to receive thy brother's blood: that blood you spilled hit that ground and is now going to be upon you. Now, what was Adam made of again? He cursed the ground; he cursed Cain. So if Adam was made from dust of the ground, and you cursed that ground, that ground ain't the same color, does it? Something happens to that color. - It shall not henceforth yield unto thee her strength: that's why, when you bring it to today, when the so-called white man needs resources, does he stay in Europe? No. If it were not for Africa, Europe would be a third world country. That's why the white man had to go to the Americas where Israel is, to Africa where Israel is, to acquire resources. The white man is a scavenger. - A fugitive and a vagabond shalt thou be in the earth: you're going to be a bum, you're going to wander around, in this land over here, that land over there, where you don't belong. A vagabond's a bum; bums sleep where they don't belong: the subway, the sidewalk, a bus station, in the staircase, in your elevator, under the bridge. A fugitive is a person that escapes from the law, escapes his crimes, has not served his sentence yet. Cain, that'll be you and your descendants' lot. - Thou hast driven me out this day from the face of the earth, and from thy face shall I be hid: God will deal with him no more. Who will deal with him now? Satan. God is not your God no more. That curse fell upon him and his children. - Everyone that findeth me shall slay me: anybody's going to know, that's that murderer right there. How they know? He going to look different, cuz that melanin is gone. When you examine the so-called white man today, look at him: you see his blood flowing right through his skin.
