That goes for the man, the wife, the children: it's on you. Every man work out their own soul salvation with fear and trembling. Daniel 2:36-43 2:11:33 - The dream the Lord showed King Nebuchadnezzar regarding the empires to follow. Thou art this head of gold: that's Babylon. After thee shall arise another kingdom inferior to thee: the Medes joined with the Persians. And another third kingdom of brass: Greece. And the fourth kingdom shall be strong as iron: Rome. And whereas thou sawest the feet and toes, part of potters' clay, and part of iron, the kingdom shall be divided: that's America. But there shall be in it of the strength of the iron: Rome's power, military might. - Iron: remember what Cain specialized in? Brass and iron, weapons, war. Same thing. Nothing new under the sun. Revelation 13:1-14 2:15:45 - This beast rising up out of the sea is the fourth beast; rather than ten toes, this beast has ten horns. It's the same exact beast, just given a different attribute. On the statue it's toes of feet; in Daniel 7 it's the fourth beast; in Esdras it's an eagle; in Revelation it's a dragon. - Like unto a leopard: that's the Greek philosophy, democracy, the politics of America. The mouth of a lion: the Babylonian doctrines found in America. The feet of a bear: Persia. This empire took all the ancient dark civilizations, learned from their mistakes, and merged them into itself. - And the dragon gave him his power: Satan. Remember he told Cain, he shall rule over you. The same power Cain gained back then through the music and the warfare, he gained here now. And his seat, and great authority. - And I saw one of his heads as it were wounded to death: the Renaissance. And his deadly wound was healed, and all the world wondered after the beast. And they worshipped the dragon which gave power unto the beast: they worshipped Satan. - He maketh fire come down from heaven on the earth in the sight of men: nuclear power, nuclear warfare. And deceiveth them that dwell on the earth by the means of those miracles: miracles is another word for technology. In the sight of the beast: in the sight of his own people, Germany, Russia. That they should make an image to the beast: an image dedicated to the captive church, that Cesare Borgia, the white image of Christ; the image of the beast. Precepts: - Revelation 17:3-5 He saw the woman sit upon a scarlet coloured beast that had seven heads and ten horns, she being the eighth head. Arrayed in purple and scarlet, decked with gold: well off, wealthy, powerful. And upon her forehead was a name written: Mystery, Babylon the Great, the mother of harlots. Why is this important? I said before, judgment is like a ring. Babylon was the first, and then it ends with Babylon again. It's full circle, just as a ring. Babylon reigned over us; now Babylon reigns over us again. Nothing new under the sun. This is a whole loop. 2 Peter 3:1-7 2:19:58 - There shall come in the last days scoffers, walking after their own lusts: like in Noah's time. They didn't believe: Noah building the boat for no reason, Noah's crazy, his crazy sons and wives over there building a boat. They were scoffing. And saying, Where is the promise of his coming? Where's your rain at? Where's this judgment coming from? - For since the fathers fell asleep, all things continue as they were from the beginning: this is how the world is supposed to be, this how the world is. This ain't captivity, we free. - By the word of God the heavens were of old: the heavens that were of old, that's Cain's kingdom, the ruling class that was of old. Whereby the world that then was, being overflowed with water, perished. - But the heavens and the earth, which are now, by the same word: the same word preached by who? Noah. Noah preached the same word to the people before the flood, and we're preaching to them before what? Kept in store, reserved unto fire against the day of judgment and perdition of ungodly men. The same word that was being preached by Enoch, Methuselah, Lamech, Noah, to the wicked of our people mingled amongst the other people at the time: the flood came and killed them. That's what we're doing today: here we are back again, preaching to the same wicked sons of God mixed with the same people, before what comes? Fire. It's the exact same thing. Precepts: - Matthew 24:37-39 This generation shall not pass till all these things be fulfilled: the same generation that was around during Christ's time, guess where they're at now? Here. Heaven and earth shall pass away: with nuclear fire. But as the days of Noe were, so shall also the coming of the Son of man be. The exact same people that were ruling during Noah's time will be ruling in this time. The same ignorance Noah faced back then, we're going to face now. The same word he was preaching back then, we're preaching now. They were eating and drinking, marrying and giving in marriage, until the day that Noe entered into the ark, and knew not until the flood came, and took them all away. - Wisdom of Solomon 10:4 For whose cause the earth being drowned with the flood: he is the cause. Whose evil was responsible for the earth being flooded? Cain's evil. And the sons of God dealt with them: if you're all for Cain now, I'mma kill all of y'all. Likewise today: I promised y'all with the rainbow that I would not flood the earth again. I won't flood it, but I'll burn it. - Revelation 18:4-5 Come out of her, my people: out of Babylon. That ye be not partakers of her sins: whose sins do we not partake in? Edom's sins. The same way the sons of God should not partake in the daughters of men's sins back then that Noah was preaching to. It's the exact same thing all over again. And that ye receive not of her plagues: her plagues back then was water; her plagues now going to be fire. For her sins have reached unto heaven, and God hath remembered her iniquities: the Lord remembered Cain's too. 2 Peter 3:8-14 2:28:31 - The Lord is not slack concerning his promise, as some men count slackness: meaning some men scoff and don't believe it's coming. The fire is coming here. - But is longsuffering to us-ward: remember that word, longsuffering. What did Noah do? Preach to the people. God gave us time to get it right. Not willing that any should perish: not willing that any should be drowned to death or burned alive. But that all should come to repentance: as Noah was preaching back then before they got drowned to death. - For the day of the Lord will come as a thief in the night: just like the flood came as a thief in the night. The heavens shall pass away with a great noise: boom. And the elements shall melt with fervent heat. - Seeing then that all these things shall be dissolved, what manner of persons ought ye to be in all holy conversation and godliness: like Noah was, his three sons were, and his wife and their wives were. - Wherein the heavens being on fire shall be dissolved: the heavens being on fire, as opposed to being underwater. Nevertheless we, according to his promise, look for new heavens and a new earth: like Noah's time, a new heavens and new earth, wherein dwelleth righteousness. - Wherefore, beloved, seeing that ye look for such things, be diligent that ye may be found of him in peace, without spot, and blameless. In Closing So with that, all praises. 12 tribes worldwide. 12 tribes worldwide. 12 tribes worldwide. And with that we say shalom. Happy Sabbath. (The stream ended at the close of the teaching; no announcements were captured in this recording.) --- Class Notes Index Transcript: full session

title: The Colossians & The CHRISTIANS of America
text: Introduction Thumbnail video: "Master Kirk, why did you leave us? These men in purple do nothing for the black community. A day of freedom coming." Class comes from IUIC Tallahassee, Florida, on the Sabbath day. When we read Paul's epistles, understand that the mainstream Christian audience, mainstream Christianity today, they do not understand Paul's epistles. So today we are going over the Colossians and the Christians of America: who the church at Colosse actually was, how the gospel spread through Asia, and how the Christians of America flipped these same scriptures during slavery to fit their narrative. Scriptures Opened Ephesians 2:12-14 14:45 - Video played: pastor Philip Anthony Mitchell preaching that black people use their ethnicity as an idol, that black people do not like white people for something they cannot control, and that Ephesians teaches the dividing line was destroyed so that all of us were made into one family. He is saying black people do not like white people because of something they cannot control. Did you forget about slavery? He claims Ephesians 2 is about joining blacks and whites together through Christ. So we are going to deal with the us in that chapter. - He is our peace, who hath made both one, and hath broken down the middle wall of partition between us. We need to deal with who the us is. Ephesians 1:1 says the epistle is written to the saints which are at Ephesus. - That at that time ye were without Christ, being aliens from the commonwealth of Israel, and strangers from the covenants of promise. Christians never address the covenants of promise. The only time the Lord made a covenant with all nations was in Genesis 9, when he said he would not destroy the world by water any more. In regards to the covenants, the Lord made covenant with Abraham and through his seed, Abraham, Isaac, and Jacob. He never made covenants with the other nations. - A question was put to an AI chat program live in class: did God ever enter into a covenant with all nations or only Israel, answered with KJV scriptures. The answer read on screen: God made a universal covenant with all humanity through Noah after the flood; the covenant of the law at Sinai was only with Israel, not with all nations; and the new covenant as prophesied is likewise stated to be with the house of Israel and the house of Judah. They know that, but they try to force this all nations doctrine. It is not in the Bible. - But now in Christ Jesus ye who sometimes were far off are made nigh by the blood of Christ. Who was afar off? Israel. These Ephesians in Ephesus are Israelites scattered in Ephesus. He is our peace: not everybody's peace. Christ is the peace that brings both nations, the southern and northern kingdom, back together. Precepts: - Ephesians 1:1 Paul writes to the saints which are at Ephesus. For those who are new: who are the saints according to the holy scriptures? - Psalms 148:14 The praise of all his saints, even of the children of Israel, a people near unto him. Christianity has never been able to show another definition of saints in the scripture. The only saints in the scriptures are the twelve tribes of Israel. - Acts 13:17 The God of this people of Israel chose our fathers, and exalted the people when they dwelt as strangers in the land of Egypt. So those strangers are the nation of Israel. - 1 Peter 1:1 Peter writes to the strangers scattered throughout Pontus, Galatia, Cappadocia, Asia, and Bithynia. On the map of Asia Minor you see Ephesus, and right next to it Colosse. That is what we are dealing with today. - Romans 9:4-5 Who are Israelites, to whom pertaineth the adoption, and the glory, and the covenants. The Bible is letting you know Christ came for the Israelites, and the covenants of promise are for the Israelites, no other nation. - Jeremiah 46:27 Fear not, O my servant Jacob, be not dismayed, O Israel: for behold, I will save thee from afar off. It is Israel who is afar off. - Isaiah 9:6-8 Unto us a child is born: possessive again. His name shall be called the Prince of Peace. Of the increase of his government and peace there shall be no end: when it is time for Christ to return and the Israelites to reign, there is no end to it. The Lord sent his word into Jacob, and it lighted upon Israel. So our peace is talking about Israel's peace. - Ezekiel 37:21-22 I will take the children of Israel from among the heathen, and will make them one nation, and one king shall be king to them all. That is what Ephesians 2:14 means by made both one. It was never prophesied that Israel would be joined back together through animal sacrifice, but only through Christ. So you would have Israelites living in places like Galatia, Ephesus, and Colosse. Acts 2:5-9 28:55 - What Christians fail to understand is that Acts is the basis of the New Testament. Paul's epistles, first and second Peter, James: Acts is literally the understanding. Just in case you get confused on a verse, go back to Acts 2:5. It tells you who the audience is. - There were dwelling at Jerusalem Jews, devout men, out of every nation under heaven. The children of Israel were scattered amongst the heathen, like we just read in Ezekiel 37. Verse 9 names the dwellers: Parthians, Medes, Elamites, Mesopotamia, Judaea, Cappadocia, Pontus, and Asia. Asia Minor is where Ephesus and Colosse sit. Acts 19:1-10 30:22 - Paul, having passed through the upper coasts, came to Ephesus. Look at the map and see how close Ephesus is to Colosse. - This continued by the space of two years, so that all they which dwelt in Asia heard the word of the Lord Jesus, both Jews and Greeks. That means Colosse heard the word Paul was preaching. You will not find a verse in Acts saying Paul went to Colosse, but we actually did just read it, because Colosse is in Asia next to Ephesus. If you always wondered why you cannot find the precept in Acts, that is your precept right there. Colossians 1:1-6 32:15 - Paul and Timotheus write to the saints and faithful brethren in Christ which are at Colosse. Just like Ephesians mentions the saints at Ephesus, it is the same concept here: these are Israelites in Asia. - Since we heard of your faith in Christ Jesus: what is Paul saying? Paul never went to Colosse. But because the spirit was so heavy in Ephesus, it spread all throughout Asia, and Paul heard there was another congregation over in Colosse that was fervent in spirit too, so he wrote to them. - Which is come unto you, as it is in all the world. On the map, Ephesus is in the middle, Colosse to the right of it, Laodicea above it, and Hierapolis, known as one of the wealthy cities in that region. The word spread throughout those cities. You read about Laodicea in Revelation. Precepts: - Colossians 2:1 For I would that ye knew what great conflict I have for you, and for them at Laodicea, and for as many as have not seen my face in the flesh. Why had they not seen Paul's face? Because he never went to Laodicea and he never went to Colosse. Acts 19:26-27 36:07 - Not alone at Ephesus, but almost throughout all Asia, this Paul hath persuaded and turned away much people. Turned them away from idolatry to serving the one true God and believing on Jesus the Christ. - The temple of the great goddess Diana, whom all Asia and the world worshipped. Colosse, just like Ephesus, just like the rest of the world, was worshipping Diana. They worshipped these women deities, just like America worships the Virgin Mary, women's rights, liberation, all of that. It is the same thing. But the spirit was so heavy on the apostle Paul that places he did not physically go to were getting touched. Colossians 1:7-8 37:34 - As ye also learned of Epaphras, our dear fellowservant, who is for you a faithful minister of Christ. The church at Colosse heard and learned through Epaphras. That is how they woke up. This brother heard it and said, I am going to teach all of y'all. That is just like today: somebody sees IUIC on the internet, prints out the flyers, starts hitting the city, and then this school pops up and that school pops up. We are the continuation of the acts of the apostles. When we read these scriptures we have to put ourselves in them and envision how the forefathers were, because we are doing the exact same thing. - Epaphras was a self-starter. He did not need someone right there to get the ground running. He heard the truth, believed it, and went and taught it. Precepts: - Acts 18:1-8 Same concept at Corinth: Crispus, the chief ruler of the synagogue, was practicing the law of sacrifice, but he believed on the Lord with all his house, and many of the Corinthians hearing believed and were baptized. It started with him and then the others took hold of it. Just like a lot of us were practicing Christianity and then believed. - Colossians 4:12-13 Epaphras, who is one of you, a servant of Christ, always labouring fervently for you in prayers. I bear him record that he hath a great zeal for you, and them that are in Laodicea, and them in Hierapolis. Colosse, Laodicea, and Hierapolis are all in that same region. Epaphras was putting in serious work. - Philemon 1:23-25 There salute thee Epaphras, my fellowprisoner in Christ Jesus. Why is Epaphras mentioned in the epistle to Philemon? Because Philemon was also of Colosse. Demas is named too: remember when you read Timothy, Demas forsook this truth. - Philemon 1:1-2 Paul writes unto Philemon our dearly beloved, and fellowlabourer, and to the church in thy house. It started with Epaphras, then you had others come. - Philemon 1:10 I beseech thee for my son Onesimus, whom I have begotten in my bonds. Why would Paul say that to Philemon? Because they had to be in the same place: Colosse. - Colossians 4:18 The salutation by the hand of me Paul. The subscript in many Bibles reads: written from Rome to the Colossians by Tychicus and Onesimus. Some people's Bibles may not have that, so it was posted on the screen. - Colossians 4:7-10 All my state shall Tychicus declare unto you, with Onesimus, a faithful and beloved brother, who is one of you. Aristarchus my fellowprisoner saluteth you, and Marcus, sister's son to Barnabas. If Marcus is Barnabas' sister's son, that makes Marcus his nephew, which is John Mark. - Acts 15:37-41 At the end of Acts 15, Paul and Barnabas had a dispute, and that is who they had the dispute over: John Mark. Barnabas stuck up for him because it was his nephew. It shows you not just anybody can travel. Paul gave him a chance, and when it came to the work he was nowhere to be found. Paul said he is not coming with me any more; Barnabas said, that is my sister's son, I am taking him with me. And the contention was so sharp between them that they departed asunder one from the other. Colossians 1:26-27 48:38 - Even the mystery which hath been hid from ages and from generations, but now is made manifest to his saints. Once again that term saints. - The riches of the glory of this mystery among the Gentiles, which is Christ in you, the hope of glory. The Gentiles here are the northern kingdom, who can come back into the fold. You had no hope unless Christ came and died for us. There was no repentance, no reconciliation, lest it be for Christ. Precepts: - Matthew 4:15 The land of Zabulon, and the land of Nephthalim, Galilee of the Gentiles. Zebulun and Naphtali are Israelite tribes of the northern kingdom. - Ephesians 3:3-6 By revelation he made known unto me the mystery: that the Gentiles should be fellowheirs, and of the same body, and partakers of his promise in Christ by the gospel. That is the mystery: the animal sacrifice is done away with, and the northern and southern kingdom now have a chance to come back into the fold with Christ. The promises were not made through animal sacrifice but through Christ. Colossians 3:1 52:55 - If ye then be risen with Christ, seek those things which are above. If you decide to repent and follow Christ, this is now what you do. But if you do not want to accept Christ, it is not for you. All Israel is not Israel, as it says in Romans 9:6. Precepts: - Galatians 3:16-22 Now to Abraham and his seed were the promises made. He saith not, and to seeds, as of many; but as of one: and to thy seed, which is Christ. Through that chosen lineage of Abraham, Isaac, and Jacob came the twelve tribes and came Jesus the Christ. The law was added because of transgressions, till the seed should come to whom the promise was made. As soon as Christ came on the scene, animal sacrifice was done away with. The promise by faith of Jesus Christ is given to them that believe: it is not talking about everybody, it is the Israelites that believe on Christ that get the promises. - Romans 3:29-30 Is he the God of the Jews only? Is he not also of the Gentiles? Is he only for the southern kingdom? He is also the God of the northern kingdom: one God which shall justify the circumcision by faith, and uncircumcision through faith. Colossians 3:10-11 56:39 - Where there is neither Greek nor Jew, circumcision nor uncircumcision, Barbarian, Scythian, bond nor free: but Christ is all, and in all. A Christian would say, to hell with all of those facts you just showed, because of this scripture right here: Greeks, Barbarians, Scythians, those are the other nations. Really, after we just read all of that in context? So we are going to go over it. - Book read in class, on the Jewish diaspora: in spite of attempts to show that the Jews in the western diaspora knew Hebrew, it is common knowledge that basically they knew only Greek. The Jews of the west knew neither Hebrew nor Aramaic, and their religious lives, including the reading of the Torah and prayer, were conducted solely in Greek. The Torah was translated into Greek in the third century BCE. The sages recognized that there were entire diaspora communities that spoke only Greek, and provided a translation of scripture for the Greek-speaking communities. Rabbinic literature almost totally ignores the vast western diaspora that existed at that time, which is particularly noticeable compared with the relatively large number of places in this diaspora mentioned in chapter 2 of Acts, in the chapters describing the journeys of Paul, and in the Pauline epistles, which give a comprehensive picture of the geography of the western Jewish Greek-speaking diaspora in the first century. - So you had some of our people referred to as Greeks and some of our people referred to as Jews, based off of a language differential, but we are still the same people. - Definition read in class: barbarian, a word derived from the Greek barbaros, used among the early Greeks to describe all foreigners, including the Romans. If you were not a Greek, they called you a barbarian. - Book read in class: Israel Redivivus, being a history of the tribes of Israel distinct from that of Judah, by Frederick Charles Danvers: with regard to the Israelites, it must be remembered that each tribe was divided into different families or subtribes, even as there were at a later date many tribes bearing different names who were collectively known to the Greeks as Scythians. The Scythians were nomadic people of that area. We were scattered everywhere, so we are the Barbarians, we are the Scythians, we are the Greeks. This is our book. Precepts: - James 1:1 James writes to the twelve tribes which are scattered abroad. Would it be a surprise for us to be called Greeks and barbarians? We were scattered abroad throughout the four corners of the earth. - Acts 2:10 Strangers of Rome. We were the Romans too. Verse 5 already told you: Jews, devout men, out of every nation under heaven. We were called Romans, we were called Greeks, we were called barbarians. - Acts 10:34-36 Now they will say, see, Christ is all and in all, God is no respecter of persons. Read the whole thing: the word which God sent unto the children of Israel, preaching peace by Jesus Christ: he is Lord of all. Lord of all Israel. Colossians 3:12-13 1:05:55 - Put on therefore, as the elect of God, holy and beloved. After referencing us as the Greeks, the Barbarians, and the Scythians in verse 11, Paul clears it up in verse 12. He is speaking in a language where we can understand. - The Lord through the apostle Paul is instructing the Colossians on how to deal with one another: bowels of mercies, kindness, humbleness of mind, meekness, longsuffering, forbearing one another and forgiving one another. Why? Because we are the same people. We are the sons and daughters of the living God, so there is a way we have to govern ourselves and treat each other. Precepts: - Isaiah 45:4 For Jacob my servant's sake, and Israel mine elect. That is who the elect of God is. - Leviticus 20:26 Ye shall be holy unto me: for I the Lord am holy, and have severed you from other people, that ye should be mine. Holy means severed, separated from all other nations on the face of the earth. So in Colossians 3:12 the Lord is saying it is not all nations. - Baruch 3:36 He hath found out all the way of knowledge, and hath given it unto Jacob his servant, and to Israel his beloved. That is the holy and beloved. Colossians 3:22 1:09:48 - Servants, obey in all things your masters according to the flesh. Now that we have the understanding, going precept upon precept and in context, these servants would have to be Israelites, and these masters would have to be Israelites. This is a scripture that they took and cherry-picked to fit their evil narrative during slavery. The Lord sees it all; the Lord has not forgotten what they have done. - Book read in class: The Religious Instruction of the Negroes in the United States. The 1673 Christian directory of Mr. Baxter gave directions to those masters in foreign plantations who have negroes and other slaves: understand how far your power over your slaves extendeth; remember that they have immortal souls and are equally capable of salvation with yourselves; remember that God is their absolute owner; that they and you are equally under the government and laws of God; that God is their reconciled tender father; that you are Christ's trustees, or the guardians of their souls; so must you exercise both your power and love to bring them to the knowledge and faith of Christ. That is where that false sense of equality comes from. It comes from slavery, it comes from Christianity. In their minds they really believed they were masters, but that is not what Colossians 3:22 is talking about. We are showing you how they flipped the narrative. - Movie clip shown from Django Unchained: a slave preacher draped in cut-out Bible pages, reading Genesis 9:2 over the plantation. They were opening the Bible and literally saying what they wanted to say. That is why to this day many of our people will not fully believe the word unless it comes out of the white man's mouth: it comes from the oral tradition of slavery. - The book continued: the census of 1790 counted 697,697 slaves and 59,481 free persons of color; they are in the eye of the law property, over which there is an absolute control; by law or custom they are excluded from the advantages of education, and by consequence from the reading of the word of God; and this immense mass of immortal beings is thrown for religious instruction upon oral communications entirely. The only time we could hear about the Bible, the white man had to verbally tell us about it. If we wanted to learn about God, we had to go through them. - The Willie Lynch letter read in class: the black slave, after receiving this indoctrination, shall carry on and will become self-refueling and self-generating for hundreds of years, maybe thousands. You must pitch the old black male versus the young black male, the dark skinned slaves versus the light skinned slaves. You must also have your white servants and overseers distrust all blacks, but it is necessary that your slaves trust and depend on us; they must love, respect, and trust only us. Distrust is stronger than trust, and envy is stronger than adulation. So we go precept upon precept and break it down, but because of what was done to our people, that distrust is always there amongst blacks and Hispanics; yet as soon as the white man says something, it is gold. They can tell you the same thing and now you know it is true. - The book continued: nor have the negroes any church organizations different from or independent of our own; such independent organizations are indeed not on the whole advisable; we may according to the power lodged in our hands forbid religious meetings; we may forbid our servants going to church at all, or only to such churches as we may select for them; we may literally shut up the kingdom of heaven against men; it is not too much therefore to say that the negroes are in a state of almost absolute dependence upon their owners for the words of eternal life. They believed they were God. This went on during the Inquisition as well, when they changed Christianity into the all-inclusive Catholic system and hunted the real Jews, tearing up the safe houses and taking our book. The same thing is going to happen again, because now we know the truth. - They are the most needy of any people in our country, the book said. It does say needy, and the Bible says it too. Precepts: - Ezekiel 25:8 Because that Moab and Seir do say, Behold, the house of Judah is like unto all the heathen. How did we become like the heathen? By following after the heathen: celebrating their pagan rituals, Christmas, Thanksgiving, eating the unclean foods, praying to a white image. That is what makes us heathenistic. - Galatians 3:7-8 Even with all of that, the scripture, foreseeing that God would justify the heathen through faith, preached before the gospel unto Abraham. The Lord already knew we were going to become heathens, and he saw it beforehand. We are still God's chosen people. - Isaiah 45:25 In the Lord shall all the seed of Israel be justified, and shall glory. That justification is for one people. Yes, we became heathen, but we are still going to be justified through Christ. - Acts 5:31 Him hath God exalted with his right hand to be a Prince and a Saviour, for to give repentance to Israel, and forgiveness of sins. A savior brings salvation, and that salvation is for the children of Israel. The slave masters taught that they and their slaves were equally capable of salvation; that is not how it goes. - Daniel 9:24 Seventy weeks are determined upon thy people and upon thy holy city, to make reconciliation for iniquity. Reconciliation means to do again: it cannot apply to the other nations, because they were never a people close or near to God. The Israelites are the only ones that have been close or near to God, and through Christ we get our reconciliation. And if the slave masters wrote that God was the reconciled father of their slaves, that means they knew who we are. - Deuteronomy 28:48 Therefore shalt thou serve thine enemies, in hunger, and in thirst, and in nakedness, and in want of all things. We wanted food, clothing, housing, shelter, and we also got that old time religion from them too. - Jeremiah 5:19 Like as ye have forsaken me, and served strange gods in your land, so shall ye serve strangers in a land that is not yours. We are serving strangers in a land that is not ours. - Lamentations 5:8 Servants have ruled over us: there is none that doth deliver us out of their hand. This is Bible prophecy. - 2 Esdras 5:42 He said unto me, I will liken my judgment unto a ring. The curse comes right back around: Assyria, Babylon, Persia, Greece, Rome, and America present day. It keeps happening because we are the people of God. But this is the last time. - Nehemiah 9:37 It yieldeth much increase unto the kings whom thou hast set over us because of our sins: also they have dominion over our bodies, and over our cattle, at their pleasure, and we are in great distress. They looked at us as their property: chattel slavery, three-fifths of a man. They never looked at us as their equals. - Revelation 13:14-15 He had power to give life unto the image of the beast: that false image of Christ. As many as would not worship the image of the beast should be killed. If our people did not agree, they were killed. Our people knew it was not true, but they did not want to die, so they went with the lie, generation after generation. But it is a new generation on the earth, and we are not accepting the lies any more. - Isaiah 32:7 The instruments also of the churl are evil: he deviseth wicked devices to destroy the poor with lying words, even when the needy speaketh right. Even when we speak straight out of the Bible, they call it hate speech. The needy in that book is us. Deuteronomy 28:48 1:39:31 - Video played: a panel clip captioned that Officer Tatum shocks the panel and says black people were better off during slavery. Asked whether he agreed with the statement that black men like him were better off during slavery, he answered, listen, 100 percent. This shows that we have been destroyed as a people. - He shall put a yoke of iron upon thy neck, until he have destroyed thee. The yoke of iron was on our neck, and we have been destroyed as a people to the point that in present day you have our own people saying we were better off in slavery. - In the clip he argued that after slavery there was an explosion of success, black Wall Street, marriage, and that now the inner cities are full of murder, violent crime, and abortion at disproportionate rates. But who legalized abortion? Who started Planned Parenthood, with Margaret Sanger? He thinks white people simply switched and started loving us after slavery. Slavery did not simply end in 1863: then came the school to prison pipeline, redlining, sundown towns, sharecropping. It is still the same system, but he cannot see that. - He also claimed the Israelites were nowhere to be found when a black man died, that he had not seen Hebrew Israelites saying anything in the community. That is a lie. That is what we do literally every week. We teach in the hoods and the ghettos where our people are: O Block in Chicago, East St. Louis, Memphis, Miami, Compton, Philadelphia. We go to our people. - Why were the brothers in Ocean Springs, Mississippi? Because one of our brothers had a mysterious death with a crowd of white people around it, in a town known for lynching black people. Yes, we are activists: we stand up for righteousness and speak against the evils and atrocities that happen to our people, and that puts fear in our oppressors. - Video played from a 1966 CBS documentary, Black Power, White Backlash, filmed in Cicero, Illinois, where 15,000 black people worked in the factories every day but not a single black family could live: residents said they would be afraid to go out at night, that you really could not trust any of them, and one said there are many good coloreds, but the ones that are going to march I don't like. They do not like when we march, because when we march we have our pride, our dignity, and our confidence. They do not like when we stand up as the nation of Israel; it angers them and it makes them afraid. Precepts: - Habakkuk 3:14 They came out as a whirlwind to scatter me: their rejoicing was as to devour the poor secretly. When Christ returns, these same people who had us in slavery will try to fight against him. And the devouring is secret: after the emancipation proclamation came the traps that still oppress us to this day. - Isaiah 14:32 The Lord hath founded Zion, and the poor of his people shall trust in it. We are the poor that they devour secretly. - Acts 24:16 Herein do I exercise myself, to have always a conscience void of offence toward God, and toward men. What is better than standing up for God and standing up for his people? Getting your household in order, not committing fornication and adultery, taking care of your family. That is what better looks like. - Nehemiah 9:27 Thou deliveredst them into the hand of their enemies, who vexed them: and in the time of their trouble, when they cried unto thee, thou heardest them from heaven, and thou gavest them saviours, who saved them out of the hand of their enemies. That is what is happening now: the Lord is starting to hear our cry, and the saviors are going city to city and country to country teaching the word of God. - Exodus 7:4 That I may lay my hand upon Egypt, and bring forth mine armies, and my people the children of Israel, out of the land of Egypt by great judgments. We have been marching since Egypt; we marched around the walls of Jericho. - Revelation 11:11 The spirit of life from God entered into them, and they stood upon their feet; and great fear fell upon them which saw them. Great fear falls upon them when they see us rise up as the army of the living God. - 2 Chronicles 17:9 And they taught in Judah, and had the book of the law of the Lord with them, and went about throughout all the cities of Judah, and taught the people. We go to our people just like the forefathers did, and we bring the Bible with us. We do not just go to one city or one state; wherever our people are scattered and afflicted, we are there. - Matthew 15:24 Video played: a pastor declaring that the gospel cannot be for one ethnicity only, and that ministries teaching so are cultic. But Christ answered and said, I am not sent but unto the lost sheep of the house of Israel. It is one nation, twelve tribes. - Revelation 21:12 The holy city had twelve gates, and names written thereon, which are the names of the twelve tribes of the children of Israel. The kingdom is for God's people. Colossians 4:1 1:58:17 - Back to Colossians 3:22 in context: servants, obey in all things your masters, not with eyeservice, as menpleasers, but in singleness of heart, fearing God. Why? Your master was taking care of your clothes, your raiment, your housing, your food. That is your brother, and as you do your duties, they take care of you. - Masters, give unto your servants that which is just and equal. They claimed they were the masters; did they do that? No. They lived in the big house while we lived in the outhouse, and we never got the forty acres and the mule. So they showed themselves hypocrites and impostors. The verse ends: knowing that ye also have a Master in heaven. Precepts: - Ecclesiasticus 19:21 If a servant say to his master, I will not do as it pleaseth thee; though afterward he do it, he angereth him that nourisheth him. You are not just angering the master, you are also angering the Lord that nourisheth us. - Ephesians 6:5-6 Servants, be obedient to them that are your masters according to the flesh, as the servants of Christ, doing the will of God from the heart. Colossians, Ephesians, and Philemon were all written during the same period, to the same region. - Jeremiah 34:9 That every man should let his manservant, and every man his maidservant, being an Hebrew or an Hebrewess, go free; that none should serve himself of them, to wit, of a Jew his brother. These servants are Israelites. - 1 Timothy 6:1-2 Let as many servants as are under the yoke count their own masters worthy of all honour. And they that have believing masters, let them not despise them, because they are brethren. Not one time does the Lord say we are brethren with the other nations, so those masters are Israelites. If your master still believed in the law of sacrifice but you believed on Christ, you still honored him and treated him with respect. - Galatians 3:28 There is neither Jew nor Greek, there is neither bond nor free, there is neither male nor female: for ye are all one in Christ Jesus. The Greek-speaking Jews and the Jews, the Israelite servant and the Israelite master, the Israelite man and the Israelite woman: we are all one nation under Christ. That is all it is talking about. - Leviticus 25:55 For unto me the children of Israel are servants; they are my servants whom I brought forth out of the land of Egypt. - Romans 14:4 Who art thou that judgest another man's servant? To his own master he standeth or falleth. Our real master is Christ. Leviticus 25:44-46 2:03:42 - They inserted themselves in the scriptures where they are not, but here is where they actually are. Both thy bondmen, and thy bondmaids, which thou shalt have, shall be of the heathen that are round about you. Since they went outside of their natural design, the Lord says they are going back to that. - And ye shall take them as an inheritance for your children after you, to inherit them for a possession; they shall be your bondmen for ever. We were originally to have them as servants, but we sinned against our God and became their possession. It is going to go back to the way it is supposed to be. Precepts: - Psalms 2:8-10 Ask of me, and I shall give thee the heathen for thine inheritance, and the uttermost parts of the earth for thy possession. Thou shalt break them with a rod of iron. Be wise now therefore, O ye kings: be instructed, ye judges of the earth. - Ecclesiastes 3:14 I know that, whatsoever God doeth, it shall be for ever: nothing can be put to it, nor any thing taken from it: and God doeth it, that men should fear before him. They think they can change their judgment. No. God said it; it is in writing; it is stamped. Isaiah 14:1-2 2:07:12 - For the Lord will have mercy on Jacob, and will yet choose Israel, and set them in their own land: and the strangers shall be joined with them, and they shall cleave to the house of Jacob. - The people shall take them, and bring them to their place. God's chosen people are going to take the strangers and put them in their own place, back to their own dwelling. And the house of Israel shall possess them in the land of the Lord for servants and handmaids, and they shall take them captives, whose captives they were; and they shall rule over their oppressors. That is the role the Lord appointed, and the scripture already said for how long: for ever. Revelation 1:11 2:10:15 - What thou seest, write in a book, and send it unto the seven churches which are in Asia: Ephesus, Smyrna, Pergamos, Thyatira, Sardis, Philadelphia, and Laodicea. Laodicea was right there next to Colosse. On the map, Philadelphia and Sardis are all right there by Colosse as well. Precepts: - 2 Timothy 4:12 And Tychicus have I sent to Ephesus. Ephesus is right there next to Colosse; the same messengers served that whole region. - Colossians 4:16 When this epistle is read among you, cause that it be read also in the church of the Laodiceans; and that ye likewise read the epistle from Laodicea. Now it connects: Asia may not name Colosse in the book of Acts, but the churches of Asia are all right there together. Ecclesiastes 8:9 2:11:43 - In closing: there is a time wherein one man ruleth over another to his own hurt. That is Esau. The way Esau treated us is going to be to his own detriment. Precepts: - Zechariah 1:15 I am very sore displeased with the heathen that are at ease: for I was but a little displeased, and they helped forward the affliction. Yes, we sinned against our God, and the Lord allowed us to go into the hands of our enemies, but they took it too far. - Isaiah 63:9 In all their affliction he was afflicted, and the angel of his presence saved them. Through all our slavery the Lord saw all of it, and when he comes back he is going to repay all of that pain and suffering. Salvation is not for the oppressors; salvation is for those who have been afflicted. - Psalms 119:85 The proud have digged pits for me, which are not after thy law. They are not after God's laws: look at what is legalized in America. They do not keep God's laws and they do not uphold them. - Obadiah 1:1-3 Who are the proud? The vision of Obadiah: thus saith the Lord God concerning Edom. The pride of thine heart hath deceived thee, thou that saith in his heart, Who shall bring me down to the ground? - Ecclesiasticus 27:26-29 Whoso diggeth a pit shall fall therein. He that worketh mischief, it shall fall upon him, and he shall not know whence it cometh, because his pride hath deceived him. Mockery and reproach are from the proud; but vengeance, as a lion, shall lie in wait for them. They that rejoice at the fall of the righteous shall be taken in the snare, and anguish shall consume them before they die. They thought evil against us, but the Lord saw it for good. Jacob is going to win in the end. - Psalms 94:20 Shall the throne of iniquity have fellowship with thee, which frameth mischief by a law? That is what they do: they work mischief and then call it law. Think about the laws framed against us since this administration came into office. - Jeremiah 4:7 The lion is come up from his thicket, and the destroyer of the Gentiles is on his way; he is gone forth from his place to make thy land desolate. That is twofold: it is talking about Nebuchadnezzar, and it is talking about Christ. - Isaiah 26:10-14 Let favour be shewed to the wicked, yet will he not learn righteousness: in the land of uprightness will he deal unjustly. Where is the land of uprightness? The land of Israel, and he dealt unjustly in it. They shall see, and be ashamed for their envy at the people; the fire of thine enemies shall devour them. Lord, thou wilt ordain peace for us, like we read in Ephesians 2. O Lord our God, other lords beside thee have had dominion over us: the Babylonians, the Assyrians, and every ruler since. They are dead, they shall not live; they are deceased, they shall not rise: therefore hast thou visited and destroyed them, and made all their memory to perish. - 2 Esdras 2:28 The heathen shall envy thee, but they shall be able to do nothing against thee, saith the Lord. They cannot stop it, because they are not going to be in rulership any more. In Closing It does not pay to be wicked, and it does not pay to follow after your oppressor, because in the end the oppressor is going to be destroyed. Twelve tribes. That is the end of today's class, and with that we say shalom. --- Class Notes Index Transcript: full session

title: The Inevitability of Obsolescence & Agony of Defeat
text: Introduction Shalom everyone, Most High and Christ bless. Happy Sabbath, brothers and sisters. A lot of people attended the blitz today, and shout out to the Captain and the Deacon for a great class earlier today. Today's topic is called The Inevitability of Obsolescence and the Agony of Defeat. Yes, I know: these are not your everyday average words, and as we proceed with the class we'll explain what the meaning of some of these words are. A video was played of detractors online slandering the congregation; for those of you looking at the thumbnail, you can get the idea of what this class will be about today. This recording is the first portion of the class; the stream cuts off mid-teaching, and the session continues in the second recording. Scriptures Opened Psalms 3:1-8 3:30 - Opening reading before prayer. Lord, how are they increased that trouble me! many are they that rise up against me. But thou, O Lord, art a shield for me; my glory, and the lifter up of mine head. - I will not be afraid of ten thousands of people, that have set themselves against me round about. Salvation belongeth unto the Lord: thy blessing is upon thy people. Ecclesiastes 1:4-9 9:44 - The things of old are back today. The same spirits that were back then are back here today: the same morality for the righteous, and the same immorality for the immoral. - One generation passeth away, and another generation cometh: but the earth abideth for ever. King Solomon is making a comparison here; he's not only talking about the things of heaven that God created. This is also pertaining to men and the spirits of men. - The thing that hath been, it is that which shall be; and there is no new thing under the sun. The same hatred, envy, and strife that we see going on today is the same thing that was back then. A lot of us are baffled by the things we see on social media, but you shouldn't be. It should just let you know that this Bible is a real book and you are in the right place. Romans 15:4 12:14 - For whatsoever things were written aforetime were written for our learning: the things of our forefathers, the works and the faith they displayed, both the faithful and those without faith. Why? Because there's no new thing under the sun. The same things that took place during the times of Babylon, King Solomon, the Assyrian captivity, and the Roman captivity exist today. - That we through patience and comfort of the scriptures might have hope. A lot of times we're uncomfortable because of trials and tribulations, but the word of God is supposed to give us comfort if we read, study, and apply. That's only for the believers; if you're moving in unbelief, you're going to be extremely uncomfortable when trials arise. - When the Most High raises up prophets, a new servant, or a clearer revelation of truth, corrupt leaders often recognize that their influence is fading. Instead of humbling themselves and submitting to God, they become envious and defensive, and often that envy leads to violence. They attempt to preserve their position by persecuting the very people God has chosen. In their mind the persecutions may delay God's purpose, but they cannot stop the movement. The Most High put a special spirit on our bishops to be the pioneers of this movement in today's time. We're all looking for the same goal, and that goal is the kingdom. Romans 8:13-14 15:34 - For if ye live after the flesh, ye shall die. What's some things pertaining to the flesh? Jealousy is a major one. Lust for money. Lust for power. You're going to see a lot of our forefathers battled that lust for power; some were able to overcome that demon and some succumbed to it. They were left as an example for us of what not to be. - But if ye through the Spirit do mortify the deeds of the body, ye shall live: that's talking about eternal life. Anything contrary to God's laws is the lust of the flesh. - For as many as are led by the Spirit of God, they are the sons of God. Brothers, are you the sons of God? Absolutely, but we got to walk in the spirit and run from the flesh. A lot of these camps have not been walking in the spirit; they've been walking in the flesh and running from the spirit. - When our light, which is the keeping of the commandments and our good works, shines on their darkness, which is the walking in the flesh, envy and hatred come. That's the agony of defeat: coming to the realization that the Most High is going to put out your candle. John 8:44 18:37 - Ye are of your father the devil, and the lusts of your father ye will do: the envy, the hatred, the malice, the guile, all the works of the flesh on display by the devil. - This is self-examination time, even for brothers and sisters within our congregation. Ask yourself: are you walking after the lusts of the flesh, or after the fruits of the spirit with Christ? We pray these other congregations outside of us ask themselves the same thing. - Christ was speaking to the Pharisees, and some of them were moved by an evil spirit: envy, pride, fear, hatred, spiritual blindness. The Pharisees were raised in the law, so they knew about Christ, because Christ is in the Old Testament; he said, Lo, I come in the volume of the book. What would possess a doctor of the law to kick against the pricks like that, except it be hatred? They were afraid that Christ was going to replace them and take their followers. - What does followers equal in the mind of the carnal? Money. Just like the Christian church, there's no difference with some of these camps; they added a little Israelite twist to their doctrine, but in their mind they're looking after power and money. When they see members waking up and leaving, they see those dollar bills disappearing, and they can't stand that. It's the same thing as the Pharisees. John 11:47-48 21:47 - Then gathered the chief priests and the Pharisees a council: that council is the Sanhedrin, the organization of counsellors of the Pharisees. What do we? for this man doeth many miracles. If we let him thus alone, all men will believe on him. - The same thing of yesterday is the same thing we see today: if we leave these brothers alone, surely they will heap righteous followers to themselves. So let's taint them, call them names, slander them, try to roll up on them at camp and antagonize them into a physical confrontation, so we can show the whole world they ain't righteous. Guess what? That's not going to happen, because God is in charge of this movement, not man. - And the Romans shall come and take away both our place and nation: that's what the Pharisees feared. Acts 15:5 23:42 - But there rose up certain of the sect of the Pharisees which believed. Not all the Pharisees were against Christ; you did have some that believed on him. This is the great dispute of Acts 15 over circumcising and commanding to keep the law of Moses; read the whole chapter when you get a chance. John 3:1-2 25:10 - There was a man of the Pharisees, named Nicodemus, a ruler of the Jews: the same came to Jesus by night. Why by night? It was a secret; he was a secret follower. But he believed on Christ. Luke 23:50-51 25:54 - Behold, there was a man named Joseph, a counsellor; and he was a good man, and a just: the same had not consented to the counsel and deed of them. Not every man is allowed into the council of the Pharisees, so this scripture lets you know Joseph of Arimathaea had close relations with the Pharisees, but he was a follower of Christ. - Who also himself waited for the kingdom of God: he knew the kingdom of God was only going to come by the Messiah, Christ, and he accepted that. That's why he asked Pilate for the body of Christ. - These men had the fortitude to go against the grain, that evil movement of the Pharisees to destroy Christ and his followers, and say: what y'all doing is wrong; y'all persecuting these brothers wrongfully. And these are just the two that are mentioned; the Bible is written in an abbreviated form. We pray that same spirit falls on many of these Israelites out there who secretly see the evil in their own congregations and are biding their time until they also walk out those doors. Ecclesiasticus 10:2 28:09 - As the judge of the people is himself, so are his officers. There are those who stay silent about their wicked leaders, and silence means you accept it. You want to know why you can't break down the scriptures precept upon precept, and you give foolish breakdowns like John the Baptist was evil and turned against Christ? Because your wicked leaders don't teach and are not keeping the scriptures. - Their mind has become spiritually dark: void of judgment, void of discernment, void of truth. And that spirit spreads like osmosis throughout all the officers and soldiers in the camp. You utter the same rhetoric as your leader, and you can't break down the scriptures, giving breakdowns like wormwood is a drink. Foolish breakdowns, because you're not moving in the spirit; you're moving in the flesh. Psalms 111:10 29:37 - The fear of the Lord is the beginning of wisdom: not breaking his Sabbath, not buying and selling wilfully on his Sabbath, not multiplying wives. The fear of the Lord is keeping his commandments. - A good understanding have all they that do his commandments. The Most High is going to elevate your understanding of the scripture, but that only comes with application of God's laws. Like the waters in Ezekiel, he's going to bring it to the knee, to the thigh, to the chest, causing the increase of your learning and understanding to grow. But when you're not keeping the commandments of God, that water stays stuck at the ankles and will never rise. You will never grow. Jude 1:16 31:15 - These are murmurers, complainers, walking after their own lusts. Brothers and sisters, examine yourselves and make sure we don't fall under this too, because these same spirits are in the congregation. That's why every couple of years there's a shaking of the tree; we had it in 2018 and we recently had it. The Most High is going to shake the tree, and the murmurers and gossipers get shaken out. - And their mouth speaketh great swelling words, having men's persons in admiration because of advantage. Why do they lack the fortitude to say, this is wrong what this guy is doing? Because they have men's persons in admiration: they want to move up. The congregation will have twenty people in it, but they want to be called a captain of a thousand. So they follow the wicked leader, murmur and repeat the same things he does, and move up in rank instead of checking him. Isaiah 28:9-10 33:09 - Whom shall he teach knowledge? and whom shall he make to understand doctrine? them that are weaned from the milk. The milk is the sincere understanding of the word, which is God's laws. You don't give a young baby steak; you give a baby milk to nurture them. It's the same with us in this truth: God's laws is what nurtures us and causes us to grow. - For precept must be upon precept, line upon line, here a little, and there a little. You want a good understanding of the Sabbath? Leviticus 23, Exodus, Nehemiah. Here a little in the Old Testament, there a little in the New Testament. That's how you understand the scriptures, not leaning on your own understanding. - Definition read in class: obsolescence describes something that is passing out of use because something greater, newer, or more effective has replaced it; the state of becoming old-fashioned and no longer useful, even if it still be in good working order. Hebrews 8:13 37:50 - In that he saith, A new covenant, he hath made the first old. The old covenant of animal sacrifice became obsolete upon Christ's crucifixion, because he was the Lamb of God, that ultimate sacrifice for the nation of Israel, bringing in the new covenant. - The problem is not merely that something old is being replaced. The problem arises when people refuse to accept that God is moving forward. That's when the agony of defeat comes in: you can't accept that God is using a particular person, people, or organization for a greater purpose because they're more effective. God doesn't want the old; he wants to use the new. John 3:26-30 39:30 - People like to say that John the Baptist was evil, started his own camp, and went against Christ, which is complete nonsense. Let's see what the Bible says. This is the righteous response when you understand that God is using someone or something greater for the same goal: raising up the elect of God so we can inherit the kingdom. - They came unto John and said, Rabbi, he that was with thee beyond Jordan, behold, the same baptizeth, and all men come to him. John answered, A man can receive nothing, except it be given him from heaven. Why is it hard for these other camps to accept that the great work that started from a mustard seed out of a man's living room in 2003 has grown to be this great tree with many branches, and it ain't done yet? Because of envy and hatred. But John the Baptist, the same man you said was not in the truth, accepted it. - Ye yourselves bear me witness, that I said, I am not the Christ, but that I am sent before him. He understood he was sent before him: the voice in the wilderness that Isaiah prophesied, making the path for something greater. We're all ambassadors of Christ, setting up the way for when he invades this earth. Every Israelite organization is supposed to have that same mindset, not fighting and slandering each other. - He that hath the bride is the bridegroom: but the friend of the bridegroom rejoiceth greatly because of the bridegroom's voice: this my joy therefore is fulfilled. He came to fulfill his role, knowing something greater was coming to carry on. - He must increase, but I must decrease. The unrighteous response is the opposite: envy, fear of losing influence, accusation, slander, violence, murder, anger. That was the response of the Pharisees to Christ, completely contrary to the response of John the Baptist. Genesis 4:3-8 44:05 - The things written aforetime were written for our learning, so let's go back to Genesis. Cain brought of the fruit of the ground an offering unto the Lord; he was supposed to bring the firstlings of the flock. Abel brought the firstlings of his flock and of the fat thereof, and the Lord had respect unto Abel, because Abel did what the Lord said. - And Cain was very wroth, and his countenance fell. Why was he upset? He understood the law and knew what God wanted. He was upset because of Abel: Abel shined a light on his darkness. Abel was the righteous, and it put a magnifying glass on Cain's disobedience. It's the same today: our light puts a magnifying glass on a lot of these false doctrines and camps that won't get right. - If thou doest well, shalt thou not be accepted? and if thou doest not well, sin lieth at the door. We know the consequences of sin; why get mad? All Cain had to do was check himself and offer the right offering unto the Lord. Instead of correcting your doctrine and just doing the work, walking in the lot God puts you in, you want to make it a competition based off envy and strife, not to glorify Christ's name but to be the head man in charge. - And Cain talked with Abel his brother. What do you think was going on in those conversations? Abel was teaching, trying to correct his brother in the process of time. - And Cain rose up against Abel his brother, and slew him. In the process of time he allowed that wrath to accumulate and increase, and that anger became murder. When Saul tried to kill King David, that was hatred inside that manifested into actions. The Pharisees, the same thing. It's going to be the same thing today; do not be shocked. We see the buildup. 1 John 3:11-12 50:24 - For this is the message that ye heard from the beginning, that we should love one another. Not as Cain, who was of that wicked one, and slew his brother. This is John writing during the time of Rome, thousands of years later, still going back to what happened with Cain, because the things written aforetime were written for our learning. - And wherefore slew he him? Because his own works were evil, and his brother's righteous. Cain didn't kill Abel because Abel harmed him; Cain killed Abel because his righteousness revealed Cain's sin and disobedience. - Brothers know if their works are evil. You know if your doctrine is garbage. But because of gain, because of money and the lust of the things thereof, you'll preach things contrary to the Bible to fulfill your lust, knowing deep down that what you're doing is wrong. John 3:19-21 52:34 - And this is the condemnation, that light is come into the world, and men loved darkness rather than light, because their deeds were evil. The light is Christ, and also the keeping of the commandments. You're going to have men who love darkness rather than light; that's what we see today. - For every one that doeth evil hateth the light, neither cometh to the light, lest his deeds should be reproved. - But he that doeth truth, the keeping of the commandments, cometh to the light, that his deeds may be made manifest, that they are wrought in God. That's the fruits of the spirit. Genesis 37:3-11 53:56 - Now Israel loved Joseph more than all his children, because he was the son of his old age. When his brethren saw that their father loved him more than all his brethren, they hated him, and could not speak peaceably unto him. That hatred started because they saw the affinity Jacob had for Joseph. - Joseph dreamed a dream, and told it his brethren: and they hated him yet the more. His brethren said, Shalt thou indeed reign over us? The hatred was multiplying after every event. They didn't see that the spirit of the Most High God was working in Joseph. - And his brethren envied him. Envy means to covet something. What did they envy Joseph for? His gifts, the dream. In Closing The stream cuts off here, mid-teaching on Joseph and his brothers. The class continues in the second recording, which picks up with the conspiring of Joseph's brothers and Acts 7:9. --- Class Notes Index Transcript: full session

title: The Inevitability of Obsolescence & Agony of Defeat
text: Introduction The stream joins the class already in progress, mid-teaching on Joseph's brothers: a conspiring murder, and then once they were able to actually murder him, it leads to what? Lies. Now you're lying to cover up that act. So it's adding sin unto sin, like it says in the book of Isaiah. Y'all know the history of that; they ended up selling him into slavery. But it was all for a greater purpose. Scriptures Opened Acts 7:9 0:00 - The patriarchs is the fathers. How are they able to quote this during the time of the acts of the apostles? Because they were reading what was written afore time in the Old Testament. No new thing under the sun; that's what King Solomon said. This is the works of the apostles during the time of Rome, quoting something that happened way back during the time of Jacob and Joseph. - But God was with him. The same way we say God is with us, because surely this movement in IUIC is not of man; it's of God. God is using the bishop, putting the wisdom and understanding upon him to delegate and set forth the things that he put in place for a greater purpose.
