There is no speech nor language where their voice is not heard: whatever language you speak, the word will reach you; we will translate it. But you need to be cleansed. - Psalms 141:5 Let the righteous smite me; it shall be a kindness: and let him reprove me; it shall be an excellent oil, which shall not break my head. Somebody telling you that you are doing evil is not going to kill you. It is supposed to kill the old man in you, not you. When you come to this truth, prepare your soul for temptation; it starts unmasking who you are and what we have to fix. Ecclesiasticus 21:3-6 43:12 - All iniquity is as a two edged sword, the wounds whereof cannot be healed. We just read that the word of God is a twoedged sword that cures, so why can these wounds not be healed? Verse six answers: he that hateth to be reproved is in the way of sinners, but he that feareth the Lord will repent from his heart. The wounds cannot be healed because you hate to be reproved. The word of God cuts, but you can be healed if you accept what it is saying. That means somebody is telling you, and you are listening. James 1:19 44:20 - Let every man be swift to hear, slow to speak, slow to wrath. Do more listening than talking, because if you are talking you cannot hear what is being said. And after you hear what is being said, why are you angry? You said, God, show me the errors of my ways, cleanse me. Well, he is sending the prophets to tell you, and now you are mad at them for telling you. That is why the people killed the prophets: they kept coming and telling them what they were doing wrong, and they did not want to hear it, to the point they killed them just to shut them up. Let us not be those people. - There is an art to listening. The greatest gift a young person can give is to just listen. You will save yourself so much headache. Be neutral, hear what is being said, examine yourself whether it is true, and if it is, fix it. Stop lying to yourself. James 1:1-4 46:02 - James, a servant of God, to the twelve tribes which are scattered abroad. My brethren, count it all joy when ye fall into divers temptations. Why would you count it joy to fall into temptations? Answers from the floor: because the Lord sees you fit to be chastised and you will be increased; because being tried reaffirms you are a son of God; because you are learning about yourself, learning your faults. That last one is the point: you count it joy because you are learning what you have to fix. - Some people come to this truth and never knew they deal with a spirit of unforgiveness. They cannot let somebody off the hook for something that happened ten years ago. The word of God will reveal it to you: I struggle with getting past things. Good; now you can learn how to forgive, because you want forgiveness yourself. - Knowing this, that the trying of your faith worketh patience. But let patience have her perfect work, that ye may be perfect and entire, wanting nothing, lacking nothing. Precepts: - 2 Corinthians 2:6-11 Sufficient to such a man is this punishment: he got punished for his action because he was in error. Now contrariwise ye ought rather to forgive him, and comfort him. Some brothers do not have the spirit to comfort; they look at the comfort part as weak. The Bible says forgive and comfort him, lest perhaps such a one should be swallowed up with overmuch sorrow: you never allow him to grow out of the situation, he feels repentance is hopeless, and you destroy a brother. Confirm your love toward him. It is not a weak nature to forgive a brother and confirm your love: I see you fighting, you are trying to get right, we are here for you. And do it lest Satan should get an advantage of us: for we are not ignorant of his devices, and one of his devices is unforgiveness. If a brother has not committed the same infraction again, why do you keep bringing it up over and over? That is something you are battling. James 1:5 53:51 - If any of you lack wisdom, let him ask of God, that giveth to all men liberally. How do we ask of God? Do you think wisdom just floats down from heaven? No: you have to study, you have to open the book. And how do you know unless you have a teacher? Somebody has to teach you, and as you grow in understanding you realize, like Paul, I had not known sin but by the law. Now you know what you have to fix in you. Precepts: - Ecclesiasticus 51:12-21 When I was yet young, I desired wisdom openly in my prayer; I prayed for her before the temple, and will seek her out even to the end. I directed my soul unto her, and I found her in pureness. You want to be tethered to wisdom because with wisdom you avoid the punishment. My heart was troubled in seeking her: because as you seek her, you start realizing the issues you have, the severity of what God is talking about. At first it sounds good, the fringes and the feast days; but now you are learning what you really are inside, a murmurer, a backbiter, and your heart is troubled. Therefore have I gotten a good possession. - Psalms 139:23-24 Search me, O God, and know my heart: try me, and know my thoughts. You are asking God to measure you against his word. And see if there be any wicked way in me, and lead me in the way everlasting. So when you ask God for wisdom and he starts showing you your errors, that is the prayer being answered. Blessed is the man that endures it. James 1:6-8 1:00:39 - Let him ask in faith, nothing wavering. You ask in faith for God to show you about you, so you can fix you. For he that wavereth is like a wave of the sea driven with the wind and tossed. The scripture comes to you correcting, and now you are wavering. What are you trying to do when you waver? You are trying to dodge correction. - A double minded man is unstable in all his ways: always tossed around, never steady, never going head on. Precepts: - Ecclesiasticus 4:26 Be not ashamed to confess thy sins, and force not the course of the river. The river is flowing, and you are trying to reroute it away from you. You are trying to dodge correction. - Amos 5:24 But let judgment run down as waters, and righteousness as a mighty stream. Let judgment run down. Do not waver and get around it; do not force the course to divert it. - Micah 7:9 I will bear the indignation of the Lord, because I have sinned against him. That is taking accountability. Until he plead my cause, and execute judgment for me: he shall bring me forth to the light. Why? Because I do not dodge what I asked for. I asked God to show me my secret faults, and now that he is showing me, this is not the time to start dodging, making excuses, or blaming the brothers for not checking in on me. Take your medicine and move on. I do not judge a person by the infraction so much as by what they do afterwards: do they take their medicine, the scriptures? Big talk means nothing if you ghost as soon as correction comes. - 2 Esdras 2:1 Precept brought by the captain: I brought this people out of bondage, and gave them my commandments by my servants the prophets, whom they would not hear, but despised my counsels. The counsel the prophets bring out of the scriptures is God's counsel; when you resist it, it is not men you are despising. The carnal man causes you to resist the direction God wants you to grow in. Ecclesiasticus 37:12-16 1:13:42 - Be continually with a godly man, whom thou knowest to keep the commandments of the Lord. Not a man that appears to be godly, but one you know keeps the laws of God; and if you are tethered to wisdom, you will have a discerning spirit to know that. Whose mind is according to thy mind: your mind has to be a godly mind too; can two walk together except they be agreed? And he will sorrow with thee if thou shalt miscarry: a godly man fights with you to help you. I have to see the fight in you; if I see no fight, I wash my hands with a clear conscience. - And let the counsel of thine own heart stand: for there is no man more faithful unto thee than it. Nobody is more faithful to you than your own mind; but if you are not a godly man, your thought process is corrupted, and your decisions will not be made right. Do not come to counsel with your mind already made up; you waste everybody's time. - For a man's mind is sometime wont to tell him more than seven watchmen that sit above in an high tower. The watchmen see from a vantage point; you see your own life from ground level. A brother's counsel may be good from where he sits and still not fit what you are walking through, and brothers can be overbearing with counsel. So hear it from a neutral place. - And above all this pray to the Most High, that he will direct thy way in truth. You listen to the counsel, you process it, then you go to God, and God will direct your way. Let reason go before every enterprise, and counsel before every action. James 1:17-18 1:19:25 - Every good gift and every perfect gift is from above. Wisdom is a good gift: if you lack it, God will give it. With whom is no variableness, neither shadow of turning: God is not tossed to and fro; his wisdom is constant, pure, undefiled. With man there is variableness: double minded, jumping all over the place, always responding, always got something to say, never listening. - Of his own will begat he us with the word of truth, that we should be a kind of firstfruits of his creatures. The literal firstfruits brought to God had to be without spot. We are supposed to keep ourselves unspotted from the world; and to become unspotted, we have to learn what we were doing wrong so we can fix it. So why are you mad? That is the whole purpose. Precepts: - Deuteronomy 32:26 I said, I would scatter them into corners, I would make the remembrance of them to cease from among men. That goes with Deuteronomy 28:64: scattered and serving gods of wood and stone, we were spotted. James writes to the twelve tribes scattered abroad, ones that had been living as sinners. So count it joy when God starts showing you who you are. James 1:12-15 1:25:04 - Let no man say when he is tempted, I am tempted of God: God cannot be tempted with evil, neither tempteth he any man. But every man is tempted, when he is drawn away of his own lust, and enticed. Enticed means it appeals to you and you give in; you entertain it. That is on you; that is your choice. Do not blame God for what your own lust drew you to. He put the test in front of you, but you made the choice; now you know what your vice is, and that is what you fight. - Blessed is the man that endureth temptation: for when he is tried, he shall receive the crown of life. How do you know what you can endure unless you go through it? You do not know if you can lift the weight until it is on the rack. You are asking for muscles; well, you have to lift. Precepts: - James 4:7-8 Submit yourselves therefore to God: take the counsel. Resist the devil, and he will flee from you. How do you resist him? By submitting to God first. Draw nigh to God, and he will draw nigh to you. How do you draw nigh? You come to the house of learning, somebody teaches you, and God draws nigh back to you and gives you a way to escape. Cleanse your hands, ye sinners; and purify your hearts, ye double minded. James 1:21-27 1:29:54 - Lay apart all filthiness and superfluity of naughtiness, the excess of sin, and receive with meekness the engrafted word, which is able to save your souls. The word can save your soul if you receive it, keep quiet, and listen. - But be ye doers of the word, and not hearers only, deceiving your own selves. You deceive yourself if you hear and do not do. You are just going through the motions like you are in the truth. - A hearer and not a doer is like a man beholding his natural face in a glass: the glass is the Bible. You look in the book and see yourself, and then you go your way and straightway forget what manner of man you were. You can turn your head from the mirror, but what you saw is still there. You can close the book; you are still a sinner. Not looking does not change who you are. - Whoso looketh into the perfect law of liberty, and continueth therein, being not a forgetful hearer, but a doer of the work, this man shall be blessed in his deed. - If any man among you seem to be religious, and bridleth not his tongue, but deceiveth his own heart, this man's religion is vain. You can put on the shirt, put on the fringes, grow the beard, stop eating pork; but if you are not willing to deal honestly with what you have going on in your head, you are wasting your time. - Pure religion and undefiled before God and the Father is this, to visit the fatherless and widows in their affliction, and to keep himself unspotted from the world. The fatherless and widows lack a hedge, a guide. Now that you are unspotted because you learned about yourself, it is time to go help others become unspotted. But how are you going to teach them if they are not swift to hear? How can you help someone who dodges every time you tell them something? James 4:1 1:35:28 - From whence come wars and fightings among you? come they not hence, even of your lusts that war in your members? When correction comes and your mind will not accept it, that is the war inside you. Something in you is adverse to correction. - Every captain who has sat in counsel knows the look: you tell a person what they are doing wrong, and they squint, get confused, and repeat back the very thing you just said. It is the battle in the mind at that moment; right is coming in, and wrong is warring against it. Precepts: - James 3:15-16 For where envying and strife is, there is confusion and every evil work. The word of God is pure and there is no variableness in it; there should be no confusion in what is being said. The confusion is that wisdom which descendeth not from above, but is earthly, sensual, devilish: it is deceiving you. Then you wonder why good things are withheld from you and why you cannot move forward. - James 4:10-11 Speak not evil one of another, brethren: when brothers get corrected and do not like it, they start speaking evil of the ones who corrected them. What are you supposed to do instead? Humble yourselves in the sight of the Lord. - James 4:17 Therefore to him that knoweth to do good, and doeth it not, to him it is sin. You know what is being said is right, but you do not want to do it, because that sin is what you are struggling with. People in the streets want to fight the brothers just for teaching the Bible, because it convicts them. - Job 9:20 Precept brought by the captain on justifying yourself: if I justify myself, mine own mouth shall condemn me. The margin renders justify as cleanse or clear self. Deceiving yourself is telling yourself, I am already cleansed, I am already clear, while refusing the reproof and instruction the teachers bring. Video played in class: sometimes you have to let people suffer the consequences of choices they made knowingly, because rescue delays the learning; growth delayed by rescue is growth denied. As David said, it is good that I was afflicted. Teachers cannot carry everybody; and teachers, do not weaponize the scriptures either: do not be the brother that is wise and teacheth many, and is unprofitable to himself, holding brothers to an accountability you will not hold yourself to. 2 Corinthians 3:18 1:44:41 - But we all, with open face beholding as in a glass the glory of the Lord, are changed into the same image from glory to glory. When we behold the glass openly, we change. There is supposed to be a change in us. Precepts: - Daniel 9:2-6 The open face: Daniel set his face unto the Lord God, to seek by prayer and supplications, with fasting, and sackcloth, and ashes. He understood by books, by the writings of Jeremiah the prophet, the number of the years. He went to the book, then made his confession: we have sinned, and have committed iniquity, and have done wickedly, by departing from thy precepts. Neither have we hearkened unto thy servants the prophets: they would not listen to the servants God sent to show them what they were doing wrong. - 2 Corinthians 4:1-3 Seeing we have this ministry, we faint not; but have renounced the hidden things of dishonesty. When you seek his face openly, you renounce the secret sins: not walking in craftiness, not talking your way around it, nor handling the word of God deceitfully, but by manifestation of the truth commending ourselves to every man's conscience. Blessed is the man whose conscience does not condemn him, because he examined himself against the word and renounced what he was doing. But if our gospel be hid, it is hid to them that are lost: if you do not understand that you have to renounce sin, you are lost. That is the Christian church: we are not under the law, we are under grace, you cannot call me a sinner, I am saved; yet the hidden things have never been renounced. Your religion is vain if the secret life never changes. - 2 Esdras 16:63 Surely he knoweth your inventions, and what ye think in your hearts, even them that sin, and would hide their sins. You cannot openly seek his face while you are hiding your sins. - 2 Esdras 2:3-4 I brought you up with gladness, but with sorrow and heaviness have I lost you: for ye have sinned before the Lord your God. The gospel is hid to them that are lost, to him that is still in sin and will not renounce the hidden things of dishonesty. Mark 1:1-20 1:52:55 - Behold, I send my messenger before thy face, which shall prepare thy way before thee. God sent John to teach the people and get them right, to prepare for Christ. That is the job of the prophet, the apostle, the teacher: to show you. - Christ called Simon and Andrew, James and John, from their nets: come ye after me, and I will make you to become fishers of men. These men came in to get right. Do you think that walking with him he was not showing them all their errors? Precepts: - Luke 22:31-34 Simon, Simon, behold, Satan hath desired to have you, that he may sift you as wheat: but I have prayed for thee, that thy faith fail not: and when thou art converted, strengthen thy brethren. Christ is showing Peter that he still has things to work on. Peter answers, Lord, I am ready to go with thee, both into prison, and to death; and Christ says, I tell thee, Peter, the cock shall not crow this day, before that thou shalt thrice deny that thou knowest me. Peter, you are not there yet. And Peter did become the head of the church afterwards, but first there were things he had to reconcile within himself. God opens the book, we behold ourselves in it, and he sends prophets to show us how to get right. The worst thing to do is deny it. Medicine hurts sometimes, but if you are sincere you take your medicine and you get better. 2 Esdras 1:5 2:01:10 - Go thy way, and shew my people their sinful deeds, and their children their wickedness which they have done against me. God commands the prophets to go and show the people their sinful deeds. Precepts: - Ezekiel 3:17-18 Son of man, I have made thee a watchman unto the house of Israel: give them warning from me. If the watchman does not warn the wicked from his wicked way, the wicked man dies in his iniquity, but his blood will I require at thine hand. As teachers we do not even have a choice: if we do not tell you what you are doing wrong, that blood is on our hands. - Leviticus 19:17 Thou shalt not hate thy brother in thine heart: thou shalt in any wise rebuke thy neighbour, and not suffer sin upon him. If you see a brother in error and do not correct him, you hate your brother in your heart. Hosea 5:15 2:04:14 - I will go and return to my place, till they acknowledge their offence, and seek my face: in their affliction they will seek me early. Our people have to be afflicted before they seek him; that is how it is. And the afflictions are just starting: what we have seen so far is the prelude. - News discussed in class: the hands of the civil rights era are being turned back right now. Memphis, one of the blackest cities in America, has been carved up by gerrymandering and parceled out to the outskirts of the state so that its people cannot win a congressional seat any more; it is happening in Texas and everywhere. An elected black congressman was hauled out by state troopers protesting that he was lawfully there. We frame the law by mischief is written for a reason. Our people swear they are going to vote their way out of this, and the churches that once organized the community are silent. Where is the Christian church on the front line while all of this is turned back, while our people are found hanged in 2026 and it is ruled suicide? The only ones crying aloud about it are the Israelites. The teaching stands: our people need to see the affliction for what it is, get their minds right, and get lined up on the right side before the decree brings forth. Precepts: - Additions to Esther 13:18 All Israel in like manner cried most earnestly unto the Lord, because their death was before their eyes. That is when our people are going to come: when death is before their eyes, they will cry earnestly and look for God. And when they come, we will show them how to get right. - Zephaniah 2:1-3 Gather yourselves together, O nation not desired; before the decree bring forth, before the fierce anger of the Lord come upon you. Seek ye the Lord, all ye meek of the earth, which have wrought his judgment; seek righteousness, seek meekness: it may be ye shall be hid in the day of the Lord's anger. If you are seeking righteousness, you are admitting you do not yet have it; you are walking in error and correcting it. So when you come to the house of learning and somebody shows you your error, do not leave mad; leaving means going back out to face the fierce anger unprepared. 2 Chronicles 7:14-20 2:17:18 - If my people, which are called by my name, shall humble themselves, and pray, and seek my face, and turn from their wicked ways; then will I hear from heaven, and will forgive their sin, and will heal their land. God does not hear the prayer of sinners; but when we turn back, his eyes and ears are open to the prayer made in this place, and his heart is there perpetually. The question people always ask, how do you all do this, how do you mobilize: because we keep God's commandments and believe on Christ. That is the whole recipe. - If thou wilt walk before me, as David thy father walked: did David not sin? He did, but he repented, he changed, and he was called a friend of God. After you get right, then you teach transgressors thy ways, as Psalms 51 says: you go to the fatherless and the widows and teach them. - But if ye turn away, and forsake my statutes: definition read in class, forsake means to abandon, desert, or leave entirely, a breach of duty. Then will I pluck them up by the roots, and make them to be a proverb and a byword among all nations. Reading that is understanding why we went into captivity. Precepts: - Ecclesiastes 4:13 Who was God warning? Solomon. What was Solomon's problem beyond the sin itself? Better is a poor and a wise child than an old and foolish king, who will no more be admonished. He could not take correction; nobody could tell him anything. From that flowed all his other problems. Even Solomon at the end understood the whole duty of man: fear God and keep his commandments. But he should not have had to go through it, with all the wisdom given to him and his father's life before his eyes. - Proverbs 15:10 Correction is grievous unto him that forsaketh the way: and he that hateth reproof shall die. - Proverbs 29:1 He, that being often reproved hardeneth his neck, shall suddenly be destroyed, and that without remedy. Corrected over and over, and after a while the neck hardens, the scriptures have no effect, there is no contriteness, no shame. If the word of God is not moving you to change after ten years, something is disconnected. The word of God changes you; if it is not working, examine whether you even believe. Luke 6:46-48 2:25:45 - And why call ye me, Lord, Lord, and do not the things which I say? You call on him but refuse to do the things he says; what is the purpose? - Whosoever cometh to me, and heareth my sayings, and doeth them, is like a man which built an house, and digged deep, and laid the foundation on a rock: and when the flood arose, the stream beat vehemently upon that house, and could not shake it. He was warned that a flood was coming, and he prepared himself. That is us: prepare before the decree brings forth, be rooted in Christ, not just a hearer but a doer. If you only heard, the house stays as it was and the flood takes it. If you heard, there has to be some type of change. Psalms 50:16-23 2:27:59 - But unto the wicked God saith, What hast thou to do to declare my statutes? Seeing thou hatest instruction, and castest my words behind thee. This is calling Lord, Lord, but hating to be instructed; hardened now. - When thou sawest a thief, then thou consentedst with him, and hast been partaker with adulterers. You are supposed to resist the devil, not entertain the devil. Thou givest thy mouth to evil, and thy tongue frameth deceit: walking dishonestly, handling the word of God dishonestly. - Thou sittest and speakest against thy brother; thou slanderest thine own mother's son. These things hast thou done, and I kept silence; thou thoughtest that I was altogether such an one as thyself: but I will reprove thee, and set them in order before thine eyes. Just because he did not act right away does not mean you got away with it. - Now consider this, ye that forget God: this is talking about Israel, because the other nations never knew God to forget him. Whoso offereth praise glorifieth me: and to him that ordereth his conversation aright will I shew the salvation of God; and the salvation is to Israel. Precepts: - Ecclesiasticus 19:13-15 Admonish a friend, it may be he hath not done it: and if he have done it, that he do it no more. Admonish thy friend, it may be he hath not said it: and if he have, that he speak it not again. Admonish a friend: for many times it is a slander, and believe not every tale. Sometimes a brother admonishes you and now you are angry behind it and speaking against him. Why is it bothering you? - Proverbs 18:24 A man that hath friends must shew himself friendly: and there is a friend that sticketh closer than a brother. Friend and brother are synonymous in this teaching; the slander of Psalms 50:20 lands on both. 1 Corinthians 12:28-31 2:32:32 - God hath set some in the church, first apostles, secondarily prophets, thirdly teachers. The Most High sets up apostles, teachers, and leaders, and the whole point is to build back his kingdom. These men are supposed to guide you and show you a more excellent way: how to serve God. That is the purpose for which they were sent. 1 Samuel 12:20-25 2:33:44 - Fear not: ye have done all this wickedness: yet turn not aside from following the Lord, but serve the Lord with all your heart. It pleased the Lord to make you his people; he will not forsake his people for his great name's sake, but you have to turn to him. - God forbid that I should sin against the Lord in ceasing to pray for you: but I will teach you the good and the right way. That is the charge: teach the people the good and the right way to walk, and the people have to be willing to listen. But if ye shall still do wickedly, ye shall be consumed. The teacher's hands are clean when he has done his part; what you do with it is on you. Psalms 25:2-5 2:35:41 - O my God, I trust in thee: let me not be ashamed. Lead me in thy truth, and teach me: for thou art the God of my salvation; on thee do I wait all the day. Look at what David is asking for: lead me and teach me. Precepts: - Isaiah 48:17 Thus saith the Lord, thy Redeemer, the Holy One of Israel; I am the Lord thy God which teacheth thee to profit, which leadeth thee by the way that thou shouldest go. God leads through the prophets he sends, and many killed the prophets. That is why it says be swift to hear, slow to speak, slow to wrath. The brothers get guns pulled on them in the street just for reading the Bible. Are we the enemies because we tell the people the truth? No. Either repent, or die in your sins. In Closing I pray you all received something. The whole class in three words: listen, learn, and live. Ask the Lord for wisdom, take the counsel he sends, take your medicine when the correction comes, and be a doer and not a hearer only. Stay faithful, stay godly, stay in the spirit. Bishop is up next. Announcements & References This session closed directly into the next class; announcements were carried in the later session. Thanks given to the booster club for financing and praying the worldwide Passover blitz missions through, and a salute to all the men who traveled and hazarded their lives carrying the gospel abroad. --- Class Notes Index Transcript: full session

title: MAKING THE GREAT RED DRAGON'S 8TH HEAD 'GREAT AGAIN'
text: Introduction Today's lesson, the topic is making the great red dragon's eighth head great again. Now of course, we're not trying to make it great again; y'all know better than that. This is what this country is all about. This country is about bringing it back, and we need to be mindful of that comeback. Shout out to the bishops: Bishop Nathaniel, Bishop Kana, who I am honored to have with me, Deacon Yosua; I got the captains, Captain Noah, Captain Zakar. When I said making the great red dragon, cuz we know that this beast called America is that eighth beast that rode on the back, so to speak, of the seven heads that carried her. So this eighth beast is America, and the runners of America, presidents, governors, and the people that are set up to sustain this, is absolutely duty bound in their spirit to make sure that this lasts forever, meaning at our detriment, because this place would not be anything if it were not for slavery. The whole world economy is based on our destruction, is based on us being pillaged, exploited, robbed, raped, thoroughly robbed, hung; you name it, it was done to us. Everything that God had given us for the benefit of us, they have taken it and used it for their benefit, meanwhile at the same time kept us at a deficit to make sure that we would never rise to even recognize what our true potential are. As they said in the documentary with the Native American Indians, The Canary Effect: kill the Indian and save the man. In other words, kill his real spirit, but save the body, save the sweat equity. That's what's been done to the twelve tribes of Israel. We're basically a shell of a people; we are the dry bones in the valley. Lost, destroyed, no sense of unity, nothing. This is what Trump is basically saying; he's just out pronouncing it. But this has always been the objective of this country. The subtitle: the continuance of 400 years of sweat equity. The subject matter in this lesson is about how America seeks to corrupt our young children while they are still mentally developing; then by the time they mature, they would have already ruined their lives beyond repair. Scriptures Opened Job 9:24 12:53 - They want to keep it this way. The Bible says the earth is given into the hand of the wicked. The wicked cover the faces of the judges. And if not, if Esau is not the wicked, you tell God who and where is the wicked. Proverbs 29:2 12:53 - When the righteous are in authority: the righteous people, that's the Israelites. The people of the earth rejoice. There's obviously that the righteous ain't winning. The righteous ain't in rulership at all. - But when the wicked beareth rule, the people mourn. Everybody mourning. The birds mourning, the sharks are mourning, everything on the planet earth is catching hell because there's a fool in office. There's a fool ruling. Ecclesiastes 10:5-7 12:53 - There is an evil which I have seen under the sun: the Most High showed him the visions of where this planet is going. As an error which proceedeth from the ruler: meaning the wrong people are ruling. The wrong type of rulership is on this planet now. - Folly is set in great dignity: a fool is set as a judge. That's crazy. A fool is ruling. Pollute the only air you can breathe, pollute the only water you can drink. It's a complete mess. Now the people's minds: a man doesn't even know if he's a man; a woman don't even know if she's a woman. Ezekiel 34:20-31 2:33:02 - Behold, I, even I, will judge between the fat cattle and between the lean cattle. And you know what that goes with: in the New Testament, Christ said, all nations shall be before me, and I shall separate the sheep from the goats. That comes from here. - Therefore will I save my flock, and they shall no more be a prey. Cuz we are prey to our own people; a lot of times we think of being a prey just to the nations, but our own people prey upon us as well. P R E Y, not P R A Y. - And I will set up one shepherd over them, and he shall feed them, even my servant David; and I the Lord will be their God, and my servant David a prince among them. And I will make with them a covenant of peace: that's why he's the Prince of Peace. - They shall dwell safely in the wilderness, and sleep in the woods. I will cause the shower to come down in his season: there shall be showers of blessing, blessings upon blessings. - The earth shall yield her increase: remember what God told Cain, the earth shall not yield to you her strength; so now here it's saying the earth will yield her strength to us. And they shall be safe in their land, and none shall make them afraid: nobody's going to make us afraid ever again, cuz right now we live in fear. - And they shall no more be a prey to the heathen, the other nations. I will raise up for them a plant of renown, meaning famous. Thus shall they know that I the Lord their God am with them, and that they, even the house of Israel, are my people. And ye my flock, the flock of my pasture, are men, and I am your God, saith the Lord God. 1 Kings 13:1-32 2:37:12 (Bishop's teaching) - This chapter deals with us going to the left or right of what God says. If God tells us something, let's follow it; follow the Lamb whithersoever he goeth. - The man of God out of Judah cried against the altar, and Jeroboam put forth his hand, saying, lay hold on him; and his hand dried up. You see how pain will get you to change your thoughts: he wanted to put the dude to death a few minutes ago, and now he wants him to pray to God for him. And the king's hand was restored. - The man of God said, if thou wilt give me half thine house, I will not go in with thee: for so was it charged me by the word of the Lord, saying, eat no bread, nor drink water, nor turn again by the same way that thou camest. The Lord instructed him what not to do and what to do. - An old prophet dwelt in Bethel, and said unto him, I am a prophet also as thou art; and an angel spake unto me by the word of the Lord, saying, bring him back. But he lied unto him. This dude was lying. Remember we were talking about earlier: God said, the only one I speak mouth to mouth with is Moses; everybody else I'll talk to with dreams and visions. This guy said an angel came to him. - And when he was gone, a lion met him by the way, and slew him: it is the man of God who was disobedient unto the word of the Lord. You see this? That's why you got to be mindful with brothers. - After this thing, Jeroboam returned not from his evil way, but made again of the lowest of the people priests of the high places: he made bums priests. Whosoever would, he consecrated him. And this thing became sin unto the house of Jeroboam, even to cut it off, and to destroy it from off the face of the earth. - Some people are in your life for blessings, some in your life for cursings; but ultimately it's to try us, and try each and every one of us. Precepts: - Jeremiah 9:4 That's why the Lord said, put ye no trust in a brother, for every brother will utterly supplant. In Closing As we're reading this, we definitely got to examine ourselves. Are we fulfilling? Are we in this truth with loyalty? Do we have a passion for this truth, or are we just here? Am I just here because I like you, you're my buddy; wherever he goes, I go? That's how some brothers are. Your relationship got to be by the Bible. That's the reason why we here together: the Bible is the link. Without the Bible, there ain't no link. Announcements & References Sit down, part two: Captain Haniah, Captain Matathias, and Captain Galayah sat down with Fred Price Jr. and three other Christian pastors for a conversation where the scriptures did the cooking. From the recap clip: "You guys don't recognize Hebrew at all, but you're Israelite. The King James Bible is also from Hebrew; does he have to know Hebrew? You say we need to know Hebrew, but you got Chinese Christians all over. Isaiah 54:3: thy seed shall inherit the Gentiles: that's the Israelites right there, the seed of Abraham, Isaac, and Jacob, which is the twelve tribes of Israel; they are going to inherit the other nations. Context is key. Nobody ever pulls Isaiah 54:3, because they don't want to talk about the Gentiles, which is the other nations, going into captivity. Did Christ have sinful flesh? He did not; he was the seed of the woman. Now we're finding out that you believe more in theology than scripture. You saying the Lord can't keep covenant? You are lying on the Bible." Books referenced in class: - The Cambridge History of Judaism: The Early Modern World, 1500-1815 (black Jewish communities in Africa; read at length above) - The Complete Works of Flavius Josephus (history of Theudas and Judas of Galilee) - The Spiritual Power of a Black Woman, by Captain Hoshaya (on Amazon) - Trauma Letters: Healing the Child Within, by Captain Galayah (on Amazon): "You were not born this way. The patterns, the defenses, the reactions, the way you think, respond, and protect yourself: none of it started as identity. It started as adaptation." Full sit down with Bishop Yahwasa, Captain Hoshaya, and Captain Galayah drops this week; if you purchased the books, leave a review on Amazon. - Yahawashi Invades France, issue 4 (comic book; sold out during class). Coming next: Yahawashi Invades Rome, issue 1, going through the seven heads. Challenge: 10,000 album sales to go triple platinum; the first side drops at 5,000 pre-orders (570 pre-ordered at class time). - Israel Live top five: scan the QR code to vote for next week's episode, every Monday at 9:00 pm. title: The End Of PAX Americana
text: Introduction New moon class. Happy new moon; a lot of brothers and sisters made it out even though we are not in our kingdom and some are still at work. We are living in some perilous times right now; things are getting worse and worse. I hope you brothers and sisters are preparing for what is coming, preparing your mind, your spirit, and physically preparing also. Thumbnail video: the atom bomb dropped on Japan; "We are trying to establish world peace so that all men can live together in brotherhood and freedom"; the European Union formed, the United Nations formed; Kennedy on the Cuba crisis: "This government, as promised, has maintained the closest surveillance of the Soviet military buildup on the island of Cuba"; the invasion of Panama; the war with Iraq; Trump: "The European Union will pay a very big price, and we anticipate a substantial tariff to be placed on them at the earliest possible moment"; then the war with Iran. That is where we are at right now. Tonight's topic is the end of PAX Americana. Some of you all might be hearing that terminology for the first time. I have been watching a lot of geopolitics, and a lot of those commentators use that term. As a prophet of God you must be watching and looking at geopolitics: the wars going on all over the world, the policies being passed all over the world. The Lord told us to watch and pray. Why are you watching? Because the things taking place, the Lord is doing it. Scriptures Opened 2 Chronicles 2:4 11:23 - Two scriptures first concerning why we are here tonight. Behold, I build an house to the name of the Lord my God: that house was the temple. - On the sabbaths, and on the new moons: so there is a difference between the Sabbath day, the seventh day Sabbath, and the new moon, which is also a Sabbath, which is the beginning of the month. - And on the solemn feasts of the Lord our God: the solemn feasts are Passover, Tabernacles, the Memorial of Blowing of Trumpets, all these feasts. Ecclesiasticus 43:6-8 13:29 - He made the moon also to serve in her season: the moon lets us know seasons, for a declaration of times; that is how we can tell time, by the moon. - From the moon is the sign of feasts: this is how you know when the feast days come, by the moon, because we have some feasts that are seasonal. - A light that decreaseth in her perfection: when God created the moon, it was a light. When it is perfect is when it is a light, when it is new; after it is new, then it decreases. Tonight when you look up in the sky and see a bright light, that is the new moon. - Esau got things backwards: they say the new moon is when it is dark, and we used to celebrate it like that at one point in time. No. This is the right way, and this is the way everybody on the earth is going to celebrate it when Christ returns, whether you all believe what we say or not. That next couple years could be 10, 15, 20; you don't know. - The month is called after her name: the word month derives from the word moon. Increasing wonderfully in her changing: after it decreases, it increases. Being an instrument of the armies above, shining in the firmament of heaven. Isaiah 29:11 21:29 - Some people online gainsay: what is this dude up there talking about? But he is a prophet. Yes, I am a prophet, and not just me: there are thousands of prophets in IUIC, and thousands more in learning. When you say you are a prophet, don't let nobody question it. - The vision of all is become unto you as the words of a book: the Lord gave the prophets visions, and all the visions God gave the prophets are written in a book. The book that is sealed is the Bible. - Which men deliver to one that is learned, saying, Read this, I pray thee: and he saith, I cannot; for it is sealed. This Bible is sealed, and everyone cannot understand it: the visions of Daniel, the visions of John the Revelator, the visions of Jeremiah. Nobody on earth could understand this book, because it is sealed. Amos 3:6-7 23:05 - This is how you prove that we are prophets. Shall a trumpet be blown in the city, and the people not be afraid? The trumpet is warning of evil. - Shall there be evil in a city, and the Lord hath not done it? The evil happening in a city is God's judgment: plagues, destruction. When these things happen, it is the Lord that does it. - Surely the Lord God will do nothing, but he revealeth his secret unto his servants the prophets. So the book that is sealed, who does God reveal it to? The prophets. If you can understand the Bible and understand these visions, you are a prophet. 1 Corinthians 2:9-11 24:33 - Once you can understand this Bible, that makes you a prophet. But how are you able to understand it? - But God hath revealed them unto us by his Spirit. At that time "us" was the apostles and the believers in Christ: the visions of Jeremiah, of Isaiah, of Daniel were revealed to our forefathers back in that time, the same way they are revealed to us today. - For the Spirit searcheth all things, yea, the deep things of God: those deep things, those parables, those dark sentences, the spirit searches out and shows to us. - The things of God knoweth no man, but the Spirit of God: the Spirit of God understands the things of God and reveals them to us; God's plan for the future, what is going to happen on this earth. The prophets wrote what is going to happen in these last days, and the things you see taking place on this earth, the prophets wrote about. Only the sons of God, the Israelites, can understand these visions, because we have the Spirit of God dwelling in us. Definitions and article read in class: - The noun phrase Pax Americana was first coined in the 1890s, with the earliest recorded evidence in an 1894 magazine issue, originally describing pan-American peace and the Monroe Doctrine. - Pax Americana, Latin for American peace, is a term for the period of global relative peace and stability backed by the economic, military, and cultural power of the United States after World War II. Pax is Latin, meaning it is a Roman language; remember America is Rome. American peace was set up in 1945 by economics, military power, and democracy. - Article: "The End of Pax Americana Under Trump 2.0." Key takeaways: the pillars of Pax Americana, military credibility (peace through strength, you have heard that term from Trump), economic openness (free trade, which Trump just threw in the garbage, putting tariffs on all these nations), and democratic values, are weakening and may not endure. Democratic values is America pushing democracy all over the earth; that began in 1945. Growing US unpredictability and global power shifts are undermining America's role as Europe's reliable security guarantor; Europe must reduce its dependence on the United States and prepare for greater strategic and security autonomy. I am going to show you all that in the scriptures. - For decades Germany and many other European and Western countries have based their relationship with the United States on the concept of Pax Americana: the idea that American power and strength contribute to the security of Western countries and to international stability, military power embedded in alliance structures. That alliance is America, the European Union, and NATO, and that is falling apart. The three pillars of Pax Americana have been eroding for years, even decades; under the second Trump administration they may finally crash down for good. And that is the Lord's doing. - Videos played: after World War II, for the first time there was a power able to dominate the entire globe, through aerial supremacy backed by special forces and the CIA. The CIA infiltrated governments in the world, identified who would be loyal to the American empire and promoted them; those who challenged it were demoted or eliminated. You heard that? When it says military, don't think it is just the army; the CIA is part of their military. Trump said he was about to unleash the CIA in Venezuela, and then they took down Maduro. - For decades Pax Americana meant US led global alliances ensured security and promoted democracy worldwide. Under Trump's grand strategy every alliance is now transactional; the US is refocusing on its own hemisphere, reviving a modern Monroe Doctrine; troop cuts across Europe and the Middle East; aggressive tariffs; foreign aid slashed; global institutions like the WTO sidelined. The old consensus that maintained global peace is crumbling. - A commentator: future historians will look back on 2026 as the beginning of the end of Pax Americana, not because China is doing something, but because the current administration is doing things which will accelerate it, adopting a very aggressive posture against many countries, starting the reciprocal tariff war. That American peace set up all over the world, you see it coming to an end. You see Russia and Ukraine at war, nations warring with each other; America cannot control the world anymore. Revelation 17:1-7 45:51 - Now I am going to show you all American peace, Pax Americana, in the scripture. The judgment of the great whore: that great whore is America. - That sitteth upon many waters: meaning rules many nations. With whom the kings of the earth have committed fornication, and the inhabitants of the earth have been made drunk with the wine of her fornication: that wine of fornication is also going into falsehood, lies, oppression. - A woman sit upon a scarlet coloured beast: the woman sitting upon the scarlet coloured beast is America; the scarlet coloured beast is Europe, the European Union, NATO. - Full of names of blasphemy: they call themselves Jews, they call themselves Christians, they call themselves the people of God. It is blasphemy to say you are a Jew and you are not a Jew. - Having seven heads and ten horns: this is the same seven heads and ten horns in Daniel. - Arrayed in purple and scarlet colour, and decked with gold and precious stones and pearls: meaning this country is rich. Having a golden cup in her hand full of abominations and filthiness of her fornication. - Upon her forehead a name written, MYSTERY, BABYLON THE GREAT: this is not ancient Babylon; it says mystery because a lot of you all don't understand that this place is spiritual Babylon, the mother of harlots and abominations of the earth. - I saw the woman drunken with the blood of the saints, and with the blood of the martyrs of Jesus. Wherefore didst thou marvel? I will tell thee the mystery of the woman, and of the beast that carrieth her. Revelation 17:11-17 50:12 - The beast that was, and is not, even he is the eighth: Bishop went over this Saturday. The eighth is that harlot we read about, mystery Babylon. - And is of the seven: the seven is Britain. America came from Britain; they fought Britain for their independence. And goeth into perdition, meaning destruction: she will be destroyed. - The ten horns are ten kings: going into the European Union. Today it is twenty-something, thirty-something nations, but in the beginning it was ten. Which have received no kingdom as yet: because the European Union was not set up as yet. - But receive power as kings one hour with the beast: they receive power for a time with America. That time began after World War II. - These have one mind, and shall give their power and strength unto the beast: they gave their military strength and their economic strength to America. They formed the NATO alliance, they formed the UN, they formed the IMF, the International Monetary Fund. All these institutions ruling the earth today came about in 1945, Europe and America. This is when the American peace began after World War II: they said we need to set up a form of peace, so they set up these institutions, and those institutions were set up to oppress the poor and for America and Europe to retain control over the world. When Europe gave their power to America, that was the beginning of Pax Americana. - These shall make war with the Lamb: when Christ returns, Europe and America will fight against Christ; Christ is the Lamb. And the Lamb shall overcome them: Christ is going to destroy America and Europe, for he is Lord of lords and King of kings. They that are with him are called, and chosen, and faithful: that is the 144,000. - The waters which thou sawest are peoples, and multitudes, and nations, and tongues: this is proving that America and Europe are ruling over all nations. - The ten horns shall hate the whore: the ten horns that were carrying her are going to end up hating her. This is what you see taking place today. They gave their power unto America for a time, over 70 years, and that time is up. Trump came into office and started disrespecting Europe; there was free trade between Europe and America, and now he says you all have to start paying tariffs, you have been using us for 70 years. Right now there is a rift between the whore and the ten horns, and that is all by design. - And shall make her desolate, and naked, and shall eat her flesh, and burn her with fire: America will be destroyed with nuclear bombs. NATO, along with Russia, Iran, all of them, are going to play a big role in destroying Babylon. - For God hath put in their hearts to fulfil his will: God put it in the Europeans' heart. What Europe and America are doing, they are fulfilling God's will. When they formed the NATO alliance and the European Union, they were fulfilling prophecy. For 70 years they agreed and gave their kingdom unto the beast, until the words of God shall be fulfilled. That is what you see right now: that separation, that division taking place. The word of God that has to be fulfilled is that they are going to hate the whore and burn her with fire. Leviticus 21:9 1:00:48 - What is the judgment for a whore according to the law? The daughter of any priest, if she profane herself by playing the whore, she shall be burnt with fire. That was the judgment. - So the great whore in Revelation 17 has to be burned with fire. What kind of fire? Thermonuclear destruction. Video played in class, on Sir John Glubb's study of empires: - In 1976 a British general, Sir John Glubb, studied empires across 3,000 years of history and found that almost every major empire lasted roughly 250 years and then collapsed: the Assyrians 247 years, the Persians, the Greeks 231 years, the Ottomans 250 years, the British 250 years, and America is right within that range today. - Every empire moved through the same seven stages in the same order: the age of pioneers (America 1776 to 1815), the age of conquest, the age of commerce (1890s to about 1945), the age of affluence (1945 through the 70s, the golden age), the age of intellect (80s to about 2000s), and finally the age of decadence: obsession with entertainment, wealth gaps widening, political polarization, trust collapsing. National debt 36 trillion, trust in government at 22 percent, the population split into two hostile camps. The US is deeply in stage six, and stage six does not last long: Rome took 30 years from stage six to collapse, Britain took 40. - From 1945 to the 70s is when America became the military superpower; that is when Pax Americana really began, when America started dominating the whole world, pushing democracy over the whole world, and everybody in the world started using the American dollar to trade. - A couple weeks ago America met its 250th year anniversary, and every major kingdom fell within 250 years. And when you look at God's will: everything started going bad ever since 2019, and from 1619 to 2019 you get 400 years. After 400 years, American society started declining. The Lord is making preparation to deliver us up out of here. - Video: there is now a concern in Europe that they cannot rely on America, and even that America may be hostile to Europe; Europe recognizes it needs to build up its own military defense industry. Couple that with the tariff debate and you have an anger at the United States amongst its allies that is damaging; a transactional, bullying foreign policy means your allies will behave accordingly. America is bullying Europe and all the nations. Remember: thou art greatly despised. Obadiah 1:1-4, 7 1:06:16 - Thus saith the Lord God concerning Edom. An ambassador is sent among the heathen: there will be somebody that rises up amongst Ishmael, what the Arabs call the Mahdi, saying, Arise ye, and let us rise up against her in battle. - They are going to rise up against America and Israel in battle; this prophecy concerns America and Israel. If you pay attention, right now there is a bill passed where America and Israel's military is becoming one. So when you read this prophecy and wonder why it speaks of them together: they are one. - Behold, I have made thee small among the heathen: when you look at the land of Israel, it is small, with the Arab nations surrounding it. - Thou art greatly despised: America and Israel are greatly despised. The Arab nations will greatly despise them, the European nations, Russia, China. That is what you see taking place, because of what is happening in Palestine, Lebanon, and Iran. - Let me tell you about Iran: what is going on in Iran is going to cause a global collapse. What America and Israel are doing in Iran will cause a world depression, not recession; depression. A loss of jobs. There will be famine. Pay attention. - The pride of thine heart hath deceived thee: you see how prideful the talk is; he started the war but he cannot come out of it. They say we have the technology, nobody can fight against us; they think they are untouchable. But God has them thinking that way for a reason. - Thou that dwellest in the clefts of the rock: that is where the term Caucasian comes from. - That saith in his heart, Who shall bring me down to the ground? That is the pride: we have the strongest military in the world, nobody can take us down. - Though thou exalt thyself as the eagle: this is letting you know it is talking about America; the symbol of America is the eagle. And though thou set thy nest among the stars: who did space traveling first? America, 1969. Thence will I bring thee down, saith the Lord: from 1945 to the 70s America was at its peak, and in 1969, guess what happened? The Israelites started waking up. From 1969 the teachings of God started going out. That is where we all came from, that is inside here right now. - All the men of thy confederacy have brought thee even to the border: everybody America made that confederacy with, the European Union, the NATO alliance. The men that were at peace with thee have deceived thee: that is NATO; they will deceive America and prevail against her, and they will burn her with fire. They that eat thy bread have laid a wound under thee: there is none understanding in him. They will destroy this place. That is Bible prophecy. Daniel 8:23-25 1:12:49 - And in the latter time of their kingdom: the last days, the time we are living in right now. - A king of fierce countenance, and understanding dark sentences, shall stand up: when you go into the history, this goes into Antiochus. But this scripture is twofold; it is not just talking about Antiochus, and I am going to show you all that. - And his power shall be mighty, but not by his own power: that king is talking about that system; it is talking about America. Their power is going into their technology; how did they get that power? We answer that in Revelation 13. - And he shall destroy wonderfully, and shall prosper, and practise, and shall destroy the mighty and the holy people: we know Antiochus did that in the past, and America did the same thing to the holy people. America enslaved us, destroyed the North American Indians, destroyed us over here on this side of the world. And it is not just what they did to us, but what they are going to do. - And through his policy also he shall cause craft to prosper in his hand. Definition read in class: in this verse craft means deceit, cunning, trickery, and clever scheming. His policy goes into his politics, his religion, his economics. It is going into democracy; it is going into him setting up the IMF, which tells countries how much their money is worth; going into taking the resources of Africa ever since 1945. All that scheming, trickery, and deceit: Antiochus prospered with it, and America prospered with it too. Look at Christianity: did it not prosper in his hand? Everything he set up since 1945, financial and religious, it all prospered; that is his deceit, with all deceivableness of unrighteousness in them that perish. - And by peace shall destroy many: remember what we are going over. Pax means peace; Pax Americana, American peace. Through peace he shall destroy many. To understand that we have to go to the history in 1 Maccabees. - He shall also stand up against the prince of princes: did Antiochus stand up against the Prince of princes? Antiochus did not fight against Christ, so this is letting you know it is twofold: the same thing is going to be done again in these last days. It is the same thing we just read in Revelation 17: they going to make war with the Lamb, and the Lamb shall overcome them. - But he shall be broken without hands: that goes back into Daniel, where he saw the statue and the feet broken by a stone cut without hands. Acts 5:30-31 1:16:12 - The God of our fathers raised up Jesus, whom ye slew and hanged on a tree: the Romans killed him. - Him hath God exalted with his right hand to be a Prince and a Saviour, for to give repentance to Israel. So who is the Prince of princes that he is going to stand up against? Christ is that prince. Revelation 13:1-4 1:18:22 - A beast rise up out of the sea, having seven heads and ten horns: the same seven heads and ten horns we read in Revelation 17. Upon his heads the name of blasphemy: this is the fourth beast, going into Europe, the European Union. - I saw one of his heads as it were wounded to death: that was Rome; Rome fell. And his deadly wound was healed: Rome came back as America in 1776. - And all the world wondered after the beast. - And they worshipped the dragon which gave power unto the beast: who is the dragon that gave power unto the beast? Satan. So when you worship the beast's god, who are you worshiping? Do not think he just has all this power because he is so smart. He was able to come up with all these technologies and advances because Satan gave him that power. That is Daniel 8: his power shall be mighty, but not by his own power. Daniel 7:25 1:21:20 - And he shall speak great words against the Most High, and shall wear out the saints of the Most High, and think to change times and laws. - It says he will wear out the saints of the Most High: that is saying the same thing it says in Daniel 8, destroy the mighty and the holy people. The same way Antiochus destroyed us is the same way America wore us out. Revelation 12:17 1:22:50 - And the dragon was wroth with the woman: the woman is Israel. - And went to make war with the remnant of her seed, which keep the commandments of God: they are going to make war with us. Understand that this right here is physical. As we keep teaching this word and Israel keeps waking up all over the world, America, Israel, and Europe will make war with us. Revelation 17:6 1:23:51 - And when they make war with us, what is going to happen? The same thing Antiochus did to us is the same thing America is going to do. - The woman drunken with the blood of the saints, and with the blood of the martyrs of Jesus: why would America be drunken with the blood of the saints and the martyrs? That is that war, for teaching the word of God. A lot of us are going to be killed here in America. Revelation 18:19-20 1:24:38 - Alas, alas, that great city, wherein were made rich all that had ships in the sea by reason of her costliness. For in one hour is she made desolate. - Rejoice over her, thou heaven, and ye holy apostles and prophets: why, when mystery Babylon the great is destroyed, will the apostles and the prophets be rejoicing? - For God hath avenged you on her: why does God have to avenge us on her? Because in that war, the prophets are here. That is why I tell you all I am a prophet, and there are thousands of prophets here in IUIC. A lot of the prophets are going to die here in Babylon teaching the word of God. And not just the prophets are here; the apostles are here too. 1 Maccabees 1:41-47, 50-51 1:31:17 - Moreover king Antiochus wrote to his whole kingdom, that all should be one people. All shall be one people: what is that called today? Democracy. The same thing Antiochus did, America did the same thing. - And every one should leave his laws: so all the heathen agreed according to the commandment of the king. Back then all the heathen left their laws and their customs and followed what Antiochus set up. - Let me tell you what democracy is: democracy is being subservient to the head. Who was the head there? Antiochus; all nations were subservient to him. Democracy is a form of slavery. After 1945 America went all over the world and pushed democracy; that is part of Pax Americana. Go to India: India has a democratic government. Go throughout the Caribbean islands, throughout South America: all of them are pushing democracy. Go to Africa: all these countries in Africa follow democracy. When did that begin? After colonialism, America and Europe came in and said, we are going to push our values on the whole world. Democracy is their values. Everybody wears suit jackets and ties; they all have senates and constitutions. Where did they get all that from? From Esau. Democracy is not equal rights and so forth; that is what was pushed through the craft, the deceit. - Yea, many also of the Israelites consented to his religion, and sacrificed unto idols, and profaned the sabbath: this is why I am telling you all it is also going into religion. Democracy and religion go hand in hand; that is how they pushed their religion all over the world also. - For the king had sent letters by messengers unto Jerusalem and the cities of Juda, that they should follow the strange laws of the land, and forbid burnt offerings, and sacrifice, and drink offerings in the temple, and that they should profane the sabbaths and festival days, and pollute the sanctuary and holy people, set up altars, and groves. - And whosoever would not do according to the commandment of the king, he said, he should die: so if you did not follow it, you were killed. He said, let us all be one people, let us set up peace, and you all follow my traditions and my customs; and if you did not follow it, you were put to death. So when it says through peace he shall destroy many, that is what it is going into. - America pushed the same thing, strength through peace. Ever since 1945, millions of people were killed and assassinated to maintain the hegemony, Pax Americana, over the world. In order for them to set up that democracy, they did a lot of killing. - In the selfsame manner wrote he to his whole kingdom, and appointed overseers. Revelation 13:11 1:38:58 - I beheld another beast coming up out of the earth; and he had two horns like a lamb. The two horns like a lamb go into their two political parties, the Democrats and the Republicans. - It says as a lamb because they say they are a Christian, God fearing society, about justice, rights, and peace. That is a lamb. It is also going into their democracy: we are going to help you, we are spreading peace and love on the earth. It is their craft, their deceit, as Daniel 8 calls it. - And he spake as a dragon: if you do not follow those two horns, if you do not follow their democracy, if you do not agree with their policies and their politics, they will kill you. That is why it says by peace he shall destroy many. Videos played in class, on how the peace was enforced: - A former CIA officer: "In the CIA, we didn't give a hoot about democracy. It was fine if a government was elected and would cooperate with us, but if it didn't, then democracy didn't mean a thing to us, and I don't think it means a thing today. The true goal of the United States government is control. They feel that if the United States did not control the governments of Latin America, then somebody else would. The principle of government by the people, for the people, of the people, that's just silly." So you see: democracy is not about freedom and justice; it is about listening to what America and Europe say, falling in line, and serving them. If you do not, the same way Antiochus said you shall be put to death, America did the same thing. Through peace, he destroyed many. - Video: every South American country which has had its government overthrown by the CIA since 1947: Costa Rica 1948, Guatemala 1954, El Salvador 1979, Nicaragua 1981, Panama 1989, Paraguay 1954, Brazil 1964, Peru 1968, Chile 1973, Uruguay 1973, Argentina 1976, and Venezuela 2002. Many were perceived as ideologically opposed to the United States. Any country that went against the order that was set up and did not want to accept democracy, they sent the CIA in there or went to war with them. - Maurice Bishop of Grenada: a charismatic lawyer who led a bloodless coup against a corrupt dictator in 1979, built free health care, launched literacy programs that amazed international observers; unemployment dropped, schools multiplied, and Grenadians adored their young prime minister. In October 1983 a hardline faction placed him under house arrest; the people freed him and marched with him to Fort Rupert, and soldiers machine gunned Bishop and seven supporters. The CIA was behind that, and three years into the revolution America went to war with Grenada. - Bishop in his own words, on a secret State Department report: the report said the Grenada revolution was in one sense even worse than Cuba and Nicaragua, because the people and leadership of Grenada speak English and therefore can communicate directly with the people of the United States; and that what also made them very dangerous is that the people and leadership of Grenada are predominantly black, 95 percent, and could have a dangerous appeal to 30 million black people in the United States. Remember what Hoover said: the biggest threat is negro unity. - Bishop also explained Cuba's assistance: doctors and dentists that made free health care a reality in a short time, literacy specialists that helped wipe out illiteracy, help with agriculture and the international airport. In 1983 Reagan ordered the US invasion of Grenada, justified as protecting American citizens, and the administration celebrated it as the first rollback of communist influence during the Cold War. They do not want to see our people do good; when you do good, they come after you. - Patrice Lumumba did the same thing in Africa, and they assassinated him. Also Thomas Sankara, and hundreds more leaders that did not follow the democracy that America was pushing after 1945. Thousands of leaders were killed, anybody that rose up against the status quo. That is what it means: by peace he shall destroy many. - Che Guevara: a trained physician from Argentina who rode his motorcycle through Latin America, witnessed crushing poverty and workers exploited by American corporations, and decided the world did not need another doctor but a revolutionary. He joined Fidel Castro; they overthrew Cuba's dictatorship in 1959. After winning in Cuba he gave up his government position and went into the jungles of Africa and South America to spread more revolutions; in 1967 they caught him in Bolivia and executed him. He was teaching against the system, so they said we have to take him out. Daniel 8:23-25 2:03:16 (closing reading) - A king of fierce countenance shall stand up: that is Antiochus, and it is America. It is twofold. - And he shall destroy wonderfully, and shall prosper and practise: all the evil this man is doing, he is going to prosper in it and keep practicing it. You see how he is destroying wonderfully, bombing all over the place. - And shall destroy the mighty and the holy people: the twelve tribes of Israel. - And through his policy also he shall cause craft to prosper in his hand: the craft is the deceit and the lies. The deceit goes into the IMF, into his religion, into his trade and economics; all of that prospered in his hand. He is taking from nations, setting tariffs on nations, telling you how much your money is worth, sending the CIA into your country; he is prospering in these things. - And he shall magnify himself in his heart: the same way Antiochus set himself up as God. Let me tell you all something: there is a new Christianity 2.0 coming with these white Christian nationalists. You are going to see what is going to happen. - And by peace shall destroy many: the same way Antiochus said, let us all be one people, America came with democracy after World War II, after 80 million people were killed, and said, let us have peace now, and pushed democracy, which is western values, on everybody on the earth: set up your government the same way we set up our government. And establishing that Pax Americana, a lot of countries were destroyed, a lot of leaders were destroyed, a lot of countries overthrown by the CIA and by war: Iraq, Afghanistan, North Korea, where people are still being born with deformities because of the chemicals dropped on the population. - There will be another form of peace that they will try to set up, which goes into the Abraham Accords, that one religion and that one world order. And they are going to persecute those of us that do not follow it, the same way. - He shall also stand up against the Prince of princes: America and Europe will stand up against Christ; Christ is the Prince of princes. But he shall be broken. In Closing I am not going to be able to go into Iran tonight; Lord's will I will continue this another time, because there is a lot going on with America and Iran right now. Iran just sent missiles at American bases; Iran is not going to be destroyed; when you read the scripture, God says I raised them up. It is the end of the American hegemony, America and Europe ruling the world; we are coming to the end of that. That is the time we are living in right now. What America is doing in Iran is going to cause depression; a lot of you all are going to lose your jobs; things are going to get very bad. There will be no stop to the war in the east; it is going to get worse and worse, even with Russia and Ukraine; do not be surprised to see Russia invade Poland. This week the Houthis in Yemen started fighting with Saudi Arabia, shooting missiles at each other. The Strait of Hormuz is shut down, and now the Red Sea is shut down. Depression is coming, and everybody is going to blame America and Israel for it. Pay attention to the things you see taking place. From the videos I showed you all: every leader that rose up and spoke against America, its values, and its democracy, you all understand what happened to them. They were killed, assassinated, or put in prison. So when we read Revelation 17:6, that she will be drunken with the blood of the saints, and Revelation 18:20, rejoice over her, ye holy apostles and prophets, for God hath avenged you on her, do you all understand what we are doing? Revelation 12:17: the dragon will make war with them that keep the commandments. The teachings of Christ are a revolution. We are labeled a threat to this whole system; they are watching us, scheming and planning how to destroy this movement. So do not sleep. You all watch and pray. And as leaders, you have to be willing to die for what you believe in. Anyways, it is a new moon; enjoy the new moon, let us eat and have a good time. title: AGREE TOGETHER | BOUND NOT BONDAGE
text: Introduction Sabbath class from California, on the West Coast. Bishop opens the class with a preface on prophecy and idolatry that hit him in the spirit that morning, then turns it over to Deacon Abiel for the main lesson: agree together, bound not bondage. Tomorrow is the Marriage Is Honorable event, the third one, so this whole class is preparation for the marriages of the nation. Definitions read in class: bound is fastened by or as if by a band; placed under legal or moral restraint or obligation. Marriage is a legal obligation through the Most High; that covenant you have with your wife is between you two and it is honored by the Lord. Bondage is a state of being bound usually by compulsion, as of a law, such as slavery or serfdom. Some of us have a perception that marriage is like slavery. What is that one word that many wives associate with slavery? Submission. When they hear that word submit, the first thing is, I am a servant, I am a slave. But that is not what it is. It is called order, what the Lord has designed as marriage. Scriptures Opened Ecclesiastes 1:9-11 24:07 - The thing that hath been, it is that which shall be. The thing is talking about man on earth: whether man keeps the commandments or does not keep the commandments, that which is done is that which shall be done. There is no new thing under the sun. From the time of Genesis, as it has been is going to be so in these last days. - Is there anything whereof it may be said, See, this is new? It hath been already of old time, which was before us. There are no new incidents on this earth. The things that are done by man are the things that were done in the past. - There is no remembrance of former things. Why? Because the spirits from the past return to the future. Precepts: - Ecclesiastes 6:10 That which hath been is named already, and it is known that it is man. That tells you what the thing of Ecclesiastes 1:9 is. Romans 15:4 26:01 - What Ecclesiastes 1:9 says, Paul uses different words, but it is the same meaning. Whatsoever things were written aforetime were written for our learning, our learning today. In your Christianity mind you might go, no, that makes no sense, because everything is new. Nothing is new; everything that was done in the past is reoccurring. - In order to deal with these reoccurring events, we must read the history and testimonies of our ancestors from the past, that we through patience and comfort of the scriptures might have hope. Precepts: - 2 Esdras 5:42 He likens his judgment unto a ring. A ring is like a circle: there is no slackness of the last, and no swiftness of the first. His judgments on the earth are a continual event that reoccurs over and over. That is why Paul said comfort yourselves through what is written in the testimonies of the past, because what you are living is a reoccurring event. - Hosea 12:10 All the prophets spoke: Isaiah, Jeremiah, Daniel, Hosea. He multiplied visions and used similitudes, or parables, by the ministry of the prophets, comparing one thing to another. Revelation 13:1-2 29:04 - A beast rises up out of the sea, having seven heads and ten horns. Put on the screen: the seven heads are Greece, Rome, Spain, France, Germany, Great Britain, with America as the eighth head; the ten horns are Belgium, Luxembourg, Netherlands, Germany, United Kingdom, Italy, Greece, France, Denmark, and Ireland. These are all European powers, because that is what this is talking about. Upon his heads the name of blasphemy. - The beast which I saw was like unto a leopard: in Daniel 7 the leopard was the symbol of Greece. His feet were as the feet of a bear: the bear was Media Persia. His mouth as the mouth of a lion: the lion was ancient Babylon. This last kingdom has attributes of the ancient Grecian empire, of ancient Media Persia, and of ancient Babylon in it. - And the dragon, which is Satan in this part right here, gave him his power, his armaments, and his seat, and great authority. Precepts: - Matthew 4:8-9 You can be blessed by God or you can be blessed by Satan. The devil took Christ to an exceeding high mountain, showed him all the kingdoms of the world and the glory of them, and said, All these things will I give thee. What is the stipulation? If thou wilt fall down and worship me. That is exactly what Revelation 13:2 describes: the dragon gave him his power and his seat and great authority. - 1 Timothy 6:9-10 They that will be rich fall into temptation and a snare. The love of money is the root of all evil, which while some coveted after, they have erred from the faith and pierced themselves through with many sorrows. That is what Satan will have you do. If you covet fame and fortune in this world, you must worship Satan; that is the only way. Daniel 3:1-30 36:14 - Nebuchadnezzar the king made an image of gold and gathered the princes, the governors, the captains, the judges, the treasurers, the counsellors, the sheriffs, and all the rulers of the provinces to the dedication of the image. Nebuchadnezzar had set up a one world religion. It is the same thing they are trying to do today. - You may read that and go, that was back then, that does not happen today. News article read in class from Newsbreak: pastors prayed over a massive gold statue of Donald Trump in Florida.
