Evangelical leaders gathered at Trump National Doral in Miami to bless and dedicate a towering gold leaf statue dubbed Don Colossus, 22 feet tall on a 7 foot pedestal, depicting Trump with his fist raised, unveiled during a dedication ceremony led by evangelical pastor Mark Burns, who told attendees the statue was not a golden calf but a symbol of resilience, freedom, patriotism, strength, and willpower. Evangelical leaders prayed over the monument while supporters applauded around the base. Trump himself called into the event by phone to thank Burns and the guests, and on Friday they did it again at Mar-a-Lago. So they prayed over this image, this 22 foot golden image. You see the comparison with Daniel the third chapter. - Video played of a clip from the series The Boys, where the Homelander character receives a message that his destiny is not serving the Lord but being the Lord: they are mixing evangelical Christians into politics and patterning it after this administration. A man sets himself up as the Messiah on earth. Y'all just seen Daniel 3 coming to life. We are seeing it in our time. - Whoso falleth not down and worshippeth shall the same hour be cast into the midst of a burning fiery furnace. Certain Chaldeans accused the Jews: Shadrach, Meshach, and Abednego serve not thy gods, nor worship the golden image which thou hast set up. - We are not careful to answer thee in this matter: meaning, we are not worried to answer you. Our God whom we serve is able to deliver us. Then watch the next verse: but if not. They understood God does what he wants; you cannot force the Lord to save you or deliver you. But if not, be it known unto thee, O king, that we will not serve thy gods. They understood that the body is temporal but the spirit lives on. - The form of the fourth is like the Son of God. Many translations say that fourth one looks like a god; Nebuchadnezzar did not know, but the translators understood it was Christ. - The fire had no power over their bodies, nor was an hair of their heads singed. Nebuchadnezzar then made a decree that no one speak anything amiss against the God of Shadrach, Meshach, and Abednego, because there is no other God that can deliver after this sort. But when you read the history, Nebuchadnezzar did not hold true to that at all; he went right back to his idolatrous ways. These are the things we have to read, learn, and implement in our own hearts, minds, and souls, because these events will occur again. Precepts: - Revelation 13:6-8 He opened his mouth in blasphemy against God: this is Rome, the Roman Catholic Church, which is the mother of all Christian denominations. It was given unto him to make war with the saints: the twelve tribes of Israel are the saints; war was orchestrated against us under Pope Nicholas V, and he overcame us and enslaved us. Power was given him over all kindreds and tongues and nations: that is how that race became the dominant power on the planet. And all that dwell upon the earth shall worship him: the whole world worships that image as God, as Jesus, as the angels. Ask a Muslim or a Buddhist whose image that is and they will say Jesus. That is what they all do. - 1 Maccabees 1:41-50 That was Babylon; now here is the Greek captivity. King Antiochus wrote to his whole kingdom that all should be one people, and every one should leave his laws. All the heathen agreed, yea, many also of the Israelites consented to his religion, like Pastor Mark Burns, and sacrificed unto idols and profaned the sabbath. The purpose of the king's letters was to the end they might forget the law and change all the ordinances, and whosoever would not do according to the commandment of the king, he said, should die. The same idolatry we read about in Babylon happened in Greece. It is like a ring; it is going to continue. Do not think America is absolved from this. We are seeing elements of it now. Some of you have been swooned to sleep: nothing is ever going to happen here. Now you see a big gold statue set up. Wisdom of Solomon 14:12-27 58:39 - The devising of idols was the beginning of spiritual fornication. Idolatry was the beginning of sin. You are going, wait a minute, did not Eve eat an apple? It was not an apple; it was idolatry. For neither were they from the beginning, neither shall they be for ever: when the Lord created Adam and Eve there was no idolatry; that came sometime later, and there comes an end. - He gives an example of how idolatry grows in the earth: a father afflicted with untimely mourning made an image of his child soon taken away, and now honored him as a god, which was then a dead man, and delivered ceremonies and sacrifices to those under him, like in honor of Tammuz that you read about in Ezekiel 8. Thus in process of time an ungodly custom grown strong was kept as a law, and graven images were worshipped by the commandments of kings. That is what Christmas is about, worshipping this Cesare Borgia guy as Jesus on December 25th; that is what Easter Sunday is all about. And here is a lie: I do not do it because America says to do it, I do it for the children. So why do you have to do it on that particular day like America says? - Whom men could not honour in presence, because they dwelt far off, they took the counterfeit of his visage from far, and made an express image of a king whom they honoured. So they took his image from Rome and took it across the world: Columbus and the conquistadors came with the cross and images of Jesus by the thousands, worldwide. That is who Matthew 24:4-5 is talking about, not ten Israelites with a Bible in Liberia. - The singular diligence of the artificer, the artist, did help to set forward the ignorant to more superstition. Our people in Christianity truly believe those false images are God; the Bible is calling them the ignorant. - History read in class: Leonardo da Vinci made sketches in the 1400s of Cesare Borgia as the new Jesus. The Head of Christ, also called the Sallman Head, is a 1940 portrait of Jesus by Warner Sallman; the Baptist bookstore popularized the painting throughout the southern United States, and the Salvation Army and YMCA handed out pocket sized versions to American servicemen heading overseas during World War II. That is how that image became famous. - And so the multitude, allured by the grace of the work, took him now for a god, which a little before was but honoured as a man. It starts with Nimrod, Semiramis, Tammuz, but I bring up Cesare Borgia today because our people do not know those names. This was an occasion to deceive the world. - They lived in the great war of ignorance. We are telling people those images are not God, and they say, you are disturbing us, you are causing division. In Liberia, every radio show we went on said, why are you men causing division? Those so great plagues called they peace. - For whilst they slew their children in sacrifices, or used secret ceremonies, or made revellings of strange rites. You will read that and go, that is only in the past. Video played in class on the newly released Epstein files alleging secret ceremonies, torture, and ritual abuse among presidents, princes, and celebrities; the teaching point is that verse 23 is not ancient history, and nothing is secret that shall not be revealed. God is exposing these people to shatter the idols that people have created out of popular figures. - So that there reigned in all men without exception blood, manslaughter, theft, dissimulation, corruption, unfaithfulness, tumult, perjury, disquieting of good men, defiling of souls, changing of kind: males becoming females, females becoming males; disorder in marriages, adultery, and shameless uncleanness. - For the worshipping of idols not to be named is the beginning, the cause, and the end of all evil. The beginning sin with Eve was idolatry, and these end times are going to end the same way. Precepts: - Matthew 24:4-5 Take heed that no man deceive you: for many shall come in my name, saying, I am Christ, and shall deceive many. In Liberia they told us the many is us ten men out there teaching. No: the many that came in his name saying I am Christ is the image the conquistadors carried worldwide. Proverbs 31:26 1:20:33 - Because idolatry, hatred, malice, grudging, and bitterness corrupt a marriage one way or the other, a telegram was set up for sisters to send in letters with questions for the Marriage Is Honorable event tomorrow. One submission read in class asked how you can receive advice or approach leadership about your marriage issues when some of their marriages have the same issues or worse, pointing at the one instance of a leader put out for adultery. That email was not beneficial; it was an attack. There are three bishops and seven or eight deacons, and she ignores all the ones who were not in the midst of any such thing and highlights the one instance. For every solution we try to give, that spirit has two problems. - She openeth her mouth with wisdom, and in her tongue is the law of kindness. This is the kind of wife you want. There was no kindness or wisdom in that email. Brothers, be mindful who you marry. Precepts: - Ezekiel 24:12 When Israel is in the midst of sin, God uses this language in the female context: she hath wearied herself with lies, and her great scum went not forth out of her. Definition read in class: scum is a layer of foul or unwanted matter that forms on top of a liquid, and informally a despised, immoral, or worthless person. That is the word God chose for his own people when the wickedness would not come out. Self examine, so that word never describes you. Proverbs 22:3 1:27:03 - Deacon Abiel takes the class. We are always going through prophecy; we have the blueprint of what is going to go down. But what good does it do us if we are not preparing for what is coming? You just saw Daniel 3 coming to life before your eyes. History is repeating itself. - A prudent man foreseeth the evil, and hideth himself: he sees what is about to happen and he prepares for that. But the simple pass on, and are punished. Somebody watching this class is taking notes, saying that is some good stuff, and then will immediately close their Bible, go home, and proceed to be a demon. You saw the evil, but you are not hiding. Precepts: - 2 Esdras 14:11-13 The world is divided into ten parts and ten parts of it are gone already. That was during the time of Ezra; understand we are in the last days and the clock is ticking. Now therefore set thine house in order, and reprove thy people. Notice we start first with setting our own houses in order; then we have the ability to tell somebody else to get right. If we are going to set our houses in order, where do we start? With your marriage. If the home front is not right, how are you going to get out there and instruct your people? Genesis 2:18-24 1:33:05 - Go all the way back to the beginning, to why marriage was made. It is not good that the man should be alone; I will make him an help meet for him. The Lord God caused a deep sleep to fall upon Adam, took one of his ribs, and made he a woman. This is now bone of my bones, and flesh of my flesh. Therefore shall a man leave his father and his mother, and shall cleave unto his wife: and they shall be one flesh. - Brothers, who gives you your wife? The Lord does. Ecclesiastes 9:9 1:35:01 - Live joyfully with the wife whom thou lovest all the days of the life of thy vanity, which he hath given thee under the sun. Which he hath given thee: brothers, the Lord gave her to you. That sister was created for you. This is your portion all the days of your life. Precepts: - Ecclesiasticus 26:23 Now some of you are saying, she is all jacked up though. Here is the surprise: a wicked woman is given as a portion to a wicked man, but a godly woman is given to him that feareth the Lord. So ask yourself, why was she given to me? What am I not reflecting on, how am I not being real with myself, to understand why I am in the situation I am in? You see all of her flaws and you look at yourself like you never did anything wrong. - Ecclesiasticus 26:3 A good wife is a good portion, which shall be given in the portion of them that fear the Lord. If you are not serious about this walk, how can you expect a righteous woman? Everybody says I want that virtuous woman, but you have been in sin the whole time you have been in this truth and you want the Proverbs 31. No sir; that is not your portion. It goes according to where your faith is at. Now it is not always the case; sometimes a husband is righteous and he is trying to correct his wife and get her right. - Ecclesiastes 7:26 Here is the reality check for the evil sisters who think, if I am evil he must be evil, we will just be evil together. I find more bitter than death the woman whose heart is snares and nets, and her hands as bands: whoso pleaseth God shall escape from her. A man will be delivered from a woman like that. So do not think you can just stay evil and you two will be together forever; the Lord will deliver him. How about you just repent and get it together so you can be heirs together. Malachi 2:14 1:40:53 - Write this down: marriage is a covenant. The Lord hath been witness between thee and the wife of thy youth, against whom thou hast dealt treacherously: yet is she thy companion, and the wife of thy covenant. You brothers that deal treacherously with your wives, the Lord sees you, and there is payment for that. - The wife of thy youth: marriage was designed to happen when you are young. Not that you cannot marry when you are older, but naturally, when a young boy becomes a man and a young woman becomes a woman, that is when they search for a companion, so that they can grow old together. - Bishop's account told in class: a brother married a sister, then came asking to get rid of her because she was not right. Before the marriage she had told him plainly about her mental health and her medication, and he said yes anyway. The answer: she is yours. Stop being fooled by beauty; beauty is vain. Know who you are marrying, and once you covenant, that covenant stands. Proverbs 5:18-19 1:45:23 - Let thy fountain be blessed: and rejoice with the wife of thy youth. Hands went up around the room for marriages of five, ten, fifteen, twenty, twenty five years, and Bishop has been married thirty six years. These are the examples we have right here. - Those of you married a long time are supposed to still be able to look at your wife or your husband and see when you were young. That is why people who have that can be content: as you get older, both of you change, both of you get old, but you remember. Let her breast satisfy thee at all times; and be thou ravished always with her love. Her body will change with the years, but she is yours, brother, and that bond cannot be broken if you are in the Lord. Precepts: - Tobit 8:7 I take not this my sister for lust, but uprightly: therefore mercifully ordain that we may become aged together. We pray we see our older years together. Some of us make it there and some do not; let it be because of passing, not because you would not apply the scriptures. The prophecy classes are dope, but you have to have the same zeal for these classes on marriage and repentance, or your marriage falls apart and then you look at us like it was our fault. Ephesians 5:31-32 1:50:55 - For this cause shall a man leave his father and mother, and shall be joined unto his wife. The reason the young man leaves the house is to start his own family, not to go out there and figure it out. You do not send your son out like that, and you do not send your daughters out into the world with no protection. - This is a great mystery: but I speak concerning Christ and the church. The marriage is a mirror image: the husband represents Christ, and the wife represents the church. Ephesians 5:25-27 1:53:07 - Husbands, love your wives, even as Christ also loved the church, and gave himself for it. Brothers, did Christ give his life for the church? Would you give your life for your wife, for your house, for understanding how to deal with your wife the right way? - When we understand that we are the representation of Christ in the home, you are supposed to move like Christ in the house. You speak it and you walk it; we are not hypocritical in our speech, because that is what we require of them. Matthew 16:22-23 1:56:04 - Did Christ deal what we would call harshly with the church at times? He did. There is a misconception among sisters that the man is supposed to be soft spoken and agreeable at all times. No. Sisters, you might agree with 30 percent of what your husband says; you are going to spend the majority doing things you do not agree with. It is not for you to agree; it is for you to do. - The first thing wives say about submission is, as unto the Lord, and you are not Christ; Jesus would not say what you are saying. Really? Peter took him and began to rebuke him, and he turned and said unto Peter, Get thee behind me, Satan. Peter was called Satan himself. What is worse than being called Satan? Nobody wants to admit to being rightfully called something. Not that we should be calling each other out of our names, but there are times you need to realize what spirit you are carrying, and that is what Christ did: I see the spirit on you and I am going to tell you what it is. Mark 4:37-40 1:57:53 - The storm arose, the disciples woke Christ saying, Master, carest thou not that we perish? He rebuked the wind, said unto the sea, Peace, be still, and then said unto them, Why are ye so fearful? how is it that ye have no faith? - Sisters have heard that from their husbands and been the most offended. You tell your wife her faith is weak and it is an issue. No, it is the truth. Christ said it to them to strengthen them, to get them to realize, you are moving in fear. Why are you acting scared? Do you not believe? Matthew 17:17 1:59:49 - O faithless and perverse generation, how long shall I be with you? how long shall I suffer you? Depending on who is reading, you can hear the frustration in Christ's voice. Christ got frustrated, got angry, was fed up at times. Did that mean he did not love them? No. He dealt that way because it was necessary. - How many times have you told your wife what she was doing was wrong, and it became, why are you so mean? It is not me being mean; I am telling you what it is. Why can you not receive it like they received it from Christ? Many times your wife does not see Christ in you, brother, so everything is taken offensively. And we recognize, sisters, some brothers are not trying to build up, they are trying to tear down; but it is not for you to decide when. You have to put it in the Lord's hands. Ecclesiastes 3:1-8 2:01:19 - To every thing there is a season, and a time to every purpose under the heaven. A time to kill, and a time to heal; a time to break down, and a time to build up; a time to love, and a time to hate; a time of war, and a time of peace. - We have seen Christ drive men out of temples and call for destruction on cities. There is a time for everything. Just because his demeanor was such does not mean he did not love the church. The Lord has given man the ability to discern between those times, and it is his job to do that. Sisters, if you take everything as, he is trying to destroy me, you will never be built up. You have to trust that the one the Lord created you for is going to take care of you. 1 Corinthians 14:33-34 2:03:00 - Write this down: the divine order. For God is not the author of confusion, but of peace. Why does, Let your women keep silence in the churches, follow immediately after that? Because a woman speaking out of turn concerning the church is confusion. A woman not being in order is confusion. - Whenever you are having these issues in your household, it is because you allowed confusion to breach. You allowed feminism in the house; you did not stop it at the door. You allowed pride to come in. Precepts: - Acts 19:1-34 There is history behind why Paul said let the women keep silence in the churches. In Ephesus and that whole region around Corinth they worshipped the great goddess Diana, whom all Asia and the world worshipped, and the people cried out for two hours, Great is Diana of the Ephesians. Some of those women repented, so to speak, came into the church, and brought that goddess spirit with them. That whole feminist movement is the same spirit back today. 1 Corinthians 11:3 2:04:27 - The head of every man is Christ; and the head of the woman is the man; and the head of Christ is God. Is anybody confused on the order? Then why is there so much confusion when it comes to your position as a husband and your position as a wife? Because pride has made its way in, and because of your lack of leadership, brother: you are non confrontational, you are passive, she raises her voice and you cower. There is confusion in your home because you gave up your position. - If you are scared of your wife, you cannot get out here and cast down the lies of the nations and bring us out of this captivity when you are scared to deal with your own house. Precepts: - John 5:30 Was Christ ever confused about his position and role with the Father? I can of mine own self do nothing: I seek not mine own will, but the will of the Father which hath sent me. Christ understands his role and position, and Christ tells us the husband is the head of the wife. So why is there still so much confusion? Somebody does not believe like they say they do. Genesis 2:18 2:10:40 - I will make him an help. Definition read in class: to help is to give assistance or support to someone, to provide someone with something that is useful or necessary in achieving an end. Help meet means suitable for him. - Sometimes the help thinks they are supposed to lead, or the help thinks they are supposed to guide. But what is a help? Someone that assists in making what the husband wants happen. Sisters, the help is the greatest thing you are ever going to be. The moment you decide being the help is not the greatest thing you can be, you are going to destroy your marriage. - Brothers, the same goes the other way: the moment you decide not to provide, not to be the man God told you to be, watch what happens to your household. It is a domino effect. Some of you brothers did not want a wife; you wanted a mama. Precepts: - Genesis 3:16 Thy desire shall be to thy husband, and he shall rule over thee. Some teach that it was only at this point the woman was to listen to the husband. No: she was told she was the help back in Genesis 2; Genesis 3:16 confirms the rule after the transgression. So why do we feel today that being a help is a bad thing? - Isaiah 3:12 Write this down: women were never designed to lead men. As for my people, children are their oppressors, and women rule over them. O my people, they which lead thee cause thee to err. Women ruling over you is a curse, brothers. Some of you are scared to lead your house and you have allowed her to lead. It is not a secret; everyone sees it. You must change the way you think. - Jeremiah 31:22 How long wilt thou go about, O thou backsliding daughter? for the Lord hath created a new thing in the earth, a woman shall compass a man. This was never heard of, women being over men. That is not the natural state, but you allow it. Cases come up where the brother does not know what is going on in his own house because his wife runs everything, and he is used to it. - Ezekiel 34:31 And ye my flock, the flock of my pasture, are men. The Lord uses men to lead. It has always been that way and it is never going to change. Sisters, the influencers on social media making you think the man is supposed to worship the ground you walk on will not influence the men in purple and gold. Do you want a man or do you want a boy? And sisters, when your husband gets around the brothers and comes home acting different, he is supposed to come home different: he examined himself, saw he was lacking, and came home on fire to fix his house. 2 Timothy 3:1-6 2:22:07 - There is an attack to destroy the household. Satan and his people know that in order to destroy us they have to attack our foundation, and the foundation is the home. We are building a nation, and if we are not strong on the home front, we are not going to get up off the ground. - In the last days perilous times shall come: lovers of their own selves, covetous, boasters, proud, truce breakers, false accusers, fierce, traitors, lovers of pleasures more than lovers of God. All of these are types sent out to destroy. - Having a form of godliness, but denying the power thereof: these are your social media influencers big-heading our women, making them think they are greater than us. From such turn away. - For of this sort are they which creep into houses, and lead captive silly women laden with sins. This is how you get infiltrated: through the phone, through conversation, through whoever is influencing them. Sisters, your algorithm is jacked up: if you keep watching that woman-power, men-are-worthless content, that is all you will see, and then you look at your husband sideways because of your algorithm. - Word given in class to the sisters deep in social media: the men in your DMs do not want to marry you. If the Most High put your marriage together, you are not going to find better than that, because God put that together. Once you leave that, the protection of God is no longer on you; you are on your own. A case was told in class of a wife who degraded herself online for small cash payments from strangers and refused her husband's correction; that path leaves a family of three children behind for nothing. If that is where a wife is, she is already gone. The Tyler Perry movie Temptation was referenced: he convinces her to leave her husband, and watch what happens. 1 Peter 3:1 2:30:19 - Stop with this, I cannot submit to a man that is not right. It is old, it is tired, it is played out. Do you believe or do you not believe? That is the question at hand. - Likewise, ye wives, be in subjection to your own husbands; that, if any obey not the word, they also may without the word be won by the conversation of the wives. Peter is telling wives that through your chaste conversation, your obedience, your example, you can win over a husband who is not even in the truth yet. So you still have to hear him? Yes. Ask yourself: do you serve a God who will redeem and deliver you because you are faithful, or do you not believe? Joshua 24:15 2:32:03 - The roles of a husband. This is the same Joshua who came out of Egypt, who saw all that happened. Choose you this day whom ye will serve; but as for me and my house, we will serve the Lord. - A man of the Lord understands his first role: he must command his house. Those in his house do not have a choice. Some of you have kids that are not keeping the commandments and you let them do whatever. As for you and your house, what are you going to do? A man commands his home. Your first role is commander in chief of the house; you have to see yourself in that manner, otherwise you will allow someone else to have rule in your home. This is your house: not Deacon's house, your house. 1 Timothy 5:8 2:34:07 - If any provide not for his own, and specially for those of his own house, he hath denied the faith, and is worse than an infidel. Your role as a husband is to provide. - Many households today are only sustained by two incomes, and it is extremely difficult now for a man to hold down everything, but it is possible, and you have to be able to if you have to. If it is going to be a mean cottage, it is a mean cottage, but it is yours. If she works too, the income is the household income and you figure it out together, and do not be a tyrant about it; but brothers, if you give up your position, you will never get it back. Colossians 3:19 2:38:45 - Husbands, love your wives, and be not bitter against them. You have to have restraint regardless of what has happened. You have to be Christ in the home; that means you have to be able to forgive, to let go, to have the emotional stability to lead the home properly. Ephesians 5:25-29 2:39:33 - Christ corrected the church, taught them, fed them, and literally died for the church. That is the exact love you have to show your wife. If you are going to give your life, that also means you get up and investigate the strange sound downstairs instead of sending your wife; it means you work the long shift to make sure the bills get paid. - Some of you love the PlayStation. You would rather play video games or hang out with the brothers than provide for your house. If we find that is you: rank stripped immediately. It makes no sense for your children to be a reflection of poverty while you have the latest of everything. You cannot say you love your family if you are not willing to sacrifice for them. - So ought men to love their wives as their own bodies. There is no reason to treat your wife in a way you would not want to be dealt with. When leadership has dealt harshly with you, it was necessary and you understood it. It is the same in the house, but you have to know how to do it: there are brothers who know how to tear down but do not know how to build up, and then you wonder why she never smiles. Building up is also a skill set. Just like you want to be built up, do it for her as well. Psalms 112:1-10 2:45:02 - Blessed is the man that feareth the Lord, that delighteth greatly in his commandments. His seed shall be mighty upon earth. He is gracious, and full of compassion, and righteous. A good man sheweth favour, and lendeth: he is there for his brother. He shall not be afraid of evil tidings: his heart is fixed, trusting in the Lord. He is not afraid of confrontation; he understands what the Lord has put in front of him and he deals with it. These are attributes we must possess as men of the Lord. Titus 2:6-8 2:46:57 - Young men likewise exhort to be sober minded. In all things shewing thyself a pattern of good works: in doctrine shewing uncorruptness, gravity, sincerity, sound speech that cannot be condemned; that he that is of the contrary part may be ashamed, having no evil thing to say of you. These are the examples of how men are supposed to conduct themselves, with one another and with our wives. 1 Timothy 3:1-5 2:47:41 - If a man desire the office of a bishop, he desireth a good work. Who desires this office? That should be everybody, because a bishop is an example of what we are all supposed to be: blameless, the husband of one wife, vigilant, sober, of good behaviour, given to hospitality, apt to teach, not greedy, patient, not a brawler, not covetous. - One that ruleth well his own house, having his children in subjection with all gravity; for if a man know not how to rule his own house, how shall he take care of the church of God? How can you lead other men and tell them this is the way if your own house is out of order, if your wife does not listen to you and your kids do not listen to you? You cannot be over men if you cannot rule your own house. - Slides read in class, things husbands do that destroy marriages: adultery and fornication, which has caused damage in Israel beyond repair, so if you are battling that, get help right now; failure to lead; bitterness and harshness, holding things over her head after she has repented, humiliating her, unrealistic expectations; neglect, when a trip to the store is the only outing your wife has had in months, take your wife out, because ordering the house and dealing with the kids is difficult; pride and refusing correction, you ask leadership for counsel, then leave and remix it your own way; financial irresponsibility, wasting money, gambling, hiding spending, chasing image over stability; lack of self control, emotional men punching walls and threatening divorce constantly, saying things that cannot be unsaid; loving the world more than his family, idolizing jobs, status, and friends; failure to dwell with his wife according to knowledge; and withholding love and affection, because if she is not getting it from you, where is she going to get it from? Precepts: - Ecclesiasticus 36:25 Where no hedge is, there the possession is spoiled. If you do not lead your house, you lose control, and the possession is spoiled. If you are not there guiding, instructing, and correcting, the marriage comes to a crashing halt. - 1 Peter 3:7 Likewise, ye husbands, dwell with them according to knowledge, giving honour unto the wife, as unto the weaker vessel. A wise husband studies his wife: her fears, emotions, struggles, and strengths. When you understand your wife, you know her limits, and you set things up in the home so things can work. Some men never learn their wives and then wonder why the marriage feels distant. Ephesians 5:22-24 3:04:22 - The roles of a wife. Wives, submit yourselves unto your own husbands, as unto the Lord. As the church is subject unto Christ, so let the wives be to their own husbands in everything. - You assist your husband in what he wants. This goes for the house: it is the house of the husband, the way the ancient houses carried the father's name. When you understand whose house it is, you understand whose desires set the direction. The confusion comes when you think your aspirations are supposed to supersede his. We are on the same team, yes, but somebody is the head of the team, and the head makes the decisions for the franchise. - Be honest, sisters: when it comes to the ordering of the house, most husbands let you do what you want with the drapes, the pots, the design. Most men are not fighting you over the couch set. So stop acting like submission is slavery; most of that is exaggeration. Precepts: - Ecclesiasticus 26:16 As the sun when it ariseth in the high heaven, so is the beauty of a good wife in the ordering of her house. The way you set it up, the way you do things, that is your beauty. And for you brothers whose wives only clean for presentation when company comes: you have to order your house and demand what the desire of your home is. Proverbs 31:10-28 3:12:13 - Who can find a virtuous woman? for her price is far above rubies. The heart of her husband doth safely trust in her. This woman has shown this to her husband; he has observed her and he has no worries. Brothers, do you not want that? Sisters, do you not want to give that to your husband? - She riseth also while it is yet night, and giveth meat to her household: she is up early preparing for her household. She considereth a field, and buyeth it: she is investing for the household. She stretcheth out her hand to the poor. She is not afraid of the snow for her household: for all her household are clothed with scarlet. She is prepared. - She openeth her mouth with wisdom; and in her tongue is the law of kindness. She looketh well to the ways of her household, and eateth not the bread of idleness. Her household is her business and she is not idle. - Her children arise up, and call her blessed; her husband also, and he praiseth her. Who has to institute that in the house? The husband. You teach the children to honor their mother. - She will do him good and not evil all the days of her life. Teaching from the table: if a man at her job puts a hand on her, a virtuous wife handles that herself right there; she does not carry it home as a spark for her husband to catch a case over. Bishop's account: a brother called saying he was on his way to his wife's job to fight a man who grabbed her hand. The counsel: turn around, call your wife, and tell her she had better handle that; that is her job. Of course, if it is an assault she cannot stop, that is different; everybody understands that. But she will do him good and not evil means there are things she is supposed to shut down herself. Titus 2:3-5 3:19:43 - The aged women likewise, that they be in behaviour as becometh holiness, teachers of good things; that they may teach the young women to be sober, to love their husbands, to love their children, to be discreet, chaste, keepers at home. - Keepers at home: she takes care of her house; there is enough pertaining to her own house for her to deal with. She is not idle, she is not a busybody in everybody else's house. - Obedient to their own husbands, that the word of God be not blasphemed. The word of God is blasphemed when a wife who claims she believes is not obedient to her husband. What is the difference between a man who does not provide, who the scripture says is worse than an infidel, and a woman who does not submit? She is not a believer. You can tell if a woman believes the Bible by how she deals with her husband: her tone, her reverence, not going back and forth with him, dealing with him like she would deal with the Lord. 1 Timothy 5:14-16 3:23:40 - I will therefore that the younger women marry, bear children, guide the house, give none occasion to the adversary to speak reproachfully. Why was Paul addressing the younger women marrying? The younger widows were looking to the church to fund their lives. The answer was: you younger women, marry, so you can be taken care of by your husband. The school helps the older widows, and the active widows; but you younger women are expected to move on and marry. - Slides read in class, things a wife can do to destroy her marriage: disrespecting her husband, belittling him, talking down to him, embarrassing him publicly, constantly challenging his authority, because the moment your husband cannot lead or instruct you, you have stepped outside what God put in place; contention and constant arguments, because it is not normal to go back and forth with your spouse, and when that is happening Satan is afoot; refusing submission, competing with the husband, undermining his leadership, trying to dominate the household, because two heads create confusion every time; public humiliation, exposing private matters, gossiping about her husband, attacking him before friends and family; withholding intimacy, weaponizing it, which creates resentment, temptation, and emotional distance, and whoever counsels you to move that way is the devil; open 1 Corinthians 7 right then and there; and following worldly counsel, listening to evil relatives, friends, and a jacked up social media algorithm on how to deal with your husband. - Questions submitted for the marriage event were read. One sister wrote that her husband is slothful and only works for Esau, and asked how she is supposed to rebuke him as the weaker vessel. Answer: there are things your husband is not going to receive from you; you cannot stand over him demanding. Push him to be around leadership, because when brothers come around the leaders, things come out, and that hot seat has changed lives. That brother is probably also tired as hell. - Another sister asked how to encourage her lord to spend time with the girls in a blended family. Answer: stop trying to tell a man how to be a father; that is that bossy spirit trying to find an excuse to instruct him. Influence him through your own actions: take the girls to the park yourself and let your example provoke him. Complaining and nagging has never moved a man; pray to the Most High and be a good influence. And sisters, be honest about the choices that created the blended situation; we are not miracle workers. - A brother wrote that in over ten years his wife has taken no initiative, no meal prep, while he works twelve hour shifts, and asked for help. Answer: you have to command your house, brother. There is no way you work those shifts and cannot get a plate of food made. Fix it. - Another submission asked why there are no structured events or classes for married couples. The browser was pulled up live in class: type in IUIC marriage class and playlists of over a hundred videos come up, plus the cabin trip series, plus this being the third Marriage Is Honorable event. Some people only see what they want to see. Matthew 19:4-5 3:49:45 - Have ye not read, that he which made them at the beginning made them male and female, and they twain shall be one flesh? There is a lot packed into being one flesh. We have constantly pushed the importance of applying what we learn to our everyday lives and our marriages. If we do not apply, we will not grow, and you will not see change in our homes. - Even with the problems we have here, we are eons ahead of so many congregations and churches, and even ourselves, we are trying to perfect it. Psalms 127:1 3:51:15 - Except the Lord build the house, they labour in vain that build it. We labor in vain if we are not building in the Lord. If we are not doing it according to how he said, it is going to crash. All the tears, all the pain, all the grief you are going through: if you are not going to apply, it is going to keep happening. Colossians 3:12-15 3:52:10 - Put on therefore, as the elect of God, holy and beloved, bowels of mercies, kindness, humbleness of mind, meekness, longsuffering. We have to put all these things on; this gets rid of a lot of the nonsense we deal with. - Forbearing one another, and forgiving one another: too many marriages suffer because one spouse will not forgive the other. You have to forgive and move past it, and allow the other person to grow. If you keep hanging things over their head, you will never come out of it. - And above all these things put on charity, which is the bond of perfectness. And let the peace of God rule in your hearts, to the which also ye are called in one body; and be ye thankful. Just like in the household: you are one flesh. In Closing We must do what the Most High God told us to do and apply all that we have learned here so that our marriages can flourish. The home is the foundation of the nation we are building. Set thine house in order: agree together, bound in covenant, not in bondage. Announcements & References Worldwide blitz Passover mission recaps played in class: Mission 198 in Jamaica; Mission 205 in Edmonton, Canada; Mission 213 in Trinidad, where the brothers cleaned the streets of Laventille and stood up at a mass grave site demanding the community's men stand up; Mission 221 in St. Lucia; Mission 225 in Ghana, where the people cast away their idols; Mission 226 in Liberia, led by the General, with a Rise Up Liberia anthem recalling the two wars and fourteen lost years; and Mission 227 in Haiti. Israel United in Christ is not just a church, a congregation, or a school: it is a nation, the nation written about in the Holy Bible. Support call: the schools outside America have financial needs. In Liberia the power goes out every two hours, the cameras and internet have to keep working, the schools need air conditioning for the kids, and the pantry needs food. None of the leadership is driving Bentleys; the money goes to the schools. One cannot do it, but together we can move mountains. Music and media: the second video from Original Royalty Recordings, Black Gold, off the third studio album Saving Sarah's Daughters by The Pen, premiered in class; the album is available at originalroyalty.com and all streaming platforms. Israel Live top five: scan the QR code to cast your vote for next week's episode, every Monday night at 9:00 pm. The Marriage Is Honorable event, the third one, is tomorrow. Closing reading: 1 Corinthians 11:23-29, the bread and the cup, in remembrance of the Lord's death till he come; let a man examine himself. --- Class Notes Index Transcript: full session

title: BEGINNING OF SORROWS & GREAT PAIN
text: Introduction Thumbnail video: "Tell us, when shall these things be, and what shall be the sign of thy coming, and of the end of the world? Take heed that no man deceive you: for many shall come in my name, saying, I am Christ; and shall deceive many. And ye shall hear of wars and rumours of wars: see that ye be not troubled: for all these things must come to pass, but the end is not yet. For nation shall rise against nation, and kingdom against kingdom: and there shall be famines, and pestilences, and earthquakes, in divers places. All these are the beginning of sorrows. Then shall they deliver you up to be afflicted, and shall kill you: and ye shall be hated of all nations for my name's sake." There is a lot going on all over the world. My job is to paint the picture in your mind of what is going to happen, to prepare you brothers and sisters for what is coming, to prepare your mind and your spirit, and to take the things you see happening in the world and show them to you in the scriptures. The topic this afternoon is the beginning of sorrows and great pain. In The News Two points before the topic. The congressional hearing on Fauci: - This week there was a congressional hearing concerning Fauci and the coronavirus. Republican after Republican on the Senate Homeland Security Committee unleashed on Dr. Anthony Fauci as he declined to answer any of their questions. In his opening statement Fauci claimed committee chairman Rand Paul wants to prosecute him; then over and over came the familiar refrain: "I respectfully decline to answer based upon my rights under the Fifth Amendment of the Constitution." - Fauci had received a preemptive blanket pardon from former President Biden, but Senator Paul put him on notice that he did not think that pardon applied here: it is against the law to obstruct an investigation of Congress. If he did not do anything wrong, why would he be pardoned? - Senator Paul has long accused Fauci of lying to suppress the theory that the virus leaked from a lab in Wuhan, China, a lab that Paul says received US government funding for research to make viruses more transmissible: perhaps the worst medical decision in our history, funding dangerous gain of function research in a less than safe lab in a totalitarian country. Publicly he promoted the theory that the virus arose naturally, while privately he was aware of a mountain of evidence. - From the hearing on the lockdowns: he argued he did not personally issue every lockdown order, but officials across the country invoked his authority to justify these decisions, presented not as judgments open to debate but as dictates of science itself. He wrote that the task force recommendations were driven by himself, and that he had convinced the mayor to close the New York City schools. You could not go to work; you were kicked out of college if you did not get the COVID-19 vaccine. "Are all objections to COVID vaccinations ideological? You affected people's ability to work, travel, be educated, to actually flourish in American society. Shame on you." - So now it comes out that the whole thing was a setup. It was gain of function research that created that virus. Millions of Americans died from COVID-19; some estimate as many as 15 million people died worldwide. And millions more that took the shot are dealing with complications: blood clots, heart attacks, all types of diseases. If you took it, you better pray and fast and get that out of your system. - But watch: everybody is blaming Fauci. Video played of the last three presidents together urging everyone to get vaccinated: "The science is clear. These vaccines will protect you. It's up to you." So Fauci is being used as the fall guy. This is bigger than Fauci. It is the shadow governments, the spiritual wickedness in high places, that made the decision to vaccinate 80 percent of the people on the planet. It was a planned-demic, and the leaders in society were behind it, and they were behind Fauci. The surge at Ceuta: - Spain has deployed security forces and military personnel to its North African territory of Ceuta after an extraordinary surge of migrants crossed from Morocco. Spanish authorities estimate around 65,000 people entered Ceuta within 24 hours; at least 38 migrants died breaching the border. Ceuta is that little piece of Spain that sits in Morocco; Morocco claims Ceuta and Melilla as its own territory, and the most dramatic example before this came in 2021, when more than 8,000 people swam and made their way to Ceuta during a crisis between Spain and Morocco. - The report itself asks the question nobody seems able to answer: was this an uncontrolled humanitarian surge, or was it allowed to happen? How did so many people reach the border almost simultaneously? Was the surge deliberately organized? - Now watch the clips. Netanyahu: "Spain has defamed our heroes. I will not allow any country to wage a diplomatic war against us without paying an immediate price. The Spanish, they are not behaving nicely, but they will learn. You lost, Spain. You will see, very soon." And Trump said the same kind of thing: the Spanish are not behaving very well. - So that border in Morocco was let open and 65,000 people rushed that little territory in 24 hours. That was planned and organized. Who is behind it? Morocco number one, because they left the borders open; number two, Israel; number three, America. Spain spoke against what is being done, and this is the immediate price. I am telling you all: the treacherous dealers. Scriptures Opened Deuteronomy 28:60-61 30:42 - Before the topic, one scripture concerning Fauci and the gain of function research and all these diseases our people are dying from today. All the diseases that our forefathers had in Egypt, the Most High says he is going to bring all of that upon us, and they shall cleave unto thee. - Also every sickness, and every plague, which is not written in the book of this law. What sickness and plague is that? If it is not written in the law and our forefathers never knew about it back then, it means it is something new, something that was going to be created. He is talking about man-made sicknesses and plagues. - Like what? Like Ebola, like HIV and AIDS, like the coronavirus. All of those things came through gain of function research; a lot of these diseases were created by Edom. To do what? To kill us, to destroy us. Them will the Lord bring upon thee, until thou be destroyed. That is a curse the Lord said would fall upon us. Matthew 16:1-3 33:10 - When did the beginning of sorrows start? Christ told the Pharisees and Sadducees: when it is evening, ye say it will be fair weather, for the sky is red; and in the morning, foul weather today, for the sky is red and lowring. You go outside, look at the sky, and you can tell it is going to rain today. - O ye hypocrites, ye can discern the face of the sky; but can ye not discern the signs of the times? We must be able to discern the signs of the times. The Most High gave us signs to look for so we would know what time we are living in. If you are able to look at the signs of the sky and read them, you should be able to watch the signs of the time and read that also. 2 Esdras 9:1-8 35:41 - Measure thou the time diligently in itself: and when thou seest part of the signs past, meaning fulfilled, then shalt thou understand that it is the very same time wherein the Highest will begin to visit the world which he made. - Therefore when there shall be seen earthquakes and uproars of the people in the world. Are we seeing earthquakes taking place all over the world? Are we seeing uproars amongst the people all over the world? Then shalt thou well understand that the Most High spake of those things from the days that were before thee: the days of Daniel, of Jeremiah, of Isaiah, even all the way back in Genesis. The Most High spoke about these things from the beginning. - Like as all that is made in the world hath a beginning and an end, even so the times of the Highest have plain beginnings in wonder and powerful works, and endings in effects and signs. Before this earth ends you are going to see a lot of signs and effects. There will be sorrows, there will be pain, things you cannot even imagine happening on this earth. - And every one that shall be saved, and shall be able to escape by his works: by you keeping the commandments, by you doing what is right, by you dealing right with your brothers. And by faith: by you believing in the Lord. If you have faith and works, the Lord will preserve you from the said perils, the dangers, those sorrows that are coming upon the earth, and you shall see his salvation in his land and within his borders: for we were sanctified for the Lord from the beginning. Genesis 15:13 42:42 - The Lord told Abram: know of a surety that thy seed shall be a stranger in a land that is not theirs, and shall serve them; and they shall afflict them four hundred years. How long did the prophecy say we would be in Egypt, serving the Egyptians? Four hundred years. Exodus 12:40-41 43:29 - Now the sojourning of the children of Israel, who dwelt in Egypt, was four hundred and thirty years. So the prophecy said 400 years, but we came out at 430. Is the Bible contradicting itself? No. When the Lord is dealing with his salvation, his time is his time: no man knoweth the day or the hour. Exodus 3:6-7 44:50 - When the Lord came unto Moses he said, I am the God of Abraham, the God of Isaac, and the God of Jacob. And the Lord said, I have surely seen the affliction of my people which are in Egypt, and have heard their cry by reason of their taskmasters; for I know their sorrows. - So when we were in Egypt, God came down and saw what the Egyptians were doing to us. He heard their cry. He knew their sorrows. What was taking place? He was visiting us in Egypt, and he was making preparation to deliver us out of Egypt. After 400 years, the Lord came, saw our affliction, and started making preparation to deliver us from ancient Egypt. Revelation 11:8 46:59 - Their dead bodies shall lie in the street of the great city, which spiritually is called Sodom and Egypt. The great city is America. Why spiritually Egypt? Because everything that happened to us in ancient Egypt happened to us here in America. In ancient Egypt there was Jim Crow; the same thing here. In ancient Egypt we worked the fields; we were slaves working the fields here in America too. That is why the Bible says this place is spiritual Egypt. - Now examine how long we have been here as slaves in America: over 400 years. When was the 400 year mark? 2019. And right after the 400 year mark, what happened? You all saw the world change after 2019. COVID-19, and the world shut down for two years. The Russia and Ukraine war began, and millions are dead. The Congo. Palestine destroyed after October 7th, 2023, then the war with Lebanon, then the war with Iran. White people saying they do not want migrants in their country any more; riots; January 6th. Everything in America has changed; everything in this world has changed. - What is happening after that 400 years? The Lord is visiting the earth. The Bible calls it something: the beginning of sorrows. It is just the beginning, because he has begun to visit the earth. I am not saying we are going to be here 430 years; but what I can tell you is that we are living in the beginning of sorrows. The same way in ancient Egypt, after 400 years the Lord came down, started visiting, saw the affliction, and made preparation to deliver us out; it is the same way here in America. The Lord is putting things in place to destroy this place and deliver us up out of here. All the wars you see taking place is God making preparation to deliver us up out of here. 2 Esdras 15:5-11 54:06 - He went back to 2 Esdras 9:1-2 first: when you see part of the signs past, it is the very same time wherein the Highest will begin to visit the world which he made. How does the Lord visit the world that he has made? Behold, saith the Lord, I will bring plagues upon the world; the sword, famine, death, and destruction. That is how he visits the world. That is what you see taking place today, and the Lord is the one bringing it. - There were always wars, always death, always famine; but after 2019 it has been amplified. The Russia and Ukraine war, millions of people dead. The coronavirus, millions of people dead. Babies blown up in Palestine. Everybody is in sorrow right now. But those of you in America and in certain regions away from the wars, you are happy; you go to work every day, you have a good life, you have nothing to worry about as yet. That is why Christ says it is the beginning. - For wickedness hath exceedingly polluted the whole earth, and their hurtful works are fulfilled: all the hurtful works they have committed here in America are fulfilled. Therefore saith the Lord, I will hold my tongue no more as touching their wickedness. Behold, the innocent and righteous blood crieth unto me, and the souls of the just complain continually: this is going into them killing us. Therefore, saith the Lord, I will surely avenge them. - Behold, my people is led as a flock to the slaughter: in the future we will be led as a flock to the slaughter here in Babylon. I will not suffer them now to dwell in the land of Egypt: remember, America is spiritual Egypt. But I will bring them with a mighty hand and a stretched out arm, and smite Egypt with plagues, as before. The same way he smote Egypt with plagues in the past, he is going to do it again to this spiritual Egypt, after that 400 years. We could be here another 15 years, another 20 years; but just know the time we are living in is when the Lord has begun to visit the earth. Matthew 24:3-8 1:00:32 - As he sat upon the mount of Olives, the disciples came unto him privately, saying, Tell us, when shall these things be? And what shall be the sign of thy coming, and of the end of the world? The end of the world meaning the destruction of the people that are ruling the earth today. Christ is going to explain what we have to look for. - Take heed that no man deceive you. For many shall come in my name, saying, I am Christ. Who came in the name of Christ? You have Christians and you have those who call themselves Jews. They came in his name, saying they are following Christ, they are the anointed, they are the chosen people. What is it called in Revelation? The false prophets. And shall deceive many: they have deceived the whole earth. Ask anybody on earth what Christ looks like; they are going to say a white man. - And ye shall hear of wars and rumours of wars: see that ye be not troubled, for all these things must come to pass. Everything you see taking place now is a buildup; it is the Lord beginning to visit the earth, and it started after 2019, the 400 year mark. But the end is not yet. I want you all to understand: we are not living in the end as yet. - For nation shall rise against nation, and kingdom against kingdom. We are seeing that right now. And there shall be famines: we are seeing famines all over the earth because of these wars, and the famine is going to get worse, because of the strait of Hormuz being closed, and the Red Sea; and the fertilizer that comes from oil that they use on the crops. The famine is going to get worse in the next couple of years all over the world. - And pestilences: that is Ebola, that is the coronavirus. And earthquakes in divers places. When you see the pestilence, the earthquakes, and a bunch of wars, what is it called? All these are the beginning of sorrows. When you see these things, it is just the beginning. 2 Esdras 16:16-21 1:09:57 - Like as an arrow which is shot of a mighty archer returneth not backward, even so the plagues that shall be sent upon earth shall not return again. Who is sending the plagues upon the earth? The Lord. - Woe is me, woe is me, who will deliver me in those days? Ezra saw himself in these times also. So much death and destruction and pain is coming to the earth, and a lot of you are in la la land, worrying about the wrong things. You saw millions of people die these last couple of years; you saw how Fauci is the fall guy for the pandemic that killed millions; and millions of you got vaccinated for your job. Now they turn around and say you should not have taken it. Stop trusting these people. - The beginning of sorrows and great mournings; the beginning of famine and great death. They say over 15 million people died worldwide from the coronavirus: that is great death. Two to three million died in the Russia and Ukraine war: great death. Over a hundred thousand died in the war in Palestine: great death. And it says it is the beginning of great death. - The beginning of wars. We always had wars: the Iraq war, the Vietnam war. So why does it say the beginning of wars? Because there is a point in history when things begin to get worse and worse and worse. What point can we pinpoint when wars intensify? After the 400 years, after 2019. These are the wars that lead up to the war of Armageddon. Before 2019, the whole world loved the ones who call themselves Jews; if you spoke, they said you are antisemitic. Now the whole world is saying these people are genocidal. And think: you have seen little children bombed and killed over there. If you are a parent and your child gets killed, you do not just move on. Whole peoples have become radicalized now; America and Israel just mobilized millions against themselves. That war after 2019 was the beginning of the wars that lead up to Armageddon. - And the powers shall stand in fear; the beginning of evils. Evil is about to multiply on this earth. You see them running around chanting, get out of my country. What shall I do when these evils shall come? Ezra asked, because he knew he would be alive in these last days. - Behold, famine and plague, tribulation and anguish, are sent as scourges for amendment: God sent all these things as scourges, as judgment for the nations. But for all these things they shall not turn from their wickedness. Do you think the world is going to change? No matter all the plagues, death, and destruction, a lot of people are not going to turn from their wickedness, including our people here in America. They are not going to repent; they are going to get worse. - Nor be always mindful of the scourges: because it happens on one side of the world, then it stops, then it happens on another side, like a woman in travail. The same way a lot of you get up in the morning and do not think about what is going on in Iran or in the Congo, because you are comfortable. You have a roof, you are safe. It is not going to be like that all the time. - Behold, victuals shall be so good cheap upon earth, that they shall think themselves to be in good case. Food is cheap, clothing is cheap here in America; that is why you think you are good. But what is happening to the prices of food? Going up. The prices on everything are going to get very, very high. Those of you that have money right now, you better be buying and storing up. Revelation 6:7-10 1:25:04 - What seal are we living in? The seal we are living in is the fourth seal. When he opened the fourth seal: behold, a pale horse, and his name that sat on him was Death, and hell followed with him. And power was given unto them over the fourth part of the earth. The fourth part of the earth is talking about America. - Book shown in class: The Fourth Part of the World: "an astonishing epic of global discovery, imperial ambition, and the birth of America." You think they do not know? They know where the fourth part of the earth is. The fourth part of the world is America. - To kill with sword: with war. And with hunger: with famine. And with death: there will be much death; did we not read all these things in Matthew 24? And with the beasts of the earth: that is going into zoonosis, gain of function research. These diseases like Ebola and corona were created from beasts, from animals. - So this is letting you know who will be responsible for all the war, all the famine, and all the death that is going to take place on the earth: America. The fourth seal is the beginning of sorrows; it is America turning back into the oppressor, the king of Babylon. - Then the fifth seal: I saw under the altar the souls of them that were slain for the word of God, and for the testimony which they held. And they cried with a loud voice, saying, How long, O Lord, holy and true, dost thou not judge and avenge our blood on them that dwell on the earth? The fifth seal is the saints being killed; it is us being killed here in America, crying out for vengeance. That is the seal after the one we are in now. Isaiah 14:3-11, 16-19 1:31:47 - In the day that the Lord shall give thee rest from thy sorrow, and from thy fear, and from the hard bondage wherein thou wast made to serve: he is talking about us, the Israelites. Thou shalt take up this proverb against the king of Babylon: the king of Babylon here is America. - How hath the oppressor ceased! the golden city ceased! America is the oppressor, and the golden city because America is the richest country on the earth. America is going to bring oppression to its citizens, to Europe, to Iran, to everybody on the earth. That is what we are seeing right now; that is the fourth seal. - He who smote the people in wrath with a continual stroke, he that ruled the nations in anger, is persecuted, and none hindereth. They are the ones starting these wars, creating famine through these wars, unleashing bioweapon diseases on the earth. America caused the war in Russia and Ukraine by trying to expand NATO; America and Israel caused the war with Iran and Lebanon. - The whole earth is at rest, and is quiet: they break forth into singing. When America is destroyed, according to the Bible, the whole earth will be at rest, and everybody is going to be singing. Yea, the fir trees rejoice at thee, and the cedars of Lebanon, saying, Since thou art laid down, no feller is come up against us. That is what Lebanon is going to say, because right now Lebanon is being bombed. - Hell from beneath is moved for thee: all the nations that are below, on the bottom, will rise up against America. You see what is happening with Venezuela, with Cuba: that is the oppressor at work, and the nations will rise up against her. - All they shall speak and say unto thee, Art thou also become weak as we? This is letting you know America is in decline. When America left Afghanistan, the nations watched that and said, are you becoming weak? Now they are fighting Iran, and Iran is giving them a run, and Russia and China are watching, thinking, art thou become like unto us? And there will be civil war here in America that will weaken America; the fighting between the parties will spill out into a physical war. Once the nations see America is weak, they will rise up, and they will destroy America and Israel. - Thy pomp is brought down to the grave: your pride brought down to the ground. - They that see thee shall narrowly look upon thee, saying, Is this the man that made the earth to tremble, that did shake kingdoms? That made the earth tremble by dropping bombs. Right now Iran is being shaken. That made the world as a wilderness: look at Palestine right now, a wilderness. And it is going to get worse, because right now we are just living in the beginning of sorrows. - That opened not the house of his prisoners: we are his prisoners, and he will never let go. A lot of you think you are free; you are not free; you were never free. - All the kings of the nations lie in glory, every one in his own house: after this, every nation in its own land. But thou art cast out of thy grave like an abominable branch: this place will be destroyed and cast out. Jeremiah 51:7 1:42:51 - Babylon hath been a golden cup in the Lord's hand, that made all the earth drunken. America is that golden cup in the Lord's hand. The nations have drunken of her wine; therefore the nations are mad. Why are the nations mad? Because they drank of that wine, and that wine is going into oppression, affliction, war, judgment, death, famine, destruction, America dealing unjustly with all nations. - God used ancient Babylon to bring judgment on all the nations back then, including us. The same way the Lord used ancient Babylon, he is going to use America today, and America is going to bring death and destruction and judgment on all nations. And who is using America to do that? The Lord. Who is sending the plagues on the earth? The Lord. Remember, the Most High rules in the kingdom of men. Jeremiah 25:15-16 1:46:11 - The Lord told Jeremiah, take the wine cup of this fury at my hand, and cause all the nations to whom I send thee to drink it. So when the Lord says Babylon has been a golden cup in his hand, that cup is going into the Lord's fury. It is going into the fourth seal: America bringing death, famine, and destruction on the earth. - And they shall drink, and be moved, and be mad, because of the sword that I will send among them. How did the Lord send the sword amongst all nations back then? He used Babylon. Babylon came and conquered Egypt; Babylon destroyed us; Babylon conquered all those lands. The same way God used ancient Babylon as his cup and as his sword to bring judgment on the whole earth, Mystery Babylon the great holds that golden cup today, and they are bringing forth the fury, death, and destruction on all nations. Their brothers in Europe are going to feel it too. Revelation 18:1-4 1:49:45 - Babylon the great is fallen, is fallen, and is become the habitation of devils, and the hold of every foul spirit. This Babylon is talking about America, Mystery Babylon the great, the mother of harlots. - For all nations have drunk of the wine of the wrath of her fornication: this verse is letting you know why Babylon is destroyed. It goes right into that cup with the fury of the Lord, into the fourth seal. - And the merchants of the earth are waxed rich through the abundance of her delicacies: the nations are already rich. China is rich; Saudi Arabia is rich. Look how beautiful China is right now; they got like that in the last 40 to 60 years by trading with America. So the time for them to get rich has already passed; now they are rebelling against America. - And I heard another voice from heaven, saying, Come out of her, my people, that ye be not partakers of her sins, and that ye receive not of her plagues. Is it talking about leaving the country? No. It is saying separate yourself from the lies being pushed here in Babylon. There are plagues coming here to America, and you do not want to receive of them. Get rid of the Christmas, get rid of the Easter, stop following Christianity. Jesus Christ was not a white man. Come out of all of these lies that were taught to you in slavery. Micah 4:10 2:03:47 - Montage played of the politicians and pundits: "short-term pain for the long-term gain," over and over. They bombed Iran, the gas prices went high, everything went high, and they said, listen, it is a short-term pain; long-term it is going to be worth it. No. Let me tell you what the Bible says: there will be no short-term pain. There will be pain and pain and pain; there will be long-term pain with no gain. They started the war and now they are trying to pull out of it, but they cannot. Why? Because the Lord is behind it. The Lord wants America to do exactly what you see America doing. - News clip played: this week marks 150 days since the war of choice on Iran. He said the war would last five days, then two weeks; it has been 150 days. Regime change did not happen; the Ayatollahs are more entrenched than ever. The nuclear talks have broken down. Their ballistic missile stocks are higher than the Pentagon claims, and they launched more missiles at American troops just on Tuesday. The Houthi rebels are attacking civilian shipping in the Red Sea this week, and the strait of Hormuz is still closed. Americans have already spent nearly 500 dollars per household more on gas since this war began; gas in Delaware is 4.15 a gallon. Victuals are not cheap any more. And another report: the United States carried out fresh strikes on Iran despite a peace agreement signed just weeks ago; the conflict began on February 28th with joint US and Israeli operations. What they did there will cause a global depression, not a recession: a recession is no jobs; a depression is everybody suffering. - Be in pain, and labour to bring forth, O daughter of Zion, like a woman in travail. A woman in travail is bringing forth a baby: as the time gets closer, the pain increases, it gets stronger, and it comes closer together. Remember back in the day it would be a couple of years before some war popped off. After 2019, every year something crazy is happening; every month; matter of fact, every week. - For now shalt thou go forth out of the city, and thou shalt dwell in the field, and thou shalt go even to Babylon; there shalt thou be delivered. Right here in Babylon we are going to be delivered. The Lord is going to deliver us here in Babylon. 2 Esdras 16:36-46 2:05:51 - Behold the word of the Lord, receive it; believe not the gods of whom the Lord spake. Behold, the plagues draw nigh, and are not slack: as when a woman with child in the ninth month bringeth forth her son, within two or three hours of her birth great pains compass her womb, and when the child cometh forth they slack not a moment. Even so shall not the plagues be slack to come upon the earth. Those plagues are the war, the death, the famine, the destruction, the earthquakes, the man-made diseases. - And the world shall mourn, and sorrows shall come upon it on every side. On every side, meaning anywhere on this earth you go, you cannot run from it. You cannot run to Jamaica; you cannot run to Africa. Pain is going to come on every side of this earth, including here in America. There will be no short-term pain: the pain is going to increase and get worse as the time gets close. - O my people, hear my word: make you ready to the battle. What does that mean, brothers and sisters? You have to prepare. You better be preparing. Have a plan; sometimes the plan might not work, but still have plan A, B, C. Put up food; store food; store the things you are going to need. That is what God says to do. - And in those evils be even as pilgrims upon the earth. You have to be willing to lose everything, leave everything, and go. If you are in Texas and things get crazy in Texas, you better go. Talking about, I love my house, I worked my whole life for my house: you are going to end up dead. If you have to leave Babylon and go to another country, you better leave. Do not get comfortable. - He that selleth, let him be as he that fleeth away; he that buildeth, as he that shall not dwell therein; he that soweth, as if he should not reap. You build a house, you have to look at it as, I might not live in this house. You have a farm and you are planting; you might not be there to reap it, because you had to flee, because of the pain, because of the sorrows. - And therefore they that labour labour in vain: for strangers shall reap their fruits. They are going to try to take the goods and the things we prepared. Jeremiah 51:8-9 2:13:32 - Babylon is suddenly fallen and destroyed: howl for her; take balm for her pain, if so be she may be healed. What is balm? Ointment you put on pain to ease the pain. Remember what they said: short-term pain. Will there be any medicine you can take to stop the pain the Lord is about to send on this earth? Let us see if you can stop what God is about to make happen: the pain that is coming here to Babylon, the civil war and all the things you see coming here. - We would have healed Babylon, but she is not healed. This place is not going to be healed. The pains are not going to stop. Forsake her, and let us go every one into his own country: for her judgment reacheth unto heaven. God is about to judge her. Jeremiah 30:5-7 2:15:59 - We have heard a voice of trembling, of fear, and not of peace. Do not let anybody tell you that there will be peace on the earth. There will be no peace: it is death, destruction, and famine coming on this earth. - Wherefore do I see every man with his hands on his loins, as a woman in travail, and all faces are turned into paleness? Everybody holding their stomach; everybody scared. - Alas! for that day is great, so that none is like it: it is even the time of Jacob's trouble. Jacob's trouble is coming; great pains are coming. Brothers and sisters, prepare your mind; prepare yourself for what is coming. That is what the Lord commands us to do. 2 Esdras 15:15-24 2:17:49 - For the sword and their destruction draweth nigh, and one people shall stand up to fight against another, and swords in their hands. For there shall be sedition among men: that is what you see taking place right now, division and sedition amongst all nations, amongst Europe and America. - And invading one another: Russia just invaded Ukraine; they are bombing Iran; Israel just invaded Palestine; Israel just invaded Lebanon. This is what we are seeing. We are living in the beginning of sorrows, the time when the Lord said he begins to visit the earth. - A man shall desire to go into a city, and shall not be able. Why will you not be able to go to certain cities? Because there will be restrictions, there will be division, there will be civil war. America will be divided in the future. - A man shall have no pity upon his neighbour, but shall destroy their houses with the sword, and spoil their goods, because of the lack of bread, and for great tribulation. As the sorrows intensify, people are going to be running up in your house and taking your food; I am talking about some Walking Dead scenes. Great tribulation is coming, whether you believe it or not. I already told you, me and my brothers are prophets; by the time some of you realize it, it is going to be too late. - Behold, saith God, I will call together all the kings of the earth to reverence me, to turn themselves one against another, and repay the things that they have done to them. Look at the Houthis fighting with Saudi Arabia. Did you know that starting in 2014 they allowed Saudi Arabia to go to war with Yemen and starve them out? America blocked their shipping supply, and hundreds of thousands died from the bombing and the starvation. The only country that helped them was Iran; that is why they are so loyal to Iran, and why they have so much animosity toward Saudi Arabia and the West. When people cry death to this one or that one, they have reasons behind it. - Like as they do yet this day unto my chosen, so will I do also, and recompense in their bosom. Why are the Russians and Ukraine killing each other? Why is all this fighting happening over there in Palestine? Why is Iran and America fighting? It is because of what they did to us. So do not be mad; do not be sad. It is God's judgment for what was done to his chosen. - My right hand shall not spare the sinners, and my sword shall not cease over them that shed innocent blood upon the earth. Woe to them that sin, and keep not my commandments: those of you brothers and sisters that sin and do not keep God's commandments, the Bible says woe unto you. Isaiah 13:6-19 2:25:41 - Howl ye; for the day of the Lord is at hand; it shall come as a destruction from the Almighty. Therefore shall all hands be faint, and every man's heart shall melt. - Pangs and sorrows shall take hold of them; they shall be in pain as a woman that travaileth. There is pain coming on this earth to the wicked, to all the nations, and like a woman in travail it is going to increase and increase and get worse and worse. That is why the Lord said, when you see these things happening, do not be troubled: it is the beginning of sorrows, the Lord judging the nations for what they did to us. - Behold, the day of the Lord cometh, cruel both with wrath and fierce anger, to lay the land desolate. The land is America, Mystery Babylon, going to be destroyed.
